Taking tanθ_m = 0.44 for the main span and tanθ_s = 0.40 for the side span: H = V/(0.44+0.40) ≈ 651 MN for both cables, 326 MN each; T = 326×√(1+0.44²) ≈ 356 MN. Wire area per cable 27,572×18.68 mm² ≈ 515,000 mm² gives a stress of about 691 N/mm², a factor of about 2.19 on the 1,517 N/mm² minimum strength. The angles are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「由塔頂荷重反推主纜張力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Back-calculating cable tension from tower load", which statement holds?
options: 吊索只是把橋面掛起來的細鋼索，壞一兩根不影響整體。
把橋面換輕只會讓橋更安全，不會改變幾何。
optionsEn: Suspenders are just thin ropes hanging the deck; losing one or two does not matter.
A lighter deck only makes the bridge safer; it does not change the geometry.
quiz.explanation: V = 61,500 short ton×907.2 kg×9.81 ≈ 547 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: V = 61,500 short tons×907.2 kg×9.81 ≈ 547 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 由塔頂荷重反推主纜張力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Back-calculating cable tension from tower load: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「每塔 61,500 噸纜力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “61,500-ton cable load per tower” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以竣工測量或光達掃描取得塔頂兩側主纜實際傾角，代回計算 H 與 T，並與原設計值和有限元素模型比較；若三者差異超過約定範圍，檢查恆載假設（例如 1986 年更換後的橋面重量）與塔頂索鞍位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain actual cable angles on both sides of the tower top from as-built survey or lidar, recompute H and T, and compare with original design values and the finite-element model; if the three differ beyond an agreed band, check dead-load assumptions such as the deck weight after the 1986 replacement and the saddle positions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：既有懸索橋的評估報告應附一份「恆載履歷表」，逐項列出歷次改造增減的重量與日期，並以塔頂反力與主纜幾何做獨立驗算，作為與有限元素模型比對的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: An evaluation of an existing suspension bridge should include a dead-load history listing the weight added or removed by each modification with dates, and an independent check from tower reactions and cable geometry as the benchmark for the finite-element model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若評估仍沿用 1937 年的恆載而忽略後來的橋面更換、加勁與附加設施，計算出的主纜應力與安全係數會偏離實際；反過來若遺漏新增荷重（防墜網、抗風整流板），可能高估剩餘容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An evaluation still using 1937 dead loads, ignoring later deck replacement, bracing and attachments, misstates cable stress and safety factor; conversely, missing added loads such as the deterrent net or wind fairings can overstate remaining capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以竣工測量或光達掃描取得塔頂兩側主纜實際傾角，代回計算 H 與 T，並與原設計值和有限元素模型比較；若三者差異超過約定範圍，檢查恆載假設（例如 1986 年更換後的橋面重量）與塔頂索鞍位置。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain actual cable angles on both sides of the tower top from as-built survey or lidar, recompute H and T, and compare with original design values and the finite-element model; if the three differ beyond an agreed band, check dead-load assumptions such as the deck weight after the 1986 replacement and the saddle positions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 既有懸索橋的評估報告應附一份「恆載履歷表」，逐項列出歷次改造增減的重量與日期，並以塔頂反力與主纜幾何做獨立驗算，作為與有限元素模型比對的基準。
knowledge.textEn: An evaluation of an existing suspension bridge should include a dead-load history listing the weight added or removed by each modification with dates, and an independent check from tower reactions and cable geometry as the benchmark for the finite-element model.

quiz.question: 要驗證「由塔頂荷重反推主纜張力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Back-calculating cable tension from tower load"?
options: 以竣工測量或光達掃描取得塔頂兩側主纜實際傾角，代回計算 H 與 T，並與原設計值和有限元素模型比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
螺栓一旦鎖到規定張力，就能永久保持。
optionsEn: Obtain actual cable angles on both sides of the tower top from as-built survey or lidar, recompute H and T, and compare with original design values and the finite-element model.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once bolts are tightened to the specified tension, they keep it forever.
quiz.explanation: 以竣工測量或光達掃描取得塔頂兩側主纜實際傾角，代回計算 H 與 T，並與原設計值和有限元素模型比較；若三者差異超過約定範圍，檢查恆載假設（例如 1986 年更換後的橋面重量）與塔頂索鞍位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain actual cable angles on both sides of the tower top from as-built survey or lidar, recompute H and T, and compare with original design values and the finite-element model; if the three differ beyond an agreed band, check dead-load assumptions such as the deck weight after the 1986 replacement and the saddle positions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 由塔頂荷重反推主纜張力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Back-calculating cable tension from tower load: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「每塔 61,500 噸纜力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “61,500-ton cable load per tower” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若評估仍沿用 1937 年的恆載而忽略後來的橋面更換、加勁與附加設施，計算出的主纜應力與安全係數會偏離實際；反過來若遺漏新增荷重（防墜網、抗風整流板），可能高估剩餘容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An evaluation still using 1937 dead loads, ignoring later deck replacement, bracing and attachments, misstates cable stress and safety factor; conversely, missing added loads such as the deterrent net or wind fairings can overstate remaining capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種「由支承反力反推內力」的檢核，是評估既有懸索橋時最常用的獨立驗算，可與原始計算書或有限元素模型相互印證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Back-calculating internal forces from support reactions is the most common independent check when evaluating an existing suspension bridge, cross-checking the original calculations or a finite-element model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔頂荷重就等於主纜張力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The load on the tower equals the cable tension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若評估仍沿用 1937 年的恆載而忽略後來的橋面更換、加勁與附加設施，計算出的主纜應力與安全係數會偏離實際；反過來若遺漏新增荷重（防墜網、抗風整流板），可能高估剩餘容量。
knowledge.textEn: An evaluation still using 1937 dead loads, ignoring later deck replacement, bracing and attachments, misstates cable stress and safety factor; conversely, missing added loads such as the deterrent net or wind fairings can overstate remaining capacity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「由塔頂荷重反推主纜張力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Back-calculating cable tension from tower load" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若評估仍沿用 1937 年的恆載而忽略後來的橋面更換、加勁與附加設施，計算出的主纜應力與安全係數會偏離實際。
懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An evaluation still using 1937 dead loads, ignoring later deck replacement, bracing and attachments, misstates cable stress and safety factor.
A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load.
quiz.explanation: 若評估仍沿用 1937 年的恆載而忽略後來的橋面更換、加勁與附加設施，計算出的主纜應力與安全係數會偏離實際；反過來若遺漏新增荷重（防墜網、抗風整流板），可能高估剩餘容量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An evaluation still using 1937 dead loads, ignoring later deck replacement, bracing and attachments, misstates cable stress and safety factor; conversely, missing added loads such as the deterrent net or wind fairings can overstate remaining capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 主纜重力勁度與橫向變位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「27.7 ft 橫向變位」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “27.7 ft lateral deflection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主資料列出主跨中央最大橫向變位約 27.7 ft（約 8.4 m），遠大於最大下垂 10.8 ft 與上揚 5.8 ft。懸索橋抵抗側風的勁度主要不是來自加勁桁架的側向彎曲，而是來自主纜的「重力勁度」：受張的主纜像鐘擺一樣，被側向推開時，張力的水平分量會把它拉回中心。張力越大、跨徑越短，回復力越強；1950 年代增設的下層橫向斜撐則提高了橋面本身的側向與扭轉勁度，兩者共同決定側風下的變位與振動特性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「27.7 ft 橫向變位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Owner data list a maximum transverse deflection at mid-span of about 27.7 ft (about 8.4 m), far more than the maximum downward 10.8 ft and upward 5.8 ft. A suspension bridge resists crosswind mainly not through lateral bending of the stiffening truss but through the gravity stiffness of the cables: like a pendulum, a tensioned cable pushed sideways is pulled back by the horizontal component of its tension. Higher tension and shorter span give stronger restoring force; the lower lateral bracing added in the 1950s raised the deck's own lateral and torsional stiffness, and the two together set deflection and vibration in crosswinds. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “27.7 ft lateral deflection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以弦受側向均布力估算 δ = w_L·l²/(8H)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate with a string under uniform lateral load δ = w_L·l²/(8H).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「27.7 ft 橫向變位」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “27.7 ft lateral deflection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主纜重力勁度與橫向變位
knowledge.titleEn: Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection
knowledge.text: 業主資料列出主跨中央最大橫向變位約 27.7 ft（約 8.4 m），遠大於最大下垂 10.8 ft 與上揚 5.8 ft。懸索橋抵抗側風的勁度主要不是來自加勁桁架的側向彎曲，而是來自主纜的「重力勁度」：受張的主纜像鐘擺一樣，被側向推開時，張力的水平分量會把它拉回中心。
knowledge.textEn: Owner data list a maximum transverse deflection at mid-span of about 27.7 ft (about 8.4 m), far more than the maximum downward 10.8 ft and upward 5.8 ft. A suspension bridge resists crosswind mainly not through lateral bending of the stiffening truss but through the gravity stiffness of the cables: like a pendulum, a tensioned cable pushed sideways is pulled back by the horizontal component of its tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主纜重力勁度與橫向變位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection" is correct?
options: 懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。
老橋的鋼絲強度一定比規格值低很多，所以不值得試驗。
業主資料列出主跨中央最大橫向變位約 27.7 ft（約 8.4 m），遠大於最大下垂 10.8 ft 與上揚 5.8 ft。
optionsEn: A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load.
Old bridge wire is always far below its specification, so testing is pointless.
Owner data list a maximum transverse deflection at mid-span of about 27.7 ft (about 8.4 m), far more than the maximum downward 10.8 ft and upward 5.8 ft.
quiz.explanation: 業主資料列出主跨中央最大橫向變位約 27.7 ft（約 8.4 m），遠大於最大下垂 10.8 ft 與上揚 5.8 ft。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Owner data list a maximum transverse deflection at mid-span of about 27.7 ft (about 8.4 m), far more than the maximum downward 10.8 ft and upward 5.8 ft. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主纜重力勁度與橫向變位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「27.7 ft 橫向變位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “27.7 ft lateral deflection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以弦受側向均布力估算 δ = w_L·l²/(8H)。取 H = 651 MN（兩纜合計）、l = 1,280 m、側向風力 w_L = 15 kN/m：δ = 15×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 4.7 m；反算達到 8.4 m 需 w_L ≈ 8×651,000×8.44/1,280² ≈ 26.9 kN/m。忽略桁架側向勁度，為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate with a string under uniform lateral load δ = w_L·l²/(8H). With H = 651 MN for both cables, l = 1,280 m and lateral wind load w_L = 15 kN/m: δ = 15×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 4.7 m; reaching 8.4 m would need w_L ≈ 8×651,000×8.44/1,280² ≈ 26.9 kN/m. Truss lateral stiffness is ignored; values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 GNSS 在跨中與四分點量測強風中的側向位移，同步記錄橋面高度的風速風向，將位移對風壓（∝U²）作圖，檢查斜率是否符合重力勁度加桁架勁度的模型；並比較伸縮縫與風支承在側向位移時的行程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure lateral displacement in strong wind with GNSS at mid-span and quarter points, recording deck-level wind speed and direction, plot displacement against wind pressure (∝U²) and check the slope against a gravity-plus-truss stiffness model; also compare the travel of expansion joints and wind shoes during lateral movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以弦受側向均布力估算 δ = w_L·l²/(8H)。取 H = 651 MN（兩纜合計）、l = 1,280 m、側向風力 w_L = 15 kN/m：δ = 15×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 4.7 m；反算達到 8.4 m 需 w_L ≈ 8×651,000×8.44/1,280² ≈ 26.9 kN/m。忽略桁架側向勁度，為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate with a string under uniform lateral load δ = w_L·l²/(8H). With H = 651 MN for both cables, l = 1,280 m and lateral wind load w_L = 15 kN/m: δ = 15×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 4.7 m; reaching 8.4 m would need w_L ≈ 8×651,000×8.44/1,280² ≈ 26.9 kN/m. Truss lateral stiffness is ignored; values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主纜重力勁度與橫向變位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection", which statement holds?
options: 以弦受側向均布力估算 δ = w_L·l²/(8H)。
空中紡線的速度只取決於紡線輪跑多快。
只要整座橋在強風中穩定，欄杆的振動與聲音就不是工程問題。
optionsEn: Estimate with a string under uniform lateral load δ = w_L·l²/(8H).
Aerial-spinning speed depends only on how fast the wheels run.
If the whole bridge is stable in strong wind, railing vibration and noise are not engineering problems.
quiz.explanation: 以弦受側向均布力估算 δ = w_L·l²/(8H)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate with a string under uniform lateral load δ = w_L·l²/(8H). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主纜重力勁度與橫向變位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「27.7 ft 橫向變位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “27.7 ft lateral deflection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以 GNSS 在跨中與四分點量測強風中的側向位移，同步記錄橋面高度的風速風向，將位移對風壓（∝U²）作圖，檢查斜率是否符合重力勁度加桁架勁度的模型；並比較伸縮縫與風支承在側向位移時的行程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure lateral displacement in strong wind with GNSS at mid-span and quarter points, recording deck-level wind speed and direction, plot displacement against wind pressure (∝U²) and check the slope against a gravity-plus-truss stiffness model; also compare the travel of expansion joints and wind shoes during lateral movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：任何會增加橋面受風面積或改變斷面形狀的工程，都要在設計階段提出側風變位與氣動穩定的評估，並由業主的風工程顧問核可；評估須同時列出伸縮縫、風支承與管線的位移容量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Any work that adds wind area or changes the deck section must come with an assessment of lateral deflection and aerodynamic stability at design stage, approved by the owner's wind consultant, listing the displacement capacity of joints, wind shoes and services.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若改造增加了橋面側向受風面積（例如加裝圍欄或設備）而未更新側風分析，實際橫向變位與伸縮縫行程需求可能超出原設計；側向勁度不足也會讓渦振與扭轉耦合更容易發生。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a modification increases the deck's lateral wind area, such as new fencing or equipment, without updating the crosswind analysis, actual lateral deflection and joint travel demand may exceed design; low lateral stiffness also makes vortex and torsional coupling easier. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 GNSS 在跨中與四分點量測強風中的側向位移，同步記錄橋面高度的風速風向，將位移對風壓（∝U²）作圖，檢查斜率是否符合重力勁度加桁架勁度的模型；並比較伸縮縫與風支承在側向位移時的行程。
knowledge.textEn: Measure lateral displacement in strong wind with GNSS at mid-span and quarter points, recording deck-level wind speed and direction, plot displacement against wind pressure (∝U²) and check the slope against a gravity-plus-truss stiffness model; also compare the travel of expansion joints and wind shoes during lateral movement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 任何會增加橋面受風面積或改變斷面形狀的工程，都要在設計階段提出側風變位與氣動穩定的評估，並由業主的風工程顧問核可；評估須同時列出伸縮縫、風支承與管線的位移容量。
knowledge.textEn: Any work that adds wind area or changes the deck section must come with an assessment of lateral deflection and aerodynamic stability at design stage, approved by the owner's wind consultant, listing the displacement capacity of joints, wind shoes and services.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主纜重力勁度與橫向變位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

quiz.explanationEn: Measure lateral displacement in strong wind with GNSS at mid-span and quarter points, recording deck-level wind speed and direction, plot displacement against wind pressure (∝U²) and check the slope against a gravity-plus-truss stiffness model; also compare the travel of expansion joints and wind shoes during lateral movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主纜重力勁度與橫向變位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「27.7 ft 橫向變位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “27.7 ft lateral deflection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若改造增加了橋面側向受風面積（例如加裝圍欄或設備）而未更新側風分析，實際橫向變位與伸縮縫行程需求可能超出原設計；側向勁度不足也會讓渦振與扭轉耦合更容易發生。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a modification increases the deck's lateral wind area, such as new fencing or equipment, without updating the crosswind analysis, actual lateral deflection and joint travel demand may exceed design; low lateral stiffness also makes vortex and torsional coupling easier. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：張力越大、跨徑越短，回復力越強；1950 年代增設的下層橫向斜撐則提高了橋面本身的側向與扭轉勁度，兩者共同決定側風下的變位與振動特性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Higher tension and shorter span give stronger restoring force; the lower lateral bracing added in the 1950s raised the deck's own lateral and torsional stiffness, and the two together set deflection and vibration in crosswinds.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若改造增加了橋面側向受風面積（例如加裝圍欄或設備）而未更新側風分析，實際橫向變位與伸縮縫行程需求可能超出原設計；側向勁度不足也會讓渦振與扭轉耦合更容易發生。
knowledge.textEn: If a modification increases the deck's lateral wind area, such as new fencing or equipment, without updating the crosswind analysis, actual lateral deflection and joint travel demand may exceed design; low lateral stiffness also makes vortex and torsional coupling easier.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主纜重力勁度與橫向變位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cable gravity stiffness and lateral deflection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
老橋的鋼絲強度一定比規格值低很多，所以不值得試驗。
若改造增加了橋面側向受風面積（例如加裝圍欄或設備）而未更新側風分析，實際橫向變位與伸縮縫行程需求可能超出原設計；側向勁度不足也會讓渦振與扭轉耦合更容易發生。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Old bridge wire is always far below its specification, so testing is pointless.

If a modification increases the deck's lateral wind area, such as new fencing or equipment, without updating the crosswind analysis, actual lateral deflection and joint travel demand may exceed design.
quiz.explanation: 若改造增加了橋面側向受風面積（例如加裝圍欄或設備）而未更新側風分析，實際橫向變位與伸縮縫行程需求可能超出原設計；側向勁度不足也會讓渦振與扭轉耦合更容易發生。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If a modification increases the deck's lateral wind area, such as new fencing or equipment, without updating the crosswind analysis, actual lateral deflection and joint travel demand may exceed design; low lateral stiffness also makes vortex and torsional coupling easier. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「1930 年代鋼絲的強度與延性」與「吊索受力與 1970 年代全面更換」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strength and ductility of the 1930s wire" and "Suspender forces and the 1970s full replacement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 1930 年代鋼絲的強度與延性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strength and ductility of the 1930s wire: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「0.192 in 鍍鋅鋼絲」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “0.192 in galvanised wire” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 金門大橋每條主纜含 27,572 根直徑 0.192 in（約 4.88 mm）的鍍鋅鋼絲，分成 61 束、平均每束約 452 根，連同纏繞外徑約 36⅜ in（0.92 m）。業主公布的鋼絲平均抗拉強度 235,600 psi（規格最低 220,000 psi）、降伏強度 182,600 psi、斷裂伸長率 6.3%（最低 4.0%）。與現代 1,770 至 1,960 MPa 級鋼絲相比強度較低，但延性與降伏比較寬裕；評估既有主纜時，要用當時規格的最低值與實際抽樣結果，而不是現代鋼絲的數字。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「0.192 in 鍍鋅鋼絲」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each Golden Gate cable contains 27,572 galvanised wires of 0.192 in (about 4.88 mm) diameter in 61 strands averaging about 452 wires, about 36⅜ in (0.92 m) in diameter with wrapping. The owner lists average wire tensile strength of 235,600 psi (220,000 psi specified minimum), yield of 182,600 psi and elongation at rupture of 6.3% (4.0% minimum). The strength is lower than modern 1,770 to 1,960 MPa wire, but ductility and yield ratio are generous; evaluating an existing cable must use the period specification minimum and actual sample results, not modern wire figures. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “0.192 in galvanised wire” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Conversions: 235,600 psi ≈ 1,624 N/mm², 220,000 psi ≈ 1,517 N/mm², 182,600 psi ≈ 1,259 N/mm², a yield ratio ≈ 0.775.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「老橋的鋼絲強度一定比規格值低很多，所以不值得試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Old bridge wire is always far below its specification, so testing is pointless." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「0.192 in 鍍鋅鋼絲」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “0.192 in galvanised wire”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 1930 年代鋼絲的強度與延性
knowledge.titleEn: Strength and ductility of the 1930s wire
knowledge.text: 金門大橋每條主纜含 27,572 根直徑 0.192 in（約 4.88 mm）的鍍鋅鋼絲，分成 61 束、平均每束約 452 根，連同纏繞外徑約 36⅜ in（0.92 m）。業主公布的鋼絲平均抗拉強度 235,600 psi（規格最低 220,000 psi）、降伏強度 182,600 psi、斷裂伸長率 6.3%（最低 4.0%）。
knowledge.textEn: Each Golden Gate cable contains 27,572 galvanised wires of 0.192 in (about 4.88 mm) diameter in 61 strands averaging about 452 wires, about 36⅜ in (0.92 m) in diameter with wrapping. The owner lists average wire tensile strength of 235,600 psi (220,000 psi specified minimum), yield of 182,600 psi and elongation at rupture of 6.3% (4.0% minimum).

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：老橋的鋼絲強度一定比規格值低很多，所以不值得試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Old bridge wire is always far below its specification, so testing is pointless. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「1930 年代鋼絲的強度與延性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strength and ductility of the 1930s wire" is correct?
options: 金門大橋每條主纜含 27,572 根直徑 0.192 in（約 4.88 mm）的鍍鋅鋼絲，分成 61 束、平均每束約 452 根，連同纏繞外徑約 36⅜ in（0.92 m）。
老橋的鋼絲強度一定比規格值低很多，所以不值得試驗。
吊索只是把橋面掛起來的細鋼索，壞一兩根不影響整體。
optionsEn: Each Golden Gate cable contains 27,572 galvanised wires of 0.192 in (about 4.88 mm) diameter in 61 strands averaging about 452 wires, about 36⅜ in (0.92 m) in diameter with wrapping.
Old bridge wire is always far below its specification, so testing is pointless.
Suspenders are just thin ropes hanging the deck; losing one or two does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 金門大橋每條主纜含 27,572 根直徑 0.192 in（約 4.88 mm）的鍍鋅鋼絲，分成 61 束、平均每束約 452 根，連同纏繞外徑約 36⅜ in（0.92 m）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each Golden Gate cable contains 27,572 galvanised wires of 0.192 in (about 4.88 mm) diameter in 61 strands averaging about 452 wires, about 36⅜ in (0.92 m) in diameter with wrapping. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 1930 年代鋼絲的強度與延性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strength and ductility of the 1930s wire: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「0.192 in 鍍鋅鋼絲」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “0.192 in galvanised wire” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：換算：235,600 psi ≈ 1,624 N/mm²、220,000 psi ≈ 1,517 N/mm²、182,600 psi ≈ 1,259 N/mm²，降伏比 ≈ 0.775。單絲面積 π/4×4.877² ≈ 18.68 mm²，每纜面積 ≈ 515,000 mm²，以最低強度計破斷力 ≈ 781 MN。兩纜總長核算：2×27,572×2,332 m ≈ 128,600 km，與公布的約 129,000 km 一致。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Conversions: 235,600 psi ≈ 1,624 N/mm², 220,000 psi ≈ 1,517 N/mm², 182,600 psi ≈ 1,259 N/mm², a yield ratio ≈ 0.775. Wire area π/4×4.877² ≈ 18.68 mm², about 515,000 mm² per cable, for a minimum breaking force ≈ 781 MN. Total length check: 2×27,572×2,332 m ≈ 128,600 km, matching the published 129,000 km or so. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開纜檢查時取出代表性鋼絲做拉伸、伸長率與扭轉試驗，並以金相與鍍鋅層量測判斷腐蝕階段；依試驗結果與斷絲統計建立剩餘強度模型，比較設計時的最低強度與實際分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During cable openings remove representative wires for tensile, elongation and torsion tests, and assess corrosion stage by metallography and zinc measurement; build a remaining-strength model from test results and broken-wire counts, comparing the original specified minimum with the actual distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Conversions: 235,600 psi ≈ 1,624 N/mm², 220,000 psi ≈ 1,517 N/mm², 182,600 psi ≈ 1,259 N/mm², a yield ratio ≈ 0.775. Wire area π/4×4.877² ≈ 18.68 mm², about 515,000 mm² per cable, for a minimum breaking force ≈ 781 MN. Total length check: 2×27,572×2,332 m ≈ 128,600 km, matching the published 129,000 km or so.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「1930 年代鋼絲的強度與延性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strength and ductility of the 1930s wire", which statement holds?
options: 把橋面換輕只會讓橋更安全，不會改變幾何。
螺栓一旦鎖到規定張力，就能永久保持。
optionsEn: A lighter deck only makes the bridge safer; it does not change the geometry.
Conversions: 235,600 psi ≈ 1,624 N/mm², 220,000 psi ≈ 1,517 N/mm², 182,600 psi ≈ 1,259 N/mm², a yield ratio ≈ 0.775.
Once bolts are tightened to the specified tension, they keep it forever.
quiz.explanationEn: Conversions: 235,600 psi ≈ 1,624 N/mm², 220,000 psi ≈ 1,517 N/mm², 182,600 psi ≈ 1,259 N/mm², a yield ratio ≈ 0.775. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 1930 年代鋼絲的強度與延性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strength and ductility of the 1930s wire: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「0.192 in 鍍鋅鋼絲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “0.192 in galvanised wire” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 開纜檢查時取出代表性鋼絲做拉伸、伸長率與扭轉試驗，並以金相與鍍鋅層量測判斷腐蝕階段；依試驗結果與斷絲統計建立剩餘強度模型，比較設計時的最低強度與實際分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During cable openings remove representative wires for tensile, elongation and torsion tests, and assess corrosion stage by metallography and zinc measurement; build a remaining-strength model from test results and broken-wire counts, comparing the original specified minimum with the actual distribution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保存原始鋼絲規格與出廠試驗紀錄，每次開纜取樣都要記錄位置、束號與試驗結果，納入同一資料庫，讓日後的剩餘強度評估能追溯並比較趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep the original wire specification and mill test records, and log location, strand number and results for every cable sample in one database so later remaining-strength evaluations can trace and compare trends.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若評估直接套用現代鋼絲強度，主纜安全係數會被高估；反之若只依外觀判斷而不做試驗，可能忽略內部鋼絲的脆化或腐蝕裂縫，延誤除濕或補強決策。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying modern wire strengths overstates the cable's safety factor; judging only by appearance without testing can miss embrittlement or corrosion cracking of inner wires and delay dehumidification or strengthening decisions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 開纜檢查時取出代表性鋼絲做拉伸、伸長率與扭轉試驗，並以金相與鍍鋅層量測判斷腐蝕階段；依試驗結果與斷絲統計建立剩餘強度模型，比較設計時的最低強度與實際分布。
knowledge.textEn: During cable openings remove representative wires for tensile, elongation and torsion tests, and assess corrosion stage by metallography and zinc measurement; build a remaining-strength model from test results and broken-wire counts, comparing the original specified minimum with the actual distribution.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保存原始鋼絲規格與出廠試驗紀錄，每次開纜取樣都要記錄位置、束號與試驗結果，納入同一資料庫，讓日後的剩餘強度評估能追溯並比較趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Keep the original wire specification and mill test records, and log location, strand number and results for every cable sample in one database so later remaining-strength evaluations can trace and compare trends.

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The deterrent net is a light accessory with no effect on structure or wind stability.
During cable openings remove representative wires for tensile, elongation and torsion tests, and assess corrosion stage by metallography and zinc measurement.
quiz.explanation: 開纜檢查時取出代表性鋼絲做拉伸、伸長率與扭轉試驗，並以金相與鍍鋅層量測判斷腐蝕階段；依試驗結果與斷絲統計建立剩餘強度模型，比較設計時的最低強度與實際分布。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 1930 年代鋼絲的強度與延性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strength and ductility of the 1930s wire: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「0.192 in 鍍鋅鋼絲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “0.192 in galvanised wire” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若評估直接套用現代鋼絲強度，主纜安全係數會被高估；反之若只依外觀判斷而不做試驗，可能忽略內部鋼絲的脆化或腐蝕裂縫，延誤除濕或補強決策。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying modern wire strengths overstates the cable's safety factor; judging only by appearance without testing can miss embrittlement or corrosion cracking of inner wires and delay dehumidification or strengthening decisions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：與現代 1,770 至 1,960 MPa 級鋼絲相比強度較低，但延性與降伏比較寬裕；評估既有主纜時，要用當時規格的最低值與實際抽樣結果，而不是現代鋼絲的數字。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The strength is lower than modern 1,770 to 1,960 MPa wire, but ductility and yield ratio are generous; evaluating an existing cable must use the period specification minimum and actual sample results, not modern wire figures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「老橋的鋼絲強度一定比規格值低很多，所以不值得試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Old bridge wire is always far below its specification, so testing is pointless." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「1930 年代鋼絲的強度與延性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
吊索只是把橋面掛起來的細鋼索，壞一兩根不影響整體。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Suspenders are just thin ropes hanging the deck; losing one or two does not matter.
