steps.title: 第 3B 期主橋耐震改造：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「38 組消能裝置」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “38 energy-dissipation devices” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以非線性黏滯阻尼器說明消能：F = C·v^α。取 C = 3,000 kN·(s/m)^0.4、α = 0.4、振幅 X = 0.5 m、週期 4 s（ω = 1.571 rad/s）：峰值速度 0.785 m/s，F ≈ 3,000×0.785^0.4 ≈ 2,720 kN；每循環耗能 E = λ·C·X^(1+α)·ω^α，λ ≈ 3.58，E ≈ 4,880 kJ。裝置型式與參數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Illustrate dissipation with a nonlinear viscous damper F = C·v^α. With C = 3,000 kN·(s/m)^0.4, α = 0.4, amplitude X = 0.5 m and a 4 s period (ω = 1.571 rad/s): peak velocity 0.785 m/s and F ≈ 3,000×0.785^0.4 ≈ 2,720 kN; energy per cycle E = λ·C·X^(1+α)·ω^α with λ ≈ 3.58 gives E ≈ 4,880 kJ. Device type and parameters are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：消能裝置須做原型與逐件試驗，涵蓋設計速度範圍、溫度與循環次數，力—位移遲滯迴圈的耗能與規格比較；全橋以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層紀錄，檢查塔底應力、伸縮縫三維位移與橋面斜撐受力是否符合兩級地震的性能目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Damping devices need prototype and production tests over the design velocity range, temperatures and cycle counts, comparing hysteresis-loop energy with the specification; the whole bridge is analysed by nonlinear time history with several near-fault records to check tower-base stress, three-dimensional joint movement and lateral-bracing forces against the performance goals for both earthquake levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以非線性黏滯阻尼器說明消能：F = C·v^α。取 C = 3,000 kN·(s/m)^0.4、α = 0.4、振幅 X = 0.5 m、週期 4 s（ω = 1.571 rad/s）：峰值速度 0.785 m/s，F ≈ 3,000×0.785^0.4 ≈ 2,720 kN；每循環耗能 E = λ·C·X^(1+α)·ω^α，λ ≈ 3.58，E ≈ 4,880 kJ。裝置型式與參數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Illustrate dissipation with a nonlinear viscous damper F = C·v^α. With C = 3,000 kN·(s/m)^0.4, α = 0.4, amplitude X = 0.5 m and a 4 s period (ω = 1.571 rad/s): peak velocity 0.785 m/s and F ≈ 3,000×0.785^0.4 ≈ 2,720 kN; energy per cycle E = λ·C·X^(1+α)·ω^α with λ ≈ 3.58 gives E ≈ 4,880 kJ. Device type and parameters are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「第 3B 期主橋耐震改造」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge", which statement holds?
options: 懸索橋的橫向勁度主要來自橋面桁架，主纜只負責垂直荷重。
以非線性黏滯阻尼器說明消能：F = C·v^α。
吊索只是把橋面掛起來的細鋼索，壞一兩根不影響整體。
optionsEn: A suspension bridge's lateral stiffness comes mainly from the deck truss; the cables only carry vertical load.
Illustrate dissipation with a nonlinear viscous damper F = C·v^α.
Suspenders are just thin ropes hanging the deck; losing one or two does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以非線性黏滯阻尼器說明消能：F = C·v^α。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Illustrate dissipation with a nonlinear viscous damper F = C·v^α. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 第 3B 期主橋耐震改造：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「38 組消能裝置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “38 energy-dissipation devices” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 消能裝置須做原型與逐件試驗，涵蓋設計速度範圍、溫度與循環次數，力—位移遲滯迴圈的耗能與規格比較；全橋以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層紀錄，檢查塔底應力、伸縮縫三維位移與橋面斜撐受力是否符合兩級地震的性能目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Damping devices need prototype and production tests over the design velocity range, temperatures and cycle counts, comparing hysteresis-loop energy with the specification; the whole bridge is analysed by nonlinear time history with several near-fault records to check tower-base stress, three-dimensional joint movement and lateral-bracing forces against the performance goals for both earthquake levels. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：耐震改造的分期順序應依構件勁度與倒塌後果排定（業主先做較不柔的橋塔與邊跨），每期完工都要更新全橋模型與性能矩陣；消能裝置需納入定期檢查與抽測計畫，並保存原型試驗曲線作為基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Sequence retrofit phases by stiffness and collapse consequence (the owner starts with the less flexible towers and side spans), updating the whole-bridge model and performance matrix at the end of each phase; put damping devices on a periodic inspection and sampling programme with prototype test curves kept as the baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只補強主橋而不處理伸縮縫，大地震時橋面與塔之間的相對位移可能使伸縮縫破壞、支承脫落；消能裝置若在長期風與交通的小振幅循環中磨耗而未檢查，地震時的耗能可能遠低於設計。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Strengthening the main bridge without new joints lets relative movement between deck and towers in a large earthquake destroy joints and unseat bearings; dampers worn by years of small wind and traffic cycles without inspection may dissipate far less energy than designed in an earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 消能裝置須做原型與逐件試驗，涵蓋設計速度範圍、溫度與循環次數，力—位移遲滯迴圈的耗能與規格比較；全橋以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層紀錄，檢查塔底應力、伸縮縫三維位移與橋面斜撐受力是否符合兩級地震的性能目標。
knowledge.textEn: Damping devices need prototype and production tests over the design velocity range, temperatures and cycle counts, comparing hysteresis-loop energy with the specification; the whole bridge is analysed by nonlinear time history with several near-fault records to check tower-base stress, three-dimensional joint movement and lateral-bracing forces against the performance goals for both earthquake levels.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 耐震改造的分期順序應依構件勁度與倒塌後果排定（業主先做較不柔的橋塔與邊跨），每期完工都要更新全橋模型與性能矩陣；消能裝置需納入定期檢查與抽測計畫，並保存原型試驗曲線作為基準。
knowledge.textEn: Sequence retrofit phases by stiffness and collapse consequence (the owner starts with the less flexible towers and side spans), updating the whole-bridge model and performance matrix at the end of each phase; put damping devices on a periodic inspection and sampling programme with prototype test curves kept as the baseline.

quiz.question: 要驗證「第 3B 期主橋耐震改造」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
把橋面換輕只會讓橋更安全，不會改變幾何。
消能裝置須做原型與逐件試驗，涵蓋設計速度範圍、溫度與循環次數，力—位移遲滯迴圈的耗能與規格比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A lighter deck only makes the bridge safer; it does not change the geometry.
Damping devices need prototype and production tests over the design velocity range, temperatures and cycle counts, comparing hysteresis-loop energy with the specification.
quiz.explanation: 消能裝置須做原型與逐件試驗，涵蓋設計速度範圍、溫度與循環次數，力—位移遲滯迴圈的耗能與規格比較；全橋以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層紀錄，檢查塔底應力、伸縮縫三維位移與橋面斜撐受力是否符合兩級地震的性能目標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Damping devices need prototype and production tests over the design velocity range, temperatures and cycle counts, comparing hysteresis-loop energy with the specification; the whole bridge is analysed by nonlinear time history with several near-fault records to check tower-base stress, three-dimensional joint movement and lateral-bracing forces against the performance goals for both earthquake levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 第 3B 期主橋耐震改造：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「38 組消能裝置」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “38 energy-dissipation devices” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只補強主橋而不處理伸縮縫，大地震時橋面與塔之間的相對位移可能使伸縮縫破壞、支承脫落；消能裝置若在長期風與交通的小振幅循環中磨耗而未檢查，地震時的耗能可能遠低於設計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Strengthening the main bridge without new joints lets relative movement between deck and towers in a large earthquake destroy joints and unseat bearings; dampers worn by years of small wind and traffic cycles without inspection may dissipate far less energy than designed in an earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：第 3B 期涵蓋主跨、兩邊跨、兩座橋塔與南塔基座：塔底以大型鋼板補強、塔內桁架補強、更換橋面與主塔及混凝土塔柱交接處的伸縮縫以容納三維位移、補強橋面橫向斜撐、改造 255 根橫梁，並安裝 38 組消能裝置，大幅減少傳入橋梁的地震能量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Phase 3B covers the main span, both side spans, both towers and the South Tower pier: steel plates at the tower bases, strengthened tower trusses, new expansion joints at the towers and pylons for three-dimensional movement, reinforced roadway lateral bracing, 255 retrofitted floor beams and 38 energy-dissipation devices that greatly reduce seismic energy entering the bridge.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「1989 年地震中金門大橋沒有損壞，代表它不需要耐震改造。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because the bridge was undamaged in 1989, it does not need seismic retrofit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只補強主橋而不處理伸縮縫，大地震時橋面與塔之間的相對位移可能使伸縮縫破壞、支承脫落；消能裝置若在長期風與交通的小振幅循環中磨耗而未檢查，地震時的耗能可能遠低於設計。
knowledge.textEn: Strengthening the main bridge without new joints lets relative movement between deck and towers in a large earthquake destroy joints and unseat bearings; dampers worn by years of small wind and traffic cycles without inspection may dissipate far less energy than designed in an earthquake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「第 3B 期主橋耐震改造」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Phase 3B seismic retrofit of the main bridge" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只補強主橋而不處理伸縮縫，大地震時橋面與塔之間的相對位移可能使伸縮縫破壞、支承脫落。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
防墜網是輕量的附屬設施，對橋梁的結構與風穩定沒有影響。
optionsEn: Strengthening the main bridge without new joints lets relative movement between deck and towers in a large earthquake destroy joints and unseat bearings.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The deterrent net is a light accessory with no effect on structure or wind stability.
quiz.explanation: 只補強主橋而不處理伸縮縫，大地震時橋面與塔之間的相對位移可能使伸縮縫破壞、支承脫落；消能裝置若在長期風與交通的小振幅循環中磨耗而未檢查，地震時的耗能可能遠低於設計。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Strengthening the main bridge without new joints lets relative movement between deck and towers in a large earthquake destroy joints and unseat bearings; dampers worn by years of small wind and traffic cycles without inspection may dissipate far less energy than designed in an earthquake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「防墜網與整流板」如何影響舊金山金門大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deterrent net and wind fairing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Golden Gate Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 防墜系統在東西兩側人行道下方 20 ft 處裝設海洋級不鏽鋼網，向外伸出 20 ft，沿 1.7 mi 全長連續，2018 年動工、2024 年初完成。網片與支架改變了橋面邊緣的流場並增加風阻，因此必須搭配抗風改造：透風的西側欄杆與人行道下方整流板，確保橋梁在持續 100 mph 的風中仍保有結構完整與氣動穩定。這說明一座 1937 年的懸索橋，每次在斷面上加東西，都要重新回答「顫振、抖振、渦振與側向變位是否仍可接受」的問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「防墜網與整流板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The deterrent system hangs marine-grade stainless-steel netting 20 ft below the sidewalks on both sides, extending 20 ft out and running continuously for the full 1.7 miles; it began in 2018 and was complete in early 2024. The netting and its supports change the flow at the deck edges and add wind resistance, so it had to be paired with the wind retrofit, the more porous west railing and a fairing below the sidewalk, to keep the bridge structurally sound and aerodynamically stable in sustained winds up to 100 mph. It shows that every addition to the section of a 1937 suspension bridge reopens the question of whether flutter, buffeting, vortex shedding and lateral deflection remain acceptable. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deterrent net and wind fairing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：100 mph（44.7 m/s）風壓 q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 100 mph (44.7 m/s) the wind pressure q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防墜網是輕量的附屬設施，對橋梁的結構與風穩定沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The deterrent net is a light accessory with no effect on structure or wind stability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「防墜網與整流板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deterrent net and wind fairing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理
knowledge.titleEn: Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management
knowledge.text: 防墜系統在東西兩側人行道下方 20 ft 處裝設海洋級不鏽鋼網，向外伸出 20 ft，沿 1.7 mi 全長連續，2018 年動工、2024 年初完成。網片與支架改變了橋面邊緣的流場並增加風阻，因此必須搭配抗風改造：透風的西側欄杆與人行道下方整流板，確保橋梁在持續 100 mph 的風中仍保有結構完整與氣動穩定。
knowledge.textEn: The deterrent system hangs marine-grade stainless-steel netting 20 ft below the sidewalks on both sides, extending 20 ft out and running continuously for the full 1.7 miles; it began in 2018 and was complete in early 2024. The netting and its supports change the flow at the deck edges and add wind resistance, so it had to be paired with the wind retrofit, the more porous west railing and a fairing below the sidewalk, to keep the bridge structurally sound and aerodynamically stable in sustained winds up to 100 mph.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：防墜網是輕量的附屬設施，對橋梁的結構與風穩定沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The deterrent net is a light accessory with no effect on structure or wind stability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management" is correct?
options: 防墜網是輕量的附屬設施，對橋梁的結構與風穩定沒有影響。
防墜系統在東西兩側人行道下方 20 ft 處裝設海洋級不鏽鋼網，向外伸出 20 ft，沿 1.7 mi 全長連續，2018 年動工、2024 年初完成。
塔頂荷重就等於主纜張力。
optionsEn: The deterrent net is a light accessory with no effect on structure or wind stability.
The deterrent system hangs marine-grade stainless-steel netting 20 ft below the sidewalks on both sides, extending 20 ft out and running continuously for the full 1.7 miles.
The load on the tower equals the cable tension.
quiz.explanation: 防墜系統在東西兩側人行道下方 20 ft 處裝設海洋級不鏽鋼網，向外伸出 20 ft，沿 1.7 mi 全長連續，2018 年動工、2024 年初完成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The deterrent system hangs marine-grade stainless-steel netting 20 ft below the sidewalks on both sides, extending 20 ft out and running continuously for the full 1.7 miles; it began in 2018 and was complete in early 2024. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防墜網與整流板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deterrent net and wind fairing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：100 mph（44.7 m/s）風壓 q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa。若網片與支架在兩側合計增加等效投影深度 0.6 m、阻力係數 1.2：ΔF ≈ 1,249×1.2×0.6 ≈ 0.90 kN/m；以重力勁度估算跨中附加側向變位 Δδ = ΔF·l²/(8H) ≈ 0.90×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 0.28 m。投影深度與係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 100 mph (44.7 m/s) the wind pressure q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa. If the net and supports add an equivalent projected depth of 0.6 m in total with a drag coefficient of 1.2: ΔF ≈ 1,249×1.2×0.6 ≈ 0.90 kN/m; the gravity-stiffness estimate of added mid-span lateral deflection is Δδ = ΔF·l²/(8H) ≈ 0.90×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 0.28 m. Projected depth and coefficient are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以含網片、整流板與新欄杆的斷面模型重新量測靜力係數與氣動導數，檢查顫振臨界風速、抖振反應與渦振；施工後以監測資料比較改造前後同風況下的位移與加速度，並持續記錄網片與支架的腐蝕與鬆動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Re-measure static coefficients and aerodynamic derivatives on a section model including the net, fairing and new railing, checking flutter onset, buffeting and vortex shedding; after construction compare monitored displacement and acceleration before and after under similar winds, and keep recording corrosion and loosening of the net and supports.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 100 mph（44.7 m/s）風壓 q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa。若網片與支架在兩側合計增加等效投影深度 0.6 m、阻力係數 1.2：ΔF ≈ 1,249×1.2×0.6 ≈ 0.90 kN/m；以重力勁度估算跨中附加側向變位 Δδ = ΔF·l²/(8H) ≈ 0.90×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 0.28 m。投影深度與係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: At 100 mph (44.7 m/s) the wind pressure q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa. If the net and supports add an equivalent projected depth of 0.6 m in total with a drag coefficient of 1.2: ΔF ≈ 1,249×1.2×0.6 ≈ 0.90 kN/m; the gravity-stiffness estimate of added mid-span lateral deflection is Δδ = ΔF·l²/(8H) ≈ 0.90×1,280²/(8×651,000) ≈ 0.28 m. Projected depth and coefficient are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management", which statement holds?
options: 老橋的鋼絲強度一定比規格值低很多，所以不值得試驗。
空中紡線的速度只取決於紡線輪跑多快。
100 mph（44.7 m/s）風壓 q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa。
optionsEn: Old bridge wire is always far below its specification, so testing is pointless.
Aerial-spinning speed depends only on how fast the wheels run.
At 100 mph (44.7 m/s) the wind pressure q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa.
quiz.explanation: 100 mph（44.7 m/s）風壓 q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 100 mph (44.7 m/s) the wind pressure q = ½ρU² ≈ 1,249 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防墜網與整流板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deterrent net and wind fairing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以含網片、整流板與新欄杆的斷面模型重新量測靜力係數與氣動導數，檢查顫振臨界風速、抖振反應與渦振；施工後以監測資料比較改造前後同風況下的位移與加速度，並持續記錄網片與支架的腐蝕與鬆動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Re-measure static coefficients and aerodynamic derivatives on a section model including the net, fairing and new railing, checking flutter onset, buffeting and vortex shedding; after construction compare monitored displacement and acceleration before and after under similar winds, and keep recording corrosion and loosening of the net and supports. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應建立「斷面變更管理」制度：任何附加於橋面或桁架的設施，先登錄重量、受風面積與連接細部，由結構與風工程顧問評估並核准，完工後更新恆載履歷、風洞基準與檢查清單，作為交接文件的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner should run section-change management: any attachment to deck or truss is first registered with its weight, wind area and connection details, assessed and approved by structural and wind consultants, and after completion the dead-load history, wind-tunnel baseline and inspection checklist are updated as part of the handover record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若附加物在未經氣動評估下裝上，可能降低顫振裕度或在某風向引發新的渦振；網片支架與桁架的連接若疲勞或腐蝕鬆脫，部件墜落還會危及航道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attachments installed without aerodynamic assessment can lower flutter margin or start new vortex vibration in some wind directions; fatigued or corroded connections between net supports and the truss can loosen and drop parts into the shipping channel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以含網片、整流板與新欄杆的斷面模型重新量測靜力係數與氣動導數，檢查顫振臨界風速、抖振反應與渦振；施工後以監測資料比較改造前後同風況下的位移與加速度，並持續記錄網片與支架的腐蝕與鬆動。
knowledge.textEn: Re-measure static coefficients and aerodynamic derivatives on a section model including the net, fairing and new railing, checking flutter onset, buffeting and vortex shedding; after construction compare monitored displacement and acceleration before and after under similar winds, and keep recording corrosion and loosening of the net and supports.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主應建立「斷面變更管理」制度：任何附加於橋面或桁架的設施，先登錄重量、受風面積與連接細部，由結構與風工程顧問評估並核准，完工後更新恆載履歷、風洞基準與檢查清單，作為交接文件的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: The owner should run section-change management: any attachment to deck or truss is first registered with its weight, wind area and connection details, assessed and approved by structural and wind consultants, and after completion the dead-load history, wind-tunnel baseline and inspection checklist are updated as part of the handover record.

quiz.question: 要驗證「防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management"?
options: 以含網片、整流板與新欄杆的斷面模型重新量測靜力係數與氣動導數，檢查顫振臨界風速、抖振反應與渦振。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要整座橋在強風中穩定，欄杆的振動與聲音就不是工程問題。
optionsEn: Re-measure static coefficients and aerodynamic derivatives on a section model including the net, fairing and new railing, checking flutter onset, buffeting and vortex shedding.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the whole bridge is stable in strong wind, railing vibration and noise are not engineering problems.
quiz.explanation: 以含網片、整流板與新欄杆的斷面模型重新量測靜力係數與氣動導數，檢查顫振臨界風速、抖振反應與渦振；施工後以監測資料比較改造前後同風況下的位移與加速度，並持續記錄網片與支架的腐蝕與鬆動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Re-measure static coefficients and aerodynamic derivatives on a section model including the net, fairing and new railing, checking flutter onset, buffeting and vortex shedding; after construction compare monitored displacement and acceleration before and after under similar winds, and keep recording corrosion and loosening of the net and supports. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防墜網與整流板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deterrent net and wind fairing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若附加物在未經氣動評估下裝上，可能降低顫振裕度或在某風向引發新的渦振；網片支架與桁架的連接若疲勞或腐蝕鬆脫，部件墜落還會危及航道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attachments installed without aerodynamic assessment can lower flutter margin or start new vortex vibration in some wind directions; fatigued or corroded connections between net supports and the truss can loosen and drop parts into the shipping channel. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這說明一座 1937 年的懸索橋，每次在斷面上加東西，都要重新回答「顫振、抖振、渦振與側向變位是否仍可接受」的問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It shows that every addition to the section of a 1937 suspension bridge reopens the question of whether flutter, buffeting, vortex shedding and lateral deflection remain acceptable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「防墜網是輕量的附屬設施，對橋梁的結構與風穩定沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The deterrent net is a light accessory with no effect on structure or wind stability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若附加物在未經氣動評估下裝上，可能降低顫振裕度或在某風向引發新的渦振；網片支架與桁架的連接若疲勞或腐蝕鬆脫，部件墜落還會危及航道。
knowledge.textEn: Attachments installed without aerodynamic assessment can lower flutter margin or start new vortex vibration in some wind directions; fatigued or corroded connections between net supports and the truss can loosen and drop parts into the shipping channel.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防墜網、整流板與斷面變更管理」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deterrent net, fairing and section-change management" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若附加物在未經氣動評估下裝上，可能降低顫振裕度或在某風向引發新的渦振；網片支架與桁架的連接若疲勞或腐蝕鬆脫，部件墜落還會危及航道。
塔頂荷重就等於主纜張力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Attachments installed without aerodynamic assessment can lower flutter margin or start new vortex vibration in some wind directions.
The load on the tower equals the cable tension.
quiz.explanation: 若附加物在未經氣動評估下裝上，可能降低顫振裕度或在某風向引發新的渦振；網片支架與桁架的連接若疲勞或腐蝕鬆脫，部件墜落還會危及航道。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attachments installed without aerodynamic assessment can lower flutter margin or start new vortex vibration in some wind directions; fatigued or corroded connections between net supports and the truss can loosen and drop parts into the shipping channel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 瀨戶大橋橋群
courses.summary: 瀨戶大橋是連接本州岡山與四國香川的六座橋梁，海峽段約 9.4 km，全部為上層公路、下層鐵路的雙層結構，1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車。本課從如何沿海峽配置三座懸索橋、兩座斜張橋與一座桁架橋出發，說明南北備讚瀨戶大橋的三跨連續構造與索股交叉的共用錨碇、11 座設置沉箱與預壘骨材水中混凝土、起重船牽引導索與工廠全尺寸預組，最後談鍍鋅鋼絲防蝕、乾燥空氣與公路鐵路並存下的維護。
courses.summaryEn: Seto Ohashi is a group of six bridges linking Okayama on Honshu with Kagawa on Shikoku across about 9.4 km of sea, all double-deck with road above and rail below, opened together on 10 April 1988. The course starts from how three suspension bridges, two cable-stayed bridges and a truss bridge were arranged along the strait, explains the three-span continuous Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto bridges and their shared anchorage where strands cross, eleven placed caissons with prepacked underwater concrete, crane-ship pilot ropes and full factory trial assembly, and ends with galvanised-wire protection, dry air and maintenance with road and rail side by side.
courses.focus: 9.4 km 海峽上的六座公路鐵路兩用橋：橋型配置、連續懸索橋、共用錨碇、設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土
courses.focusEn: Six road–rail bridges across 9.4 km of strait: type selection, continuous suspension spans, a shared anchorage, placed caissons and prepacked concrete
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較南備讚瀨戶大橋型懸索橋在不同鋼絲直徑下的主纜狀態。主纜 271 股×127 根 = 34,417 根鋼絲，張力約 45,000 t（≈ 441 MN），主纜直徑 107 cm（毛面積 0.899 m²）。若鋼絲直徑 5.10 mm，單絲面積 20.4 mm²，總面積 ≈ 0.703 m²，應力 ≈ 441/0.703 ≈ 628 N/mm²，對 1,570 N/mm² 鋼絲的安全係數 ≈ 2.50，空隙率 ≈ 22%。若直徑為 5.00 mm，單絲 19.6 mm²、總面積 ≈ 0.676 m²，應力 ≈ 653 N/mm²、係數 ≈ 2.40，空隙率 ≈ 25%；若為 5.20 mm，總面積 ≈ 0.731 m²、係數 ≈ 2.60、空隙率 ≈ 19%。可見「約 5 mm」的 0.1 mm 差異就會改變安全係數約 4% 與空隙率約 3 個百分點。除公開的股數、直徑與張力外，數值為教學假設，不代表瀨戶大橋的設計計算。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare the cable state of a Minami Bisan-Seto type suspension bridge for different wire diameters. The cable has 271 strands × 127 wires = 34,417 wires, a tension of about 45,000 t (≈ 441 MN) and a diameter of 107 cm (gross area 0.899 m²). With 5.10 mm wire, each wire is 20.4 mm², the total area ≈ 0.703 m², the stress ≈ 441/0.703 ≈ 628 N/mm², the safety factor on 1,570 N/mm² wire ≈ 2.50 and the void ratio ≈ 22%. With 5.00 mm wire, each is 19.6 mm², the total ≈ 0.676 m², the stress ≈ 653 N/mm², the factor ≈ 2.40 and voids ≈ 25%; with 5.20 mm, the total ≈ 0.731 m², the factor ≈ 2.60 and voids ≈ 19%. A 0.1 mm difference within ‘about 5 mm’ changes the safety factor by about 4% and the void ratio by about 3 points. Apart from the published strand count, diameter and tension, values are teaching assumptions, not Seto Ohashi design calculations.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 海峽段約 9.4 km，由六座上層公路、下層鐵路的雙層橋組成
下津井瀨戶大橋中央跨 940 m，北備讚 990 m，南備讚 1,100 m
櫃石島橋與岩黑島橋為斜張橋，中央跨各 420 m；與島橋為桁架橋，最大跨 245 m
六座橋於 1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車
共製作 11 座設置沉箱，其中一例寬 59 m、長 75 m、高 55 m、重約 18,000 t
沉箱設置容許誤差 50 cm，拖航需至少 4 天穩定天候並以 12 艘拖船執行
預壘骨材粒徑 80 至 150 mm，砂漿船每日最多製造 5,800 m³ 砂漿
南備讚主纜直徑 107 cm、張力約 45,000 t，每股 127 根約 5 mm 鋼絲
北、南備讚共用錨碇內索股交叉，分別為 234 股與 271 股
貓道寬 4.5 m、扶手高 1.4 m
factsEn: The sea section is about 9.4 km, made up of six double-deck bridges with road above and rail below
Centre spans: Shimotsui-Seto 940 m, Kita Bisan-Seto 990 m and Minami Bisan-Seto 1,100 m
Hitsuishijima and Iwakurojima are cable-stayed with 420 m centre spans; Yoshima is a truss with a 245 m maximum span
All six bridges opened together on 10 April 1988
Eleven placed caissons were built; one example is 59 m wide, 75 m long, 55 m high and about 18,000 t
Caisson placement tolerance was 50 cm; towing needed at least four stable days and 12 tugs
Prepacked aggregate was 80 to 150 mm, and the mortar ship could make up to 5,800 m³ a day
Minami Bisan-Seto's cable is 107 cm in diameter with about 45,000 t of tension, 127 wires of about 5 mm per strand
Strands cross in the shared Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto anchorage, 234 and 271 strands respectively
Catwalks were 4.5 m wide with 1.4 m handrails

1988　4 月 10 日六座橋同時通車，公路與鐵路共用
timelineEn: 1978 — Ground-breaking ceremony for Seto Ohashi on 10 October
1979 — Site work begins on Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto on 16 January
1981 — Site work begins on Shimotsui-Seto on 12 July, with a tunnel anchorage on the Honshu side
1982 — Site work begins on the Hitsuishijima Bridge on 8 November
1988 — All six bridges open on 10 April, carrying road and rail

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數」與「鐵路通行與連續懸索橋」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait" and "Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Type layout over 9.4 km” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 瀨戶大橋並非單一橋梁，而是一條跨越塩飽諸島的鏈：下津井瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，中央跨 940 m）、櫃石島橋與岩黑島橋（斜張橋，各 420 m）、與島橋（桁架橋，最大跨 245 m）、北備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，990 m）與南備讚瀨戶大橋（懸索橋，1,100 m）。主要航道與深水處用懸索橋大跨越過，島嶼之間較淺且船舶較小的水道用斜張橋與桁架橋，讓每一段的跨徑與基礎數量都配合水深、航道與島嶼位置。海中基礎是最昂貴、最受潮流與天候限制的工作，因此減少海中基礎數量是配置的核心考量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seto Ohashi is not one bridge but a chain across the Shiwaku Islands: Shimotsui-Seto (suspension, 940 m centre span), the Hitsuishijima and Iwakurojima bridges (cable-stayed, 420 m each), Yoshima (truss, 245 m maximum span), Kita Bisan-Seto (suspension, 990 m) and Minami Bisan-Seto (suspension, 1,100 m). Main channels and deep water are crossed by long suspension spans, while shallower inter-island waters with smaller ships use cable-stayed and truss bridges, so each segment's span and foundation count fit water depth, navigation and island positions. Marine foundations are the most expensive work and the most constrained by currents and weather, so reducing their number is central to the layout. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Type layout over 9.4 km” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若 9.4 km 全部以 245 m 跨的桁架橋通過，約需 9,400/245 ≈ 38 處海中或島上基礎；實際工程只製作 11 座大型設置沉箱作為主要海中基礎。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Crossing all 9.4 km with 245 m truss spans would need about 9,400/245 ≈ 38 marine or island foundations; the project built only 11 large placed caissons as its main marine foundations.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「跨海連絡橋應該全部使用同一種最先進的橋型。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Type layout over 9.4 km” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若 9.4 km 全部以 245 m 跨的桁架橋通過，約需 9,400/245 ≈ 38 處海中或島上基礎；實際工程只製作 11 座大型設置沉箱作為主要海中基礎。若懸索橋垂跨比取 1/10，三座懸索橋主纜垂度約為 94 m、99 m 與 110 m，決定了塔高的主要部分。垂跨比為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Crossing all 9.4 km with 245 m truss spans would need about 9,400/245 ≈ 38 marine or island foundations; the project built only 11 large placed caissons as its main marine foundations. With a 1/10 sag ratio, the three suspension bridges' cable sags would be about 94 m, 99 m and 110 m, setting most of each tower's height. The sag ratio is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以航道主管機關核定的航道寬度與淨空、海底地形與地質鑽探資料，比較不同橋型配置的海中基礎數、施工天數與風險；定案後把每座橋的橋型、跨徑與基礎位置列入整體配置圖，作為各橋設計的共同基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare layouts by marine foundation count, construction days and risk, using channel widths and clearances approved by the navigation authority, seabed topography and borehole data; once fixed, record each bridge's type, spans and foundation locations on a master layout as the common basis for all individual designs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Type layout over 9.4 km” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以航道主管機關核定的航道寬度與淨空、海底地形與地質鑽探資料，比較不同橋型配置的海中基礎數、施工天數與風險；定案後把每座橋的橋型、跨徑與基礎位置列入整體配置圖，作為各橋設計的共同基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare layouts by marine foundation count, construction days and risk, using channel widths and clearances approved by the navigation authority, seabed topography and borehole data; once fixed, record each bridge's type, spans and foundation locations on a master layout as the common basis for all individual designs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大型跨海工程的配置報告應以表格比較各段的水深、航道、基礎數與橋型方案，並保存被淘汰方案的理由；日後若有新增航道需求或維修策略變更，可回到此基準評估影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The layout report for a major sea crossing should tabulate water depth, channel, foundation count and type options for each segment and keep the reasons for rejected options, so later new channel demands or maintenance strategy changes can be assessed against that baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若為追求單一橋型而在淺水區也使用大跨懸索橋，錨碇與塔的成本會不成比例；反之在主航道使用短跨，海中基礎增加，不僅工期與潮流風險上升，也增加船舶撞擊機率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using long suspension spans even in shallow water for the sake of a single type makes anchorages and towers disproportionately costly; short spans in the main channel multiply marine foundations, raising schedule and tidal risk as well as ship-collision probability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.question: 在「沿海峽配置橋型與海中基礎數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Arranging bridge types and marine foundations along the strait" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

若為追求單一橋型而在淺水區也使用大跨懸索橋，錨碇與塔的成本會不成比例；反之在主航道使用短跨，海中基礎增加，不僅工期與潮流風險上升，也增加船舶撞擊機率。
懸索橋的加勁梁在橋塔處一定要斷開，才能適應主纜變形。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using long suspension spans even in shallow water for the sake of a single type makes anchorages and towers disproportionately costly.
A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation.

quiz.explanationEn: Using long suspension spans even in shallow water for the sake of a single type makes anchorages and towers disproportionately costly; short spans in the main channel multiply marine foundations, raising schedule and tidal risk as well as ship-collision probability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鐵路通行與連續懸索橋：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「三跨連續加勁桁」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-span continuous truss” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 業主將北、南備讚瀨戶大橋描述為三跨連續加勁桁架懸索橋。一般公路懸索橋常在橋塔處把加勁梁分開以鉸接或伸縮縫連接，鐵路卻難以接受橋塔處的折角：列車通過時主跨下垂、邊跨上揚，兩側梁端轉角相加，形成軌道的突然轉折。把加勁桁在塔處做成連續，能大幅減少這個折角，代價是塔處的彎矩與支承反力增加，以及溫度與活載下更複雜的縱向位移。這是瀨戶大橋作為公路鐵路兩用懸索橋的關鍵選擇之一。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「三跨連續加勁桁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The owner describes Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto as three-span continuous truss-stiffened suspension bridges. Road suspension bridges often separate the stiffening girder at the towers with hinges or expansion joints, but rail cannot easily accept an angle break there: as a train crosses, the main span sags and the side span rises, and the two girder-end rotations add up to a sudden kink in the track. Making the stiffening truss continuous over the towers greatly reduces this kink, at the price of larger bending moments and bearing reactions at the towers and more complex longitudinal movement under temperature and live load. This was one of the key choices that made Seto Ohashi a road–rail suspension bridge. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Three-span continuous truss” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以拋物線撓度形狀估算梁端轉角 θ ≈ 4δ/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate girder-end rotation from a parabolic deflection shape, θ ≈ 4δ/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸索橋的加勁梁在橋塔處一定要斷開，才能適應主纜變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A suspension bridge girder must always be separated at the towers to suit cable deformation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「三跨連續加勁桁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Three-span continuous truss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 鐵路通行與連續懸索橋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三跨連續加勁桁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-span continuous truss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以拋物線撓度形狀估算梁端轉角 θ ≈ 4δ/L。取主跨 L = 1,100 m、列車荷重下最大撓度 δ = 2.0 m：θ ≈ 4×2.0/1,100 ≈ 0.0073 rad；若塔處為鉸接，兩側轉角相加的折角可達約 0.0145 rad。連續構造把折角限制在梁的連續曲率內，鐵路容許折角則遠小於此值。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate girder-end rotation from a parabolic deflection shape, θ ≈ 4δ/L. With main span L = 1,100 m and maximum deflection under train load δ = 2.0 m: θ ≈ 4×2.0/1,100 ≈ 0.0073 rad; with a hinge at the tower the two rotations add to a kink of about 0.0145 rad. Continuity keeps the angle within the girder's smooth curvature, while the permissible rail kink is far smaller. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型針對單線與雙線列車、公路車隊與溫度組合，輸出塔處與梁端的軌道折角、縱向位移與支承反力，與鐵路軌道標準比較；通車前以試運轉列車量測軌道高低差與加速度，確認乘坐品質。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the finite-element model with single- and double-track trains, road traffic and temperature combinations to output track angle breaks, longitudinal movement and bearing reactions at towers and girder ends against railway track standards; before opening measure track irregularity and car-body acceleration with test trains to confirm ride quality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鐵路通行與連續懸索橋：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三跨連續加勁桁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Three-span continuous truss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素模型針對單線與雙線列車、公路車隊與溫度組合，輸出塔處與梁端的軌道折角、縱向位移與支承反力，與鐵路軌道標準比較；通車前以試運轉列車量測軌道高低差與加速度，確認乘坐品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use the finite-element model with single- and double-track trains, road traffic and temperature combinations to output track angle breaks, longitudinal movement and bearing reactions at towers and girder ends against railway track standards; before opening measure track irregularity and car-body acceleration with test trains to confirm ride quality. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：公路鐵路兩用橋應由橋梁與鐵路單位共同制定軌道折角、伸縮量與支承反力的設計表，並在竣工後建立塔處與梁端的長期位移與轉角監測，作為維護與限速決策的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For road–rail bridges the bridge and railway parties should jointly fix design tables for track kink, expansion and bearing reaction, and after completion set up long-term movement and rotation monitoring at towers and girder ends as the basis for maintenance and speed decisions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以公路標準設計塔處接頭，列車通過時的折角與衝擊會加速軌道部件、支承與伸縮裝置的損耗，嚴重時需要限速；連續梁在塔處的負彎矩若低估，上弦或下弦構件可能疲勞開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing tower joints only to road standards lets train-induced kinks and impact wear track components, bearings and expansion devices quickly, possibly forcing speed limits; underestimating negative moment at the towers in a continuous girder can lead to fatigue cracking of chord members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鐵路通行與連續懸索橋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rail traffic and continuous suspension spans" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩橋共用錨碇時，兩側主纜力會互相抵消，錨碇可以做得很小。
若只以公路標準設計塔處接頭，列車通過時的折角與衝擊會加速軌道部件、支承與伸縮裝置的損耗，嚴重時需要限速；連續梁在塔處的負彎矩若低估，上弦或下弦構件可能疲勞開裂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
With a shared anchorage the two cable forces cancel out, so the anchorage can be small.
Designing tower joints only to road standards lets train-induced kinks and impact wear track components, bearings and expansion devices quickly, possibly forcing speed limits.
quiz.explanation: 若只以公路標準設計塔處接頭，列車通過時的折角與衝擊會加速軌道部件、支承與伸縮裝置的損耗，嚴重時需要限速；連續梁在塔處的負彎矩若低估，上弦或下弦構件可能疲勞開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing tower joints only to road standards lets train-induced kinks and impact wear track components, bearings and expansion devices quickly, possibly forcing speed limits; underestimating negative moment at the towers in a continuous girder can lead to fatigue cracking of chord members. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇」與「設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage" and "Placed caissons and prepacked concrete": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「共用錨碇索股交叉」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shared anchorage strand crossing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 北、南備讚瀨戶大橋相鄰而建，兩橋之間共用一座錨碇，兩側主纜的索股在錨碇內交叉錨定：北備讚為 234 股、南備讚為 271 股，業主稱這種構造為世界首例。每股由 127 根直徑約 5 mm 的平行鋼絲排成六角形，不扭絞。南備讚瀨戶大橋的主纜最大，直徑 107 cm，承受約 45,000 t 的張力。共用錨碇節省了一座巨大的重力式構造，但必須同時承受兩橋方向相反的主纜力，並在兩橋荷重不平衡時保持穩定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「共用錨碇索股交叉」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto stand side by side and share one anchorage between them, where the strands of both cables cross and are anchored: 234 strands for Kita Bisan-Seto and 271 for Minami Bisan-Seto, a structure the owner calls a world first. Each strand is 127 parallel wires of about 5 mm laid in a hexagon, not twisted. Minami Bisan-Seto's cable is the largest, 107 cm in diameter and carrying about 45,000 t of tension. The shared anchorage saved one huge gravity structure, but it must resist cable forces from both bridges in opposite directions and stay stable when their loads are unbalanced. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shared anchorage strand crossing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Minami Bisan-Seto has 271×127 = 34,417 wires.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩橋共用錨碇時，兩側主纜力會互相抵消，錨碇可以做得很小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a shared anchorage the two cable forces cancel out, so the anchorage can be small." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「共用錨碇索股交叉」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shared anchorage strand crossing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：兩橋共用錨碇時，兩側主纜力會互相抵消，錨碇可以做得很小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共用錨碇索股交叉」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shared anchorage strand crossing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：南備讚 271×127 = 34,417 根。張力 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN；若鋼絲強度 1,570 N/mm²、安全係數取 2.5，所需面積 A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m²，每根約 20.4 mm²，對應直徑 ≈ 5.10 mm，與公開的「約 5 mm」一致；毛面積 π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m²，空隙率 ≈ 22%。強度與安全係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Minami Bisan-Seto has 271×127 = 34,417 wires. A tension of 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN, with wire strength 1,570 N/mm² and safety factor 2.5, needs A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m², about 20.4 mm² per wire, a diameter ≈ 5.10 mm, consistent with the published ‘about 5 mm’; gross area π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m² gives a void ratio ≈ 22%. Strength and safety factor are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：共用錨碇的穩定檢核要包含兩橋同時滿載、單橋滿載另一橋空載、溫度差與地震等組合，計算合力方向與基底反力分布；施工時逐股量測錨固力與索股垂度，確認兩側索股交叉排列與錨頭位置符合圖說。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Stability checks of the shared anchorage must cover both bridges fully loaded, one loaded with the other empty, temperature differences and earthquake, computing resultant direction and base-pressure distribution; during construction measure anchoring force and sag strand by strand, confirming the crossing arrangement and socket positions match the drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 南備讚 271×127 = 34,417 根。張力 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN；若鋼絲強度 1,570 N/mm²、安全係數取 2.5，所需面積 A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m²，每根約 20.4 mm²，對應直徑 ≈ 5.10 mm，與公開的「約 5 mm」一致；毛面積 π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m²，空隙率 ≈ 22%。強度與安全係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Minami Bisan-Seto has 271×127 = 34,417 wires. A tension of 45,000 t ≈ 441 MN, with wire strength 1,570 N/mm² and safety factor 2.5, needs A = 441×2.5/1,570 ≈ 0.703 m², about 20.4 mm² per wire, a diameter ≈ 5.10 mm, consistent with the published ‘about 5 mm’; gross area π/4×1.07² = 0.899 m² gives a void ratio ≈ 22%. Strength and safety factor are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage", which statement holds?
options: 加勁桁只要在工廠做得準確，現場合龍就不需要考慮溫度。
沉箱很重，潮流對它的影響可以忽略。
optionsEn: If the truss is accurate at the factory, temperature does not matter at closure.
Minami Bisan-Seto has 271×127 = 34,417 wires.
A caisson is so heavy that tidal currents hardly affect it.
quiz.explanation: 南備讚 271×127 = 34,417 根。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Minami Bisan-Seto has 271×127 = 34,417 wires. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「共用錨碇索股交叉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shared anchorage strand crossing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 共用錨碇的穩定檢核要包含兩橋同時滿載、單橋滿載另一橋空載、溫度差與地震等組合，計算合力方向與基底反力分布；施工時逐股量測錨固力與索股垂度，確認兩側索股交叉排列與錨頭位置符合圖說。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Stability checks of the shared anchorage must cover both bridges fully loaded, one loaded with the other empty, temperature differences and earthquake, computing resultant direction and base-pressure distribution; during construction measure anchoring force and sag strand by strand, confirming the crossing arrangement and socket positions match the drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：共用錨碇的設計基準應列出所有不平衡荷重組合與容許偏心，並在錨碇內保留足夠的檢查通道與照明，讓每一個索股錨頭都能定期目視與量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis for a shared anchorage should list every unbalanced load combination and the allowable eccentricity, and the anchorage must keep enough inspection access and lighting so every strand socket can be seen and measured periodically.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只檢核兩橋對稱受力，單側滿載時錨碇的合力偏心可能使基底一側壓力過大或另一側脫開；索股交叉區排列錯誤則造成錨頭擁擠、受力不均，日後也難以檢查與更換。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only symmetric loading can miss the eccentric resultant when one bridge is loaded, overstressing one side of the base or lifting the other; misarranged strands in the crossing zone crowd sockets, share load unevenly and are hard to inspect or replace later. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 共用錨碇的穩定檢核要包含兩橋同時滿載、單橋滿載另一橋空載、溫度差與地震等組合，計算合力方向與基底反力分布；施工時逐股量測錨固力與索股垂度，確認兩側索股交叉排列與錨頭位置符合圖說。
knowledge.textEn: Stability checks of the shared anchorage must cover both bridges fully loaded, one loaded with the other empty, temperature differences and earthquake, computing resultant direction and base-pressure distribution; during construction measure anchoring force and sag strand by strand, confirming the crossing arrangement and socket positions match the drawings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 共用錨碇的設計基準應列出所有不平衡荷重組合與容許偏心，並在錨碇內保留足夠的檢查通道與照明，讓每一個索股錨頭都能定期目視與量測。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis for a shared anchorage should list every unbalanced load combination and the allowable eccentricity, and the anchorage must keep enough inspection access and lighting so every strand socket can be seen and measured periodically.

quiz.question: 要驗證「107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

Stability checks of the shared anchorage must cover both bridges fully loaded, one loaded with the other empty, temperature differences and earthquake, computing resultant direction and base-pressure distribution.

quiz.explanationEn: Stability checks of the shared anchorage must cover both bridges fully loaded, one loaded with the other empty, temperature differences and earthquake, computing resultant direction and base-pressure distribution; during construction measure anchoring force and sag strand by strand, confirming the crossing arrangement and socket positions match the drawings. steps.title: 107 cm 主纜與交叉共用錨碇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The 107 cm cable and the crossing shared anchorage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「共用錨碇索股交叉」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shared anchorage strand crossing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只檢核兩橋對稱受力，單側滿載時錨碇的合力偏心可能使基底一側壓力過大或另一側脫開；索股交叉區排列錯誤則造成錨頭擁擠、受力不均，日後也難以檢查與更換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only symmetric loading can miss the eccentric resultant when one bridge is loaded, overstressing one side of the base or lifting the other; misarranged strands in the crossing zone crowd sockets, share load unevenly and are hard to inspect or replace later. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用錨碇節省了一座巨大的重力式構造，但必須同時承受兩橋方向相反的主纜力，並在兩橋荷重不平衡時保持穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The shared anchorage saved one huge gravity structure, but it must resist cable forces from both bridges in opposite directions and stay stable when their loads are unbalanced.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩橋共用錨碇時，兩側主纜力會互相抵消，錨碇可以做得很小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With a shared anchorage the two cable forces cancel out, so the anchorage can be small." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Placed caissons and prepacked concrete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「11 座設置沉箱」如何影響瀨戶大橋橋群的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eleven placed caissons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seto Ohashi bridge network”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 瀨戶大橋的海中基礎採用設置沉箱工法：在完成整平的岩盤上放置巨大的箱形鋼製模板，再在內部填充水中混凝土，共製作 11 座。以其中一例而言，沉箱寬 59 m、長 75 m、高 55 m、重約 18,000 t，在造船廠船塢製作近 2 年，與現場作業平行進行以縮短工期。沉箱內的水中混凝土採用預壘骨材工法：先在海水中投放 80 至 150 mm 的大粒徑骨材，再從注入管壓入砂漿，把骨材間的海水擠出；砂漿船「世紀」每日最多可製造 5,800 m³ 砂漿，一旦開始注入就必須三晝夜連續作業。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「11 座設置沉箱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seto Ohashi's marine foundations used the placed-caisson method: a huge box-shaped steel form is set on a levelled rock surface and filled with underwater concrete, eleven in all. One example caisson is 59 m wide, 75 m long and 55 m high, weighs about 18,000 t and took nearly two years to build in a shipyard dock, in parallel with site work to shorten the schedule. The underwater concrete inside used the prepacked-aggregate method: 80 to 150 mm aggregate is first placed in the seawater, then mortar is pumped in through injection pipes to displace the water between stones; the mortar plant ship Seiki could produce up to 5,800 m³ a day, and once injection started it ran continuously for three days and nights. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Eleven placed caissons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預壘骨材的空隙率取 40%，每日 5,800 m³ 砂漿可完成約 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ 的混凝土；三晝夜約 43,500 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking a 40% void ratio for the prepacked aggregate, 5,800 m³ of mortar a day completes about 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ of concrete, about 43,500 m³ in three days and nights.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預壘骨材混凝土只要砂漿強度夠，品質就有保證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Prepacked concrete is guaranteed as long as the mortar is strong enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預壘骨材的空隙率取 40%，每日 5,800 m³ 砂漿可完成約 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ 的混凝土；三晝夜約 43,500 m³。沉箱外廓體積 59×75×55 ≈ 243,000 m³，扣除隔艙與鋼殼仍需多次分層注入。若空隙率為 45%，每日完成量降為約 12,900 m³。空隙率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking a 40% void ratio for the prepacked aggregate, 5,800 m³ of mortar a day completes about 5,800/0.40 = 14,500 m³ of concrete, about 43,500 m³ in three days and nights. The caisson envelope is 59×75×55 ≈ 243,000 m³, so even after deducting partitions and shell it needs several injection lifts. At 45% voids the daily output drops to about 12,900 m³. The void ratio is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：注入過程中以測深與注入管周邊的砂漿面計量測砂漿上升高度，確認注入管埋入深度與各區均勻上升；完成後鑽心取樣檢查骨材間是否充填密實、有無海水夾層或泥膜，並以試體確認砂漿強度與流動性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During injection measure mortar rise with soundings and gauges around the pipes, confirming pipe embedment and even rise in every zone; afterwards core to check that voids between stones are fully filled without seawater pockets or silt films, and confirm mortar strength and flow with specimens.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Placed caissons and prepacked concrete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「11 座設置沉箱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eleven placed caissons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 注入過程中以測深與注入管周邊的砂漿面計量測砂漿上升高度，確認注入管埋入深度與各區均勻上升；完成後鑽心取樣檢查骨材間是否充填密實、有無海水夾層或泥膜，並以試體確認砂漿強度與流動性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During injection measure mortar rise with soundings and gauges around the pipes, confirming pipe embedment and even rise in every zone; afterwards core to check that voids between stones are fully filled without seawater pockets or silt films, and confirm mortar strength and flow with specimens. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預壘骨材工法應訂定骨材清洗與投放後的最長等待時間、注入管間距、連續作業的備援（第二套泵與發電機）與中斷處理程序，並以鑽心結果作為驗收停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The prepacked method needs limits on aggregate washing and the maximum wait after placement, injection-pipe spacing, back-up for continuous work (spare pumps and generators) and a procedure for interruptions, with core results as the acceptance hold point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：骨材在投放後若被潮流帶入泥砂或生物附著，砂漿無法與骨材緊密結合，形成弱面；注入若中斷超過允許時間，新舊砂漿之間產生冷縫，基礎內部出現不連續面，降低抗剪與耐久性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If silt or marine growth coats the aggregate after placement, mortar cannot bond tightly and weak planes form; interrupting injection beyond the allowable time leaves cold joints between old and new mortar, creating internal discontinuities that cut shear capacity and durability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
