workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算塔頂在風荷載下的附加彎矩。取塔上段迎風寬 b = 10 m，以單元 2 的指數律求 z = 300 m 時 U ≈ 57.2 m/s，q = ½ρU² = 0.5×1.225×57.2² ≈ 2,004 Pa；取阻力係數 C_D = 1.3，每公尺風力 w = 2,004×1.3×10 ≈ 26.1 kN/m。若塔上 100 m 平均承受此風力、合力作用於塔頂以下 50 m，對 200 m 高程處的彎矩 M = 26.1×100×50 ≈ 130,300 kN·m。若改用橋面高度 70 m 的風速 48.0 m/s，q ≈ 1,411 Pa，w ≈ 18.3 kN/m，M ≈ 91,700 kN·m，低估約 30%（1 − 91,700/130,300 ≈ 0.30）。若塔寬改為 8 m，兩者都乘以 0.8。數值為教學假設，不代表蘇通大橋的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the extra moment from wind on the upper tower. Take an upper-tower width b = 10 m; from the unit 2 power law U ≈ 57.2 m/s at z = 300 m, so q = ½ρU² = 0.5×1.225×57.2² ≈ 2,004 Pa; with C_D = 1.3 the force per metre is w = 2,004×1.3×10 ≈ 26.1 kN/m. If the top 100 m of tower carries this on average with the resultant 50 m below the top, the moment at the 200 m level is M = 26.1×100×50 ≈ 130,300 kN·m. Using the deck-level speed of 48.0 m/s at 70 m instead gives q ≈ 1,411 Pa, w ≈ 18.3 kN/m and M ≈ 91,700 kN·m, an underestimate of about 30% (1 − 91,700/130,300 ≈ 0.30). If the tower width becomes 8 m, both scale by 0.8. Values are teaching assumptions, not the Sutong design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位」與「長江口風剖面與 300 m 塔的風荷載」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters" and "Estuary wind profile and wind load on 300 m towers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」如何影響蘇通長江公路大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tower–deck viscous dampers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sutong Yangtze River Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 蘇通大橋主橋全長 2,088 m，若橋面在塔處完全固定，溫度伸縮與混凝土塔的徐變會在塔底產生巨大彎矩；若完全漂浮，颱風、船撞與地震又會讓橋面大幅縱飄，撞壞伸縮縫。設計團隊比較多種體系後，採用附加位移限制裝置的超大型液體黏滯阻尼器，公開論文指出這是此類裝置在橋梁工程的首次應用。慢速的溫度位移幾乎不受阻；快速的風振與地震由阻尼器耗能；位移一旦達到限位值，限位裝置接手，防止極端事件中橋面超出伸縮縫與支承的行程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Sutong main bridge is 2,088 m long. Fixing the deck to the towers would let thermal movement and tower creep create huge tower-base moments; a fully floating deck would let typhoons, ship impact and earthquakes push it far enough to wreck the expansion joints. After comparing systems, the design team adopted very large fluid viscous dampers with an added displacement limiter, described in a published paper as the first use of such a device in bridge engineering. Slow thermal movement is almost unresisted, fast wind and seismic motion is dissipated by the dampers, and once displacement reaches the limit the limiter takes over so the deck cannot exceed joint and bearing travel in an extreme event. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tower–deck viscous dampers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT，取 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、自中點起算 L = 1,044 m、ΔT = 50 °C：ΔL ≈ 0.63 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, L = 1,044 m from mid-length and ΔT = 50 °C, ΔL ≈ 0.63 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「黏滯阻尼器在任何速度下都提供相同的固定約束力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A viscous damper provides the same fixed restraint force at every velocity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tower–deck viscous dampers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位
knowledge.titleEn: Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters
knowledge.text: 蘇通大橋主橋全長 2,088 m，若橋面在塔處完全固定，溫度伸縮與混凝土塔的徐變會在塔底產生巨大彎矩；若完全漂浮，颱風、船撞與地震又會讓橋面大幅縱飄，撞壞伸縮縫。設計團隊比較多種體系後，採用附加位移限制裝置的超大型液體黏滯阻尼器，公開論文指出這是此類裝置在橋梁工程的首次應用。
knowledge.textEn: The Sutong main bridge is 2,088 m long. Fixing the deck to the towers would let thermal movement and tower creep create huge tower-base moments; a fully floating deck would let typhoons, ship impact and earthquakes push it far enough to wreck the expansion joints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：黏滯阻尼器在任何速度下都提供相同的固定約束力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A viscous damper provides the same fixed restraint force at every velocity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters" is correct?
options: 黏滯阻尼器在任何速度下都提供相同的固定約束力。
蘇通大橋主橋全長 2,088 m，若橋面在塔處完全固定，溫度伸縮與混凝土塔的徐變會在塔底產生巨大彎矩。
同一座橋的風速在任何高度都一樣，只需要用一個設計風速。
optionsEn: A viscous damper provides the same fixed restraint force at every velocity.
The Sutong main bridge is 2,088 m long.
Wind speed is the same at every height on a bridge, so one design speed is enough.
quiz.explanation: 蘇通大橋主橋全長 2,088 m，若橋面在塔處完全固定，溫度伸縮與混凝土塔的徐變會在塔底產生巨大彎矩；若完全漂浮，颱風、船撞與地震又會讓橋面大幅縱飄，撞壞伸縮縫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Sutong main bridge is 2,088 m long. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tower–deck viscous dampers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT，取 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、自中點起算 L = 1,044 m、ΔT = 50 °C：ΔL ≈ 0.63 m。阻尼力 F = C·v^α：若 v = 0.4 m/s 時 F = 2,000 kN、α = 0.4，C = 2,000/0.4^0.4 ≈ 2,885 kN/(m/s)^0.4；v = 0.05 m/s 時 F ≈ 2,885×0.302 ≈ 870 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, L = 1,044 m from mid-length and ΔT = 50 °C, ΔL ≈ 0.63 m. Damper force F = C·v^α: if F = 2,000 kN at v = 0.4 m/s with α = 0.4, C = 2,000/0.4^0.4 ≈ 2,885 kN/(m/s)^0.4, and at v = 0.05 m/s F ≈ 2,885×0.302 ≈ 870 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：阻尼器以實尺寸試驗機做力—速度與疲勞循環試驗，限位裝置驗證觸發位移與剛度；安裝後監測塔梁相對位移、阻尼器行程與溫度，確認日常位移落在非限位區，事件後檢查行程紀錄是否觸及限位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test full-size dampers for force–velocity behaviour and fatigue cycling and verify the limiter’s engagement displacement and stiffness; after installation monitor tower–deck displacement, damper stroke and temperature to confirm daily movement stays outside the limiter zone, and after events check whether the stroke record reached the limit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, L = 1,044 m from mid-length and ΔT = 50 °C, ΔL ≈ 0.63 m. Damper force F = C·v^α: if F = 2,000 kN at v = 0.4 m/s with α = 0.4, C = 2,000/0.4^0.4 ≈ 2,885 kN/(m/s)^0.4, and at v = 0.05 m/s F ≈ 2,885×0.302 ≈ 870 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters", which statement holds?
options: 鋼錨箱放進塔內後，混凝土塔壁就完全不受斜索水平力。
多點提升時只要總荷重在設備容量內，各吊點就一定安全。
溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT，取 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、自中點起算 L = 1,044 m、ΔT = 50 °C：ΔL ≈ 0.63 m。
optionsEn: Once steel anchor boxes are in the tower, the concrete walls carry none of the horizontal stay force.
In a multi-point lift, every point is safe as long as the total load is within equipment capacity.
Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, L = 1,044 m from mid-length and ΔT = 50 °C, ΔL ≈ 0.63 m.
quiz.explanation: 溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT，取 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、自中點起算 L = 1,044 m、ΔT = 50 °C：ΔL ≈ 0.63 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT; with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C, L = 1,044 m from mid-length and ΔT = 50 °C, ΔL ≈ 0.63 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tower–deck viscous dampers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器以實尺寸試驗機做力—速度與疲勞循環試驗，限位裝置驗證觸發位移與剛度；安裝後監測塔梁相對位移、阻尼器行程與溫度，確認日常位移落在非限位區，事件後檢查行程紀錄是否觸及限位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test full-size dampers for force–velocity behaviour and fatigue cycling and verify the limiter’s engagement displacement and stiffness; after installation monitor tower–deck displacement, damper stroke and temperature to confirm daily movement stays outside the limiter zone, and after events check whether the stroke record reached the limit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：阻尼器與限位裝置的參數要與伸縮縫、支承的設計行程一起列表核對，並在維護手冊規定行程刻度巡檢、漏油判定與更換時的臨時約束方案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Tabulate damper and limiter parameters against the design travel of joints and bearings, and specify stroke-scale inspections, leak criteria and a temporary restraint scheme for replacement in the maintenance manual.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若限位值設得太小，日常溫度位移就會頂到限位，塔底承受不必要的彎矩；阻尼器漏油或密封磨耗會讓阻尼下降，強風時橋面縱向擺幅增加，伸縮縫與支承加速損壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A limit set too small lets daily thermal movement hit it, imposing unnecessary tower-base moments; oil leakage or seal wear reduces damping so the deck swings further longitudinally in strong wind, accelerating joint and bearing damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal restraint: viscous dampers with displacement limiters: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tower–deck viscous dampers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若限位值設得太小，日常溫度位移就會頂到限位，塔底承受不必要的彎矩；阻尼器漏油或密封磨耗會讓阻尼下降，強風時橋面縱向擺幅增加，伸縮縫與支承加速損壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A limit set too small lets daily thermal movement hit it, imposing unnecessary tower-base moments; oil leakage or seal wear reduces damping so the deck swings further longitudinally in strong wind, accelerating joint and bearing damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：慢速的溫度位移幾乎不受阻；快速的風振與地震由阻尼器耗能；位移一旦達到限位值，限位裝置接手，防止極端事件中橋面超出伸縮縫與支承的行程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Slow thermal movement is almost unresisted, fast wind and seismic motion is dissipated by the dampers, and once displacement reaches the limit the limiter takes over so the deck cannot exceed joint and bearing travel in an extreme event.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「黏滯阻尼器在任何速度下都提供相同的固定約束力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A viscous damper provides the same fixed restraint force at every velocity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「縱向約束：黏滯阻尼器加位移限位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 長江口風剖面與 300 m 塔的風荷載：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Estuary wind profile and wind load on 300 m towers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塔頂風速」如何影響蘇通長江公路大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tower-top wind speed” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sutong Yangtze River Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 蘇通大橋位於開闊的長江口，地表粗糙度低，風速隨高度增加明顯。主塔高 300.4 m，塔頂的風速遠高於橋面高度，而風壓又與風速平方成正比，所以塔上段承受的單位面積風力可比橋面高出四成以上。公開論文指出，300 m 高塔對風極為敏感，施工期的抗風問題尤其重要：塔柱在自立狀態下頻率低、沒有斜索與橋面約束，容易出現渦致振動與大幅擺動，需以臨時連接或阻尼措施控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塔頂風速」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sutong Bridge sits in the open Yangtze estuary, where low surface roughness makes wind speed rise markedly with height. The towers are 300.4 m tall, so wind speed at the top is far above that at deck level, and because pressure goes with the square of speed, the upper tower can see over four-tenths more pressure per unit area than the deck. Published papers stress that a 300 m tower is highly wind-sensitive, especially during construction: a free-standing tower has low frequencies and no restraint from stays or deck, so it is prone to vortex-induced vibration and large sway that must be controlled with temporary ties or damping. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tower-top wind speed” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：指數律風剖面 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Power-law profile U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一座橋的風速在任何高度都一樣，只需要用一個設計風速。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Wind speed is the same at every height on a bridge, so one design speed is enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塔頂風速」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tower-top wind speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Estuary wind profile and wind load on 300 m towers
knowledge.text: 蘇通大橋位於開闊的長江口，地表粗糙度低，風速隨高度增加明顯。主塔高 300.4 m，塔頂的風速遠高於橋面高度，而風壓又與風速平方成正比，所以塔上段承受的單位面積風力可比橋面高出四成以上。
knowledge.textEn: Sutong Bridge sits in the open Yangtze estuary, where low surface roughness makes wind speed rise markedly with height. The towers are 300.4 m tall, so wind speed at the top is far above that at deck level, and because pressure goes with the square of speed, the upper tower can see over four-tenths more pressure per unit area than the deck.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一座橋的風速在任何高度都一樣，只需要用一個設計風速。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Wind speed is the same at every height on a bridge, so one design speed is enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長江口風剖面與 300 m 塔的風荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Estuary wind profile and wind load on 300 m towers" is correct?
options: 同一座橋的風速在任何高度都一樣，只需要用一個設計風速。

Piles must reach rock to be reliable; friction piles are unsuitable for major bridge towers.
Sutong Bridge sits in the open Yangtze estuary, where low surface roughness makes wind speed rise markedly with height.

steps.title: 長江口風剖面與 300 m 塔的風荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Estuary wind profile and wind load on 300 m towers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔頂風速」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tower-top wind speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：指數律風剖面 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。取 U₁₀ = 38 m/s、α = 0.12：橋面 z = 70 m 時 U ≈ 38×1.263 ≈ 48.0 m/s；塔頂 z = 300 m 時 U ≈ 38×1.504 ≈ 57.2 m/s；風壓比 (57.2/48.0)² ≈ 1.42。風速與指數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Power-law profile U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α. With U₁₀ = 38 m/s and α = 0.12, the deck at z = 70 m sees U ≈ 38×1.263 ≈ 48.0 m/s and the tower top at z = 300 m sees U ≈ 38×1.504 ≈ 57.2 m/s; the pressure ratio is (57.2/48.0)² ≈ 1.42. Speeds and exponent are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以橋址氣象站與塔上不同高度的風速計長期量測，擬合實際風剖面指數與紊流強度，與設計假設比較；自立塔階段在塔頂設加速度計，觀察渦振的風速與振幅，確認臨時抑振措施有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure long-term wind at the site station and on anemometers at several tower heights, fit the actual profile exponent and turbulence intensity and compare with design assumptions; during the free-standing tower stage place accelerometers at the top to observe vortex vibration speeds and amplitudes and confirm temporary suppression works.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Power-law profile U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α. With U₁₀ = 38 m/s and α = 0.12, the deck at z = 70 m sees U ≈ 38×1.263 ≈ 48.0 m/s and the tower top at z = 300 m sees U ≈ 38×1.504 ≈ 57.2 m/s; the pressure ratio is (57.2/48.0)² ≈ 1.42. Speeds and exponent are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長江口風剖面與 300 m 塔的風荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 指數律風剖面 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。

steps.instruction: 以橋址氣象站與塔上不同高度的風速計長期量測，擬合實際風剖面指數與紊流強度，與設計假設比較；自立塔階段在塔頂設加速度計，觀察渦振的風速與振幅，確認臨時抑振措施有效。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫應依高度分段訂出塔吊與爬模的停工風速，並把自立塔最高狀態的抗風措施列為停留檢查點；塔上風速計資料要與施工日誌同步保存。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The method statement should set stop-work wind speeds for cranes and climbing forms by height band, with wind measures for the tallest free-standing state a hold point; tower anemometer data should be archived alongside the site diary.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沿用橋面高度的風速設計塔上段與施工設備，塔吊、爬模與錨箱吊裝可能在高處遭遇超出預期的風力；自立塔渦振若未控制，反覆擺動會使施工機具與未硬化混凝土受損。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing the upper tower and its equipment for deck-level wind can expose tower cranes, climbing forms and anchor-box lifts to unexpectedly high forces at height; uncontrolled vortex vibration of the free-standing tower can damage equipment and green concrete through repeated sway. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.textEn: The method statement should set stop-work wind speeds for cranes and climbing forms by height band, with wind measures for the tallest free-standing state a hold point; tower anemometer data should be archived alongside the site diary.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長江口風剖面與 300 m 塔的風荷載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Estuary wind profile and wind load on 300 m towers"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以橋址氣象站與塔上不同高度的風速計長期量測，擬合實際風剖面指數與紊流強度，與設計假設比較。
混凝土塔完工後高度就固定不變，不需要預留壓縮量。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Measure long-term wind at the site station and on anemometers at several tower heights, fit the actual profile exponent and turbulence intensity and compare with design assumptions.
A concrete tower’s height is fixed once complete, so no allowance for shortening is needed.
quiz.explanation: 以橋址氣象站與塔上不同高度的風速計長期量測，擬合實際風剖面指數與紊流強度，與設計假設比較；自立塔階段在塔頂設加速度計，觀察渦振的風速與振幅，確認臨時抑振措施有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure long-term wind at the site station and on anemometers at several tower heights, fit the actual profile exponent and turbulence intensity and compare with design assumptions; during the free-standing tower stage place accelerometers at the top to observe vortex vibration speeds and amplitudes and confirm temporary suppression works. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長江口風剖面與 300 m 塔的風荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Estuary wind profile and wind load on 300 m towers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塔頂風速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tower-top wind speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若沿用橋面高度的風速設計塔上段與施工設備，塔吊、爬模與錨箱吊裝可能在高處遭遇超出預期的風力；自立塔渦振若未控制，反覆擺動會使施工機具與未硬化混凝土受損。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing the upper tower and its equipment for deck-level wind can expose tower cranes, climbing forms and anchor-box lifts to unexpectedly high forces at height; uncontrolled vortex vibration of the free-standing tower can damage equipment and green concrete through repeated sway. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：公開論文指出，300 m 高塔對風極為敏感，施工期的抗風問題尤其重要：塔柱在自立狀態下頻率低、沒有斜索與橋面約束，容易出現渦致振動與大幅擺動，需以臨時連接或阻尼措施控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Published papers stress that a 300 m tower is highly wind-sensitive, especially during construction: a free-standing tower has low frequencies and no restraint from stays or deck, so it is prone to vortex-induced vibration and large sway that must be controlled with temporary ties or damping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一座橋的風速在任何高度都一樣，只需要用一個設計風速。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Wind speed is the same at every height on a bridge, so one design speed is enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若沿用橋面高度的風速設計塔上段與施工設備，塔吊、爬模與錨箱吊裝可能在高處遭遇超出預期的風力；自立塔渦振若未控制，反覆擺動會使施工機具與未硬化混凝土受損。
knowledge.textEn: Designing the upper tower and its equipment for deck-level wind can expose tower cranes, climbing forms and anchor-box lifts to unexpectedly high forces at height; uncontrolled vortex vibration of the free-standing tower can damage equipment and green concrete through repeated sway.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長江口風剖面與 300 m 塔的風荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Estuary wind profile and wind load on 300 m towers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
基樁一定要打到岩盤才可靠，摩擦樁不適合大橋主塔。
若沿用橋面高度的風速設計塔上段與施工設備，塔吊、爬模與錨箱吊裝可能在高處遭遇超出預期的風力；自立塔渦振若未控制，反覆擺動會使施工機具與未硬化混凝土受損。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Piles must reach rock to be reliable; friction piles are unsuitable for major bridge towers.
Designing the upper tower and its equipment for deck-level wind can expose tower cranes, climbing forms and anchor-box lifts to unexpectedly high forces at height.
quiz.explanation: 若沿用橋面高度的風速設計塔上段與施工設備，塔吊、爬模與錨箱吊裝可能在高處遭遇超出預期的風力；自立塔渦振若未控制，反覆擺動會使施工機具與未硬化混凝土受損。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing the upper tower and its equipment for deck-level wind can expose tower cranes, climbing forms and anchor-box lifts to unexpectedly high forces at height; uncontrolled vortex vibration of the free-standing tower can damage equipment and green concrete through repeated sway. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「131 根鑽孔摩擦樁的承載與群樁效應」與「鋼錨箱與混凝土塔壁的組合錨固區」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Capacity of 131 bored friction piles and group effects" and "Composite anchorage zone of steel boxes and concrete walls": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 131 根鑽孔摩擦樁的承載與群樁效應：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Capacity of 131 bored friction piles and group effects: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「主塔群樁」如何影響蘇通長江公路大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Main-tower pile group” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sutong Yangtze River Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 長江口的沉積層極厚，岩盤深達約 300 m，基樁無法嵌岩，只能靠樁側摩擦與樁端承載把荷重傳到砂土層。公開報導指出每座主塔由 131 根直徑達 2.8 m、長約 120 m 的鑽孔灌注樁支承，群樁平面約 114 m × 48 m。摩擦樁的承載主要來自深部砂層的側阻，群樁中各樁應力球重疊，群樁沉陷大於單樁；同時水流沖刷會把上部土層移走，降低有效埋深與側阻。因此設計同時檢查單樁承載、群樁沉陷與沖刷後的承載折減。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「主塔群樁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Yangtze estuary sediments are extremely thick, with rock about 300 m down, so piles cannot be socketed into rock and must carry load by shaft friction and end bearing in sand layers. Public reports state that each main tower stands on 131 bored cast-in-place piles up to 2.8 m in diameter and about 120 m long, in a group about 114 m × 48 m in plan. Friction-pile capacity comes mainly from shaft resistance in deep sands; stress bulbs overlap within the group, so group settlement exceeds single-pile settlement, and scour removes upper soil, reducing embedment and shaft resistance. Design therefore checks single-pile capacity, group settlement and capacity after scour together. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Main-tower pile group” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單樁側阻 Q_s = π·D·L·f_s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Single-pile shaft capacity Q_s = π·D·L·f_s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基樁一定要打到岩盤才可靠，摩擦樁不適合大橋主塔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Piles must reach rock to be reliable; friction piles are unsuitable for major bridge towers." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「主塔群樁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Main-tower pile group”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 131 根鑽孔摩擦樁的承載與群樁效應
knowledge.titleEn: Capacity of 131 bored friction piles and group effects
knowledge.text: 長江口的沉積層極厚，岩盤深達約 300 m，基樁無法嵌岩，只能靠樁側摩擦與樁端承載把荷重傳到砂土層。公開報導指出每座主塔由 131 根直徑達 2.8 m、長約 120 m 的鑽孔灌注樁支承，群樁平面約 114 m × 48 m。
knowledge.textEn: The Yangtze estuary sediments are extremely thick, with rock about 300 m down, so piles cannot be socketed into rock and must carry load by shaft friction and end bearing in sand layers. Public reports state that each main tower stands on 131 bored cast-in-place piles up to 2.8 m in diameter and about 120 m long, in a group about 114 m × 48 m in plan.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基樁一定要打到岩盤才可靠，摩擦樁不適合大橋主塔。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Piles must reach rock to be reliable; friction piles are unsuitable for major bridge towers. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「131 根鑽孔摩擦樁的承載與群樁效應」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Capacity of 131 bored friction piles and group effects" is correct?
options: 長江口的沉積層極厚，岩盤深達約 300 m，基樁無法嵌岩，只能靠樁側摩擦與樁端承載把荷重傳到砂土層。
基樁一定要打到岩盤才可靠，摩擦樁不適合大橋主塔。
鋼錨箱放進塔內後，混凝土塔壁就完全不受斜索水平力。
optionsEn: The Yangtze estuary sediments are extremely thick, with rock about 300 m down, so piles cannot be socketed into rock and must carry load by shaft friction and end bearing in sand layers.
Piles must reach rock to be reliable; friction piles are unsuitable for major bridge towers.
Once steel anchor boxes are in the tower, the concrete walls carry none of the horizontal stay force.
quiz.explanation: 長江口的沉積層極厚，岩盤深達約 300 m，基樁無法嵌岩，只能靠樁側摩擦與樁端承載把荷重傳到砂土層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Yangtze estuary sediments are extremely thick, with rock about 300 m down, so piles cannot be socketed into rock and must carry load by shaft friction and end bearing in sand layers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 131 根鑽孔摩擦樁的承載與群樁效應：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Capacity of 131 bored friction piles and group effects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主塔群樁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Main-tower pile group” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單樁側阻 Q_s = π·D·L·f_s。取 D = 2.8 m、有效長 L = 117 m、平均側阻 f_s = 60 kPa：Q_s = π×2.8×117×60 ≈ 61,750 kN；端阻以 3,000 kPa 計 Q_b = π×2.8²/4×3,000 ≈ 18,470 kN。若沖刷使有效長減 10 m，Q_s 降約 5,280 kN。土壤參數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Single-pile shaft capacity Q_s = π·D·L·f_s. With D = 2.8 m, effective length L = 117 m and mean shaft friction f_s = 60 kPa, Q_s = π×2.8×117×60 ≈ 61,750 kN; end bearing at 3,000 kPa gives Q_b = π×2.8²/4×3,000 ≈ 18,470 kN. If scour removes 10 m of effective length, Q_s falls by about 5,280 kN. Soil parameters are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以試樁的靜載試驗或自平衡（雙向）試驗取得荷重—沉陷曲線，反算各土層側阻並修正設計參數；工程樁以聲波透測檢查完整性，樁底沉渣以測繩或鑽芯確認；施工與營運期以水準與沉陷板監測群樁沉陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use static or self-balanced bidirectional load tests on trial piles to obtain load–settlement curves, back-calculate layer shaft friction and correct the design parameters; check working piles by cross-hole sonic logging, verify base cleanliness by sounding or coring, and monitor group settlement with levelling and settlement plates during construction and service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單樁側阻 Q_s = π·D·L·f_s。取 D = 2.8 m、有效長 L = 117 m、平均側阻 f_s = 60 kPa：Q_s = π×2.8×117×60 ≈ 61,750 kN；端阻以 3,000 kPa 計 Q_b = π×2.8²/4×3,000 ≈ 18,470 kN。若沖刷使有效長減 10 m，Q_s 降約 5,280 kN。土壤參數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Single-pile shaft capacity Q_s = π·D·L·f_s. With D = 2.8 m, effective length L = 117 m and mean shaft friction f_s = 60 kPa, Q_s = π×2.8×117×60 ≈ 61,750 kN; end bearing at 3,000 kPa gives Q_b = π×2.8²/4×3,000 ≈ 18,470 kN. If scour removes 10 m of effective length, Q_s falls by about 5,280 kN. Soil parameters are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「131 根鑽孔摩擦樁的承載與群樁效應」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Capacity of 131 bored friction piles and group effects", which statement holds?
options: 多點提升時只要總荷重在設備容量內，各吊點就一定安全。
單樁側阻 Q_s = π·D·L·f_s。
沖刷坑在洪水後會自然回淤，所以不會影響基樁承載。
optionsEn: In a multi-point lift, every point is safe as long as the total load is within equipment capacity.
Single-pile shaft capacity Q_s = π·D·L·f_s.
Scour holes refill naturally after floods, so they never affect pile capacity.
quiz.explanation: 單樁側阻 Q_s = π·D·L·f_s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Single-pile shaft capacity Q_s = π·D·L·f_s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 131 根鑽孔摩擦樁的承載與群樁效應：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Capacity of 131 bored friction piles and group effects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主塔群樁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Main-tower pile group” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以試樁的靜載試驗或自平衡（雙向）試驗取得荷重—沉陷曲線，反算各土層側阻並修正設計參數；工程樁以聲波透測檢查完整性，樁底沉渣以測繩或鑽芯確認；施工與營運期以水準與沉陷板監測群樁沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use static or self-balanced bidirectional load tests on trial piles to obtain load–settlement curves, back-calculate layer shaft friction and correct the design parameters; check working piles by cross-hole sonic logging, verify base cleanliness by sounding or coring, and monitor group settlement with levelling and settlement plates during construction and service. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大型摩擦樁群要先做試樁再定案樁長，並把鑽孔垂直度、泥漿性質、沉渣厚度與灌注連續性列為每根樁的檢查項目；試樁報告要回饋到設計並由設計單位確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For large friction-pile groups, test trial piles before finalising pile length, make drilling verticality, slurry properties, base sediment and continuity of concreting checklist items for every pile, and feed trial-pile reports back to the designer for confirmation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樁底沉渣過厚或泥漿護壁形成厚泥皮，會大幅降低端阻與側阻，使單樁沉陷超出預期；群樁不均勻沉陷會使承台傾斜，進而改變塔軸與斜索索力分布。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Thick base sediment or a heavy bentonite filter cake sharply reduces end and shaft resistance so single piles settle more than predicted; uneven group settlement tilts the cap, changing the tower axis and the distribution of stay forces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以試樁的靜載試驗或自平衡（雙向）試驗取得荷重—沉陷曲線，反算各土層側阻並修正設計參數；工程樁以聲波透測檢查完整性，樁底沉渣以測繩或鑽芯確認；施工與營運期以水準與沉陷板監測群樁沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Use static or self-balanced bidirectional load tests on trial piles to obtain load–settlement curves, back-calculate layer shaft friction and correct the design parameters; check working piles by cross-hole sonic logging, verify base cleanliness by sounding or coring, and monitor group settlement with levelling and settlement plates during construction and service.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 大型摩擦樁群要先做試樁再定案樁長，並把鑽孔垂直度、泥漿性質、沉渣厚度與灌注連續性列為每根樁的檢查項目；試樁報告要回饋到設計並由設計單位確認。
knowledge.textEn: For large friction-pile groups, test trial piles before finalising pile length, make drilling verticality, slurry properties, base sediment and continuity of concreting checklist items for every pile, and feed trial-pile reports back to the designer for confirmation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「131 根鑽孔摩擦樁的承載與群樁效應」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Capacity of 131 bored friction piles and group effects"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
超長斜索只會以第一階模態振動，只要針對第一階設計阻尼器即可。
以試樁的靜載試驗或自平衡（雙向）試驗取得荷重—沉陷曲線，反算各土層側阻並修正設計參數。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Very long stays vibrate only in the first mode, so dampers need only target mode 1.
Use static or self-balanced bidirectional load tests on trial piles to obtain load–settlement curves, back-calculate layer shaft friction and correct the design parameters.
quiz.explanation: 以試樁的靜載試驗或自平衡（雙向）試驗取得荷重—沉陷曲線，反算各土層側阻並修正設計參數；工程樁以聲波透測檢查完整性，樁底沉渣以測繩或鑽芯確認；施工與營運期以水準與沉陷板監測群樁沉陷。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use static or self-balanced bidirectional load tests on trial piles to obtain load–settlement curves, back-calculate layer shaft friction and correct the design parameters; check working piles by cross-hole sonic logging, verify base cleanliness by sounding or coring, and monitor group settlement with levelling and settlement plates during construction and service. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 131 根鑽孔摩擦樁的承載與群樁效應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Capacity of 131 bored friction piles and group effects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主塔群樁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Main-tower pile group” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樁底沉渣過厚或泥漿護壁形成厚泥皮，會大幅降低端阻與側阻，使單樁沉陷超出預期；群樁不均勻沉陷會使承台傾斜，進而改變塔軸與斜索索力分布。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Thick base sediment or a heavy bentonite filter cake sharply reduces end and shaft resistance so single piles settle more than predicted; uneven group settlement tilts the cap, changing the tower axis and the distribution of stay forces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此設計同時檢查單樁承載、群樁沉陷與沖刷後的承載折減。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design therefore checks single-pile capacity, group settlement and capacity after scour together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基樁一定要打到岩盤才可靠，摩擦樁不適合大橋主塔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Piles must reach rock to be reliable; friction piles are unsuitable for major bridge towers." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 樁底沉渣過厚或泥漿護壁形成厚泥皮，會大幅降低端阻與側阻，使單樁沉陷超出預期；群樁不均勻沉陷會使承台傾斜，進而改變塔軸與斜索索力分布。
knowledge.textEn: Thick base sediment or a heavy bentonite filter cake sharply reduces end and shaft resistance so single piles settle more than predicted; uneven group settlement tilts the cap, changing the tower axis and the distribution of stay forces.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「131 根鑽孔摩擦樁的承載與群樁效應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Capacity of 131 bored friction piles and group effects" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 樁底沉渣過厚或泥漿護壁形成厚泥皮，會大幅降低端阻與側阻，使單樁沉陷超出預期；群樁不均勻沉陷會使承台傾斜，進而改變塔軸與斜索索力分布。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鋼錨箱放進塔內後，混凝土塔壁就完全不受斜索水平力。
optionsEn: Thick base sediment or a heavy bentonite filter cake sharply reduces end and shaft resistance so single piles settle more than predicted.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once steel anchor boxes are in the tower, the concrete walls carry none of the horizontal stay force.
quiz.explanation: 樁底沉渣過厚或泥漿護壁形成厚泥皮，會大幅降低端阻與側阻，使單樁沉陷超出預期；群樁不均勻沉陷會使承台傾斜，進而改變塔軸與斜索索力分布。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Thick base sediment or a heavy bentonite filter cake sharply reduces end and shaft resistance so single piles settle more than predicted; uneven group settlement tilts the cap, changing the tower axis and the distribution of stay forces. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼錨箱與混凝土塔壁的組合錨固區：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite anchorage zone of steel boxes and concrete walls: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼錨箱」如何影響蘇通長江公路大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel anchor boxes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sutong Yangtze River Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開論文指出，蘇通大橋塔的斜索錨固區採鋼—混凝土組合結構，構造與受力都相當複雜，長期耐久性需特別關注。斜索的水平分力會把塔壁向外拉開，若只靠混凝土承受就需要大量環向預力；把鋼錨箱嵌入塔內後，兩側斜索的水平分力大部分在鋼錨箱內自我平衡，剩餘部分再經剪力連接件傳給混凝土。力量如何在鋼與混凝土之間分配，取決於兩者的相對勁度與連接件的滑移，因此錨固區的設計需要精細的局部分析與試驗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼錨箱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Published papers state that the Sutong tower anchorage zone uses a steel–concrete composite structure whose construction and load behaviour are complex, with long-term durability needing close attention. The horizontal components of the stays try to split the tower walls apart, and resisting them with concrete alone needs heavy circumferential prestress; with steel anchor boxes embedded in the tower, most of the horizontal force from opposite stays is balanced inside the box, and the remainder passes to the concrete through shear connectors. How force is shared between steel and concrete depends on their relative stiffness and connector slip, so the anchorage zone needs detailed local analysis and testing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Steel anchor boxes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：索力 T = 7,000 kN、與水平夾角 25° 時水平分力 H = 7,000×cos25° ≈ 6,344 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a stay force T = 7,000 kN at 25° to the horizontal, the horizontal component is H = 7,000×cos25° ≈ 6,344 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼錨箱放進塔內後，混凝土塔壁就完全不受斜索水平力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once steel anchor boxes are in the tower, the concrete walls carry none of the horizontal stay force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼錨箱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Steel anchor boxes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼錨箱與混凝土塔壁的組合錨固區
knowledge.titleEn: Composite anchorage zone of steel boxes and concrete walls
knowledge.text: 公開論文指出，蘇通大橋塔的斜索錨固區採鋼—混凝土組合結構，構造與受力都相當複雜，長期耐久性需特別關注。斜索的水平分力會把塔壁向外拉開，若只靠混凝土承受就需要大量環向預力；把鋼錨箱嵌入塔內後，兩側斜索的水平分力大部分在鋼錨箱內自我平衡，剩餘部分再經剪力連接件傳給混凝土。
knowledge.textEn: Published papers state that the Sutong tower anchorage zone uses a steel–concrete composite structure whose construction and load behaviour are complex, with long-term durability needing close attention. The horizontal components of the stays try to split the tower walls apart, and resisting them with concrete alone needs heavy circumferential prestress; with steel anchor boxes embedded in the tower, most of the horizontal force from opposite stays is balanced inside the box, and the remainder passes to the concrete through shear connectors.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼錨箱放進塔內後，混凝土塔壁就完全不受斜索水平力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once steel anchor boxes are in the tower, the concrete walls carry none of the horizontal stay force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼錨箱與混凝土塔壁的組合錨固區」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Composite anchorage zone of steel boxes and concrete walls" is correct?
options: 鋼錨箱放進塔內後，混凝土塔壁就完全不受斜索水平力。
公開論文指出，蘇通大橋塔的斜索錨固區採鋼—混凝土組合結構，構造與受力都相當複雜，長期耐久性需特別關注。
施工平台只是臨時設施，不需要像永久結構一樣做設計檢核。
optionsEn: Once steel anchor boxes are in the tower, the concrete walls carry none of the horizontal stay force.

Published papers state that the Sutong tower anchorage zone uses a steel–concrete composite structure whose construction and load behaviour are complex, with long-term durability needing close attention.
A work platform is temporary, so it needs no design checks like a permanent structure.
quiz.explanation: 公開論文指出，蘇通大橋塔的斜索錨固區採鋼—混凝土組合結構，構造與受力都相當複雜，長期耐久性需特別關注。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Published papers state that the Sutong tower anchorage zone uses a steel–concrete composite structure whose construction and load behaviour are complex, with long-term durability needing close attention. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼錨箱與混凝土塔壁的組合錨固區：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Composite anchorage zone of steel boxes and concrete walls: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼錨箱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel anchor boxes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：索力 T = 7,000 kN、與水平夾角 25° 時水平分力 H = 7,000×cos25° ≈ 6,344 kN。若鋼錨箱與混凝土壁的勁度比使鋼箱分擔 60%，鋼箱承受約 3,806 kN，混凝土壁約 2,538 kN；分擔比改為 80% 時混凝土只剩約 1,269 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a stay force T = 7,000 kN at 25° to the horizontal, the horizontal component is H = 7,000×cos25° ≈ 6,344 kN. If relative stiffness gives the steel box 60%, it carries about 3,806 kN and the concrete wall about 2,538 kN; at an 80% share the concrete carries only about 1,269 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以足尺或大比例錨固區試體加載，量測鋼錨箱應變、剪力連接件滑移與混凝土裂縫，與局部有限元素模型比較分擔比；施工時檢查錨箱定位、焊道超音波檢測與混凝土澆置密實度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Load full-size or large-scale anchorage specimens, measuring anchor-box strains, connector slip and concrete cracking, and compare the force share with a local finite-element model; during construction check box positioning, ultrasonic testing of welds and concrete compaction around the boxes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 索力 T = 7,000 kN、與水平夾角 25° 時水平分力 H = 7,000×cos25° ≈ 6,344 kN。若鋼錨箱與混凝土壁的勁度比使鋼箱分擔 60%，鋼箱承受約 3,806 kN，混凝土壁約 2,538 kN；分擔比改為 80% 時混凝土只剩約 1,269 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a stay force T = 7,000 kN at 25° to the horizontal, the horizontal component is H = 7,000×cos25° ≈ 6,344 kN. If relative stiffness gives the steel box 60%, it carries about 3,806 kN and the concrete wall about 2,538 kN; at an 80% share the concrete carries only about 1,269 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼錨箱與混凝土塔壁的組合錨固區」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Composite anchorage zone of steel boxes and concrete walls", which statement holds?
options: 風洞模型只要外形相似，不需要考慮質量與勁度的縮尺。
混凝土塔完工後高度就固定不變，不需要預留壓縮量。
索力 T = 7,000 kN、與水平夾角 25° 時水平分力 H = 7,000×cos25° ≈ 6,344 kN。
optionsEn: A wind-tunnel model only needs the right shape; mass and stiffness scaling do not matter.
A concrete tower’s height is fixed once complete, so no allowance for shortening is needed.
For a stay force T = 7,000 kN at 25° to the horizontal, the horizontal component is H = 7,000×cos25° ≈ 6,344 kN.

quiz.explanationEn: For a stay force T = 7,000 kN at 25° to the horizontal, the horizontal component is H = 7,000×cos25° ≈ 6,344 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼錨箱與混凝土塔壁的組合錨固區：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Composite anchorage zone of steel boxes and concrete walls: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼錨箱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel anchor boxes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以足尺或大比例錨固區試體加載，量測鋼錨箱應變、剪力連接件滑移與混凝土裂縫，與局部有限元素模型比較分擔比；施工時檢查錨箱定位、焊道超音波檢測與混凝土澆置密實度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Load full-size or large-scale anchorage specimens, measuring anchor-box strains, connector slip and concrete cracking, and compare the force share with a local finite-element model; during construction check box positioning, ultrasonic testing of welds and concrete compaction around the boxes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：錨箱節段應在工廠預拼並量測斜索出口角度，現場以測量控制每節錨箱的空間位置；錨固區混凝土要有裂縫寬度檢查與記錄，作為營運期比較的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Pre-assemble anchor-box segments in the shop and measure stay exit angles, control each box’s spatial position by survey on site, and record crack widths in the anchorage concrete as a baseline for in-service comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若混凝土分擔比被低估，塔壁在使用荷載下出現豎向裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕預力與鋼筋；錨箱焊道細節不良則在斜索活載的反覆作用下產生疲勞裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Underestimating the concrete share lets vertical cracks open in the walls under service load, admitting water that corrodes prestress and reinforcement; poor weld details in the anchor box develop fatigue cracks under repeated live-load stay forces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以足尺或大比例錨固區試體加載，量測鋼錨箱應變、剪力連接件滑移與混凝土裂縫，與局部有限元素模型比較分擔比；施工時檢查錨箱定位、焊道超音波檢測與混凝土澆置密實度。
knowledge.textEn: Load full-size or large-scale anchorage specimens, measuring anchor-box strains, connector slip and concrete cracking, and compare the force share with a local finite-element model; during construction check box positioning, ultrasonic testing of welds and concrete compaction around the boxes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 錨箱節段應在工廠預拼並量測斜索出口角度，現場以測量控制每節錨箱的空間位置；錨固區混凝土要有裂縫寬度檢查與記錄，作為營運期比較的基準。
knowledge.textEn: Pre-assemble anchor-box segments in the shop and measure stay exit angles, control each box’s spatial position by survey on site, and record crack widths in the anchorage concrete as a baseline for in-service comparison.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼錨箱與混凝土塔壁的組合錨固區」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Composite anchorage zone of steel boxes and concrete walls"?
options: 以足尺或大比例錨固區試體加載，量測鋼錨箱應變、剪力連接件滑移與混凝土裂縫，與局部有限元素模型比較分擔比；施工時檢查錨箱定位、焊道超音波檢測與混凝土澆置密實度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
黏滯阻尼器在任何速度下都提供相同的固定約束力。
optionsEn: Load full-size or large-scale anchorage specimens, measuring anchor-box strains, connector slip and concrete cracking, and compare the force share with a local finite-element model.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A viscous damper provides the same fixed restraint force at every velocity.
quiz.explanation: 以足尺或大比例錨固區試體加載，量測鋼錨箱應變、剪力連接件滑移與混凝土裂縫，與局部有限元素模型比較分擔比；施工時檢查錨箱定位、焊道超音波檢測與混凝土澆置密實度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Load full-size or large-scale anchorage specimens, measuring anchor-box strains, connector slip and concrete cracking, and compare the force share with a local finite-element model; during construction check box positioning, ultrasonic testing of welds and concrete compaction around the boxes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼錨箱與混凝土塔壁的組合錨固區：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Composite anchorage zone of steel boxes and concrete walls: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼錨箱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Steel anchor boxes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若混凝土分擔比被低估，塔壁在使用荷載下出現豎向裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕預力與鋼筋；錨箱焊道細節不良則在斜索活載的反覆作用下產生疲勞裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Underestimating the concrete share lets vertical cracks open in the walls under service load, admitting water that corrodes prestress and reinforcement; poor weld details in the anchor box develop fatigue cracks under repeated live-load stay forces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：力量如何在鋼與混凝土之間分配，取決於兩者的相對勁度與連接件的滑移，因此錨固區的設計需要精細的局部分析與試驗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: How force is shared between steel and concrete depends on their relative stiffness and connector slip, so the anchorage zone needs detailed local analysis and testing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼錨箱放進塔內後，混凝土塔壁就完全不受斜索水平力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once steel anchor boxes are in the tower, the concrete walls carry none of the horizontal stay force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若混凝土分擔比被低估，塔壁在使用荷載下出現豎向裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕預力與鋼筋；錨箱焊道細節不良則在斜索活載的反覆作用下產生疲勞裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Underestimating the concrete share lets vertical cracks open in the walls under service load, admitting water that corrodes prestress and reinforcement; poor weld details in the anchor box develop fatigue cracks under repeated live-load stay forces.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼錨箱與混凝土塔壁的組合錨固區」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Composite anchorage zone of steel boxes and concrete walls" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若混凝土分擔比被低估，塔壁在使用荷載下出現豎向裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕預力與鋼筋；錨箱焊道細節不良則在斜索活載的反覆作用下產生疲勞裂縫。
施工平台只是臨時設施，不需要像永久結構一樣做設計檢核。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Underestimating the concrete share lets vertical cracks open in the walls under service load, admitting water that corrodes prestress and reinforcement.
A work platform is temporary, so it needs no design checks like a permanent structure.
quiz.explanation: 若混凝土分擔比被低估，塔壁在使用荷載下出現豎向裂縫，水分進入後腐蝕預力與鋼筋；錨箱焊道細節不良則在斜索活載的反覆作用下產生疲勞裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Underestimating the concrete share lets vertical cracks open in the walls under service load, admitting water that corrodes prestress and reinforcement; poor weld details in the anchor box develop fatigue cracks under repeated live-load stay forces. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「深水施工平台、鋼護筒與樁垂直度」與「鋼箱梁大節段同步提升與合龍」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Deep-water platforms, steel casings and pile verticality" and "Synchronised lifting of steel box segments and closure": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 深水施工平台、鋼護筒與樁垂直度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Deep-water platforms, steel casings and pile verticality: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼護筒施工平台」如何影響蘇通長江公路大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel-casing work platform” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sutong Yangtze River Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 在浪高約 3 m、潮差約 4 m、每天約 3,000 艘船通過的江面上鑽 131 根百米長樁，第一步是建立穩定的施工平台。公開報導指出，承包商原計畫以約 130 根 60 m 長臨時鋼管支撐約 117 m × 55 m 的平台，但試打的 12 根不穩定，後改用 120 m 長的永久鋼護筒兼作平台支撐。鋼護筒提供鑽孔導向並保護孔壁，其垂直度直接決定樁身在深處是否偏離設計位置；樁偏斜會改變群樁受力分配並與相鄰樁碰撞。報導指出設計垂直度容許 1/200，實際達到約 1/400。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼護筒施工平台」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drilling 131 piles each about 100 m long in a river with waves of about 3 m, tides of about 4 m and some 3,000 ships a day starts with a stable work platform. Public reports state that the contractor planned about 130 temporary 60 m steel pipes to support a platform of about 117 m × 55 m, but 12 trial pipes proved unstable, so 120 m permanent steel casings were used to support the platform. The casings guide drilling and protect the bore, and their verticality determines whether the pile drifts from position at depth; inclined piles change load sharing in the group and can clash with neighbours. The reports cite a design verticality tolerance of 1/200 and achieved values of about 1/400. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Steel-casing work platform” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樁底偏位 e = L×傾斜率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pile-toe offset e = L × inclination.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工平台只是臨時設施，不需要像永久結構一樣做設計檢核。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A work platform is temporary, so it needs no design checks like a permanent structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼護筒施工平台」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Steel-casing work platform”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 深水施工平台、鋼護筒與樁垂直度
knowledge.titleEn: Deep-water platforms, steel casings and pile verticality
knowledge.text: 在浪高約 3 m、潮差約 4 m、每天約 3,000 艘船通過的江面上鑽 131 根百米長樁，第一步是建立穩定的施工平台。公開報導指出，承包商原計畫以約 130 根 60 m 長臨時鋼管支撐約 117 m × 55 m 的平台，但試打的 12 根不穩定，後改用 120 m 長的永久鋼護筒兼作平台支撐。
knowledge.textEn: Drilling 131 piles each about 100 m long in a river with waves of about 3 m, tides of about 4 m and some 3,000 ships a day starts with a stable work platform. Public reports state that the contractor planned about 130 temporary 60 m steel pipes to support a platform of about 117 m × 55 m, but 12 trial pipes proved unstable, so 120 m permanent steel casings were used to support the platform.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工平台只是臨時設施，不需要像永久結構一樣做設計檢核。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A work platform is temporary, so it needs no design checks like a permanent structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「深水施工平台、鋼護筒與樁垂直度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deep-water platforms, steel casings and pile verticality" is correct?
options: 施工平台只是臨時設施，不需要像永久結構一樣做設計檢核。
多點提升時只要總荷重在設備容量內，各吊點就一定安全。
在浪高約 3 m、潮差約 4 m、每天約 3,000 艘船通過的江面上鑽 131 根百米長樁，第一步是建立穩定的施工平台。
optionsEn: A work platform is temporary, so it needs no design checks like a permanent structure.
In a multi-point lift, every point is safe as long as the total load is within equipment capacity.
Drilling 131 piles each about 100 m long in a river with waves of about 3 m, tides of about 4 m and some 3,000 ships a day starts with a stable work platform.
quiz.explanation: 在浪高約 3 m、潮差約 4 m、每天約 3,000 艘船通過的江面上鑽 131 根百米長樁，第一步是建立穩定的施工平台。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drilling 131 piles each about 100 m long in a river with waves of about 3 m, tides of about 4 m and some 3,000 ships a day starts with a stable work platform. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 深水施工平台、鋼護筒與樁垂直度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deep-water platforms, steel casings and pile verticality: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼護筒施工平台」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel-casing work platform” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樁底偏位 e = L×傾斜率。L = 117 m 時，1/200 對應 e = 117/200 ≈ 0.59 m，1/400 對應約 0.29 m；以樁徑 2.8 m 計，前者相當於約 21% 樁徑，後者約 10%。長度為教學假設，傾斜率為公開資料。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Pile-toe offset e = L × inclination. For L = 117 m, 1/200 gives e = 117/200 ≈ 0.59 m and 1/400 about 0.29 m; with a 2.8 m pile these are about 21% and 10% of the diameter. The length is a teaching assumption; the inclinations are published values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每根鋼護筒沉放時以雙向經緯儀或傾斜儀量測垂直度，鑽孔過程以超音波孔壁量測儀檢查孔徑與傾斜；完成後把每根樁的實際偏位輸入群樁模型，複核承台內力與各樁軸力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the verticality of each casing during placement with two theodolites or an inclinometer, check bore diameter and inclination with an ultrasonic caliper during drilling, and afterwards enter each pile’s actual offset into the group model to recheck cap forces and pile loads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 樁底偏位 e = L×傾斜率。L = 117 m 時，1/200 對應 e = 117/200 ≈ 0.59 m，1/400 對應約 0.29 m；以樁徑 2.8 m 計，前者相當於約 21% 樁徑，後者約 10%。長度為教學假設，傾斜率為公開資料。
knowledge.textEn: Pile-toe offset e = L × inclination. For L = 117 m, 1/200 gives e = 117/200 ≈ 0.59 m and 1/400 about 0.29 m; with a 2.8 m pile these are about 21% and 10% of the diameter. The length is a teaching assumption; the inclinations are published values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「深水施工平台、鋼護筒與樁垂直度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Deep-water platforms, steel casings and pile verticality", which statement holds?
options: 樁底偏位 e = L×傾斜率。
沖刷坑在洪水後會自然回淤，所以不會影響基樁承載。
超長斜索只會以第一階模態振動，只要針對第一階設計阻尼器即可。
optionsEn: Pile-toe offset e = L × inclination.
Scour holes refill naturally after floods, so they never affect pile capacity.
Very long stays vibrate only in the first mode, so dampers need only target mode 1.
quiz.explanation: 樁底偏位 e = L×傾斜率。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Pile-toe offset e = L × inclination. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 深水施工平台、鋼護筒與樁垂直度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deep-water platforms, steel casings and pile verticality: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼護筒施工平台」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel-casing work platform” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每根鋼護筒沉放時以雙向經緯儀或傾斜儀量測垂直度，鑽孔過程以超音波孔壁量測儀檢查孔徑與傾斜；完成後把每根樁的實際偏位輸入群樁模型，複核承台內力與各樁軸力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the verticality of each casing during placement with two theodolites or an inclinometer, check bore diameter and inclination with an ultrasonic caliper during drilling, and afterwards enter each pile’s actual offset into the group model to recheck cap forces and pile loads. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：深水平台要有獨立的臨時工程設計、浪流與船撞檢核、颱風前的撤離與加固程序；樁位與垂直度量測結果應逐根簽認，超限樁由設計單位決定處理方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A deep-water platform needs its own temporary-works design, wave, current and ship-impact checks and pre-typhoon evacuation and securing procedures; pile position and verticality results are signed off pile by pile, with the designer deciding treatment of out-of-tolerance piles.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：臨時平台支撐失穩可能導致鑽機傾覆與人員傷亡；樁身偏斜超限時若未重新分析，承台受力與沉陷分布會偏離設計，甚至需要補樁。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Instability of temporary platform supports can topple drilling rigs and injure crews; piles beyond tolerance that are not reanalysed shift cap forces and settlement away from the design and may require additional piles. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每根鋼護筒沉放時以雙向經緯儀或傾斜儀量測垂直度，鑽孔過程以超音波孔壁量測儀檢查孔徑與傾斜；完成後把每根樁的實際偏位輸入群樁模型，複核承台內力與各樁軸力。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the verticality of each casing during placement with two theodolites or an inclinometer, check bore diameter and inclination with an ultrasonic caliper during drilling, and afterwards enter each pile’s actual offset into the group model to recheck cap forces and pile loads.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 深水平台要有獨立的臨時工程設計、浪流與船撞檢核、颱風前的撤離與加固程序；樁位與垂直度量測結果應逐根簽認，超限樁由設計單位決定處理方式。
knowledge.textEn: A deep-water platform needs its own temporary-works design, wave, current and ship-impact checks and pre-typhoon evacuation and securing procedures; pile position and verticality results are signed off pile by pile, with the designer deciding treatment of out-of-tolerance piles.

quiz.question: 要驗證「深水施工平台、鋼護筒與樁垂直度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

同一座橋的風速在任何高度都一樣，只需要用一個設計風速。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Measure the verticality of each casing during placement with two theodolites or an inclinometer, check bore diameter and inclination with an ultrasonic caliper during drilling, and afterwards enter each pile’s actual offset into the group model to recheck cap forces and pile loads.
Wind speed is the same at every height on a bridge, so one design speed is enough.
quiz.explanation: 每根鋼護筒沉放時以雙向經緯儀或傾斜儀量測垂直度，鑽孔過程以超音波孔壁量測儀檢查孔徑與傾斜；完成後把每根樁的實際偏位輸入群樁模型，複核承台內力與各樁軸力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the verticality of each casing during placement with two theodolites or an inclinometer, check bore diameter and inclination with an ultrasonic caliper during drilling, and afterwards enter each pile’s actual offset into the group model to recheck cap forces and pile loads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 深水施工平台、鋼護筒與樁垂直度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deep-water platforms, steel casings and pile verticality: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼護筒施工平台」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Steel-casing work platform” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 臨時平台支撐失穩可能導致鑽機傾覆與人員傷亡；樁身偏斜超限時若未重新分析，承台受力與沉陷分布會偏離設計，甚至需要補樁。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Instability of temporary platform supports can topple drilling rigs and injure crews; piles beyond tolerance that are not reanalysed shift cap forces and settlement away from the design and may require additional piles. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：報導指出設計垂直度容許 1/200，實際達到約 1/400。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The reports cite a design verticality tolerance of 1/200 and achieved values of about 1/400.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工平台只是臨時設施，不需要像永久結構一樣做設計檢核。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A work platform is temporary, so it needs no design checks like a permanent structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「深水施工平台、鋼護筒與樁垂直度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

多點提升時只要總荷重在設備容量內，各吊點就一定安全。
臨時平台支撐失穩可能導致鑽機傾覆與人員傷亡；樁身偏斜超限時若未重新分析，承台受力與沉陷分布會偏離設計，甚至需要補樁。

In a multi-point lift, every point is safe as long as the total load is within equipment capacity.
Instability of temporary platform supports can topple drilling rigs and injure crews.

quiz.explanationEn: Instability of temporary platform supports can topple drilling rigs and injure crews; piles beyond tolerance that are not reanalysed shift cap forces and settlement away from the design and may require additional piles. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼箱梁大節段同步提升與合龍：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Synchronised lifting of steel box segments and closure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「同步提升千斤頂」如何影響蘇通長江公路大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Synchronised lifting jacks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sutong Yangtze River Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 蘇通大橋鋼箱梁以船運到位後，由懸臂端吊機或提升設備垂直吊起再與既有梁段焊接，鋼梁架設須趕在颱風季前完成。大型節段常以四個或更多吊點同步提升，節段本身與吊架都很剛硬，任何一個吊點多升或少升幾毫米，荷重就會在吊點間大幅重分配。公開報導中重型提升分包商指出，吊點間 10 mm 的相對位移就可能轉移約 35% 的荷重。因此提升系統需要電腦同步控制、每點荷重即時顯示與自動停機。全橋合龍則在 2007 年 6 月完成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「同步提升千斤頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At Sutong the steel box segments were barged into position, lifted vertically by cantilever-tip cranes or lifting gear and welded to the previous segment, and girder erection had to finish before the typhoon season. Large segments are usually lifted at four or more points in synchrony; the segment and lifting frame are stiff, so if one point rises a few millimetres more or less, load redistributes sharply among the points. In public reports the heavy-lift subcontractor noted that a 10 mm relative movement between jacking points could shift about 35% of the load. Lifting systems therefore need computer synchronisation, live load display at each point and automatic stops. Full closure of the deck was achieved in June 2007. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Synchronised lifting jacks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：節段 450 t 以 4 點提升，理想每點 112.5 t；若 10 mm 差動轉移 35%，即約 0.35×112.5 ≈ 39.4 t（約 386 kN），等效吊點勁度約 386/10 ≈ 38.6 kN/mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 450 t segment lifted at 4 points ideally puts 112.5 t on each; if 10 mm of differential shifts 35%, that is about 0.35×112.5 ≈ 39.4 t (about 386 kN), an equivalent point stiffness of about 386/10 ≈ 38.6 kN/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多點提升時只要總荷重在設備容量內，各吊點就一定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In a multi-point lift, every point is safe as long as the total load is within equipment capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「同步提升千斤頂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Synchronised lifting jacks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼箱梁大節段同步提升與合龍
knowledge.titleEn: Synchronised lifting of steel box segments and closure
knowledge.text: 蘇通大橋鋼箱梁以船運到位後，由懸臂端吊機或提升設備垂直吊起再與既有梁段焊接，鋼梁架設須趕在颱風季前完成。大型節段常以四個或更多吊點同步提升，節段本身與吊架都很剛硬，任何一個吊點多升或少升幾毫米，荷重就會在吊點間大幅重分配。

Large segments are usually lifted at four or more points in synchrony; the segment and lifting frame are stiff, so if one point rises a few millimetres more or less, load redistributes sharply among the points.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多點提升時只要總荷重在設備容量內，各吊點就一定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「鋼箱梁大節段同步提升與合龍」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Synchronised lifting of steel box segments and closure" is correct?

optionsEn: At Sutong the steel box segments were barged into position, lifted vertically by cantilever-tip cranes or lifting gear and welded to the previous segment, and girder erection had to finish before the typhoon season.
