Fit strain gauges to representative hangers, cross-girders and stringers, record weeks of train and traffic stress histories, and derive equivalent ranges and daily cycles by rainflow counting.
A steel arch already acts as an arch during erection and supports itself without temporary support.
quiz.explanation: 在代表性吊桿、橫梁與縱梁裝設應變計，記錄數週的列車與車流應力歷時，以雨流計數求等效應力幅與每日循環數；結合歷史交通資料估算已累積的損傷，並以目視、磁粒或渦電流檢測高風險細節。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit strain gauges to representative hangers, cross-girders and stringers, record weeks of train and traffic stress histories, and derive equivalent ranges and daily cycles by rainflow counting; estimate accumulated damage with historical traffic data, and inspect high-risk details by visual, magnetic-particle or eddy-current testing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現代交通下的疲勞評估：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fatigue assessment under modern traffic: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鉚接細節疲勞評估」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Riveted-detail fatigue assessment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以設計時的交通量評估，歷史累積損傷被低估，疲勞裂紋可能在鉚釘孔邊緣萌生並在構件內擴展而未被發現；腐蝕與疲勞交互作用時，裂紋成長速度更快。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assessing with design-era traffic underestimates accumulated damage, so fatigue cracks may start at rivet-hole edges and grow undetected; where corrosion and fatigue interact, cracks grow faster still. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此現代評估會以實測應力與交通資料計算累積損傷，找出最需要檢查與補強的細節。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Modern assessment therefore computes cumulative damage from measured stresses and traffic data to find the details that most need inspection and strengthening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「百年老橋沒有倒，代表它不會有疲勞問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A century-old bridge that is still standing cannot have fatigue problems." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以設計時的交通量評估，歷史累積損傷被低估，疲勞裂紋可能在鉚釘孔邊緣萌生並在構件內擴展而未被發現；腐蝕與疲勞交互作用時，裂紋成長速度更快。
knowledge.textEn: Assessing with design-era traffic underestimates accumulated damage, so fatigue cracks may start at rivet-hole edges and grow undetected; where corrosion and fatigue interact, cracks grow faster still.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現代交通下的疲勞評估」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fatigue assessment under modern traffic" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼橋只要定期刷一層新漆，就不會發生腐蝕損傷。
若只以設計時的交通量評估，歷史累積損傷被低估，疲勞裂紋可能在鉚釘孔邊緣萌生並在構件內擴展而未被發現；腐蝕與疲勞交互作用時，裂紋成長速度更快。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
As long as a steel bridge gets a fresh coat of paint regularly, corrosion damage cannot occur.
Assessing with design-era traffic underestimates accumulated damage, so fatigue cracks may start at rivet-hole edges and grow undetected.
quiz.explanation: 若只以設計時的交通量評估，歷史累積損傷被低估，疲勞裂紋可能在鉚釘孔邊緣萌生並在構件內擴展而未被發現；腐蝕與疲勞交互作用時，裂紋成長速度更快。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assessing with design-era traffic underestimates accumulated damage, so fatigue cracks may start at rivet-hole edges and grow undetected; where corrosion and fatigue interact, cracks grow faster still. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「塗裝與腐蝕維護」與「工程遺產的修繕與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Painting and corrosion maintenance" and "Repair and handover of engineering heritage": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 塗裝與腐蝕維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Painting and corrosion maintenance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塗裝系統」如何影響雪梨港灣大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Paint system” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Harbour Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雪梨港灣大橋處於海港環境，鹽霧與潮濕讓鋼材持續面臨腐蝕，而鉚接構造的板件搭接縫、鉚釘頭與角落正是積水與鹽分的位置。公開資料指出需要塗裝的鋼材面積約 485,000 平方公尺，每一道塗層約需 30,000 公升油漆，可見塗裝是持續性的大型工程，而不是偶爾的修補。塗裝系統的壽命取決於表面處理品質、膜厚與施工條件；舊漆層可能含鉛，噴砂與清除必須在封閉圍護與廢棄物管制下進行，以保護工人與港灣環境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塗裝系統」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bridge sits in a harbour environment where salt spray and humidity keep the steel under constant corrosion attack, and the lap seams, rivet heads and corners of riveted construction are exactly where water and salt collect. Public sources put the painted steel area at about 485,000 m², needing about 30,000 litres of paint per coat, showing that painting is a continuous major operation rather than occasional touch-up. Coating life depends on surface preparation, film thickness and application conditions; old layers may contain lead, so blasting and removal must happen inside containment with waste control to protect workers and the harbour. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Paint system” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Average spreading rate = 485,000 m² / 30,000 L ≈ 16.2 m²/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋只要定期刷一層新漆，就不會發生腐蝕損傷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as a steel bridge gets a fresh coat of paint regularly, corrosion damage cannot occur." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塗裝系統」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Paint system”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 塗裝與腐蝕維護
knowledge.text: 雪梨港灣大橋處於海港環境，鹽霧與潮濕讓鋼材持續面臨腐蝕，而鉚接構造的板件搭接縫、鉚釘頭與角落正是積水與鹽分的位置。公開資料指出需要塗裝的鋼材面積約 485,000 平方公尺，每一道塗層約需 30,000 公升油漆，可見塗裝是持續性的大型工程，而不是偶爾的修補。
knowledge.textEn: The bridge sits in a harbour environment where salt spray and humidity keep the steel under constant corrosion attack, and the lap seams, rivet heads and corners of riveted construction are exactly where water and salt collect. Public sources put the painted steel area at about 485,000 m², needing about 30,000 litres of paint per coat, showing that painting is a continuous major operation rather than occasional touch-up.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼橋只要定期刷一層新漆，就不會發生腐蝕損傷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as a steel bridge gets a fresh coat of paint regularly, corrosion damage cannot occur. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「塗裝與腐蝕維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Painting and corrosion maintenance" is correct?
options: 雪梨港灣大橋處於海港環境，鹽霧與潮濕讓鋼材持續面臨腐蝕，而鉚接構造的板件搭接縫、鉚釘頭與角落正是積水與鹽分的位置。
鋼橋只要定期刷一層新漆，就不會發生腐蝕損傷。
遺產橋梁只能原樣保存，任何修繕都會破壞其價值。
optionsEn: The bridge sits in a harbour environment where salt spray and humidity keep the steel under constant corrosion attack, and the lap seams, rivet heads and corners of riveted construction are exactly where water and salt collect.
As long as a steel bridge gets a fresh coat of paint regularly, corrosion damage cannot occur.
A heritage bridge must be kept exactly as built, and any repair destroys its value.
quiz.explanation: 雪梨港灣大橋處於海港環境，鹽霧與潮濕讓鋼材持續面臨腐蝕，而鉚接構造的板件搭接縫、鉚釘頭與角落正是積水與鹽分的位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The bridge sits in a harbour environment where salt spray and humidity keep the steel under constant corrosion attack, and the lap seams, rivet heads and corners of riveted construction are exactly where water and salt collect. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 塗裝與腐蝕維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Painting and corrosion maintenance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塗裝系統」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Paint system” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平均塗布率 = 485,000 m² / 30,000 L ≈ 16.2 m²/L。若油漆體積固體分 50%，理論乾膜厚 DFT = 體積固體分×10/塗布率 = 50×10/16.2 ≈ 31 μm（未計損耗）；若目標系統總乾膜 250 μm，約需 8 道同等塗層的量。固體分與目標膜厚為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Average spreading rate = 485,000 m² / 30,000 L ≈ 16.2 m²/L. With 50% volume solids, theoretical dry-film thickness DFT = volume solids×10/spreading rate = 50×10/16.2 ≈ 31 μm, ignoring losses; a 250 μm total system would need the equivalent of about 8 such coats. Solids content and target thickness are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：塗裝前檢查表面處理等級與鹽分殘留，施工時量測濕膜與乾膜厚度、環境溫濕度與露點；完成後抽測附著力，並建立分區塗裝紀錄，追蹤各區的劣化與重塗週期。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before painting check surface preparation grade and residual salts; during application measure wet and dry film thickness, ambient temperature, humidity and dew point; afterwards spot-test adhesion and keep zone-by-zone painting records to track deterioration and recoating cycles.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 平均塗布率 = 485,000 m² / 30,000 L ≈ 16.2 m²/L。若油漆體積固體分 50%，理論乾膜厚 DFT = 體積固體分×10/塗布率 = 50×10/16.2 ≈ 31 μm（未計損耗）；若目標系統總乾膜 250 μm，約需 8 道同等塗層的量。固體分與目標膜厚為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Average spreading rate = 485,000 m² / 30,000 L ≈ 16.2 m²/L. With 50% volume solids, theoretical dry-film thickness DFT = volume solids×10/spreading rate = 50×10/16.2 ≈ 31 μm, ignoring losses; a 250 μm total system would need the equivalent of about 8 such coats. Solids content and target thickness are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塗裝與腐蝕維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Painting and corrosion maintenance", which statement holds?
options: 拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。
鉸接支承一旦安裝完成，就會永遠自由轉動，不需要維護。
optionsEn: An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered.
Average spreading rate = 485,000 m² / 30,000 L ≈ 16.2 m²/L.
Once installed, a hinged bearing will always rotate freely without maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 平均塗布率 = 485,000 m² / 30,000 L ≈ 16.2 m²/L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Average spreading rate = 485,000 m² / 30,000 L ≈ 16.2 m²/L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 塗裝與腐蝕維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Painting and corrosion maintenance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塗裝系統」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Paint system” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 塗裝前檢查表面處理等級與鹽分殘留，施工時量測濕膜與乾膜厚度、環境溫濕度與露點；完成後抽測附著力，並建立分區塗裝紀錄，追蹤各區的劣化與重塗週期。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before painting check surface preparation grade and residual salts; during application measure wet and dry film thickness, ambient temperature, humidity and dew point; afterwards spot-test adhesion and keep zone-by-zone painting records to track deterioration and recoating cycles. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：塗裝維護計畫應以分區劣化調查決定優先順序，規定表面處理、鹽分檢測與膜厚驗收標準，含鉛舊漆的移除須有圍護、監測與廢棄物管理方案；噴砂後先檢查鋼材損失與裂紋再塗裝。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The painting programme should set priorities from zone-by-zone condition surveys, define surface preparation, salt testing and film-thickness acceptance, and require containment, monitoring and waste management for removing lead paint; after blasting, check section loss and cracks before recoating.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：表面鹽分未清除就塗裝，塗膜下方很快起泡、剝落，腐蝕在漆膜下擴展；搭接縫的隙縫腐蝕產生膨脹力，可能把板件撐開、拉斷鉚釘頭，形成結構性損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Painting over residual salt quickly blisters and lifts the film, spreading corrosion underneath; crevice corrosion in lap seams generates expansion forces that can pry plates apart and pop rivet heads, causing structural damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 塗裝前檢查表面處理等級與鹽分殘留，施工時量測濕膜與乾膜厚度、環境溫濕度與露點；完成後抽測附著力，並建立分區塗裝紀錄，追蹤各區的劣化與重塗週期。
knowledge.textEn: Before painting check surface preparation grade and residual salts; during application measure wet and dry film thickness, ambient temperature, humidity and dew point; afterwards spot-test adhesion and keep zone-by-zone painting records to track deterioration and recoating cycles.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 塗裝維護計畫應以分區劣化調查決定優先順序，規定表面處理、鹽分檢測與膜厚驗收標準，含鉛舊漆的移除須有圍護、監測與廢棄物管理方案；噴砂後先檢查鋼材損失與裂紋再塗裝。
knowledge.textEn: The painting programme should set priorities from zone-by-zone condition surveys, define surface preparation, salt testing and film-thickness acceptance, and require containment, monitoring and waste management for removing lead paint; after blasting, check section loss and cracks before recoating.

quiz.question: 要驗證「塗裝與腐蝕維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Painting and corrosion maintenance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩個半拱只要對準就能直接接上，溫度影響可以忽略。
塗裝前檢查表面處理等級與鹽分殘留，施工時量測濕膜與乾膜厚度、環境溫濕度與露點；完成後抽測附著力，並建立分區塗裝紀錄，追蹤各區的劣化與重塗週期。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The two half-arches can simply be joined once aligned, and temperature can be ignored.
Before painting check surface preparation grade and residual salts.
quiz.explanation: 塗裝前檢查表面處理等級與鹽分殘留，施工時量測濕膜與乾膜厚度、環境溫濕度與露點；完成後抽測附著力，並建立分區塗裝紀錄，追蹤各區的劣化與重塗週期。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before painting check surface preparation grade and residual salts; during application measure wet and dry film thickness, ambient temperature, humidity and dew point; afterwards spot-test adhesion and keep zone-by-zone painting records to track deterioration and recoating cycles. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 塗裝與腐蝕維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Painting and corrosion maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塗裝系統」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Paint system” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 表面鹽分未清除就塗裝，塗膜下方很快起泡、剝落，腐蝕在漆膜下擴展；搭接縫的隙縫腐蝕產生膨脹力，可能把板件撐開、拉斷鉚釘頭，形成結構性損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Painting over residual salt quickly blisters and lifts the film, spreading corrosion underneath; crevice corrosion in lap seams generates expansion forces that can pry plates apart and pop rivet heads, causing structural damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：塗裝系統的壽命取決於表面處理品質、膜厚與施工條件；舊漆層可能含鉛，噴砂與清除必須在封閉圍護與廢棄物管制下進行，以保護工人與港灣環境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Coating life depends on surface preparation, film thickness and application conditions; old layers may contain lead, so blasting and removal must happen inside containment with waste control to protect workers and the harbour.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼橋只要定期刷一層新漆，就不會發生腐蝕損傷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as a steel bridge gets a fresh coat of paint regularly, corrosion damage cannot occur." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 表面鹽分未清除就塗裝，塗膜下方很快起泡、剝落，腐蝕在漆膜下擴展；搭接縫的隙縫腐蝕產生膨脹力，可能把板件撐開、拉斷鉚釘頭，形成結構性損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Painting over residual salt quickly blisters and lifts the film, spreading corrosion underneath; crevice corrosion in lap seams generates expansion forces that can pry plates apart and pop rivet heads, causing structural damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「塗裝與腐蝕維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Painting and corrosion maintenance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 表面鹽分未清除就塗裝，塗膜下方很快起泡、剝落，腐蝕在漆膜下擴展；搭接縫的隙縫腐蝕產生膨脹力，可能把板件撐開、拉斷鉚釘頭，形成結構性損傷。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
遺產橋梁只能原樣保存，任何修繕都會破壞其價值。
optionsEn: Painting over residual salt quickly blisters and lifts the film, spreading corrosion underneath.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A heritage bridge must be kept exactly as built, and any repair destroys its value.
quiz.explanation: 表面鹽分未清除就塗裝，塗膜下方很快起泡、剝落，腐蝕在漆膜下擴展；搭接縫的隙縫腐蝕產生膨脹力，可能把板件撐開、拉斷鉚釘頭，形成結構性損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Painting over residual salt quickly blisters and lifts the film, spreading corrosion underneath; crevice corrosion in lap seams generates expansion forces that can pry plates apart and pop rivet heads, causing structural damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 工程遺產的修繕與交接：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「遺產保存與螺栓替換」如何影響雪梨港灣大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Heritage conservation and bolt replacement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Harbour Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大橋在 1988 年被美國土木工程師學會列為國際歷史土木工程地標，並獲澳洲工程遺產的國家工程地標認定，2007 年建立保存管理計畫，現由新南威爾斯州交通部管理。遺產結構的修繕要在安全與真實性之間取得平衡：替換鉚釘時，現代高強度螺栓施工方便、預拉力可靠，但外觀與原有鉚接不同；以熱鉚復原則保存工藝，卻需要稀有技術。每一次修繕都會改變結構的組成，因此需要完整記錄替換了什麼、為什麼、用什麼材料，讓後來的工程師知道哪些部分已非原件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「遺產保存與螺栓替換」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In 1988 the bridge was named an International Historic Civil Engineering Landmark by the American Society of Civil Engineers and a National Engineering Landmark by Engineering Heritage Australia; a conservation management plan was established in 2007, and the bridge is managed by Transport for NSW. Repairs to heritage structures balance safety with authenticity: modern high-strength bolts are easy to install with reliable preload but look different from rivets, while hot riveting preserves the craft yet needs rare skills. Each repair changes the fabric, so complete records of what was replaced, why and with what material are needed so later engineers know which parts are no longer original. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Heritage conservation and bolt replacement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 M24、8.8 級高強度螺栓替換鉚釘時，預拉力 F_p = 0.7·f_u·A_s = 0.7×800×353 ≈ 197.7 kN；摩擦係數 0.3、單一摩擦面時，每顆抗滑力約 0.3×197.7 ≈ 59 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Replacing a rivet with an M24 grade 8.8 high-strength bolt gives a preload F_p = 0.7·f_u·A_s = 0.7×800×353 ≈ 197.7 kN; with a friction coefficient of 0.3 and one slip plane, each bolt resists about 0.3×197.7 ≈ 59 kN of slip.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「遺產橋梁只能原樣保存，任何修繕都會破壞其價值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A heritage bridge must be kept exactly as built, and any repair destroys its value." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「遺產保存與螺栓替換」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 工程遺產的修繕與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repair and handover of engineering heritage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「遺產保存與螺栓替換」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Heritage conservation and bolt replacement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 M24、8.8 級高強度螺栓替換鉚釘時，預拉力 F_p = 0.7·f_u·A_s = 0.7×800×353 ≈ 197.7 kN；摩擦係數 0.3、單一摩擦面時，每顆抗滑力約 0.3×197.7 ≈ 59 kN。螺栓等級與摩擦係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Replacing a rivet with an M24 grade 8.8 high-strength bolt gives a preload F_p = 0.7·f_u·A_s = 0.7×800×353 ≈ 197.7 kN; with a friction coefficient of 0.3 and one slip plane, each bolt resists about 0.3×197.7 ≈ 59 kN of slip. Bolt grade and friction coefficient are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：替換前確認接頭的設計力與替換後的剛度差異，避免改變力量分配；螺栓施工以扭矩或轉角法控制預拉力並抽驗；每次修繕更新構件履歷資料庫，標明位置、材料、方法與日期，並由遺產管理單位確認符合保存計畫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before replacement confirm the joint's design forces and any stiffness change so force sharing is not altered; control preload by torque or turn-of-nut and spot-check it; after each repair update the component-history database with location, material, method and date, confirmed by the heritage manager as consistent with the conservation plan.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 M24、8.8 級高強度螺栓替換鉚釘時，預拉力 F_p = 0.7·f_u·A_s = 0.7×800×353 ≈ 197.7 kN；摩擦係數 0.3、單一摩擦面時，每顆抗滑力約 0.3×197.7 ≈ 59 kN。螺栓等級與摩擦係數為教學假設。

Bolt grade and friction coefficient are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「工程遺產的修繕與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

A steel arch already acts as an arch during erection and supports itself without temporary support.

steps.title: 工程遺產的修繕與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Repair and handover of engineering heritage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「遺產保存與螺栓替換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Heritage conservation and bolt replacement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 替換前確認接頭的設計力與替換後的剛度差異，避免改變力量分配；螺栓施工以扭矩或轉角法控制預拉力並抽驗；每次修繕更新構件履歷資料庫，標明位置、材料、方法與日期，並由遺產管理單位確認符合保存計畫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before replacement confirm the joint's design forces and any stiffness change so force sharing is not altered; control preload by torque or turn-of-nut and spot-check it; after each repair update the component-history database with location, material, method and date, confirmed by the heritage manager as consistent with the conservation plan. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：修繕方案應依保存管理計畫由結構工程師與遺產專家共同核定，明訂可接受的替換材料與外觀要求；交接文件包含構件履歷、檢查紀錄、塗裝分區、量測基準與遺產登錄要求，供未來的管理者延續。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Repair schemes should be approved jointly by structural engineers and heritage specialists under the conservation management plan, stating acceptable replacement materials and appearance; handover documents include component histories, inspection records, painting zones, measurement baselines and heritage-listing requirements for future managers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在同一接頭混用鉚釘與高強度螺栓而未考慮勁度差異，力量會集中在較剛的螺栓，造成局部超載；修繕紀錄缺失時，後人無法分辨原件與替換件，評估時可能錯用材料性質。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing rivets and high-strength bolts in one joint without considering their different stiffness concentrates load on the stiffer bolts and overloads them locally; missing repair records leave later engineers unable to tell original from replaced parts, risking wrong material properties in assessment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 工程遺產的修繕與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repair and handover of engineering heritage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「遺產保存與螺栓替換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Heritage conservation and bolt replacement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在同一接頭混用鉚釘與高強度螺栓而未考慮勁度差異，力量會集中在較剛的螺栓，造成局部超載；修繕紀錄缺失時，後人無法分辨原件與替換件，評估時可能錯用材料性質。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing rivets and high-strength bolts in one joint without considering their different stiffness concentrates load on the stiffer bolts and overloads them locally; missing repair records leave later engineers unable to tell original from replaced parts, risking wrong material properties in assessment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每一次修繕都會改變結構的組成，因此需要完整記錄替換了什麼、為什麼、用什麼材料，讓後來的工程師知道哪些部分已非原件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each repair changes the fabric, so complete records of what was replaced, why and with what material are needed so later engineers know which parts are no longer original.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「遺產橋梁只能原樣保存，任何修繕都會破壞其價值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A heritage bridge must be kept exactly as built, and any repair destroys its value." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在同一接頭混用鉚釘與高強度螺栓而未考慮勁度差異，力量會集中在較剛的螺栓，造成局部超載；修繕紀錄缺失時，後人無法分辨原件與替換件，評估時可能錯用材料性質。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「工程遺產的修繕與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Repair and handover of engineering heritage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若在同一接頭混用鉚釘與高強度螺栓而未考慮勁度差異，力量會集中在較剛的螺栓，造成局部超載；修繕紀錄缺失時，後人無法分辨原件與替換件，評估時可能錯用材料性質。
雪梨港灣大橋兩端的巨大石砌橋塔承擔了拱的推力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Mixing rivets and high-strength bolts in one joint without considering their different stiffness concentrates load on the stiffer bolts and overloads them locally.
The massive stone pylons at each end of the bridge carry the arch thrust.
quiz.explanation: 若在同一接頭混用鉚釘與高強度螺栓而未考慮勁度差異，力量會集中在較剛的螺栓，造成局部超載；修繕紀錄缺失時，後人無法分辨原件與替換件，評估時可能錯用材料性質。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing rivets and high-strength bolts in one joint without considering their different stiffness concentrates load on the stiffer bolts and overloads them locally; missing repair records leave later engineers unable to tell original from replaced parts, risking wrong material properties in assessment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 新河峽大橋
courses.summary: 新河峽大橋位於美國西維吉尼亞州，主拱跨度 1,700 英尺（約 518 公尺），全長 3,030 英尺（約 924 公尺），橋面高出新河約 876 英尺（約 267 公尺），1977 年通車，以免塗裝的 COR-TEN 耐候鋼建造。本課從兩鉸桁架拱與峽谷地形出發，分析排架立柱、上承式桁架、焊接箱形弦桿與低溫韌性，再拆解跨越峽谷的纜索吊運、以油井套管作背拉索的懸臂架設與 1976 年以 16 具千斤頂完成的合龍，最後談線形量測、載重評等、耐候鋼維護與橋梁日活動的管理。
courses.summaryEn: New River Gorge Bridge in West Virginia has a 1,700 ft (about 518 m) arch, a total length of 3,030 ft (about 924 m) and a deck about 876 ft (about 267 m) above the New River; it opened in 1977, built of unpainted COR-TEN weathering steel. Starting from the two-hinged truss arch and the gorge, the course examines spandrel bents, deck trusses, welded box chords and low-temperature toughness, then the cableway across the gorge, cantilever erection held by oil-well-casing tiebacks and the 1976 closure with 16 hydraulic jacks, ending with geometry surveys, load rating, care of weathering steel and managing Bridge Day.
courses.focus: 以耐候鋼兩鉸桁架拱、峽谷纜索吊運與背拉懸臂架設，跨越 267 公尺深的峽谷
courses.focusEn: Spanning a gorge 267 m deep with a weathering-steel two-hinged truss arch erected by gorge cableway and tieback cantilevering
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 合龍千斤頂練習：假設合龍前每個半拱重 W = 4,000 t（約 39.2 MN），重心距拱腳鉸 110 m，背拉索對鉸的力臂 60 m，所需背拉力 T = W·x/h = 39.2×110/60 ≈ 71.9 MN。每側 8 具 1,250 短噸千斤頂，能力約 8×1,250×0.907×9.81 ≈ 89 MN，利用率約 81%。下放時放出背拉索 Δc = 0.15 m，半拱轉角 θ = 0.15/60 = 2.5 mrad；拱頂端點距鉸高約 112.8 m、水平約 259 m，端點向中央移動約 2.5×10⁻³×112.8 ≈ 0.28 m，下降約 2.5×10⁻³×259 ≈ 0.65 m。半拱弧長約 292 m，溫度變化 10 °C 使長度變化約 292×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 35 mm，所以最後幾公分的對位必須在溫度穩定時完成。數值為教學假設，不代表新河峽大橋的實際設計或施工數據。
workedExample.textEn: Closure-jack exercise: assume each half-arch weighs W = 4,000 t (about 39.2 MN) before closure, with its centroid 110 m from the arch-foot hinge and a 60 m tieback lever arm about the hinge, so the required tieback force is T = W·x/h = 39.2×110/60 ≈ 71.9 MN. Eight 1,250 short-ton jacks per side give about 8×1,250×0.907×9.81 ≈ 89 MN, a utilisation of about 81%. Paying out Δc = 0.15 m of tieback rotates the half-arch by θ = 0.15/60 = 2.5 mrad; with the tip about 112.8 m above and about 259 m horizontally from the hinge, it moves about 2.5×10⁻³×112.8 ≈ 0.28 m toward mid-span and drops about 2.5×10⁻³×259 ≈ 0.65 m. A half-arch about 292 m long changes length by about 292×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 35 mm for 10 °C, so the last few centimetres of alignment must be made when temperature is stable. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual design or erection data of the bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱」與「排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch" and "Bents, deck trusses and bearings": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「兩鉸桁架拱推力」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 新河峽谷兩側是陡峭的岩壁，深約 267 公尺，谷底無法設置中間橋墩，堅硬的岩壁卻正好能承受拱的推力，因此選擇上承式鋼拱。主拱是兩鉸桁架拱，只在兩端支點設鉸、拱頂不設鉸，拱矢 370 英尺，矢跨比約 1:4.6；拱肋桁架深度由拱頂約 34 英尺增加到支點處約 53 英尺。國家史蹟登錄文件指出，上下弦桿在錨碇處透過位於兩弦之間的銷共同承受壓力。橋面荷載經排架立柱傳到拱上，再以軸壓與推力送入兩岸的混凝土推力座。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「兩鉸桁架拱推力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The New River Gorge has steep rock walls about 267 m deep, so no intermediate piers could stand in the valley, yet the hard rock walls are ideal for resisting arch thrust, which led to a deck arch in steel. The main arch is a two-hinged truss arch, hinged only at its supports and not at the crown, with a rise of 370 ft and a rise-to-span ratio of about 1:4.6; rib depth grows from about 34 ft at the crown to about 53 ft at the supports. The National Register nomination notes that top and bottom chords share compression at the anchorage through a pin placed midway between them. Deck loads pass down spandrel bents to the arch and then, as axial force and thrust, into concrete thrust blocks on each side. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Parabolic arch thrust H = w·L²/(8f).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「峽谷越深，拱就必須越高，所以矢跨比對推力沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A deeper gorge simply needs a taller arch, so the rise-to-span ratio does not affect thrust." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「兩鉸桁架拱推力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 新河峽谷兩側是陡峭的岩壁，深約 267 公尺，谷底無法設置中間橋墩，堅硬的岩壁卻正好能承受拱的推力，因此選擇上承式鋼拱。主拱是兩鉸桁架拱，只在兩端支點設鉸、拱頂不設鉸，拱矢 370 英尺，矢跨比約 1:4.6；拱肋桁架深度由拱頂約 34 英尺增加到支點處約 53 英尺。
knowledge.textEn: The New River Gorge has steep rock walls about 267 m deep, so no intermediate piers could stand in the valley, yet the hard rock walls are ideal for resisting arch thrust, which led to a deck arch in steel. The main arch is a two-hinged truss arch, hinged only at its supports and not at the crown, with a rise of 370 ft and a rise-to-span ratio of about 1:4.6; rib depth grows from about 34 ft at the crown to about 53 ft at the supports.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：峽谷越深，拱就必須越高，所以矢跨比對推力沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A deeper gorge simply needs a taller arch, so the rise-to-span ratio does not affect thrust. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch" is correct?
options: 峽谷越深，拱就必須越高，所以矢跨比對推力沒有影響。
新河峽谷兩側是陡峭的岩壁，深約 267 公尺，谷底無法設置中間橋墩，堅硬的岩壁卻正好能承受拱的推力，因此選擇上承式鋼拱。
立柱只承受垂直壓力，斜撐只是為了外觀或施工方便。
optionsEn: A deeper gorge simply needs a taller arch, so the rise-to-span ratio does not affect thrust.

The New River Gorge has steep rock walls about 267 m deep, so no intermediate piers could stand in the valley, yet the hard rock walls are ideal for resisting arch thrust, which led to a deck arch in steel.
Columns only take vertical compression, and the bracing is just for appearance or construction convenience.
quiz.explanation: 新河峽谷兩側是陡峭的岩壁，深約 267 公尺，谷底無法設置中間橋墩，堅硬的岩壁卻正好能承受拱的推力，因此選擇上承式鋼拱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The New River Gorge has steep rock walls about 267 m deep, so no intermediate piers could stand in the valley, yet the hard rock walls are ideal for resisting arch thrust, which led to a deck arch in steel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「兩鉸桁架拱推力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。L = 1,700 ft ≈ 518.2 m、f = 370 ft ≈ 112.8 m，取總荷載 w = 250 kN/m：H = 250×518.2²/(8×112.8) ≈ 74,400 kN。若拱矢降為 L/6 ≈ 86.4 m，推力升到約 97,100 kN，增加約 31%。w 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Parabolic arch thrust H = w·L²/(8f). With L = 1,700 ft ≈ 518.2 m, f = 370 ft ≈ 112.8 m and a total load w = 250 kN/m, H = 250×518.2²/(8×112.8) ≈ 74,400 kN. Reducing the rise to L/6 ≈ 86.4 m raises the thrust to about 97,100 kN, about 31% more. w is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時以桁架模型分析全跨、半跨與集中荷載下的弦桿與腹桿力，並檢查推力座在岩盤上的承載與抗滑；營運期以測量監測推力座與拱腳的位移，因為兩鉸拱的內力對支點水平位移很敏感。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage analyse chord and web forces under full-span, half-span and concentrated loads with a truss model and check the thrust blocks for rock bearing and sliding; in service monitor thrust-block and arch-foot movements by survey, since a two-hinged arch's forces are sensitive to horizontal support movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Parabolic arch thrust H = w·L²/(8f). With L = 1,700 ft ≈ 518.2 m, f = 370 ft ≈ 112.8 m and a total load w = 250 kN/m, H = 250×518.2²/(8×112.8) ≈ 74,400 kN. Reducing the rise to L/6 ≈ 86.4 m raises the thrust to about 97,100 kN, about 31% more. w is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch", which statement holds?
options: 箱形斷面是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕，也不需要檢查。
合龍只是把最後一根構件吊上去接起來，千斤頂只是輔助。
拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。
optionsEn: A box section is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection.
Closure is just lifting the last member into place, with jacks as a minor aid.
Parabolic arch thrust H = w·L²/(8f).
quiz.explanation: 拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Parabolic arch thrust H = w·L²/(8f). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「兩鉸桁架拱推力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時以桁架模型分析全跨、半跨與集中荷載下的弦桿與腹桿力，並檢查推力座在岩盤上的承載與抗滑；營運期以測量監測推力座與拱腳的位移，因為兩鉸拱的內力對支點水平位移很敏感。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage analyse chord and web forces under full-span, half-span and concentrated loads with a truss model and check the thrust blocks for rock bearing and sliding; in service monitor thrust-block and arch-foot movements by survey, since a two-hinged arch's forces are sensitive to horizontal support movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：拱橋選址時應先完成岩盤調查與推力座的穩定分析，並把推力座背後的排水列為長期維護項目；監測計畫須包含拱腳的三維位移量測與異常門檻。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Siting an arch requires rock investigation and thrust-block stability analysis first, with drainage behind the blocks treated as a long-term maintenance item; the monitoring plan must include 3D movement of the arch feet with alert thresholds.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：推力座若因岩體節理或風化而滑動，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，弦桿彎曲應力大增；排水不良使推力座背後積水，水壓與凍脹可能推動岩塊，形成長期的漸進位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a thrust block slides on jointed or weathered rock, the span lengthens, the crown drops and chord bending rises sharply; poor drainage behind a block lets water pressure and frost heave push rock blocks, causing slow progressive movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計時以桁架模型分析全跨、半跨與集中荷載下的弦桿與腹桿力，並檢查推力座在岩盤上的承載與抗滑；營運期以測量監測推力座與拱腳的位移，因為兩鉸拱的內力對支點水平位移很敏感。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage analyse chord and web forces under full-span, half-span and concentrated loads with a truss model and check the thrust blocks for rock bearing and sliding; in service monitor thrust-block and arch-foot movements by survey, since a two-hinged arch's forces are sensitive to horizontal support movement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 拱橋選址時應先完成岩盤調查與推力座的穩定分析，並把推力座背後的排水列為長期維護項目；監測計畫須包含拱腳的三維位移量測與異常門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Siting an arch requires rock investigation and thrust-block stability analysis first, with drainage behind the blocks treated as a long-term maintenance item; the monitoring plan must include 3D movement of the arch feet with alert thresholds.

quiz.question: 要驗證「峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch"?
options: 設計時以桁架模型分析全跨、半跨與集中荷載下的弦桿與腹桿力，並檢查推力座在岩盤上的承載與抗滑。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要定期做目視檢查，就足以確定大型鋼拱橋的承載能力。
optionsEn: At design stage analyse chord and web forces under full-span, half-span and concentrated loads with a truss model and check the thrust blocks for rock bearing and sliding.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Periodic visual inspection alone is enough to establish the capacity of a large steel arch.
quiz.explanation: 設計時以桁架模型分析全跨、半跨與集中荷載下的弦桿與腹桿力，並檢查推力座在岩盤上的承載與抗滑；營運期以測量監測推力座與拱腳的位移，因為兩鉸拱的內力對支點水平位移很敏感。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At design stage analyse chord and web forces under full-span, half-span and concentrated loads with a truss model and check the thrust blocks for rock bearing and sliding; in service monitor thrust-block and arch-foot movements by survey, since a two-hinged arch's forces are sensitive to horizontal support movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「兩鉸桁架拱推力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 推力座若因岩體節理或風化而滑動，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，弦桿彎曲應力大增；排水不良使推力座背後積水，水壓與凍脹可能推動岩塊，形成長期的漸進位移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a thrust block slides on jointed or weathered rock, the span lengthens, the crown drops and chord bending rises sharply; poor drainage behind a block lets water pressure and frost heave push rock blocks, causing slow progressive movement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：橋面荷載經排架立柱傳到拱上，再以軸壓與推力送入兩岸的混凝土推力座。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Deck loads pass down spandrel bents to the arch and then, as axial force and thrust, into concrete thrust blocks on each side.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「峽谷越深，拱就必須越高，所以矢跨比對推力沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A deeper gorge simply needs a taller arch, so the rise-to-span ratio does not affect thrust." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 推力座若因岩體節理或風化而滑動，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，弦桿彎曲應力大增；排水不良使推力座背後積水，水壓與凍脹可能推動岩塊，形成長期的漸進位移。
knowledge.textEn: If a thrust block slides on jointed or weathered rock, the span lengthens, the crown drops and chord bending rises sharply; poor drainage behind a block lets water pressure and frost heave push rock blocks, causing slow progressive movement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「峽谷地形與兩鉸桁架拱」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The gorge and the two-hinged truss arch" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
推力座若因岩體節理或風化而滑動，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，弦桿彎曲應力大增；排水不良使推力座背後積水，水壓與凍脹可能推動岩塊，形成長期的漸進位移。
立柱只承受垂直壓力，斜撐只是為了外觀或施工方便。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If a thrust block slides on jointed or weathered rock, the span lengthens, the crown drops and chord bending rises sharply.
Columns only take vertical compression, and the bracing is just for appearance or construction convenience.
quiz.explanation: 推力座若因岩體節理或風化而滑動，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，弦桿彎曲應力大增；排水不良使推力座背後積水，水壓與凍脹可能推動岩塊，形成長期的漸進位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If a thrust block slides on jointed or weathered rock, the span lengthens, the crown drops and chord bending rises sharply; poor drainage behind a block lets water pressure and frost heave push rock blocks, causing slow progressive movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bents, deck trusses and bearings: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「排架立柱」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spandrel bents” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋面由 23 跨的 Warren 式上承桁架組成，桁架深 18 英尺；拱上 14 跨每跨約 129 英尺 9 英寸，南側引橋 5 跨、北側引橋 4 跨。桁架支承在排架上，拱上的排架立柱高度由約 25 英尺到 304 英尺不等，間距 72 英尺，立柱為中空斷面並以斜撐連接。登錄文件記載支承配置：靠近拱頂的幾座排架用搖軸支承，其餘排架用固定支承，拱兩端的排架則使用齒輪式伸縮支承。這種配置讓橋面與拱之間的相對溫度變形有處可釋放，又讓水平力有明確的傳遞路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「排架立柱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The deck consists of 23 spans of Warren deck trusses 18 ft deep: 14 spans of about 129 ft 9 in over the arch, five on the south approach and four on the north. The trusses sit on bents; spandrel bent columns over the arch range from about 25 ft to 304 ft tall at 72 ft spacing, with hollow sections linked by diagonal bracing. The nomination records the bearing layout: rocker shoes on the bents nearest the crown, fixed shoes elsewhere and gear-type expansion bearings on the bents at the arch ends. This arrangement releases relative thermal movement between deck and arch while giving horizontal forces a clear path. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spandrel bents” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：高 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m 的立柱若視為兩端鉸接、無中間支撐，歐拉挫屈荷載 P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Treating a 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m column as pin-ended without intermediate bracing, the Euler load is P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「立柱只承受垂直壓力，斜撐只是為了外觀或施工方便。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Columns only take vertical compression, and the bracing is just for appearance or construction convenience." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「排架立柱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Spandrel bents”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承
knowledge.text: 橋面由 23 跨的 Warren 式上承桁架組成，桁架深 18 英尺；拱上 14 跨每跨約 129 英尺 9 英寸，南側引橋 5 跨、北側引橋 4 跨。桁架支承在排架上，拱上的排架立柱高度由約 25 英尺到 304 英尺不等，間距 72 英尺，立柱為中空斷面並以斜撐連接。
knowledge.textEn: The deck consists of 23 spans of Warren deck trusses 18 ft deep: 14 spans of about 129 ft 9 in over the arch, five on the south approach and four on the north. The trusses sit on bents; spandrel bent columns over the arch range from about 25 ft to 304 ft tall at 72 ft spacing, with hollow sections linked by diagonal bracing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：立柱只承受垂直壓力，斜撐只是為了外觀或施工方便。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Columns only take vertical compression, and the bracing is just for appearance or construction convenience. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bents, deck trusses and bearings" is correct?
options: 立柱只承受垂直壓力，斜撐只是為了外觀或施工方便。
耐候鋼會自己形成保護鏽層，所以任何環境、任何細節都不需要考慮腐蝕與韌性。
橋面由 23 跨的 Warren 式上承桁架組成，桁架深 18 英尺；拱上 14 跨每跨約 129 英尺 9 英寸，南側引橋 5 跨、北側引橋 4 跨。
optionsEn: Columns only take vertical compression, and the bracing is just for appearance or construction convenience.
Weathering steel forms its own protective rust, so corrosion and toughness need no attention in any environment or detail.
The deck consists of 23 spans of Warren deck trusses 18 ft deep: 14 spans of about 129 ft 9 in over the arch, five on the south approach and four on the north.
quiz.explanation: 橋面由 23 跨的 Warren 式上承桁架組成，桁架深 18 英尺；拱上 14 跨每跨約 129 英尺 9 英寸，南側引橋 5 跨、北側引橋 4 跨。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The deck consists of 23 spans of Warren deck trusses 18 ft deep: 14 spans of about 129 ft 9 in over the arch, five on the south approach and four on the north. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bents, deck trusses and bearings: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排架立柱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spandrel bents” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：高 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m 的立柱若視為兩端鉸接、無中間支撐，歐拉挫屈荷載 P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)²。取 E = 200 GPa、I = 0.05 m⁴、K = 1.0：P_cr = π²×200×10⁶×0.05/92.7² ≈ 11,500 kN；若斜撐使有效長度減半，P_cr 提高 4 倍到約 46,000 kN。I 與 K 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Treating a 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m column as pin-ended without intermediate bracing, the Euler load is P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)². With E = 200 GPa, I = 0.05 m⁴ and K = 1.0, P_cr = π²×200×10⁶×0.05/92.7² ≈ 11,500 kN; bracing that halves the effective length raises P_cr fourfold to about 46,000 kN. I and K are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以整體模型檢查高立柱在軸力、風力與溫度變形下的二階效應，並確認斜撐節點的勁度足以提供假設的側向支撐；現場檢查搖軸支承的傾角與齒輪式支承的齒合位置，與溫度對照判斷是否正常。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check second-order effects in the tall columns under axial load, wind and thermal deformation with a global model, confirming bracing joints are stiff enough to provide the assumed lateral restraint; in the field inspect rocker tilt and gear-bearing tooth engagement against temperature to judge whether they behave normally.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 高 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m 的立柱若視為兩端鉸接、無中間支撐，歐拉挫屈荷載 P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)²。取 E = 200 GPa、I = 0.05 m⁴、K = 1.0：P_cr = π²×200×10⁶×0.05/92.7² ≈ 11,500 kN；若斜撐使有效長度減半，P_cr 提高 4 倍到約 46,000 kN。I 與 K 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Treating a 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m column as pin-ended without intermediate bracing, the Euler load is P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)². With E = 200 GPa, I = 0.05 m⁴ and K = 1.0, P_cr = π²×200×10⁶×0.05/92.7² ≈ 11,500 kN; bracing that halves the effective length raises P_cr fourfold to about 46,000 kN. I and K are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bents, deck trusses and bearings", which statement holds?
options: 高 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m 的立柱若視為兩端鉸接、無中間支撐，歐拉挫屈荷載 P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)²。
臨時纜索吊運系統只是施工機具，不需要像永久結構一樣設計與驗證。
鋼構件很剛硬，溫度對拱的高程影響只有幾公釐，可以忽略。
optionsEn: Treating a 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m column as pin-ended without intermediate bracing, the Euler load is P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)².
A temporary cableway is just construction equipment and needs no design or verification like a permanent structure.
Steel is stiff, so temperature changes the arch level by only a few millimetres and can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 高 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m 的立柱若視為兩端鉸接、無中間支撐，歐拉挫屈荷載 P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating a 304 ft ≈ 92.7 m column as pin-ended without intermediate bracing, the Euler load is P_cr = π²·E·I/(K·L)². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bents, deck trusses and bearings: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排架立柱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spandrel bents” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以整體模型檢查高立柱在軸力、風力與溫度變形下的二階效應，並確認斜撐節點的勁度足以提供假設的側向支撐；現場檢查搖軸支承的傾角與齒輪式支承的齒合位置，與溫度對照判斷是否正常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check second-order effects in the tall columns under axial load, wind and thermal deformation with a global model, confirming bracing joints are stiff enough to provide the assumed lateral restraint; in the field inspect rocker tilt and gear-bearing tooth engagement against temperature to judge whether they behave normally. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢查手冊應把高立柱的斜撐節點與各類支承列為重點項目，記錄每次檢查時的溫度與支承位置；任何斜撐構件的更換須先提供臨時支撐並經結構工程師核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection manual should prioritise bracing joints of tall columns and every bearing type, recording temperature and bearing positions at each inspection; replacing any bracing member requires temporary support and structural-engineer approval first.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：斜撐連接若因腐蝕或鬆動失效，立柱有效長度增加，挫屈強度大幅下降；搖軸支承卡死或傾角超出設計範圍時，溫度力被迫由立柱承受，可能造成立柱彎曲或支承損壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If bracing connections fail by corrosion or loosening, column effective length grows and buckling strength drops sharply; seized rockers or tilts beyond the design range force thermal loads into the columns, bending them or damaging bearings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 排架立柱、上承式桁架與支承：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bents, deck trusses and bearings: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排架立柱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spandrel bents” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 斜撐連接若因腐蝕或鬆動失效，立柱有效長度增加，挫屈強度大幅下降；搖軸支承卡死或傾角超出設計範圍時，溫度力被迫由立柱承受，可能造成立柱彎曲或支承損壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If bracing connections fail by corrosion or loosening, column effective length grows and buckling strength drops sharply; seized rockers or tilts beyond the design range force thermal loads into the columns, bending them or damaging bearings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種配置讓橋面與拱之間的相對溫度變形有處可釋放，又讓水平力有明確的傳遞路徑。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Columns only take vertical compression, and the bracing is just for appearance or construction convenience." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Weathering steel forms its own protective rust, so corrosion and toughness need no attention in any environment or detail.
If bracing connections fail by corrosion or loosening, column effective length grows and buckling strength drops sharply.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「耐候鋼與低溫韌性」與「焊接箱形弦桿與桁架節點」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Weathering steel and low-temperature toughness" and "Welded box chords and truss joints": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 耐候鋼與低溫韌性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Weathering steel and low-temperature toughness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「COR-TEN B 耐候鋼」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “COR-TEN B weathering steel” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 新河峽大橋以 COR-TEN B 耐候鋼建造，鋼中的銅、鉻、鎳等合金元素讓表面在乾濕交替下形成緻密的鏽層，減緩後續腐蝕，因此不需塗裝，國家公園管理局也說明大橋的鏽色外觀不需重新油漆。設計者必須確保焊道的風化速率與母材相近，以免焊縫處顏色或腐蝕行為不同。另一個關鍵是低溫韌性：西維吉尼亞冬季寒冷，鋼材在低溫下若韌性不足，小裂紋可能在未達降伏強度時就突然脆斷，因此主要受拉構件需要規定衝擊韌性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「COR-TEN B 耐候鋼」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bridge is built of COR-TEN B weathering steel, whose copper, chromium and nickel let a dense rust layer form under wetting and drying and slow further corrosion, so no paint is needed; the National Park Service notes that the rust-coloured finish never needs repainting. Designers had to make welds weather at the same rate as the base steel so joints would not differ in colour or corrosion behaviour. Low-temperature toughness is the other key: West Virginia winters are cold, and steel with poor toughness can fracture suddenly from small cracks below yield stress, so main tension members need specified impact toughness. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “COR-TEN B weathering steel” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：臨界裂紋深度 a_c = (1/π)·[K_c/(Y·σ)]²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Critical crack depth a_c = (1/π)·[K_c/(Y·σ)]².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「耐候鋼會自己形成保護鏽層，所以任何環境、任何細節都不需要考慮腐蝕與韌性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Weathering steel forms its own protective rust, so corrosion and toughness need no attention in any environment or detail." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「COR-TEN B 耐候鋼」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “COR-TEN B weathering steel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 新河峽大橋以 COR-TEN B 耐候鋼建造，鋼中的銅、鉻、鎳等合金元素讓表面在乾濕交替下形成緻密的鏽層，減緩後續腐蝕，因此不需塗裝，國家公園管理局也說明大橋的鏽色外觀不需重新油漆。設計者必須確保焊道的風化速率與母材相近，以免焊縫處顏色或腐蝕行為不同。

Designers had to make welds weather at the same rate as the base steel so joints would not differ in colour or corrosion behaviour.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：耐候鋼會自己形成保護鏽層，所以任何環境、任何細節都不需要考慮腐蝕與韌性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Weathering steel forms its own protective rust, so corrosion and toughness need no attention in any environment or detail. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「耐候鋼與低溫韌性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

耐候鋼會自己形成保護鏽層，所以任何環境、任何細節都不需要考慮腐蝕與韌性。

optionsEn: The bridge is built of COR-TEN B weathering steel, whose copper, chromium and nickel let a dense rust layer form under wetting and drying and slow further corrosion, so no paint is needed.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 耐候鋼與低溫韌性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weathering steel and low-temperature toughness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「COR-TEN B 耐候鋼」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “COR-TEN B weathering steel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臨界裂紋深度 a_c = (1/π)·[K_c/(Y·σ)]²。取 Y = 1.12、σ = 150 MPa：常溫 K_c = 100 MPa·√m 時 a_c = (1/π)×(100/168)² ≈ 0.113 m = 113 mm；低溫 K_c 降到 50 MPa·√m 時 a_c ≈ 28 mm，只剩四分之一。K_c 與應力為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Critical crack depth a_c = (1/π)·[K_c/(Y·σ)]². With Y = 1.12 and σ = 150 MPa, K_c = 100 MPa·√m at mild temperature gives a_c = (1/π)×(100/168)² ≈ 0.113 m = 113 mm; if K_c falls to 50 MPa·√m in the cold, a_c ≈ 28 mm, only a quarter. K_c and stress are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋼材採購規定 Charpy 衝擊試驗溫度與最低能量，依構件是否為斷裂關鍵構件分級；焊接程序評定包含焊道與熱影響區的韌性，並以試片驗證焊材的耐候性能與母材相符。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Purchase specifications set Charpy test temperature and minimum energy, graded by whether members are fracture-critical; welding procedure qualification includes weld and heat-affected-zone toughness, and coupons verify that filler metal weathers like the base steel.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 臨界裂紋深度 a_c = (1/π)·[K_c/(Y·σ)]²。取 Y = 1.12、σ = 150 MPa：常溫 K_c = 100 MPa·√m 時 a_c = (1/π)×(100/168)² ≈ 0.113 m = 113 mm；低溫 K_c 降到 50 MPa·√m 時 a_c ≈ 28 mm，只剩四分之一。K_c 與應力為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Critical crack depth a_c = (1/π)·[K_c/(Y·σ)]². With Y = 1.12 and σ = 150 MPa, K_c = 100 MPa·√m at mild temperature gives a_c = (1/π)×(100/168)² ≈ 0.113 m = 113 mm; if K_c falls to 50 MPa·√m in the cold, a_c ≈ 28 mm, only a quarter. K_c and stress are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「耐候鋼與低溫韌性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weathering steel and low-temperature toughness", which statement holds?
options: 合龍只是把最後一根構件吊上去接起來，千斤頂只是輔助。
臨界裂紋深度 a_c = (1/π)·[K_c/(Y·σ)]²。
只要定期做目視檢查，就足以確定大型鋼拱橋的承載能力。
optionsEn: Closure is just lifting the last member into place, with jacks as a minor aid.
Critical crack depth a_c = (1/π)·[K_c/(Y·σ)]².

steps.instruction: 鋼材採購規定 Charpy 衝擊試驗溫度與最低能量，依構件是否為斷裂關鍵構件分級；焊接程序評定包含焊道與熱影響區的韌性，並以試片驗證焊材的耐候性能與母材相符。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 耐候鋼與低溫韌性：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「COR-TEN B 耐候鋼」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 若受拉構件使用低溫韌性不足的鋼材或焊材，冬季重車通過時，焊趾的小缺陷可能在無明顯預兆下脆斷；焊材耐候性不符時，焊道優先腐蝕形成凹槽，成為疲勞與斷裂的起點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Steel or filler with poor low-temperature toughness in tension members can fracture without warning from small weld-toe flaws under winter truck loads; mismatched filler metal corrodes preferentially into grooves that start fatigue cracks and fractures. steps.observation: 連結機制：另一個關鍵是低溫韌性：西維吉尼亞冬季寒冷，鋼材在低溫下若韌性不足，小裂紋可能在未達降伏強度時就突然脆斷，因此主要受拉構件需要規定衝擊韌性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Low-temperature toughness is the other key: West Virginia winters are cold, and steel with poor toughness can fracture suddenly from small cracks below yield stress, so main tension members need specified impact toughness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「耐候鋼會自己形成保護鏽層，所以任何環境、任何細節都不需要考慮腐蝕與韌性。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Weathering steel forms its own protective rust, so corrosion and toughness need no attention in any environment or detail." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 焊接箱形弦桿與桁架節點：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Welded box chords and truss joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「焊接箱形弦桿」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Welded box chords” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 拱肋的上下弦桿是單室焊接箱形斷面：兩片 58 英寸高、2 至 4 英寸厚的腹板，配上兩片 39 英寸寬、約 13/16 至 1½ 英寸厚的蓋板。箱形斷面在兩個方向都有良好的抗挫屈能力，適合承受拱的巨大軸壓；上下弦之間以 Howe 式桁架腹桿連接，兩片拱肋之間以 K 形斜撐連成整體以抵抗橫向風力。焊接箱形構件的關鍵在於厚板焊接品質、殘餘應力與節點處的應力集中，這些都會影響挫屈強度與疲勞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「焊接箱形弦桿」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The arch chords are single-cell welded boxes: two webs 58 in deep and 2 to 4 in thick with two cover plates 39 in wide and about 13/16 to 1½ in thick. A box section resists buckling well in both directions and suits the arch's large axial compression; Howe-truss web members join the chords, and K-bracing ties the two ribs together against lateral wind. For welded box members the critical issues are thick-plate weld quality, residual stresses and stress concentrations at joints, all of which affect buckling strength and fatigue. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Welded box chords” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking two webs of 58 in ≈ 1,473 mm × 3 in ≈ 76 mm and two cover plates of 39 in ≈ 991 mm × 1¼ in ≈ 31.75 mm, A ≈ 2×1,473×76 + 2×991×31.75 ≈ 286,800 mm² ≈ 0.287 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「箱形斷面是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕，也不需要檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A box section is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Welded box chords”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 焊接箱形弦桿與桁架節點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Welded box chords and truss joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焊接箱形弦桿」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Welded box chords” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取腹板 58 in ≈ 1,473 mm × 3 in ≈ 76 mm 兩片、蓋板 39 in ≈ 991 mm × 1¼ in ≈ 31.75 mm 兩片：A ≈ 2×1,473×76 + 2×991×31.75 ≈ 286,800 mm² ≈ 0.287 m²。以降伏強度 345 MPa 計，全斷面降伏軸力約 0.287×345 ≈ 99 MN；未計挫屈折減。板厚選擇為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking two webs of 58 in ≈ 1,473 mm × 3 in ≈ 76 mm and two cover plates of 39 in ≈ 991 mm × 1¼ in ≈ 31.75 mm, A ≈ 2×1,473×76 + 2×991×31.75 ≈ 286,800 mm² ≈ 0.287 m². At a yield strength of 345 MPa the squash load is about 0.287×345 ≈ 99 MN, before any buckling reduction. Plate choices are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：厚板全滲透焊道以超音波檢測，角焊縫以磁粒檢測抽驗；製造後量測箱形構件的直線度、扭曲與斷面尺寸，與挫屈設計假設的初始缺陷比較；節點組裝後檢查螺栓或焊接的配合與間隙。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test thick-plate full-penetration welds ultrasonically and sample fillet welds by magnetic particle; after fabrication measure straightness, twist and section dimensions of box members against the initial imperfections assumed in buckling design; after joint assembly check fit-up and gaps of bolts or welds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Taking two webs of 58 in ≈ 1,473 mm × 3 in ≈ 76 mm and two cover plates of 39 in ≈ 991 mm × 1¼ in ≈ 31.75 mm, A ≈ 2×1,473×76 + 2×991×31.75 ≈ 286,800 mm² ≈ 0.287 m².
quiz.explanationEn: Taking two webs of 58 in ≈ 1,473 mm × 3 in ≈ 76 mm and two cover plates of 39 in ≈ 991 mm × 1¼ in ≈ 31.75 mm, A ≈ 2×1,473×76 + 2×991×31.75 ≈ 286,800 mm² ≈ 0.287 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 焊接箱形弦桿與桁架節點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Welded box chords and truss joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「焊接箱形弦桿」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Welded box chords” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 厚板全滲透焊道以超音波檢測，角焊縫以磁粒檢測抽驗；製造後量測箱形構件的直線度、扭曲與斷面尺寸，與挫屈設計假設的初始缺陷比較；節點組裝後檢查螺栓或焊接的配合與間隙。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test thick-plate full-penetration welds ultrasonically and sample fillet welds by magnetic particle; after fabrication measure straightness, twist and section dimensions of box members against the initial imperfections assumed in buckling design; after joint assembly check fit-up and gaps of bolts or welds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：箱形構件應設計排水孔與檢查開口，並在檢查計畫中安排定期內部檢查；厚板焊接需有預熱、層間溫度與焊後檢測的書面程序，由焊接檢驗員逐項簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Box members need drain holes and access openings, with periodic interior inspection in the plan; thick-plate welding requires written procedures for preheat, interpass temperature and post-weld testing, signed off item by item by the welding inspector.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：厚板焊接若預熱不足，可能產生層狀撕裂或氫致裂紋；箱形構件內部若積水且無排水孔，耐候鋼在長期潮濕下無法形成保護鏽層，內部腐蝕持續而不易察覺。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient preheat on thick plates can cause lamellar tearing or hydrogen cracking; water trapped inside a box member without drain holes keeps weathering steel permanently wet so no protective patina forms, and hidden internal corrosion continues. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 焊接箱形弦桿與桁架節點：失效診斷
