quiz.explanationEn: Jacks and gauges must be calibrated and used as matched sets; record pressure and elongation in increments, correct for initial slack and anchor set, and compare with the calculated elongation, stopping and notifying the designer if the deviation exceeds the specified tolerance, commonly ±5% to ±7%; friction tests on the first tendons can back-calculate μ and k. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 摩擦損失與伸長量驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Friction losses and elongation checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「張拉伸長量紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stressing elongation records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 孔道在澆置時被壓扁或漏漿堵塞，鋼腱伸長量偏小卻被當作量測誤差放行，結果有效預力不足，懸臂端下撓超出預測，頂板在營運期開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A duct crushed or blocked by grout leakage during casting gives short elongation that is waved through as a measuring error; the effective prestress is then deficient, the tip deflects more than predicted, and the top slab cracks in service. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩者都必須在灌漿前查明，因為灌漿後就無法再處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Either must be resolved before grouting, because afterwards nothing can be done.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千斤頂壓力達到設計值，就代表鋼腱整段都有設計預力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the jack reaches the design pressure, the whole tendon carries the design prestress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 孔道在澆置時被壓扁或漏漿堵塞，鋼腱伸長量偏小卻被當作量測誤差放行，結果有效預力不足，懸臂端下撓超出預測，頂板在營運期開裂。
knowledge.textEn: A duct crushed or blocked by grout leakage during casting gives short elongation that is waved through as a measuring error; the effective prestress is then deficient, the tip deflects more than predicted, and the top slab cracks in service.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「摩擦損失與伸長量驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Friction losses and elongation checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
混凝土潛變幾年內就結束，之後撓度不再增加。
孔道在澆置時被壓扁或漏漿堵塞，鋼腱伸長量偏小卻被當作量測誤差放行，結果有效預力不足，懸臂端下撓超出預測，頂板在營運期開裂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Concrete creep ends within a few years, after which deflection stops increasing.
A duct crushed or blocked by grout leakage during casting gives short elongation that is waved through as a measuring error.
quiz.explanation: 孔道在澆置時被壓扁或漏漿堵塞，鋼腱伸長量偏小卻被當作量測誤差放行，結果有效預力不足，懸臂端下撓超出預測，頂板在營運期開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A duct crushed or blocked by grout leakage during casting gives short elongation that is waved through as a measuring error; the effective prestress is then deficient, the tip deflects more than predicted, and the top slab cracks in service. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潛變、預力損失與長期撓度」與「預力檢查、補強預留與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Creep, prestress loss and long-term deflection" and "Tendon inspection, future-prestress provisions and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 潛變、預力損失與長期撓度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Creep, prestress loss and long-term deflection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「跨中長期下垂」如何影響橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term midspan sag” governs force, deformation or durability in “Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平衡懸臂橋在閉合前是靜定懸臂，閉合後成為連續梁，混凝土潛變會讓結構逐漸往「一次整體澆築」的內力狀態重分配，跨中正彎矩增加。同時鋼腱鬆弛、混凝土乾縮與潛變造成預力損失，使跨中持續下垂。長跨箱梁對這些參數極為敏感：1977 年完工的 Koror–Babeldaob 橋主跨約 241 m，跨中設鉸，約 16 年後懸臂端下撓超過約 1.2 m；1996 年 7 月完成封閉中鉸並加設連續體外預力的補強，同年 9 月倒塌，鑑定調查認為頂板分層剝離觸發破壞，成為長期撓度與補強評估的經典教訓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「跨中長期下垂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before closure a balanced-cantilever bridge is a statically determinate cantilever; after closure it is continuous, and creep gradually redistributes moments towards the state of a girder cast in one piece, increasing midspan sagging moment. Strand relaxation, shrinkage and creep also reduce prestress, so the midspan keeps sagging. Long-span boxes are very sensitive to these parameters: the Koror–Babeldaob Bridge, completed in 1977 with a main span of about 241 m and a midspan hinge, had cantilever tips that deflected more than about 1.2 m after some 16 years; a retrofit finished in July 1996 closed the hinge and added continuous external tendons, and the bridge collapsed that September, with the forensic investigation pointing to delamination of the top flange as the trigger, a classic lesson in long-term deflection and retrofit assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Long-term midspan sag” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：長期撓度 δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Long-term deflection δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土潛變幾年內就結束，之後撓度不再增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete creep ends within a few years, after which deflection stops increasing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「跨中長期下垂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Long-term midspan sag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 潛變、預力損失與長期撓度
knowledge.titleEn: Creep, prestress loss and long-term deflection
knowledge.text: 平衡懸臂橋在閉合前是靜定懸臂，閉合後成為連續梁，混凝土潛變會讓結構逐漸往「一次整體澆築」的內力狀態重分配，跨中正彎矩增加。同時鋼腱鬆弛、混凝土乾縮與潛變造成預力損失，使跨中持續下垂。
knowledge.textEn: Before closure a balanced-cantilever bridge is a statically determinate cantilever; after closure it is continuous, and creep gradually redistributes moments towards the state of a girder cast in one piece, increasing midspan sagging moment. Strand relaxation, shrinkage and creep also reduce prestress, so the midspan keeps sagging.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土潛變幾年內就結束，之後撓度不再增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Concrete creep ends within a few years, after which deflection stops increasing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潛變、預力損失與長期撓度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Creep, prestress loss and long-term deflection" is correct?
options: 平衡懸臂橋在閉合前是靜定懸臂，閉合後成為連續梁，混凝土潛變會讓結構逐漸往「一次整體澆築」的內力狀態重分配，跨中正彎矩增加。
混凝土潛變幾年內就結束，之後撓度不再增加。
預力混凝土箱梁內部沒有車輛荷載，所以不需要定期進入檢查。
optionsEn: Before closure a balanced-cantilever bridge is a statically determinate cantilever.
Concrete creep ends within a few years, after which deflection stops increasing.
The inside of a prestressed box girder carries no traffic, so it needs no routine inspection.
quiz.explanation: 平衡懸臂橋在閉合前是靜定懸臂，閉合後成為連續梁，混凝土潛變會讓結構逐漸往「一次整體澆築」的內力狀態重分配，跨中正彎矩增加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before closure a balanced-cantilever bridge is a statically determinate cantilever; after closure it is continuous, and creep gradually redistributes moments towards the state of a girder cast in one piece, increasing midspan sagging moment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 潛變、預力損失與長期撓度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Creep, prestress loss and long-term deflection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨中長期下垂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-term midspan sag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：長期撓度 δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ)。跨中彈性撓度 δ_el = 60 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時 δ_∞ = 60×3.0 = 180 mm；若實際 φ = 2.5，δ_∞ = 60×3.5 = 210 mm，多出 30 mm，預拱若以 φ = 2.0 設定就會殘留下垂。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Long-term deflection δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ). With an elastic midspan deflection δ_el = 60 mm and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, δ_∞ = 60×3.0 = 180 mm; if the real φ is 2.5, δ_∞ = 60×3.5 = 210 mm, 30 mm more, so a camber set for φ = 2.0 leaves a residual sag. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計階段以至少兩種潛變乾縮模型（例如 fib Model Code 與 ACI 209 或 B3/B4）做敏感度分析，評估長期撓度上下限；完工後建立跨中與四分點高程的固定測量點，定期在相同溫度條件下量測，與預測曲線比較，偏離趨勢持續擴大時啟動結構評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage, run a sensitivity study with at least two creep–shrinkage models, for example fib Model Code and ACI 209 or B3/B4, to bound long-term deflection; after completion set permanent level points at midspan and quarter points and survey them periodically under similar temperatures, triggering a structural assessment if the deviation from prediction keeps growing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 長期撓度 δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ)。跨中彈性撓度 δ_el = 60 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時 δ_∞ = 60×3.0 = 180 mm；若實際 φ = 2.5，δ_∞ = 60×3.5 = 210 mm，多出 30 mm，預拱若以 φ = 2.0 設定就會殘留下垂。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term deflection δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ). With an elastic midspan deflection δ_el = 60 mm and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, δ_∞ = 60×3.0 = 180 mm; if the real φ is 2.5, δ_∞ = 60×3.5 = 210 mm, 30 mm more, so a camber set for φ = 2.0 leaves a residual sag. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「潛變、預力損失與長期撓度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Creep, prestress loss and long-term deflection", which statement holds?
options: 只要兩側節塊數量相同，墩頂就不會有不平衡彎矩。
長期撓度 δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ)。
預鑄節塊的環氧接縫就像膠水，主要靠黏著力承受剪力。
optionsEn: If both sides have the same number of segments, there is no unbalanced moment at the pier.
Long-term deflection δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ).
The epoxy in precast segment joints acts like glue and carries shear mainly by adhesion.
quiz.explanation: 長期撓度 δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term deflection δ_∞ ≈ δ_el·(1 + φ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 潛變、預力損失與長期撓度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Creep, prestress loss and long-term deflection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨中長期下垂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-term midspan sag” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計階段以至少兩種潛變乾縮模型（例如 fib Model Code 與 ACI 209 或 B3/B4）做敏感度分析，評估長期撓度上下限；完工後建立跨中與四分點高程的固定測量點，定期在相同溫度條件下量測，與預測曲線比較，偏離趨勢持續擴大時啟動結構評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage, run a sensitivity study with at least two creep–shrinkage models, for example fib Model Code and ACI 209 or B3/B4, to bound long-term deflection; after completion set permanent level points at midspan and quarter points and survey them periodically under similar temperatures, triggering a structural assessment if the deviation from prediction keeps growing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工資料必須保存施工期線形紀錄、預拱值與長期撓度預測曲線；任何長期下垂或補強工程前，先由獨立的結構工程師以實測資料重新評估，並將評估結論列為施工許可的前提。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: As-built records must keep the construction geometry log, camber values and the predicted long-term deflection curve; before any sag remedy or retrofit, an independent structural engineer re-assesses the bridge with measured data, and that assessment is a precondition for the works permit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只採用單一短期試驗得到的潛變係數，或忽略預力鬆弛與乾縮的長期損失，跨中下垂會在十多年內持續擴大；若補強時未充分理解既有預力與潛變狀態，新增荷重或改變結構系統可能觸發突然破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a single short-term creep coefficient, or ignoring long-term relaxation and shrinkage losses, lets midspan sag grow for more than a decade; a retrofit made without understanding the existing prestress and creep state can add load or change the structural system and trigger sudden failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計階段以至少兩種潛變乾縮模型（例如 fib Model Code 與 ACI 209 或 B3/B4）做敏感度分析，評估長期撓度上下限；完工後建立跨中與四分點高程的固定測量點，定期在相同溫度條件下量測，與預測曲線比較，偏離趨勢持續擴大時啟動結構評估。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage, run a sensitivity study with at least two creep–shrinkage models, for example fib Model Code and ACI 209 or B3/B4, to bound long-term deflection; after completion set permanent level points at midspan and quarter points and survey them periodically under similar temperatures, triggering a structural assessment if the deviation from prediction keeps growing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 竣工資料必須保存施工期線形紀錄、預拱值與長期撓度預測曲線；任何長期下垂或補強工程前，先由獨立的結構工程師以實測資料重新評估，並將評估結論列為施工許可的前提。
knowledge.textEn: As-built records must keep the construction geometry log, camber values and the predicted long-term deflection curve; before any sag remedy or retrofit, an independent structural engineer re-assesses the bridge with measured data, and that assessment is a precondition for the works permit.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潛變、預力損失與長期撓度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Creep, prestress loss and long-term deflection"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要兩懸臂端在閉合當天高程相同，橋梁線形就已經完成。
設計階段以至少兩種潛變乾縮模型（例如 fib Model Code 與 ACI 209 或 B3/B4）做敏感度分析，評估長期撓度上下限。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once the two tips are at the same level on closure day, the bridge geometry is finished.
At design stage, run a sensitivity study with at least two creep–shrinkage models, for example fib Model Code and ACI 209 or B3/B4, to bound long-term deflection.
quiz.explanation: 設計階段以至少兩種潛變乾縮模型（例如 fib Model Code 與 ACI 209 或 B3/B4）做敏感度分析，評估長期撓度上下限；完工後建立跨中與四分點高程的固定測量點，定期在相同溫度條件下量測，與預測曲線比較，偏離趨勢持續擴大時啟動結構評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At design stage, run a sensitivity study with at least two creep–shrinkage models, for example fib Model Code and ACI 209 or B3/B4, to bound long-term deflection; after completion set permanent level points at midspan and quarter points and survey them periodically under similar temperatures, triggering a structural assessment if the deviation from prediction keeps growing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 潛變、預力損失與長期撓度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Creep, prestress loss and long-term deflection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨中長期下垂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-term midspan sag” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只採用單一短期試驗得到的潛變係數，或忽略預力鬆弛與乾縮的長期損失，跨中下垂會在十多年內持續擴大；若補強時未充分理解既有預力與潛變狀態，新增荷重或改變結構系統可能觸發突然破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a single short-term creep coefficient, or ignoring long-term relaxation and shrinkage losses, lets midspan sag grow for more than a decade; a retrofit made without understanding the existing prestress and creep state can add load or change the structural system and trigger sudden failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：長跨箱梁對這些參數極為敏感：1977 年完工的 Koror–Babeldaob 橋主跨約 241 m，跨中設鉸，約 16 年後懸臂端下撓超過約 1.2 m；1996 年 7 月完成封閉中鉸並加設連續體外預力的補強，同年 9 月倒塌，鑑定調查認為頂板分層剝離觸發破壞，成為長期撓度與補強評估的經典教訓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Long-span boxes are very sensitive to these parameters: the Koror–Babeldaob Bridge, completed in 1977 with a main span of about 241 m and a midspan hinge, had cantilever tips that deflected more than about 1.2 m after some 16 years; a retrofit finished in July 1996 closed the hinge and added continuous external tendons, and the bridge collapsed that September, with the forensic investigation pointing to delamination of the top flange as the trigger, a classic lesson in long-term deflection and retrofit assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土潛變幾年內就結束，之後撓度不再增加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete creep ends within a few years, after which deflection stops increasing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只採用單一短期試驗得到的潛變係數，或忽略預力鬆弛與乾縮的長期損失，跨中下垂會在十多年內持續擴大；若補強時未充分理解既有預力與潛變狀態，新增荷重或改變結構系統可能觸發突然破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Using a single short-term creep coefficient, or ignoring long-term relaxation and shrinkage losses, lets midspan sag grow for more than a decade; a retrofit made without understanding the existing prestress and creep state can add load or change the structural system and trigger sudden failure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「潛變、預力損失與長期撓度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Creep, prestress loss and long-term deflection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只採用單一短期試驗得到的潛變係數，或忽略預力鬆弛與乾縮的長期損失，跨中下垂會在十多年內持續擴大。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
預力混凝土箱梁內部沒有車輛荷載，所以不需要定期進入檢查。
optionsEn: Using a single short-term creep coefficient, or ignoring long-term relaxation and shrinkage losses, lets midspan sag grow for more than a decade.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The inside of a prestressed box girder carries no traffic, so it needs no routine inspection.
quiz.explanation: 只採用單一短期試驗得到的潛變係數，或忽略預力鬆弛與乾縮的長期損失，跨中下垂會在十多年內持續擴大；若補強時未充分理解既有預力與潛變狀態，新增荷重或改變結構系統可能觸發突然破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a single short-term creep coefficient, or ignoring long-term relaxation and shrinkage losses, lets midspan sag grow for more than a decade; a retrofit made without understanding the existing prestress and creep state can add load or change the structural system and trigger sudden failure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 預力檢查、補強預留與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Tendon inspection, future-prestress provisions and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「備用預力孔道」如何影響橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spare post-tensioning ducts” governs force, deformation or durability in “Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平衡懸臂橋的長期性能取決於預力系統是否完整：體內鋼腱靠灌漿保護，難以直接檢查，因此要靠箱內檢查、裂縫圖、撓度紀錄與非破壞檢測（例如透地雷達或磁漏檢測）間接判斷。現代規範要求預留備用孔道、錨碇與轉向塊，讓日後可以加裝體外鋼腱補償預力損失或增加載重能力；箱梁內部也需有照明、通風、排水與通行門，使檢查人員能沿全長走動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「備用預力孔道」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The long-term performance of a balanced-cantilever bridge depends on the integrity of its prestress: internal tendons are protected by grout and hard to inspect, so their condition is judged indirectly through inspections inside the box, crack maps, deflection records and non-destructive methods such as ground-penetrating radar or magnetic flux leakage. Modern provisions call for spare ducts, anchorages and deviators so that external tendons can later be added to make up for losses or increase capacity, and the box interior needs lighting, ventilation, drainage and access doors so inspectors can walk its full length. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spare post-tensioning ducts” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若預留能力取正負彎矩區預力的 10%：墩頂懸臂預力 127,500 kN 的 10% 為 12,750 kN，以每束 3,200 kN 計需 12,750/3,200 ≈ 4 束，即在墩頂兩側各預留 2 組錨碇與孔道。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the provision is 10% of the negative- and positive-moment prestress, 10% of the 127,500 kN pier cantilever prestress is 12,750 kN; at 3,200 kN per tendon that is 12,750/3,200 ≈ 4 tendons, i.e. two spare anchorages and ducts on each side of the pier.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預力混凝土箱梁內部沒有車輛荷載，所以不需要定期進入檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The inside of a prestressed box girder carries no traffic, so it needs no routine inspection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「備用預力孔道」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Spare post-tensioning ducts”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預力檢查、補強預留與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Tendon inspection, future-prestress provisions and handover
knowledge.text: 平衡懸臂橋的長期性能取決於預力系統是否完整：體內鋼腱靠灌漿保護，難以直接檢查，因此要靠箱內檢查、裂縫圖、撓度紀錄與非破壞檢測（例如透地雷達或磁漏檢測）間接判斷。現代規範要求預留備用孔道、錨碇與轉向塊，讓日後可以加裝體外鋼腱補償預力損失或增加載重能力；箱梁內部也需有照明、通風、排水與通行門，使檢查人員能沿全長走動。
knowledge.textEn: The long-term performance of a balanced-cantilever bridge depends on the integrity of its prestress: internal tendons are protected by grout and hard to inspect, so their condition is judged indirectly through inspections inside the box, crack maps, deflection records and non-destructive methods such as ground-penetrating radar or magnetic flux leakage. Modern provisions call for spare ducts, anchorages and deviators so that external tendons can later be added to make up for losses or increase capacity, and the box interior needs lighting, ventilation, drainage and access doors so inspectors can walk its full length.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預力混凝土箱梁內部沒有車輛荷載，所以不需要定期進入檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The inside of a prestressed box girder carries no traffic, so it needs no routine inspection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預力檢查、補強預留與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tendon inspection, future-prestress provisions and handover" is correct?
options: 預力混凝土箱梁內部沒有車輛荷載，所以不需要定期進入檢查。
平衡懸臂橋的長期性能取決於預力系統是否完整：體內鋼腱靠灌漿保護，難以直接檢查，因此要靠箱內檢查、裂縫圖、撓度紀錄與非破壞檢測（例如透地雷達或磁漏檢測）間接判斷。
平衡懸臂橋完工後的內力與施工期間一樣，只需用完工模型設計。
optionsEn: The inside of a prestressed box girder carries no traffic, so it needs no routine inspection.

The long-term performance of a balanced-cantilever bridge depends on the integrity of its prestress: internal tendons are protected by grout and hard to inspect, so their condition is judged indirectly through inspections inside the box, crack maps, deflection records and non-destructive methods such as ground-penetrating radar or magnetic flux leakage.
A balanced-cantilever bridge carries the same internal forces during construction as when finished, so the finished model is enough.
quiz.explanation: 平衡懸臂橋的長期性能取決於預力系統是否完整：體內鋼腱靠灌漿保護，難以直接檢查，因此要靠箱內檢查、裂縫圖、撓度紀錄與非破壞檢測（例如透地雷達或磁漏檢測）間接判斷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The long-term performance of a balanced-cantilever bridge depends on the integrity of its prestress: internal tendons are protected by grout and hard to inspect, so their condition is judged indirectly through inspections inside the box, crack maps, deflection records and non-destructive methods such as ground-penetrating radar or magnetic flux leakage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預力檢查、補強預留與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tendon inspection, future-prestress provisions and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「備用預力孔道」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spare post-tensioning ducts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若預留能力取正負彎矩區預力的 10%：墩頂懸臂預力 127,500 kN 的 10% 為 12,750 kN，以每束 3,200 kN 計需 12,750/3,200 ≈ 4 束，即在墩頂兩側各預留 2 組錨碇與孔道。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the provision is 10% of the negative- and positive-moment prestress, 10% of the 127,500 kN pier cantilever prestress is 12,750 kN; at 3,200 kN per tendon that is 12,750/3,200 ≈ 4 tendons, i.e. two spare anchorages and ducts on each side of the pier. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前做一次完整基準檢查：箱內裂縫圖與寬度、錨頭保護蓋狀態、灌漿孔與排氣孔封閉、跨中與墩頂高程、伸縮縫間隙，所有結果附照片與座標存入養護資料庫；之後每次定期檢查都與此基準比較，裂縫寬度或撓度增量超過門檻即啟動詳細評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, carry out a full baseline inspection: crack maps and widths inside the box, anchor cap condition, sealing of grout and vent ports, midspan and pier levels, and joint gaps, with photographs and coordinates stored in the maintenance database; compare every later routine inspection with this baseline and trigger a detailed assessment if crack widths or deflection increments exceed thresholds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若預留能力取正負彎矩區預力的 10%：墩頂懸臂預力 127,500 kN 的 10% 為 12,750 kN，以每束 3,200 kN 計需 12,750/3,200 ≈ 4 束，即在墩頂兩側各預留 2 組錨碇與孔道。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If the provision is 10% of the negative- and positive-moment prestress, 10% of the 127,500 kN pier cantilever prestress is 12,750 kN; at 3,200 kN per tendon that is 12,750/3,200 ≈ 4 tendons, i.e. two spare anchorages and ducts on each side of the pier. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預力檢查、補強預留與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tendon inspection, future-prestress provisions and handover", which statement holds?
options: 懸臂鋼腱只在施工期有用，閉合後就可以不計。
掛籃只是模板，重量與變形不會影響橋梁線形。
若預留能力取正負彎矩區預力的 10%：墩頂懸臂預力 127,500 kN 的 10% 為 12,750 kN，以每束 3,200 kN 計需 12,750/3,200 ≈ 4 束，即在墩頂兩側各預留 2 組錨碇與孔道。
optionsEn: Cantilever tendons only matter during construction and can be ignored after closure.
A form traveler is just formwork, so its weight and deflection do not affect the bridge geometry.
If the provision is 10% of the negative- and positive-moment prestress, 10% of the 127,500 kN pier cantilever prestress is 12,750 kN.
quiz.explanation: 若預留能力取正負彎矩區預力的 10%：墩頂懸臂預力 127,500 kN 的 10% 為 12,750 kN，以每束 3,200 kN 計需 12,750/3,200 ≈ 4 束，即在墩頂兩側各預留 2 組錨碇與孔道。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If the provision is 10% of the negative- and positive-moment prestress, 10% of the 127,500 kN pier cantilever prestress is 12,750 kN; at 3,200 kN per tendon that is 12,750/3,200 ≈ 4 tendons, i.e. two spare anchorages and ducts on each side of the pier. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預力檢查、補強預留與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tendon inspection, future-prestress provisions and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「備用預力孔道」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spare post-tensioning ducts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前做一次完整基準檢查：箱內裂縫圖與寬度、錨頭保護蓋狀態、灌漿孔與排氣孔封閉、跨中與墩頂高程、伸縮縫間隙，所有結果附照片與座標存入養護資料庫；之後每次定期檢查都與此基準比較，裂縫寬度或撓度增量超過門檻即啟動詳細評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, carry out a full baseline inspection: crack maps and widths inside the box, anchor cap condition, sealing of grout and vent ports, midspan and pier levels, and joint gaps, with photographs and coordinates stored in the maintenance database; compare every later routine inspection with this baseline and trigger a detailed assessment if crack widths or deflection increments exceed thresholds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包括施工階段分析、鋼腱張拉與灌漿紀錄、線形控制歷程、備用孔道位置圖、箱內檢查路線與安全進入程序；管理單位應排定首次詳細檢查並保存原始量測資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should include the construction-stage analysis, stressing and grouting records, the geometry-control history, the spare-duct location plan, inspection routes inside the box and confined-space entry procedures; the owner should schedule the first detailed inspection and keep the raw survey data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：箱梁排水孔堵塞讓雨水積存在底板，沿錨碇與孔道滲入，鋼絞線多年後腐蝕斷裂，等到外觀出現縱向裂縫時損傷已大；若未預留補強錨碇，日後補強只能在既有箱梁上鑽孔植筋，風險與成本都高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blocked box drains let rainwater pond on the bottom slab and seep along anchorages and ducts, corroding strands until they break years later, by which time visible longitudinal cracks show heavy damage; without spare anchorages, later strengthening needs drilling and doweling into the existing box, with high risk and cost. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前做一次完整基準檢查：箱內裂縫圖與寬度、錨頭保護蓋狀態、灌漿孔與排氣孔封閉、跨中與墩頂高程、伸縮縫間隙，所有結果附照片與座標存入養護資料庫；之後每次定期檢查都與此基準比較，裂縫寬度或撓度增量超過門檻即啟動詳細評估。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, carry out a full baseline inspection: crack maps and widths inside the box, anchor cap condition, sealing of grout and vent ports, midspan and pier levels, and joint gaps, with photographs and coordinates stored in the maintenance database; compare every later routine inspection with this baseline and trigger a detailed assessment if crack widths or deflection increments exceed thresholds.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包括施工階段分析、鋼腱張拉與灌漿紀錄、線形控制歷程、備用孔道位置圖、箱內檢查路線與安全進入程序；管理單位應排定首次詳細檢查並保存原始量測資料。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents should include the construction-stage analysis, stressing and grouting records, the geometry-control history, the spare-duct location plan, inspection routes inside the box and confined-space entry procedures; the owner should schedule the first detailed inspection and keep the raw survey data.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預力檢查、補強預留與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tendon inspection, future-prestress provisions and handover"?
options: 交接前做一次完整基準檢查：箱內裂縫圖與寬度、錨頭保護蓋狀態、灌漿孔與排氣孔封閉、跨中與墩頂高程、伸縮縫間隙，所有結果附照片與座標存入養護資料庫。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
線形誤差可以等到閉合時再一次修正。
optionsEn: Before handover, carry out a full baseline inspection: crack maps and widths inside the box, anchor cap condition, sealing of grout and vent ports, midspan and pier levels, and joint gaps, with photographs and coordinates stored in the maintenance database.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, carry out a full baseline inspection: crack maps and widths inside the box, anchor cap condition, sealing of grout and vent ports, midspan and pier levels, and joint gaps, with photographs and coordinates stored in the maintenance database; compare every later routine inspection with this baseline and trigger a detailed assessment if crack widths or deflection increments exceed thresholds. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預力檢查、補強預留與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tendon inspection, future-prestress provisions and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「備用預力孔道」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spare post-tensioning ducts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 箱梁排水孔堵塞讓雨水積存在底板，沿錨碇與孔道滲入，鋼絞線多年後腐蝕斷裂，等到外觀出現縱向裂縫時損傷已大；若未預留補強錨碇，日後補強只能在既有箱梁上鑽孔植筋，風險與成本都高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked box drains let rainwater pond on the bottom slab and seep along anchorages and ducts, corroding strands until they break years later, by which time visible longitudinal cracks show heavy damage; without spare anchorages, later strengthening needs drilling and doweling into the existing box, with high risk and cost. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：現代規範要求預留備用孔道、錨碇與轉向塊，讓日後可以加裝體外鋼腱補償預力損失或增加載重能力；箱梁內部也需有照明、通風、排水與通行門，使檢查人員能沿全長走動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Modern provisions call for spare ducts, anchorages and deviators so that external tendons can later be added to make up for losses or increase capacity, and the box interior needs lighting, ventilation, drainage and access doors so inspectors can walk its full length.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預力混凝土箱梁內部沒有車輛荷載，所以不需要定期進入檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The inside of a prestressed box girder carries no traffic, so it needs no routine inspection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預力檢查、補強預留與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tendon inspection, future-prestress provisions and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
箱梁排水孔堵塞讓雨水積存在底板，沿錨碇與孔道滲入，鋼絞線多年後腐蝕斷裂，等到外觀出現縱向裂縫時損傷已大。
平衡懸臂橋完工後的內力與施工期間一樣，只需用完工模型設計。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Blocked box drains let rainwater pond on the bottom slab and seep along anchorages and ducts, corroding strands until they break years later, by which time visible longitudinal cracks show heavy damage.
A balanced-cantilever bridge carries the same internal forces during construction as when finished, so the finished model is enough.

courses.title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
courses.summary: 從簡支箱梁的正彎矩與體外預力需求出發，計算架橋機對橋墩的施工荷載，再處理乾接縫與環氧接縫、轉向塊與錨碇橫隔、架橋機推進穩定、整跨荷重轉換與預製場幾何控制，最後以鋼腱振動頻率、接縫監測與可更換性驗收交接，並以佛州 Long Key 橋、Seven Mile 橋與曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路為案例。
courses.summaryEn: Starting from the sagging moment and external prestress demand of a simple-span box girder, compute gantry construction loads on the piers, then handle dry and epoxy joints, deviators and anchorage diaphragms, gantry launching stability, whole-span load transfer and casting-yard geometry control, and finally accept and hand over with tendon vibration checks, joint monitoring and replaceability, using Florida's Long Key and Seven Mile bridges and Bangkok's Bang Na Expressway as cases.
courses.focus: 以架橋機整跨懸吊預鑄節塊、一次張拉體外鋼腱，讓長距離高架橋以每跨數天的節奏重複推進
courses.focusEn: Hanging a whole span of precast segments from a gantry and stressing external tendons at once, so long viaducts advance at a few days per span
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 工程規劃練習：一條 12.6 km 的高架橋採 42 m 簡支跨，共 12,600/42 = 300 跨，每跨 14 個節塊，總計 300×14 = 4,200 個節塊。若每部架橋機每 2.5 天完成一跨（含推進），單部需要 300×2.5 = 750 個工作天；投入 3 部架橋機則約 250 個工作天。供料需求為 3×14/2.5 = 16.8 個節塊／天，若每個短線台座每天產出 1 個節塊，至少需要 17 個台座，另加故障與養護餘裕。為吸收颱風或運輸中斷，堆置場若要儲備 30 天用量，需容納約 30×16.8 ≈ 504 個節塊。若架設循環變為 3 天／跨，總工期增為 300×3/3 = 300 天，日需求降為 3×14/3 = 14 個節塊。這說明逐跨工法的關鍵路徑常在預製與運輸，而不只是架設本身。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際工程的計畫。
workedExample.textEn: Planning exercise: a 12.6 km viaduct with 42 m simple spans has 12,600/42 = 300 spans; at 14 segments per span it needs 300×14 = 4,200 segments. If each gantry completes a span every 2.5 days including launching, one gantry needs 300×2.5 = 750 working days; three gantries need about 250. Supply demand is 3×14/2.5 = 16.8 segments per day, so with one segment per short-line cell per day at least 17 cells are needed, plus margin for breakdowns and curing. To ride out a typhoon or transport stoppage with 30 days of buffer, the storage yard must hold about 30×16.8 ≈ 504 segments. If the erection cycle slips to 3 days per span, the duration grows to 300×3/3 = 300 days while daily demand drops to 3×14/3 = 14 segments. This shows that the critical path of span-by-span work often lies in casting and transport, not only in erection. Values are teaching assumptions, not the plan of any real project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」與「架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection" and "Gantry construction loads on the piers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Whole-span box and external tendons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 逐跨工法把一整跨的預鑄節塊（常見 10 至 14 塊）同時懸吊或擱置在架橋機或下承桁架上，調整線形後一次張拉縱向鋼腱，使整跨立刻成為能自承重的簡支梁，再把架橋機推到下一跨。因為所有節塊在張拉前都由臨時結構承托，接縫在施工期不需承受懸臂彎矩，箱梁可以用等高度斷面，最適合跨度約 30 至 45 m、跨數很多的長距離高架橋。鋼腱多採體外配置，沿箱內由錨碇橫隔經轉向塊折線布設，近似拋物線的偏心抵抗跨中正彎矩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Span-by-span erection hangs or rests a whole span of precast segments, commonly 10 to 14, on an overhead gantry or underslung truss, aligns them, then stresses the longitudinal tendons in one operation so the span immediately becomes a self-supporting simple beam before the gantry moves on. Because all segments are carried by temporary works until stressing, the joints never carry cantilever moment during construction and the box can have constant depth, ideal for long viaducts with many spans of about 30 to 45 m. Tendons are usually external, running inside the box from anchorage diaphragm to deviators in a polygonal profile whose eccentricity approximates a parabola to resist midspan sagging moment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Whole-span box and external tendons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡支跨 L = 42 m、自重 w = 180 kN/m：M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m；加鋪面 50 kN/m 的 11,025 kN·m 與活載 12,000 kN·m，合計 M = 62,715 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Simple span L = 42 m, self-weight w = 180 kN/m: M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m; adding 11,025 kN·m from 50 kN/m surfacing and 12,000 kN·m of live load gives M = 62,715 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Whole-span box and external tendons”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求
knowledge.titleEn: Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection
knowledge.text: 逐跨工法把一整跨的預鑄節塊（常見 10 至 14 塊）同時懸吊或擱置在架橋機或下承桁架上，調整線形後一次張拉縱向鋼腱，使整跨立刻成為能自承重的簡支梁，再把架橋機推到下一跨。因為所有節塊在張拉前都由臨時結構承托，接縫在施工期不需承受懸臂彎矩，箱梁可以用等高度斷面，最適合跨度約 30 至 45 m、跨數很多的長距離高架橋。
knowledge.textEn: Span-by-span erection hangs or rests a whole span of precast segments, commonly 10 to 14, on an overhead gantry or underslung truss, aligns them, then stresses the longitudinal tendons in one operation so the span immediately becomes a self-supporting simple beam before the gantry moves on. Because all segments are carried by temporary works until stressing, the joints never carry cantilever moment during construction and the box can have constant depth, ideal for long viaducts with many spans of about 30 to 45 m.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection" is correct?
options: 逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。
逐跨工法把一整跨的預鑄節塊（常見 10 至 14 塊）同時懸吊或擱置在架橋機或下承桁架上，調整線形後一次張拉縱向鋼腱，使整跨立刻成為能自承重的簡支梁，再把架橋機推到下一跨。
架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。
optionsEn: Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete.

Span-by-span erection hangs or rests a whole span of precast segments, commonly 10 to 14, on an overhead gantry or underslung truss, aligns them, then stresses the longitudinal tendons in one operation so the span immediately becomes a self-supporting simple beam before the gantry moves on.
Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient.

quiz.explanationEn: Span-by-span erection hangs or rests a whole span of precast segments, commonly 10 to 14, on an overhead gantry or underslung truss, aligns them, then stresses the longitudinal tendons in one operation so the span immediately becomes a self-supporting simple beam before the gantry moves on. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Whole-span box and external tendons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡支跨 L = 42 m、自重 w = 180 kN/m：M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m；加鋪面 50 kN/m 的 11,025 kN·m 與活載 12,000 kN·m，合計 M = 62,715 kN·m。斷面 A = 7.2 m²、S_b = 4.0 m³、跨中偏心 e = 1.0 m，底緣保留 0.7 MPa 壓應力：P ≥ (62,715/4.0 + 700)/(1/7.2 + 1.0/4.0) ≈ 42,120 kN，取 12 束 × 3,600 kN = 43,200 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Simple span L = 42 m, self-weight w = 180 kN/m: M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m; adding 11,025 kN·m from 50 kN/m surfacing and 12,000 kN·m of live load gives M = 62,715 kN·m. With A = 7.2 m², S_b = 4.0 m³, midspan eccentricity e = 1.0 m and 0.7 MPa residual bottom compression, P ≥ (62,715/4.0 + 700)/(1/7.2 + 1.0/4.0) ≈ 42,120 kN; use 12 tendons × 3,600 kN = 43,200 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段模型檢查三個狀態：節塊懸吊於架橋機（梁體無預力）、張拉完成後架橋機卸載（自重加預力）、營運滿載（含鋪面與活載），每個狀態列出每一接縫上下緣應力，確認接縫在所有使用狀態都維持設計規定的殘餘壓應力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check three states in a construction-stage model: segments hanging from the gantry with no prestress, after stressing with the gantry unloaded (self-weight plus prestress), and full service load with surfacing and live load, listing top and bottom stresses at every joint and confirming that each joint keeps the specified residual compression in all service states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Simple span L = 42 m, self-weight w = 180 kN/m: M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m; adding 11,025 kN·m from 50 kN/m surfacing and 12,000 kN·m of live load gives M = 62,715 kN·m. With A = 7.2 m², S_b = 4.0 m³, midspan eccentricity e = 1.0 m and 0.7 MPa residual bottom compression, P ≥ (62,715/4.0 + 700)/(1/7.2 + 1.0/4.0) ≈ 42,120 kN; use 12 tendons × 3,600 kN = 43,200 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection", which statement holds?
options: 體外鋼腱不埋在混凝土裡，所以轉向塊只需要很少的鋼筋。
張拉完成後只要拆除吊桿，荷重自然會平均傳到四個支承。
簡支跨 L = 42 m、自重 w = 180 kN/m：M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m。
optionsEn: Because external tendons are not embedded, deviators need very little reinforcement.
After stressing, removing the hangers automatically shares the load equally among the four bearings.
Simple span L = 42 m, self-weight w = 180 kN/m: M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m.
quiz.explanation: 簡支跨 L = 42 m、自重 w = 180 kN/m：M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m；加鋪面 50 kN/m 的 11,025 kN·m 與活載 12,000 kN·m，合計 M = 62,715 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Simple span L = 42 m, self-weight w = 180 kN/m: M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m; adding 11,025 kN·m from 50 kN/m surfacing and 12,000 kN·m of live load gives M = 62,715 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Whole-span box and external tendons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段模型檢查三個狀態：節塊懸吊於架橋機（梁體無預力）、張拉完成後架橋機卸載（自重加預力）、營運滿載（含鋪面與活載），每個狀態列出每一接縫上下緣應力，確認接縫在所有使用狀態都維持設計規定的殘餘壓應力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check three states in a construction-stage model: segments hanging from the gantry with no prestress, after stressing with the gantry unloaded (self-weight plus prestress), and full service load with surfacing and live load, listing top and bottom stresses at every joint and confirming that each joint keeps the specified residual compression in all service states. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計圖說應明列每一跨的節塊編號、鋼腱編號與張拉順序，並註明接縫殘餘壓應力的設計值，作為施工與日後評估的共同基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings should list segment numbers, tendon numbers and stressing order for every span and state the design residual joint compression, as a shared basis for construction and later assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段模型檢查三個狀態：節塊懸吊於架橋機（梁體無預力）、張拉完成後架橋機卸載（自重加預力）、營運滿載（含鋪面與活載），每個狀態列出每一接縫上下緣應力，確認接縫在所有使用狀態都維持設計規定的殘餘壓應力。
knowledge.textEn: Check three states in a construction-stage model: segments hanging from the gantry with no prestress, after stressing with the gantry unloaded (self-weight plus prestress), and full service load with surfacing and live load, listing top and bottom stresses at every joint and confirming that each joint keeps the specified residual compression in all service states.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計圖說應明列每一跨的節塊編號、鋼腱編號與張拉順序，並註明接縫殘餘壓應力的設計值，作為施工與日後評估的共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Drawings should list segment numbers, tendon numbers and stressing order for every span and state the design residual joint compression, as a shared basis for construction and later assessment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection"?
options: 以施工階段模型檢查三個狀態：節塊懸吊於架橋機（梁體無預力）、張拉完成後架橋機卸載（自重加預力）、營運滿載（含鋪面與活載），每個狀態列出每一接縫上下緣應力，確認接縫在所有使用狀態都維持設計規定的殘餘壓應力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
體外鋼腱張拉完成後力量不會改變，所以不需要再量測。
optionsEn: Check three states in a construction-stage model: segments hanging from the gantry with no prestress, after stressing with the gantry unloaded (self-weight plus prestress), and full service load with surfacing and live load, listing top and bottom stresses at every joint and confirming that each joint keeps the specified residual compression in all service states.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once stressed, an external tendon's force never changes, so it need not be measured again.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段模型檢查三個狀態：節塊懸吊於架橋機（梁體無預力）、張拉完成後架橋機卸載（自重加預力）、營運滿載（含鋪面與活載），每個狀態列出每一接縫上下緣應力，確認接縫在所有使用狀態都維持設計規定的殘餘壓應力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check three states in a construction-stage model: segments hanging from the gantry with no prestress, after stressing with the gantry unloaded (self-weight plus prestress), and full service load with surfacing and live load, listing top and bottom stresses at every joint and confirming that each joint keeps the specified residual compression in all service states. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Whole-span box and external tendons” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋼腱多採體外配置，沿箱內由錨碇橫隔經轉向塊折線布設，近似拋物線的偏心抵抗跨中正彎矩。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tendons are usually external, running inside the box from anchorage diaphragm to deviators in a polygonal profile whose eccentricity approximates a parabola to resist midspan sagging moment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。
架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators.
Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient.
quiz.explanation: 若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Gantry construction loads on the piers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「架橋機支腿反力」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gantry leg reactions” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 整跨節塊在張拉前全部重量經由架橋機傳到前後兩座橋墩，架橋機自重也一併加上；支腿通常放在墩帽或已完成箱梁的端部，與墩柱軸線有偏心，墩柱在施工期承受營運時不會出現的單側彎矩。架橋機推進時重心沿縱向移動，風力又作用在高聳的主桁與節塊上，所以墩帽承壓、墩柱彎矩、基礎與支承臨時鎖定都要以施工荷載逐一檢核，而不是只套用營運荷載組合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「架橋機支腿反力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before stressing, the entire weight of a span of segments, plus the gantry's own weight, passes through the gantry to the two piers; legs usually sit on the pier cap or on the end of the completed girder, eccentric to the column axis, so the column carries one-sided bending that never occurs in service. As the gantry launches, its centre of gravity moves along the bridge and wind acts on the tall girders and hanging segments, so pier-cap bearing, column bending, foundations and temporary bearing locks must each be checked for construction loads rather than service combinations alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Gantry leg reactions” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一跨節塊 W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN，架橋機在該跨的自重 4,000 kN，兩支腿平均反力 R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN；支腿距墩軸偏心 1.2 m 時墩柱施工彎矩 M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m，須與墩柱設計彎矩與基礎承載比較。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One span of segments weighs W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN and the gantry contributes 4,000 kN over that span, so each of the two legs carries on average R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN; with a 1.2 m leg eccentricity from the pier axis the construction moment in the column is M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m, to be compared with the column and foundation capacity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「架橋機支腿反力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Gantry leg reactions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載
knowledge.titleEn: Gantry construction loads on the piers
knowledge.text: 整跨節塊在張拉前全部重量經由架橋機傳到前後兩座橋墩，架橋機自重也一併加上；支腿通常放在墩帽或已完成箱梁的端部，與墩柱軸線有偏心，墩柱在施工期承受營運時不會出現的單側彎矩。架橋機推進時重心沿縱向移動，風力又作用在高聳的主桁與節塊上，所以墩帽承壓、墩柱彎矩、基礎與支承臨時鎖定都要以施工荷載逐一檢核，而不是只套用營運荷載組合。
knowledge.textEn: Before stressing, the entire weight of a span of segments, plus the gantry's own weight, passes through the gantry to the two piers; legs usually sit on the pier cap or on the end of the completed girder, eccentric to the column axis, so the column carries one-sided bending that never occurs in service. As the gantry launches, its centre of gravity moves along the bridge and wind acts on the tall girders and hanging segments, so pier-cap bearing, column bending, foundations and temporary bearing locks must each be checked for construction loads rather than service combinations alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gantry construction loads on the piers" is correct?
options: 架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。
乾接縫只是少塗一層環氧，結構行為與環氧接縫完全相同。
整跨節塊在張拉前全部重量經由架橋機傳到前後兩座橋墩，架橋機自重也一併加上。
optionsEn: Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient.
A dry joint is just an epoxy joint without the epoxy and behaves identically.
Before stressing, the entire weight of a span of segments, plus the gantry's own weight, passes through the gantry to the two piers.
quiz.explanation: 整跨節塊在張拉前全部重量經由架橋機傳到前後兩座橋墩，架橋機自重也一併加上；支腿通常放在墩帽或已完成箱梁的端部，與墩柱軸線有偏心，墩柱在施工期承受營運時不會出現的單側彎矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before stressing, the entire weight of a span of segments, plus the gantry's own weight, passes through the gantry to the two piers; legs usually sit on the pier cap or on the end of the completed girder, eccentric to the column axis, so the column carries one-sided bending that never occurs in service. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gantry construction loads on the piers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「架橋機支腿反力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gantry leg reactions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一跨節塊 W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN，架橋機在該跨的自重 4,000 kN，兩支腿平均反力 R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN；支腿距墩軸偏心 1.2 m 時墩柱施工彎矩 M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m，須與墩柱設計彎矩與基礎承載比較。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One span of segments weighs W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN and the gantry contributes 4,000 kN over that span, so each of the two legs carries on average R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN; with a 1.2 m leg eccentricity from the pier axis the construction moment in the column is M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m, to be compared with the column and foundation capacity. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：架橋機供應商須提供各工況（空載推進、懸吊整跨、張拉、颱風停機）的支腿反力表，由橋梁設計單位對照墩帽、墩柱與基礎容量逐項確認；首跨架設時在支腿下設荷重計或以油壓讀值監測實際反力，與表列值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The gantry supplier must provide leg-reaction tables for each case (empty launch, full span hanging, stressing, storm parking), which the bridge designer checks against pier-cap, column and foundation capacity item by item; on the first span, monitor real reactions with load cells or hydraulic readings under the legs and compare with the table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gantry construction loads on the piers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「架橋機支腿反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gantry leg reactions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 架橋機供應商須提供各工況（空載推進、懸吊整跨、張拉、颱風停機）的支腿反力表，由橋梁設計單位對照墩帽、墩柱與基礎容量逐項確認；首跨架設時在支腿下設荷重計或以油壓讀值監測實際反力，與表列值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The gantry supplier must provide leg-reaction tables for each case (empty launch, full span hanging, stressing, storm parking), which the bridge designer checks against pier-cap, column and foundation capacity item by item; on the first span, monitor real reactions with load cells or hydraulic readings under the legs and compare with the table. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把架橋機支腿位置、最大反力與停機條件（例如風速上限）寫入橋墩設計說明與施工計畫，任何更換架橋機或改變支腿位置都需重新送審。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write gantry leg positions, maximum reactions and parking conditions, such as a wind-speed limit, into the pier design notes and the construction plan, and require resubmission for any change of gantry or leg position.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支腿落在墩帽邊緣或未經設計的位置，可能壓碎墩帽混凝土或使支承墊石開裂；若颱風停機時未鎖定架橋機並降低懸吊荷重，側風可能使架橋機橫移甚至倒塌，砸毀已完成的跨。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Legs landing near the edge of a pier cap or at an undesigned position can crush the cap concrete or crack bearing plinths; if the gantry is not locked and unloaded when parked for a typhoon, cross-wind can slide or topple it onto completed spans. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
