肋—面板焊縫焊得越深越好，最好完全燒穿。
optionsEn: If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear.

For a 16 mm steel plate with 50 mm of surfacing assumed fully composite, a surfacing modulus of 5,000 MPa at moderate temperature gives a strip bending stiffness about 5.3 times that of the plate alone.
The deeper the rib-to-deck weld the better; full melt-through is best.
quiz.explanation: 16 mm 鋼面板加 50 mm 鋪面，假設完全合成：鋪面模數 5,000 MPa（約常溫）時板條抗彎勁度約為鋼板單獨的 5.3 倍；高溫降到 1,000 MPa 時只剩約 1.9 倍；低溫 10,000 MPa 時約 9.1 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 16 mm steel plate with 50 mm of surfacing assumed fully composite, a surfacing modulus of 5,000 MPa at moderate temperature gives a strip bending stiffness about 5.3 times that of the plate alone; at 1,000 MPa in hot weather only about 1.9 times; at 10,000 MPa in cold weather about 9.1 times. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surfacing system and composite action with the plate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環氧瀝青鋪面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋪設前檢查鋼面板噴砂等級、粗糙度與防蝕底漆，鋪面材料做配比與黏結強度試驗；鋪設後以拉拔試驗抽查與鋼板的黏結，並以敲擊或熱像檢查脫層；通車初期在面板下方貼應變計量測不同季節的應力幅，驗證設計假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before paving, check blast grade, roughness and primer on the steel plate and test the surfacing mix and bond strength; after paving, spot-check bond by pull-off tests and look for debonding by sounding or thermography; in the first years, gauge the plate underside to measure stress ranges in different seasons and verify design assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋪面系統（防蝕層、黏結層、鋪面）應與鋼橋面一起設計與驗收，規格中明訂適用溫度範圍與黏結強度；維護計畫須包括鋪面裂縫的即時封填，避免水分進入鋼板界面。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design and accept the surfacing system (corrosion layer, bond coat, surfacing) together with the steel deck, specifying the temperature range and bond strength; the maintenance plan must include prompt sealing of surfacing cracks so water cannot reach the steel interface.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋪面系統與面板協同作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surfacing system and composite action with the plate"?

工地對接焊只會影響局部，不會改變整跨長度。

Site butt welds are local and do not change the length of a whole span.
Before paving, check blast grade, roughness and primer on the steel plate and test the surfacing mix and bond strength.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surfacing system and composite action with the plate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環氧瀝青鋪面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋪面的勁度隨溫度大幅改變，夏季高溫時合成效果降低，面板應力上升；鋪面開裂或與鋼板脫層，則同時失去分散荷載與防水兩種功能。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surfacing stiffness changes greatly with temperature, so composite action drops in hot summers and plate stresses rise; cracking or debonding of the surfacing loses both load spreading and waterproofing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。
knowledge.textEn: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋪面系統與面板協同作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surfacing system and composite action with the plate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。
optionsEn: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately.
quiz.explanation: 鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「疲勞熱點檢查清單」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fatigue hot-spot checklist” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性橋面的疲勞裂縫集中在少數已知位置：肋—面板焊縫根部向面板內成長、肋—橫梁連接與開孔端部、嵌補肋拼接焊縫、面板對接焊。根部向面板成長的裂縫從上方被鋪面遮住、從箱內看不到焊縫內部，往往要到鋪面沿肋線開裂才被發現。因此交接時必須提供以熱點為主的檢查清單、箱內通行路線、可用的超音波檢測方法，以及依裂縫成長速度訂定的檢查週期；修復可用止裂孔、螺栓補強板或橋面加鋪高性能混凝土層。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「疲勞熱點檢查清單」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fatigue cracks in orthotropic decks concentrate at a few known locations: rib-to-deck weld roots growing into the deck plate, rib-to-floorbeam connections and cut-out ends, insert-rib splice welds and deck-plate butt welds. Root cracks growing into the plate are hidden by surfacing from above and invisible inside the weld from within the box, so they are often found only when the surfacing cracks along rib lines. Handover must therefore supply a hot-spot inspection checklist, access routes inside the box, suitable ultrasonic methods and inspection intervals based on crack-growth rates; repairs include stop holes, bolted doubler plates or an overlay of high-performance concrete on the deck. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fatigue hot-spot checklist” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Paris 定律 da/dN = C·(ΔK)³，ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa)，C = 3×10⁻¹³（mm 與 MPa√mm）、Y = 1.12、Δσ = 40 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Paris law da/dN = C·(ΔK)³ with ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa), C = 3×10⁻¹³ (mm and MPa√mm), Y = 1.12 and Δσ = 40 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「疲勞熱點檢查清單」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fatigue hot-spot checklist”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover
knowledge.text: 正交異性橋面的疲勞裂縫集中在少數已知位置：肋—面板焊縫根部向面板內成長、肋—橫梁連接與開孔端部、嵌補肋拼接焊縫、面板對接焊。根部向面板成長的裂縫從上方被鋪面遮住、從箱內看不到焊縫內部，往往要到鋪面沿肋線開裂才被發現。
knowledge.textEn: Fatigue cracks in orthotropic decks concentrate at a few known locations: rib-to-deck weld roots growing into the deck plate, rib-to-floorbeam connections and cut-out ends, insert-rib splice welds and deck-plate butt welds. Root cracks growing into the plate are hidden by surfacing from above and invisible inside the weld from within the box, so they are often found only when the surfacing cracks along rib lines.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover" is correct?
options: 鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。
正交異性橋面的疲勞裂縫集中在少數已知位置：肋—面板焊縫根部向面板內成長、肋—橫梁連接與開孔端部、嵌補肋拼接焊縫、面板對接焊。
鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。
optionsEn: Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately.

Fatigue cracks in orthotropic decks concentrate at a few known locations: rib-to-deck weld roots growing into the deck plate, rib-to-floorbeam connections and cut-out ends, insert-rib splice welds and deck-plate butt welds.
A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough.
quiz.explanation: 正交異性橋面的疲勞裂縫集中在少數已知位置：肋—面板焊縫根部向面板內成長、肋—橫梁連接與開孔端部、嵌補肋拼接焊縫、面板對接焊。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fatigue cracks in orthotropic decks concentrate at a few known locations: rib-to-deck weld roots growing into the deck plate, rib-to-floorbeam connections and cut-out ends, insert-rib splice welds and deck-plate butt welds. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「疲勞熱點檢查清單」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fatigue hot-spot checklist” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Paris 定律 da/dN = C·(ΔK)³，ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa)，C = 3×10⁻¹³（mm 與 MPa√mm）、Y = 1.12、Δσ = 40 MPa。裂縫由 2 mm 長到 12 mm：N = 2(a₀^−0.5 − a₁^−0.5)/[C·(YΔσ)³·π^1.5] ≈ 5.6×10⁶ 次；若重車輪每日 3,000 次，約 5.1 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Paris law da/dN = C·(ΔK)³ with ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa), C = 3×10⁻¹³ (mm and MPa√mm), Y = 1.12 and Δσ = 40 MPa. Growing a crack from 2 mm to 12 mm takes N = 2(a₀^−0.5 − a₁^−0.5)/[C·(YΔσ)³·π^1.5] ≈ 5.6×10⁶ cycles, about 5.1 years at 3,000 heavy wheel passes a day. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前完成一次基準檢查：箱內熱點逐一目視與磁粉檢測、重車道肋—面板焊縫以超音波抽查、鋪面裂縫圖與照片；之後的檢查週期依裂縫成長計算與實際交通量設定，每次結果與基準比較，新裂縫須記錄位置、長度與方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover complete a baseline inspection: every hot spot inside the box checked visually and by magnetic particle, heavy-lane rib-to-deck welds sampled by ultrasonics, and the surfacing crack map photographed; set later intervals from crack-growth calculations and actual traffic, compare every result with the baseline, and record the position, length and direction of any new crack.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Paris 定律 da/dN = C·(ΔK)³，ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa)，C = 3×10⁻¹³（mm 與 MPa√mm）、Y = 1.12、Δσ = 40 MPa。裂縫由 2 mm 長到 12 mm：N = 2(a₀^−0.5 − a₁^−0.5)/[C·(YΔσ)³·π^1.5] ≈ 5.6×10⁶ 次；若重車輪每日 3,000 次，約 5.1 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Paris law da/dN = C·(ΔK)³ with ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa), C = 3×10⁻¹³ (mm and MPa√mm), Y = 1.12 and Δσ = 40 MPa. Growing a crack from 2 mm to 12 mm takes N = 2(a₀^−0.5 − a₁^−0.5)/[C·(YΔσ)³·π^1.5] ≈ 5.6×10⁶ cycles, about 5.1 years at 3,000 heavy wheel passes a day. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。

optionsEn: Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate.
Welding distortion can simply be pulled out with jacks during assembly.

quiz.explanation: Paris 定律 da/dN = C·(ΔK)³，ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa)，C = 3×10⁻¹³（mm 與 MPa√mm）、Y = 1.12、Δσ = 40 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Paris law da/dN = C·(ΔK)³ with ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa), C = 3×10⁻¹³ (mm and MPa√mm), Y = 1.12 and Δσ = 40 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「疲勞熱點檢查清單」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fatigue hot-spot checklist” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前完成一次基準檢查：箱內熱點逐一目視與磁粉檢測、重車道肋—面板焊縫以超音波抽查、鋪面裂縫圖與照片；之後的檢查週期依裂縫成長計算與實際交通量設定，每次結果與基準比較，新裂縫須記錄位置、長度與方向。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover complete a baseline inspection: every hot spot inside the box checked visually and by magnetic particle, heavy-lane rib-to-deck welds sampled by ultrasonics, and the surfacing crack map photographed; set later intervals from crack-growth calculations and actual traffic, compare every result with the baseline, and record the position, length and direction of any new crack. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含關鍵細部清單與疲勞計算、焊接與檢測紀錄、節段幾何報告、鋪面系統資料、箱內通行與照明配置及檢查週期；重車道交通量顯著增加時，管理單位應通知結構顧問重新評估檢查週期。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should contain the key-detail list and fatigue calculations, welding and inspection records, segment geometry reports, surfacing data, box access and lighting layout and inspection intervals; if heavy-lane traffic rises markedly, the owner should ask the structural consultant to re-evaluate the intervals.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沒有熱點清單與基準資料，檢查人員在箱內只看塗裝與鏽蝕，面板根部裂縫持續成長，直到穿透面板使鋪面局部塌陷；修補時若只封填鋪面裂縫而不處理鋼板裂縫，問題會在下一個夏季重現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a hot-spot list and baseline, inspectors inside the box look only at coating and rust while root cracks keep growing until they penetrate the plate and the surfacing locally collapses; sealing the surfacing crack without repairing the steel crack brings the problem back the next summer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Before handover complete a baseline inspection: every hot spot inside the box checked visually and by magnetic particle, heavy-lane rib-to-deck welds sampled by ultrasonics, and the surfacing crack map photographed; set later intervals from crack-growth calculations and actual traffic, compare every result with the baseline, and record the position, length and direction of any new crack.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含關鍵細部清單與疲勞計算、焊接與檢測紀錄、節段幾何報告、鋪面系統資料、箱內通行與照明配置及檢查週期；重車道交通量顯著增加時，管理單位應通知結構顧問重新評估檢查週期。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents should contain the key-detail list and fatigue calculations, welding and inspection records, segment geometry reports, surfacing data, box access and lighting layout and inspection intervals; if heavy-lane traffic rises markedly, the owner should ask the structural consultant to re-evaluate the intervals.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover"?
options: 交接前完成一次基準檢查：箱內熱點逐一目視與磁粉檢測、重車道肋—面板焊縫以超音波抽查、鋪面裂縫圖與照片。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。
optionsEn: Before handover complete a baseline inspection: every hot spot inside the box checked visually and by magnetic particle, heavy-lane rib-to-deck welds sampled by ultrasonics, and the surfacing crack map photographed.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside.
quiz.explanation: 交接前完成一次基準檢查：箱內熱點逐一目視與磁粉檢測、重車道肋—面板焊縫以超音波抽查、鋪面裂縫圖與照片；之後的檢查週期依裂縫成長計算與實際交通量設定，每次結果與基準比較，新裂縫須記錄位置、長度與方向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover complete a baseline inspection: every hot spot inside the box checked visually and by magnetic particle, heavy-lane rib-to-deck welds sampled by ultrasonics, and the surfacing crack map photographed; set later intervals from crack-growth calculations and actual traffic, compare every result with the baseline, and record the position, length and direction of any new crack. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「疲勞熱點檢查清單」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fatigue hot-spot checklist” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沒有熱點清單與基準資料，檢查人員在箱內只看塗裝與鏽蝕，面板根部裂縫持續成長，直到穿透面板使鋪面局部塌陷；修補時若只封填鋪面裂縫而不處理鋼板裂縫，問題會在下一個夏季重現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a hot-spot list and baseline, inspectors inside the box look only at coating and rust while root cracks keep growing until they penetrate the plate and the surfacing locally collapses; sealing the surfacing crack without repairing the steel crack brings the problem back the next summer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此交接時必須提供以熱點為主的檢查清單、箱內通行路線、可用的超音波檢測方法，以及依裂縫成長速度訂定的檢查週期；修復可用止裂孔、螺栓補強板或橋面加鋪高性能混凝土層。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover must therefore supply a hot-spot inspection checklist, access routes inside the box, suitable ultrasonic methods and inspection intervals based on crack-growth rates; repairs include stop holes, bolted doubler plates or an overlay of high-performance concrete on the deck.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沒有熱點清單與基準資料，檢查人員在箱內只看塗裝與鏽蝕，面板根部裂縫持續成長，直到穿透面板使鋪面局部塌陷；修補時若只封填鋪面裂縫而不處理鋼板裂縫，問題會在下一個夏季重現。
knowledge.textEn: Without a hot-spot list and baseline, inspectors inside the box look only at coating and rust while root cracks keep growing until they penetrate the plate and the surfacing locally collapses; sealing the surfacing crack without repairing the steel crack brings the problem back the next summer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
沒有熱點清單與基準資料，檢查人員在箱內只看塗裝與鏽蝕，面板根部裂縫持續成長，直到穿透面板使鋪面局部塌陷。
鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without a hot-spot list and baseline, inspectors inside the box look only at coating and rust while root cracks keep growing until they penetrate the plate and the surfacing locally collapses.
A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough.
quiz.explanation: 沒有熱點清單與基準資料，檢查人員在箱內只看塗裝與鏽蝕，面板根部裂縫持續成長，直到穿透面板使鋪面局部塌陷；修補時若只封填鋪面裂縫而不處理鋼板裂縫，問題會在下一個夏季重現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without a hot-spot list and baseline, inspectors inside the box look only at coating and rust while root cracks keep growing until they penetrate the plate and the surfacing locally collapses; sealing the surfacing crack without repairing the steel crack brings the problem back the next summer. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 自行式模組運輸車換橋
courses.summary: 從整跨上部結構改由運輸車支承時的彎矩反轉出發，計算動態放大、軸線數量、臨時支撐塔穩定與行駛路徑地盤承載，再處理封閉時段時程、落梁行程與支承對位、移動中的應變與水平監測、地盤預壓試驗，最後檢核既有下部結構、評估用路人成本並交接，案例取自 FHWA 手冊中的佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue、荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 與芝加哥 Wells Street 換橋。
courses.summaryEn: Starting from the moment reversal when a whole span is carried by transporters, compute dynamic allowance, axle-line count, temporary-tower stability and travel-path bearing, then handle the closure timeline, set-down stroke and bearing alignment, strain and level monitoring during the move and ground proof testing, and finally check the existing substructure, evaluate user costs and hand over, with cases from the FHWA manual: Florida's I-4/Graves Avenue, the Netherlands' Badhoevedorp A4/A5 and Chicago's Wells Street replacements.
courses.focus: 以支承點改變、軸線容量、地盤承載與封閉時段控制，用自行式模組運輸車在數小時內移除舊橋並放上整跨新橋
courses.focusEn: Support-point changes, axle-line capacity, ground bearing and closure-window control that let SPMTs remove an old span and set a whole new one within hours
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一跨 40 m、總重 10,000 kN（w = 250 kN/m）的預力梁橋，以 SPMT 運輸，比較運輸支點內縮距離 a。a = 3.0 m：跨中彎矩 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m，梁端負彎矩含 15% 動態放大 1.15×250×3²/2 ≈ 1,294 kN·m；a = 4.5 m：跨中 250×31²/8 − 250×4.5²/2 = 27,500 kN·m，梁端 1.15×250×4.5²/2 ≈ 2,911 kN·m；a = 6.0 m：跨中 20,000 kN·m，梁端 ≈ 5,175 kN·m。若梁端頂緣容許的附加負彎矩上限為 3,000 kN·m，則 a ≤ √[2×3,000/(1.15×250)] ≈ 4.57 m，取 a = 4.5 m 以內。軸線數量以 (10,000 + 1,000)×1.15/235 ≈ 54 軸線、利用率 80% 時約 68 軸線計，選 72 軸線。若橋重因加裝護欄增加 5%，所需軸線變為 54×1.05/0.8 ≈ 71，仍在 72 軸線內但餘裕幾乎用盡。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 40 m prestressed span weighing 10,000 kN (w = 250 kN/m) is moved by SPMT, comparing the support inset a. For a = 3.0 m, midspan moment is 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m and the end hogging moment with 15% dynamic allowance is 1.15×250×3²/2 ≈ 1,294 kN·m; for a = 4.5 m, midspan 250×31²/8 − 250×4.5²/2 = 27,500 kN·m and end 1.15×250×4.5²/2 ≈ 2,911 kN·m; for a = 6.0 m, midspan 20,000 kN·m and end about 5,175 kN·m. If the girder-end top fibre can accept at most 3,000 kN·m of added hogging, a ≤ √[2×3,000/(1.15×250)] ≈ 4.57 m, so a is kept within 4.5 m. Axle lines: (10,000 + 1,000)×1.15/235 ≈ 54, about 68 at 80% utilisation, so 72 are chosen. If barriers add 5% to the weight, the need becomes 54×1.05/0.8 ≈ 71, still within 72 but with almost no margin. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: FHWA 手冊：SPMT 每軸線最大承載約 26 至 33 美噸（24 至 30 公噸），依車寬而定
每軸線最大接地壓力約每平方英尺 1,500 至 2,000 磅
載重行駛速度通常約 3 mph（4.8 km/h），可應付約 18 吋地面起伏與約 8% 坡度
可用液壓行程至少約 24 吋，作業宜假設 16 至 20 吋；動態放大至少 15% 自重
佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue（2006）新跨約 143 ft（43.5 m）、約 1,300 美噸，運到橋位約 30 分鐘
荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 兩跨橋長約 390 ft（118.8 m）、逾 3,600 美噸，以 134 軸線移動 2 小時
芝加哥 Wells Street 2002 年以 SPMT 在一個週末換上 111 ft、425 美噸的鋼桁架
法國 PRA 13 09 鐵路橋以約每分鐘 8 吋移動 146 ft，鐵路只封閉 48 小時
factsEn: FHWA manual: an SPMT axle line carries a maximum of about 26 to 33 US tons (24 to 30 t), depending on width
Each axle line exerts a maximum ground pressure of about 1,500 to 2,000 pounds per square foot
Loaded SPMTs typically travel at about 3 mph (4.8 km/h) and handle about 18 inch surface variations and about 8% grades
Available hydraulic stroke is at least about 24 inches, with 16 to 20 inches assumed in operations; dynamic allowance is at least 15% of dead load
Florida's I-4/Graves Avenue (2006) new spans were about 143 ft (43.5 m) and about 1,300 US tons, each driven to site in about 30 minutes
The Badhoevedorp A4/A5 two-span bridge, about 390 ft (118.8 m) and over 3,600 US tons, moved on 134 axle lines in 2 hours
Chicago's Wells Street bridge received a 111 ft, 425 US ton steel truss by SPMT over one weekend in 2002
France's PRA 13 09 railway bridge moved 146 ft at about 8 inches per minute with a rail closure of only 48 hours

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉」與「軸線數量、動態放大與三點支承」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support-point change and moment reversal during the move" and "Axle lines, dynamic allowance and three-point support": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Support-point change and moment reversal during the move: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」如何影響自行式模組運輸車換橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “SPMT support points and overhangs” governs force, deformation or durability in “SPMT bridge replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 以自行式模組運輸車（SPMT）換橋時，新橋整跨先在附近的預製區臨時支架上完成，再由運輸車從梁下頂起、開到橋位、降落到支承上；舊橋則以相反流程移走。運輸車的支承點通常位於梁端內側數公尺，而不是永久支承位置，所以運輸期間梁成為兩端外伸的簡支梁：跨中正彎矩略減，但梁端出現營運時不存在的負彎矩。預力梁端部頂緣在營運時本來就受預力拉應力，再加上外伸負彎矩，可能開裂，因此支承點位置必須由設計者決定，而不是由運輸商依車輛配置自行選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In an SPMT replacement, the new span is completed on temporary supports in a nearby staging area, lifted from below by self-propelled modular transporters, driven to site and lowered onto its bearings, while the old span is removed by the reverse process. The transporter support points usually lie a few metres inside the girder ends rather than at the permanent bearings, so during transport the girder becomes a simple beam with overhangs: midspan sagging moment drops slightly, but the ends see hogging moment that never occurs in service. At prestressed girder ends the top fibre already carries tension from prestress, and the overhang moment can crack it, so support positions must be set by the designer, not chosen by the transport contractor to suit the vehicle layout. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “SPMT support points and overhangs” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：跨長 40 m、總重 10,000 kN（w = 250 kN/m），運輸支點內縮 a = 3.0 m：支點間 34 m，跨中彎矩 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m（營運簡支為 wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m）；梁端負彎矩 250×3²/2 = 1,125 kN·m，乘以 15% 動態放大為 1,294 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 40 m span weighing 10,000 kN (w = 250 kN/m) carried at points a = 3.0 m inside the ends, the supports are 34 m apart and midspan moment is 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m versus wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m simply supported in service; the end hogging moment is 250×3²/2 = 1,125 kN·m, or 1,294 kN·m with a 15% dynamic allowance.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「運輸車在梁下任何位置頂起都可以，只要總重不超過車輛容量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Transporters may lift a span anywhere along its length as long as total weight is within capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “SPMT support points and overhangs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉
knowledge.titleEn: Support-point change and moment reversal during the move
knowledge.text: 以自行式模組運輸車（SPMT）換橋時，新橋整跨先在附近的預製區臨時支架上完成，再由運輸車從梁下頂起、開到橋位、降落到支承上；舊橋則以相反流程移走。運輸車的支承點通常位於梁端內側數公尺，而不是永久支承位置，所以運輸期間梁成為兩端外伸的簡支梁：跨中正彎矩略減，但梁端出現營運時不存在的負彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: In an SPMT replacement, the new span is completed on temporary supports in a nearby staging area, lifted from below by self-propelled modular transporters, driven to site and lowered onto its bearings, while the old span is removed by the reverse process. The transporter support points usually lie a few metres inside the girder ends rather than at the permanent bearings, so during transport the girder becomes a simple beam with overhangs: midspan sagging moment drops slightly, but the ends see hogging moment that never occurs in service.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：運輸車在梁下任何位置頂起都可以，只要總重不超過車輛容量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Transporters may lift a span anywhere along its length as long as total weight is within capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support-point change and moment reversal during the move" is correct?
options: 運輸車在梁下任何位置頂起都可以，只要總重不超過車輛容量。
以自行式模組運輸車（SPMT）換橋時，新橋整跨先在附近的預製區臨時支架上完成，再由運輸車從梁下頂起、開到橋位、降落到支承上；舊橋則以相反流程移走。
SPMT 軸線越多越安全，群組怎麼分都沒有差別。
optionsEn: Transporters may lift a span anywhere along its length as long as total weight is within capacity.

In an SPMT replacement, the new span is completed on temporary supports in a nearby staging area, lifted from below by self-propelled modular transporters, driven to site and lowered onto its bearings, while the old span is removed by the reverse process.
More axle lines always make the move safer, and how they are grouped makes no difference.
quiz.explanation: 以自行式模組運輸車（SPMT）換橋時，新橋整跨先在附近的預製區臨時支架上完成，再由運輸車從梁下頂起、開到橋位、降落到支承上；舊橋則以相反流程移走。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In an SPMT replacement, the new span is completed on temporary supports in a nearby staging area, lifted from below by self-propelled modular transporters, driven to site and lowered onto its bearings, while the old span is removed by the reverse process. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support-point change and moment reversal during the move: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “SPMT support points and overhangs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：跨長 40 m、總重 10,000 kN（w = 250 kN/m），運輸支點內縮 a = 3.0 m：支點間 34 m，跨中彎矩 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m（營運簡支為 wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m）；梁端負彎矩 250×3²/2 = 1,125 kN·m，乘以 15% 動態放大為 1,294 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 40 m span weighing 10,000 kN (w = 250 kN/m) carried at points a = 3.0 m inside the ends, the supports are 34 m apart and midspan moment is 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m versus wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m simply supported in service; the end hogging moment is 250×3²/2 = 1,125 kN·m, or 1,294 kN·m with a 15% dynamic allowance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計者以運輸支點位置、預力與自重建立運輸狀態模型，檢核梁端頂緣與跨中底緣在包含動態放大後的應力，並與規範施工期容許值比較；運輸商提交的車輛配置圖必須標示每一支承點座標，由設計者比對確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The designer models the transport state with the actual support positions, prestress and self-weight, checks girder-end top-fibre and midspan bottom-fibre stresses including the dynamic allowance against construction-stage limits, and confirms that the transporter's layout drawing shows the coordinates of every support point.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 跨長 40 m、總重 10,000 kN（w = 250 kN/m），運輸支點內縮 a = 3.0 m：支點間 34 m，跨中彎矩 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m（營運簡支為 wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m）；梁端負彎矩 250×3²/2 = 1,125 kN·m，乘以 15% 動態放大為 1,294 kN·m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 40 m span weighing 10,000 kN (w = 250 kN/m) carried at points a = 3.0 m inside the ends, the supports are 34 m apart and midspan moment is 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m versus wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m simply supported in service; the end hogging moment is 250×3²/2 = 1,125 kN·m, or 1,294 kN·m with a 15% dynamic allowance. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support-point change and moment reversal during the move", which statement holds?
options: SPMT 輪胎很多、接地壓力低，所以不需要檢查行駛路徑的地盤。
SPMT 的升降行程很大，落梁時不需要預先計算行程與撓度。
跨長 40 m、總重 10,000 kN（w = 250 kN/m），運輸支點內縮 a = 3.0 m：支點間 34 m，跨中彎矩 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m（營運簡支為 wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m）。
optionsEn: With so many tyres and low contact pressure, an SPMT route needs no ground checks.
SPMT lift range is so large that set-down needs no stroke or deflection calculation.

For a 40 m span weighing 10,000 kN (w = 250 kN/m) carried at points a = 3.0 m inside the ends, the supports are 34 m apart and midspan moment is 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m versus wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m simply supported in service.
quiz.explanation: 跨長 40 m、總重 10,000 kN（w = 250 kN/m），運輸支點內縮 a = 3.0 m：支點間 34 m，跨中彎矩 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m（營運簡支為 wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m）；梁端負彎矩 250×3²/2 = 1,125 kN·m，乘以 15% 動態放大為 1,294 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 40 m span weighing 10,000 kN (w = 250 kN/m) carried at points a = 3.0 m inside the ends, the supports are 34 m apart and midspan moment is 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m versus wL²/8 = 50,000 kN·m simply supported in service; the end hogging moment is 250×3²/2 = 1,125 kN·m, or 1,294 kN·m with a 15% dynamic allowance. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support-point change and moment reversal during the move: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “SPMT support points and overhangs” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計者以運輸支點位置、預力與自重建立運輸狀態模型，檢核梁端頂緣與跨中底緣在包含動態放大後的應力，並與規範施工期容許值比較；運輸商提交的車輛配置圖必須標示每一支承點座標，由設計者比對確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The designer models the transport state with the actual support positions, prestress and self-weight, checks girder-end top-fibre and midspan bottom-fibre stresses including the dynamic allowance against construction-stage limits, and confirms that the transporter's layout drawing shows the coordinates of every support point. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約圖說應明訂運輸與暫置期間的容許支承區域、最大外伸長度與動態放大假設，並要求承包商提送運輸階段計算，經設計單位審查同意後才可施作。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Contract drawings should define permitted support zones, maximum overhang and the dynamic allowance for transport and storage, and require the contractor to submit transport-stage calculations accepted by the designer before work.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：運輸商為了配合車輛長度把支點往內移，梁端外伸變長，預力梁端部頂緣在運輸中開裂；若支點落在沒有橫隔梁的位置，梁底局部承壓過大，造成翼板破損或鋼梁腹板局部挫屈。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A transport contractor moving support points inward to suit vehicle length lengthens the overhangs and cracks prestressed girder ends at the top during transport; supports placed away from diaphragms overload the soffit locally, breaking flanges or buckling steel webs. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計者以運輸支點位置、預力與自重建立運輸狀態模型，檢核梁端頂緣與跨中底緣在包含動態放大後的應力，並與規範施工期容許值比較；運輸商提交的車輛配置圖必須標示每一支承點座標，由設計者比對確認。
knowledge.textEn: The designer models the transport state with the actual support positions, prestress and self-weight, checks girder-end top-fibre and midspan bottom-fibre stresses including the dynamic allowance against construction-stage limits, and confirms that the transporter's layout drawing shows the coordinates of every support point.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約圖說應明訂運輸與暫置期間的容許支承區域、最大外伸長度與動態放大假設，並要求承包商提送運輸階段計算，經設計單位審查同意後才可施作。
knowledge.textEn: Contract drawings should define permitted support zones, maximum overhang and the dynamic allowance for transport and storage, and require the contractor to submit transport-stage calculations accepted by the designer before work.

quiz.question: 要驗證「換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support-point change and moment reversal during the move"?
options: 設計者以運輸支點位置、預力與自重建立運輸狀態模型，檢核梁端頂緣與跨中底緣在包含動態放大後的應力，並與規範施工期容許值比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
地質報告合格就代表行駛路徑一定能承受運輸荷載。
optionsEn: The designer models the transport state with the actual support positions, prestress and self-weight, checks girder-end top-fibre and midspan bottom-fibre stresses including the dynamic allowance against construction-stage limits, and confirms that the transporter's layout drawing shows the coordinates of every support point.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A satisfactory geotechnical report guarantees the route can take the transport load.
quiz.explanation: 設計者以運輸支點位置、預力與自重建立運輸狀態模型，檢核梁端頂緣與跨中底緣在包含動態放大後的應力，並與規範施工期容許值比較；運輸商提交的車輛配置圖必須標示每一支承點座標，由設計者比對確認。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The designer models the transport state with the actual support positions, prestress and self-weight, checks girder-end top-fibre and midspan bottom-fibre stresses including the dynamic allowance against construction-stage limits, and confirms that the transporter's layout drawing shows the coordinates of every support point. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support-point change and moment reversal during the move: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “SPMT support points and overhangs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 運輸商為了配合車輛長度把支點往內移，梁端外伸變長，預力梁端部頂緣在運輸中開裂；若支點落在沒有橫隔梁的位置，梁底局部承壓過大，造成翼板破損或鋼梁腹板局部挫屈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A transport contractor moving support points inward to suit vehicle length lengthens the overhangs and cracks prestressed girder ends at the top during transport; supports placed away from diaphragms overload the soffit locally, breaking flanges or buckling steel webs. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：預力梁端部頂緣在營運時本來就受預力拉應力，再加上外伸負彎矩，可能開裂，因此支承點位置必須由設計者決定，而不是由運輸商依車輛配置自行選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At prestressed girder ends the top fibre already carries tension from prestress, and the overhang moment can crack it, so support positions must be set by the designer, not chosen by the transport contractor to suit the vehicle layout.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「運輸車在梁下任何位置頂起都可以，只要總重不超過車輛容量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Transporters may lift a span anywhere along its length as long as total weight is within capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
