Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Set-down alignment, tide and draft change: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「落位導向與荷重轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Set-down guides and load transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一次放鉤到零，船體上浮又把吊鉤提起，構件在支撐上跳動，臨時支撐或支承受衝擊損壞；漲潮時未及時放鉤，吊索被拉緊，構件被拖離已對位的位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Releasing the hook to zero in one go lets the rising vessel lift it again so the member bounces on its supports, damaging temporary supports or bearings; failing to pay out on a rising tide tightens the slings and drags the member off its aligned position. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此落位要分級進行，每一級都確認構件已穩定坐上支撐、臨時固定完成，才逐步釋放吊鉤荷重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Set-down therefore proceeds in stages, each confirming that the member sits stably on its supports and is temporarily secured before more hook load is released.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浮吊落位與陸上起重機一樣，只要把吊鉤慢慢放下即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Setting down with a floating crane is just like a land crane: lower the hook slowly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一次放鉤到零，船體上浮又把吊鉤提起，構件在支撐上跳動，臨時支撐或支承受衝擊損壞；漲潮時未及時放鉤，吊索被拉緊，構件被拖離已對位的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Releasing the hook to zero in one go lets the rising vessel lift it again so the member bounces on its supports, damaging temporary supports or bearings; failing to pay out on a rising tide tightens the slings and drags the member off its aligned position.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Set-down alignment, tide and draft change" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 一次放鉤到零，船體上浮又把吊鉤提起，構件在支撐上跳動，臨時支撐或支承受衝擊損壞；漲潮時未及時放鉤，吊索被拉緊，構件被拖離已對位的位置。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。
optionsEn: Releasing the hook to zero in one go lets the rising vessel lift it again so the member bounces on its supports, damaging temporary supports or bearings.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift.
quiz.explanation: 一次放鉤到零，船體上浮又把吊鉤提起，構件在支撐上跳動，臨時支撐或支承受衝擊損壞；漲潮時未及時放鉤，吊索被拉緊，構件被拖離已對位的位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Releasing the hook to zero in one go lets the rising vessel lift it again so the member bounces on its supports, damaging temporary supports or bearings; failing to pay out on a rising tide tightens the slings and drags the member off its aligned position. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吊重與重心的量測驗證」與「天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity" and "Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吊重與重心的量測驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊鉤荷重計」如何影響浮吊大型橋段吊裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hook load cells” governs force, deformation or durability in “Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 吊裝計算的起點是構件重量與重心，但混凝土單位重、鋼筋量、預埋件、殘留模板與積水都會使實際重量偏離計算值。因此大型吊裝會在吊鉤或各吊索上安裝荷重計，頂離支架後先暫停，量測總重與各點分配，反算重心位置；若與計算差異超出預留的重量裕度，必須停止並重新評估吊具與起重機利用率。量得的數據也回饋給後續相同構件的吊裝計畫。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊鉤荷重計」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lift calculations start from member weight and centre of gravity, but concrete unit weight, reinforcement, embedments, leftover formwork and trapped water all move the real weight away from calculation. Major lifts therefore fit load cells on the hook or each sling, pause just after lift-off, measure total weight and its distribution and back-calculate the centre of gravity; if the difference exceeds the weight contingency, the lift stops and rigging and crane utilisation are re-evaluated. The data also feed back into the plans for later identical members. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hook load cells” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩組吊點相距 20 m，量得 R₁ = 7,800 kN、R₂ = 7,200 kN，總重 15,000 kN，重心距第一組 x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m；設計值 10.0 m，偏差 0.4 m，構件吊起後會向第一組一側傾斜，須調整吊索長度或吊點。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With two lift-point groups 20 m apart reading R₁ = 7,800 kN and R₂ = 7,200 kN, the total is 15,000 kN and the centre of gravity lies x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m from the first group; against a design value of 10.0 m, the 0.4 m offset will tilt the hanging member towards the first group, so sling lengths or lift points must be adjusted.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊鉤荷重計」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hook load cells”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊重與重心的量測驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity
knowledge.text: 吊裝計算的起點是構件重量與重心，但混凝土單位重、鋼筋量、預埋件、殘留模板與積水都會使實際重量偏離計算值。因此大型吊裝會在吊鉤或各吊索上安裝荷重計，頂離支架後先暫停，量測總重與各點分配，反算重心位置；若與計算差異超出預留的重量裕度，必須停止並重新評估吊具與起重機利用率。
knowledge.textEn: Lift calculations start from member weight and centre of gravity, but concrete unit weight, reinforcement, embedments, leftover formwork and trapped water all move the real weight away from calculation. Major lifts therefore fit load cells on the hook or each sling, pause just after lift-off, measure total weight and its distribution and back-calculate the centre of gravity; if the difference exceeds the weight contingency, the lift stops and rigging and crane utilisation are re-evaluated.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊重與重心的量測驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity" is correct?
options: 構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。
吊裝計算的起點是構件重量與重心，但混凝土單位重、鋼筋量、預埋件、殘留模板與積水都會使實際重量偏離計算值。
只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。
optionsEn: Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift.

Lift calculations start from member weight and centre of gravity, but concrete unit weight, reinforcement, embedments, leftover formwork and trapped water all move the real weight away from calculation.
If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝計算的起點是構件重量與重心，但混凝土單位重、鋼筋量、預埋件、殘留模板與積水都會使實際重量偏離計算值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lift calculations start from member weight and centre of gravity, but concrete unit weight, reinforcement, embedments, leftover formwork and trapped water all move the real weight away from calculation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊重與重心的量測驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊鉤荷重計」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hook load cells” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩組吊點相距 20 m，量得 R₁ = 7,800 kN、R₂ = 7,200 kN，總重 15,000 kN，重心距第一組 x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m；設計值 10.0 m，偏差 0.4 m，構件吊起後會向第一組一側傾斜，須調整吊索長度或吊點。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With two lift-point groups 20 m apart reading R₁ = 7,800 kN and R₂ = 7,200 kN, the total is 15,000 kN and the centre of gravity lies x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m from the first group; against a design value of 10.0 m, the 0.4 m offset will tilt the hanging member towards the first group, so sling lengths or lift points must be adjusted. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：荷重計須有有效校正並在吊裝前歸零；頂離支架約 100 至 200 mm 後保持數分鐘，記錄穩定讀值並與計算重量、重心比較，差異在預設範圍內才續吊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Load cells need valid calibration and are zeroed before the lift; after raising the member about 100 to 200 mm off its supports, hold for a few minutes, record steady readings and compare with calculated weight and centre of gravity, continuing only if differences are within the preset range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩組吊點相距 20 m，量得 R₁ = 7,800 kN、R₂ = 7,200 kN，總重 15,000 kN，重心距第一組 x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m；設計值 10.0 m，偏差 0.4 m，構件吊起後會向第一組一側傾斜，須調整吊索長度或吊點。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With two lift-point groups 20 m apart reading R₁ = 7,800 kN and R₂ = 7,200 kN, the total is 15,000 kN and the centre of gravity lies x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m from the first group; against a design value of 10.0 m, the 0.4 m offset will tilt the hanging member towards the first group, so sling lengths or lift points must be adjusted. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊重與重心的量測驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity", which statement holds?
options: 吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。
浮吊吊裝只要風小就可以進行，波浪對吊物影響不大。
optionsEn: A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure.
A floating-crane lift can proceed whenever wind is light; waves hardly affect the load.
With two lift-point groups 20 m apart reading R₁ = 7,800 kN and R₂ = 7,200 kN, the total is 15,000 kN and the centre of gravity lies x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m from the first group.
quiz.explanation: 兩組吊點相距 20 m，量得 R₁ = 7,800 kN、R₂ = 7,200 kN，總重 15,000 kN，重心距第一組 x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m；設計值 10.0 m，偏差 0.4 m，構件吊起後會向第一組一側傾斜，須調整吊索長度或吊點。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With two lift-point groups 20 m apart reading R₁ = 7,800 kN and R₂ = 7,200 kN, the total is 15,000 kN and the centre of gravity lies x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m from the first group; against a design value of 10.0 m, the 0.4 m offset will tilt the hanging member towards the first group, so sling lengths or lift points must be adjusted. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊重與重心的量測驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊鉤荷重計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hook load cells” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 荷重計須有有效校正並在吊裝前歸零；頂離支架約 100 至 200 mm 後保持數分鐘，記錄穩定讀值並與計算重量、重心比較，差異在預設範圍內才續吊。量測結果附於吊裝紀錄，並更新同型構件的重量資料庫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Load cells need valid calibration and are zeroed before the lift; after raising the member about 100 to 200 mm off its supports, hold for a few minutes, record steady readings and compare with calculated weight and centre of gravity, continuing only if differences are within the preset range. Results are attached to the lift record and update the weight database for similar members. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝計畫應訂定重量裕度（例如 5%）與重心容許偏差，並規定頂離暫停量測為必要步驟；吊裝前清除構件上的雜物與積水並由專人檢查簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lift plan should set a weight contingency, for example 5%, and a centre-of-gravity tolerance, and make the lift-off pause and measurement mandatory; before lifting, debris and water are removed from the member and checked and signed off by a designated person.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：構件內殘留模板與積水使實際重量比計算多數個百分點，起重機在最大工作半徑下超載警報，吊物已離開駁船無法安全放回；重心偏移未發現，構件在空中傾斜並撞擊吊臂或駁船結構。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Leftover formwork and trapped water make the member several percent heavier than calculated, the crane's overload alarm sounds at maximum radius with the load already off the barge and no safe place to set it back; an undetected centre-of-gravity offset tilts the member in the air into the boom or barge structure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 荷重計須有有效校正並在吊裝前歸零；頂離支架約 100 至 200 mm 後保持數分鐘，記錄穩定讀值並與計算重量、重心比較，差異在預設範圍內才續吊。量測結果附於吊裝紀錄，並更新同型構件的重量資料庫。
knowledge.textEn: Load cells need valid calibration and are zeroed before the lift; after raising the member about 100 to 200 mm off its supports, hold for a few minutes, record steady readings and compare with calculated weight and centre of gravity, continuing only if differences are within the preset range. Results are attached to the lift record and update the weight database for similar members.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊裝計畫應訂定重量裕度（例如 5%）與重心容許偏差，並規定頂離暫停量測為必要步驟；吊裝前清除構件上的雜物與積水並由專人檢查簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The lift plan should set a weight contingency, for example 5%, and a centre-of-gravity tolerance, and make the lift-off pause and measurement mandatory; before lifting, debris and water are removed from the member and checked and signed off by a designated person.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊重與重心的量測驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity"?
options: 荷重計須有有效校正並在吊裝前歸零；頂離支架約 100 至 200 mm 後保持數分鐘，記錄穩定讀值並與計算重量、重心比較，差異在預設範圍內才續吊。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
構件能承受營運荷載，就一定能承受自己的吊裝狀態。
optionsEn: Load cells need valid calibration and are zeroed before the lift.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A member that can carry service loads can always carry its own lifting state.
quiz.explanation: 荷重計須有有效校正並在吊裝前歸零；頂離支架約 100 至 200 mm 後保持數分鐘，記錄穩定讀值並與計算重量、重心比較，差異在預設範圍內才續吊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Load cells need valid calibration and are zeroed before the lift; after raising the member about 100 to 200 mm off its supports, hold for a few minutes, record steady readings and compare with calculated weight and centre of gravity, continuing only if differences are within the preset range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊重與重心的量測驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊鉤荷重計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hook load cells” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 構件內殘留模板與積水使實際重量比計算多數個百分點，起重機在最大工作半徑下超載警報，吊物已離開駁船無法安全放回；重心偏移未發現，構件在空中傾斜並撞擊吊臂或駁船結構。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Leftover formwork and trapped water make the member several percent heavier than calculated, the crane's overload alarm sounds at maximum radius with the load already off the barge and no safe place to set it back; an undetected centre-of-gravity offset tilts the member in the air into the boom or barge structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量得的數據也回饋給後續相同構件的吊裝計畫。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The data also feed back into the plans for later identical members.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 構件內殘留模板與積水使實際重量比計算多數個百分點，起重機在最大工作半徑下超載警報，吊物已離開駁船無法安全放回；重心偏移未發現，構件在空中傾斜並撞擊吊臂或駁船結構。
knowledge.textEn: Leftover formwork and trapped water make the member several percent heavier than calculated, the crane's overload alarm sounds at maximum radius with the load already off the barge and no safe place to set it back; an undetected centre-of-gravity offset tilts the member in the air into the boom or barge structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊重與重心的量測驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
構件內殘留模板與積水使實際重量比計算多數個百分點，起重機在最大工作半徑下超載警報，吊物已離開駁船無法安全放回。
只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Leftover formwork and trapped water make the member several percent heavier than calculated, the crane's overload alarm sounds at maximum radius with the load already off the barge and no safe place to set it back.
If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe.
quiz.explanation: 構件內殘留模板與積水使實際重量比計算多數個百分點，起重機在最大工作半徑下超載警報，吊物已離開駁船無法安全放回；重心偏移未發現，構件在空中傾斜並撞擊吊臂或駁船結構。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Leftover formwork and trapped water make the member several percent heavier than calculated, the crane's overload alarm sounds at maximum radius with the load already off the barge and no safe place to set it back; an undetected centre-of-gravity offset tilts the member in the air into the boom or barge structure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「天候窗口與預報係數」如何影響浮吊大型橋段吊裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weather window and forecast factor” governs force, deformation or durability in “Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 浮吊吊裝是一次不能中途隨意中斷的作業：吊物一旦離開駁船，就必須完成落位與臨時固定。因此決定是否開始，要看整個作業期間（含應變時間）的天候預報，而不是開始時的天氣。海事作業標準以作業限值乘上小於 1 的預報係數，作為預報值的上限，來涵蓋預報誤差；同時要把地面或海面 10 m 的風速換算到吊臂高度，因為高處風速較大，吊物與吊臂承受的風力也較大。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「天候窗口與預報係數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A floating-crane lift cannot be stopped casually halfway: once the load leaves the barge, set-down and temporary fixing must be completed. Whether to start therefore depends on the forecast for the whole operation including contingency time, not the weather at the start. Marine-operation standards multiply the operational limit by a forecast factor below 1 to set the maximum acceptable forecast value, covering forecast error; the 10 m wind speed must also be converted to boom height, where it is stronger and loads the boom and suspended member more. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Weather window and forecast factor” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風速剖面 V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wind profile V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「天候窗口與預報係數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Weather window and forecast factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值
knowledge.titleEn: Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits
knowledge.text: 浮吊吊裝是一次不能中途隨意中斷的作業：吊物一旦離開駁船，就必須完成落位與臨時固定。因此決定是否開始，要看整個作業期間（含應變時間）的天候預報，而不是開始時的天氣。
knowledge.textEn: A floating-crane lift cannot be stopped casually halfway: once the load leaves the barge, set-down and temporary fixing must be completed. Whether to start therefore depends on the forecast for the whole operation including contingency time, not the weather at the start.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits" is correct?
options: 只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。
吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。
浮吊吊裝是一次不能中途隨意中斷的作業：吊物一旦離開駁船，就必須完成落位與臨時固定。
optionsEn: If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe.
Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them.
A floating-crane lift cannot be stopped casually halfway: once the load leaves the barge, set-down and temporary fixing must be completed.
quiz.explanation: 浮吊吊裝是一次不能中途隨意中斷的作業：吊物一旦離開駁船，就必須完成落位與臨時固定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A floating-crane lift cannot be stopped casually halfway: once the load leaves the barge, set-down and temporary fixing must be completed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「天候窗口與預報係數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weather window and forecast factor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風速剖面 V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11。V₁₀ = 10 m/s 時，90 m 吊臂高度 V₉₀ ≈ 10×9^0.11 ≈ 12.7 m/s。若起重機在吊臂高度的作業限值 15 m/s、預報係數 0.8，預報值須 ≤ 12 m/s，換算回 10 m 高度約 12/1.27 ≈ 9.4 m/s。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind profile V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11. For V₁₀ = 10 m/s, the speed at a 90 m boom height is V₉₀ ≈ 10×9^0.11 ≈ 12.7 m/s. With a crane limit of 15 m/s at boom height and a forecast factor of 0.8, the forecast must not exceed 12 m/s, about 12/1.27 ≈ 9.4 m/s at 10 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：作業前訂定計畫作業時間與應變時間，取得涵蓋整段時間的專業海象氣象預報；作業前會議確認預報值在折減後的限值內，作業中以吊臂頂與船上的風速計、波浪資料持續監測，接近限值即啟動預先規劃的中止或安全放置方案。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the lift, define the planned operation time and contingency, obtain a specialist marine forecast covering the whole period, and confirm at the pre-lift meeting that forecasts are within the reduced limits; during the lift monitor boom-tip and deck anemometers and wave data continuously, triggering the pre-planned abort or safe-set-down option near the limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 風速剖面 V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11。V₁₀ = 10 m/s 時，90 m 吊臂高度 V₉₀ ≈ 10×9^0.11 ≈ 12.7 m/s。若起重機在吊臂高度的作業限值 15 m/s、預報係數 0.8，預報值須 ≤ 12 m/s，換算回 10 m 高度約 12/1.27 ≈ 9.4 m/s。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Wind profile V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11. For V₁₀ = 10 m/s, the speed at a 90 m boom height is V₉₀ ≈ 10×9^0.11 ≈ 12.7 m/s. With a crane limit of 15 m/s at boom height and a forecast factor of 0.8, the forecast must not exceed 12 m/s, about 12/1.27 ≈ 9.4 m/s at 10 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits", which statement holds?
options: 風速剖面 V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11。
只要吊索總容量大於構件重量，吊索角度與長度就無關緊要。
吊耳只在吊裝時用幾小時，設計可以比永久構件寬鬆。
optionsEn: Wind profile V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11.
As long as total sling capacity exceeds member weight, sling angles and lengths do not matter.
Lugs are used for only a few hours, so they can be designed less strictly than permanent members.
quiz.explanation: 風速剖面 V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wind profile V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「天候窗口與預報係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weather window and forecast factor” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 作業前訂定計畫作業時間與應變時間，取得涵蓋整段時間的專業海象氣象預報；作業前會議確認預報值在折減後的限值內，作業中以吊臂頂與船上的風速計、波浪資料持續監測，接近限值即啟動預先規劃的中止或安全放置方案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the lift, define the planned operation time and contingency, obtain a specialist marine forecast covering the whole period, and confirm at the pre-lift meeting that forecasts are within the reduced limits; during the lift monitor boom-tip and deck anemometers and wave data continuously, triggering the pre-planned abort or safe-set-down option near the limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝的開始決定是停留點：由吊裝總指揮、船長、海事保證檢驗員與業主代表依預報與限值共同簽認；中止條件與吊物安全放置位置事先規劃，不在現場臨時決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The decision to start is a hold point signed jointly by the lift director, master, marine warranty surveyor and owner's representative against forecasts and limits; abort criteria and safe set-down locations are planned beforehand, not improvised on site.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只依開始時的好天氣起吊，未考慮下午鋒面接近，吊物在空中時風速超過限值，只能冒險落位或吊著等待；以地面風速判斷而忽略吊臂高度的風，吊物旋轉失控。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lifting on a fine morning without regard to an approaching afternoon front leaves the load in the air when wind exceeds the limit, forcing a risky set-down or a hanging wait; judging by ground-level wind and ignoring wind at boom height lets the load spin out of control. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 吊裝的開始決定是停留點：由吊裝總指揮、船長、海事保證檢驗員與業主代表依預報與限值共同簽認；中止條件與吊物安全放置位置事先規劃，不在現場臨時決定。

quiz.question: 要驗證「天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits"?

作業前訂定計畫作業時間與應變時間，取得涵蓋整段時間的專業海象氣象預報。
浮吊很重，水流不可能推動它，所以不必特別錨泊。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Before the lift, define the planned operation time and contingency, obtain a specialist marine forecast covering the whole period, and confirm at the pre-lift meeting that forecasts are within the reduced limits.
A floating crane is so heavy that current cannot move it, so special mooring is unnecessary.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「天候窗口與預報係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weather window and forecast factor” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只依開始時的好天氣起吊，未考慮下午鋒面接近，吊物在空中時風速超過限值，只能冒險落位或吊著等待；以地面風速判斷而忽略吊臂高度的風，吊物旋轉失控。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lifting on a fine morning without regard to an approaching afternoon front leaves the load in the air when wind exceeds the limit, forcing a risky set-down or a hanging wait; judging by ground-level wind and ignoring wind at boom height lets the load spin out of control. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：海事作業標準以作業限值乘上小於 1 的預報係數，作為預報值的上限，來涵蓋預報誤差；同時要把地面或海面 10 m 的風速換算到吊臂高度，因為高處風速較大，吊物與吊臂承受的風力也較大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Marine-operation standards multiply the operational limit by a forecast factor below 1 to set the maximum acceptable forecast value, covering forecast error; the 10 m wind speed must also be converted to boom height, where it is stronger and loads the boom and suspended member more.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只依開始時的好天氣起吊，未考慮下午鋒面接近，吊物在空中時風速超過限值，只能冒險落位或吊著等待；以地面風速判斷而忽略吊臂高度的風，吊物旋轉失控。
knowledge.textEn: Lifting on a fine morning without regard to an approaching afternoon front leaves the load in the air when wind exceeds the limit, forcing a risky set-down or a hanging wait; judging by ground-level wind and ignoring wind at boom height lets the load spin out of control.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。
只依開始時的好天氣起吊，未考慮下午鋒面接近，吊物在空中時風速超過限值，只能冒險落位或吊著等待；以地面風速判斷而忽略吊臂高度的風，吊物旋轉失控。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them.
Lifting on a fine morning without regard to an approaching afternoon front leaves the load in the air when wind exceeds the limit, forcing a risky set-down or a hanging wait.
quiz.explanation: 只依開始時的好天氣起吊，未考慮下午鋒面接近，吊物在空中時風速超過限值，只能冒險落位或吊著等待；以地面風速判斷而忽略吊臂高度的風，吊物旋轉失控。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lifting on a fine morning without regard to an approaching afternoon front leaves the load in the air when wind exceeds the limit, forcing a risky set-down or a hanging wait; judging by ground-level wind and ignoring wind at boom height lets the load spin out of control. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久」與「吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Marine durability of lifting holes and joints" and "Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Marine durability of lifting holes and joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊孔封填與保護層」如何影響浮吊大型橋段吊裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lifting-hole sealing and cover” governs force, deformation or durability in “Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土構件為了吊裝而留下的貫穿孔、預埋吊具凹槽與臨時預力錨座，在吊裝後都要封填。這些位置常位於海水噴濺區，若封填材料的緻密度低於母體混凝土，或與母體界面脫開，氯離子會更快到達鋼筋。聯邦大橋這類冰海環境中的橋梁，還要承受凍融與冰撞。耐久設計因此必須把吊裝細部當作永久構件的一部分，規定封填材料、表面處理與檢查方法。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊孔封填與保護層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Through-holes, recesses for cast-in lifting devices and temporary prestressing anchors left in concrete members by the lift must all be sealed afterwards. They often lie in the splash zone, and if the filling is less dense than the parent concrete or debonds from it, chlorides reach the reinforcement sooner. Bridges in icy seas such as Confederation Bridge also face freeze–thaw and ice impact. Durability design must therefore treat lifting details as part of the permanent member, specifying filling materials, surface preparation and inspection methods. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lifting-hole sealing and cover” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Fick 擴散 C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fick diffusion C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊孔封填與保護層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lifting-hole sealing and cover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久
knowledge.titleEn: Marine durability of lifting holes and joints
knowledge.text: 混凝土構件為了吊裝而留下的貫穿孔、預埋吊具凹槽與臨時預力錨座，在吊裝後都要封填。這些位置常位於海水噴濺區，若封填材料的緻密度低於母體混凝土，或與母體界面脫開，氯離子會更快到達鋼筋。
knowledge.textEn: Through-holes, recesses for cast-in lifting devices and temporary prestressing anchors left in concrete members by the lift must all be sealed afterwards. They often lie in the splash zone, and if the filling is less dense than the parent concrete or debonds from it, chlorides reach the reinforcement sooner.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Marine durability of lifting holes and joints" is correct?
options: 混凝土構件為了吊裝而留下的貫穿孔、預埋吊具凹槽與臨時預力錨座，在吊裝後都要封填。
吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。
吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。
optionsEn: Through-holes, recesses for cast-in lifting devices and temporary prestressing anchors left in concrete members by the lift must all be sealed afterwards.
Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them.
A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土構件為了吊裝而留下的貫穿孔、預埋吊具凹槽與臨時預力錨座，在吊裝後都要封填。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Through-holes, recesses for cast-in lifting devices and temporary prestressing anchors left in concrete members by the lift must all be sealed afterwards. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Marine durability of lifting holes and joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊孔封填與保護層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lifting-hole sealing and cover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Fick 擴散 C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]。以 C/C_s = 0.1 為鋼筋起鏽門檻時 x/(2√(Dt)) ≈ 1.163，t = [x/(2×1.163)]²/D。保護層 x = 75 mm：母體 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t ≈ 33 年；封填材料 D = 5×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t ≈ 6.6 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fick diffusion C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]. Taking C/C_s = 0.1 as the corrosion threshold gives x/(2√(Dt)) ≈ 1.163 and t = [x/(2×1.163)]²/D. For 75 mm cover, parent concrete with D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s reaches it in about 33 years, while a filling with D = 5×10⁻¹² m²/s does so in about 6.6 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：封填前檢查孔壁粗糙度與清潔，封填材料做擴散係數或電阻率試驗並與母體比較；封填後以敲擊與拉拔試驗確認黏結，並在交接時把每一處封填位置、材料與日期列表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before filling, check hole-surface roughness and cleanliness and test the filling's diffusion coefficient or resistivity against the parent concrete; afterwards confirm bond by sounding and pull-off tests, and tabulate every sealed location, material and date at handover.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Fick 擴散 C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]。以 C/C_s = 0.1 為鋼筋起鏽門檻時 x/(2√(Dt)) ≈ 1.163，t = [x/(2×1.163)]²/D。保護層 x = 75 mm：母體 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t ≈ 33 年；封填材料 D = 5×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t ≈ 6.6 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Fick diffusion C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]. Taking C/C_s = 0.1 as the corrosion threshold gives x/(2√(Dt)) ≈ 1.163 and t = [x/(2×1.163)]²/D. For 75 mm cover, parent concrete with D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s reaches it in about 33 years, while a filling with D = 5×10⁻¹² m²/s does so in about 6.6 years. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Marine durability of lifting holes and joints", which statement holds?
options: 浮吊吊裝只要風小就可以進行，波浪對吊物影響不大。
Fick 擴散 C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]。
構件能承受營運荷載，就一定能承受自己的吊裝狀態。
optionsEn: A floating-crane lift can proceed whenever wind is light; waves hardly affect the load.
Fick diffusion C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))].
A member that can carry service loads can always carry its own lifting state.
quiz.explanation: Fick 擴散 C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Fick diffusion C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Marine durability of lifting holes and joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊孔封填與保護層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lifting-hole sealing and cover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 封填前檢查孔壁粗糙度與清潔，封填材料做擴散係數或電阻率試驗並與母體比較；封填後以敲擊與拉拔試驗確認黏結，並在交接時把每一處封填位置、材料與日期列表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before filling, check hole-surface roughness and cleanliness and test the filling's diffusion coefficient or resistivity against the parent concrete; afterwards confirm bond by sounding and pull-off tests, and tabulate every sealed location, material and date at handover. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構件圖說應把吊孔封填列為永久細部，規定材料性能、施工方法與檢查頻率；封填作業屬檢驗停留點，完成並驗收後才可進行塗裝或防護層施工。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Member drawings should treat lifting-hole sealing as a permanent detail with specified material performance, method and inspection frequency; sealing is an inspection hold point, accepted before any coating or protective layer is applied.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：吊裝後以一般砂漿草率封填吊孔，數年後封填塊周圍出現鏽水與裂縫，鋼筋在吊點附近局部腐蝕；臨時預力錨座未封閉，鋼棒端部腐蝕並使周圍混凝土剝落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Filling lifting holes hastily with ordinary mortar lets rust stains and cracks appear around the patches within a few years, with local corrosion near the lift points; unsealed temporary prestress anchorages corrode at bar ends and spall the surrounding concrete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 封填前檢查孔壁粗糙度與清潔，封填材料做擴散係數或電阻率試驗並與母體比較；封填後以敲擊與拉拔試驗確認黏結，並在交接時把每一處封填位置、材料與日期列表。
knowledge.textEn: Before filling, check hole-surface roughness and cleanliness and test the filling's diffusion coefficient or resistivity against the parent concrete; afterwards confirm bond by sounding and pull-off tests, and tabulate every sealed location, material and date at handover.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 構件圖說應把吊孔封填列為永久細部，規定材料性能、施工方法與檢查頻率；封填作業屬檢驗停留點，完成並驗收後才可進行塗裝或防護層施工。
knowledge.textEn: Member drawings should treat lifting-hole sealing as a permanent detail with specified material performance, method and inspection frequency; sealing is an inspection hold point, accepted before any coating or protective layer is applied.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Marine durability of lifting holes and joints"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
浮吊落位與陸上起重機一樣，只要把吊鉤慢慢放下即可。
封填前檢查孔壁粗糙度與清潔，封填材料做擴散係數或電阻率試驗並與母體比較；封填後以敲擊與拉拔試驗確認黏結，並在交接時把每一處封填位置、材料與日期列表。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Setting down with a floating crane is just like a land crane: lower the hook slowly.
Before filling, check hole-surface roughness and cleanliness and test the filling's diffusion coefficient or resistivity against the parent concrete.
quiz.explanation: 封填前檢查孔壁粗糙度與清潔，封填材料做擴散係數或電阻率試驗並與母體比較；封填後以敲擊與拉拔試驗確認黏結，並在交接時把每一處封填位置、材料與日期列表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before filling, check hole-surface roughness and cleanliness and test the filling's diffusion coefficient or resistivity against the parent concrete; afterwards confirm bond by sounding and pull-off tests, and tabulate every sealed location, material and date at handover. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Marine durability of lifting holes and joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊孔封填與保護層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lifting-hole sealing and cover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 吊裝後以一般砂漿草率封填吊孔，數年後封填塊周圍出現鏽水與裂縫，鋼筋在吊點附近局部腐蝕；臨時預力錨座未封閉，鋼棒端部腐蝕並使周圍混凝土剝落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Filling lifting holes hastily with ordinary mortar lets rust stains and cracks appear around the patches within a few years, with local corrosion near the lift points; unsealed temporary prestress anchorages corrode at bar ends and spall the surrounding concrete. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：耐久設計因此必須把吊裝細部當作永久構件的一部分，規定封填材料、表面處理與檢查方法。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Durability design must therefore treat lifting details as part of the permanent member, specifying filling materials, surface preparation and inspection methods.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 吊裝後以一般砂漿草率封填吊孔，數年後封填塊周圍出現鏽水與裂縫，鋼筋在吊點附近局部腐蝕；臨時預力錨座未封閉，鋼棒端部腐蝕並使周圍混凝土剝落。
knowledge.textEn: Filling lifting holes hastily with ordinary mortar lets rust stains and cracks appear around the patches within a few years, with local corrosion near the lift points; unsealed temporary prestress anchorages corrode at bar ends and spall the surrounding concrete.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Marine durability of lifting holes and joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 吊裝後以一般砂漿草率封填吊孔，數年後封填塊周圍出現鏽水與裂縫，鋼筋在吊點附近局部腐蝕；臨時預力錨座未封閉，鋼棒端部腐蝕並使周圍混凝土剝落。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。
optionsEn: Filling lifting holes hastily with ordinary mortar lets rust stains and cracks appear around the patches within a few years, with local corrosion near the lift points.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝後以一般砂漿草率封填吊孔，數年後封填塊周圍出現鏽水與裂縫，鋼筋在吊點附近局部腐蝕；臨時預力錨座未封閉，鋼棒端部腐蝕並使周圍混凝土剝落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Filling lifting holes hastily with ordinary mortar lets rust stains and cracks appear around the patches within a few years, with local corrosion near the lift points; unsealed temporary prestress anchorages corrode at bar ends and spall the surrounding concrete. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」如何影響浮吊大型橋段吊裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lug removal and fatigue details” governs force, deformation or durability in “Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼構件上的吊耳在吊裝後通常要切除，但切除位置若留下殘根、切割缺口或焊縫未磨平，就等於在主梁受拉翼板上留下一個附加物細部，疲勞類別大幅下降。正確的做法是在離母材一段距離處切除，再磨平並做磁粉檢測；若吊耳位於低應力區且設計允許保留，也要確認其焊縫細部的疲勞類別。交接時應把每一個吊耳的位置、處理方式與檢測結果，以及吊裝紀錄（重量、重心、天候、荷重讀值）一併移交。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lugs on steel members are usually cut off after the lift, but a stub, gouge or unground weld left at the cut equals an attachment detail on a tension flange, sharply lowering its fatigue category. The correct method is to cut a short distance from the parent metal, grind flush and test by magnetic particle; if a lug in a low-stress zone may stay by design, its weld detail's fatigue category must still be confirmed. Handover should include every lug's position, treatment and test result, together with the lift records of weight, centre of gravity, weather and load readings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lug removal and fatigue details” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：S–N 曲線 m = 3 時壽命比 = (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With an m = 3 S–N curve, the life ratio is (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lug removal and fatigue details”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接
knowledge.titleEn: Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records
knowledge.text: 鋼構件上的吊耳在吊裝後通常要切除，但切除位置若留下殘根、切割缺口或焊縫未磨平，就等於在主梁受拉翼板上留下一個附加物細部，疲勞類別大幅下降。正確的做法是在離母材一段距離處切除，再磨平並做磁粉檢測；若吊耳位於低應力區且設計允許保留，也要確認其焊縫細部的疲勞類別。
knowledge.textEn: Lugs on steel members are usually cut off after the lift, but a stub, gouge or unground weld left at the cut equals an attachment detail on a tension flange, sharply lowering its fatigue category. The correct method is to cut a short distance from the parent metal, grind flush and test by magnetic particle; if a lug in a low-stress zone may stay by design, its weld detail's fatigue category must still be confirmed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records" is correct?
options: 吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。
鋼構件上的吊耳在吊裝後通常要切除，但切除位置若留下殘根、切割缺口或焊縫未磨平，就等於在主梁受拉翼板上留下一個附加物細部，疲勞類別大幅下降。
只要吊索總容量大於構件重量，吊索角度與長度就無關緊要。
optionsEn: A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure.
Lugs on steel members are usually cut off after the lift, but a stub, gouge or unground weld left at the cut equals an attachment detail on a tension flange, sharply lowering its fatigue category.
As long as total sling capacity exceeds member weight, sling angles and lengths do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 鋼構件上的吊耳在吊裝後通常要切除，但切除位置若留下殘根、切割缺口或焊縫未磨平，就等於在主梁受拉翼板上留下一個附加物細部，疲勞類別大幅下降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lugs on steel members are usually cut off after the lift, but a stub, gouge or unground weld left at the cut equals an attachment detail on a tension flange, sharply lowering its fatigue category. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lug removal and fatigue details” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：S–N 曲線 m = 3 時壽命比 = (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³。母材平滑板類別 160 MPa，若殘留附加物使類別降為 80 MPa，同一應力幅下壽命為 (80/160)³ = 1/8。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With an m = 3 S–N curve, the life ratio is (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³. A plain plate of category 160 MPa reduced to category 80 MPa by a remaining attachment has (80/160)³ = 1/8 of the life at the same stress range. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：切除吊耳後以目視與磁粉檢測確認無裂紋、表面已磨平且沒有咬邊，量測研磨後板厚不低於設計值；吊裝紀錄逐件整理，包括吊裝計畫版本、量測重量與重心、天候紀錄、落位量測與臨時固定檢查，由業主驗收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After lug removal, confirm by visual and magnetic-particle inspection that there are no cracks, the surface is ground flush without undercut, and measured plate thickness after grinding is not below design; compile lift records member by member, including plan revision, measured weight and centre of gravity, weather logs, set-down surveys and temporary-fixing inspections, accepted by the owner.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: S–N 曲線 m = 3 時壽命比 = (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³。母材平滑板類別 160 MPa，若殘留附加物使類別降為 80 MPa，同一應力幅下壽命為 (80/160)³ = 1/8。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With an m = 3 S–N curve, the life ratio is (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³. A plain plate of category 160 MPa reduced to category 80 MPa by a remaining attachment has (80/160)³ = 1/8 of the life at the same stress range. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records", which statement holds?
options: 吊耳只在吊裝時用幾小時，設計可以比永久構件寬鬆。
浮吊很重，水流不可能推動它，所以不必特別錨泊。
S–N 曲線 m = 3 時壽命比 = (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³。
optionsEn: Lugs are used for only a few hours, so they can be designed less strictly than permanent members.
A floating crane is so heavy that current cannot move it, so special mooring is unnecessary.
With an m = 3 S–N curve, the life ratio is (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³.
quiz.explanation: S–N 曲線 m = 3 時壽命比 = (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With an m = 3 S–N curve, the life ratio is (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lug removal and fatigue details” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 切除吊耳後以目視與磁粉檢測確認無裂紋、表面已磨平且沒有咬邊，量測研磨後板厚不低於設計值；吊裝紀錄逐件整理，包括吊裝計畫版本、量測重量與重心、天候紀錄、落位量測與臨時固定檢查，由業主驗收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After lug removal, confirm by visual and magnetic-particle inspection that there are no cracks, the surface is ground flush without undercut, and measured plate thickness after grinding is not below design; compile lift records member by member, including plan revision, measured weight and centre of gravity, weather logs, set-down surveys and temporary-fixing inspections, accepted by the owner. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含吊裝計畫與修訂紀錄、吊具與吊耳檢測報告、吊耳處理清單、量測與天候紀錄、封填紀錄，並標示需在首次定期檢查特別檢視的位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should include lift plans with revisions, rigging and lug test reports, the lug treatment list, measurement and weather logs and sealing records, and mark the locations to be examined closely at the first routine inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：吊耳以火焰切割後未研磨，受拉翼板上留下的缺口在數年交通荷載後成為疲勞裂縫起點；吊裝紀錄散失，日後檢查發現構件局部變形，無法判斷是吊裝衝擊還是營運造成。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A flame-cut lug left unground leaves a notch on a tension flange that becomes a fatigue crack origin after years of traffic; with lift records lost, local distortion found at a later inspection cannot be attributed to lifting impact or service. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 切除吊耳後以目視與磁粉檢測確認無裂紋、表面已磨平且沒有咬邊，量測研磨後板厚不低於設計值；吊裝紀錄逐件整理，包括吊裝計畫版本、量測重量與重心、天候紀錄、落位量測與臨時固定檢查，由業主驗收。
knowledge.textEn: After lug removal, confirm by visual and magnetic-particle inspection that there are no cracks, the surface is ground flush without undercut, and measured plate thickness after grinding is not below design; compile lift records member by member, including plan revision, measured weight and centre of gravity, weather logs, set-down surveys and temporary-fixing inspections, accepted by the owner.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含吊裝計畫與修訂紀錄、吊具與吊耳檢測報告、吊耳處理清單、量測與天候紀錄、封填紀錄，並標示需在首次定期檢查特別檢視的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents should include lift plans with revisions, rigging and lug test reports, the lug treatment list, measurement and weather logs and sealing records, and mark the locations to be examined closely at the first routine inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records"?
options: 切除吊耳後以目視與磁粉檢測確認無裂紋、表面已磨平且沒有咬邊，量測研磨後板厚不低於設計值。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。
optionsEn: After lug removal, confirm by visual and magnetic-particle inspection that there are no cracks, the surface is ground flush without undercut, and measured plate thickness after grinding is not below design.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift.
quiz.explanation: 切除吊耳後以目視與磁粉檢測確認無裂紋、表面已磨平且沒有咬邊，量測研磨後板厚不低於設計值；吊裝紀錄逐件整理，包括吊裝計畫版本、量測重量與重心、天候紀錄、落位量測與臨時固定檢查，由業主驗收。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After lug removal, confirm by visual and magnetic-particle inspection that there are no cracks, the surface is ground flush without undercut, and measured plate thickness after grinding is not below design; compile lift records member by member, including plan revision, measured weight and centre of gravity, weather logs, set-down surveys and temporary-fixing inspections, accepted by the owner. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lug removal and fatigue details” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 吊耳以火焰切割後未研磨，受拉翼板上留下的缺口在數年交通荷載後成為疲勞裂縫起點；吊裝紀錄散失，日後檢查發現構件局部變形，無法判斷是吊裝衝擊還是營運造成。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A flame-cut lug left unground leaves a notch on a tension flange that becomes a fatigue crack origin after years of traffic; with lift records lost, local distortion found at a later inspection cannot be attributed to lifting impact or service. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時應把每一個吊耳的位置、處理方式與檢測結果，以及吊裝紀錄（重量、重心、天候、荷重讀值）一併移交。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover should include every lug's position, treatment and test result, together with the lift records of weight, centre of gravity, weather and load readings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 吊耳以火焰切割後未研磨，受拉翼板上留下的缺口在數年交通荷載後成為疲勞裂縫起點；吊裝紀錄散失，日後檢查發現構件局部變形，無法判斷是吊裝衝擊還是營運造成。
knowledge.textEn: A flame-cut lug left unground leaves a notch on a tension flange that becomes a fatigue crack origin after years of traffic; with lift records lost, local distortion found at a later inspection cannot be attributed to lifting impact or service.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
吊耳以火焰切割後未研磨，受拉翼板上留下的缺口在數年交通荷載後成為疲勞裂縫起點；吊裝紀錄散失，日後檢查發現構件局部變形，無法判斷是吊裝衝擊還是營運造成。
只要吊索總容量大於構件重量，吊索角度與長度就無關緊要。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A flame-cut lug left unground leaves a notch on a tension flange that becomes a fatigue crack origin after years of traffic.
As long as total sling capacity exceeds member weight, sling angles and lengths do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 吊耳以火焰切割後未研磨，受拉翼板上留下的缺口在數年交通荷載後成為疲勞裂縫起點；吊裝紀錄散失，日後檢查發現構件局部變形，無法判斷是吊裝衝擊還是營運造成。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A flame-cut lug left unground leaves a notch on a tension flange that becomes a fatigue crack origin after years of traffic; with lift records lost, local distortion found at a later inspection cannot be attributed to lifting impact or service. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換
courses.summary: 從溫度、乾縮、潛變與活載造成的梁端位移出發，決定伸縮縫型式與間隙數，檢核中梁輪載衝擊與疲勞，再處理錨碇箱與後澆混凝土、安裝溫度預設、通車條件下的分幅更換、出廠疲勞與防水試驗、現場間隙—溫度量測，最後以止水排水維護與生命週期更換策略交接，並以新 Tappan Zee 橋的 LR18 模組式伸縮縫、Øresund 橋的旋轉橫梁伸縮縫更換與漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋伸縮縫翻修為案例。
courses.summaryEn: Starting from girder-end movements due to temperature, shrinkage, creep and live load, choose the joint type and number of gaps and check centre-beam wheel impact and fatigue, then handle anchorage boxes and blockout concrete, temperature presetting at installation, staged replacement under traffic, factory fatigue and watertightness tests and field gap–temperature measurements, and finally hand over with seal and drainage maintenance and a life-cycle replacement strategy, using the LR18 modular joints of the new Tappan Zee crossing, the swivel-joist joint replacement on the Øresund Bridge and the joint rehabilitation of Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge as cases.
courses.focus: 以伸縮量計算、安裝溫度預設、錨碇與疲勞細部控制，讓伸縮縫跟上橋梁變形並能在通車條件下更換
courses.focusEn: Movement calculation, temperature presetting, anchorage and fatigue detailing that let a joint follow the bridge's movements and be replaced under traffic
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 選型練習：一座鋼橋伸縮長度 480 m，α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C，結構溫度範圍 −5 至 +55°C（ΔT = 60°C）：溫度位移 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×60 ≈ 346 mm；加上活載轉角與煞車往復 ±20 mm 共 40 mm，合計約 386 mm。若模組式每間隙 80 mm，需 386/80 ≈ 4.8，取 5 個間隙（400 mm），中位開口 200 mm（每間隙 40 mm），參考溫度 25°C。安裝時結構溫度 35°C，梁較中位長 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×10 ≈ 58 mm，預設總開口 200 − 58 ≈ 142 mm，平均每間隙約 28.5 mm。若耐震要求另需容納 150 mm 地震位移，總需求約 536 mm，需 536/80 ≈ 6.7，取 7 個間隙；或改採在地震時允許犧牲、事後快速更換的設計，兩者須與業主的震後通行目標一起比較。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Selection exercise: a steel bridge has a 480 m expansion length, α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C and a structure temperature range of −5 to +55°C (ΔT = 60°C), so thermal movement is 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×60 ≈ 346 mm; adding ±20 mm, 40 mm in all, for live-load rotation and braking gives about 386 mm. At 80 mm per modular gap, 386/80 ≈ 4.8, so 5 gaps (400 mm) with a mid opening of 200 mm (40 mm per gap) at a 25°C reference. Installed at a structure temperature of 35°C, the girder is 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×10 ≈ 58 mm longer than at mid, so the preset total opening is 200 − 58 ≈ 142 mm, about 28.5 mm per gap. If seismic design also requires 150 mm of earthquake displacement, the demand becomes about 536 mm, needing 536/80 ≈ 6.7, so 7 gaps; alternatively a design that may be sacrificed in an earthquake and quickly replaced afterwards can be compared, together with the owner's post-earthquake access objective. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.
