factsEn: The Cypress Street Viaduct opened in 1957 and collapsed in the Loma Prieta earthquake on 17 October 1989, killing 42 people
Caltrans SDC 1.7 limits displacement ductility demand to μ_D ≤ 4 for single-column bents on fixed foundations and ≤ 5 for multi-column bents
The same criteria require each ductile member to have a local displacement ductility capacity μ_c of at least 3
Caltrans criteria use an expected yield strength of 68 ksi (475 MPa) for A706 reinforcement
Caltrans criteria limit column longitudinal steel to between 0.01 A_g and 0.04 A_g
Caltrans SDC 2.1 takes the overstrength moment as 120% of the idealised plastic moment
The PEER Structural Performance Database holds over 400 cyclic tests of reinforced concrete columns
The 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake (Mw 7.7) badly damaged about 102 major bridges in Taiwan
In the 1995 Kobe earthquake 10 spans of the Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route toppled at 3 locations
timeline: 1971　聖費爾南多地震暴露橋柱圍束與剪力不足，加州開始修訂橋梁耐震設計

timelineEn: 1971 — The San Fernando earthquake exposes inadequate column confinement and shear, and California begins revising bridge seismic design
1989 — The Cypress Street Viaduct collapses in the Loma Prieta earthquake, accelerating criteria built on capacity design
1995 — Several single-column elevated sections of the Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route topple in the Kobe earthquake
1996 — Japan revises the seismic part of its highway bridge specifications, strengthening ductility design and adding residual-displacement checks
1999 — Taiwan's Chi-Chi earthquake badly damages about 102 major bridges, driving code revision and retrofit of existing bridges

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「容量設計與破壞層級」與「位移需求與韌性限值」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Capacity design and failure hierarchy" and "Displacement demand and ductility limits": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 容量設計與破壞層級：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Capacity design and failure hierarchy: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「超強度彎矩 M_o」如何影響橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Overstrength moment M_o” governs force, deformation or durability in “Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 以彈性設計抵抗設計地震對橋墩並不經濟，因此規範允許橋墩以塑性變形消散能量，但必須事先決定「哪裡可以壞、怎麼壞」。容量設計把柱端彎曲塑鉸設為唯一的延性保險絲，其他構件（剪力、帽梁、基礎、梁柱接頭、支承與錨定）都以塑鉸可能達到的超強度彎矩來設計，確保它們保持彈性。這樣即使地震遠超預期，破壞仍以可預測、可修復的彎曲變形出現，而不是脆性剪斷或基礎破壞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「超強度彎矩 M_o」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Designing piers to stay elastic in the design earthquake is uneconomical, so codes allow piers to dissipate energy by yielding, but the designer must decide in advance where damage may occur and how. Capacity design makes the column-end flexural plastic hinge the only ductile fuse, and designs every other element (shear, cap beam, foundation, beam–column joint, bearings and anchorages) for the overstrength moment the hinge can develop, so that they stay elastic. Even in an earthquake far beyond expectation, damage then appears as predictable, repairable flexural deformation rather than brittle shear or foundation failure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Overstrength moment M_o” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2·M_p。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Overstrength moment M_o = 1.2·M_p.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「超強度彎矩 M_o」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Overstrength moment M_o”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 容量設計與破壞層級
knowledge.text: 以彈性設計抵抗設計地震對橋墩並不經濟，因此規範允許橋墩以塑性變形消散能量，但必須事先決定「哪裡可以壞、怎麼壞」。容量設計把柱端彎曲塑鉸設為唯一的延性保險絲，其他構件（剪力、帽梁、基礎、梁柱接頭、支承與錨定）都以塑鉸可能達到的超強度彎矩來設計，確保它們保持彈性。
knowledge.textEn: Designing piers to stay elastic in the design earthquake is uneconomical, so codes allow piers to dissipate energy by yielding, but the designer must decide in advance where damage may occur and how. Capacity design makes the column-end flexural plastic hinge the only ductile fuse, and designs every other element (shear, cap beam, foundation, beam–column joint, bearings and anchorages) for the overstrength moment the hinge can develop, so that they stay elastic.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「容量設計與破壞層級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Capacity design and failure hierarchy" is correct?
options: 橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。
以彈性設計抵抗設計地震對橋墩並不經濟，因此規範允許橋墩以塑性變形消散能量，但必須事先決定「哪裡可以壞、怎麼壞」。
只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。
optionsEn: The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety.
Designing piers to stay elastic in the design earthquake is uneconomical, so codes allow piers to dissipate energy by yielding, but the designer must decide in advance where damage may occur and how.
If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked.
quiz.explanation: 以彈性設計抵抗設計地震對橋墩並不經濟，因此規範允許橋墩以塑性變形消散能量，但必須事先決定「哪裡可以壞、怎麼壞」。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing piers to stay elastic in the design earthquake is uneconomical, so codes allow piers to dissipate energy by yielding, but the designer must decide in advance where damage may occur and how. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 容量設計與破壞層級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Capacity design and failure hierarchy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超強度彎矩 M_o」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Overstrength moment M_o” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2·M_p。M_p = 12 MN·m 時 M_o = 14.4 MN·m；懸臂高 L = 10 m 的單柱，對應剪力 V_o = M_o/L = 1.44 MN，基礎、帽梁與柱剪力都以此設計；若柱高只有 6 m，V_o 升為 2.4 MN。數值為教學假設，係數依所採規範。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Overstrength moment M_o = 1.2·M_p. For M_p = 12 MN·m, M_o = 14.4 MN·m; for a single cantilever column of height L = 10 m the corresponding shear is V_o = M_o/L = 1.44 MN, used to design foundation, cap beam and column shear; a 6 m column raises V_o to 2.4 MN. Values are teaching assumptions; the factor follows the governing code. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以彎矩—曲率分析求得柱的理想化塑性彎矩 M_p（採期望材料強度），乘以超強度係數後，逐一核對柱剪力、帽梁、基礎、樁與接頭的設計強度是否大於對應需求，並在計算書中列出完整的能力保護清單。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the column's idealised plastic moment M_p from moment–curvature analysis using expected material strengths, apply the overstrength factor, and check that the design strengths of column shear, cap beam, footing, piles and joints exceed the corresponding demands, listing the full capacity-protection table in the calculations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2·M_p。M_p = 12 MN·m 時 M_o = 14.4 MN·m；懸臂高 L = 10 m 的單柱，對應剪力 V_o = M_o/L = 1.44 MN，基礎、帽梁與柱剪力都以此設計；若柱高只有 6 m，V_o 升為 2.4 MN。數值為教學假設，係數依所採規範。
knowledge.textEn: Overstrength moment M_o = 1.2·M_p. For M_p = 12 MN·m, M_o = 14.4 MN·m; for a single cantilever column of height L = 10 m the corresponding shear is V_o = M_o/L = 1.44 MN, used to design foundation, cap beam and column shear; a 6 m column raises V_o to 2.4 MN. Values are teaching assumptions; the factor follows the governing code.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「容量設計與破壞層級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Capacity design and failure hierarchy", which statement holds?
options: 塑鉸長度就是柱底出現裂縫的長度，可以在現場直接量到。
只要續接器能承受鋼筋的降伏強度，就可以用在塑鉸區。
超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2·M_p。
optionsEn: The plastic-hinge length is simply the cracked length at the column base and can be measured on site.
Any coupler that develops the bar's yield strength can be used in a plastic hinge zone.
Overstrength moment M_o = 1.2·M_p.
quiz.explanation: 超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2·M_p。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Overstrength moment M_o = 1.2·M_p. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 容量設計與破壞層級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Capacity design and failure hierarchy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「超強度彎矩 M_o」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Overstrength moment M_o” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以彎矩—曲率分析求得柱的理想化塑性彎矩 M_p（採期望材料強度），乘以超強度係數後，逐一核對柱剪力、帽梁、基礎、樁與接頭的設計強度是否大於對應需求，並在計算書中列出完整的能力保護清單。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain the column's idealised plastic moment M_p from moment–curvature analysis using expected material strengths, apply the overstrength factor, and check that the design strengths of column shear, cap beam, footing, piles and joints exceed the corresponding demands, listing the full capacity-protection table in the calculations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計審查時要求一張「延性構件與能力保護構件」對照表，列出塑鉸位置、M_p、M_o 與各能力保護構件的強度比；變更柱配筋時，必須同步重算所有能力保護構件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design review requires a table of ductile versus capacity-protected members listing hinge locations, M_p, M_o and each protected member's strength ratio; any change to column reinforcement triggers recalculation of all capacity-protected members.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若剪力或基礎只以設計地震力計算，塑鉸形成前或形成時柱先剪斷，強度在一個循環內驟降；1971 年聖費爾南多與 1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中多座高架橋就因柱剪力與接頭不足而崩塌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If shear or foundations are designed only for the design earthquake force, the column can fail in shear before or as the hinge forms, losing strength within one cycle; in the 1971 San Fernando and 1989 Loma Prieta earthquakes several viaducts collapsed because of inadequate column shear and joint capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以彎矩—曲率分析求得柱的理想化塑性彎矩 M_p（採期望材料強度），乘以超強度係數後，逐一核對柱剪力、帽梁、基礎、樁與接頭的設計強度是否大於對應需求，並在計算書中列出完整的能力保護清單。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain the column's idealised plastic moment M_p from moment–curvature analysis using expected material strengths, apply the overstrength factor, and check that the design strengths of column shear, cap beam, footing, piles and joints exceed the corresponding demands, listing the full capacity-protection table in the calculations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計審查時要求一張「延性構件與能力保護構件」對照表，列出塑鉸位置、M_p、M_o 與各能力保護構件的強度比；變更柱配筋時，必須同步重算所有能力保護構件。
knowledge.textEn: Design review requires a table of ductile versus capacity-protected members listing hinge locations, M_p, M_o and each protected member's strength ratio; any change to column reinforcement triggers recalculation of all capacity-protected members.

quiz.question: 要驗證「容量設計與破壞層級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Capacity design and failure hierarchy"?
options: 以彎矩—曲率分析求得柱的理想化塑性彎矩 M_p（採期望材料強度），乘以超強度係數後，逐一核對柱剪力、帽梁、基礎、樁與接頭的設計強度是否大於對應需求，並在計算書中列出完整的能力保護清單。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
震後柱子沒有倒，就表示可以直接恢復通行。
optionsEn: Obtain the column's idealised plastic moment M_p from moment–curvature analysis using expected material strengths, apply the overstrength factor, and check that the design strengths of column shear, cap beam, footing, piles and joints exceed the corresponding demands, listing the full capacity-protection table in the calculations.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If a column did not collapse in the earthquake, the bridge can reopen immediately.
quiz.explanation: 以彎矩—曲率分析求得柱的理想化塑性彎矩 M_p（採期望材料強度），乘以超強度係數後，逐一核對柱剪力、帽梁、基礎、樁與接頭的設計強度是否大於對應需求，並在計算書中列出完整的能力保護清單。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain the column's idealised plastic moment M_p from moment–curvature analysis using expected material strengths, apply the overstrength factor, and check that the design strengths of column shear, cap beam, footing, piles and joints exceed the corresponding demands, listing the full capacity-protection table in the calculations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 容量設計與破壞層級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Capacity design and failure hierarchy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「超強度彎矩 M_o」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Overstrength moment M_o” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若剪力或基礎只以設計地震力計算，塑鉸形成前或形成時柱先剪斷，強度在一個循環內驟降；1971 年聖費爾南多與 1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中多座高架橋就因柱剪力與接頭不足而崩塌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If shear or foundations are designed only for the design earthquake force, the column can fail in shear before or as the hinge forms, losing strength within one cycle; in the 1971 San Fernando and 1989 Loma Prieta earthquakes several viaducts collapsed because of inadequate column shear and joint capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這樣即使地震遠超預期，破壞仍以可預測、可修復的彎曲變形出現，而不是脆性剪斷或基礎破壞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Even in an earthquake far beyond expectation, damage then appears as predictable, repairable flexural deformation rather than brittle shear or foundation failure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若剪力或基礎只以設計地震力計算，塑鉸形成前或形成時柱先剪斷，強度在一個循環內驟降；1971 年聖費爾南多與 1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中多座高架橋就因柱剪力與接頭不足而崩塌。
knowledge.textEn: If shear or foundations are designed only for the design earthquake force, the column can fail in shear before or as the hinge forms, losing strength within one cycle; in the 1971 San Fernando and 1989 Loma Prieta earthquakes several viaducts collapsed because of inadequate column shear and joint capacity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「容量設計與破壞層級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Capacity design and failure hierarchy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若剪力或基礎只以設計地震力計算，塑鉸形成前或形成時柱先剪斷，強度在一個循環內驟降。
只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If shear or foundations are designed only for the design earthquake force, the column can fail in shear before or as the hinge forms, losing strength within one cycle.
If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked.
quiz.explanation: 若剪力或基礎只以設計地震力計算，塑鉸形成前或形成時柱先剪斷，強度在一個循環內驟降；1971 年聖費爾南多與 1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中多座高架橋就因柱剪力與接頭不足而崩塌。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If shear or foundations are designed only for the design earthquake force, the column can fail in shear before or as the hinge forms, losing strength within one cycle; in the 1971 San Fernando and 1989 Loma Prieta earthquakes several viaducts collapsed because of inadequate column shear and joint capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 位移需求與韌性限值：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Displacement demand and ductility limits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「位移韌性需求 μ_D」如何影響橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Displacement ductility demand μ_D” governs force, deformation or durability in “Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 對週期較長的橋梁，等位移原則指出非線性結構的最大位移與同週期的彈性結構相近，因此設計可先求彈性位移需求，再除以柱的降伏位移得到位移韌性需求 μ_D。韌性需求越高，塑鉸轉角越大、損傷越重；加州運輸局耐震設計準則 1.7 版把固定基礎單柱橋墩的 μ_D 限制在 4、多柱排架限制在 5，並要求每個延性構件的局部位移韌性容量至少為 3。限值的目的是讓需求與容量之間保有餘裕，同時把震後損傷控制在可修復範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「位移韌性需求 μ_D」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For longer-period bridges the equal-displacement principle says the peak displacement of a nonlinear structure is close to that of an elastic structure with the same period, so design first finds the elastic displacement demand and divides it by the column's yield displacement to get the displacement ductility demand μ_D. Higher demand means larger hinge rotations and heavier damage; Caltrans Seismic Design Criteria version 1.7 limits μ_D to 4 for single-column bents on fixed foundations and 5 for multi-column bents, and requires each ductile member to have a local displacement ductility capacity of at least 3. The limits keep a margin between demand and capacity and hold post-earthquake damage within a repairable range. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Displacement ductility demand μ_D” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D with ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375 and D = 2.0 m gives φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m; yield displacement Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 = 0.00267×10²/3 ≈ 0.089 m, ignoring bar slip.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「位移韌性需求 μ_D」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Displacement ductility demand μ_D”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 位移需求與韌性限值
knowledge.text: 對週期較長的橋梁，等位移原則指出非線性結構的最大位移與同週期的彈性結構相近，因此設計可先求彈性位移需求，再除以柱的降伏位移得到位移韌性需求 μ_D。韌性需求越高，塑鉸轉角越大、損傷越重；加州運輸局耐震設計準則 1.7 版把固定基礎單柱橋墩的 μ_D 限制在 4、多柱排架限制在 5，並要求每個延性構件的局部位移韌性容量至少為 3。
knowledge.textEn: For longer-period bridges the equal-displacement principle says the peak displacement of a nonlinear structure is close to that of an elastic structure with the same period, so design first finds the elastic displacement demand and divides it by the column's yield displacement to get the displacement ductility demand μ_D. Higher demand means larger hinge rotations and heavier damage; Caltrans Seismic Design Criteria version 1.7 limits μ_D to 4 for single-column bents on fixed foundations and 5 for multi-column bents, and requires each ductile member to have a local displacement ductility capacity of at least 3.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「位移需求與韌性限值」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Displacement demand and ductility limits" is correct?
options: 只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。
箍筋主要是用來固定主筋位置，對耐震性能影響不大。
對週期較長的橋梁，等位移原則指出非線性結構的最大位移與同週期的彈性結構相近，因此設計可先求彈性位移需求，再除以柱的降伏位移得到位移韌性需求 μ_D。
optionsEn: If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked.
Hoops mainly hold the longitudinal bars in place and matter little for seismic performance.

For longer-period bridges the equal-displacement principle says the peak displacement of a nonlinear structure is close to that of an elastic structure with the same period, so design first finds the elastic displacement demand and divides it by the column's yield displacement to get the displacement ductility demand μ_D.
quiz.explanation: 對週期較長的橋梁，等位移原則指出非線性結構的最大位移與同週期的彈性結構相近，因此設計可先求彈性位移需求，再除以柱的降伏位移得到位移韌性需求 μ_D。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For longer-period bridges the equal-displacement principle says the peak displacement of a nonlinear structure is close to that of an elastic structure with the same period, so design first finds the elastic displacement demand and divides it by the column's yield displacement to get the displacement ductility demand μ_D. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 位移需求與韌性限值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Displacement demand and ductility limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「位移韌性需求 μ_D」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Displacement ductility demand μ_D” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：降伏曲率 φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D，ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375，D = 2.0 m，φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m；降伏位移 Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 = 0.00267×10²/3 ≈ 0.089 m（未計鋼筋滑移）。彈性位移需求 Δ_D = 0.30 m，μ_D = 0.30/0.089 ≈ 3.4，小於 4。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D with ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375 and D = 2.0 m gives φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m; yield displacement Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 = 0.00267×10²/3 ≈ 0.089 m, ignoring bar slip. For an elastic displacement demand Δ_D = 0.30 m, μ_D = 0.30/0.089 ≈ 3.4, below 4. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以反應譜或非線性時間歷程分析求得每座排架的位移需求，與推覆分析（pushover）得到的降伏位移與容量位移比較，確認 μ_D 不超過規範限值且 Δ_D 小於容量位移；短週期橋梁要另加位移放大係數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain each bent's displacement demand by response-spectrum or nonlinear time-history analysis and compare it with yield and capacity displacements from pushover analysis, confirming μ_D stays within the code limit and Δ_D below capacity; short-period bridges need an additional displacement magnification factor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D with ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375 and D = 2.0 m gives φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m; yield displacement Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 = 0.00267×10²/3 ≈ 0.089 m, ignoring bar slip. For an elastic displacement demand Δ_D = 0.30 m, μ_D = 0.30/0.089 ≈ 3.4, below 4. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「位移需求與韌性限值」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Displacement demand and ductility limits", which statement holds?
options: 箍筋間距差幾公分不影響結構安全，可以依現場方便調整。
單調推到破壞的試驗就足以代表地震下的柱韌性。
optionsEn: Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D with ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375 and D = 2.0 m gives φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m.
A few centimetres of extra hoop spacing do not affect safety and can be adjusted for site convenience.
A monotonic push to failure is enough to represent column ductility under earthquakes.
quiz.explanationEn: Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D with ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375 and D = 2.0 m gives φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m; yield displacement Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 = 0.00267×10²/3 ≈ 0.089 m, ignoring bar slip. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 位移需求與韌性限值：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Displacement demand and ductility limits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「位移韌性需求 μ_D」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Displacement ductility demand μ_D” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以反應譜或非線性時間歷程分析求得每座排架的位移需求，與推覆分析（pushover）得到的降伏位移與容量位移比較，確認 μ_D 不超過規範限值且 Δ_D 小於容量位移；短週期橋梁要另加位移放大係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain each bent's displacement demand by response-spectrum or nonlinear time-history analysis and compare it with yield and capacity displacements from pushover analysis, confirming μ_D stays within the code limit and Δ_D below capacity; short-period bridges need an additional displacement magnification factor. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：相鄰排架的有效勁度比應盡量接近（例如以墩高、斷面或基礎埋深調整），設計報告須列出每座排架的 Δ_D、Δ_y、Δ_c 與 μ_D，作為審查與後續評估的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep effective stiffness ratios of adjacent bents close, adjusting pier height, section or foundation embedment, and list Δ_D, Δ_y, Δ_c and μ_D for every bent in the design report as the baseline for review and later assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一座橋中長短不一的橋墩若未調整勁度，短墩吸收大部分地震力且韌性需求集中，可能先達到剪力或韌性極限；忽略短週期放大則低估位移，使塑鉸轉角超過容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If piers of very different heights in one bridge are not balanced in stiffness, the short piers attract most of the seismic force and concentrate ductility demand, reaching shear or ductility limits first; ignoring short-period magnification underestimates displacement and drives hinge rotation beyond capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以反應譜或非線性時間歷程分析求得每座排架的位移需求，與推覆分析（pushover）得到的降伏位移與容量位移比較，確認 μ_D 不超過規範限值且 Δ_D 小於容量位移；短週期橋梁要另加位移放大係數。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain each bent's displacement demand by response-spectrum or nonlinear time-history analysis and compare it with yield and capacity displacements from pushover analysis, confirming μ_D stays within the code limit and Δ_D below capacity; short-period bridges need an additional displacement magnification factor.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 相鄰排架的有效勁度比應盡量接近（例如以墩高、斷面或基礎埋深調整），設計報告須列出每座排架的 Δ_D、Δ_y、Δ_c 與 μ_D，作為審查與後續評估的基準。
knowledge.textEn: Keep effective stiffness ratios of adjacent bents close, adjusting pier height, section or foundation embedment, and list Δ_D, Δ_y, Δ_c and μ_D for every bent in the design report as the baseline for review and later assessment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「位移需求與韌性限值」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Displacement demand and ductility limits"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以反應譜或非線性時間歷程分析求得每座排架的位移需求，與推覆分析（pushover）得到的降伏位移與容量位移比較，確認 μ_D 不超過規範限值且 Δ_D 小於容量位移。
耐震與耐久是兩個獨立問題，腐蝕不會影響橋墩的耐震能力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Obtain each bent's displacement demand by response-spectrum or nonlinear time-history analysis and compare it with yield and capacity displacements from pushover analysis, confirming μ_D stays within the code limit and Δ_D below capacity.
Seismic and durability performance are separate issues; corrosion does not affect a pier's seismic capacity.
quiz.explanation: 以反應譜或非線性時間歷程分析求得每座排架的位移需求，與推覆分析（pushover）得到的降伏位移與容量位移比較，確認 μ_D 不超過規範限值且 Δ_D 小於容量位移；短週期橋梁要另加位移放大係數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain each bent's displacement demand by response-spectrum or nonlinear time-history analysis and compare it with yield and capacity displacements from pushover analysis, confirming μ_D stays within the code limit and Δ_D below capacity; short-period bridges need an additional displacement magnification factor. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 位移需求與韌性限值：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Displacement demand and ductility limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「位移韌性需求 μ_D」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Displacement ductility demand μ_D” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一座橋中長短不一的橋墩若未調整勁度，短墩吸收大部分地震力且韌性需求集中，可能先達到剪力或韌性極限；忽略短週期放大則低估位移，使塑鉸轉角超過容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If piers of very different heights in one bridge are not balanced in stiffness, the short piers attract most of the seismic force and concentrate ductility demand, reaching shear or ductility limits first; ignoring short-period magnification underestimates displacement and drives hinge rotation beyond capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：限值的目的是讓需求與容量之間保有餘裕，同時把震後損傷控制在可修復範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The limits keep a margin between demand and capacity and hold post-earthquake damage within a repairable range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一座橋中長短不一的橋墩若未調整勁度，短墩吸收大部分地震力且韌性需求集中，可能先達到剪力或韌性極限；忽略短週期放大則低估位移，使塑鉸轉角超過容量。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Displacement demand and ductility limits" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「圍束箍筋與核心混凝土」與「塑鉸長度、轉角容量與搭接禁區」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Confining hoops and core concrete" and "Hinge length, rotation capacity and no-splice zones": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 圍束箍筋與核心混凝土：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Confining hoops and core concrete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「螺旋箍筋體積比 ρ_s」如何影響橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spiral volumetric ratio ρ_s” governs force, deformation or durability in “Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 塑鉸轉角容量主要取決於受壓區混凝土能承受多大壓應變：保護層混凝土在應變約 0.004 時剝落，但被螺旋箍筋或封閉箍筋圍束的核心混凝土，受到箍筋的側向反力，強度與極限應變都大幅提高。圍束同時防止縱向主筋在反覆載重下挫屈，以及提供剪力強度。圓形斷面用螺旋筋圍束效率最高，矩形斷面則需要繫筋把箍筋的長邊拉住，否則箍筋向外彎曲，圍束作用只在角落有效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「螺旋箍筋體積比 ρ_s」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The rotation capacity of a plastic hinge depends mainly on how much compressive strain the concrete can sustain: cover concrete spalls at a strain of about 0.004, but core concrete confined by spirals or closed hoops gains strength and ultimate strain from the hoops' lateral reaction. Confinement also stops longitudinal bars buckling under reversed loading and supplies shear strength. Circular sections confined by spirals are the most efficient; rectangular sections need cross-ties to restrain the long sides of the hoops, or the hoops bow outward and confine effectively only at the corners. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spiral volumetric ratio ρ_s” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ρ_s = 4·A_sp/(D′·s); a 22 mm spiral with A_sp = 380 mm², core diameter D′ = 1,900 mm and pitch s = 100 mm gives ρ_s = 1,520/190,000 = 0.0080.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「箍筋主要是用來固定主筋位置，對耐震性能影響不大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hoops mainly hold the longitudinal bars in place and matter little for seismic performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「螺旋箍筋體積比 ρ_s」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Spiral volumetric ratio ρ_s”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 圍束箍筋與核心混凝土
knowledge.text: 塑鉸轉角容量主要取決於受壓區混凝土能承受多大壓應變：保護層混凝土在應變約 0.004 時剝落，但被螺旋箍筋或封閉箍筋圍束的核心混凝土，受到箍筋的側向反力，強度與極限應變都大幅提高。圍束同時防止縱向主筋在反覆載重下挫屈，以及提供剪力強度。
knowledge.textEn: The rotation capacity of a plastic hinge depends mainly on how much compressive strain the concrete can sustain: cover concrete spalls at a strain of about 0.004, but core concrete confined by spirals or closed hoops gains strength and ultimate strain from the hoops' lateral reaction. Confinement also stops longitudinal bars buckling under reversed loading and supplies shear strength.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：箍筋主要是用來固定主筋位置，對耐震性能影響不大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hoops mainly hold the longitudinal bars in place and matter little for seismic performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「圍束箍筋與核心混凝土」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Confining hoops and core concrete" is correct?
options: 塑鉸轉角容量主要取決於受壓區混凝土能承受多大壓應變：保護層混凝土在應變約 0.004 時剝落，但被螺旋箍筋或封閉箍筋圍束的核心混凝土，受到箍筋的側向反力，強度與極限應變都大幅提高。
箍筋主要是用來固定主筋位置，對耐震性能影響不大。
塑鉸長度就是柱底出現裂縫的長度，可以在現場直接量到。
optionsEn: The rotation capacity of a plastic hinge depends mainly on how much compressive strain the concrete can sustain: cover concrete spalls at a strain of about 0.004, but core concrete confined by spirals or closed hoops gains strength and ultimate strain from the hoops' lateral reaction.
Hoops mainly hold the longitudinal bars in place and matter little for seismic performance.
The plastic-hinge length is simply the cracked length at the column base and can be measured on site.
quiz.explanation: 塑鉸轉角容量主要取決於受壓區混凝土能承受多大壓應變：保護層混凝土在應變約 0.004 時剝落，但被螺旋箍筋或封閉箍筋圍束的核心混凝土，受到箍筋的側向反力，強度與極限應變都大幅提高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The rotation capacity of a plastic hinge depends mainly on how much compressive strain the concrete can sustain: cover concrete spalls at a strain of about 0.004, but core concrete confined by spirals or closed hoops gains strength and ultimate strain from the hoops' lateral reaction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 圍束箍筋與核心混凝土：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Confining hoops and core concrete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺旋箍筋體積比 ρ_s」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spiral volumetric ratio ρ_s” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ρ_s = 4·A_sp/(D′·s)，22 mm 螺旋筋 A_sp = 380 mm²、核心直徑 D′ = 1,900 mm、間距 s = 100 mm，ρ_s = 1,520/190,000 = 0.0080。極限應變 ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4·ρ_s·f_yh·ε_su/f′_cc = 0.004 + 1.4×0.008×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0136，約為未圍束值的 3.4 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ρ_s = 4·A_sp/(D′·s); a 22 mm spiral with A_sp = 380 mm², core diameter D′ = 1,900 mm and pitch s = 100 mm gives ρ_s = 1,520/190,000 = 0.0080. Ultimate strain ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4·ρ_s·f_yh·ε_su/f′_cc = 0.004 + 1.4×0.008×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0136, about 3.4 times the unconfined value. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 Mander 等圍束混凝土模型建立彎矩—曲率分析，確認極限曲率由核心混凝土壓應變或主筋拉應變控制；並檢查箍筋間距不超過規範對防止主筋挫屈的上限（常以主筋直徑的倍數表示）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the moment–curvature analysis with a confined-concrete model such as Mander's, confirming whether ultimate curvature is governed by core compressive strain or bar tensile strain; check that hoop spacing does not exceed the code limit for preventing bar buckling, usually expressed as a multiple of bar diameter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: ρ_s = 4·A_sp/(D′·s); a 22 mm spiral with A_sp = 380 mm², core diameter D′ = 1,900 mm and pitch s = 100 mm gives ρ_s = 1,520/190,000 = 0.0080. Ultimate strain ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4·ρ_s·f_yh·ε_su/f′_cc = 0.004 + 1.4×0.008×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0136, about 3.4 times the unconfined value. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Confining hoops and core concrete", which statement holds?
options: 只要續接器能承受鋼筋的降伏強度，就可以用在塑鉸區。
震後柱子沒有倒，就表示可以直接恢復通行。

quiz.explanation: ρ_s = 4·A_sp/(D′·s)，22 mm 螺旋筋 A_sp = 380 mm²、核心直徑 D′ = 1,900 mm、間距 s = 100 mm，ρ_s = 1,520/190,000 = 0.0080。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ρ_s = 4·A_sp/(D′·s); a 22 mm spiral with A_sp = 380 mm², core diameter D′ = 1,900 mm and pitch s = 100 mm gives ρ_s = 1,520/190,000 = 0.0080. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 圍束箍筋與核心混凝土：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Confining hoops and core concrete: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「螺旋箍筋體積比 ρ_s」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spiral volumetric ratio ρ_s” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以 Mander 等圍束混凝土模型建立彎矩—曲率分析，確認極限曲率由核心混凝土壓應變或主筋拉應變控制；並檢查箍筋間距不超過規範對防止主筋挫屈的上限（常以主筋直徑的倍數表示）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the moment–curvature analysis with a confined-concrete model such as Mander's, confirming whether ultimate curvature is governed by core compressive strain or bar tensile strain; check that hoop spacing does not exceed the code limit for preventing bar buckling, usually expressed as a multiple of bar diameter. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：塑鉸區的箍筋必須是封閉箍或連續螺旋，彎鉤以 135 度彎入核心並有足夠延伸長度，或採焊接封閉箍；圖面要單獨繪出塑鉸區的箍筋間距與範圍，不得以一般區配筋替代。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hinge-zone hoops must be closed hoops or continuous spirals, with 135-degree hooks anchored into the core with adequate extension, or welded closed hoops; drawings show hinge-zone spacing and extent separately and must not substitute general-zone detailing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中崩塌的賽普勒斯街高架橋，柱缺乏足夠的環向圍束以防止爆裂，上下柱之間也缺少鋼筋連接；圍束不足的柱在保護層剝落後核心壓碎、主筋外凸挫屈，強度與軸向承載同時喪失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The Cypress Street Viaduct, which collapsed in the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake, had columns lacking enough hoop confinement to prevent bursting and upper columns not tied to the lower ones with reinforcement; in poorly confined columns, once the cover spalls the core crushes and bars buckle outward, losing both lateral strength and axial capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 Mander 等圍束混凝土模型建立彎矩—曲率分析，確認極限曲率由核心混凝土壓應變或主筋拉應變控制；並檢查箍筋間距不超過規範對防止主筋挫屈的上限（常以主筋直徑的倍數表示）。
knowledge.textEn: Build the moment–curvature analysis with a confined-concrete model such as Mander's, confirming whether ultimate curvature is governed by core compressive strain or bar tensile strain; check that hoop spacing does not exceed the code limit for preventing bar buckling, usually expressed as a multiple of bar diameter.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 塑鉸區的箍筋必須是封閉箍或連續螺旋，彎鉤以 135 度彎入核心並有足夠延伸長度，或採焊接封閉箍；圖面要單獨繪出塑鉸區的箍筋間距與範圍，不得以一般區配筋替代。
knowledge.textEn: Hinge-zone hoops must be closed hoops or continuous spirals, with 135-degree hooks anchored into the core with adequate extension, or welded closed hoops; drawings show hinge-zone spacing and extent separately and must not substitute general-zone detailing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「圍束箍筋與核心混凝土」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Confining hoops and core concrete"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
混凝土剪力強度是固定值，不會因柱子的彎曲變形而改變。
以 Mander 等圍束混凝土模型建立彎矩—曲率分析，確認極限曲率由核心混凝土壓應變或主筋拉應變控制。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The concrete shear strength is a fixed value that does not change with column flexural deformation.
Build the moment–curvature analysis with a confined-concrete model such as Mander's, confirming whether ultimate curvature is governed by core compressive strain or bar tensile strain.
quiz.explanation: 以 Mander 等圍束混凝土模型建立彎矩—曲率分析，確認極限曲率由核心混凝土壓應變或主筋拉應變控制；並檢查箍筋間距不超過規範對防止主筋挫屈的上限（常以主筋直徑的倍數表示）。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build the moment–curvature analysis with a confined-concrete model such as Mander's, confirming whether ultimate curvature is governed by core compressive strain or bar tensile strain; check that hoop spacing does not exceed the code limit for preventing bar buckling, usually expressed as a multiple of bar diameter. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 圍束箍筋與核心混凝土：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Confining hoops and core concrete: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「螺旋箍筋體積比 ρ_s」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spiral volumetric ratio ρ_s” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中崩塌的賽普勒斯街高架橋，柱缺乏足夠的環向圍束以防止爆裂，上下柱之間也缺少鋼筋連接；圍束不足的柱在保護層剝落後核心壓碎、主筋外凸挫屈，強度與軸向承載同時喪失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The Cypress Street Viaduct, which collapsed in the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake, had columns lacking enough hoop confinement to prevent bursting and upper columns not tied to the lower ones with reinforcement; in poorly confined columns, once the cover spalls the core crushes and bars buckle outward, losing both lateral strength and axial capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圓形斷面用螺旋筋圍束效率最高，矩形斷面則需要繫筋把箍筋的長邊拉住，否則箍筋向外彎曲，圍束作用只在角落有效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Circular sections confined by spirals are the most efficient; rectangular sections need cross-ties to restrain the long sides of the hoops, or the hoops bow outward and confine effectively only at the corners.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「箍筋主要是用來固定主筋位置，對耐震性能影響不大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hoops mainly hold the longitudinal bars in place and matter little for seismic performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 塑鉸長度、轉角容量與搭接禁區：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Hinge length, rotation capacity and no-splice zones: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塑鉸長度 L_p」如何影響橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plastic-hinge length L_p” governs force, deformation or durability in “Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 實際塑性變形分布在柱底一段區域內，為了計算方便，以等效塑鉸長度 L_p 把曲率集中成一個轉角：L_p 一部分來自柱高（彎矩梯度），一部分來自主筋在基礎中的應變滲透，因此與主筋直徑及降伏強度有關。塑鉸轉角容量等於（極限曲率 − 降伏曲率）乘以 L_p，再乘以柱高換算為塑性位移。塑鉸區內不允許主筋搭接，因為搭接在反覆大應變下會滑脫，這正是許多早期橋墩在柱底搭接處破壞的原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塑鉸長度 L_p」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Plastic deformation actually spreads over a zone at the column base; for convenience an equivalent plastic-hinge length L_p concentrates curvature into one rotation. Part of L_p comes from the column height through moment gradient and part from strain penetration of the bars into the footing, so it depends on bar diameter and yield strength. Hinge rotation capacity equals ultimate minus yield curvature times L_p, converted to plastic displacement through the column height. Lap splices are not allowed in the hinge zone because they slip under reversed large strains, which is why many older piers failed at base lap splices. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Plastic-hinge length L_p” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: L_p = 0.08·L + 0.022·f_ye·d_bl = 0.08×10 + 0.022×475×0.036 ≈ 1.18 m (not less than 0.044·f_ye·d_bl ≈ 0.75 m).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塑鉸長度就是柱底出現裂縫的長度，可以在現場直接量到。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The plastic-hinge length is simply the cracked length at the column base and can be measured on site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塑鉸長度 L_p」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Plastic-hinge length L_p”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 塑鉸長度、轉角容量與搭接禁區
knowledge.titleEn: Hinge length, rotation capacity and no-splice zones
knowledge.text: 實際塑性變形分布在柱底一段區域內，為了計算方便，以等效塑鉸長度 L_p 把曲率集中成一個轉角：L_p 一部分來自柱高（彎矩梯度），一部分來自主筋在基礎中的應變滲透，因此與主筋直徑及降伏強度有關。塑鉸轉角容量等於（極限曲率 − 降伏曲率）乘以 L_p，再乘以柱高換算為塑性位移。
knowledge.textEn: Plastic deformation actually spreads over a zone at the column base; for convenience an equivalent plastic-hinge length L_p concentrates curvature into one rotation. Part of L_p comes from the column height through moment gradient and part from strain penetration of the bars into the footing, so it depends on bar diameter and yield strength.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：塑鉸長度就是柱底出現裂縫的長度，可以在現場直接量到。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The plastic-hinge length is simply the cracked length at the column base and can be measured on site. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「塑鉸長度、轉角容量與搭接禁區」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hinge length, rotation capacity and no-splice zones" is correct?
options: 塑鉸長度就是柱底出現裂縫的長度，可以在現場直接量到。
實際塑性變形分布在柱底一段區域內，為了計算方便，以等效塑鉸長度 L_p 把曲率集中成一個轉角：L_p 一部分來自柱高（彎矩梯度），一部分來自主筋在基礎中的應變滲透，因此與主筋直徑及降伏強度有關。
箍筋間距差幾公分不影響結構安全，可以依現場方便調整。
optionsEn: The plastic-hinge length is simply the cracked length at the column base and can be measured on site.
Plastic deformation actually spreads over a zone at the column base.
A few centimetres of extra hoop spacing do not affect safety and can be adjusted for site convenience.
quiz.explanation: 實際塑性變形分布在柱底一段區域內，為了計算方便，以等效塑鉸長度 L_p 把曲率集中成一個轉角：L_p 一部分來自柱高（彎矩梯度），一部分來自主筋在基礎中的應變滲透，因此與主筋直徑及降伏強度有關。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Plastic deformation actually spreads over a zone at the column base; for convenience an equivalent plastic-hinge length L_p concentrates curvature into one rotation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 塑鉸長度、轉角容量與搭接禁區：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hinge length, rotation capacity and no-splice zones: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塑鉸長度 L_p」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Plastic-hinge length L_p” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：等效塑鉸長度 L_p = 0.08·L + 0.022·f_ye·d_bl = 0.08×10 + 0.022×475×0.036 ≈ 1.18 m（不小於 0.044·f_ye·d_bl ≈ 0.75 m）。中性軸深 c = 0.25·D = 0.5 m，φ_u = 0.0136/0.5 ≈ 0.0272 1/m；θ_p = (0.0272 − 0.0027)×1.18 ≈ 0.029 rad；Δ_p = θ_p·(L − L_p/2) ≈ 0.029×9.41 ≈ 0.27 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: L_p = 0.08·L + 0.022·f_ye·d_bl = 0.08×10 + 0.022×475×0.036 ≈ 1.18 m (not less than 0.044·f_ye·d_bl ≈ 0.75 m). With neutral-axis depth c = 0.25·D = 0.5 m, φ_u = 0.0136/0.5 ≈ 0.0272 1/m; θ_p = (0.0272 − 0.0027)×1.18 ≈ 0.029 rad; Δ_p = θ_p·(L − L_p/2) ≈ 0.029×9.41 ≈ 0.27 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對手算與推覆分析的容量位移，並確認圖面上的塑鉸區範圍（通常取 L_p、斷面尺寸與柱高某比例三者中的較大值）內沒有主筋搭接、斷筋或施工縫錯位；續接只能放在塑鉸區外或使用經試驗認可的機械續接器。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the hand capacity displacement with the pushover result, and confirm that within the hinge-zone extent on the drawings (usually the greatest of L_p, the section dimension and a fraction of column height) there are no lap splices, bar cutoffs or misplaced construction joints; splices go outside the zone or use test-qualified mechanical couplers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塑鉸長度、轉角容量與搭接禁區」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hinge length, rotation capacity and no-splice zones", which statement holds?
options: 單調推到破壞的試驗就足以代表地震下的柱韌性。
耐震與耐久是兩個獨立問題，腐蝕不會影響橋墩的耐震能力。
optionsEn: A monotonic push to failure is enough to represent column ductility under earthquakes.
Seismic and durability performance are separate issues; corrosion does not affect a pier's seismic capacity.
quiz.explanationEn: L_p = 0.08·L + 0.022·f_ye·d_bl = 0.08×10 + 0.022×475×0.036 ≈ 1.18 m (not less than 0.044·f_ye·d_bl ≈ 0.75 m). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 塑鉸長度、轉角容量與搭接禁區：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hinge length, rotation capacity and no-splice zones: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塑鉸長度 L_p」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Plastic-hinge length L_p” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對手算與推覆分析的容量位移，並確認圖面上的塑鉸區範圍（通常取 L_p、斷面尺寸與柱高某比例三者中的較大值）內沒有主筋搭接、斷筋或施工縫錯位；續接只能放在塑鉸區外或使用經試驗認可的機械續接器。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the hand capacity displacement with the pushover result, and confirm that within the hinge-zone extent on the drawings (usually the greatest of L_p, the section dimension and a fraction of column height) there are no lap splices, bar cutoffs or misplaced construction joints; splices go outside the zone or use test-qualified mechanical couplers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：柱主筋優先採用通長或塑鉸區外的機械續接，基礎內錨定長度與彎鉤方向依設計圖施作；施工前召開配筋協調會，確認塑鉸區、施工縫與續接位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prefer continuous column bars or mechanical couplers outside the hinge zone, and build footing anchorage length and hook direction exactly as drawn; hold a reinforcement coordination meeting before construction to confirm hinge-zone, construction-joint and splice locations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：舊橋常在柱底以短搭接連接基礎預留筋，地震時搭接段滑脫，柱底彎矩強度驟降並形成搖擺；主筋在柱中段截斷時，塑鉸可能轉移到截斷點而該處缺乏圍束，造成意外的剪力或彎曲破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Older piers often lap column bars onto short footing starter bars at the base; in an earthquake the splice slips, base moment strength collapses and the column rocks; where bars are cut off at mid-height, the hinge can migrate to the cutoff point, which lacks confinement, causing unexpected shear or flexural failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對手算與推覆分析的容量位移，並確認圖面上的塑鉸區範圍（通常取 L_p、斷面尺寸與柱高某比例三者中的較大值）內沒有主筋搭接、斷筋或施工縫錯位；續接只能放在塑鉸區外或使用經試驗認可的機械續接器。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the hand capacity displacement with the pushover result, and confirm that within the hinge-zone extent on the drawings (usually the greatest of L_p, the section dimension and a fraction of column height) there are no lap splices, bar cutoffs or misplaced construction joints; splices go outside the zone or use test-qualified mechanical couplers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 柱主筋優先採用通長或塑鉸區外的機械續接，基礎內錨定長度與彎鉤方向依設計圖施作；施工前召開配筋協調會，確認塑鉸區、施工縫與續接位置。
knowledge.textEn: Prefer continuous column bars or mechanical couplers outside the hinge zone, and build footing anchorage length and hook direction exactly as drawn; hold a reinforcement coordination meeting before construction to confirm hinge-zone, construction-joint and splice locations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「塑鉸長度、轉角容量與搭接禁區」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hinge length, rotation capacity and no-splice zones"?
options: 比對手算與推覆分析的容量位移，並確認圖面上的塑鉸區範圍（通常取 L_p、斷面尺寸與柱高某比例三者中的較大值）內沒有主筋搭接、斷筋或施工縫錯位。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。
optionsEn: Compare the hand capacity displacement with the pushover result, and confirm that within the hinge-zone extent on the drawings (usually the greatest of L_p, the section dimension and a fraction of column height) there are no lap splices, bar cutoffs or misplaced construction joints.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety.
quiz.explanation: 比對手算與推覆分析的容量位移，並確認圖面上的塑鉸區範圍（通常取 L_p、斷面尺寸與柱高某比例三者中的較大值）內沒有主筋搭接、斷筋或施工縫錯位；續接只能放在塑鉸區外或使用經試驗認可的機械續接器。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare the hand capacity displacement with the pushover result, and confirm that within the hinge-zone extent on the drawings (usually the greatest of L_p, the section dimension and a fraction of column height) there are no lap splices, bar cutoffs or misplaced construction joints; splices go outside the zone or use test-qualified mechanical couplers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 塑鉸長度、轉角容量與搭接禁區：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hinge length, rotation capacity and no-splice zones: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塑鉸長度 L_p」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Plastic-hinge length L_p” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 舊橋常在柱底以短搭接連接基礎預留筋，地震時搭接段滑脫，柱底彎矩強度驟降並形成搖擺；主筋在柱中段截斷時，塑鉸可能轉移到截斷點而該處缺乏圍束，造成意外的剪力或彎曲破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Older piers often lap column bars onto short footing starter bars at the base; in an earthquake the splice slips, base moment strength collapses and the column rocks; where bars are cut off at mid-height, the hinge can migrate to the cutoff point, which lacks confinement, causing unexpected shear or flexural failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：塑鉸區內不允許主筋搭接，因為搭接在反覆大應變下會滑脫，這正是許多早期橋墩在柱底搭接處破壞的原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lap splices are not allowed in the hinge zone because they slip under reversed large strains, which is why many older piers failed at base lap splices.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塑鉸長度就是柱底出現裂縫的長度，可以在現場直接量到。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The plastic-hinge length is simply the cracked length at the column base and can be measured on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 舊橋常在柱底以短搭接連接基礎預留筋，地震時搭接段滑脫，柱底彎矩強度驟降並形成搖擺；主筋在柱中段截斷時，塑鉸可能轉移到截斷點而該處缺乏圍束，造成意外的剪力或彎曲破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Older piers often lap column bars onto short footing starter bars at the base; in an earthquake the splice slips, base moment strength collapses and the column rocks; where bars are cut off at mid-height, the hinge can migrate to the cutoff point, which lacks confinement, causing unexpected shear or flexural failure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「塑鉸長度、轉角容量與搭接禁區」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hinge length, rotation capacity and no-splice zones" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
舊橋常在柱底以短搭接連接基礎預留筋，地震時搭接段滑脫，柱底彎矩強度驟降並形成搖擺。
箍筋間距差幾公分不影響結構安全，可以依現場方便調整。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Older piers often lap column bars onto short footing starter bars at the base.
A few centimetres of extra hoop spacing do not affect safety and can be adjusted for site convenience.
quiz.explanation: 舊橋常在柱底以短搭接連接基礎預留筋，地震時搭接段滑脫，柱底彎矩強度驟降並形成搖擺；主筋在柱中段截斷時，塑鉸可能轉移到截斷點而該處缺乏圍束，造成意外的剪力或彎曲破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Older piers often lap column bars onto short footing starter bars at the base; in an earthquake the splice slips, base moment strength collapses and the column rocks; where bars are cut off at mid-height, the hinge can migrate to the cutoff point, which lacks confinement, causing unexpected shear or flexural failure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「塑鉸區鋼筋施工與查驗」與「續接器、錨定與接頭施工」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hinge-zone reinforcement construction and inspection" and "Couplers, anchorage and joint construction": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 塑鉸區鋼筋施工與查驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Hinge-zone reinforcement construction and inspection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「箍筋間距查驗」如何影響橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hoop spacing inspection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 塑鉸區配筋最密：大直徑主筋、密集螺旋筋、繫筋與基礎頂層筋交錯，模板內空間有限，施工者常為了方便澆置而放寬箍筋間距、縮短彎鉤或省略繫筋，這些小變更都直接降低圍束效果。混凝土方面，粒料粒徑與坍度必須讓混凝土流過密集鋼筋並充分搗實，否則柱底出現蜂窩，保護層與核心之間的握裹不良。施工縫若設在塑鉸區內，界面也會成為弱面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「箍筋間距查驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The hinge zone has the densest reinforcement: large longitudinal bars, closely spaced spirals, cross-ties and the footing's top mat all intersect in limited form space, and contractors are tempted to widen hoop spacing, shorten hooks or omit cross-ties for easier placing, each of which directly reduces confinement. For concrete, aggregate size and slump must let it flow through congested steel and be fully compacted, or honeycombing appears at the column base with poor bond between cover and core. A construction joint placed within the hinge zone also becomes a plane of weakness. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hoop spacing inspection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：螺旋筋體積比與間距成反比，ρ_s ∝ 1/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ρ_s ∝ 1/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「箍筋間距差幾公分不影響結構安全，可以依現場方便調整。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A few centimetres of extra hoop spacing do not affect safety and can be adjusted for site convenience." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「箍筋間距查驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hoop spacing inspection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 塑鉸區鋼筋施工與查驗
knowledge.text: 塑鉸區配筋最密：大直徑主筋、密集螺旋筋、繫筋與基礎頂層筋交錯，模板內空間有限，施工者常為了方便澆置而放寬箍筋間距、縮短彎鉤或省略繫筋，這些小變更都直接降低圍束效果。混凝土方面，粒料粒徑與坍度必須讓混凝土流過密集鋼筋並充分搗實，否則柱底出現蜂窩，保護層與核心之間的握裹不良。
knowledge.textEn: The hinge zone has the densest reinforcement: large longitudinal bars, closely spaced spirals, cross-ties and the footing's top mat all intersect in limited form space, and contractors are tempted to widen hoop spacing, shorten hooks or omit cross-ties for easier placing, each of which directly reduces confinement. For concrete, aggregate size and slump must let it flow through congested steel and be fully compacted, or honeycombing appears at the column base with poor bond between cover and core.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：箍筋間距差幾公分不影響結構安全，可以依現場方便調整。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A few centimetres of extra hoop spacing do not affect safety and can be adjusted for site convenience. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「塑鉸區鋼筋施工與查驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hinge-zone reinforcement construction and inspection" is correct?
options: 箍筋間距差幾公分不影響結構安全，可以依現場方便調整。
只要續接器能承受鋼筋的降伏強度，就可以用在塑鉸區。
塑鉸區配筋最密：大直徑主筋、密集螺旋筋、繫筋與基礎頂層筋交錯，模板內空間有限，施工者常為了方便澆置而放寬箍筋間距、縮短彎鉤或省略繫筋，這些小變更都直接降低圍束效果。
optionsEn: A few centimetres of extra hoop spacing do not affect safety and can be adjusted for site convenience.
Any coupler that develops the bar's yield strength can be used in a plastic hinge zone.

The hinge zone has the densest reinforcement: large longitudinal bars, closely spaced spirals, cross-ties and the footing's top mat all intersect in limited form space, and contractors are tempted to widen hoop spacing, shorten hooks or omit cross-ties for easier placing, each of which directly reduces confinement.
quiz.explanation: 塑鉸區配筋最密：大直徑主筋、密集螺旋筋、繫筋與基礎頂層筋交錯，模板內空間有限，施工者常為了方便澆置而放寬箍筋間距、縮短彎鉤或省略繫筋，這些小變更都直接降低圍束效果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The hinge zone has the densest reinforcement: large longitudinal bars, closely spaced spirals, cross-ties and the footing's top mat all intersect in limited form space, and contractors are tempted to widen hoop spacing, shorten hooks or omit cross-ties for easier placing, each of which directly reduces confinement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 塑鉸區鋼筋施工與查驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hinge-zone reinforcement construction and inspection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「箍筋間距查驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hoop spacing inspection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：螺旋筋體積比與間距成反比，ρ_s ∝ 1/s。設計間距 s = 100 mm、ρ_s = 0.0080；若現場放寬為 130 mm，ρ_s = 1,520/(1,900×130) ≈ 0.0062，下降約 23%；ε_cu 由 0.0136 降為 0.004 + 1.4×0.0062×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0114，約下降 16%，轉角容量隨之降低。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ρ_s ∝ 1/s. With s = 100 mm, ρ_s = 0.0080; if widened on site to 130 mm, ρ_s = 1,520/(1,900×130) ≈ 0.0062, about 23% lower; ε_cu falls from 0.0136 to 0.004 + 1.4×0.0062×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0114, about 16% lower, and rotation capacity drops accordingly. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：澆置前由監造逐支柱量測塑鉸區箍筋間距、彎鉤角度與延伸長度、繫筋數量與保護層，以照片與量尺記錄；混凝土採用可通過鋼筋淨距的粒料尺寸，並在試拌時確認流動性；拆模後檢查柱底是否有蜂窩。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before casting, the inspector measures each column's hinge-zone hoop spacing, hook angle and extension, cross-tie count and cover, recording with photos and a tape; the concrete uses an aggregate size that passes the bar clear spacing with flowability confirmed in trial mixes; after stripping inspect the column base for honeycombing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: ρ_s ∝ 1/s. With s = 100 mm, ρ_s = 0.0080; if widened on site to 130 mm, ρ_s = 1,520/(1,900×130) ≈ 0.0062, about 23% lower; ε_cu falls from 0.0136 to 0.004 + 1.4×0.0062×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0114, about 16% lower, and rotation capacity drops accordingly. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塑鉸區鋼筋施工與查驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hinge-zone reinforcement construction and inspection", which statement holds?
options: 螺旋筋體積比與間距成反比，ρ_s ∝ 1/s。
震後柱子沒有倒，就表示可以直接恢復通行。
混凝土剪力強度是固定值，不會因柱子的彎曲變形而改變。
optionsEn: If a column did not collapse in the earthquake, the bridge can reopen immediately.
The concrete shear strength is a fixed value that does not change with column flexural deformation.
quiz.explanation: 螺旋筋體積比與間距成反比，ρ_s ∝ 1/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ρ_s ∝ 1/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 塑鉸區鋼筋施工與查驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hinge-zone reinforcement construction and inspection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「箍筋間距查驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hoop spacing inspection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 澆置前由監造逐支柱量測塑鉸區箍筋間距、彎鉤角度與延伸長度、繫筋數量與保護層，以照片與量尺記錄；混凝土採用可通過鋼筋淨距的粒料尺寸，並在試拌時確認流動性；拆模後檢查柱底是否有蜂窩。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before casting, the inspector measures each column's hinge-zone hoop spacing, hook angle and extension, cross-tie count and cover, recording with photos and a tape; the concrete uses an aggregate size that passes the bar clear spacing with flowability confirmed in trial mixes; after stripping inspect the column base for honeycombing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把塑鉸區配筋查驗列為澆置前的停留點，未經監造簽認不得澆置；任何配筋變更（間距、彎鉤、續接）須經設計者書面同意，並記入竣工圖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make hinge-zone reinforcement inspection a hold point before casting that cannot be passed without the inspector's signature; any change to spacing, hooks or splices needs the designer's written approval and goes into the as-built drawings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：箍筋間距在施工中被放寬、彎鉤只做 90 度或繫筋遺漏，地震時保護層剝落後箍筋彎鉤張開，核心混凝土失去圍束，主筋挫屈；這種缺陷在完工後完全被混凝土覆蓋，只有大地震才會暴露。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Hoop spacing widened during construction, 90-degree hooks or missing cross-ties let hooks open once the cover spalls in an earthquake, so the core loses confinement and bars buckle; such defects are completely hidden by concrete after completion and are exposed only by a major earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 澆置前由監造逐支柱量測塑鉸區箍筋間距、彎鉤角度與延伸長度、繫筋數量與保護層，以照片與量尺記錄；混凝土採用可通過鋼筋淨距的粒料尺寸，並在試拌時確認流動性；拆模後檢查柱底是否有蜂窩。
knowledge.textEn: Before casting, the inspector measures each column's hinge-zone hoop spacing, hook angle and extension, cross-tie count and cover, recording with photos and a tape; the concrete uses an aggregate size that passes the bar clear spacing with flowability confirmed in trial mixes; after stripping inspect the column base for honeycombing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把塑鉸區配筋查驗列為澆置前的停留點，未經監造簽認不得澆置；任何配筋變更（間距、彎鉤、續接）須經設計者書面同意，並記入竣工圖。
knowledge.textEn: Make hinge-zone reinforcement inspection a hold point before casting that cannot be passed without the inspector's signature; any change to spacing, hooks or splices needs the designer's written approval and goes into the as-built drawings.

quiz.question: 要驗證「塑鉸區鋼筋施工與查驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hinge-zone reinforcement construction and inspection"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
澆置前由監造逐支柱量測塑鉸區箍筋間距、彎鉤角度與延伸長度、繫筋數量與保護層，以照片與量尺記錄。
只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before casting, the inspector measures each column's hinge-zone hoop spacing, hook angle and extension, cross-tie count and cover, recording with photos and a tape.
If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked.
quiz.explanation: 澆置前由監造逐支柱量測塑鉸區箍筋間距、彎鉤角度與延伸長度、繫筋數量與保護層，以照片與量尺記錄；混凝土採用可通過鋼筋淨距的粒料尺寸，並在試拌時確認流動性；拆模後檢查柱底是否有蜂窩。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before casting, the inspector measures each column's hinge-zone hoop spacing, hook angle and extension, cross-tie count and cover, recording with photos and a tape; the concrete uses an aggregate size that passes the bar clear spacing with flowability confirmed in trial mixes; after stripping inspect the column base for honeycombing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 塑鉸區鋼筋施工與查驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hinge-zone reinforcement construction and inspection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「箍筋間距查驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hoop spacing inspection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 箍筋間距在施工中被放寬、彎鉤只做 90 度或繫筋遺漏，地震時保護層剝落後箍筋彎鉤張開，核心混凝土失去圍束，主筋挫屈；這種缺陷在完工後完全被混凝土覆蓋，只有大地震才會暴露。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Hoop spacing widened during construction, 90-degree hooks or missing cross-ties let hooks open once the cover spalls in an earthquake, so the core loses confinement and bars buckle; such defects are completely hidden by concrete after completion and are exposed only by a major earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工縫若設在塑鉸區內，界面也會成為弱面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A construction joint placed within the hinge zone also becomes a plane of weakness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「箍筋間距差幾公分不影響結構安全，可以依現場方便調整。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A few centimetres of extra hoop spacing do not affect safety and can be adjusted for site convenience." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 箍筋間距在施工中被放寬、彎鉤只做 90 度或繫筋遺漏，地震時保護層剝落後箍筋彎鉤張開，核心混凝土失去圍束，主筋挫屈；這種缺陷在完工後完全被混凝土覆蓋，只有大地震才會暴露。
