knowledge.textEn: Before handover, have a third party take several raw runs and recompute peaks, amplification and frequencies with the processing parameters in the report to confirm reproducibility; check that weighbridge tickets, calibration certificates and the test log are attached and that the data format can be read by the owner's monitoring system.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主應把動態試驗資料納入橋梁管理系統，訂定重新試驗的觸發條件（重大補強、事故、評等變更、伸縮縫更換），並要求後續試驗盡量沿用相同的量測點與試驗車配置，以便直接比較。
knowledge.textEn: The owner should load dynamic-test data into the bridge management system, define triggers for retesting (major strengthening, accidents, rating changes, joint replacement), and require later tests to reuse the same gauge locations and truck configuration wherever possible so results compare directly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試驗報告、重現性與基準交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Test report, repeatability and baseline handover"?
options: 交接前由第三方抽取數趟原始資料，依報告記載的處理參數重算峰值、動力放大與頻率，確認可以重現。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
實測頻率比模型高，就代表橋梁沒有任何問題。
optionsEn: Before handover, have a third party take several raw runs and recompute peaks, amplification and frequencies with the processing parameters in the report to confirm reproducibility.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A measured frequency higher than the model means the bridge has no problems.
quiz.explanation: 交接前由第三方抽取數趟原始資料，依報告記載的處理參數重算峰值、動力放大與頻率，確認可以重現；檢查報告是否附有試驗車秤重單、儀器校正證書與試驗日誌，並確認資料格式可被業主的監測系統讀取。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, have a third party take several raw runs and recompute peaks, amplification and frequencies with the processing parameters in the report to confirm reproducibility; check that weighbridge tickets, calibration certificates and the test log are attached and that the data format can be read by the owner's monitoring system. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 試驗報告、重現性與基準交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Test report, repeatability and baseline handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動態試驗基準檔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dynamic-test baseline file” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若報告只留下結論數字，十年後橋梁補強或改建時，工程師無法判斷頻率變化是結構改變還是試驗方法不同；試驗車重與溫度紀錄缺漏，則讓前後兩次試驗無法比較。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the report keeps only conclusions, engineers strengthening or rebuilding the bridge ten years later cannot tell whether a frequency change reflects the structure or a different test method; missing truck weights or temperatures make the two tests incomparable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：千禧橋改造前後以同一套試驗邏輯對照，正是用試驗驗證工程成效的例子；1940 年塔科馬海峽橋通車約四個月即在風中倒塌，也提醒動力行為必須被量測而不只是假設。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Comparing the Millennium Bridge before and after its retrofit with the same test logic is an example of verifying engineering work by testing, and the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, which fell in the wind about four months after opening in 1940, is a reminder that dynamic behaviour must be measured, not merely assumed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「載重試驗通過一次，就證明橋梁永遠安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing one load test proves the bridge safe forever." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若報告只留下結論數字，十年後橋梁補強或改建時，工程師無法判斷頻率變化是結構改變還是試驗方法不同；試驗車重與溫度紀錄缺漏，則讓前後兩次試驗無法比較。
knowledge.textEn: If the report keeps only conclusions, engineers strengthening or rebuilding the bridge ten years later cannot tell whether a frequency change reflects the structure or a different test method; missing truck weights or temperatures make the two tests incomparable.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試驗報告、重現性與基準交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Test report, repeatability and baseline handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若報告只留下結論數字，十年後橋梁補強或改建時，工程師無法判斷頻率變化是結構改變還是試驗方法不同；試驗車重與溫度紀錄缺漏，則讓前後兩次試驗無法比較。
車速越快，橋梁的動力放大一定越大。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If the report keeps only conclusions, engineers strengthening or rebuilding the bridge ten years later cannot tell whether a frequency change reflects the structure or a different test method.
The faster the vehicle, the larger the dynamic amplification must be.
quiz.explanation: 若報告只留下結論數字，十年後橋梁補強或改建時，工程師無法判斷頻率變化是結構改變還是試驗方法不同；試驗車重與溫度紀錄缺漏，則讓前後兩次試驗無法比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the report keeps only conclusions, engineers strengthening or rebuilding the bridge ten years later cannot tell whether a frequency change reflects the structure or a different test method; missing truck weights or temperatures make the two tests incomparable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 台北 101
courses.summary: 在既有 24 步的系統觀念之上，本段改用數字與證據深入台北 101：三級風力準則與角隅修形、八支巨柱的力偶與合成斷面容量、SM570M 厚板焊接、380 支岩盤嵌入基樁、2002 年地震塔吊墜落的臨時結構教訓、填充混凝土驗收、兩級地震性能，以及阻尼器事件紀錄與帷幕牆維護。
courses.summaryEn: Building on the existing 24 system-level steps, this extension goes into Taipei 101 with numbers and evidence: three-tier wind criteria and corner notches, the eight-mega-column couple and composite capacity, SM570M thick-plate welding, 380 rock-socketed piles, temporary-works lessons from the 2002 crane collapse, infill-concrete acceptance, two-level seismic performance, damper event records and curtain-wall upkeep.
courses.focus: 以巨柱合成斷面、外伸桁架力偶、台北盆地基樁與施工期臨時結構的實際數字，深化台北 101 的結構檢核
courses.focusEn: Deepening Taipei 101 checks with real numbers on composite mega-columns, outrigger couples, basin piles and construction-stage temporary works
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 超高層建築巨作

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 巨柱檢核練習：某鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱 2.4 m × 3.0 m、板厚 80 mm，f_y = 414 MPa、f_c = 69 MPa。A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m²、A_s = 0.84 m²，名目擠壓強度 N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 720 MN，取強度折減 0.75 得設計容量約 540 MN。外伸桁架傳來的彎矩 12 GN·m 由力臂 40 m、每側 4 支巨柱分擔，ΔN = 12,000/(40×4) = 75 MN；重力軸力 350 MN 時受壓側合計 425 MN，使用率 425/540 ≈ 0.79。若填充混凝土只達 41 MPa，N₀ 約 569 MN、設計容量約 427 MN，使用率升到約 1.00，已無餘裕；若外伸桁架勁度不足使 M_col 降為 8 GN·m，ΔN 減為 50 MN，但核心筒須多承擔 4 GN·m。數值為教學假設，不代表台北 101 的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Mega-column check: a concrete-filled steel box 2.4 m × 3.0 m with 80 mm plate, f_y = 414 MPa and f_c = 69 MPa. A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m² and A_s = 0.84 m², so the nominal squash load is N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 720 MN, or about 540 MN design capacity with a resistance factor of 0.75. An outrigger moment of 12 GN·m shared over a 40 m lever arm by 4 columns per side gives ΔN = 12,000/(40×4) = 75 MN; with 350 MN of gravity load the compression side carries 425 MN, a utilisation of 425/540 ≈ 0.79. If the infill reaches only 41 MPa, N₀ is about 569 MN and design capacity about 427 MN, pushing utilisation to about 1.00 with no margin left; if softer outriggers reduce M_col to 8 GN·m, ΔN drops to 50 MN but the core must carry an extra 4 GN·m. Values are teaching assumptions, not Taipei 101's design values.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 台北 101 建築高度 508 m，地上 101 層、地下 5 層，2004 年完工
周邊共 8 支巨柱，底部約 2.4 m × 3.0 m，以 50 至 80 mm 鋼板焊成
巨柱與核心箱形柱填充約 10,000 psi（約 69 MPa）混凝土，核心柱填至約 62 層
外伸桁架約每 8 至 10 層一道，深度為單層、雙層或三層
塔樓下 380 支直徑 1.5 m 基樁，嵌入岩盤 15 至 33 m，筏基厚 3.0 至 4.7 m
試驗樁壓力試驗最大約 40.6 MN、拉拔試驗最大約 22 MN
風力準則：約半年回歸期檢核舒適度、50 年檢核變位、100 年檢核強度
2002 年 3 月 31 日規模 6.8 地震使 56 樓兩部塔吊墜落，五人罹難
共 61 部電梯，最高速度約 16.83 m/s
2015 年蘇迪勒颱風時主擺錘擺幅約 100 cm
factsEn: Taipei 101 is 508 m tall with 101 storeys above ground and 5 below, completed in 2004
Eight perimeter mega-columns measure about 2.4 m × 3.0 m at the base, built from 50 to 80 mm plates
Mega-columns and core box columns are filled with about 10,000 psi (about 69 MPa) concrete, the core columns to about level 62
Outriggers occur about every 8 to 10 floors and are one, two or three storeys deep
380 piles of 1.5 m diameter under the tower are socketed 15 to 33 m into rock beneath a raft 3.0 to 4.7 m thick
Trial piles were tested to about 40.6 MN in compression and about 22 MN in pull-out
Wind criteria: about a half-year return period for comfort, 50 years for drift and 100 years for strength
The magnitude 6.8 earthquake of 31 March 2002 toppled two cranes from level 56, killing five people
61 elevators with a top speed of about 16.83 m/s
The main pendulum swung about 100 cm in Typhoon Soudelor in 2015

newStages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「三級風力準則與角隅修形」與「外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping" and "Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 三級風力準則與角隅修形：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「角隅鋸齒缺角」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sawtooth corner notches” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 的風工程不是單一設計風速，而是三組回歸期各管一件事：約半年回歸期檢核居住舒適度、50 年回歸期檢核變位、100 年回歸期檢核構材強度。風洞試驗後，建築在四個角隅做出鋸齒狀缺角，讓氣流在角部提早分離並打亂整齊的渦流脫落，使橫風向反應明顯降低。角隅修形同時改變帷幕牆的局部風壓分布，因此構架、阻尼器與外牆三方都必須使用同一份風洞資料，而不是各自套用規範公式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「角隅鋸齒缺角」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101's wind engineering is not one design wind speed but three return periods, each governing a different check: roughly a half-year event for occupant comfort, a 50-year event for drift and a 100-year event for member strength. After wind-tunnel testing, the four corners were given sawtooth notches that trigger early flow separation and break up organised vortex shedding, clearly reducing across-wind response. Corner shaping also changes local cladding pressures, so the frame, damper and façade teams must all work from the same wind-tunnel dataset rather than each applying code formulas on their own. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sawtooth corner notches” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以均布等效風壓估計基底彎矩 M = ½·q·C·B·H²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Estimate the base moment from a uniform equivalent pressure, M = ½·q·C·B·H².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「角隅缺角主要是造型裝飾，對結構風力沒有實質影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Corner notches are mainly decorative and have no real effect on structural wind loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「角隅鋸齒缺角」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sawtooth corner notches”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 三級風力準則與角隅修形
knowledge.titleEn: Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping
knowledge.text: 台北 101 的風工程不是單一設計風速，而是三組回歸期各管一件事：約半年回歸期檢核居住舒適度、50 年回歸期檢核變位、100 年回歸期檢核構材強度。風洞試驗後，建築在四個角隅做出鋸齒狀缺角，讓氣流在角部提早分離並打亂整齊的渦流脫落，使橫風向反應明顯降低。
knowledge.textEn: Taipei 101's wind engineering is not one design wind speed but three return periods, each governing a different check: roughly a half-year event for occupant comfort, a 50-year event for drift and a 100-year event for member strength. After wind-tunnel testing, the four corners were given sawtooth notches that trigger early flow separation and break up organised vortex shedding, clearly reducing across-wind response.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：角隅缺角主要是造型裝飾，對結構風力沒有實質影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Corner notches are mainly decorative and have no real effect on structural wind loads. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「三級風力準則與角隅修形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping" is correct?
options: 角隅缺角主要是造型裝飾，對結構風力沒有實質影響。
台北 101 的風工程不是單一設計風速，而是三組回歸期各管一件事：約半年回歸期檢核居住舒適度、50 年回歸期檢核變位、100 年回歸期檢核構材強度。
外伸桁架設得越多越好，每層都設最能減少變位。
optionsEn: Corner notches are mainly decorative and have no real effect on structural wind loads.

Taipei 101's wind engineering is not one design wind speed but three return periods, each governing a different check: roughly a half-year event for occupant comfort, a 50-year event for drift and a 100-year event for member strength.
The more outriggers the better; one on every floor reduces drift most.
quiz.explanation: 台北 101 的風工程不是單一設計風速，而是三組回歸期各管一件事：約半年回歸期檢核居住舒適度、50 年回歸期檢核變位、100 年回歸期檢核構材強度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Taipei 101's wind engineering is not one design wind speed but three return periods, each governing a different check: roughly a half-year event for occupant comfort, a 50-year event for drift and a 100-year event for member strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 三級風力準則與角隅修形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「角隅鋸齒缺角」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sawtooth corner notches” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以均布等效風壓估計基底彎矩 M = ½·q·C·B·H²。取 q = 2.5 kPa、C = 1.3、B = 50 m、H = 500 m，M = 0.5×2,500×1.3×50×500² ≈ 20.3 GN·m；若角隅修形使等效係數降低 25%，M 約降為 15.2 GN·m，基礎與巨柱軸力隨之同比例減少。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Estimate the base moment from a uniform equivalent pressure, M = ½·q·C·B·H². With q = 2.5 kPa, C = 1.3, B = 50 m and H = 500 m, M = 0.5×2,500×1.3×50×500² ≈ 20.3 GN·m; if corner shaping lowers the equivalent coefficient by 25%, M falls to about 15.2 GN·m and foundation and mega-column forces drop in proportion. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：要求風洞報告分別列出三種回歸期的基底彎矩、變位與頂層加速度，並附角隅修形與未修形的比較試驗；高頻力平衡結果要以結構實際模態重新組合，再與規範公式估算比對，差異超過約兩成時必須查明原因並書面說明。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Require the wind-tunnel report to list base moments, drifts and top-floor accelerations separately for the three return periods, with comparative tests of notched and unnotched corners; recombine force-balance results with the structure's actual modes, compare with code-formula estimates, and investigate and document any difference larger than about 20%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以均布等效風壓估計基底彎矩 M = ½·q·C·B·H²。取 q = 2.5 kPa、C = 1.3、B = 50 m、H = 500 m，M = 0.5×2,500×1.3×50×500² ≈ 20.3 GN·m；若角隅修形使等效係數降低 25%，M 約降為 15.2 GN·m，基礎與巨柱軸力隨之同比例減少。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate the base moment from a uniform equivalent pressure, M = ½·q·C·B·H². With q = 2.5 kPa, C = 1.3, B = 50 m and H = 500 m, M = 0.5×2,500×1.3×50×500² ≈ 20.3 GN·m; if corner shaping lowers the equivalent coefficient by 25%, M falls to about 15.2 GN·m and foundation and mega-column forces drop in proportion. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「三級風力準則與角隅修形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping", which statement holds?
options: 鋼材強度等級越高越好，降伏比高一點也沒有關係。
塔吊是臨時設備，不需要考慮地震力。
以均布等效風壓估計基底彎矩 M = ½·q·C·B·H²。
optionsEn: The higher the steel grade the better, and a high yield ratio does not matter.
Tower cranes are temporary equipment and need not be designed for earthquakes.
Estimate the base moment from a uniform equivalent pressure, M = ½·q·C·B·H².
quiz.explanation: 以均布等效風壓估計基底彎矩 M = ½·q·C·B·H²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate the base moment from a uniform equivalent pressure, M = ½·q·C·B·H². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 三級風力準則與角隅修形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「角隅鋸齒缺角」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sawtooth corner notches” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 要求風洞報告分別列出三種回歸期的基底彎矩、變位與頂層加速度，並附角隅修形與未修形的比較試驗；高頻力平衡結果要以結構實際模態重新組合，再與規範公式估算比對，差異超過約兩成時必須查明原因並書面說明。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Require the wind-tunnel report to list base moments, drifts and top-floor accelerations separately for the three return periods, with comparative tests of notched and unnotched corners; recombine force-balance results with the structure's actual modes, compare with code-formula estimates, and investigate and document any difference larger than about 20%. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把三級風力準則與允收值寫入結構設計基準書，任何外形變更（角隅尺寸、塔頂與帷幕牆突出物）都必須回送風工程顧問評估，並在變更紀錄中保留風洞比對資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write the three-tier wind criteria and acceptance values into the structural design basis, send any change of external form (corner dimensions, crown, façade projections) back to the wind consultant for assessment, and keep the wind-tunnel comparison in the change record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只拿 100 年強度風載設計構架而未檢核半年回歸期加速度，結構雖安全，常見颱風時高樓層使用者仍會明顯不適；若角隅缺角在施工中為了帷幕牆單元化而被簡化，實際風力可能回到未修形的較高水準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing the frame only for 100-year strength loads without checking half-year accelerations leaves a safe structure that still makes upper-floor occupants uncomfortable in common typhoons; if the corner notches are simplified during construction to ease unitised cladding, actual wind forces can revert to the higher unnotched level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 要求風洞報告分別列出三種回歸期的基底彎矩、變位與頂層加速度，並附角隅修形與未修形的比較試驗；高頻力平衡結果要以結構實際模態重新組合，再與規範公式估算比對，差異超過約兩成時必須查明原因並書面說明。
knowledge.textEn: Require the wind-tunnel report to list base moments, drifts and top-floor accelerations separately for the three return periods, with comparative tests of notched and unnotched corners; recombine force-balance results with the structure's actual modes, compare with code-formula estimates, and investigate and document any difference larger than about 20%.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把三級風力準則與允收值寫入結構設計基準書，任何外形變更（角隅尺寸、塔頂與帷幕牆突出物）都必須回送風工程顧問評估，並在變更紀錄中保留風洞比對資料。
knowledge.textEn: Write the three-tier wind criteria and acceptance values into the structural design basis, send any change of external form (corner dimensions, crown, façade projections) back to the wind consultant for assessment, and keep the wind-tunnel comparison in the change record.

quiz.question: 要驗證「三級風力準則與角隅修形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping"?
options: 要求風洞報告分別列出三種回歸期的基底彎矩、變位與頂層加速度，並附角隅修形與未修形的比較試驗。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
雙重系統中的抗彎構架只是分擔核心剩下的力，從不需要單獨承擔。
optionsEn: Require the wind-tunnel report to list base moments, drifts and top-floor accelerations separately for the three return periods, with comparative tests of notched and unnotched corners.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
In a dual system the moment frame only shares what the core leaves over and never needs to stand alone.
quiz.explanation: 要求風洞報告分別列出三種回歸期的基底彎矩、變位與頂層加速度，並附角隅修形與未修形的比較試驗；高頻力平衡結果要以結構實際模態重新組合，再與規範公式估算比對，差異超過約兩成時必須查明原因並書面說明。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Require the wind-tunnel report to list base moments, drifts and top-floor accelerations separately for the three return periods, with comparative tests of notched and unnotched corners; recombine force-balance results with the structure's actual modes, compare with code-formula estimates, and investigate and document any difference larger than about 20%. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 三級風力準則與角隅修形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「角隅鋸齒缺角」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sawtooth corner notches” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只拿 100 年強度風載設計構架而未檢核半年回歸期加速度，結構雖安全，常見颱風時高樓層使用者仍會明顯不適；若角隅缺角在施工中為了帷幕牆單元化而被簡化，實際風力可能回到未修形的較高水準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing the frame only for 100-year strength loads without checking half-year accelerations leaves a safe structure that still makes upper-floor occupants uncomfortable in common typhoons; if the corner notches are simplified during construction to ease unitised cladding, actual wind forces can revert to the higher unnotched level. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：角隅修形同時改變帷幕牆的局部風壓分布，因此構架、阻尼器與外牆三方都必須使用同一份風洞資料，而不是各自套用規範公式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Corner shaping also changes local cladding pressures, so the frame, damper and façade teams must all work from the same wind-tunnel dataset rather than each applying code formulas on their own.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「角隅缺角主要是造型裝飾，對結構風力沒有實質影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「八支巨柱的力偶」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eight-mega-column couple” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 周邊有八支巨柱（每面兩支），26 樓以下每面另有次巨柱與角柱經帶狀桁架加入；外伸桁架約每 8 至 10 層一道，依位置做成單層、雙層或三層高。核心筒受風彎曲時，外伸桁架像槓桿一樣把核心的轉角變成巨柱軸力：一側減壓、另一側增壓，形成力偶抵抗大部分傾覆彎矩。因為巨柱本身已承受很大的重力壓力，風或地震造成的軸力變化多半只是減少壓力，但柱續接仍須檢核少量的淨上拉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「八支巨柱的力偶」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101 has eight perimeter mega-columns, two per face; below level 26, sub-super columns and corner columns on each face are engaged through belt trusses. Outriggers occur about every 8 to 10 floors and are one, two or three storeys deep depending on location. When the core bends in wind, the outriggers act as levers that turn core rotation into mega-column axial force, unloading one side and adding compression to the other, so a couple resists most of the overturning moment. Because the mega-columns already carry heavy gravity compression, wind or seismic axial changes mostly reduce compression, yet column splices must still be checked for small net uplift. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Eight-mega-column couple” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：巨柱力偶 ΔN = M_col/(a·n)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mega-column couple ΔN = M_col/(a·n).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外伸桁架設得越多越好，每層都設最能減少變位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more outriggers the better; one on every floor reduces drift most." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「八支巨柱的力偶」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eight-mega-column couple” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：巨柱力偶 ΔN = M_col/(a·n)。若外伸桁架交給巨柱的彎矩 M_col = 12 GN·m，受拉側與受壓側巨柱群形心距 a = 40 m、每側 n = 4 支，ΔN = 12×10⁹/(40×4) = 75 MN；重力軸力若為 350 MN，風作用時兩側分別為 275 MN 與 425 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mega-column couple ΔN = M_col/(a·n). If the outriggers deliver M_col = 12 GN·m to the columns, with a = 40 m between tension-side and compression-side group centroids and n = 4 columns per side, ΔN = 12×10⁹/(40×4) = 75 MN; with 350 MN of gravity load, the two sides carry 275 MN and 425 MN under wind. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維模型中分別輸出核心與巨柱各自承擔的傾覆彎矩比例，並與只有核心時的頂層變位比較；再以手算力偶核對各道外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿力，確認每一道外伸桁架的分擔比例與其勁度排序一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output from the three-dimensional model the share of overturning carried by the core and by the mega-columns, and compare top drift with a core-only model; then check the chord and diagonal forces in each outrigger level with a hand couple calculation, confirming that each level's share matches its stiffness ranking.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 在三維模型中分別輸出核心與巨柱各自承擔的傾覆彎矩比例，並與只有核心時的頂層變位比較；再以手算力偶核對各道外伸桁架的弦桿與斜桿力，確認每一道外伸桁架的分擔比例與其勁度排序一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 現場實務：在設計書中列出每一道外伸桁架的樓層、深度、所連接的巨柱與分擔比例，柱續接處標明最大淨上拉的載重組合，並要求鋼構製造圖保留這些標記以便現場查核。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估；反之若接合過早鎖固而未考慮差異縮短，巨柱與外伸桁架會在完工後承受額外的重力附加力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估；反之若接合過早鎖固而未考慮差異縮短，巨柱與外伸桁架會在完工後承受額外的重力附加力。
knowledge.textEn: Overestimating the stiffness of outrigger-to-column joints makes the modelled couple larger than reality and understates core bending; conversely, locking the joints too early without allowing for differential shortening imposes additional gravity-induced forces on columns and outriggers after completion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外伸桁架把傾覆彎矩轉成巨柱軸力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outriggers turn overturning into mega-column axial force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼箱巨柱裡的混凝土只是為了增加重量與防火。
若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The concrete inside a steel-box mega-column is only there to add weight and fire protection.
Overestimating the stiffness of outrigger-to-column joints makes the modelled couple larger than reality and understates core bending.
quiz.explanation: 若外伸桁架與巨柱接合的勁度被高估，模型中的力偶會比實際大，核心筒承受的彎矩被低估；反之若接合過早鎖固而未考慮差異縮短，巨柱與外伸桁架會在完工後承受額外的重力附加力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Overestimating the stiffness of outrigger-to-column joints makes the modelled couple larger than reality and understates core bending; conversely, locking the joints too early without allowing for differential shortening imposes additional gravity-induced forces on columns and outriggers after completion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量」與「高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Composite mega-column section and axial capacity" and "High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite mega-column section and axial capacity: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 的巨柱底部約 2.4 m × 3.0 m，由厚 50 至 80 mm 的鋼板焊成箱形，內灌設計強度約 10,000 psi（約 69 MPa）的高強度混凝土，並以內部繫材防止鋼板外鼓。鋼箱提供模板、圍束與抗拉能力，混凝土提供大部分軸壓勁度並阻止鋼板向內挫屈，兩者合作的效率高於各自單獨使用。斷面隨高度逐段縮小，填充高度也分段結束（核心箱形柱與巨柱填至約 62 層），每一段的合成比例不同，計算必須逐段進行。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101's mega-columns are about 2.4 m × 3.0 m at the base, welded into boxes from 50 to 80 mm plates and filled with high-strength concrete of about 10,000 psi (about 69 MPa) design strength, with internal ties preventing the plates from bulging. The steel box provides formwork, confinement and tension capacity, while the concrete supplies most of the axial stiffness and stops the plates buckling inwards, so together they outperform either material alone. The section shrinks with height and the fill stops at different levels (core box columns and super columns are filled to about level 62), so the composite proportions change and must be checked segment by segment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：名目擠壓強度 N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Nominal squash load N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼箱巨柱裡的混凝土只是為了增加重量與防火。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The concrete inside a steel-box mega-column is only there to add weight and fire protection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量
knowledge.titleEn: Composite mega-column section and axial capacity
knowledge.text: 台北 101 的巨柱底部約 2.4 m × 3.0 m，由厚 50 至 80 mm 的鋼板焊成箱形，內灌設計強度約 10,000 psi（約 69 MPa）的高強度混凝土，並以內部繫材防止鋼板外鼓。鋼箱提供模板、圍束與抗拉能力，混凝土提供大部分軸壓勁度並阻止鋼板向內挫屈，兩者合作的效率高於各自單獨使用。
knowledge.textEn: Taipei 101's mega-columns are about 2.4 m × 3.0 m at the base, welded into boxes from 50 to 80 mm plates and filled with high-strength concrete of about 10,000 psi (about 69 MPa) design strength, with internal ties preventing the plates from bulging. The steel box provides formwork, confinement and tension capacity, while the concrete supplies most of the axial stiffness and stops the plates buckling inwards, so together they outperform either material alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼箱巨柱裡的混凝土只是為了增加重量與防火。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The concrete inside a steel-box mega-column is only there to add weight and fire protection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Composite mega-column section and axial capacity" is correct?
options: 台北 101 的巨柱底部約 2.4 m × 3.0 m，由厚 50 至 80 mm 的鋼板焊成箱形，內灌設計強度約 10,000 psi（約 69 MPa）的高強度混凝土，並以內部繫材防止鋼板外鼓。
鋼箱巨柱裡的混凝土只是為了增加重量與防火。
鋼材強度等級越高越好，降伏比高一點也沒有關係。
optionsEn: Taipei 101's mega-columns are about 2.4 m × 3.0 m at the base, welded into boxes from 50 to 80 mm plates and filled with high-strength concrete of about 10,000 psi (about 69 MPa) design strength, with internal ties preventing the plates from bulging.
The concrete inside a steel-box mega-column is only there to add weight and fire protection.
The higher the steel grade the better, and a high yield ratio does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 台北 101 的巨柱底部約 2.4 m × 3.0 m，由厚 50 至 80 mm 的鋼板焊成箱形，內灌設計強度約 10,000 psi（約 69 MPa）的高強度混凝土，並以內部繫材防止鋼板外鼓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Taipei 101's mega-columns are about 2.4 m × 3.0 m at the base, welded into boxes from 50 to 80 mm plates and filled with high-strength concrete of about 10,000 psi (about 69 MPa) design strength, with internal ties preventing the plates from bulging. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Composite mega-column section and axial capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：名目擠壓強度 N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c。2.4 m × 3.0 m、板厚 80 mm：A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m²、A_s = 7.20 − 6.36 = 0.84 m²；f_y = 414 MPa、f_c = 69 MPa，N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 347 + 373 = 720 MN。若混凝土只有 41 MPa，N₀ 約 569 MN，下降約 21%。數值為教學假設，未計長細比與強度折減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Nominal squash load N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c. For 2.4 m × 3.0 m with 80 mm plate: A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m² and A_s = 7.20 − 6.36 = 0.84 m²; with f_y = 414 MPa and f_c = 69 MPa, N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 347 + 373 = 720 MN. With only 41 MPa concrete N₀ is about 569 MN, roughly 21% less. Teaching assumptions, ignoring slenderness and resistance factors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐段建立巨柱斷面表（外尺寸、板厚、填充起訖樓層、混凝土強度），以合成柱公式與有限元素斷面分析互相核對；確認重力加風或地震組合下的軸力比在允許範圍，並檢查柱續接與隔板位置與製造圖一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a segment-by-segment mega-column schedule (outer size, plate thickness, fill start and end levels, concrete strength), cross-check composite-column formulas with finite-element section analysis, confirm the axial-load ratio under gravity plus wind or earthquake is within limits, and check that splice and diaphragm locations match the shop drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Nominal squash load N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c. For 2.4 m × 3.0 m with 80 mm plate: A_c = 2.24×2.84 = 6.36 m² and A_s = 7.20 − 6.36 = 0.84 m²; with f_y = 414 MPa and f_c = 69 MPa, N₀ = 0.84×414 + 0.85×69×6.36 ≈ 347 + 373 = 720 MN. With only 41 MPa concrete N₀ is about 569 MN, roughly 21% less. Teaching assumptions, ignoring slenderness and resistance factors.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Composite mega-column section and axial capacity", which statement holds?
options: 塔吊是臨時設備，不需要考慮地震力。
名目擠壓強度 N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c。
雙重系統中的抗彎構架只是分擔核心剩下的力，從不需要單獨承擔。
optionsEn: Tower cranes are temporary equipment and need not be designed for earthquakes.
Nominal squash load N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c.
In a dual system the moment frame only shares what the core leaves over and never needs to stand alone.
quiz.explanation: 名目擠壓強度 N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Nominal squash load N₀ = A_s·f_y + 0.85·f_c·A_c. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Composite mega-column section and axial capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete-filled steel box mega-column” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐段建立巨柱斷面表（外尺寸、板厚、填充起訖樓層、混凝土強度），以合成柱公式與有限元素斷面分析互相核對；確認重力加風或地震組合下的軸力比在允許範圍，並檢查柱續接與隔板位置與製造圖一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a segment-by-segment mega-column schedule (outer size, plate thickness, fill start and end levels, concrete strength), cross-check composite-column formulas with finite-element section analysis, confirm the axial-load ratio under gravity plus wind or earthquake is within limits, and check that splice and diaphragm locations match the shop drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：巨柱斷面表要同時出現在結構圖、鋼構製造圖與混凝土澆置計畫，每一段標明填充起訖樓層與強度；每次澆置前由監造確認隔板排氣孔與灌注孔位置，列為停止點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Show the mega-column schedule on the structural drawings, steel shop drawings and concrete placement plan, marking fill start and end levels and strength for each segment; before every pour the resident engineer confirms diaphragm vent and filling holes as a hold point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若圖面上的填充高度與實際澆置高度不符，未填充段只能靠鋼板單獨受力，容量可能比計算值少兩成以上；混凝土收縮在隔板下方留下空隙時，該處的圍束與傳力也會局部失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the drawn fill level differs from the actual pour, unfilled segments rely on the steel plates alone and can fall more than 20% below the calculated capacity; shrinkage voids under diaphragm plates also locally defeat confinement and load transfer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐段建立巨柱斷面表（外尺寸、板厚、填充起訖樓層、混凝土強度），以合成柱公式與有限元素斷面分析互相核對；確認重力加風或地震組合下的軸力比在允許範圍，並檢查柱續接與隔板位置與製造圖一致。
knowledge.textEn: Build a segment-by-segment mega-column schedule (outer size, plate thickness, fill start and end levels, concrete strength), cross-check composite-column formulas with finite-element section analysis, confirm the axial-load ratio under gravity plus wind or earthquake is within limits, and check that splice and diaphragm locations match the shop drawings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 巨柱斷面表要同時出現在結構圖、鋼構製造圖與混凝土澆置計畫，每一段標明填充起訖樓層與強度；每次澆置前由監造確認隔板排氣孔與灌注孔位置，列為停止點。
knowledge.textEn: Show the mega-column schedule on the structural drawings, steel shop drawings and concrete placement plan, marking fill start and end levels and strength for each segment; before every pour the resident engineer confirms diaphragm vent and filling holes as a hold point.

quiz.question: 要驗證「巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Composite mega-column section and axial capacity"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

quiz.explanation: 逐段建立巨柱斷面表（外尺寸、板厚、填充起訖樓層、混凝土強度），以合成柱公式與有限元素斷面分析互相核對；確認重力加風或地震組合下的軸力比在允許範圍，並檢查柱續接與隔板位置與製造圖一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a segment-by-segment mega-column schedule (outer size, plate thickness, fill start and end levels, concrete strength), cross-check composite-column formulas with finite-element section analysis, confirm the axial-load ratio under gravity plus wind or earthquake is within limits, and check that splice and diaphragm locations match the shop drawings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 巨柱合成斷面與軸壓容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Composite mega-column section and axial capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 若圖面上的填充高度與實際澆置高度不符，未填充段只能靠鋼板單獨受力，容量可能比計算值少兩成以上；混凝土收縮在隔板下方留下空隙時，該處的圍束與傳力也會局部失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “SM570M thick plates and column splices” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 的主要鋼構使用 SM570M 等級鋼材，降伏強度約 60 ksi 以上，板厚可達 80 mm。厚板焊接時冷卻快、拘束大，容易產生氫致裂紋與層狀撕裂，因此規格同時限制碳當量（板厚 40 mm 以下約 0.44%、40 mm 以上約 0.47%）與降伏比（較厚的梁與斜撐約 80%、較薄者約 85%），確保焊接性與塑性變形能力。柱續接採全滲透焊，以抵抗風與地震下可能出現的少量淨上拉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipei 101's main steelwork uses SM570M steel with a yield strength of about 60 ksi or more and plates up to 80 mm thick. Thick plates cool quickly and are highly restrained during welding, inviting hydrogen cracking and lamellar tearing, so the specification limited both the carbon equivalent (about 0.44% for plates under 40 mm and about 0.47% for 40 mm and thicker) and the yield ratio (about 80% for thicker girders and braces, about 85% for thinner ones) to secure weldability and plastic deformation capacity. Column splices are full-penetration welds to resist the small net uplift that wind and earthquakes can produce. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “SM570M thick plates and column splices” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：碳當量 Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Carbon equivalent Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼材強度等級越高越好，降伏比高一點也沒有關係。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the steel grade the better, and a high yield ratio does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “SM570M thick plates and column splices” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：碳當量 Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15。取 C 0.16、Mn 1.45、Cr 0.02、Mo 0、V 0.04、Ni 0.02、Cu 0.02，Ceq = 0.16 + 0.242 + 0.012 + 0.003 ≈ 0.42%，低於 0.47% 上限；降伏比 440/600 ≈ 0.73，低於 0.80。數值為教學假設，不是實際鋼廠成分。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Carbon equivalent Ceq = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Ni+Cu)/15. With C 0.16, Mn 1.45, Cr 0.02, Mo 0, V 0.04, Ni 0.02 and Cu 0.02, Ceq = 0.16 + 0.242 + 0.012 + 0.003 ≈ 0.42%, below the 0.47% limit; the yield ratio 440/600 ≈ 0.73 is below 0.80. Teaching assumptions, not actual mill chemistry. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一爐號的鋼材證明書都要核對化學成分、降伏比與板厚方向性能（Z 向斷面收縮率），焊接程序以實際板厚做資格檢定；施焊時記錄預熱與層間溫度，完成後以超音波檢測全滲透焊並依規範判定合格與否。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check every heat's mill certificate for chemistry, yield ratio and through-thickness (Z-direction reduction of area) properties, qualify welding procedures on the actual plate thickness, record preheat and interpass temperatures during welding, and ultrasonically test every full-penetration weld against the code acceptance criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “SM570M thick plates and column splices” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一爐號的鋼材證明書都要核對化學成分、降伏比與板厚方向性能（Z 向斷面收縮率），焊接程序以實際板厚做資格檢定；施焊時記錄預熱與層間溫度，完成後以超音波檢測全滲透焊並依規範判定合格與否。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對厚板全滲透焊設定「冷卻 48 小時後才做超音波檢測」的停止點，保留每道焊道的焊工代號、預熱紀錄與檢測報告；任何補焊都要重新檢測，並經設計單位同意後才可覆蓋。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set a hold point of ultrasonic testing no earlier than 48 hours after cooling for thick full-penetration welds, keep the welder ID, preheat record and test report for each weld, and re-test every repair weld, covering it only after the designer approves.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：厚板未充分預熱或焊材含氫量過高時，焊後數小時至數天才出現的延遲裂紋可能在檢測前就被覆蓋；層狀撕裂常出現在 T 形接頭的母材內部，在地震反覆載重下會成為斷裂起點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without adequate preheat or with high-hydrogen consumables, delayed cracks that appear hours or days after welding may be covered before inspection; lamellar tears form inside the base metal of T-joints and become fracture initiation points under cyclic seismic loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「SM570M 厚鋼板與柱續接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “SM570M thick plates and column splices” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 厚板未充分預熱或焊材含氫量過高時，焊後數小時至數天才出現的延遲裂紋可能在檢測前就被覆蓋；層狀撕裂常出現在 T 形接頭的母材內部，在地震反覆載重下會成為斷裂起點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without adequate preheat or with high-hydrogen consumables, delayed cracks that appear hours or days after welding may be covered before inspection; lamellar tears form inside the base metal of T-joints and become fracture initiation points under cyclic seismic loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：柱續接採全滲透焊，以抵抗風與地震下可能出現的少量淨上拉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Column splices are full-penetration welds to resist the small net uplift that wind and earthquakes can produce.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼材強度等級越高越好，降伏比高一點也沒有關係。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the steel grade the better, and a high yield ratio does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 厚板未充分預熱或焊材含氫量過高時，焊後數小時至數天才出現的延遲裂紋可能在檢測前就被覆蓋；層狀撕裂常出現在 T 形接頭的母材內部，在地震反覆載重下會成為斷裂起點。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高強度厚板鋼材與全滲透焊接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High-strength thick plate and full-penetration welding" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
厚板未充分預熱或焊材含氫量過高時，焊後數小時至數天才出現的延遲裂紋可能在檢測前就被覆蓋；層狀撕裂常出現在 T 形接頭的母材內部，在地震反覆載重下會成為斷裂起點。
只要基樁打到岩盤，沉陷就可以忽略。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without adequate preheat or with high-hydrogen consumables, delayed cracks that appear hours or days after welding may be covered before inspection.
Once piles reach bedrock, settlement can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 厚板未充分預熱或焊材含氫量過高時，焊後數小時至數天才出現的延遲裂紋可能在檢測前就被覆蓋；層狀撕裂常出現在 T 形接頭的母材內部，在地震反覆載重下會成為斷裂起點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without adequate preheat or with high-hydrogen consumables, delayed cracks that appear hours or days after welding may be covered before inspection; lamellar tears form inside the base metal of T-joints and become fracture initiation points under cyclic seismic loading. newStages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基」與「331 地震塔吊墜落與臨時結構耐震」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin" and "The 2002 crane collapse and seismic design of temporary works": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「反循環基樁與岩盤嵌入」如何影響台北 101的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reverse-circulation piles and rock sockets” governs force, deformation or durability in “Taipei 101”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 台北 101 基地上方約 30 m 為湖積粉土質黏土（上部約 20 m 很軟），其下為崩積層，岩盤（桂竹林層）約在地表下 40 至 65 m，頂部約 10 m 膠結不良。塔樓下設 380 支直徑 1.5 m、中心距約 3.96 m 的反循環鑽掘基樁，嵌入岩盤 15 至 33 m，上方為厚 3.0 至 4.7 m 的筏基，配合約 22 m 深的五層地下室開挖。基樁主要靠岩盤段的側摩擦承載，筏基則把巨柱與核心的集中力分配到整個樁群。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「反循環基樁與岩盤嵌入」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At the Taipei 101 site the top 30 m or so is lacustrine silty clay, the upper 20 m very soft, over colluvium, with bedrock of the Kueichulin Formation at about 40 to 65 m below ground and a poorly cemented top 10 m. Under the tower, 380 reverse-circulation bored piles of 1.5 m diameter at about 3.96 m centres are socketed 15 to 33 m into rock, capped by a raft 3.0 to 4.7 m thick within an excavation about 22 m deep for the five-level basement. The piles carry load mainly by side friction in the rock socket, while the raft spreads the concentrated mega-column and core loads across the whole group. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Reverse-circulation piles and rock sockets” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：岩盤段側摩擦 Q = π·D·L·f_s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Rock-socket side resistance Q = π·D·L·f_s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要基樁打到岩盤，沉陷就可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once piles reach bedrock, settlement can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「反循環基樁與岩盤嵌入」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Reverse-circulation piles and rock sockets”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 台北盆地軟黏土上的基樁與筏基
knowledge.titleEn: Piles and raft in the soft Taipei basin
