steps.objective: 說明「超高速電梯曳引鋼索」如何影響上海中心大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ultra-fast elevator hoist ropes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Shanghai Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 上海中心有 106 部電梯，最高速度 20.5 m/s，超長行程的曳引鋼索與補償鋼索像一條很長的弦，自然頻率隨車廂位置改變。當建築在強風下以數秒以上的週期擺動，若鋼索某一長度的頻率接近建築頻率，鋼索就會在井道內共振擺動，碰撞井道設備或纏繞。這個問題屬於結構與機電的介面：結構提供建築頻率與擺幅，電梯系統依此設定強風時的停靠樓層、降速或暫停營運模式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「超高速電梯曳引鋼索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shanghai Tower has 106 elevators with a top speed of 20.5 m/s. Very long hoist and compensation ropes behave like long strings whose natural frequency changes with car position. When the building sways with a period of several seconds in strong wind and some rope length has a frequency near the building's, the rope resonates in the shaft, striking equipment or tangling. This is a structure–services interface: the structure supplies building frequency and amplitude, and the elevator system uses them to set high-wind parking floors, reduced speed or suspended service. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ultra-fast elevator hoist ropes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：弦振動頻率 f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: String frequency f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ).

steps.title: 電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超高速電梯曳引鋼索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ultra-fast elevator hoist ropes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：弦振動頻率 f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ)。張力 T = 100 kN、單位質量 μ = 8 kg/m 時波速 √(100,000/8) ≈ 112 m/s；自由長度 L = 500 m 時 f ≈ 112/1,000 ≈ 0.112 Hz，與週期 9 s 的建築頻率 0.111 Hz 幾乎相同；車廂移到中段使 L = 250 m 時 f ≈ 0.224 Hz，可避開共振。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: String frequency f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ). With tension T = 100 kN and mass μ = 8 kg/m the wave speed is √(100,000/8) ≈ 112 m/s; for a free length L = 500 m, f ≈ 112/1,000 ≈ 0.112 Hz, almost equal to the 0.111 Hz of a building with a 9 s period; moving the car to mid-height so that L = 250 m gives f ≈ 0.224 Hz, away from resonance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以結構模型或實測取得建築前幾個模態頻率與預期擺幅，交給電梯廠商做鋼索擺動模擬；完工後在頂部設加速度計與風速計，連動電梯控制系統，於強風事件後檢查井道內鋼索磨損與設備碰撞痕跡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Provide the elevator supplier with the building's first few modal frequencies and expected amplitudes from the model or measurements for rope-sway simulation; after completion link rooftop accelerometers and anemometers to the elevator controls, and after high-wind events inspect shafts for rope wear and impact marks on equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With tension T = 100 kN and mass μ = 8 kg/m the wave speed is √(100,000/8) ≈ 112 m/s; for a free length L = 500 m, f ≈ 112/1,000 ≈ 0.112 Hz, almost equal to the 0.111 Hz of a building with a 9 s period; moving the car to mid-height so that L = 250 m gives f ≈ 0.224 Hz, away from resonance. steps.observation: 現場實務：結構設計者應提供電梯顧問書面的模態頻率、預期擺幅與量測資料，雙方共同訂定強風營運模式的啟動門檻；建築重大改裝或阻尼器調整後，須重新確認這些門檻。

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the elevator design ignores building sway, ropes can swing widely in strong wind, damaging rail brackets or snagging landing equipment and causing long outages; passengers trapped in cars at height also become a difficult rescue problem. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若電梯設計沒有考慮建築擺動，強風時鋼索可能在井道內大幅擺動，撞壞導軌支架或纏住樓層設備，造成長時間停駛；乘客受困於高空車廂也會成為緊急救援的難題。
knowledge.textEn: If the elevator design ignores building sway, ropes can swing widely in strong wind, damaging rail brackets or snagging landing equipment and causing long outages; passengers trapped in cars at height also become a difficult rescue problem.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

courses.title: 東京晴空塔
courses.summary: 從三角形基底到圓形頂部的塔身斷面與格構風力出發，理解心柱與鋼塔之間以油壓阻尼器耦合的減振機制，計算直徑 2.3 m 鋼管與節狀壁樁的容量，再處理日照彎曲下的施工測量、在中央豎井內頂升天線塔、阻尼器的雙線性特性驗證、2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查，最後是冬季落冰與鋼管塔的防蝕維護。
courses.summaryEn: Starting from the tower's triangle-to-circle section and the wind force on an open lattice, understand how the central column and steel tower are coupled through oil dampers to reduce vibration, compute the capacity of 2.3 m steel tubes and knuckle-wall piles, then handle construction surveys under solar bowing, lifting the antenna mast inside the central shaft, verifying bilinear damper behaviour, inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake, and finally falling ice and corrosion upkeep of a tubular steel tower.
courses.focus: 三角形鋼管桁架塔身、獨立鋼筋混凝土心柱與油壓阻尼的「心柱制振」，以及節狀壁樁基礎如何支撐 634 m 電波塔
courses.focusEn: How a triangular tubular steel truss, an independent concrete central column with oil dampers and knuckle-wall foundations carry a 634 m broadcasting tower
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 三腳塔腳柱受力練習：底部為邊長 s = 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱到形心距 R = s/√3 ≈ 39.3 m。若風造成的傾覆彎矩 M = 3,000 MN·m 作用於平行某一邊的軸，對應頂點腳柱的軸力變化 F₁ = M/(1.5R) ≈ 3,000/58.9 ≈ 50.9 MN，另兩腳各 F₂ = M/(3R) ≈ 25.5 MN、方向相反。設總重 400 MN、每腳 133.3 MN：頂點腳柱減壓後剩 133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 82.4 MN，另兩腳增為約 158.8 MN；風向反轉時頂點腳約 184.3 MN、另兩腳約 107.9 MN。若地震垂直加速度使重力暫時減少 30%，頂點腳只剩 0.7×133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 42.4 MN。若底邊縮為 50 m，R ≈ 28.9 m、F₁ ≈ 69.3 MN，頂點腳剩約 64.1 MN，餘裕明顯縮小。由此可見基底寬度與節狀壁樁的拉拔能力為何同樣重要。數值為教學假設，不代表東京晴空塔的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Tripod leg forces: the base is an equilateral triangle with side s = 68 m, so each leg is R = s/√3 ≈ 39.3 m from the centroid. An overturning moment M = 3,000 MN·m about an axis parallel to one side changes the apex leg force by F₁ = M/(1.5R) ≈ 3,000/58.9 ≈ 50.9 MN and the other two legs by F₂ = M/(3R) ≈ 25.5 MN each in the opposite sense. With a total weight of 400 MN, 133.3 MN per leg, the apex leg drops to 133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 82.4 MN while the other two rise to about 158.8 MN; with the wind reversed the apex leg carries about 184.3 MN and the others about 107.9 MN. If vertical earthquake acceleration briefly reduces gravity by 30%, the apex leg keeps only 0.7×133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 42.4 MN. With a 50 m base side, R ≈ 28.9 m and F₁ ≈ 69.3 MN, leaving the apex leg about 64.1 MN, a clearly reduced margin. This is why base width and the uplift capacity of the knuckle wall piles matter equally. Values are teaching assumptions, not Tokyo Skytree's design values.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 塔高 634 m，2011 年 11 月 17 日獲金氏世界紀錄認證為世界最高的塔

Observation decks sit at about 350 m and 450 m
The base is an equilateral triangle with sides of about 68 m, giving a slenderness of about 9 to 1
The largest steel tubes are about 2.3 m in diameter and about 10 cm thick
The concrete central column is about 8 m across, fixed to the tower below about 125 m and linked by oil dampers from 125 m to 375 m
Public sources credit the central-column system with about 40% to 50% less seismic response
The knuckle-wall pile foundations reach about 50 m deep
Two tuned mass dampers totalling about 100 t were lifted to the top with the antenna mast
Public sources put the construction cost at about 65 billion yen
timeline: 2008　7 月 14 日動工，展開三支腳柱的節狀壁樁基礎

2010 — From December the antenna mast is jacked up in stages inside the central shaft
2011 — Fully inspected after the 11 March earthquake, the tower reaches 634 m on 18 March
2011 — Certified by Guinness World Records as the world's tallest tower on 17 November

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力」與「心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice" and "Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「三角形到圓形的斷面」如何影響東京晴空塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Triangle-to-circle section” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tokyo Skytree”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 東京晴空塔底部是邊長約 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱向上逐漸收攏，斷面由三角形轉為圓形，約在 350 m 以上成為圓筒狀；高度與底寬比約 9：1，是極為細長的獨立塔。三角形基底在狹窄基地內提供最大的力臂與穩定性，圓形上部則讓不同風向的阻力較一致。塔身是鋼管桁架而非實心外牆，風力取決於桿件的投影面積與實積率，而不是整個輪廓面積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「三角形到圓形的斷面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tokyo Skytree stands on an equilateral triangle with sides of about 68 m; its three legs draw together as they rise, so the section changes from a triangle to a circle and becomes cylindrical above about 350 m. Its height-to-base ratio is about 9 to 1, making it an extremely slender free-standing tower. The triangular base gives the largest lever arm and stability on a narrow site, while the circular upper section makes drag more uniform across wind directions. The body is a tubular steel truss rather than a solid skin, so wind force depends on member projected area and solidity ratio rather than on the whole outline. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Triangle-to-circle section” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：格構塔單位高度風力 F = q·C_f·φ·B。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wind force per unit height on a lattice tower F = q·C_f·φ·B.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「三角形到圓形的斷面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Triangle-to-circle section”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力
knowledge.titleEn: Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice
knowledge.text: 東京晴空塔底部是邊長約 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱向上逐漸收攏，斷面由三角形轉為圓形，約在 350 m 以上成為圓筒狀；高度與底寬比約 9：1，是極為細長的獨立塔。三角形基底在狹窄基地內提供最大的力臂與穩定性，圓形上部則讓不同風向的阻力較一致。
knowledge.textEn: Tokyo Skytree stands on an equilateral triangle with sides of about 68 m; its three legs draw together as they rise, so the section changes from a triangle to a circle and becomes cylindrical above about 350 m. Its height-to-base ratio is about 9 to 1, making it an extremely slender free-standing tower.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice" is correct?
options: 格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。
東京晴空塔底部是邊長約 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱向上逐漸收攏，斷面由三角形轉為圓形，約在 350 m 以上成為圓筒狀。
心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。
optionsEn: A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored.
Tokyo Skytree stands on an equilateral triangle with sides of about 68 m.
The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight.
quiz.explanation: 東京晴空塔底部是邊長約 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱向上逐漸收攏，斷面由三角形轉為圓形，約在 350 m 以上成為圓筒狀；高度與底寬比約 9：1，是極為細長的獨立塔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tokyo Skytree stands on an equilateral triangle with sides of about 68 m; its three legs draw together as they rise, so the section changes from a triangle to a circle and becomes cylindrical above about 350 m. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三角形到圓形的斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Triangle-to-circle section” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：格構塔單位高度風力 F = q·C_f·φ·B。風速 40 m/s 時 q = ½×1.225×40² ≈ 980 Pa；取 C_f = 2.0、實積率 φ = 0.25、外輪廓寬 B = 40 m，F = 980×2.0×0.25×40 ≈ 19.6 kN/m；若沿 600 m 均布，基底彎矩約 19.6×600²/2 ≈ 3.5 GN·m。細長比 634/68 ≈ 9.3。風速與係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind force per unit height on a lattice tower F = q·C_f·φ·B. At 40 m/s, q = ½×1.225×40² ≈ 980 Pa; with C_f = 2.0, solidity φ = 0.25 and outline width B = 40 m, F = 980×2.0×0.25×40 ≈ 19.6 kN/m, and spread over 600 m the base moment is about 19.6×600²/2 ≈ 3.5 GN·m. The slenderness is 634/68 ≈ 9.3. Wind speed and coefficients are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以風洞試驗量測不同高度斷面的阻力係數與實積率影響，並確認圓形段沒有明顯的渦流共振；分析模型要逐段輸入桿件投影面積，與風洞結果比較基底剪力與彎矩，並檢查天線、維修平台等附掛物增加的受風面積。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure drag coefficients and solidity effects for sections at different heights in the wind tunnel and confirm that the circular segment shows no marked vortex resonance; enter member projected areas segment by segment in the analysis model, compare base shear and moment with the wind-tunnel results, and account for added area from antennas and maintenance platforms.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 格構塔單位高度風力 F = q·C_f·φ·B。風速 40 m/s 時 q = ½×1.225×40² ≈ 980 Pa；取 C_f = 2.0、實積率 φ = 0.25、外輪廓寬 B = 40 m，F = 980×2.0×0.25×40 ≈ 19.6 kN/m；若沿 600 m 均布，基底彎矩約 19.6×600²/2 ≈ 3.5 GN·m。細長比 634/68 ≈ 9.3。風速與係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Wind force per unit height on a lattice tower F = q·C_f·φ·B. At 40 m/s, q = ½×1.225×40² ≈ 980 Pa; with C_f = 2.0, solidity φ = 0.25 and outline width B = 40 m, F = 980×2.0×0.25×40 ≈ 19.6 kN/m, and spread over 600 m the base moment is about 19.6×600²/2 ≈ 3.5 GN·m. The slenderness is 634/68 ≈ 9.3. Wind speed and coefficients are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice", which statement holds?
options: 塔很重，所以基礎只需要考慮下壓，不會受拉。
在豎井內頂升比較安全，所以不需要另做結構分析。
格構塔單位高度風力 F = q·C_f·φ·B。
optionsEn: The tower is heavy, so its foundation only needs to resist compression and never tension.
Lifting inside the shaft is safer, so no separate structural analysis is needed.
Wind force per unit height on a lattice tower F = q·C_f·φ·B.
quiz.explanation: 格構塔單位高度風力 F = q·C_f·φ·B。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wind force per unit height on a lattice tower F = q·C_f·φ·B. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三角形到圓形的斷面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Triangle-to-circle section” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以風洞試驗量測不同高度斷面的阻力係數與實積率影響，並確認圓形段沒有明顯的渦流共振；分析模型要逐段輸入桿件投影面積，與風洞結果比較基底剪力與彎矩，並檢查天線、維修平台等附掛物增加的受風面積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure drag coefficients and solidity effects for sections at different heights in the wind tunnel and confirm that the circular segment shows no marked vortex resonance; enter member projected areas segment by segment in the analysis model, compare base shear and moment with the wind-tunnel results, and account for added area from antennas and maintenance platforms. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立附掛物登錄制度：任何新增天線、燈具或設備都要登錄投影面積與重量，由結構工程師確認累計值仍在設計範圍內，才可安裝。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set up a register of attachments: every new antenna, light or device records its projected area and weight, and installation proceeds only after the structural engineer confirms the cumulative total is within design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若後續加裝天線、照明或廣告物而未重新計算受風面積，實積率上升會讓風力超出設計；圓形段若出現渦流共振，細長的上部會產生持續擺動，對天線與連接件造成疲勞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding antennas, lighting or signage later without recalculating wind area raises the solidity and pushes wind force beyond design; vortex resonance in the circular segment would make the slender top sway persistently, fatiguing antennas and connections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以風洞試驗量測不同高度斷面的阻力係數與實積率影響，並確認圓形段沒有明顯的渦流共振；分析模型要逐段輸入桿件投影面積，與風洞結果比較基底剪力與彎矩，並檢查天線、維修平台等附掛物增加的受風面積。
knowledge.textEn: Measure drag coefficients and solidity effects for sections at different heights in the wind tunnel and confirm that the circular segment shows no marked vortex resonance; enter member projected areas segment by segment in the analysis model, compare base shear and moment with the wind-tunnel results, and account for added area from antennas and maintenance platforms.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立附掛物登錄制度：任何新增天線、燈具或設備都要登錄投影面積與重量，由結構工程師確認累計值仍在設計範圍內，才可安裝。
knowledge.textEn: Set up a register of attachments: every new antenna, light or device records its projected area and weight, and installation proceeds only after the structural engineer confirms the cumulative total is within design.

quiz.question: 要驗證「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice"?
options: 以風洞試驗量測不同高度斷面的阻力係數與實積率影響，並確認圓形段沒有明顯的渦流共振。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
地震後只要外觀沒有明顯損壞，施工中的結構就可以立即復工。
optionsEn: Measure drag coefficients and solidity effects for sections at different heights in the wind tunnel and confirm that the circular segment shows no marked vortex resonance.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If there is no visible damage after an earthquake, work on an unfinished structure can resume immediately.
quiz.explanation: 以風洞試驗量測不同高度斷面的阻力係數與實積率影響，並確認圓形段沒有明顯的渦流共振；分析模型要逐段輸入桿件投影面積，與風洞結果比較基底剪力與彎矩，並檢查天線、維修平台等附掛物增加的受風面積。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure drag coefficients and solidity effects for sections at different heights in the wind tunnel and confirm that the circular segment shows no marked vortex resonance; enter member projected areas segment by segment in the analysis model, compare base shear and moment with the wind-tunnel results, and account for added area from antennas and maintenance platforms. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三角形到圓形的斷面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Triangle-to-circle section” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若後續加裝天線、照明或廣告物而未重新計算受風面積，實積率上升會讓風力超出設計；圓形段若出現渦流共振，細長的上部會產生持續擺動，對天線與連接件造成疲勞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding antennas, lighting or signage later without recalculating wind area raises the solidity and pushes wind force beyond design; vortex resonance in the circular segment would make the slender top sway persistently, fatiguing antennas and connections. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：塔身是鋼管桁架而非實心外牆，風力取決於桿件的投影面積與實積率，而不是整個輪廓面積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The body is a tubular steel truss rather than a solid skin, so wind force depends on member projected area and solidity ratio rather than on the whole outline.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若後續加裝天線、照明或廣告物而未重新計算受風面積，實積率上升會讓風力超出設計；圓形段若出現渦流共振，細長的上部會產生持續擺動，對天線與連接件造成疲勞。
knowledge.textEn: Adding antennas, lighting or signage later without recalculating wind area raises the solidity and pushes wind force beyond design; vortex resonance in the circular segment would make the slender top sway persistently, fatiguing antennas and connections.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若後續加裝天線、照明或廣告物而未重新計算受風面積，實積率上升會讓風力超出設計；圓形段若出現渦流共振，細長的上部會產生持續擺動，對天線與連接件造成疲勞。
心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adding antennas, lighting or signage later without recalculating wind area raises the solidity and pushes wind force beyond design.
The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight.
quiz.explanation: 若後續加裝天線、照明或廣告物而未重新計算受風面積，實積率上升會讓風力超出設計；圓形段若出現渦流共振，細長的上部會產生持續擺動，對天線與連接件造成疲勞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding antennas, lighting or signage later without recalculating wind area raises the solidity and pushes wind force beyond design; vortex resonance in the circular segment would make the slender top sway persistently, fatiguing antennas and connections. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「心柱制振」如何影響東京晴空塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shimbashira vibration control” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tokyo Skytree”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 塔的中央是一根直徑約 8 m 的鋼筋混凝土圓筒心柱，內設逃生樓梯，高度約到 375 m，與外側鋼塔在結構上分離。心柱在約 125 m 以下與鋼塔固結，125 m 至 375 m 之間則以油壓阻尼器連接；地震或強風時心柱與鋼塔的週期不同，擺動出現相位差，阻尼器在兩者的相對運動中消耗能量。設計概念取自五重塔的中心柱，公開資料稱可減少地震反應約 40% 至 50%。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「心柱制振」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At the centre stands a reinforced concrete cylinder about 8 m in diameter, housing an escape stair and rising to about 375 m, structurally separate from the outer steel tower. The column is fixed to the tower below about 125 m and connected by oil dampers between 125 m and 375 m; in an earthquake or strong wind the column and tower have different periods and sway out of phase, so the dampers dissipate energy in their relative motion. The concept is drawn from the central pillar of five-storey pagodas, and public sources state seismic response reductions of about 40% to 50%. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shimbashira vibration control” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：阻尼器力 F = c·Δv，Δv = 2π·f·Δx。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Damper force F = c·Δv with Δv = 2π·f·Δx.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「心柱制振」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shimbashira vibration control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振
knowledge.titleEn: Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower
knowledge.text: 塔的中央是一根直徑約 8 m 的鋼筋混凝土圓筒心柱，內設逃生樓梯，高度約到 375 m，與外側鋼塔在結構上分離。心柱在約 125 m 以下與鋼塔固結，125 m 至 375 m 之間則以油壓阻尼器連接；地震或強風時心柱與鋼塔的週期不同，擺動出現相位差，阻尼器在兩者的相對運動中消耗能量。
knowledge.textEn: At the centre stands a reinforced concrete cylinder about 8 m in diameter, housing an escape stair and rising to about 375 m, structurally separate from the outer steel tower. The column is fixed to the tower below about 125 m and connected by oil dampers between 125 m and 375 m; in an earthquake or strong wind the column and tower have different periods and sway out of phase, so the dampers dissipate energy in their relative motion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower" is correct?
options: 心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。
鋼管越粗越厚就越安全，接頭細節不重要。
塔的中央是一根直徑約 8 m 的鋼筋混凝土圓筒心柱，內設逃生樓梯，高度約到 375 m，與外側鋼塔在結構上分離。
optionsEn: The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight.
The bigger and thicker the tube, the safer it is; joint details do not matter.
At the centre stands a reinforced concrete cylinder about 8 m in diameter, housing an escape stair and rising to about 375 m, structurally separate from the outer steel tower.
quiz.explanation: 塔的中央是一根直徑約 8 m 的鋼筋混凝土圓筒心柱，內設逃生樓梯，高度約到 375 m，與外側鋼塔在結構上分離。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At the centre stands a reinforced concrete cylinder about 8 m in diameter, housing an escape stair and rising to about 375 m, structurally separate from the outer steel tower. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「心柱制振」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shimbashira vibration control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：阻尼器力 F = c·Δv，Δv = 2π·f·Δx。若兩者相對位移振幅 Δx = 0.10 m、頻率 f = 0.3 Hz，Δv ≈ 0.188 m/s；阻尼係數 c = 5,000 kN·s/m 時 F ≈ 942 kN，每循環消耗能量 E = π·c·ω·Δx² ≈ π×5,000×1.885×0.01 ≈ 296 kJ。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Damper force F = c·Δv with Δv = 2π·f·Δx. For a relative amplitude Δx = 0.10 m at f = 0.3 Hz, Δv ≈ 0.188 m/s; with c = 5,000 kN·s/m, F ≈ 942 kN, and the energy dissipated per cycle is E = π·c·ω·Δx² ≈ π×5,000×1.885×0.01 ≈ 296 kJ. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器連接時的頂部加速度、基底剪力與兩者相對位移，確認相對位移落在阻尼器行程內；也要檢查心柱與鋼塔的週期比，若兩者太接近就不會產生足夠的相位差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare top acceleration, base shear and relative displacement with and without the damper connection in time-history analyses, confirming relative displacement stays within damper stroke; also check the period ratio of column and tower, since periods too close together will not produce enough phase difference.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 阻尼器力 F = c·Δv，Δv = 2π·f·Δx。若兩者相對位移振幅 Δx = 0.10 m、頻率 f = 0.3 Hz，Δv ≈ 0.188 m/s；阻尼係數 c = 5,000 kN·s/m 時 F ≈ 942 kN，每循環消耗能量 E = π·c·ω·Δx² ≈ π×5,000×1.885×0.01 ≈ 296 kJ。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Damper force F = c·Δv with Δv = 2π·f·Δx. For a relative amplitude Δx = 0.10 m at f = 0.3 Hz, Δv ≈ 0.188 m/s; with c = 5,000 kN·s/m, F ≈ 942 kN, and the energy dissipated per cycle is E = π·c·ω·Δx² ≈ π×5,000×1.885×0.01 ≈ 296 kJ. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器力 F = c·Δv，Δv = 2π·f·Δx。
鋼構安裝只要每段都對準設計座標，量測時間不重要。
阻尼器的力量越大越好，不需要限制。
optionsEn: Damper force F = c·Δv with Δv = 2π·f·Δx.
As long as each segment is set to design coordinates, the time of surveying does not matter.
The larger a damper's force the better, so it needs no limit.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器力 F = c·Δv，Δv = 2π·f·Δx。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Damper force F = c·Δv with Δv = 2π·f·Δx. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「心柱制振」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shimbashira vibration control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器連接時的頂部加速度、基底剪力與兩者相對位移，確認相對位移落在阻尼器行程內；也要檢查心柱與鋼塔的週期比，若兩者太接近就不會產生足夠的相位差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare top acceleration, base shear and relative displacement with and without the damper connection in time-history analyses, confirming relative displacement stays within damper stroke; also check the period ratio of column and tower, since periods too close together will not produce enough phase difference. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：心柱與鋼塔的相對位移、阻尼器行程與淨空要在同一張圖上管理，任何在兩者之間新增的管線或平台都必須保留滑動或可撓接頭；阻尼器的型號、數量與試驗資料列入交接文件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Manage relative displacement, damper stroke and clearance between column and tower on one drawing, require any new services or platforms bridging the gap to keep sliding or flexible joints, and include damper models, numbers and test data in the handover documents.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若心柱與鋼塔之間的淨空不足，大地震時兩者可能碰撞；阻尼器若漏油或卡死，心柱會變成單純的附加質量或剛性連接，減振效果消失，甚至在某些頻率放大反應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient clearance between column and tower can let them collide in a major earthquake; if dampers leak or seize, the column becomes mere added mass or a rigid link, the damping benefit disappears and response may even amplify at some frequencies. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「心柱制振」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shimbashira vibration control” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若心柱與鋼塔之間的淨空不足，大地震時兩者可能碰撞；阻尼器若漏油或卡死，心柱會變成單純的附加質量或剛性連接，減振效果消失，甚至在某些頻率放大反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient clearance between column and tower can let them collide in a major earthquake; if dampers leak or seize, the column becomes mere added mass or a rigid link, the damping benefit disappears and response may even amplify at some frequencies. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計概念取自五重塔的中心柱，公開資料稱可減少地震反應約 40% 至 50%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The concept is drawn from the central pillar of five-storey pagodas, and public sources state seismic response reductions of about 40% to 50%.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若心柱與鋼塔之間的淨空不足，大地震時兩者可能碰撞；阻尼器若漏油或卡死，心柱會變成單純的附加質量或剛性連接，減振效果消失，甚至在某些頻率放大反應。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼管越粗越厚就越安全，接頭細節不重要。
若心柱與鋼塔之間的淨空不足，大地震時兩者可能碰撞；阻尼器若漏油或卡死，心柱會變成單純的附加質量或剛性連接，減振效果消失，甚至在某些頻率放大反應。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The bigger and thicker the tube, the safer it is; joint details do not matter.
Insufficient clearance between column and tower can let them collide in a major earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 若心柱與鋼塔之間的淨空不足，大地震時兩者可能碰撞；阻尼器若漏油或卡死，心柱會變成單純的附加質量或剛性連接，減振效果消失，甚至在某些頻率放大反應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient clearance between column and tower can let them collide in a major earthquake; if dampers leak or seize, the column becomes mere added mass or a rigid link, the damping benefit disappears and response may even amplify at some frequencies. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高強度鋼管構材與分歧接頭」與「節狀連續壁樁的摩擦與拉拔」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High-strength tubular members and branch joints" and "Friction and uplift in knuckle wall piles": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高強度鋼管構材與分歧接頭：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: High-strength tubular members and branch joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「直徑 2.3 m 鋼管」如何影響東京晴空塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “2.3 m diameter steel tubes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tokyo Skytree”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 晴空塔的主要構材用鋼管而非 H 型鋼，主要接頭以焊接的分歧接頭（管對管直接相貫）組成，以減輕重量並提高耐震性；最粗的鋼管直徑約 2.3 m、厚約 10 cm，公開資料指出單根約 29 公噸，並使用約為一般鋼材兩倍強度的高強度鋼。圓管在各方向的抗彎與抗挫屈性能相同，受風面積也較小；但相貫接頭的應力集中明顯，焊接幾何與熱影響區的韌性是設計重點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「直徑 2.3 m 鋼管」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Skytree's main members are steel tubes rather than H-sections, joined mostly by welded branch joints where tube meets tube directly, to save weight and improve seismic performance; the largest tubes are about 2.3 m in diameter and about 10 cm thick, one such piece weighing about 29 t according to public sources, in high-strength steel of roughly twice ordinary strength. A circular tube has equal bending and buckling resistance in every direction and less wind area, but stress concentrations at intersecting joints are pronounced, so weld geometry and heat-affected-zone toughness are key design concerns. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “2.3 m diameter steel tubes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鋼管面積 A = π·(D − t)·t = π×2.2×0.1 ≈ 0.691 m²，每公尺重 0.691×7,850 ≈ 5,430 kg，29 t 的構材長約 5.3 m；以降伏強度 630 MPa 計，全斷面降伏軸力約 0.691×630 ≈ 435 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tube area A = π·(D − t)·t = π×2.2×0.1 ≈ 0.691 m², about 5,430 kg per metre, so a 29 t piece is about 5.3 m long; at a yield strength of 630 MPa the squash load is about 0.691×630 ≈ 435 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼管越粗越厚就越安全，接頭細節不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The bigger and thicker the tube, the safer it is; joint details do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「直徑 2.3 m 鋼管」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “2.3 m diameter steel tubes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高強度鋼管構材與分歧接頭
knowledge.titleEn: High-strength tubular members and branch joints
knowledge.text: 晴空塔的主要構材用鋼管而非 H 型鋼，主要接頭以焊接的分歧接頭（管對管直接相貫）組成，以減輕重量並提高耐震性；最粗的鋼管直徑約 2.3 m、厚約 10 cm，公開資料指出單根約 29 公噸，並使用約為一般鋼材兩倍強度的高強度鋼。圓管在各方向的抗彎與抗挫屈性能相同，受風面積也較小；但相貫接頭的應力集中明顯，焊接幾何與熱影響區的韌性是設計重點。
knowledge.textEn: Skytree's main members are steel tubes rather than H-sections, joined mostly by welded branch joints where tube meets tube directly, to save weight and improve seismic performance; the largest tubes are about 2.3 m in diameter and about 10 cm thick, one such piece weighing about 29 t according to public sources, in high-strength steel of roughly twice ordinary strength. A circular tube has equal bending and buckling resistance in every direction and less wind area, but stress concentrations at intersecting joints are pronounced, so weld geometry and heat-affected-zone toughness are key design concerns.

knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼管越粗越厚就越安全，接頭細節不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The bigger and thicker the tube, the safer it is; joint details do not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高強度鋼管構材與分歧接頭」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "High-strength tubular members and branch joints" is correct?
options: 晴空塔的主要構材用鋼管而非 H 型鋼，主要接頭以焊接的分歧接頭（管對管直接相貫）組成，以減輕重量並提高耐震性。
鋼管越粗越厚就越安全，接頭細節不重要。
塔很重，所以基礎只需要考慮下壓，不會受拉。
optionsEn: Skytree's main members are steel tubes rather than H-sections, joined mostly by welded branch joints where tube meets tube directly, to save weight and improve seismic performance.
The bigger and thicker the tube, the safer it is; joint details do not matter.
The tower is heavy, so its foundation only needs to resist compression and never tension.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高強度鋼管構材與分歧接頭：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High-strength tubular members and branch joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「直徑 2.3 m 鋼管」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “2.3 m diameter steel tubes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鋼管面積 A = π·(D − t)·t = π×2.2×0.1 ≈ 0.691 m²，每公尺重 0.691×7,850 ≈ 5,430 kg，29 t 的構材長約 5.3 m；以降伏強度 630 MPa 計，全斷面降伏軸力約 0.691×630 ≈ 435 MN。徑厚比 D/t = 23，屬局部挫屈不易發生的厚實斷面。強度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tube area A = π·(D − t)·t = π×2.2×0.1 ≈ 0.691 m², about 5,430 kg per metre, so a 29 t piece is about 5.3 m long; at a yield strength of 630 MPa the squash load is about 0.691×630 ≈ 435 MN. With D/t = 23 the section is stocky and unlikely to buckle locally. The strength is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分歧接頭以有限元素分析求熱點應力，並以縮尺或足尺試體驗證應力集中係數與疲勞強度；工廠焊接全數做超音波檢測，厚板焊接記錄預熱與層間溫度，鋼材以夏比衝擊試驗確認低溫韌性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain hot-spot stresses at branch joints by finite-element analysis and verify stress concentration factors and fatigue strength on scaled or full-size specimens; ultrasonically test all shop welds, record preheat and interpass temperatures for thick welds, and confirm low-temperature toughness of the steel by Charpy impact tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鋼管面積 A = π·(D − t)·t = π×2.2×0.1 ≈ 0.691 m²，每公尺重 0.691×7,850 ≈ 5,430 kg，29 t 的構材長約 5.3 m；以降伏強度 630 MPa 計，全斷面降伏軸力約 0.691×630 ≈ 435 MN。徑厚比 D/t = 23，屬局部挫屈不易發生的厚實斷面。強度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Tube area A = π·(D − t)·t = π×2.2×0.1 ≈ 0.691 m², about 5,430 kg per metre, so a 29 t piece is about 5.3 m long; at a yield strength of 630 MPa the squash load is about 0.691×630 ≈ 435 MN. With D/t = 23 the section is stocky and unlikely to buckle locally. The strength is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高強度鋼管構材與分歧接頭」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "High-strength tubular members and branch joints", which statement holds?
options: 在豎井內頂升比較安全，所以不需要另做結構分析。
地震後只要外觀沒有明顯損壞，施工中的結構就可以立即復工。
optionsEn: Lifting inside the shaft is safer, so no separate structural analysis is needed.
Tube area A = π·(D − t)·t = π×2.2×0.1 ≈ 0.691 m², about 5,430 kg per metre, so a 29 t piece is about 5.3 m long.
If there is no visible damage after an earthquake, work on an unfinished structure can resume immediately.
quiz.explanation: 鋼管面積 A = π·(D − t)·t = π×2.2×0.1 ≈ 0.691 m²，每公尺重 0.691×7,850 ≈ 5,430 kg，29 t 的構材長約 5.3 m；以降伏強度 630 MPa 計，全斷面降伏軸力約 0.691×630 ≈ 435 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Tube area A = π·(D − t)·t = π×2.2×0.1 ≈ 0.691 m², about 5,430 kg per metre, so a 29 t piece is about 5.3 m long; at a yield strength of 630 MPa the squash load is about 0.691×630 ≈ 435 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高強度鋼管構材與分歧接頭：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: High-strength tubular members and branch joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「直徑 2.3 m 鋼管」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “2.3 m diameter steel tubes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分歧接頭以有限元素分析求熱點應力，並以縮尺或足尺試體驗證應力集中係數與疲勞強度；工廠焊接全數做超音波檢測，厚板焊接記錄預熱與層間溫度，鋼材以夏比衝擊試驗確認低溫韌性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain hot-spot stresses at branch joints by finite-element analysis and verify stress concentration factors and fatigue strength on scaled or full-size specimens; ultrasonically test all shop welds, record preheat and interpass temperatures for thick welds, and confirm low-temperature toughness of the steel by Charpy impact tests. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每一個分歧接頭要有焊接程序書、熱點應力計算與檢測紀錄，焊趾修整列為檢驗項目；高強度鋼的焊材、熱輸入範圍與預熱溫度由材料與焊接工程師共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Give every branch joint a welding procedure, hot-spot stress calculation and inspection record, with weld-toe dressing as an inspection item; consumables, heat-input range and preheat for the high-strength steel are signed off jointly by the materials and welding engineers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相貫接頭若焊趾成形不良或有未熔合，風致反覆應力會在熱點處引發疲勞裂縫；高強度鋼若焊接熱輸入控制不當，熱影響區變脆，地震時可能在接頭附近脆性斷裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor weld-toe profiles or lack of fusion at intersecting joints let repeated wind stresses start fatigue cracks at hot spots; poorly controlled heat input on high-strength steel embrittles the heat-affected zone, risking brittle fracture near joints in an earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Obtain hot-spot stresses at branch joints by finite-element analysis and verify stress concentration factors and fatigue strength on scaled or full-size specimens; ultrasonically test all shop welds, record preheat and interpass temperatures for thick welds, and confirm low-temperature toughness of the steel by Charpy impact tests.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每一個分歧接頭要有焊接程序書、熱點應力計算與檢測紀錄，焊趾修整列為檢驗項目；高強度鋼的焊材、熱輸入範圍與預熱溫度由材料與焊接工程師共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Give every branch joint a welding procedure, hot-spot stress calculation and inspection record, with weld-toe dressing as an inspection item; consumables, heat-input range and preheat for the high-strength steel are signed off jointly by the materials and welding engineers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高強度鋼管構材與分歧接頭」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High-strength tubular members and branch joints"?

The main tubes are very thick, so corrosion does not matter for a tube tower.
Obtain hot-spot stresses at branch joints by finite-element analysis and verify stress concentration factors and fatigue strength on scaled or full-size specimens.

steps.title: 高強度鋼管構材與分歧接頭：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High-strength tubular members and branch joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「直徑 2.3 m 鋼管」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “2.3 m diameter steel tubes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 相貫接頭若焊趾成形不良或有未熔合，風致反覆應力會在熱點處引發疲勞裂縫；高強度鋼若焊接熱輸入控制不當，熱影響區變脆，地震時可能在接頭附近脆性斷裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor weld-toe profiles or lack of fusion at intersecting joints let repeated wind stresses start fatigue cracks at hot spots; poorly controlled heat input on high-strength steel embrittles the heat-affected zone, risking brittle fracture near joints in an earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圓管在各方向的抗彎與抗挫屈性能相同，受風面積也較小；但相貫接頭的應力集中明顯，焊接幾何與熱影響區的韌性是設計重點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A circular tube has equal bending and buckling resistance in every direction and less wind area, but stress concentrations at intersecting joints are pronounced, so weld geometry and heat-affected-zone toughness are key design concerns.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼管越粗越厚就越安全，接頭細節不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The bigger and thicker the tube, the safer it is; joint details do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 相貫接頭若焊趾成形不良或有未熔合，風致反覆應力會在熱點處引發疲勞裂縫；高強度鋼若焊接熱輸入控制不當，熱影響區變脆，地震時可能在接頭附近脆性斷裂。
knowledge.textEn: Poor weld-toe profiles or lack of fusion at intersecting joints let repeated wind stresses start fatigue cracks at hot spots; poorly controlled heat input on high-strength steel embrittles the heat-affected zone, risking brittle fracture near joints in an earthquake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高強度鋼管構材與分歧接頭」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High-strength tubular members and branch joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 相貫接頭若焊趾成形不良或有未熔合，風致反覆應力會在熱點處引發疲勞裂縫；高強度鋼若焊接熱輸入控制不當，熱影響區變脆，地震時可能在接頭附近脆性斷裂。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
塔很重，所以基礎只需要考慮下壓，不會受拉。
optionsEn: Poor weld-toe profiles or lack of fusion at intersecting joints let repeated wind stresses start fatigue cracks at hot spots.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The tower is heavy, so its foundation only needs to resist compression and never tension.
quiz.explanation: 相貫接頭若焊趾成形不良或有未熔合，風致反覆應力會在熱點處引發疲勞裂縫；高強度鋼若焊接熱輸入控制不當，熱影響區變脆，地震時可能在接頭附近脆性斷裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor weld-toe profiles or lack of fusion at intersecting joints let repeated wind stresses start fatigue cracks at hot spots; poorly controlled heat input on high-strength steel embrittles the heat-affected zone, risking brittle fracture near joints in an earthquake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 節狀連續壁樁的摩擦與拉拔：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Friction and uplift in knuckle wall piles: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「節狀壁樁」如何影響東京晴空塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Knuckle wall piles” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tokyo Skytree”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 晴空塔建在隅田川附近的沖積地層上，三支腳柱下方採用節狀壁樁（knuckle wall），以場鑄混凝土壁樁深入地下約 50 m，壁面每隔一段設突出的「節」，並以放射狀相互連結。節像錨一樣嵌入土層，同時增加下壓時的承壓面與上拔時的抵抗面；三角形配置使強風或地震時迎風腳可能減壓甚至受拉，所以基礎的拉拔能力與下壓能力同樣重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「節狀壁樁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Skytree stands on alluvial ground near the Sumida River, and beneath its three legs are knuckle wall piles: cast-in-place concrete wall piles reaching about 50 m deep, with projecting knuckles at intervals along the wall and radial interconnection. The knuckles key into the soil like anchors, adding bearing area in compression and resisting area in uplift; because the triangular layout can unload or even lift the windward leg in strong wind or earthquakes, the foundation's uplift capacity matters as much as its compressive capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Knuckle wall piles” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：壁樁容量 Q = 周長×L×f_s + Σ節承壓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wall-pile capacity Q = perimeter×L×f_s + Σ knuckle bearing.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塔很重，所以基礎只需要考慮下壓，不會受拉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The tower is heavy, so its foundation only needs to resist compression and never tension." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「節狀壁樁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Knuckle wall piles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節狀連續壁樁的摩擦與拉拔
knowledge.titleEn: Friction and uplift in knuckle wall piles
knowledge.text: 晴空塔建在隅田川附近的沖積地層上，三支腳柱下方採用節狀壁樁（knuckle wall），以場鑄混凝土壁樁深入地下約 50 m，壁面每隔一段設突出的「節」，並以放射狀相互連結。節像錨一樣嵌入土層，同時增加下壓時的承壓面與上拔時的抵抗面；三角形配置使強風或地震時迎風腳可能減壓甚至受拉，所以基礎的拉拔能力與下壓能力同樣重要。
knowledge.textEn: Skytree stands on alluvial ground near the Sumida River, and beneath its three legs are knuckle wall piles: cast-in-place concrete wall piles reaching about 50 m deep, with projecting knuckles at intervals along the wall and radial interconnection. The knuckles key into the soil like anchors, adding bearing area in compression and resisting area in uplift; because the triangular layout can unload or even lift the windward leg in strong wind or earthquakes, the foundation's uplift capacity matters as much as its compressive capacity.

knowledge.text: 誤解：塔很重，所以基礎只需要考慮下壓，不會受拉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「節狀連續壁樁的摩擦與拉拔」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Friction and uplift in knuckle wall piles" is correct?
options: 塔很重，所以基礎只需要考慮下壓，不會受拉。
晴空塔建在隅田川附近的沖積地層上，三支腳柱下方採用節狀壁樁（knuckle wall），以場鑄混凝土壁樁深入地下約 50 m，壁面每隔一段設突出的「節」，並以放射狀相互連結。
鋼構安裝只要每段都對準設計座標，量測時間不重要。

Skytree stands on alluvial ground near the Sumida River, and beneath its three legs are knuckle wall piles: cast-in-place concrete wall piles reaching about 50 m deep, with projecting knuckles at intervals along the wall and radial interconnection.

quiz.explanationEn: Skytree stands on alluvial ground near the Sumida River, and beneath its three legs are knuckle wall piles: cast-in-place concrete wall piles reaching about 50 m deep, with projecting knuckles at intervals along the wall and radial interconnection. steps.title: 節狀連續壁樁的摩擦與拉拔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Friction and uplift in knuckle wall piles: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節狀壁樁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Knuckle wall piles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：壁樁容量 Q = 周長×L×f_s + Σ節承壓。壁段 1.2 m × 6 m（周長 14.4 m）、L = 50 m、f_s = 80 kPa：側摩擦 14.4×50×0.08 = 57.6 MN；3 個節各外凸 0.4 m，承壓面積 0.4×14.4 = 5.76 m²、承壓 1.5 MPa，各約 8.6 MN，合計約 25.9 MN；總容量約 83.5 MN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wall-pile capacity Q = perimeter×L×f_s + Σ knuckle bearing. For a 1.2 m × 6 m panel (14.4 m perimeter), L = 50 m and f_s = 80 kPa, side friction is 14.4×50×0.08 = 57.6 MN; three knuckles each projecting 0.4 m give 0.4×14.4 = 5.76 m² of bearing at 1.5 MPa, about 8.6 MN each or 25.9 MN together, for a total of about 83.5 MN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以試驗樁做下壓與拉拔載重試驗，量測節的貢獻與側摩擦分布；施工時以超音波量測壁槽形狀，確認節的位置與尺寸符合設計，並記錄穩定液性質與混凝土澆置量，比對理論體積以發現坍孔或縮頸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Load-test trial piles in compression and uplift to measure the knuckle contribution and side-friction distribution; during construction profile the trench ultrasonically to confirm knuckle position and size, and log slurry properties and concrete volume against theoretical volume to detect collapse or necking.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 壁樁容量 Q = 周長×L×f_s + Σ節承壓。壁段 1.2 m × 6 m（周長 14.4 m）、L = 50 m、f_s = 80 kPa：側摩擦 14.4×50×0.08 = 57.6 MN；3 個節各外凸 0.4 m，承壓面積 0.4×14.4 = 5.76 m²、承壓 1.5 MPa，各約 8.6 MN，合計約 25.9 MN；總容量約 83.5 MN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Wall-pile capacity Q = perimeter×L×f_s + Σ knuckle bearing. For a 1.2 m × 6 m panel (14.4 m perimeter), L = 50 m and f_s = 80 kPa, side friction is 14.4×50×0.08 = 57.6 MN; three knuckles each projecting 0.4 m give 0.4×14.4 = 5.76 m² of bearing at 1.5 MPa, about 8.6 MN each or 25.9 MN together, for a total of about 83.5 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節狀連續壁樁的摩擦與拉拔」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Friction and uplift in knuckle wall piles", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器的力量越大越好，不需要限制。
落冰只是維護清潔問題，和結構工程無關。
壁樁容量 Q = 周長×L×f_s + Σ節承壓。
optionsEn: The larger a damper's force the better, so it needs no limit.
Falling ice is only a cleaning issue and has nothing to do with structural engineering.
Wall-pile capacity Q = perimeter×L×f_s + Σ knuckle bearing.
quiz.explanation: 壁樁容量 Q = 周長×L×f_s + Σ節承壓。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wall-pile capacity Q = perimeter×L×f_s + Σ knuckle bearing. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 節狀連續壁樁的摩擦與拉拔：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Friction and uplift in knuckle wall piles: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節狀壁樁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Knuckle wall piles” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以試驗樁做下壓與拉拔載重試驗，量測節的貢獻與側摩擦分布；施工時以超音波量測壁槽形狀，確認節的位置與尺寸符合設計，並記錄穩定液性質與混凝土澆置量，比對理論體積以發現坍孔或縮頸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Load-test trial piles in compression and uplift to measure the knuckle contribution and side-friction distribution; during construction profile the trench ultrasonically to confirm knuckle position and size, and log slurry properties and concrete volume against theoretical volume to detect collapse or necking. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每片壁樁的開挖斷面量測、節位置照片與澆置紀錄要逐片歸檔；拉拔試驗結果未達標前，不得進行腳柱基礎的上部施工，此為結構設計者簽認的停止點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: File trench profile measurements, knuckle position photographs and placement records panel by panel; superstructure work on a leg foundation must not start until uplift test results meet the criteria, a hold point signed by the structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若節的開挖尺寸不足或被坍落土填塞，節的承壓貢獻大減，拉拔容量可能遠低於設計；放射狀連結若在施工縫處接合不良，三支腳柱的基礎無法共同作用，差異沉陷與傾斜風險增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If knuckles are under-excavated or filled with collapsed soil, their bearing contribution drops sharply and uplift capacity can fall far below design; poor joints in the radial interconnection keep the three leg foundations from acting together, raising the risk of differential settlement and tilt. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以試驗樁做下壓與拉拔載重試驗，量測節的貢獻與側摩擦分布；施工時以超音波量測壁槽形狀，確認節的位置與尺寸符合設計，並記錄穩定液性質與混凝土澆置量，比對理論體積以發現坍孔或縮頸。
knowledge.textEn: Load-test trial piles in compression and uplift to measure the knuckle contribution and side-friction distribution; during construction profile the trench ultrasonically to confirm knuckle position and size, and log slurry properties and concrete volume against theoretical volume to detect collapse or necking.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每片壁樁的開挖斷面量測、節位置照片與澆置紀錄要逐片歸檔；拉拔試驗結果未達標前，不得進行腳柱基礎的上部施工，此為結構設計者簽認的停止點。
knowledge.textEn: File trench profile measurements, knuckle position photographs and placement records panel by panel; superstructure work on a leg foundation must not start until uplift test results meet the criteria, a hold point signed by the structural designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「節狀連續壁樁的摩擦與拉拔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Friction and uplift in knuckle wall piles"?
options: 以試驗樁做下壓與拉拔載重試驗，量測節的貢獻與側摩擦分布。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。
optionsEn: Load-test trial piles in compression and uplift to measure the knuckle contribution and side-friction distribution.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 以試驗樁做下壓與拉拔載重試驗，量測節的貢獻與側摩擦分布；施工時以超音波量測壁槽形狀，確認節的位置與尺寸符合設計，並記錄穩定液性質與混凝土澆置量，比對理論體積以發現坍孔或縮頸。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Load-test trial piles in compression and uplift to measure the knuckle contribution and side-friction distribution; during construction profile the trench ultrasonically to confirm knuckle position and size, and log slurry properties and concrete volume against theoretical volume to detect collapse or necking. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 節狀連續壁樁的摩擦與拉拔：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Friction and uplift in knuckle wall piles: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節狀壁樁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Knuckle wall piles” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若節的開挖尺寸不足或被坍落土填塞，節的承壓貢獻大減，拉拔容量可能遠低於設計；放射狀連結若在施工縫處接合不良，三支腳柱的基礎無法共同作用，差異沉陷與傾斜風險增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If knuckles are under-excavated or filled with collapsed soil, their bearing contribution drops sharply and uplift capacity can fall far below design; poor joints in the radial interconnection keep the three leg foundations from acting together, raising the risk of differential settlement and tilt. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：節像錨一樣嵌入土層，同時增加下壓時的承壓面與上拔時的抵抗面；三角形配置使強風或地震時迎風腳可能減壓甚至受拉，所以基礎的拉拔能力與下壓能力同樣重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The knuckles key into the soil like anchors, adding bearing area in compression and resisting area in uplift; because the triangular layout can unload or even lift the windward leg in strong wind or earthquakes, the foundation's uplift capacity matters as much as its compressive capacity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔很重，所以基礎只需要考慮下壓，不會受拉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The tower is heavy, so its foundation only needs to resist compression and never tension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若節的開挖尺寸不足或被坍落土填塞，節的承壓貢獻大減，拉拔容量可能遠低於設計；放射狀連結若在施工縫處接合不良，三支腳柱的基礎無法共同作用，差異沉陷與傾斜風險增加。
knowledge.textEn: If knuckles are under-excavated or filled with collapsed soil, their bearing contribution drops sharply and uplift capacity can fall far below design; poor joints in the radial interconnection keep the three leg foundations from acting together, raising the risk of differential settlement and tilt.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節狀連續壁樁的摩擦與拉拔」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Friction and uplift in knuckle wall piles" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若節的開挖尺寸不足或被坍落土填塞，節的承壓貢獻大減，拉拔容量可能遠低於設計；放射狀連結若在施工縫處接合不良，三支腳柱的基礎無法共同作用，差異沉陷與傾斜風險增加。
鋼構安裝只要每段都對準設計座標，量測時間不重要。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If knuckles are under-excavated or filled with collapsed soil, their bearing contribution drops sharply and uplift capacity can fall far below design.
As long as each segment is set to design coordinates, the time of surveying does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 若節的開挖尺寸不足或被坍落土填塞，節的承壓貢獻大減，拉拔容量可能遠低於設計；放射狀連結若在施工縫處接合不良，三支腳柱的基礎無法共同作用，差異沉陷與傾斜風險增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If knuckles are under-excavated or filled with collapsed soil, their bearing contribution drops sharply and uplift capacity can fall far below design; poor joints in the radial interconnection keep the three leg foundations from acting together, raising the risk of differential settlement and tilt. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「細長塔身的日照彎曲與施工測量」與「在中央豎井內組裝並頂升天線塔」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Solar bowing and surveying a slender tower" and "Assembling and lifting the antenna mast inside the shaft": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 細長塔身的日照彎曲與施工測量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Solar bowing and surveying a slender tower: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「日照彎曲與施工測量」如何影響東京晴空塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Solar bowing and construction survey” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tokyo Skytree”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 634 m 的細長鋼塔在日照下，向陽面鋼材升溫伸長、背陰面較冷，整個塔身會向背陽側彎曲，頂部偏移可達數十公分，並隨太陽方位在一天內移動。施工中每一段鋼管都要依座標安裝，若在日照強烈時測量並修正，等塔身冷卻後就會偏向另一側。因此測量必須在溫度均勻的時段（例如清晨）進行，或以溫度感測器即時修正，並把風造成的擺動另外扣除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「日照彎曲與施工測量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under sunshine, a 634 m slender steel tower heats and lengthens on its sunny side while the shaded side stays cooler, so the whole body bows away from the sun with top movements that can reach tens of centimetres, shifting with the sun's bearing through the day. Every tube segment must be set to coordinates during erection, and surveying and correcting under strong sun leaves the tower leaning the other way once it cools. Surveys must therefore be done when temperatures are uniform, such as early morning, or corrected in real time with temperature sensors, with wind sway removed separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Solar bowing and construction survey” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：溫差彎曲頂部偏移 δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2B)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Top offset from thermal bowing δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2B).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼構安裝只要每段都對準設計座標，量測時間不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as each segment is set to design coordinates, the time of surveying does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「日照彎曲與施工測量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Solar bowing and construction survey”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 634 m 的細長鋼塔在日照下，向陽面鋼材升溫伸長、背陰面較冷，整個塔身會向背陽側彎曲，頂部偏移可達數十公分，並隨太陽方位在一天內移動。施工中每一段鋼管都要依座標安裝，若在日照強烈時測量並修正，等塔身冷卻後就會偏向另一側。
knowledge.textEn: Under sunshine, a 634 m slender steel tower heats and lengthens on its sunny side while the shaded side stays cooler, so the whole body bows away from the sun with top movements that can reach tens of centimetres, shifting with the sun's bearing through the day. knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼構安裝只要每段都對準設計座標，量測時間不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「細長塔身的日照彎曲與施工測量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Solar bowing and surveying a slender tower" is correct?
options: 鋼構安裝只要每段都對準設計座標，量測時間不重要。
在豎井內頂升比較安全，所以不需要另做結構分析。
634 m 的細長鋼塔在日照下，向陽面鋼材升溫伸長、背陰面較冷，整個塔身會向背陽側彎曲，頂部偏移可達數十公分，並隨太陽方位在一天內移動。

Lifting inside the shaft is safer, so no separate structural analysis is needed.

quiz.explanationEn: Under sunshine, a 634 m slender steel tower heats and lengthens on its sunny side while the shaded side stays cooler, so the whole body bows away from the sun with top movements that can reach tens of centimetres, shifting with the sun's bearing through the day. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 細長塔身的日照彎曲與施工測量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Solar bowing and surveying a slender tower: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「日照彎曲與施工測量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Solar bowing and construction survey” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：溫差彎曲頂部偏移 δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2B)。α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、兩側溫差 ΔT = 10 °C、施工高度 H = 400 m、該段寬度 B = 40 m，δ = 12×10⁻⁶×10×400²/(2×40) ≈ 0.24 m；溫差減為 3 °C 時偏移約 0.07 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Top offset from thermal bowing δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2B). With α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, a 10 °C difference across the section, a construction height H = 400 m and width B = 40 m, δ = 12×10⁻⁶×10×400²/(2×40) ≈ 0.24 m; at a 3 °C difference the offset is about 0.07 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在塔身不同高度與方位設置溫度計與全球衛星定位接收器，建立溫差與頂部偏移的關係；每段鋼構安裝後於清晨無風時複測座標，與施工階段分析預測的形狀（含自重與溫度）比較，確認偏差在容許範圍內才可進行下一段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install thermometers and satellite-positioning receivers at several heights and orientations to correlate temperature difference with top offset; after each segment is erected, resurvey coordinates in calm early-morning conditions and compare with the shape predicted by construction-stage analysis including self-weight and temperature, proceeding only when deviations are within tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 溫差彎曲頂部偏移 δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2B)。α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、兩側溫差 ΔT = 10 °C、施工高度 H = 400 m、該段寬度 B = 40 m，δ = 12×10⁻⁶×10×400²/(2×40) ≈ 0.24 m；溫差減為 3 °C 時偏移約 0.07 m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Top offset from thermal bowing δ = α·ΔT·H²/(2B). With α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, a 10 °C difference across the section, a construction height H = 400 m and width B = 40 m, δ = 12×10⁻⁶×10×400²/(2×40) ≈ 0.24 m; at a 3 °C difference the offset is about 0.07 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「日照彎曲與施工測量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 在塔身不同高度與方位設置溫度計與全球衛星定位接收器，建立溫差與頂部偏移的關係；每段鋼構安裝後於清晨無風時複測座標，與施工階段分析預測的形狀（含自重與溫度）比較，確認偏差在容許範圍內才可進行下一段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install thermometers and satellite-positioning receivers at several heights and orientations to correlate temperature difference with top offset; after each segment is erected, resurvey coordinates in calm early-morning conditions and compare with the shape predicted by construction-stage analysis including self-weight and temperature, proceeding only when deviations are within tolerance. steps.observation: 現場實務：測量程序書要規定量測時段、溫差上限與風速上限，所有修正量由測量主管與結構工程師共同核可；三支腳柱必須在同一時段量測，資料保留以供日後完工形狀比對。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在午後量測並依此修正，塔身冷卻後會偏離設計軸線，累積到上部時天線塔可能無法對準中央豎井；三支腳柱若各自以不同時段的測量資料修正，塔身會出現扭轉誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 若在午後量測並依此修正，塔身冷卻後會偏離設計軸線，累積到上部時天線塔可能無法對準中央豎井；三支腳柱若各自以不同時段的測量資料修正，塔身會出現扭轉誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
