steps.title: 在中央豎井內組裝並頂升天線塔：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Assembling and lifting the antenna mast inside the shaft: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「天線塔頂升」如何影響東京晴空塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gain-tower lift-up” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tokyo Skytree”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 晴空塔頂部的天線塔（gain tower）外徑約 6 m，並未用塔吊一節一節吊到 600 m 以上，而是在塔身中央的豎井內由下往上組裝，連同避雷設施與兩組合計約 100 公噸的調諧質量阻尼器，逐段頂升推出塔頂。2010 年 12 月開始在豎井內逐步上推，2011 年 3 月達到 634 m。豎井內頂升避免了在極高處以塔吊吊裝大型構件，也讓高空作業轉移到有遮蔽的豎井內；代價是頂升期間塔身要承受天線塔的移動荷重與導引反力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「天線塔頂升」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The antenna mast, or gain tower, at the top of Skytree is about 6 m in outside diameter. Rather than being lifted piece by piece by crane above 600 m, it was assembled inside the central shaft from below and jacked upward in stages, carrying lightning protection and two tuned mass dampers totalling about 100 t, until it emerged at the top. Lifting inside the shaft began in December 2010 and the mast reached 634 m in March 2011. Lifting within the shaft avoided crane lifts of large members at extreme height and moved work at height into a sheltered shaft, at the cost of the tower carrying the mast's moving load and guide reactions during the lift. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Gain-tower lift-up” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：頂升荷重分配：若天線塔連同附屬設備重 3,000 t，W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN，由 6 具千斤頂分擔各約 4.9 MN；計入 1.25 動力與不均勻係數後約 6.1 MN，選用 8 MN 千斤頂時使用率約 77%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Jacking load sharing: if the mast with its equipment weighs 3,000 t, W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN, about 4.9 MN on each of 6 jacks; with a 1.25 factor for dynamics and unevenness this is about 6.1 MN, a utilisation of about 77% on 8 MN jacks.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「在豎井內頂升比較安全，所以不需要另做結構分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lifting inside the shaft is safer, so no separate structural analysis is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「天線塔頂升」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Gain-tower lift-up”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 在中央豎井內組裝並頂升天線塔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Assembling and lifting the antenna mast inside the shaft: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「天線塔頂升」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gain-tower lift-up” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：頂升荷重分配：若天線塔連同附屬設備重 3,000 t，W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN，由 6 具千斤頂分擔各約 4.9 MN；計入 1.25 動力與不均勻係數後約 6.1 MN，選用 8 MN 千斤頂時使用率約 77%。若行程 0.5 m、需推升 130 m，約 260 個循環。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Jacking load sharing: if the mast with its equipment weighs 3,000 t, W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN, about 4.9 MN on each of 6 jacks; with a 1.25 factor for dynamics and unevenness this is about 6.1 MN, a utilisation of about 77% on 8 MN jacks. With a 0.5 m stroke, a 130 m lift needs about 260 cycles. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：頂升前以施工階段分析檢查各頂升位置時塔身的應力與變形，千斤頂壓力以同步控制系統即時監測，各點荷重差異超過設定值即停止；每次頂升後量測天線塔的垂直度與導引間隙，並在強風預報時停止頂升並鎖定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before jacking, check tower stresses and deformation at each lift position with construction-stage analysis, monitor jack pressures in real time through a synchronised control system, and stop when load differences between points exceed the set value; after each lift measure mast verticality and guide clearances, stopping and locking whenever strong winds are forecast.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 頂升荷重分配：若天線塔連同附屬設備重 3,000 t，W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN，由 6 具千斤頂分擔各約 4.9 MN；計入 1.25 動力與不均勻係數後約 6.1 MN，選用 8 MN 千斤頂時使用率約 77%。若行程 0.5 m、需推升 130 m，約 260 個循環。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Jacking load sharing: if the mast with its equipment weighs 3,000 t, W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN, about 4.9 MN on each of 6 jacks; with a 1.25 factor for dynamics and unevenness this is about 6.1 MN, a utilisation of about 77% on 8 MN jacks. With a 0.5 m stroke, a 130 m lift needs about 260 cycles. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「在中央豎井內組裝並頂升天線塔」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Assembling and lifting the antenna mast inside the shaft", which statement holds?
options: 落冰只是維護清潔問題，和結構工程無關。
頂升荷重分配：若天線塔連同附屬設備重 3,000 t，W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN，由 6 具千斤頂分擔各約 4.9 MN。
格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。
optionsEn: Falling ice is only a cleaning issue and has nothing to do with structural engineering.
Jacking load sharing: if the mast with its equipment weighs 3,000 t, W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN, about 4.9 MN on each of 6 jacks.
A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 頂升荷重分配：若天線塔連同附屬設備重 3,000 t，W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN，由 6 具千斤頂分擔各約 4.9 MN；計入 1.25 動力與不均勻係數後約 6.1 MN，選用 8 MN 千斤頂時使用率約 77%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Jacking load sharing: if the mast with its equipment weighs 3,000 t, W = 3,000×9.81 ≈ 29.4 MN, about 4.9 MN on each of 6 jacks; with a 1.25 factor for dynamics and unevenness this is about 6.1 MN, a utilisation of about 77% on 8 MN jacks. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 在中央豎井內組裝並頂升天線塔：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Assembling and lifting the antenna mast inside the shaft: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「天線塔頂升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gain-tower lift-up” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 頂升前以施工階段分析檢查各頂升位置時塔身的應力與變形，千斤頂壓力以同步控制系統即時監測，各點荷重差異超過設定值即停止；每次頂升後量測天線塔的垂直度與導引間隙，並在強風預報時停止頂升並鎖定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before jacking, check tower stresses and deformation at each lift position with construction-stage analysis, monitor jack pressures in real time through a synchronised control system, and stop when load differences between points exceed the set value; after each lift measure mast verticality and guide clearances, stopping and locking whenever strong winds are forecast. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：頂升計畫要列出每一段的荷重、千斤頂壓力上限、同步誤差容許值、風速停工條件與鎖定程序；每次頂升開始前設停止點，由頂升工程師與結構工程師共同確認後才可啟動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lifting plan lists the load at each stage, jack-pressure limits, allowable synchronisation error, wind stop limits and locking procedure; set a hold point before every lift so it starts only after the lifting engineer and structural engineer jointly confirm.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若各千斤頂不同步，天線塔會傾斜並卡在導引上，造成導引構件與塔身局部超載；頂升中遭遇強風而未鎖定時，部分伸出的天線塔像懸臂受風，根部彎矩可能超過臨時支承的容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the jacks fall out of sync, the mast tilts and jams in its guides, locally overloading guide members and the tower; if it is not locked when strong wind arrives mid-lift, the partly extended mast acts as a cantilever in the wind and its root moment can exceed the temporary supports' capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 頂升前以施工階段分析檢查各頂升位置時塔身的應力與變形，千斤頂壓力以同步控制系統即時監測，各點荷重差異超過設定值即停止；每次頂升後量測天線塔的垂直度與導引間隙，並在強風預報時停止頂升並鎖定。
knowledge.textEn: Before jacking, check tower stresses and deformation at each lift position with construction-stage analysis, monitor jack pressures in real time through a synchronised control system, and stop when load differences between points exceed the set value; after each lift measure mast verticality and guide clearances, stopping and locking whenever strong winds are forecast.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 頂升計畫要列出每一段的荷重、千斤頂壓力上限、同步誤差容許值、風速停工條件與鎖定程序；每次頂升開始前設停止點，由頂升工程師與結構工程師共同確認後才可啟動。
knowledge.textEn: The lifting plan lists the load at each stage, jack-pressure limits, allowable synchronisation error, wind stop limits and locking procedure; set a hold point before every lift so it starts only after the lifting engineer and structural engineer jointly confirm.

quiz.question: 要驗證「在中央豎井內組裝並頂升天線塔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Assembling and lifting the antenna mast inside the shaft"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
鋼管越粗越厚就越安全，接頭細節不重要。
頂升前以施工階段分析檢查各頂升位置時塔身的應力與變形，千斤頂壓力以同步控制系統即時監測，各點荷重差異超過設定值即停止。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The bigger and thicker the tube, the safer it is; joint details do not matter.

Before jacking, check tower stresses and deformation at each lift position with construction-stage analysis, monitor jack pressures in real time through a synchronised control system, and stop when load differences between points exceed the set value.
quiz.explanation: 頂升前以施工階段分析檢查各頂升位置時塔身的應力與變形，千斤頂壓力以同步控制系統即時監測，各點荷重差異超過設定值即停止；每次頂升後量測天線塔的垂直度與導引間隙，並在強風預報時停止頂升並鎖定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before jacking, check tower stresses and deformation at each lift position with construction-stage analysis, monitor jack pressures in real time through a synchronised control system, and stop when load differences between points exceed the set value; after each lift measure mast verticality and guide clearances, stopping and locking whenever strong winds are forecast. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 在中央豎井內組裝並頂升天線塔：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Assembling and lifting the antenna mast inside the shaft: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「天線塔頂升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gain-tower lift-up” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若各千斤頂不同步，天線塔會傾斜並卡在導引上，造成導引構件與塔身局部超載；頂升中遭遇強風而未鎖定時，部分伸出的天線塔像懸臂受風，根部彎矩可能超過臨時支承的容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the jacks fall out of sync, the mast tilts and jams in its guides, locally overloading guide members and the tower; if it is not locked when strong wind arrives mid-lift, the partly extended mast acts as a cantilever in the wind and its root moment can exceed the temporary supports' capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：豎井內頂升避免了在極高處以塔吊吊裝大型構件，也讓高空作業轉移到有遮蔽的豎井內；代價是頂升期間塔身要承受天線塔的移動荷重與導引反力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lifting within the shaft avoided crane lifts of large members at extreme height and moved work at height into a sheltered shaft, at the cost of the tower carrying the mast's moving load and guide reactions during the lift.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「在豎井內頂升比較安全，所以不需要另做結構分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lifting inside the shaft is safer, so no separate structural analysis is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若各千斤頂不同步，天線塔會傾斜並卡在導引上，造成導引構件與塔身局部超載；頂升中遭遇強風而未鎖定時，部分伸出的天線塔像懸臂受風，根部彎矩可能超過臨時支承的容量。
knowledge.textEn: If the jacks fall out of sync, the mast tilts and jams in its guides, locally overloading guide members and the tower; if it is not locked when strong wind arrives mid-lift, the partly extended mast acts as a cantilever in the wind and its root moment can exceed the temporary supports' capacity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「在中央豎井內組裝並頂升天線塔」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Assembling and lifting the antenna mast inside the shaft" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若各千斤頂不同步，天線塔會傾斜並卡在導引上，造成導引構件與塔身局部超載；頂升中遭遇強風而未鎖定時，部分伸出的天線塔像懸臂受風，根部彎矩可能超過臨時支承的容量。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
阻尼器的力量越大越好，不需要限制。
optionsEn: If the jacks fall out of sync, the mast tilts and jams in its guides, locally overloading guide members and the tower.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The larger a damper's force the better, so it needs no limit.
quiz.explanation: 若各千斤頂不同步，天線塔會傾斜並卡在導引上，造成導引構件與塔身局部超載；頂升中遭遇強風而未鎖定時，部分伸出的天線塔像懸臂受風，根部彎矩可能超過臨時支承的容量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the jacks fall out of sync, the mast tilts and jams in its guides, locally overloading guide members and the tower; if it is not locked when strong wind arrives mid-lift, the partly extended mast acts as a cantilever in the wind and its root moment can exceed the temporary supports' capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證」與「2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Verifying the central-column oil dampers" and "Inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Verifying the central-column oil dampers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「油壓阻尼器的雙線性特性」如何影響東京晴空塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bilinear oil-damper behaviour” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tokyo Skytree”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 連接心柱與鋼塔的油壓阻尼器必須在中小振動時提供足夠阻尼，又不能在大地震時產生過大的力而損壞心柱或鋼塔接頭。常見做法是加裝釋壓閥，使阻尼器呈雙線性：速度低於某一門檻時阻尼力與速度成正比，超過門檻後阻尼係數大幅降低，力量只緩慢增加。驗證的重點是確認實際產品的門檻速度、兩段阻尼係數與溫度影響，與分析模型使用的參數一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「油壓阻尼器的雙線性特性」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The oil dampers linking the central column and steel tower must provide enough damping in small and moderate vibrations without generating forces large enough in a major earthquake to damage the column or tower connections. A common solution is a relief valve that makes the damper bilinear: below a threshold velocity force is proportional to velocity, and above it the damping coefficient drops sharply so force rises only slowly. Verification focuses on confirming that the actual units' threshold velocity, two damping coefficients and temperature sensitivity match the parameters used in the analysis model. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bilinear oil-damper behaviour” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：雙線性阻尼 F = c₁·v（v ≤ v_r），F = c₁·v_r + c₂·(v − v_r)（v > v_r）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Bilinear damping: F = c₁·v for v ≤ v_r and F = c₁·v_r + c₂·(v − v_r) for v > v_r.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器的力量越大越好，不需要限制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The larger a damper's force the better, so it needs no limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「油壓阻尼器的雙線性特性」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bilinear oil-damper behaviour”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證
knowledge.text: 連接心柱與鋼塔的油壓阻尼器必須在中小振動時提供足夠阻尼，又不能在大地震時產生過大的力而損壞心柱或鋼塔接頭。常見做法是加裝釋壓閥，使阻尼器呈雙線性：速度低於某一門檻時阻尼力與速度成正比，超過門檻後阻尼係數大幅降低，力量只緩慢增加。
knowledge.textEn: The oil dampers linking the central column and steel tower must provide enough damping in small and moderate vibrations without generating forces large enough in a major earthquake to damage the column or tower connections. A common solution is a relief valve that makes the damper bilinear: below a threshold velocity force is proportional to velocity, and above it the damping coefficient drops sharply so force rises only slowly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器的力量越大越好，不需要限制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The larger a damper's force the better, so it needs no limit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Verifying the central-column oil dampers" is correct?
options: 阻尼器的力量越大越好，不需要限制。
連接心柱與鋼塔的油壓阻尼器必須在中小振動時提供足夠阻尼，又不能在大地震時產生過大的力而損壞心柱或鋼塔接頭。
地震後只要外觀沒有明顯損壞，施工中的結構就可以立即復工。
optionsEn: The larger a damper's force the better, so it needs no limit.

The oil dampers linking the central column and steel tower must provide enough damping in small and moderate vibrations without generating forces large enough in a major earthquake to damage the column or tower connections.
If there is no visible damage after an earthquake, work on an unfinished structure can resume immediately.
quiz.explanation: 連接心柱與鋼塔的油壓阻尼器必須在中小振動時提供足夠阻尼，又不能在大地震時產生過大的力而損壞心柱或鋼塔接頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The oil dampers linking the central column and steel tower must provide enough damping in small and moderate vibrations without generating forces large enough in a major earthquake to damage the column or tower connections. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Verifying the central-column oil dampers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「油壓阻尼器的雙線性特性」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bilinear oil-damper behaviour” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：雙線性阻尼 F = c₁·v（v ≤ v_r），F = c₁·v_r + c₂·(v − v_r)（v > v_r）。取 c₁ = 10,000 kN·s/m、v_r = 0.1 m/s、c₂ = 1,000 kN·s/m：v = 0.3 m/s 時 F = 1,000 + 1,000×0.2 = 1,200 kN，若無釋壓閥則為 3,000 kN，接頭設計力可降低六成。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Bilinear damping: F = c₁·v for v ≤ v_r and F = c₁·v_r + c₂·(v − v_r) for v > v_r. With c₁ = 10,000 kN·s/m, v_r = 0.1 m/s and c₂ = 1,000 kN·s/m, at v = 0.3 m/s F = 1,000 + 1,000×0.2 = 1,200 kN, versus 3,000 kN without a relief valve, cutting the connection design force by 60%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一具阻尼器出廠前以動態試驗機做正弦加載，涵蓋門檻速度上下的多個速度與溫度，繪出力—速度曲線並與規格允差比較；安裝後檢查固定端螺栓預力、油位與行程指示，並把序號與試驗結果對應存檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before delivery, test every damper on a dynamic rig with sinusoidal loading at several velocities above and below the threshold and at several temperatures, plotting force–velocity curves against the specified tolerance; after installation check end-connection bolt preload, oil level and stroke indicators, and file serial numbers against test results.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

With c₁ = 10,000 kN·s/m, v_r = 0.1 m/s and c₂ = 1,000 kN·s/m, at v = 0.3 m/s F = 1,000 + 1,000×0.2 = 1,200 kN, versus 3,000 kN without a relief valve, cutting the connection design force by 60%. knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Verifying the central-column oil dampers", which statement holds?
options: 主鋼管很厚，所以腐蝕對鋼管塔沒有影響。
心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。
雙線性阻尼 F = c₁·v（v ≤ v_r），F = c₁·v_r + c₂·(v − v_r)（v > v_r）。
optionsEn: The main tubes are very thick, so corrosion does not matter for a tube tower.
The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight.
Bilinear damping: F = c₁·v for v ≤ v_r and F = c₁·v_r + c₂·(v − v_r) for v > v_r.
quiz.explanation: 雙線性阻尼 F = c₁·v（v ≤ v_r），F = c₁·v_r + c₂·(v − v_r)（v > v_r）。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Verifying the central-column oil dampers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「油壓阻尼器的雙線性特性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bilinear oil-damper behaviour” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一具阻尼器出廠前以動態試驗機做正弦加載，涵蓋門檻速度上下的多個速度與溫度，繪出力—速度曲線並與規格允差比較；安裝後檢查固定端螺栓預力、油位與行程指示，並把序號與試驗結果對應存檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before delivery, test every damper on a dynamic rig with sinusoidal loading at several velocities above and below the threshold and at several temperatures, plotting force–velocity curves against the specified tolerance; after installation check end-connection bolt preload, oil level and stroke indicators, and file serial numbers against test results. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購規範要寫明門檻速度、兩段阻尼係數、溫度範圍內的變化上限與逐具試驗要求；心柱與鋼塔接頭的設計力須以阻尼器可能的最大力（含製造允差）計算，並由結構設計者確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The procurement specification states the threshold velocity, both damping coefficients, the maximum variation over the temperature range and unit-by-unit testing; design the column and tower connections for the damper's maximum possible force including manufacturing tolerance, confirmed by the structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：釋壓閥設定過高時，大地震中阻尼器力量超出接頭容量，可能拉壞心柱的埋件；設定過低則中小地震時阻尼不足，心柱制振效果打折。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A relief valve set too high lets damper force exceed connection capacity in a major earthquake, possibly tearing out embeds in the column; set too low, it leaves too little damping in moderate earthquakes and weakens the central-column scheme. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每一具阻尼器出廠前以動態試驗機做正弦加載，涵蓋門檻速度上下的多個速度與溫度，繪出力—速度曲線並與規格允差比較；安裝後檢查固定端螺栓預力、油位與行程指示，並把序號與試驗結果對應存檔。
knowledge.textEn: Before delivery, test every damper on a dynamic rig with sinusoidal loading at several velocities above and below the threshold and at several temperatures, plotting force–velocity curves against the specified tolerance; after installation check end-connection bolt preload, oil level and stroke indicators, and file serial numbers against test results.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採購規範要寫明門檻速度、兩段阻尼係數、溫度範圍內的變化上限與逐具試驗要求；心柱與鋼塔接頭的設計力須以阻尼器可能的最大力（含製造允差）計算，並由結構設計者確認。
knowledge.textEn: The procurement specification states the threshold velocity, both damping coefficients, the maximum variation over the temperature range and unit-by-unit testing; design the column and tower connections for the damper's maximum possible force including manufacturing tolerance, confirmed by the structural designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Verifying the central-column oil dampers"?
options: 每一具阻尼器出廠前以動態試驗機做正弦加載，涵蓋門檻速度上下的多個速度與溫度，繪出力—速度曲線並與規格允差比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
塔很重，所以基礎只需要考慮下壓，不會受拉。
optionsEn: Before delivery, test every damper on a dynamic rig with sinusoidal loading at several velocities above and below the threshold and at several temperatures, plotting force–velocity curves against the specified tolerance.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The tower is heavy, so its foundation only needs to resist compression and never tension.
quiz.explanation: 每一具阻尼器出廠前以動態試驗機做正弦加載，涵蓋門檻速度上下的多個速度與溫度，繪出力—速度曲線並與規格允差比較；安裝後檢查固定端螺栓預力、油位與行程指示，並把序號與試驗結果對應存檔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before delivery, test every damper on a dynamic rig with sinusoidal loading at several velocities above and below the threshold and at several temperatures, plotting force–velocity curves against the specified tolerance; after installation check end-connection bolt preload, oil level and stroke indicators, and file serial numbers against test results. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Verifying the central-column oil dampers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「油壓阻尼器的雙線性特性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bilinear oil-damper behaviour” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 釋壓閥設定過高時，大地震中阻尼器力量超出接頭容量，可能拉壞心柱的埋件；設定過低則中小地震時阻尼不足，心柱制振效果打折。密封老化漏油會使兩段阻尼係數同時下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A relief valve set too high lets damper force exceed connection capacity in a major earthquake, possibly tearing out embeds in the column; set too low, it leaves too little damping in moderate earthquakes and weakens the central-column scheme. Ageing seals that leak oil lower both damping coefficients. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗證的重點是確認實際產品的門檻速度、兩段阻尼係數與溫度影響，與分析模型使用的參數一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Verification focuses on confirming that the actual units' threshold velocity, two damping coefficients and temperature sensitivity match the parameters used in the analysis model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器的力量越大越好，不需要限制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The larger a damper's force the better, so it needs no limit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 釋壓閥設定過高時，大地震中阻尼器力量超出接頭容量，可能拉壞心柱的埋件；設定過低則中小地震時阻尼不足，心柱制振效果打折。密封老化漏油會使兩段阻尼係數同時下降。
knowledge.textEn: A relief valve set too high lets damper force exceed connection capacity in a major earthquake, possibly tearing out embeds in the column; set too low, it leaves too little damping in moderate earthquakes and weakens the central-column scheme. Ageing seals that leak oil lower both damping coefficients.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Verifying the central-column oil dampers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
釋壓閥設定過高時，大地震中阻尼器力量超出接頭容量，可能拉壞心柱的埋件；設定過低則中小地震時阻尼不足，心柱制振效果打折。
地震後只要外觀沒有明顯損壞，施工中的結構就可以立即復工。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A relief valve set too high lets damper force exceed connection capacity in a major earthquake, possibly tearing out embeds in the column.
If there is no visible damage after an earthquake, work on an unfinished structure can resume immediately.
quiz.explanation: 釋壓閥設定過高時，大地震中阻尼器力量超出接頭容量，可能拉壞心柱的埋件；設定過低則中小地震時阻尼不足，心柱制振效果打折。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A relief valve set too high lets damper force exceed connection capacity in a major earthquake, possibly tearing out embeds in the column; set too low, it leaves too little damping in moderate earthquakes and weakens the central-column scheme. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「施工中強震後檢查」如何影響東京晴空塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-earthquake inspection during construction” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tokyo Skytree”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 2011 年 3 月 11 日東北地方太平洋近海地震發生時，晴空塔已接近完成高度，天線塔仍在頂升階段；地震後塔體接受全面檢查，業主公開表示人員安全、結構無損，一週後的 3 月 18 日達到 634 m。施工中的結構與完工狀態不同：阻尼器可能尚未全部連接、臨時支承仍在、上部有移動中的構件，因此地震後的檢查必須以當時的施工狀態為基準，而不是以完工設計為基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「施工中強震後檢查」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When the Tōhoku earthquake struck on 11 March 2011, Skytree was close to full height with the antenna mast still being lifted; the tower was fully inspected afterwards, the owner announced that workers were safe and the structure undamaged, and it reached 634 m a week later on 18 March. A structure under construction differs from the finished state: dampers may not all be connected, temporary supports remain and members at the top may be in motion, so post-earthquake inspection must be based on the construction state at the time, not on the completed design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-earthquake inspection during construction” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：殘留傾斜判斷：比較地震前後同一時段、相近溫度下的頂部座標，若差值 12 mm、量測高度 600 m，傾角 12/600,000 = 1/50,000；若量測不確定度為 ±15 mm，差值小於兩倍不確定度，可判定沒有可量測的殘留變形。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Residual tilt check: compare top coordinates before and after the earthquake at the same time of day and similar temperature; a 12 mm difference at 600 m is a tilt of 12/600,000 = 1/50,000, and with a survey uncertainty of ±15 mm the change is below twice the uncertainty, so no measurable residual deformation is concluded.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地震後只要外觀沒有明顯損壞，施工中的結構就可以立即復工。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If there is no visible damage after an earthquake, work on an unfinished structure can resume immediately." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「施工中強震後檢查」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-earthquake inspection during construction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查
knowledge.titleEn: Inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake
knowledge.text: 2011 年 3 月 11 日東北地方太平洋近海地震發生時，晴空塔已接近完成高度，天線塔仍在頂升階段；地震後塔體接受全面檢查，業主公開表示人員安全、結構無損，一週後的 3 月 18 日達到 634 m。施工中的結構與完工狀態不同：阻尼器可能尚未全部連接、臨時支承仍在、上部有移動中的構件，因此地震後的檢查必須以當時的施工狀態為基準，而不是以完工設計為基準。

knowledge.text: 誤解：地震後只要外觀沒有明顯損壞，施工中的結構就可以立即復工。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If there is no visible damage after an earthquake, work on an unfinished structure can resume immediately. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake" is correct?

When the Tōhoku earthquake struck on 11 March 2011, Skytree was close to full height with the antenna mast still being lifted.
quiz.explanation: 2011 年 3 月 11 日東北地方太平洋近海地震發生時，晴空塔已接近完成高度，天線塔仍在頂升階段；地震後塔體接受全面檢查，業主公開表示人員安全、結構無損，一週後的 3 月 18 日達到 634 m。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When the Tōhoku earthquake struck on 11 March 2011, Skytree was close to full height with the antenna mast still being lifted; the tower was fully inspected afterwards, the owner announced that workers were safe and the structure undamaged, and it reached 634 m a week later on 18 March. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工中強震後檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-earthquake inspection during construction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：殘留傾斜判斷：比較地震前後同一時段、相近溫度下的頂部座標，若差值 12 mm、量測高度 600 m，傾角 12/600,000 = 1/50,000；若量測不確定度為 ±15 mm，差值小於兩倍不確定度，可判定沒有可量測的殘留變形。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Residual tilt check: compare top coordinates before and after the earthquake at the same time of day and similar temperature; a 12 mm difference at 600 m is a tilt of 12/600,000 = 1/50,000, and with a survey uncertainty of ±15 mm the change is below twice the uncertainty, so no measurable residual deformation is concluded. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依事先訂好的地震後檢查清單，優先檢查臨時支承、頂升設備、已安裝阻尼器與高應力接頭，以目視、超音波與螺栓扭力抽查；同時比對地震前後的測量資料與現場加速度紀錄，確認結構反應在施工階段分析的預期範圍內，才恢復作業。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Follow a pre-agreed post-earthquake checklist, inspecting temporary supports, lifting equipment, installed dampers and highly stressed connections first by visual, ultrasonic and bolt-torque checks; compare pre- and post-earthquake survey data and site acceleration records to confirm the response was within the construction-stage analysis predictions before work resumes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 殘留傾斜判斷：比較地震前後同一時段、相近溫度下的頂部座標，若差值 12 mm、量測高度 600 m，傾角 12/600,000 = 1/50,000；若量測不確定度為 ±15 mm，差值小於兩倍不確定度，可判定沒有可量測的殘留變形。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Residual tilt check: compare top coordinates before and after the earthquake at the same time of day and similar temperature; a 12 mm difference at 600 m is a tilt of 12/600,000 = 1/50,000, and with a survey uncertainty of ±15 mm the change is below twice the uncertainty, so no measurable residual deformation is concluded. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake", which statement holds?
options: 殘留傾斜判斷：比較地震前後同一時段、相近溫度下的頂部座標，若差值 12 mm、量測高度 600 m，傾角 12/600,000 = 1/50,000。
格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。
鋼管越粗越厚就越安全，接頭細節不重要。
optionsEn: Residual tilt check: compare top coordinates before and after the earthquake at the same time of day and similar temperature.
A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored.
The bigger and thicker the tube, the safer it is; joint details do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 殘留傾斜判斷：比較地震前後同一時段、相近溫度下的頂部座標，若差值 12 mm、量測高度 600 m，傾角 12/600,000 = 1/50,000；若量測不確定度為 ±15 mm，差值小於兩倍不確定度，可判定沒有可量測的殘留變形。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Residual tilt check: compare top coordinates before and after the earthquake at the same time of day and similar temperature; a 12 mm difference at 600 m is a tilt of 12/600,000 = 1/50,000, and with a survey uncertainty of ±15 mm the change is below twice the uncertainty, so no measurable residual deformation is concluded. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工中強震後檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-earthquake inspection during construction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依事先訂好的地震後檢查清單，優先檢查臨時支承、頂升設備、已安裝阻尼器與高應力接頭，以目視、超音波與螺栓扭力抽查；同時比對地震前後的測量資料與現場加速度紀錄，確認結構反應在施工階段分析的預期範圍內，才恢復作業。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Follow a pre-agreed post-earthquake checklist, inspecting temporary supports, lifting equipment, installed dampers and highly stressed connections first by visual, ultrasonic and bolt-torque checks; compare pre- and post-earthquake survey data and site acceleration records to confirm the response was within the construction-stage analysis predictions before work resumes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫中要預先寫好地震後的停工門檻（例如現場加速度超過設定值）、檢查清單、負責技師與復工簽認程序，並定期保存基準測量資料，以便事件後立即比對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Write post-earthquake stop thresholds such as a site acceleration above a set value, a checklist, the responsible engineer and the restart sign-off procedure into the construction plan in advance, and keep baseline surveys up to date for immediate comparison after an event.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以完工設計檢核地震影響，可能忽略施工中缺少阻尼與臨時支承較弱的狀態，損傷藏在臨時接頭或頂升導引中；沒有地震前的基準測量，事後也無法判斷是否產生殘留變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assessing earthquake effects only against the completed design can overlook the construction state with missing damping and weaker temporary supports, leaving damage hidden in temporary connections or lifting guides; without a pre-earthquake baseline survey, residual deformation cannot be judged afterwards. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依事先訂好的地震後檢查清單，優先檢查臨時支承、頂升設備、已安裝阻尼器與高應力接頭，以目視、超音波與螺栓扭力抽查；同時比對地震前後的測量資料與現場加速度紀錄，確認結構反應在施工階段分析的預期範圍內，才恢復作業。
knowledge.textEn: Follow a pre-agreed post-earthquake checklist, inspecting temporary supports, lifting equipment, installed dampers and highly stressed connections first by visual, ultrasonic and bolt-torque checks; compare pre- and post-earthquake survey data and site acceleration records to confirm the response was within the construction-stage analysis predictions before work resumes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫中要預先寫好地震後的停工門檻（例如現場加速度超過設定值）、檢查清單、負責技師與復工簽認程序，並定期保存基準測量資料，以便事件後立即比對。
knowledge.textEn: Write post-earthquake stop thresholds such as a site acceleration above a set value, a checklist, the responsible engineer and the restart sign-off procedure into the construction plan in advance, and keep baseline surveys up to date for immediate comparison after an event.

quiz.question: 要驗證「2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
依事先訂好的地震後檢查清單，優先檢查臨時支承、頂升設備、已安裝阻尼器與高應力接頭，以目視、超音波與螺栓扭力抽查。
鋼構安裝只要每段都對準設計座標，量測時間不重要。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Follow a pre-agreed post-earthquake checklist, inspecting temporary supports, lifting equipment, installed dampers and highly stressed connections first by visual, ultrasonic and bolt-torque checks.
As long as each segment is set to design coordinates, the time of surveying does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 依事先訂好的地震後檢查清單，優先檢查臨時支承、頂升設備、已安裝阻尼器與高應力接頭，以目視、超音波與螺栓扭力抽查；同時比對地震前後的測量資料與現場加速度紀錄，確認結構反應在施工階段分析的預期範圍內，才恢復作業。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Follow a pre-agreed post-earthquake checklist, inspecting temporary supports, lifting equipment, installed dampers and highly stressed connections first by visual, ultrasonic and bolt-torque checks; compare pre- and post-earthquake survey data and site acceleration records to confirm the response was within the construction-stage analysis predictions before work resumes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工中強震後檢查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-earthquake inspection during construction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以完工設計檢核地震影響，可能忽略施工中缺少阻尼與臨時支承較弱的狀態，損傷藏在臨時接頭或頂升導引中；沒有地震前的基準測量，事後也無法判斷是否產生殘留變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assessing earthquake effects only against the completed design can overlook the construction state with missing damping and weaker temporary supports, leaving damage hidden in temporary connections or lifting guides; without a pre-earthquake baseline survey, residual deformation cannot be judged afterwards. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：施工中的結構與完工狀態不同：阻尼器可能尚未全部連接、臨時支承仍在、上部有移動中的構件，因此地震後的檢查必須以當時的施工狀態為基準，而不是以完工設計為基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A structure under construction differs from the finished state: dampers may not all be connected, temporary supports remain and members at the top may be in motion, so post-earthquake inspection must be based on the construction state at the time, not on the completed design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地震後只要外觀沒有明顯損壞，施工中的結構就可以立即復工。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If there is no visible damage after an earthquake, work on an unfinished structure can resume immediately." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以完工設計檢核地震影響，可能忽略施工中缺少阻尼與臨時支承較弱的狀態，損傷藏在臨時接頭或頂升導引中；沒有地震前的基準測量，事後也無法判斷是否產生殘留變形。
knowledge.textEn: Assessing earthquake effects only against the completed design can overlook the construction state with missing damping and weaker temporary supports, leaving damage hidden in temporary connections or lifting guides; without a pre-earthquake baseline survey, residual deformation cannot be judged afterwards.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
落冰只是維護清潔問題，和結構工程無關。
若只以完工設計檢核地震影響，可能忽略施工中缺少阻尼與臨時支承較弱的狀態，損傷藏在臨時接頭或頂升導引中；沒有地震前的基準測量，事後也無法判斷是否產生殘留變形。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Falling ice is only a cleaning issue and has nothing to do with structural engineering.

Assessing earthquake effects only against the completed design can overlook the construction state with missing damping and weaker temporary supports, leaving damage hidden in temporary connections or lifting guides.
quiz.explanation: 若只以完工設計檢核地震影響，可能忽略施工中缺少阻尼與臨時支承較弱的狀態，損傷藏在臨時接頭或頂升導引中；沒有地震前的基準測量，事後也無法判斷是否產生殘留變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assessing earthquake effects only against the completed design can overlook the construction state with missing damping and weaker temporary supports, leaving damage hidden in temporary connections or lifting guides; without a pre-earthquake baseline survey, residual deformation cannot be judged afterwards. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高聳塔體的結冰、落冰與周邊防護」與「鋼管塔的防蝕塗裝與長期維護」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Icing, ice fall and perimeter protection on a tall tower" and "Coating and long-term upkeep of a tubular steel tower": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高聳塔體的結冰、落冰與周邊防護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Icing, ice fall and perimeter protection on a tall tower: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「冬季結冰與落冰」如何影響東京晴空塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Winter icing and ice fall” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tokyo Skytree”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 晴空塔在 2012 年 2 月完工前後與 2013 年 1 月，曾有雪與冰塊從塔身掉落，損壞鄰近倉庫屋頂並打穿民宅屋頂，成為營運上的結構安全議題。高空溫度低、風大，雪與冰會附著在鋼管與平台上，氣溫回升或強風時成片剝落，從數百公尺高處落下。冰塊的危險取決於其質量與終端速度：較大的冰塊受空氣阻力的影響較小，落地時速度與能量都很高，足以穿透屋頂。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「冬季結冰與落冰」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In February 2012, around completion, and again in January 2013, snow and ice fell from Skytree, damaging nearby warehouse roofs and holing a house roof, making ice an operational structural-safety issue. At height it is cold and windy, so snow and ice cling to tubes and platforms and shed in sheets when temperatures rise or wind strengthens, falling from hundreds of metres. The hazard depends on the ice's mass and terminal velocity: larger pieces are less slowed by air drag and land with high speed and energy, enough to penetrate a roof. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Winter icing and ice fall” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：終端速度 v_t = √(2mg/(ρ·C_d·A))。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Terminal velocity v_t = √(2mg/(ρ·C_d·A)).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「落冰只是維護清潔問題，和結構工程無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Falling ice is only a cleaning issue and has nothing to do with structural engineering." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「冬季結冰與落冰」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Winter icing and ice fall”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高聳塔體的結冰、落冰與周邊防護
knowledge.titleEn: Icing, ice fall and perimeter protection on a tall tower
knowledge.text: 晴空塔在 2012 年 2 月完工前後與 2013 年 1 月，曾有雪與冰塊從塔身掉落，損壞鄰近倉庫屋頂並打穿民宅屋頂，成為營運上的結構安全議題。高空溫度低、風大，雪與冰會附著在鋼管與平台上，氣溫回升或強風時成片剝落，從數百公尺高處落下。
knowledge.textEn: In February 2012, around completion, and again in January 2013, snow and ice fell from Skytree, damaging nearby warehouse roofs and holing a house roof, making ice an operational structural-safety issue. At height it is cold and windy, so snow and ice cling to tubes and platforms and shed in sheets when temperatures rise or wind strengthens, falling from hundreds of metres.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：落冰只是維護清潔問題，和結構工程無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Falling ice is only a cleaning issue and has nothing to do with structural engineering. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高聳塔體的結冰、落冰與周邊防護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Icing, ice fall and perimeter protection on a tall tower" is correct?
options: 晴空塔在 2012 年 2 月完工前後與 2013 年 1 月，曾有雪與冰塊從塔身掉落，損壞鄰近倉庫屋頂並打穿民宅屋頂，成為營運上的結構安全議題。
落冰只是維護清潔問題，和結構工程無關。
主鋼管很厚，所以腐蝕對鋼管塔沒有影響。
optionsEn: In February 2012, around completion, and again in January 2013, snow and ice fell from Skytree, damaging nearby warehouse roofs and holing a house roof, making ice an operational structural-safety issue.
Falling ice is only a cleaning issue and has nothing to do with structural engineering.
The main tubes are very thick, so corrosion does not matter for a tube tower.
