steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Statistical combination of relative movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數；設計值取最不利風向的相對位移，並與單塔結果直接相加的保守估算比較，確認空橋支承與伸縮裝置的行程足夠。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction; take the design value from the worst direction's relative movement, compare it with the conservative estimate of simply adding single-tower results, and confirm the skybridge bearings and joints have enough travel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風洞試驗範圍要明列雙塔干擾與相對位移的輸出項目；完工後在兩塔空橋層附近設置同步加速度計，強風事件後比對實測相對位移與設計值，偏差大時通知結構顧問。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make twin-tower interference and relative movement explicit deliverables of the wind-tunnel scope; after completion fit synchronised accelerometers near bridge level in both towers and compare measured relative movement with the design value after strong-wind events, notifying the structural consultant of large deviations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數；設計值取最不利風向的相對位移，並與單塔結果直接相加的保守估算比較，確認空橋支承與伸縮裝置的行程足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction; take the design value from the worst direction's relative movement, compare it with the conservative estimate of simply adding single-tower results, and confirm the skybridge bearings and joints have enough travel.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風洞試驗範圍要明列雙塔干擾與相對位移的輸出項目；完工後在兩塔空橋層附近設置同步加速度計，強風事件後比對實測相對位移與設計值，偏差大時通知結構顧問。
knowledge.textEn: Make twin-tower interference and relative movement explicit deliverables of the wind-tunnel scope; after completion fit synchronised accelerometers near bridge level in both towers and compare measured relative movement with the design value after strong-wind events, notifying the structural consultant of large deviations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數。
只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction.
If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數；設計值取最不利風向的相對位移，並與單塔結果直接相加的保守估算比較，確認空橋支承與伸縮裝置的行程足夠。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction; take the design value from the worst direction's relative movement, compare it with the conservative estimate of simply adding single-tower results, and confirm the skybridge bearings and joints have enough travel. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「兩塔相對位移的統計組合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Statistical combination of relative movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：風洞試驗必須同時放置兩座塔的模型，量測各風向下兩塔的位移時程，再以統計方法求出相對位移的設計值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The wind tunnel must model both towers together, record their displacement histories for each wind direction and derive the design relative movement statistically.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。
knowledge.textEn: Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。
若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance.

Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact.
quiz.explanation: 若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護」與「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate" and "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stainless-steel and glass façade” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙子星塔的外牆以不鏽鋼與玻璃為主，在吉隆坡終年高溫、強烈日照與熱帶暴雨下運作。不鏽鋼的熱膨脹係數比玻璃與混凝土大，日照時外露金屬升溫快，三種材料的伸縮差會集中在接縫、密封膠與固定件上；暴雨與高濕度則考驗排水與防水設計。外牆的長期維護包括密封膠更換、固定件腐蝕檢查與玻璃破損更換，都需要能到達每一處的外牆維護設備。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Petronas façade is mainly stainless steel and glass, working year-round in Kuala Lumpur's heat, strong sun and tropical downpours. Stainless steel expands more with heat than glass or concrete, and exposed metal heats quickly in sunshine, so the differential movement of the three materials concentrates at joints, sealants and fixings, while heavy rain and humidity test drainage and waterproofing. Long-term upkeep includes sealant replacement, fixing corrosion checks and broken-glass replacement, all requiring access equipment that can reach every part of the façade. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stainless-steel and glass façade” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stainless-steel and glass façade”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護
knowledge.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate
knowledge.text: 雙子星塔的外牆以不鏽鋼與玻璃為主，在吉隆坡終年高溫、強烈日照與熱帶暴雨下運作。不鏽鋼的熱膨脹係數比玻璃與混凝土大，日照時外露金屬升溫快，三種材料的伸縮差會集中在接縫、密封膠與固定件上；暴雨與高濕度則考驗排水與防水設計。
knowledge.textEn: The Petronas façade is mainly stainless steel and glass, working year-round in Kuala Lumpur's heat, strong sun and tropical downpours. Stainless steel expands more with heat than glass or concrete, and exposed metal heats quickly in sunshine, so the differential movement of the three materials concentrates at joints, sealants and fixings, while heavy rain and humidity test drainage and waterproofing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate" is correct?
options: 雙子星塔的外牆以不鏽鋼與玻璃為主，在吉隆坡終年高溫、強烈日照與熱帶暴雨下運作。
不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。
空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。
optionsEn: The Petronas façade is mainly stainless steel and glass, working year-round in Kuala Lumpur's heat, strong sun and tropical downpours.
Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance.
The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure.
quiz.explanation: 雙子星塔的外牆以不鏽鋼與玻璃為主，在吉隆坡終年高溫、強烈日照與熱帶暴雨下運作。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Petronas façade is mainly stainless steel and glass, working year-round in Kuala Lumpur's heat, strong sun and tropical downpours. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stainless-steel and glass façade” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。4 m 長的構件、溫升 50 °C：沃斯田鐵系不鏽鋼 α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm；玻璃 α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 1.8 mm；兩者相差 1.6 mm，須由接縫與密封膠吸收。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a 4 m member heating by 50 °C, austenitic stainless steel with α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C grows ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm, while glass with α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C grows 1.8 mm; the 1.6 mm difference must be taken up by joints and sealant. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement; in service inspect regularly for sealant hardening and cracking, galvanic corrosion where stainless steel contacts carbon-steel fixings, and blocked drainage holes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。4 m 長的構件、溫升 50 °C：沃斯田鐵系不鏽鋼 α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm；玻璃 α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 1.8 mm；兩者相差 1.6 mm，須由接縫與密封膠吸收。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a 4 m member heating by 50 °C, austenitic stainless steel with α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C grows ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm, while glass with α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C grows 1.8 mm; the 1.6 mm difference must be taken up by joints and sealant. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate", which statement holds?
options: 建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。
熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
空橋把兩座塔連在一起，可以讓兩塔互相支撐、減少擺動。
optionsEn: The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure.
Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
The skybridge ties the two towers together so they brace each other and sway less.
quiz.explanation: 熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stainless-steel and glass façade” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement; in service inspect regularly for sealant hardening and cracking, galvanic corrosion where stainless steel contacts carbon-steel fixings, and blocked drainage holes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件列出外牆材料的熱脹設計值、接縫容許變形、密封膠更換週期與異種金屬絕緣細部；維護紀錄依立面與樓層編號管理，方便追蹤重複發生的漏水點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents list the design thermal movements of façade materials, allowable joint deformation, sealant replacement intervals and dissimilar-metal isolation details; organise maintenance records by elevation and floor to track recurring leaks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings; dissimilar metals in direct contact without isolation suffer galvanic corrosion in the humid climate, weakening the fixings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。
knowledge.textEn: Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement; in service inspect regularly for sealant hardening and cracking, galvanic corrosion where stainless steel contacts carbon-steel fixings, and blocked drainage holes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件列出外牆材料的熱脹設計值、接縫容許變形、密封膠更換週期與異種金屬絕緣細部；維護紀錄依立面與樓層編號管理，方便追蹤重複發生的漏水點。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents list the design thermal movements of façade materials, allowable joint deformation, sealant replacement intervals and dissimilar-metal isolation details; organise maintenance records by elevation and floor to track recurring leaks.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩座塔各自做到垂直，空橋自然就能對準。
以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit.
Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement.
quiz.explanation: 以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement; in service inspect regularly for sealant hardening and cracking, galvanic corrosion where stainless steel contacts carbon-steel fixings, and blocked drainage holes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stainless-steel and glass façade” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings; dissimilar metals in direct contact without isolation suffer galvanic corrosion in the humid climate, weakening the fixings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：外牆的長期維護包括密封膠更換、固定件腐蝕檢查與玻璃破損更換，都需要能到達每一處的外牆維護設備。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Long-term upkeep includes sealant replacement, fixing corrosion checks and broken-glass replacement, all requiring access equipment that can reach every part of the façade.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings; dissimilar metals in direct contact without isolation suffer galvanic corrosion in the humid climate, weakening the fixings.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。
optionsEn: Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure.
quiz.explanation: 若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings; dissimilar metals in direct contact without isolation suffer galvanic corrosion in the humid climate, weakening the fixings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「空橋避難路徑」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Skybridge escape route” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙子星塔的空橋不只是觀光設施，也是火災避難策略的一部分：一座塔發生緊急狀況時，上層人員可經空橋疏散到另一座塔，再由另一座塔的樓梯或電梯離開。這使空橋的結構、支承、防火與通道淨寬都成為生命安全系統，必須在整個建築壽命中保持可用。任何改裝（例如增設展示、管線或改變出入口）都要確認不會縮減淨寬、阻礙門扇或侵入空橋的可動空間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「空橋避難路徑」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Petronas skybridge is not just an attraction but part of the fire-evacuation strategy: in an emergency in one tower, occupants of the upper floors can cross to the other tower and leave by its stairs or lifts. That makes the bridge's structure, bearings, fire protection and clear width parts of a life-safety system that must remain available throughout the building's life. Any alteration, such as added displays, services or changed entrances, must be checked so it does not reduce clear width, obstruct doors or encroach on the bridge's movement gaps. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Skybridge escape route” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「空橋避難路徑」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Skybridge escape route”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route
knowledge.text: 雙子星塔的空橋不只是觀光設施，也是火災避難策略的一部分：一座塔發生緊急狀況時，上層人員可經空橋疏散到另一座塔，再由另一座塔的樓梯或電梯離開。這使空橋的結構、支承、防火與通道淨寬都成為生命安全系統，必須在整個建築壽命中保持可用。
knowledge.textEn: The Petronas skybridge is not just an attraction but part of the fire-evacuation strategy: in an emergency in one tower, occupants of the upper floors can cross to the other tower and leave by its stairs or lifts. That makes the bridge's structure, bearings, fire protection and clear width parts of a life-safety system that must remain available throughout the building's life.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route" is correct?
options: 空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。
雙子星塔的空橋不只是觀光設施，也是火災避難策略的一部分：一座塔發生緊急狀況時，上層人員可經空橋疏散到另一座塔，再由另一座塔的樓梯或電梯離開。
管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。
optionsEn: The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure.

The Petronas skybridge is not just an attraction but part of the fire-evacuation strategy: in an emergency in one tower, occupants of the upper floors can cross to the other tower and leave by its stairs or lifts.
In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load.
quiz.explanation: 雙子星塔的空橋不只是觀光設施，也是火災避難策略的一部分：一座塔發生緊急狀況時，上層人員可經空橋疏散到另一座塔，再由另一座塔的樓梯或電梯離開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Petronas skybridge is not just an attraction but part of the fire-evacuation strategy: in an emergency in one tower, occupants of the upper floors can cross to the other tower and leave by its stairs or lifts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空橋避難路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Skybridge escape route” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。淨寬 2.4 m、流率 1.3 人/(m·s) 時約 3.1 人/秒；若需疏散 10,000 人，約需 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s，約 53 分鐘。淨寬若因改裝減為 1.8 m，時間增為約 71 分鐘。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate. A 2.4 m clear width at 1.3 persons per metre per second passes about 3.1 persons per second, so evacuating 10,000 people takes about 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s, about 53 minutes. If an alteration narrows the width to 1.8 m, the time rises to about 71 minutes. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。淨寬 2.4 m、流率 1.3 人/(m·s) 時約 3.1 人/秒；若需疏散 10,000 人，約需 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s，約 53 分鐘。淨寬若因改裝減為 1.8 m，時間增為約 71 分鐘。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate. A 2.4 m clear width at 1.3 persons per metre per second passes about 3.1 persons per second, so evacuating 10,000 people takes about 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s, about 53 minutes. If an alteration narrows the width to 1.8 m, the time rises to about 71 minutes. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route", which statement holds?
options: 高強度混凝土比一般混凝土更有韌性，所以不需要額外圍束。
只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。
通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。
optionsEn: High-strength concrete is tougher than ordinary concrete, so it needs no extra confinement.
If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter.
Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate.
quiz.explanation: 通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空橋避難路徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Skybridge escape route” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件把空橋列為生命安全與結構雙重管制的設施，附上淨寬、可動空間、支承規格與檢查表；任何改裝申請須同時經消防與結構審查，並更新避難計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents designate the skybridge as a facility under both life-safety and structural control, with clear widths, movement gaps, bearing specifications and inspection checklists; every alteration request needs both fire and structural review and an updated evacuation plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。
knowledge.textEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件把空橋列為生命安全與結構雙重管制的設施，附上淨寬、可動空間、支承規格與檢查表；任何改裝申請須同時經消防與結構審查，並更新避難計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents designate the skybridge as a facility under both life-safety and structural control, with clear widths, movement gaps, bearing specifications and inspection checklists; every alteration request needs both fire and structural review and an updated evacuation plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route"?
options: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。
optionsEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空橋避難路徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Skybridge escape route” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：任何改裝（例如增設展示、管線或改變出入口）都要確認不會縮減淨寬、阻礙門扇或侵入空橋的可動空間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Any alteration, such as added displays, services or changed entrances, must be checked so it does not reduce clear width, obstruct doors or encroach on the bridge's movement gaps.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。
knowledge.textEn: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。
管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge.
In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load.
quiz.explanation: 若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 世界貿易中心一號大樓
courses.summary: 世界貿易中心一號大樓以約 61 m 見方的基座、逐漸削角收分的體量，把 14,000 psi 高強混凝土核心筒與周邊延性抗彎鋼框架組成混合抗側系統，再以展開基腳與岩錨坐落在曼哈頓岩盤上。本課從削角形體的風荷載、核心筒剛度與替代傳力路徑，走到岩盤基腳、尖塔分段吊裝、大體積高強混凝土的溫控與驗收，最後談強健性設計在營運期的改裝管制與尖塔維護。
courses.summaryEn: One World Trade Center rises from a base about 61 m square with chamfered, tapering faces, combining a 14,000 psi high-strength concrete core and a ductile perimeter steel moment frame into a hybrid lateral system founded on Manhattan bedrock with spread footings and rock anchors. The course moves from wind on the chamfered form, core stiffness and alternate load paths to rock footings, staged spire erection, temperature control and acceptance of high-strength mass concrete, and finally to protecting robustness during later alterations and maintaining the spire.
courses.focus: 以高強混凝土核心筒、周邊延性鋼框架與岩盤基礎，建立兼顧風荷載與結構強健性的混合系統
courses.focusEn: A hybrid of high-strength concrete core, ductile perimeter steel frame and rock foundations balancing wind load and structural robustness
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：以核心筒外圈牆檢核在重力與風力共同作用下是否出現拉應力。核心筒外邊 33.5 m、壁厚 1.2 m，面積 A = 33.5² − 31.1² ≈ 155.0 m²，慣性矩 I ≈ 27,000 m⁴，斷面模數 S = I/(33.5/2) ≈ 1,612 m³。核心筒承受重力 N = 1.2×10⁶ kN，平均壓應力 σ_N = 1.2×10⁶/155.0 ≈ 7.74 MPa。第 1 單元的收分基座力矩 8.52×10⁶ kN·m 中由核心筒分擔 60%，M = 5.11×10⁶ kN·m，彎曲應力 σ_M = 5.11×10⁶/1,612 ≈ 3.17 MPa。最大壓應力 7.74 + 3.17 ≈ 10.9 MPa，只有 96.5 MPa（14,000 psi）的約 11%；最小應力 7.74 − 3.17 ≈ 4.57 MPa 仍為壓力。若某段牆的重力只有 0.4×10⁶ kN，σ_N ≈ 2.58 MPa，最小應力變為 2.58 − 3.17 ≈ −0.59 MPa 的拉應力，就需要配置受拉鋼筋或岩錨來處理上拔。數值為教學假設，忽略開口、內牆與動力效應，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check whether the outer core walls go into tension under gravity plus wind. The core is 33.5 m outside with 1.2 m walls, so A = 33.5² − 31.1² ≈ 155.0 m², I ≈ 27,000 m⁴ and the section modulus S = I/(33.5/2) ≈ 1,612 m³. With a gravity load N = 1.2×10⁶ kN, the average compression is σ_N = 1.2×10⁶/155.0 ≈ 7.74 MPa. Taking 60% of the tapered base moment of 8.52×10⁶ kN·m from unit 1, M = 5.11×10⁶ kN·m and the bending stress σ_M = 5.11×10⁶/1,612 ≈ 3.17 MPa. The maximum compression 7.74 + 3.17 ≈ 10.9 MPa is only about 11% of 96.5 MPa (14,000 psi), and the minimum 7.74 − 3.17 ≈ 4.57 MPa is still compressive. If a wall segment carried only 0.4×10⁶ kN of gravity, σ_N ≈ 2.58 MPa and the minimum stress becomes 2.58 − 3.17 ≈ −0.59 MPa tension, calling for tension reinforcement or rock anchors to resist uplift. Values are teaching assumptions that ignore openings, interior walls and dynamic effects and do not represent the actual design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「削角收分形體與風荷載」與「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" and "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「削角錐形體量」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Chamfered tapering massing” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。迎風寬度隨高度遞減，使高處的風壓作用面積變小，而高處的力臂最長，所以基座傾覆力矩下降得比總風力更明顯；斜切的立面也讓背風側渦流脫落沿高度不同步，削弱橫風向的規律激振。形體因此不只是建築表情，而是降低抗側構件需求的第一道結構手段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「削角錐形體量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top. Because the windward width shrinks with height, the pressure area is smallest where the lever arm is longest, so the base overturning moment falls faster than the total wind force; the inclined faces also desynchronise vortex shedding along the height, weakening regular across-wind excitation. The form is therefore the first structural measure that reduces demand on the lateral system, not just an architectural gesture. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Chamfered tapering massing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For uniform pressure q on a cantilever whose width tapers linearly from B₀ to B₁, the base moment is M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3), versus M = qH²B₀/2 for a prism.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「削角錐形體量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Chamfered tapering massing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載
knowledge.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load
knowledge.text: 大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。迎風寬度隨高度遞減，使高處的風壓作用面積變小，而高處的力臂最長，所以基座傾覆力矩下降得比總風力更明顯；斜切的立面也讓背風側渦流脫落沿高度不同步，削弱橫風向的規律激振。
knowledge.textEn: The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top. Because the windward width shrinks with height, the pressure area is smallest where the lever arm is longest, so the base overturning moment falls faster than the total wind force; the inclined faces also desynchronise vortex shedding along the height, weakening regular across-wind excitation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「削角收分形體與風荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" is correct?
options: 削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。
大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。
核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。
optionsEn: Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads.
The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top.
A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.
quiz.explanation: 大樓基座約 61 m 見方，四角自低處開始削角，平面在半高處成為八角形，往上逐漸轉成旋轉後的較小方形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The base is about 61 m square, its corners are chamfered from low levels, the plan becomes an octagon at mid-height and transitions toward a smaller rotated square near the top. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「削角錐形體量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Chamfered tapering massing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。取 q = 2.0 kPa、H = 417 m、B₀ = 61 m、B₁ = 43 m：稜柱 M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m，收分後 M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m，約減少 19.7%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For uniform pressure q on a cantilever whose width tapers linearly from B₀ to B₁, the base moment is M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3), versus M = qH²B₀/2 for a prism. With q = 2.0 kPa, H = 417 m, B₀ = 61 m and B₁ = 43 m, the prism gives M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m and the tapered form M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m, about 19.7% less. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以剛性模型高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗量測不同風向的基座力矩與扭矩頻譜，與手算的收分折減趨勢及設計風荷載比較；同時檢查最不利風向是否落在削角面或平直面，並確認周邊既有高樓的遮蔽與干擾效應已納入試驗模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run a rigid-model high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel test to measure base moment and torque spectra for each wind direction, and compare them with the hand-calculated taper reduction and the design wind loads; check whether the governing direction strikes a chamfered or a flat face, and confirm that shielding and interference from surrounding towers are modelled.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。取 q = 2.0 kPa、H = 417 m、B₀ = 61 m、B₁ = 43 m：稜柱 M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m，收分後 M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m，約減少 19.7%。數值為教學假設。

With q = 2.0 kPa, H = 417 m, B₀ = 61 m and B₁ = 43 m, the prism gives M ≈ 1.06×10⁷ kN·m and the tapered form M = 2.0×417²×(10.17 + 14.33) ≈ 8.52×10⁶ kN·m, about 19.7% less. knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「削角收分形體與風荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Chamfered tapering form and wind load", which statement holds?
options: 只要每根柱子強度足夠，就不需要考慮某根柱失效後的替代路徑。
尖塔不是主結構，吊裝時只要吊車容量足夠就沒有其他限制。
均布風壓 q 下，寬度由 B₀ 線性收到 B₁ 的懸臂，其基座力矩 M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3)；等寬稜柱 M = qH²B₀/2。
optionsEn: If every column is strong enough, alternate load paths after a column loss need not be considered.
A spire is not primary structure, so crane capacity is the only lifting constraint.
For uniform pressure q on a cantilever whose width tapers linearly from B₀ to B₁, the base moment is M = qH²(B₀/6 + B₁/3), versus M = qH²B₀/2 for a prism.

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「削角錐形體量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Chamfered tapering massing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以剛性模型高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗量測不同風向的基座力矩與扭矩頻譜，與手算的收分折減趨勢及設計風荷載比較；同時檢查最不利風向是否落在削角面或平直面，並確認周邊既有高樓的遮蔽與干擾效應已納入試驗模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a rigid-model high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel test to measure base moment and torque spectra for each wind direction, and compare them with the hand-calculated taper reduction and the design wind loads; check whether the governing direction strikes a chamfered or a flat face, and confirm that shielding and interference from surrounding towers are modelled. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：形體凍結前，結構團隊應以初步風洞或經驗係數比較兩到三種收分方案的基座力矩與加速度，把結果寫入設計基準報告，日後建築外形若再調整須重新取得結構確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before the form is frozen, the structural team should compare base moment and acceleration for two or three taper options using a preliminary wind test or empirical coefficients, record the results in the design basis report, and require structural sign-off for any later change to the massing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振；反之若過度依賴形體折減而風洞未涵蓋周邊建物干擾，某些風向的頂部加速度可能超出居住性準則，完工後才發現擺動與帷幕牆噪音。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions; conversely, relying on the taper benefit without a wind tunnel that models neighbouring towers can leave some directions exceeding habitability limits, discovered only after completion as sway and façade noise. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以剛性模型高頻力平衡（HFFB）風洞試驗量測不同風向的基座力矩與扭矩頻譜，與手算的收分折減趨勢及設計風荷載比較；同時檢查最不利風向是否落在削角面或平直面，並確認周邊既有高樓的遮蔽與干擾效應已納入試驗模型。
knowledge.textEn: Run a rigid-model high-frequency force-balance (HFFB) wind-tunnel test to measure base moment and torque spectra for each wind direction, and compare them with the hand-calculated taper reduction and the design wind loads; check whether the governing direction strikes a chamfered or a flat face, and confirm that shielding and interference from surrounding towers are modelled.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 形體凍結前，結構團隊應以初步風洞或經驗係數比較兩到三種收分方案的基座力矩與加速度，把結果寫入設計基準報告，日後建築外形若再調整須重新取得結構確認。
knowledge.textEn: Before the form is frozen, the structural team should compare base moment and acceleration for two or three taper options using a preliminary wind test or empirical coefficients, record the results in the design basis report, and require structural sign-off for any later change to the massing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「削角收分形體與風荷載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Chamfered tapering form and wind load"?

量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

steps.title: 削角收分形體與風荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chamfered tapering form and wind load: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「削角錐形體量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Chamfered tapering massing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振；反之若過度依賴形體折減而風洞未涵蓋周邊建物干擾，某些風向的頂部加速度可能超出居住性準則，完工後才發現擺動與帷幕牆噪音。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions; conversely, relying on the taper benefit without a wind tunnel that models neighbouring towers can leave some directions exceeding habitability limits, discovered only after completion as sway and façade noise. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：形體因此不只是建築表情，而是降低抗側構件需求的第一道結構手段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The form is therefore the first structural measure that reduces demand on the lateral system, not just an architectural gesture.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「削角與收分只是造型，對結構荷載沒有實質影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Chamfers and taper are purely aesthetic and do not change structural loads." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「削角收分形體與風荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只依規範的等寬稜柱公式設計，構件會偏保守但仍可能漏掉特定風向下的扭轉或橫風向共振。
核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing only with a code formula for a uniform prism is conservative for members yet can miss torsion or across-wind resonance in particular directions.
A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」如何影響世界貿易中心一號大樓的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” governs force, deformation or durability in “One World Trade Center”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用；低樓層有跨多層的「超級斜撐」像腰帶一樣環繞，頂部機械層則以外伸臂把周邊柱與核心筒連在一起。核心筒單獨作用時像一根懸臂梁，頂部變位以彎曲為主；外伸臂把周邊柱的軸向勁度轉成限制核心筒旋轉的力偶，周邊框架再提供額外的剪力勁度與冗餘度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public descriptions state that the concrete core carries most of the gravity load and resists wind and earthquake together with a ductile perimeter steel moment frame; multi-storey super diagonals wrap the lower levels like a belt, and outriggers at the upper mechanical levels tie perimeter columns to the core. Acting alone, the core behaves as a cantilever whose top drift is dominated by bending; the outriggers convert the axial stiffness of perimeter columns into a couple that restrains core rotation, and the perimeter frame adds shear stiffness and redundancy. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Core–frame hybrid lateral system”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工
knowledge.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame
knowledge.text: 公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用；低樓層有跨多層的「超級斜撐」像腰帶一樣環繞，頂部機械層則以外伸臂把周邊柱與核心筒連在一起。核心筒單獨作用時像一根懸臂梁，頂部變位以彎曲為主；外伸臂把周邊柱的軸向勁度轉成限制核心筒旋轉的力偶，周邊框架再提供額外的剪力勁度與冗餘度。
knowledge.textEn: Public descriptions state that the concrete core carries most of the gravity load and resists wind and earthquake together with a ductile perimeter steel moment frame; multi-storey super diagonals wrap the lower levels like a belt, and outriggers at the upper mechanical levels tie perimeter columns to the core. Acting alone, the core behaves as a cantilever whose top drift is dominated by bending; the outriggers convert the axial stiffness of perimeter columns into a couple that restrains core rotation, and the perimeter frame adds shear stiffness and redundancy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame" is correct?
options: 核心筒越厚就越好，周邊框架只是承受重力的附屬構件。
混凝土強度越高，彈性模數必然按比例同步提高。
公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用。
optionsEn: A thicker core is always better and the perimeter frame only carries gravity.
Higher concrete strength always raises the elastic modulus in proportion.
Public descriptions state that the concrete core carries most of the gravity load and resists wind and earthquake together with a ductile perimeter steel moment frame.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料描述此塔以混凝土核心筒承擔大部分重力並抵抗風與地震，周邊延性抗彎鋼框架與核心筒共同作用；低樓層有跨多層的「超級斜撐」像腰帶一樣環繞，頂部機械層則以外伸臂把周邊柱與核心筒連在一起。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Public descriptions state that the concrete core carries most of the gravity load and resists wind and earthquake together with a ductile perimeter steel moment frame; multi-storey super diagonals wrap the lower levels like a belt, and outriggers at the upper mechanical levels tie perimeter columns to the core. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。取外邊 33.5 m、壁厚 1.2 m 的方形管 I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴、E = 48 GPa、w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m、H = 417 m：Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m，約 H/1,170；若外伸臂與框架使等效勁度提高 40%，Δ ≈ 0.254 m，約 H/1,640。數值為教學假設，忽略開口與內牆。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI). For a square tube 33.5 m outside with 1.2 m walls, I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴; with E = 48 GPa, w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m and H = 417 m, Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m, about H/1,170. If outriggers and frame raise the effective stiffness by 40%, Δ ≈ 0.254 m, about H/1,640. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring openings and interior walls. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致；再以實際混凝土模數與開裂勁度折減做敏感度分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the three-dimensional finite-element model, switch off the outriggers, perimeter frame and super diagonals in turn and compare top drift, inter-storey drift ratios and the share of core base moment, confirming that each subsystem's contribution agrees with hand estimates; then run sensitivity studies with the actual concrete modulus and cracked-stiffness reductions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。取外邊 33.5 m、壁厚 1.2 m 的方形管 I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴、E = 48 GPa、w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m、H = 417 m：Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m，約 H/1,170；若外伸臂與框架使等效勁度提高 40%，Δ ≈ 0.254 m，約 H/1,640。數值為教學假設，忽略開口與內牆。
knowledge.textEn: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI). For a square tube 33.5 m outside with 1.2 m walls, I = (33.5⁴ − 31.1⁴)/12 ≈ 27,000 m⁴; with E = 48 GPa, w = 2.0 kPa×61 m = 122 kN/m and H = 417 m, Δ = 122×417⁴/(8×48×10⁶×27,000) ≈ 0.356 m, about H/1,170. If outriggers and frame raise the effective stiffness by 40%, Δ ≈ 0.254 m, about H/1,640. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring openings and interior walls.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame", which statement holds?
options: 僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。
坐落在岩盤上的基礎不會沉陷，也不需要上拔設計。
高強混凝土只要試體強度合格，就代表結構內部的混凝土品質一定合格。
optionsEn: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI).
Foundations on bedrock never settle and never need uplift design.
If high-strength cylinders pass, the concrete inside the structure must be acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 僅核心筒時頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With the core alone the top drift is Δ = wH⁴/(8EI). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「核心筒—框架混合抗側系統」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core–frame hybrid lateral system” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致；再以實際混凝土模數與開裂勁度折減做敏感度分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the three-dimensional finite-element model, switch off the outriggers, perimeter frame and super diagonals in turn and compare top drift, inter-storey drift ratios and the share of core base moment, confirming that each subsystem's contribution agrees with hand estimates; then run sensitivity studies with the actual concrete modulus and cracked-stiffness reductions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計基準應明列抗側系統的分工比例與每個子系統的容許變位角，並規定外伸臂的接合時機與調整機制，施工圖上要標示哪些接頭須待指定階段才能最終鎖定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should state how lateral resistance is shared and the allowable drift for each subsystem, define when and how outriggers are connected, and mark on the drawings which joints may only be finally locked at a specified construction stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若模型高估核心筒勁度（例如未考慮連梁開裂或開口），實際變位與加速度會大於預測；若外伸臂在施工期就剛性鎖定，核心筒與周邊柱的差異縮短會在外伸臂內鎖入巨大附加力，造成接頭或牆體開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the model overestimates core stiffness, for example by ignoring cracked coupling beams or openings, real drift and acceleration exceed predictions; if outriggers are locked rigidly during construction, differential shortening between core and perimeter columns locks large additional forces into them and can crack connections or walls. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致；再以實際混凝土模數與開裂勁度折減做敏感度分析。
knowledge.textEn: In the three-dimensional finite-element model, switch off the outriggers, perimeter frame and super diagonals in turn and compare top drift, inter-storey drift ratios and the share of core base moment, confirming that each subsystem's contribution agrees with hand estimates; then run sensitivity studies with the actual concrete modulus and cracked-stiffness reductions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計基準應明列抗側系統的分工比例與每個子系統的容許變位角，並規定外伸臂的接合時機與調整機制，施工圖上要標示哪些接頭須待指定階段才能最終鎖定。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should state how lateral resistance is shared and the allowable drift for each subsystem, define when and how outriggers are connected, and mark on the drawings which joints may only be finally locked at a specified construction stage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「核心筒與周邊框架的勁度分工」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stiffness sharing between core and perimeter frame"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在三維有限元素模型中分別關閉外伸臂、周邊框架與超級斜撐，比較頂部變位、層間變位角與核心筒基座力矩的分配，確認每個子系統的貢獻與手算一致。
強健性只在設計階段處理，完工後就不會改變。

Robustness is settled at design and cannot change after completion.
