steps.title: 開挖引起的地層位移與監測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Excavation-induced ground movement and monitoring: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鄰近鐵路設施位移監測」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Movement monitoring of adjacent rail assets” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大樓緊鄰倫敦橋車站與地下鐵設施，基地上還留有舊建築的樁與擴底。設計者以有限元素分析預測開挖對鄰近基礎設施的位移在可接受範圍，並規劃施工期監測；新樁盡量布置在既有樁與擴底之間。由上而下施工讓樓板在開挖時即提供剛性支撐，減少擋土牆變形與背後地表沉陷。監測的目的是在位移發展到影響軌道、隧道或車站結構前提出警訊，讓施工方法能及時調整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鄰近鐵路設施位移監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The building sits beside London Bridge station and Underground assets, and old piles and under-reams remained on the site. The designers used finite-element analysis to predict that movements of adjacent infrastructure would stay within acceptable limits and planned monitoring during construction, and new piles were placed between existing piles and under-reams where possible. Top-down construction lets slabs prop the wall stiffly during excavation, reducing wall deflection and ground settlement behind it. Monitoring exists to warn before movements affect tracks, tunnels or station structures, so methods can be adjusted in time. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Movement monitoring of adjacent rail assets” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以經驗關係估算：擋土牆最大水平位移 δ_h ≈ 0.15%H，背後最大沉陷 δ_v ≈ 0.75δ_h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Empirical estimates give a maximum wall deflection δ_h ≈ 0.15%H and maximum settlement behind it δ_v ≈ 0.75δ_h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要擋土牆夠強，開挖就不會影響鄰近的鐵路設施。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the retaining wall is strong enough, excavation cannot affect nearby rail assets." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鄰近鐵路設施位移監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Movement monitoring of adjacent rail assets”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開挖引起的地層位移與監測

knowledge.textEn: The building sits beside London Bridge station and Underground assets, and old piles and under-reams remained on the site. The designers used finite-element analysis to predict that movements of adjacent infrastructure would stay within acceptable limits and planned monitoring during construction, and new piles were placed between existing piles and under-reams where possible.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要擋土牆夠強，開挖就不會影響鄰近的鐵路設施。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the retaining wall is strong enough, excavation cannot affect nearby rail assets. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

A curtain wall only needs to resist wind pressure, not structural movement.

steps.title: 開挖引起的地層位移與監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Excavation-induced ground movement and monitoring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鄰近鐵路設施位移監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Movement monitoring of adjacent rail assets” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以經驗關係估算：擋土牆最大水平位移 δ_h ≈ 0.15%H，背後最大沉陷 δ_v ≈ 0.75δ_h。開挖深 H = 15 m：δ_h ≈ 22.5 mm、δ_v ≈ 16.9 mm；若以預測值 70% 作為黃色警戒，δ_v 約 11.8 mm 時即應檢討。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Empirical estimates give a maximum wall deflection δ_h ≈ 0.15%H and maximum settlement behind it δ_v ≈ 0.75δ_h. For an excavation depth H = 15 m, δ_h ≈ 22.5 mm and δ_v ≈ 16.9 mm; with an amber trigger at 70% of the prediction, review should start when δ_v reaches about 11.8 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在擋土牆內設置傾斜管，在鄰近軌道、隧道與車站結構設置稜鏡與自動全站儀，於開挖前取得基準值；每個開挖階段比較實測與預測，達到黃色或紅色警戒值時依預定的應變計畫增加支撐或暫停開挖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install inclinometers in the retaining wall and prisms with automated total stations on adjacent tracks, tunnels and station structures, taking baselines before excavation; compare measured and predicted movement at every excavation stage and, at amber or red triggers, add props or pause excavation under the pre-agreed contingency plan.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以經驗關係估算：擋土牆最大水平位移 δ_h ≈ 0.15%H，背後最大沉陷 δ_v ≈ 0.75δ_h。開挖深 H = 15 m：δ_h ≈ 22.5 mm、δ_v ≈ 16.9 mm；若以預測值 70% 作為黃色警戒，δ_v 約 11.8 mm 時即應檢討。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Empirical estimates give a maximum wall deflection δ_h ≈ 0.15%H and maximum settlement behind it δ_v ≈ 0.75δ_h. For an excavation depth H = 15 m, δ_h ≈ 22.5 mm and δ_v ≈ 16.9 mm; with an amber trigger at 70% of the prediction, review should start when δ_v reaches about 11.8 mm. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 開挖引起的地層位移與監測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Excavation-induced ground movement and monitoring: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鄰近鐵路設施位移監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Movement monitoring of adjacent rail assets” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在擋土牆內設置傾斜管，在鄰近軌道、隧道與車站結構設置稜鏡與自動全站儀，於開挖前取得基準值；每個開挖階段比較實測與預測，達到黃色或紅色警戒值時依預定的應變計畫增加支撐或暫停開挖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install inclinometers in the retaining wall and prisms with automated total stations on adjacent tracks, tunnels and station structures, taking baselines before excavation; compare measured and predicted movement at every excavation stage and, at amber or red triggers, add props or pause excavation under the pre-agreed contingency plan. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在鐵路保護範圍內施工前，須與鐵路業主協議監測項目、頻率、警戒值與應變措施，並把資料即時分享；每個開挖階段結束後的監測檢討列為停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before working inside a rail protection zone, agree monitoring items, frequency, triggers and contingency measures with the rail owner and share data in real time; the monitoring review at the end of each excavation stage is a hold point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若監測基準在施工擾動後才建立，或警戒值未與鐵路業主事先協議，位移超限時可能來不及處理，導致軌道幾何超標、列車限速甚至停駛。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If baselines are taken only after construction has disturbed the ground, or triggers were not agreed with the rail owner, exceedances may not be handled in time, leading to track-geometry breaches, speed restrictions or service suspension. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在擋土牆內設置傾斜管，在鄰近軌道、隧道與車站結構設置稜鏡與自動全站儀，於開挖前取得基準值；每個開挖階段比較實測與預測，達到黃色或紅色警戒值時依預定的應變計畫增加支撐或暫停開挖。
knowledge.textEn: Install inclinometers in the retaining wall and prisms with automated total stations on adjacent tracks, tunnels and station structures, taking baselines before excavation; compare measured and predicted movement at every excavation stage and, at amber or red triggers, add props or pause excavation under the pre-agreed contingency plan.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在鐵路保護範圍內施工前，須與鐵路業主協議監測項目、頻率、警戒值與應變措施，並把資料即時分享；每個開挖階段結束後的監測檢討列為停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Before working inside a rail protection zone, agree monitoring items, frequency, triggers and contingency measures with the rail owner and share data in real time; the monitoring review at the end of each excavation stage is a hold point.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開挖引起的地層位移與監測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Excavation-induced ground movement and monitoring"?

由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Install inclinometers in the retaining wall and prisms with automated total stations on adjacent tracks, tunnels and station structures, taking baselines before excavation.
Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design.
quiz.explanation: 在擋土牆內設置傾斜管，在鄰近軌道、隧道與車站結構設置稜鏡與自動全站儀，於開挖前取得基準值；每個開挖階段比較實測與預測，達到黃色或紅色警戒值時依預定的應變計畫增加支撐或暫停開挖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Install inclinometers in the retaining wall and prisms with automated total stations on adjacent tracks, tunnels and station structures, taking baselines before excavation; compare measured and predicted movement at every excavation stage and, at amber or red triggers, add props or pause excavation under the pre-agreed contingency plan. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 開挖引起的地層位移與監測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Excavation-induced ground movement and monitoring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鄰近鐵路設施位移監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Movement monitoring of adjacent rail assets” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若監測基準在施工擾動後才建立，或警戒值未與鐵路業主事先協議，位移超限時可能來不及處理，導致軌道幾何超標、列車限速甚至停駛。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If baselines are taken only after construction has disturbed the ground, or triggers were not agreed with the rail owner, exceedances may not be handled in time, leading to track-geometry breaches, speed restrictions or service suspension. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測的目的是在位移發展到影響軌道、隧道或車站結構前提出警訊，讓施工方法能及時調整。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Monitoring exists to warn before movements affect tracks, tunnels or station structures, so methods can be adjusted in time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要擋土牆夠強，開挖就不會影響鄰近的鐵路設施。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the retaining wall is strong enough, excavation cannot affect nearby rail assets." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若監測基準在施工擾動後才建立，或警戒值未與鐵路業主事先協議，位移超限時可能來不及處理，導致軌道幾何超標、列車限速甚至停駛。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開挖引起的地層位移與監測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Excavation-induced ground movement and monitoring" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
帷幕牆只需要承受風壓，不必考慮結構變位。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A curtain wall only needs to resist wind pressure, not structural movement.

If baselines are taken only after construction has disturbed the ground, or triggers were not agreed with the rail owner, exceedances may not be handled in time, leading to track-geometry breaches, speed restrictions or service suspension.
quiz.explanation: 若監測基準在施工擾動後才建立，或警戒值未與鐵路業主事先協議，位移超限時可能來不及處理，導致軌道幾何超標、列車限速甚至停駛。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If baselines are taken only after construction has disturbed the ground, or triggers were not agreed with the rail owner, exceedances may not be handled in time, leading to track-geometry breaches, speed restrictions or service suspension. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「帷幕牆接縫的位移容量」與「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints" and "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 帷幕牆接縫的位移容量：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 官方資料指出外牆約有 11,000 片玻璃，傾斜的玻璃「碎片」在塔頂延伸並以 25 mm 拉桿斜撐的垂直桁架穩定。帷幕牆單元必須同時容納多種位移：層間變位造成的面內錯動、鋁框溫度伸縮、樓板邊緣撓度與柱的長期縮短。接縫若只按其中一項設計，在其他位移疊加時會被擠壓或拉開，密封膠疲勞後漏水漏氣。傾斜立面使雨水與日照條件更嚴苛，接縫的耐久與可更換性更為重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Official sources state the façade has about 11,000 glass panels, and the tilted glass shards extending above the roof are stabilised by vertical trusses braced with 25 mm rods. Curtain-wall units must accommodate several movements at once: in-plane racking from storey drift, thermal movement of aluminium frames, slab-edge deflection and long-term column shortening. A joint designed for only one of these is crushed or opened when the others add up, and the sealant fatigues until water and air leak. Inclined façades make rain and sun exposure harsher, so joint durability and replaceability matter even more. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鋁豎框熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm；層間變位 h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm（面內錯動）；水平堆疊接縫需容納熱伸縮 5.5 mm 加樓板邊緣撓度 10 mm，約 15.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement of an aluminium mullion is ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm; storey drift of h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm gives in-plane racking; the horizontal stack joint must absorb 5.5 mm of thermal movement plus 10 mm of slab-edge deflection, about 15.5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「帷幕牆只需要承受風壓，不必考慮結構變位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A curtain wall only needs to resist wind pressure, not structural movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 帷幕牆接縫的位移容量
knowledge.text: 官方資料指出外牆約有 11,000 片玻璃，傾斜的玻璃「碎片」在塔頂延伸並以 25 mm 拉桿斜撐的垂直桁架穩定。帷幕牆單元必須同時容納多種位移：層間變位造成的面內錯動、鋁框溫度伸縮、樓板邊緣撓度與柱的長期縮短。
knowledge.textEn: Official sources state the façade has about 11,000 glass panels, and the tilted glass shards extending above the roof are stabilised by vertical trusses braced with 25 mm rods. Curtain-wall units must accommodate several movements at once: in-plane racking from storey drift, thermal movement of aluminium frames, slab-edge deflection and long-term column shortening.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：帷幕牆只需要承受風壓，不必考慮結構變位。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A curtain wall only needs to resist wind pressure, not structural movement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「帷幕牆接縫的位移容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints" is correct?
options: 官方資料指出外牆約有 11,000 片玻璃，傾斜的玻璃「碎片」在塔頂延伸並以 25 mm 拉桿斜撐的垂直桁架穩定。
帷幕牆只需要承受風壓，不必考慮結構變位。
所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。
optionsEn: Official sources state the façade has about 11,000 glass panels, and the tilted glass shards extending above the roof are stabilised by vertical trusses braced with 25 mm rods.
A curtain wall only needs to resist wind pressure, not structural movement.
Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong.
quiz.explanation: 官方資料指出外牆約有 11,000 片玻璃，傾斜的玻璃「碎片」在塔頂延伸並以 25 mm 拉桿斜撐的垂直桁架穩定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Official sources state the façade has about 11,000 glass panels, and the tilted glass shards extending above the roof are stabilised by vertical trusses braced with 25 mm rods. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 帷幕牆接縫的位移容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鋁豎框熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm；層間變位 h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm（面內錯動）；水平堆疊接縫需容納熱伸縮 5.5 mm 加樓板邊緣撓度 10 mm，約 15.5 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement of an aluminium mullion is ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm; storey drift of h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm gives in-plane racking; the horizontal stack joint must absorb 5.5 mm of thermal movement plus 10 mm of slab-edge deflection, about 15.5 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實尺寸樣品做帷幕牆性能試驗（氣密、水密、風壓與層間位移試驗，例如依 ASTM E283、E331、E330 與 AAMA 501），確認接縫在設計位移組合下不失效；安裝時抽查接縫寬度與單元水平，營運後定期檢查密封膠與排水孔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run full-size mock-up tests for air, water, structural pressure and inter-storey movement, for example to ASTM E283, E331, E330 and AAMA 501, confirming joints survive the design movement combination; during installation spot-check joint widths and unit levels, and in service periodically inspect sealant and drainage holes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鋁豎框熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm；層間變位 h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm（面內錯動）；水平堆疊接縫需容納熱伸縮 5.5 mm 加樓板邊緣撓度 10 mm，約 15.5 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal movement of an aluminium mullion is ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm; storey drift of h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm gives in-plane racking; the horizontal stack joint must absorb 5.5 mm of thermal movement plus 10 mm of slab-edge deflection, about 15.5 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「帷幕牆接縫的位移容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints", which statement holds?
options: 只要核心筒位於平面中央，就不會有扭轉問題。
鋁豎框熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm。
沒有斜桿的費氏桁架承載力和有斜桿的桁架差不多。
optionsEn: If the core is in the middle of the plan, there is no torsion problem.
Thermal movement of an aluminium mullion is ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm.
A Vierendeel truss without diagonals carries load about as well as a braced truss.
quiz.explanation: 鋁豎框熱伸縮 ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm；層間變位 h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm（面內錯動）；水平堆疊接縫需容納熱伸縮 5.5 mm 加樓板邊緣撓度 10 mm，約 15.5 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal movement of an aluminium mullion is ΔL = αLΔT = 23×10⁻⁶×4,000×60 ≈ 5.5 mm; storey drift of h/500 = 3,100/500 = 6.2 mm gives in-plane racking; the horizontal stack joint must absorb 5.5 mm of thermal movement plus 10 mm of slab-edge deflection, about 15.5 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 帷幕牆接縫的位移容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實尺寸樣品做帷幕牆性能試驗（氣密、水密、風壓與層間位移試驗，例如依 ASTM E283、E331、E330 與 AAMA 501），確認接縫在設計位移組合下不失效；安裝時抽查接縫寬度與單元水平，營運後定期檢查密封膠與排水孔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run full-size mock-up tests for air, water, structural pressure and inter-storey movement, for example to ASTM E283, E331, E330 and AAMA 501, confirming joints survive the design movement combination; during installation spot-check joint widths and unit levels, and in service periodically inspect sealant and drainage holes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構工程師應以書面提供帷幕牆顧問各樓層的層間變位、樓板邊緣撓度與長期縮短值，並納入帷幕牆規格；交接文件包含玻璃與密封膠更換程序及吊籠維護設備的操作限制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural engineer should give the façade consultant written values of storey drift, slab-edge deflection and long-term shortening for every level for inclusion in the façade specification; handover should include glass and sealant replacement procedures and operating limits for the building maintenance unit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Joints that are too narrow let units press against each other in high wind or summer heat until glass edges crack; aged sealant lets rain run into the inclined façade, causing interior leaks and corrosion of anchors. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「帷幕牆接縫的位移容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
塔吊的荷重只由塔吊自身的基礎承擔，與主結構無關。
以實尺寸樣品做帷幕牆性能試驗（氣密、水密、風壓與層間位移試驗，例如依 ASTM E283、E331、E330 與 AAMA 501），確認接縫在設計位移組合下不失效。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A tower crane's loads go only into its own base and have nothing to do with the main structure.

Run full-size mock-up tests for air, water, structural pressure and inter-storey movement, for example to ASTM E283, E331, E330 and AAMA 501, confirming joints survive the design movement combination.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 帷幕牆接縫的位移容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「帷幕牆接縫與層間變位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Curtain-wall joints and storey drift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Joints that are too narrow let units press against each other in high wind or summer heat until glass edges crack; aged sealant lets rain run into the inclined façade, causing interior leaks and corrosion of anchors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：傾斜立面使雨水與日照條件更嚴苛，接縫的耐久與可更換性更為重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inclined façades make rain and sun exposure harsher, so joint durability and replaceability matter even more.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「帷幕牆只需要承受風壓，不必考慮結構變位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A curtain wall only needs to resist wind pressure, not structural movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Joints that are too narrow let units press against each other in high wind or summer heat until glass edges crack; aged sealant lets rain run into the inclined façade, causing interior leaks and corrosion of anchors.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「帷幕牆接縫的位移容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Movement capacity of curtain-wall joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。
optionsEn: Joints that are too narrow let units press against each other in high wind or summer heat until glass edges crack.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong.
quiz.explanation: 接縫寬度不足時，強風或夏季高溫下單元互相擠壓使玻璃邊緣受力破裂；密封膠老化後雨水沿傾斜立面滲入，造成室內漏水與錨件腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Joints that are too narrow let units press against each other in high wind or summer heat until glass edges crack; aged sealant lets rain run into the inclined façade, causing interior leaks and corrosion of anchors. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「未防火被覆的帽桁架」如何影響碎片大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unprotected hat trusses” governs force, deformation or durability in “The Shard”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計者說明頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性，因為它們不是強度所需的構件，所以未做防火被覆。這是一個需要被記錄的工程判斷：火災時鋼材高溫後勁度下降，帽桁架對側向勁度的貢獻減少，但結構強度仍由核心筒保證。若未來有人不知道這個前提，可能把帽桁架當成承載構件加以利用（例如懸吊設備或改造時依賴其強度），就會破壞原本的防火策略。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「未防火被覆的帽桁架」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The designers explain that the outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability and, because they are not required for strength, were not fire-protected. That is an engineering judgement that must be documented: in a fire, heated steel loses stiffness and the hat trusses contribute less lateral stiffness, while strength is still assured by the core. If future users are unaware of this premise and start relying on the hat trusses, for example to hang equipment or as strength members in a renovation, the original fire strategy is undermined. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Unprotected hat trusses” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「未防火被覆的帽桁架」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Unprotected hat trusses”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses
knowledge.text: 設計者說明頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性，因為它們不是強度所需的構件，所以未做防火被覆。這是一個需要被記錄的工程判斷：火災時鋼材高溫後勁度下降，帽桁架對側向勁度的貢獻減少，但結構強度仍由核心筒保證。
knowledge.textEn: The designers explain that the outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability and, because they are not required for strength, were not fire-protected. That is an engineering judgement that must be documented: in a fire, heated steel loses stiffness and the hat trusses contribute less lateral stiffness, while strength is still assured by the core.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses" is correct?
options: 所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。
設計者說明頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性，因為它們不是強度所需的構件，所以未做防火被覆。
樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。
optionsEn: Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong.
The designers explain that the outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability and, because they are not required for strength, were not fire-protected.
Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load.
quiz.explanation: 設計者說明頂部機械層的外伸帽桁架用於改善風作用下的使用性，因為它們不是強度所需的構件，所以未做防火被覆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The designers explain that the outrigger hat trusses in the upper plant levels improve wind serviceability and, because they are not required for strength, were not fire-protected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「未防火被覆的帽桁架」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unprotected hat trusses” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。若帽桁架提供 25% 的側向勁度，火災時整體勁度約為 0.75 + 0.25×0.31 ≈ 0.83，頂部變位放大約 1/0.83 ≈ 1.21 倍。數值為教學假設，僅示範勁度降低而非強度設計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C. If the hat trusses provide 25% of lateral stiffness, the overall stiffness in a fire is about 0.75 + 0.25×0.31 ≈ 0.83, increasing top drift by about 1/0.83 ≈ 1.21 times. Values are teaching assumptions illustrating stiffness loss, not strength design. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告；交接時在現場與竣工圖上標示這些構件為「使用性構件、未防火被覆」，定期巡檢時確認沒有新增附掛荷載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report; at handover label these members on site and on as-built drawings as serviceability members without fire protection, and confirm at periodic inspections that no new loads have been hung from them.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。若帽桁架提供 25% 的側向勁度，火災時整體勁度約為 0.75 + 0.25×0.31 ≈ 0.83，頂部變位放大約 1/0.83 ≈ 1.21 倍。數值為教學假設，僅示範勁度降低而非強度設計。
knowledge.textEn: EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C. If the hat trusses provide 25% of lateral stiffness, the overall stiffness in a fire is about 0.75 + 0.25×0.31 ≈ 0.83, increasing top drift by about 1/0.83 ≈ 1.21 times. Values are teaching assumptions illustrating stiffness loss, not strength design.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses", which statement holds?
options: 後拉預力樓板和一般鋼筋混凝土樓板一樣，可以隨意鑽孔。
由上而下施工只是把工序倒過來，對結構設計沒有影響。
EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。
optionsEn: A post-tensioned slab can be drilled anywhere, just like ordinary reinforced concrete.
Top-down construction merely reverses the order of work and does not affect structural design.
EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C.
quiz.explanation: EN 1993-1-2 鋼材彈性模數折減係數 k_E,θ 在 600 °C 約 0.31。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: EN 1993-1-2 gives a steel modulus reduction factor k_E,θ of about 0.31 at 600 °C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「未防火被覆的帽桁架」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unprotected hat trusses” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告；交接時在現場與竣工圖上標示這些構件為「使用性構件、未防火被覆」，定期巡檢時確認沒有新增附掛荷載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report; at handover label these members on site and on as-built drawings as serviceability members without fire protection, and confirm at periodic inspections that no new loads have been hung from them. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：防火策略中的「不需被覆」判斷必須附上結構依據、適用條件與禁止事項，納入交接文件與物業管理規章；任何在這些構件上的新增荷載或焊接都需結構與消防工程師共同核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Any no-protection decision in the fire strategy must carry its structural justification, conditions of validity and prohibitions, written into handover documents and building rules; any new load or welding on these members needs joint approval by structural and fire engineers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告；交接時在現場與竣工圖上標示這些構件為「使用性構件、未防火被覆」，定期巡檢時確認沒有新增附掛荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report; at handover label these members on site and on as-built drawings as serviceability members without fire protection, and confirm at periodic inspections that no new loads have been hung from them.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 防火策略中的「不需被覆」判斷必須附上結構依據、適用條件與禁止事項，納入交接文件與物業管理規章；任何在這些構件上的新增荷載或焊接都需結構與消防工程師共同核准。
knowledge.textEn: Any no-protection decision in the fire strategy must carry its structural justification, conditions of validity and prohibitions, written into handover documents and building rules; any new load or welding on these members needs joint approval by structural and fire engineers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses"?
options: 在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
大樓擺動 300 至 400 mm 就表示結構有安全疑慮。
optionsEn: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A tower swaying 300 to 400 mm means it is structurally unsafe.
quiz.explanation: 在結構計算書中以「移除帽桁架」的分析證明核心筒單獨滿足強度要求，並把此結論寫入防火策略報告；交接時在現場與竣工圖上標示這些構件為「使用性構件、未防火被覆」，定期巡檢時確認沒有新增附掛荷載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Demonstrate in the structural calculations, by analysis with the hat trusses removed, that the core alone meets strength requirements, and record this in the fire strategy report; at handover label these members on site and on as-built drawings as serviceability members without fire protection, and confirm at periodic inspections that no new loads have been hung from them. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「未防火被覆的帽桁架」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unprotected hat trusses” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若未來有人不知道這個前提，可能把帽桁架當成承載構件加以利用（例如懸吊設備或改造時依賴其強度），就會破壞原本的防火策略。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If future users are unaware of this premise and start relying on the hat trusses, for example to hang equipment or as strength members in a renovation, the original fire strategy is undermined.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有鋼構件都必須防火被覆，否則就是設計錯誤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every steel member must be fire-protected, otherwise the design is wrong." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。
knowledge.textEn: If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「使用性帽桁架的防火判斷與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire strategy and handover of serviceability hat trusses" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。
樓板越輕越好，因為可以減少地震力與柱的負擔。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse.
Lighter floors are always better because they reduce seismic force and column load.
quiz.explanation: 改造工程若在未被覆的帽桁架上懸吊重型設備或把它當作新增樓板的支承，火災時這些構件可能先軟化變形，使原本只影響使用性的構件變成造成局部倒塌的弱點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If a renovation hangs heavy plant from the unprotected hat trusses or uses them to support new floors, they may soften and deform first in a fire, turning a serviceability-only member into a weak point for local collapse. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
courses.summary: 以台北 101、哈里發塔與上海中心為例，從外伸臂約束核心轉角的旋轉彈簧模型與單道外伸臂的最佳高度出發，處理巨柱有效長度與樓板支撐力、外伸桁架穿入核心牆的力傳遞，再到差異縮短與延遲鎖定、雙層高桁架的焊接收縮、應變監測回推勁度、阻尼外伸臂，最後是外伸臂樓層的改裝管控與長期徐變監測。
courses.summaryEn: Using Taipei 101, Burj Khalifa and Shanghai Tower as examples, start from the rotational-spring model of how outriggers restrain core rotation and from the optimum level of a single outrigger, handle mega-column effective length and floor bracing forces and force transfer where outrigger trusses enter core walls, then differential shortening and delayed lock-off, weld shrinkage in two-storey trusses, strain monitoring to back-calculate stiffness and damped outriggers, ending with alteration control on outrigger floors and long-term creep monitoring.
courses.focus: 外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂
courses.focusEn: How outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 高層結構系統與減振

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 單道外伸臂設計練習：某 300 m 高樓的核心筒 EI = 7.0×10¹³ N·m²，均布風載 w = 150 kN/m，只有核心時頂部位移 Δ₀ = wH⁴/(8EI) = 150,000×300⁴/(8×7.0×10¹³) ≈ 2.17 m。兩側巨柱群各 EA = 1.4×10¹¹ N、間距 d = 40 m。外伸臂放在離地 a = 165 m 時，以 M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²)) 求得回復彎矩約 2.29 GN·m，每側巨柱群軸力約 2.29×10⁹/40 ≈ 57 MN，頂部位移減少約 54%，剩約 1.00 m。若改放頂部，只減少約 41%（剩約 1.28 m）；若巨柱軸向勁度減半，最佳位置仍在約 0.54H，但減少量降為約 39%（剩約 1.32 m）。這說明外伸臂的高度與巨柱勁度同樣重要，而且在這個簡化模型中最佳高度與柱勁度無關。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Single-outrigger exercise: a 300 m tower has a core with EI = 7.0×10¹³ N·m² and a uniform wind load w = 150 kN/m, so the core alone drifts Δ₀ = wH⁴/(8EI) = 150,000×300⁴/(8×7.0×10¹³) ≈ 2.17 m at the top. The mega-column groups on each side have EA = 1.4×10¹¹ N and are d = 40 m apart. With the outrigger at a = 165 m, M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²)) gives a restoring moment of about 2.29 GN·m and a column-group force of about 2.29×10⁹/40 ≈ 57 MN, cutting top drift by about 54% to about 1.00 m. Placed at the top it cuts only about 41%, leaving about 1.28 m; with column axial stiffness halved the optimum stays near 0.54H but the reduction falls to about 39%, leaving about 1.32 m. Outrigger level and column stiffness therefore matter equally, and in this simplified model the optimum level does not depend on column stiffness. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

Taipei 101's eight mega-columns are about 2.4 m × 3.0 m at the base, filled with about 69 MPa concrete

In Shanghai Tower's major-earthquake analysis most outrigger and belt trusses stayed elastic, with mean drift below 1/130

Outriggers typically occupy 1 to 3 storeys and sit in mechanical or refuge floors
