steps.instructionEn: Sample delivered membrane by batch for uniaxial and biaxial tension, tear and elevated-temperature creep tests against the specification; after installation measure each panel's sag or curvature and edge tension and run a water test to confirm there are no ponding points; accept the PTFE ceiling additionally by sound-absorption tests and light-transmission measurement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每片膜都要有形狀與預張力的驗收紀錄，邊緣夾具與鋼構的接觸面須去除尖角並加保護墊；膜材的耐溫等級、防火性能與更換方法應寫入規格，並在交接時附上分片編號圖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Every panel needs an acceptance record of shape and pretension, and edge clamps must have sharp edges removed and protective pads against the steel; the temperature rating, fire performance and replacement method of the membranes should be specified, with a panel-numbering plan attached at handover.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：曲率不足的膜片在雨雪中下垂積水，積水使變形更大，形成漸進式積水，最後膜片撕裂；ETFE 在高溫下強度降低，若邊緣夾具處有尖角或應力集中，會在夏季強風時從邊緣開始撕裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A panel with too little curvature sags and ponds in rain or snow, the water increases the sag, and progressive ponding finally tears it; ETFE loses strength at high temperature, so sharp corners or stress concentrations at edge clamps can start tears from the edge in summer storms. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 膜材進場以批號抽樣做單軸與雙軸拉伸、撕裂與高溫潛變試驗，與規格值比較；安裝後量測每片膜的垂度或曲率與邊緣張力，進行淋水試驗確認無積水點；PTFE 天花另以吸音係數試驗與燈光透射量測驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Sample delivered membrane by batch for uniaxial and biaxial tension, tear and elevated-temperature creep tests against the specification; after installation measure each panel's sag or curvature and edge tension and run a water test to confirm there are no ponding points; accept the PTFE ceiling additionally by sound-absorption tests and light-transmission measurement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每片膜都要有形狀與預張力的驗收紀錄，邊緣夾具與鋼構的接觸面須去除尖角並加保護墊；膜材的耐溫等級、防火性能與更換方法應寫入規格，並在交接時附上分片編號圖。
knowledge.textEn: Every panel needs an acceptance record of shape and pretension, and edge clamps must have sharp edges removed and protective pads against the steel; the temperature rating, fire performance and replacement method of the membranes should be specified, with a panel-numbering plan attached at handover.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙層膜材的受力、試驗與驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Double-membrane behaviour, testing and acceptance"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
膜材進場以批號抽樣做單軸與雙軸拉伸、撕裂與高溫潛變試驗，與規格值比較。
臨時支撐只是施工用，不需要像永久結構一樣計算與檢查。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Sample delivered membrane by batch for uniaxial and biaxial tension, tear and elevated-temperature creep tests against the specification.
Temporary supports are only for construction and need no calculation or inspection like permanent structure.
quiz.explanation: 膜材進場以批號抽樣做單軸與雙軸拉伸、撕裂與高溫潛變試驗，與規格值比較；安裝後量測每片膜的垂度或曲率與邊緣張力，進行淋水試驗確認無積水點；PTFE 天花另以吸音係數試驗與燈光透射量測驗收。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample delivered membrane by batch for uniaxial and biaxial tension, tear and elevated-temperature creep tests against the specification; after installation measure each panel's sag or curvature and edge tension and run a water test to confirm there are no ponding points; accept the PTFE ceiling additionally by sound-absorption tests and light-transmission measurement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙層膜材的受力、試驗與驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Double-membrane behaviour, testing and acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ETFE 與 PTFE 雙層膜」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “ETFE and PTFE double membrane” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 曲率不足的膜片在雨雪中下垂積水，積水使變形更大，形成漸進式積水，最後膜片撕裂；ETFE 在高溫下強度降低，若邊緣夾具處有尖角或應力集中，會在夏季強風時從邊緣開始撕裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A panel with too little curvature sags and ponds in rain or snow, the water increases the sag, and progressive ponding finally tears it; ETFE loses strength at high temperature, so sharp corners or stress concentrations at edge clamps can start tears from the edge in summer storms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：膜材在受力時以曲率與預張力抵抗面外荷載，曲率太小就會產生大變形與積水，因此每片膜的形狀、預張力與排水坡度必須一併設計與驗收。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A membrane resists out-of-plane load through curvature and pretension; too little curvature means large deformation and ponding, so the shape, pretension and drainage slope of each panel must be designed and accepted together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「膜材越平越好看，只要材料夠強就不需要曲率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The flatter a membrane the better it looks, and it needs no curvature if the material is strong enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 曲率不足的膜片在雨雪中下垂積水，積水使變形更大，形成漸進式積水，最後膜片撕裂；ETFE 在高溫下強度降低，若邊緣夾具處有尖角或應力集中，會在夏季強風時從邊緣開始撕裂。
knowledge.textEn: A panel with too little curvature sags and ponds in rain or snow, the water increases the sag, and progressive ponding finally tears it; ETFE loses strength at high temperature, so sharp corners or stress concentrations at edge clamps can start tears from the edge in summer storms.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙層膜材的受力、試驗與驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Double-membrane behaviour, testing and acceptance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼構表面看起來沒有鏽，就表示整個鋼結構沒有腐蝕。
曲率不足的膜片在雨雪中下垂積水，積水使變形更大，形成漸進式積水，最後膜片撕裂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If the steel surface shows no rust, the whole steel structure is free of corrosion.
A panel with too little curvature sags and ponds in rain or snow, the water increases the sag, and progressive ponding finally tears it.
quiz.explanation: 曲率不足的膜片在雨雪中下垂積水，積水使變形更大，形成漸進式積水，最後膜片撕裂；ETFE 在高溫下強度降低，若邊緣夾具處有尖角或應力集中，會在夏季強風時從邊緣開始撕裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A panel with too little curvature sags and ponds in rain or snow, the water increases the sag, and progressive ponding finally tears it; ETFE loses strength at high temperature, so sharp corners or stress concentrations at edge clamps can start tears from the edge in summer storms. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼外殼的防蝕與排水維護」與「賽後再利用、檢測與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrosion protection and drainage of the steel shell" and "Post-Games reuse, inspection and engineering handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼外殼的防蝕與排水維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrosion protection and drainage of the steel shell: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「天溝與防蝕塗裝」如何影響北京國家體育場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gutters and protective coating” governs force, deformation or durability in “Beijing National Stadium”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鳥巢的鋼構件大部分外露，性能化防火設計只對距觀眾 6 m 內的關鍵屋蓋構件加防火保護，其餘不需被覆，因此塗裝系統同時決定外觀與耐久。天溝構件焊在主桁架上弦，雨水沿鋼構導排；任何積水、焊縫凹處或塗層破損點都會成為腐蝕起點。封閉的箱形桿件內部若有水氣進入，腐蝕將看不到也難以修補，所以箱形斷面的封閉焊接與排水孔設計同樣重要。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「天溝與防蝕塗裝」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Most steel in the Bird's Nest is exposed; performance-based fire design added fire protection only to critical roof members within 6 m of spectators, leaving the rest unprotected, so the coating system governs both appearance and durability. Gutter elements are welded to the top chords of the primary trusses, so rainwater drains along the steel, and any ponding, weld crevice or coating damage becomes a corrosion starting point. If moisture enters sealed box members, corrosion is invisible and hard to repair, so seal welding and drain-hole design of box sections matter as much as the coating. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Gutters and protective coating” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：1.2 m 方管每公尺外表面積 4×1.2 = 4.8 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 1.2 m square box has 4×1.2 = 4.8 m² of outer surface per metre.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼構表面看起來沒有鏽，就表示整個鋼結構沒有腐蝕。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the steel surface shows no rust, the whole steel structure is free of corrosion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「天溝與防蝕塗裝」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Gutters and protective coating”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼外殼的防蝕與排水維護
knowledge.titleEn: Corrosion protection and drainage of the steel shell
knowledge.text: 鳥巢的鋼構件大部分外露，性能化防火設計只對距觀眾 6 m 內的關鍵屋蓋構件加防火保護，其餘不需被覆，因此塗裝系統同時決定外觀與耐久。天溝構件焊在主桁架上弦，雨水沿鋼構導排；任何積水、焊縫凹處或塗層破損點都會成為腐蝕起點。
knowledge.textEn: Most steel in the Bird's Nest is exposed; performance-based fire design added fire protection only to critical roof members within 6 m of spectators, leaving the rest unprotected, so the coating system governs both appearance and durability. Gutter elements are welded to the top chords of the primary trusses, so rainwater drains along the steel, and any ponding, weld crevice or coating damage becomes a corrosion starting point.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼構表面看起來沒有鏽，就表示整個鋼結構沒有腐蝕。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the steel surface shows no rust, the whole steel structure is free of corrosion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼外殼的防蝕與排水維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrosion protection and drainage of the steel shell" is correct?
options: 鳥巢的鋼構件大部分外露，性能化防火設計只對距觀眾 6 m 內的關鍵屋蓋構件加防火保護，其餘不需被覆，因此塗裝系統同時決定外觀與耐久。
鋼構表面看起來沒有鏽，就表示整個鋼結構沒有腐蝕。
鋼屋蓋很大很強，吊掛幾十噸的舞台設備不必另外核算。
optionsEn: Most steel in the Bird's Nest is exposed.
If the steel surface shows no rust, the whole steel structure is free of corrosion.
A large steel roof is so strong that hanging tens of tonnes of stage equipment needs no separate check.
quiz.explanation: 鳥巢的鋼構件大部分外露，性能化防火設計只對距觀眾 6 m 內的關鍵屋蓋構件加防火保護，其餘不需被覆，因此塗裝系統同時決定外觀與耐久。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Most steel in the Bird's Nest is exposed; performance-based fire design added fire protection only to critical roof members within 6 m of spectators, leaving the rest unprotected, so the coating system governs both appearance and durability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼外殼的防蝕與排水維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrosion protection and drainage of the steel shell: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「天溝與防蝕塗裝」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gutters and protective coating” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：1.2 m 方管每公尺外表面積 4×1.2 = 4.8 m²。若外露桿件總長 36 km，塗裝面積約 4.8×36,000 = 172,800 m²；乾膜厚 240 μm 時乾膜體積 172,800×0.00024 ≈ 41.5 m³，體積固體分 60% 需濕漆約 69 m³，加 30% 損耗約 90 m³。桿件總長與膜厚為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 1.2 m square box has 4×1.2 = 4.8 m² of outer surface per metre. If exposed members total 36 km, the coated area is about 4.8×36,000 = 172,800 m²; at 240 μm dry film the dry volume is 172,800×0.00024 ≈ 41.5 m³, needing about 69 m³ of wet paint at 60% volume solids, or about 90 m³ with 30% losses. Total length and film thickness are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：工廠塗裝以表面處理等級、乾膜厚量測與附著力試驗驗收，現場補漆區另做記錄；使用期間以無人機或繩索檢查天溝積水、塗層粉化與鏽斑，依區域劃分評等；箱形桿件抽查內部濕度或以內視鏡檢查封閉性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Accept shop coating by surface-preparation grade, dry-film-thickness readings and adhesion tests, recording site touch-up areas separately; in service inspect gutters for ponding and coatings for chalking and rust by drone or rope access, rating by zone; spot-check sealed boxes for internal humidity or with a borescope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 1.2 m 方管每公尺外表面積 4×1.2 = 4.8 m²。若外露桿件總長 36 km，塗裝面積約 4.8×36,000 = 172,800 m²；乾膜厚 240 μm 時乾膜體積 172,800×0.00024 ≈ 41.5 m³，體積固體分 60% 需濕漆約 69 m³，加 30% 損耗約 90 m³。桿件總長與膜厚為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 1.2 m square box has 4×1.2 = 4.8 m² of outer surface per metre. If exposed members total 36 km, the coated area is about 4.8×36,000 = 172,800 m²; at 240 μm dry film the dry volume is 172,800×0.00024 ≈ 41.5 m³, needing about 69 m³ of wet paint at 60% volume solids, or about 90 m³ with 30% losses. Total length and film thickness are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼外殼的防蝕與排水維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Corrosion protection and drainage of the steel shell", which statement holds?
options: 大型鋼屋蓋重量輕，地震力很小，可以只做風載設計。
1.2 m 方管每公尺外表面積 4×1.2 = 4.8 m²。
節點只要比桿件強就安全，不需要另外做分析或試驗。
optionsEn: A large steel roof is light, so earthquake forces are small and wind design alone suffices.
A 1.2 m square box has 4×1.2 = 4.8 m² of outer surface per metre.
A node is safe as long as it is stronger than the members, so no separate analysis or test is needed.
quiz.explanation: 1.2 m 方管每公尺外表面積 4×1.2 = 4.8 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 1.2 m square box has 4×1.2 = 4.8 m² of outer surface per metre. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼外殼的防蝕與排水維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Corrosion protection and drainage of the steel shell: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「天溝與防蝕塗裝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gutters and protective coating” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 工廠塗裝以表面處理等級、乾膜厚量測與附著力試驗驗收，現場補漆區另做記錄；使用期間以無人機或繩索檢查天溝積水、塗層粉化與鏽斑，依區域劃分評等；箱形桿件抽查內部濕度或以內視鏡檢查封閉性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Accept shop coating by surface-preparation grade, dry-film-thickness readings and adhesion tests, recording site touch-up areas separately; in service inspect gutters for ponding and coatings for chalking and rust by drone or rope access, rating by zone; spot-check sealed boxes for internal humidity or with a borescope. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊要附塗裝系統規格、各區膜厚與色號、補漆程序與檢查週期，天溝清潔列為季度工作；任何在鋼構上新增焊接或鑽孔都須經結構工程師核可並恢復防蝕。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual should attach the coating specification, film thickness and colour code by zone, touch-up procedure and inspection intervals, with gutter cleaning as a quarterly task; any new welding or drilling on the steel must be approved by the structural engineer and its corrosion protection restored.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：天溝坡度不足或落葉堵塞造成長期積水，積水區塗層先失效，上弦鋼板逐漸減薄；箱形桿件封閉焊接不連續，水氣進入後在內部凝結，鏽蝕膨脹甚至撐裂焊縫，外觀卻看不出異狀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Gutters with too little fall or blocked by debris hold water for long periods, coatings fail first in the ponded zones and the top-chord plate thins; discontinuous seal welds on box members let moisture in to condense inside, and rust expansion can even split welds while the outside looks normal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 工廠塗裝以表面處理等級、乾膜厚量測與附著力試驗驗收，現場補漆區另做記錄；使用期間以無人機或繩索檢查天溝積水、塗層粉化與鏽斑，依區域劃分評等；箱形桿件抽查內部濕度或以內視鏡檢查封閉性。
knowledge.textEn: Accept shop coating by surface-preparation grade, dry-film-thickness readings and adhesion tests, recording site touch-up areas separately; in service inspect gutters for ponding and coatings for chalking and rust by drone or rope access, rating by zone; spot-check sealed boxes for internal humidity or with a borescope.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護手冊要附塗裝系統規格、各區膜厚與色號、補漆程序與檢查週期，天溝清潔列為季度工作；任何在鋼構上新增焊接或鑽孔都須經結構工程師核可並恢復防蝕。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance manual should attach the coating specification, film thickness and colour code by zone, touch-up procedure and inspection intervals, with gutter cleaning as a quarterly task; any new welding or drilling on the steel must be approved by the structural engineer and its corrosion protection restored.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼外殼的防蝕與排水維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Corrosion protection and drainage of the steel shell"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
卸載就是把臨時支撐拆掉，順序與速度不重要。
工廠塗裝以表面處理等級、乾膜厚量測與附著力試驗驗收，現場補漆區另做記錄。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Unloading just means removing temporary supports; order and speed do not matter.
Accept shop coating by surface-preparation grade, dry-film-thickness readings and adhesion tests, recording site touch-up areas separately.
quiz.explanation: 工廠塗裝以表面處理等級、乾膜厚量測與附著力試驗驗收，現場補漆區另做記錄；使用期間以無人機或繩索檢查天溝積水、塗層粉化與鏽斑，依區域劃分評等；箱形桿件抽查內部濕度或以內視鏡檢查封閉性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Accept shop coating by surface-preparation grade, dry-film-thickness readings and adhesion tests, recording site touch-up areas separately; in service inspect gutters for ponding and coatings for chalking and rust by drone or rope access, rating by zone; spot-check sealed boxes for internal humidity or with a borescope. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼外殼的防蝕與排水維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corrosion protection and drainage of the steel shell: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「天溝與防蝕塗裝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gutters and protective coating” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 天溝坡度不足或落葉堵塞造成長期積水，積水區塗層先失效，上弦鋼板逐漸減薄；箱形桿件封閉焊接不連續，水氣進入後在內部凝結，鏽蝕膨脹甚至撐裂焊縫，外觀卻看不出異狀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Gutters with too little fall or blocked by debris hold water for long periods, coatings fail first in the ponded zones and the top-chord plate thins; discontinuous seal welds on box members let moisture in to condense inside, and rust expansion can even split welds while the outside looks normal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：封閉的箱形桿件內部若有水氣進入，腐蝕將看不到也難以修補，所以箱形斷面的封閉焊接與排水孔設計同樣重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If moisture enters sealed box members, corrosion is invisible and hard to repair, so seal welding and drain-hole design of box sections matter as much as the coating.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼構表面看起來沒有鏽，就表示整個鋼結構沒有腐蝕。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the steel surface shows no rust, the whole steel structure is free of corrosion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 天溝坡度不足或落葉堵塞造成長期積水，積水區塗層先失效，上弦鋼板逐漸減薄；箱形桿件封閉焊接不連續，水氣進入後在內部凝結，鏽蝕膨脹甚至撐裂焊縫，外觀卻看不出異狀。
knowledge.textEn: Gutters with too little fall or blocked by debris hold water for long periods, coatings fail first in the ponded zones and the top-chord plate thins; discontinuous seal welds on box members let moisture in to condense inside, and rust expansion can even split welds while the outside looks normal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼外殼的防蝕與排水維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Corrosion protection and drainage of the steel shell" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 天溝坡度不足或落葉堵塞造成長期積水，積水區塗層先失效，上弦鋼板逐漸減薄；箱形桿件封閉焊接不連續，水氣進入後在內部凝結，鏽蝕膨脹甚至撐裂焊縫，外觀卻看不出異狀。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鋼屋蓋很大很強，吊掛幾十噸的舞台設備不必另外核算。
optionsEn: Gutters with too little fall or blocked by debris hold water for long periods, coatings fail first in the ponded zones and the top-chord plate thins.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A large steel roof is so strong that hanging tens of tonnes of stage equipment needs no separate check.
quiz.explanation: 天溝坡度不足或落葉堵塞造成長期積水，積水區塗層先失效，上弦鋼板逐漸減薄；箱形桿件封閉焊接不連續，水氣進入後在內部凝結，鏽蝕膨脹甚至撐裂焊縫，外觀卻看不出異狀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Gutters with too little fall or blocked by debris hold water for long periods, coatings fail first in the ponded zones and the top-chord plate thins; discontinuous seal welds on box members let moisture in to condense inside, and rust expansion can even split welds while the outside looks normal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 賽後再利用、檢測與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-Games reuse, inspection and engineering handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「賽後營運荷載與結構檔案」如何影響北京國家體育場的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-Games loads and structural records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Beijing National Stadium”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鳥巢在 2008 年奧運後改為長期場館，座位由奧運時約 91,000 席規劃為約 80,000 席，並於 2022 年再次用於冬奧開閉幕式。賽後活動常在屋蓋吊掛舞台燈光、音響與特效設備，形成原設計以外的集中荷載；看台與場地用途改變也會影響防火情境。因此交接文件必須清楚標示屋蓋可吊掛點、容許荷載與檢查要求，讓營運單位在每次活動前能核對。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「賽後營運荷載與結構檔案」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After the 2008 Olympics the Bird's Nest became a long-term venue, with capacity planned to drop from about 91,000 Olympic seats to about 80,000, and it hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics ceremonies. Post-Games events often hang stage lighting, sound and special-effects rigs from the roof, creating concentrated loads outside the original design, and changes in seating or field use affect fire scenarios. Handover documents must therefore mark the permitted rigging points, allowable loads and inspection requirements on the roof so that the operator can check them before every event. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-Games loads and structural records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某演出吊掛設備 60 t，由 6 個吊點平均分擔，每點 F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A show rig of 60 t shared equally by 6 points loads each with F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼屋蓋很大很強，吊掛幾十噸的舞台設備不必另外核算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A large steel roof is so strong that hanging tens of tonnes of stage equipment needs no separate check." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「賽後營運荷載與結構檔案」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-Games loads and structural records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 賽後再利用、檢測與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Post-Games reuse, inspection and engineering handover
knowledge.text: 鳥巢在 2008 年奧運後改為長期場館，座位由奧運時約 91,000 席規劃為約 80,000 席，並於 2022 年再次用於冬奧開閉幕式。賽後活動常在屋蓋吊掛舞台燈光、音響與特效設備，形成原設計以外的集中荷載；看台與場地用途改變也會影響防火情境。
knowledge.textEn: After the 2008 Olympics the Bird's Nest became a long-term venue, with capacity planned to drop from about 91,000 Olympic seats to about 80,000, and it hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics ceremonies. Post-Games events often hang stage lighting, sound and special-effects rigs from the roof, creating concentrated loads outside the original design, and changes in seating or field use affect fire scenarios.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼屋蓋很大很強，吊掛幾十噸的舞台設備不必另外核算。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A large steel roof is so strong that hanging tens of tonnes of stage equipment needs no separate check. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「賽後再利用、檢測與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-Games reuse, inspection and engineering handover" is correct?
options: 鋼屋蓋很大很強，吊掛幾十噸的舞台設備不必另外核算。
鳥巢在 2008 年奧運後改為長期場館，座位由奧運時約 91,000 席規劃為約 80,000 席，並於 2022 年再次用於冬奧開閉幕式。
鳥巢的鋼構件是隨機排列的，每根桿件都同樣承重。
optionsEn: A large steel roof is so strong that hanging tens of tonnes of stage equipment needs no separate check.
After the 2008 Olympics the Bird's Nest became a long-term venue, with capacity planned to drop from about 91,000 Olympic seats to about 80,000, and it hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics ceremonies.
The Bird's Nest members are randomly arranged and every member carries load equally.
quiz.explanation: 鳥巢在 2008 年奧運後改為長期場館，座位由奧運時約 91,000 席規劃為約 80,000 席，並於 2022 年再次用於冬奧開閉幕式。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After the 2008 Olympics the Bird's Nest became a long-term venue, with capacity planned to drop from about 91,000 Olympic seats to about 80,000, and it hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics ceremonies. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 賽後再利用、檢測與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-Games reuse, inspection and engineering handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「賽後營運荷載與結構檔案」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-Games loads and structural records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某演出吊掛設備 60 t，由 6 個吊點平均分擔，每點 F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN。若吊點容許荷載為 80 kN，必須增加到 60×9.81/80 ≈ 7.4，即至少 8 個吊點；若吊點分布不均使某點承受 1.5 倍平均值，則需約 147 kN。設備重量與容許荷載為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A show rig of 60 t shared equally by 6 points loads each with F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN. If the allowable point load is 80 kN, at least 60×9.81/80 ≈ 7.4, that is 8 points, are needed; if uneven distribution gives one point 1.5 times the average, it carries about 147 kN. Rig weight and allowable load are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每場活動的吊掛計畫須列出吊點位置、荷載、動態係數與吊具，由結構工程師依交接的吊點容量表審核；活動後目視檢查吊點與塗層，並定期以監測資料或全測站比對屋蓋關鍵節點位置與卸載後基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Each event's rigging plan must list point locations, loads, dynamic factors and rigging gear, reviewed by a structural engineer against the handed-over rigging-capacity table; after the event visually inspect the points and coatings, and periodically compare key roof node positions with the post-unloading baseline by monitoring data or total-station survey.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 某演出吊掛設備 60 t，由 6 個吊點平均分擔，每點 F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN。若吊點容許荷載為 80 kN，必須增加到 60×9.81/80 ≈ 7.4，即至少 8 個吊點；若吊點分布不均使某點承受 1.5 倍平均值，則需約 147 kN。設備重量與容許荷載為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A show rig of 60 t shared equally by 6 points loads each with F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN. If the allowable point load is 80 kN, at least 60×9.81/80 ≈ 7.4, that is 8 points, are needed; if uneven distribution gives one point 1.5 times the average, it carries about 147 kN. Rig weight and allowable load are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「賽後再利用、檢測與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-Games reuse, inspection and engineering handover", which statement holds?
options: 所有桿件外形都是 1.2 m 方管，所以斷面與板厚都一樣。
臨時支撐只是施工用，不需要像永久結構一樣計算與檢查。
某演出吊掛設備 60 t，由 6 個吊點平均分擔，每點 F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN。
optionsEn: All members look like 1.2 m boxes, so their sections and plate thicknesses are the same.
Temporary supports are only for construction and need no calculation or inspection like permanent structure.
A show rig of 60 t shared equally by 6 points loads each with F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN.
quiz.explanation: 某演出吊掛設備 60 t，由 6 個吊點平均分擔，每點 F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A show rig of 60 t shared equally by 6 points loads each with F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 賽後再利用、檢測與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-Games reuse, inspection and engineering handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「賽後營運荷載與結構檔案」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-Games loads and structural records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每場活動的吊掛計畫須列出吊點位置、荷載、動態係數與吊具，由結構工程師依交接的吊點容量表審核；活動後目視檢查吊點與塗層，並定期以監測資料或全測站比對屋蓋關鍵節點位置與卸載後基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Each event's rigging plan must list point locations, loads, dynamic factors and rigging gear, reviewed by a structural engineer against the handed-over rigging-capacity table; after the event visually inspect the points and coatings, and periodically compare key roof node positions with the post-unloading baseline by monitoring data or total-station survey. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含屋蓋吊點平面與容量表、卸載後幾何基準、監測點位置與資料格式、防火性能化設計的前提條件；任何改變吊點、看台配置或場地用途的計畫，須先經結構與消防顧問評估再核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include a roof rigging-point plan and capacity table, the post-unloading geometric baseline, monitoring point locations and data format, and the assumptions behind the performance-based fire design; any plan that changes rigging points, seating layout or field use must be assessed by structural and fire consultants before approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：活動承包商自行在桿件上綁吊或焊接吊耳，造成未經核算的局部彎曲與塗層破壞；多場活動累積的吊掛與拆卸若沒有紀錄，屋蓋在不知情下承受反覆集中荷載，日後無法追溯損傷來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Event contractors who sling from members or weld lifting lugs on their own create unchecked local bending and coating damage; without records of repeated rigging and dismantling, the roof carries repeated concentrated loads unknowingly and damage cannot later be traced to its source. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每場活動的吊掛計畫須列出吊點位置、荷載、動態係數與吊具，由結構工程師依交接的吊點容量表審核；活動後目視檢查吊點與塗層，並定期以監測資料或全測站比對屋蓋關鍵節點位置與卸載後基準。
knowledge.textEn: Each event's rigging plan must list point locations, loads, dynamic factors and rigging gear, reviewed by a structural engineer against the handed-over rigging-capacity table; after the event visually inspect the points and coatings, and periodically compare key roof node positions with the post-unloading baseline by monitoring data or total-station survey.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含屋蓋吊點平面與容量表、卸載後幾何基準、監測點位置與資料格式、防火性能化設計的前提條件；任何改變吊點、看台配置或場地用途的計畫，須先經結構與消防顧問評估再核准。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include a roof rigging-point plan and capacity table, the post-unloading geometric baseline, monitoring point locations and data format, and the assumptions behind the performance-based fire design; any plan that changes rigging points, seating layout or field use must be assessed by structural and fire consultants before approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「賽後再利用、檢測與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-Games reuse, inspection and engineering handover"?
options: 每場活動的吊掛計畫須列出吊點位置、荷載、動態係數與吊具，由結構工程師依交接的吊點容量表審核。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
鋼構屋蓋只要強度夠，溫度變化只會造成小變形，不會產生內力。
optionsEn: Each event's rigging plan must list point locations, loads, dynamic factors and rigging gear, reviewed by a structural engineer against the handed-over rigging-capacity table.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If a steel roof is strong enough, temperature change only causes small movements and no internal forces.
quiz.explanation: 每場活動的吊掛計畫須列出吊點位置、荷載、動態係數與吊具，由結構工程師依交接的吊點容量表審核；活動後目視檢查吊點與塗層，並定期以監測資料或全測站比對屋蓋關鍵節點位置與卸載後基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Each event's rigging plan must list point locations, loads, dynamic factors and rigging gear, reviewed by a structural engineer against the handed-over rigging-capacity table; after the event visually inspect the points and coatings, and periodically compare key roof node positions with the post-unloading baseline by monitoring data or total-station survey. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 賽後再利用、檢測與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-Games reuse, inspection and engineering handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「賽後營運荷載與結構檔案」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-Games loads and structural records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 活動承包商自行在桿件上綁吊或焊接吊耳，造成未經核算的局部彎曲與塗層破壞；多場活動累積的吊掛與拆卸若沒有紀錄，屋蓋在不知情下承受反覆集中荷載，日後無法追溯損傷來源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Event contractors who sling from members or weld lifting lugs on their own create unchecked local bending and coating damage; without records of repeated rigging and dismantling, the roof carries repeated concentrated loads unknowingly and damage cannot later be traced to its source. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此交接文件必須清楚標示屋蓋可吊掛點、容許荷載與檢查要求，讓營運單位在每次活動前能核對。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover documents must therefore mark the permitted rigging points, allowable loads and inspection requirements on the roof so that the operator can check them before every event.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼屋蓋很大很強，吊掛幾十噸的舞台設備不必另外核算。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A large steel roof is so strong that hanging tens of tonnes of stage equipment needs no separate check." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 活動承包商自行在桿件上綁吊或焊接吊耳，造成未經核算的局部彎曲與塗層破壞；多場活動累積的吊掛與拆卸若沒有紀錄，屋蓋在不知情下承受反覆集中荷載，日後無法追溯損傷來源。
knowledge.textEn: Event contractors who sling from members or weld lifting lugs on their own create unchecked local bending and coating damage; without records of repeated rigging and dismantling, the roof carries repeated concentrated loads unknowingly and damage cannot later be traced to its source.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「賽後再利用、檢測與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-Games reuse, inspection and engineering handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
活動承包商自行在桿件上綁吊或焊接吊耳，造成未經核算的局部彎曲與塗層破壞。
鳥巢的鋼構件是隨機排列的，每根桿件都同樣承重。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Event contractors who sling from members or weld lifting lugs on their own create unchecked local bending and coating damage.
The Bird's Nest members are randomly arranged and every member carries load equally.
quiz.explanation: 活動承包商自行在桿件上綁吊或焊接吊耳，造成未經核算的局部彎曲與塗層破壞；多場活動累積的吊掛與拆卸若沒有紀錄，屋蓋在不知情下承受反覆集中荷載，日後無法追溯損傷來源。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Event contractors who sling from members or weld lifting lugs on their own create unchecked local bending and coating damage; without records of repeated rigging and dismantling, the roof carries repeated concentrated loads unknowingly and damage cannot later be traced to its source. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園
courses.summary: 濱海灣金沙空中花園是長約 340 m、最寬約 40 m 的鋼構平台，以巨型桁架與鋼箱梁跨越三座 55 層混凝土塔樓，並在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m。課程從三塔相對變位與懸臂人致振動出發，處理鋼箱梁與後拉預力、塔頂 V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承、1,270 t 箱梁以鋼絞線千斤頂提升到約 200 m、塔樓斜腿的施工控制，再談提升監測、阻尼器驗收、無邊際泳池接縫調平與長期徐變維護。
courses.summaryEn: The Marina Bay Sands SkyPark is a steel platform about 340 m long and up to about 40 m wide that bridges three 55-storey concrete towers with mega-trusses and steel box girders and cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower. The course starts from relative tower movement and crowd-induced vibration of the cantilever, then covers box girders and post-tensioning, rooftop V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings, strand-jack lifting of a 1,270 t girder pair to about 200 m and construction control of the leaning tower legs, before turning to lift monitoring, damper acceptance, infinity-pool joints and levelling, and long-term creep and maintenance.
courses.focus: 橫跨三座獨立擺動塔樓、離地約 200 m 的鋼構平台，及其 66.5 m 懸臂、滑動支承與鋼絞線千斤頂提升
courses.focusEn: A steel platform about 200 m up across three independently swaying towers: its 66.5 m cantilever, sliding bearings and strand-jack lifting
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算懸臂箱梁提升所需的鋼絞線數與提升時間。提升件為一對約 80 m 長的箱梁，假設重 1,270 t，F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN。選用 15.7 mm 鋼絞線，最小破斷力 279 kN，要求安全係數 2.5：所需根數 n = 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 根，以 4 台千斤頂分配每台 28 根。提升高度 200 m、速度 14 m/h，純提升時間 t = 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h。若高空風速 15 m/s，箱梁迎風面 80 m × 10 m、阻力係數 2.0，橫向風力約 0.5×1.225×15²×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN，約為吊重的 1.8%，鋼絞線偏角約 atan(220/12,460) ≈ 1.0°。若安全係數改為 3.0，需約 134 根，每台 34 根；若風速增為 20 m/s，風力約 392 kN，偏角約 1.8°。所有數值為教學假設，不代表濱海灣金沙的實際提升設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the strands and lifting time for the cantilever box-girder lift. The load is a pair of box girders about 80 m long, assumed to weigh 1,270 t, F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN. Using 15.7 mm strand with a 279 kN minimum breaking load and a safety factor of 2.5, the number of strands is n = 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112, or 28 per jack for 4 jacks. Lifting 200 m at 14 m/h takes t = 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h of pure lifting. At a wind speed of 15 m/s at height, with an 80 m × 10 m frontal area and drag coefficient 2.0, the lateral force is about 0.5×1.225×15²×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN, about 1.8% of the weight, giving a strand inclination of about atan(220/12,460) ≈ 1.0°. A safety factor of 3.0 needs about 134 strands, 34 per jack; a 20 m/s wind gives about 392 kN and an inclination of about 1.8°. All values are teaching assumptions, not the actual lifting design at Marina Bay Sands.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 空中花園全長約 340 m、最寬約 40 m，面積約 1.2 公頃
平台在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m，距海平面約 200 m
三座旅館塔樓各 55 層，建築頂高約 207 m
平台分成 14 個主要預製鋼段，以鋼絞線千斤頂提升
最大一次提升為一對約 80 m 長、約 1,270 t 的箱梁，提升速度約 14 m/h，耗時超過 16 小時
永久鋼結構約 7,000 t，臨時鋼結構約 4,000 t
懸臂端內藏約 4.5 t 的調諧質量阻尼器，處理人群活動振動
每座塔可由中心擺動約 250 mm，平台以多向滑動支承容許獨立變位
基礎採約 1.5 m 厚、深約 50 m 的連續壁，形成直徑可達約 120 m 的圍堰
factsEn: The SkyPark is about 340 m long and up to about 40 m wide, covering about 1.2 ha
The platform cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower, about 200 m above sea level
The three hotel towers have 55 storeys each, with an architectural top of about 207 m
The platform was prefabricated in 14 main steel segments and raised by strand jacks
The largest lift was a pair of box girders about 80 m long and about 1,270 t, raised at about 14 m/h over more than 16 hours
Permanent steelwork was about 7,000 t and temporary steelwork about 4,000 t
A tuned mass damper of about 4.5 t in the cantilever tip controls crowd-induced vibration
Each tower can sway about 250 mm from centre, and multidirectional sliding bearings let the platform accommodate it
Foundations use diaphragm walls about 1.5 m thick and about 50 m deep forming cofferdams up to about 120 m in diameter
timeline: 2006　新加坡政府綜合度假村標案競圖，Las Vegas Sands 與 Safdie 的方案得標
2009　三座 55 層旅館塔樓於 7 月結構封頂
2009–2010　14 個主要鋼段以鋼絞線千斤頂提升至塔頂組成空中花園
2010　6 月度假村正式開幕，空中花園開放
timelineEn: 2006 — Las Vegas Sands and Safdie win the Singapore government tender competition for the integrated resort
2009 — The three 55-storey hotel towers top out in July
2009–2010 — Fourteen main steel segments are strand-jacked to the tower tops to form the SkyPark
2010 — The resort officially opens in June and the SkyPark opens to visitors
