knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「泵機輸出、壓力與功率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pump output, pressure and power", which statement holds?
options: 只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。
管線外觀沒有漏漿或變形，就表示管壁厚度足夠。
水力功率 P = p·Q。
optionsEn: One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall.
If the line shows no leaks or deformation, the walls must still be thick enough.
Hydraulic power P = p·Q.
quiz.explanation: 水力功率 P = p·Q。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydraulic power P = p·Q. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 泵機輸出、壓力與功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pump output, pressure and power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泵機與 S 閥」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pump unit and S-valve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對泵機性能曲線，確認所需壓力與排量組合落在曲線內並有裕度；現場記錄每次泵送的出口壓力、行程頻率與排量，並安排備用泵機與關鍵零件（S 閥、眼鏡板、切割環），以免單機故障中斷澆置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the pump's performance curve to confirm that the required pressure and output lie inside it with a margin; log outlet pressure, stroke rate and output for every pour, and keep a standby pump and critical spares such as S-valves, wear plates and cutting rings so that a single failure does not interrupt a pour. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重要澆置（例如巨柱或核心筒的關鍵段）前，泵機須完成保養並備妥備用機，泵送計畫書附上壓力—排量工作點；泵機操作員與樓上布料人員要有直接通訊，並規定停泵與降壓的指令方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before critical pours such as key megacolumn or core lifts, service the pump and have a standby ready, attach the pressure–output operating point to the pumping plan, give the pump operator and the placing crew upstairs direct communication, and define how stop and pressure-relief orders are given.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：泵機長時間在最高壓力下運轉，眼鏡板與切割環磨耗加快，漏漿使有效壓力下降，最終在關鍵澆置途中停機，形成冷縫；只依額定最大排量排程，忽略高壓時排量下降，供料計畫失準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Running a pump at maximum pressure for long periods accelerates wear of the wear plate and cutting ring, leakage cuts effective pressure and the pump finally stops mid-pour, creating a cold joint; scheduling on the rated maximum output while ignoring the drop at high pressure throws the supply plan off. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對泵機性能曲線，確認所需壓力與排量組合落在曲線內並有裕度；現場記錄每次泵送的出口壓力、行程頻率與排量，並安排備用泵機與關鍵零件（S 閥、眼鏡板、切割環），以免單機故障中斷澆置。
knowledge.textEn: Check the pump's performance curve to confirm that the required pressure and output lie inside it with a margin; log outlet pressure, stroke rate and output for every pour, and keep a standby pump and critical spares such as S-valves, wear plates and cutting rings so that a single failure does not interrupt a pour.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重要澆置（例如巨柱或核心筒的關鍵段）前，泵機須完成保養並備妥備用機，泵送計畫書附上壓力—排量工作點；泵機操作員與樓上布料人員要有直接通訊，並規定停泵與降壓的指令方式。
knowledge.textEn: Before critical pours such as key megacolumn or core lifts, service the pump and have a standby ready, attach the pressure–output operating point to the pumping plan, give the pump operator and the placing crew upstairs direct communication, and define how stop and pressure-relief orders are given.

quiz.question: 要驗證「泵機輸出、壓力與功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pump output, pressure and power"?
options: 核對泵機性能曲線，確認所需壓力與排量組合落在曲線內並有裕度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
泵送高度只要乘上混凝土密度就能算出所需泵壓。
optionsEn: Check the pump's performance curve to confirm that the required pressure and output lie inside it with a margin.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Pump pressure can be found simply by multiplying height by concrete density.
quiz.explanation: 核對泵機性能曲線，確認所需壓力與排量組合落在曲線內並有裕度；現場記錄每次泵送的出口壓力、行程頻率與排量，並安排備用泵機與關鍵零件（S 閥、眼鏡板、切割環），以免單機故障中斷澆置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the pump's performance curve to confirm that the required pressure and output lie inside it with a margin; log outlet pressure, stroke rate and output for every pour, and keep a standby pump and critical spares such as S-valves, wear plates and cutting rings so that a single failure does not interrupt a pour. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 泵機輸出、壓力與功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pump output, pressure and power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泵機與 S 閥」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pump unit and S-valve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 泵機長時間在最高壓力下運轉，眼鏡板與切割環磨耗加快，漏漿使有效壓力下降，最終在關鍵澆置途中停機，形成冷縫；只依額定最大排量排程，忽略高壓時排量下降，供料計畫失準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Running a pump at maximum pressure for long periods accelerates wear of the wear plate and cutting ring, leakage cuts effective pressure and the pump finally stops mid-pour, creating a cold joint; scheduling on the rated maximum output while ignoring the drop at high pressure throws the supply plan off. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：哈里發塔的泵送站以兩台 Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D 與一台 BSA 14000 HP-D 組成，泵機的機架、料斗與 S 閥都為預期壓力加強；上海中心大廈則以三一重工 HBT90CH 系列超高壓拖泵泵送核心筒混凝土。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Burj Khalifa's pumping station combined two Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D units and one BSA 14000 HP-D, with frames, hoppers and S-valves reinforced for the expected pressures; Shanghai Tower used Sany HBT90CH-series ultra-high-pressure trailer pumps for its core concrete.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵機的最大排量和最大壓力可以同時達到。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A pump can reach its maximum output and its maximum pressure at the same time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 泵機長時間在最高壓力下運轉，眼鏡板與切割環磨耗加快，漏漿使有效壓力下降，最終在關鍵澆置途中停機，形成冷縫；只依額定最大排量排程，忽略高壓時排量下降，供料計畫失準。
knowledge.textEn: Running a pump at maximum pressure for long periods accelerates wear of the wear plate and cutting ring, leakage cuts effective pressure and the pump finally stops mid-pour, creating a cold joint; scheduling on the rated maximum output while ignoring the drop at high pressure throws the supply plan off.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泵機輸出、壓力與功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pump output, pressure and power" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
泵機長時間在最高壓力下運轉，眼鏡板與切割環磨耗加快，漏漿使有效壓力下降，最終在關鍵澆置途中停機，形成冷縫。
垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Running a pump at maximum pressure for long periods accelerates wear of the wear plate and cutting ring, leakage cuts effective pressure and the pump finally stops mid-pour, creating a cold joint.
A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required.
quiz.explanation: 泵機長時間在最高壓力下運轉，眼鏡板與切割環磨耗加快，漏漿使有效壓力下降，最終在關鍵澆置途中停機，形成冷縫；只依額定最大排量排程，忽略高壓時排量下降，供料計畫失準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Running a pump at maximum pressure for long periods accelerates wear of the wear plate and cutting ring, leakage cuts effective pressure and the pump finally stops mid-pour, creating a cold joint; scheduling on the rated maximum output while ignoring the drop at high pressure throws the supply plan off. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「管線佈置、固定與止回」與「開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Line layout, fixing and shut-off" and "Priming, continuous supply and water flushing": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 管線佈置、固定與止回：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Line layout, fixing and shut-off: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「管線佈置與固定」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Line layout and fixing” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 垂直泵送管沿核心筒內的豎井或牆面設置，每層以管夾固定在結構上，承受管線與管內混凝土的重量以及每一次泵送衝程的脈動。彎管處的內壓會產生很大的推力，底部的水平轉垂直彎頭尤其關鍵，必須以混凝土座或鋼支架錨固。泵機出口與垂直段之間通常保留一段水平管，並在垂直段底部設置截止閥，停泵或更換管件時防止數百公尺混凝土柱回流衝擊泵機。管線也必須避開會隨樓層升高而移動的爬模平台。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「管線佈置與固定」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The vertical line runs up a shaft or along walls of the core, clamped to the structure at every floor to carry the weight of pipe and concrete and the pulsation of each pump stroke. Internal pressure at bends produces large thrust, and the bottom horizontal-to-vertical elbow is especially critical, anchored in a concrete block or steel frame. A horizontal run is usually kept between the pump outlet and the vertical section, with a shut-off valve at the foot of the riser so that, when pumping stops or pipes are changed, hundreds of metres of concrete cannot flow back and hit the pump. The line must also clear climbing-form platforms that move up with the building. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Line layout and fixing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：彎管推力 F = p·A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Bend thrust F = p·A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「管線佈置與固定」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Line layout and fixing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 管線佈置、固定與止回
knowledge.text: 垂直泵送管沿核心筒內的豎井或牆面設置，每層以管夾固定在結構上，承受管線與管內混凝土的重量以及每一次泵送衝程的脈動。彎管處的內壓會產生很大的推力，底部的水平轉垂直彎頭尤其關鍵，必須以混凝土座或鋼支架錨固。
knowledge.textEn: The vertical line runs up a shaft or along walls of the core, clamped to the structure at every floor to carry the weight of pipe and concrete and the pulsation of each pump stroke. Internal pressure at bends produces large thrust, and the bottom horizontal-to-vertical elbow is especially critical, anchored in a concrete block or steel frame.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「管線佈置、固定與止回」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Line layout, fixing and shut-off" is correct?
options: 垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。
泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。
垂直泵送管沿核心筒內的豎井或牆面設置，每層以管夾固定在結構上，承受管線與管內混凝土的重量以及每一次泵送衝程的脈動。
optionsEn: A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required.
Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time.
The vertical line runs up a shaft or along walls of the core, clamped to the structure at every floor to carry the weight of pipe and concrete and the pulsation of each pump stroke.
quiz.explanation: 垂直泵送管沿核心筒內的豎井或牆面設置，每層以管夾固定在結構上，承受管線與管內混凝土的重量以及每一次泵送衝程的脈動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The vertical line runs up a shaft or along walls of the core, clamped to the structure at every floor to carry the weight of pipe and concrete and the pulsation of each pump stroke. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 管線佈置、固定與止回：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Line layout, fixing and shut-off: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「管線佈置與固定」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Line layout and fixing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：彎管推力 F = p·A。p = 22.4 MPa、A ≈ 0.0123 m² 時單向推力約 275 kN，90° 彎管合力約 √2×275 ≈ 389 kN。每 4 m 樓層的管線重：鋼管約 34.5 kg/m 加混凝土約 30.1 kg/m，共約 64.6 kg/m，每層管夾約承受 2.5 kN 的靜重，另加泵送脈動。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Bend thrust F = p·A. At p = 22.4 MPa and A ≈ 0.0123 m² the thrust is about 275 kN in each direction and the resultant at a 90° bend about √2×275 ≈ 389 kN. Per 4 m storey the line weighs about 34.5 kg/m of steel plus about 30.1 kg/m of concrete, about 64.6 kg/m, so each floor clamp carries about 2.5 kN of static weight plus pumping pulsation. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：管線佈置圖須標示每一個彎管位置、錨座設計反力、管夾間距與截止閥位置，由結構工程師確認錨座與預埋件能承受推力；首次高壓泵送時觀察底部錨座與管夾是否移位，並量測管線振動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The line layout drawing should show every bend, anchor design reactions, clamp spacing and shut-off valve location, with the structural engineer confirming that anchors and embeds can take the thrust; at the first high-pressure pour watch the bottom anchor and clamps for movement and measure line vibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 彎管推力 F = p·A。p = 22.4 MPa、A ≈ 0.0123 m² 時單向推力約 275 kN，90° 彎管合力約 √2×275 ≈ 389 kN。每 4 m 樓層的管線重：鋼管約 34.5 kg/m 加混凝土約 30.1 kg/m，共約 64.6 kg/m，每層管夾約承受 2.5 kN 的靜重，另加泵送脈動。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Bend thrust F = p·A. At p = 22.4 MPa and A ≈ 0.0123 m² the thrust is about 275 kN in each direction and the resultant at a 90° bend about √2×275 ≈ 389 kN. Per 4 m storey the line weighs about 34.5 kg/m of steel plus about 30.1 kg/m of concrete, about 64.6 kg/m, so each floor clamp carries about 2.5 kN of static weight plus pumping pulsation. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「管線佈置、固定與止回」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Line layout, fixing and shut-off", which statement holds?
options: 彎管推力 F = p·A。
混凝土在工地入口檢驗合格，泵送到樓頂後的性質也不會改變。
只要強度試驗平均值合格，就不需要記錄每一車混凝土澆在哪裡。
optionsEn: Bend thrust F = p·A.
If concrete passes inspection at the site gate, its properties will not change after pumping to the top.
If the average strength passes, there is no need to record where each truck was placed.
quiz.explanation: 彎管推力 F = p·A。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Bend thrust F = p·A. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 管線佈置、固定與止回：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Line layout, fixing and shut-off: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管線佈置與固定」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Line layout and fixing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 管線佈置圖須標示每一個彎管位置、錨座設計反力、管夾間距與截止閥位置，由結構工程師確認錨座與預埋件能承受推力；首次高壓泵送時觀察底部錨座與管夾是否移位，並量測管線振動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The line layout drawing should show every bend, anchor design reactions, clamp spacing and shut-off valve location, with the structural engineer confirming that anchors and embeds can take the thrust; at the first high-pressure pour watch the bottom anchor and clamps for movement and measure line vibration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：管線錨座、管夾預埋件與通過樓板的開口應在結構施工圖中預先設計，而非現場臨時鑽孔；截止閥、洩壓與清管作業須有書面程序，並列為每次高壓泵送前的檢查項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design line anchors, clamp embeds and slab openings into the structural shop drawings rather than drilling them ad hoc; give shut-off, pressure relief and line clearing written procedures and include them in the checklist before every high-pressure pour.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：底部彎頭錨座不足，泵送脈動使彎頭逐漸移位，接頭被拉開而爆管；垂直段底部沒有截止閥，停泵時混凝土柱回流，S 閥與活塞受衝擊損壞，甚至造成人員傷害。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An inadequate anchor at the bottom elbow lets pumping pulses move it bit by bit until a coupling pulls apart and bursts; without a shut-off valve at the riser foot, the concrete column flows back when pumping stops, damaging the S-valve and pistons and possibly injuring people. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: The line layout drawing should show every bend, anchor design reactions, clamp spacing and shut-off valve location, with the structural engineer confirming that anchors and embeds can take the thrust; at the first high-pressure pour watch the bottom anchor and clamps for movement and measure line vibration.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 管線錨座、管夾預埋件與通過樓板的開口應在結構施工圖中預先設計，而非現場臨時鑽孔；截止閥、洩壓與清管作業須有書面程序，並列為每次高壓泵送前的檢查項目。
knowledge.textEn: Design line anchors, clamp embeds and slab openings into the structural shop drawings rather than drilling them ad hoc; give shut-off, pressure relief and line clearing written procedures and include them in the checklist before every high-pressure pour.

quiz.question: 要驗證「管線佈置、固定與止回」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Line layout, fixing and shut-off"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
管線佈置圖須標示每一個彎管位置、錨座設計反力、管夾間距與截止閥位置，由結構工程師確認錨座與預埋件能承受推力。
坍流度越大的混凝土就一定越容易泵送。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

The line layout drawing should show every bend, anchor design reactions, clamp spacing and shut-off valve location, with the structural engineer confirming that anchors and embeds can take the thrust.
The higher the slump flow, the easier the concrete is to pump.
quiz.explanation: 管線佈置圖須標示每一個彎管位置、錨座設計反力、管夾間距與截止閥位置，由結構工程師確認錨座與預埋件能承受推力；首次高壓泵送時觀察底部錨座與管夾是否移位，並量測管線振動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The line layout drawing should show every bend, anchor design reactions, clamp spacing and shut-off valve location, with the structural engineer confirming that anchors and embeds can take the thrust; at the first high-pressure pour watch the bottom anchor and clamps for movement and measure line vibration. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 管線佈置、固定與止回：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Line layout, fixing and shut-off: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管線佈置與固定」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Line layout and fixing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 底部彎頭錨座不足，泵送脈動使彎頭逐漸移位，接頭被拉開而爆管；垂直段底部沒有截止閥，停泵時混凝土柱回流，S 閥與活塞受衝擊損壞，甚至造成人員傷害。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An inadequate anchor at the bottom elbow lets pumping pulses move it bit by bit until a coupling pulls apart and bursts; without a shut-off valve at the riser foot, the concrete column flows back when pumping stops, damaging the S-valve and pistons and possibly injuring people. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：管線也必須避開會隨樓層升高而移動的爬模平台。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The line must also clear climbing-form platforms that move up with the building.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「垂直泵送管只要綁在牆上不會掉下來就可以，不需要計算推力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A vertical pump line only needs tying to the wall so it does not fall; no thrust calculation is required." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 底部彎頭錨座不足，泵送脈動使彎頭逐漸移位，接頭被拉開而爆管；垂直段底部沒有截止閥，停泵時混凝土柱回流，S 閥與活塞受衝擊損壞，甚至造成人員傷害。
knowledge.textEn: An inadequate anchor at the bottom elbow lets pumping pulses move it bit by bit until a coupling pulls apart and bursts; without a shut-off valve at the riser foot, the concrete column flows back when pumping stops, damaging the S-valve and pistons and possibly injuring people.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「管線佈置、固定與止回」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Line layout, fixing and shut-off" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。
底部彎頭錨座不足，泵送脈動使彎頭逐漸移位，接頭被拉開而爆管；垂直段底部沒有截止閥，停泵時混凝土柱回流，S 閥與活塞受衝擊損壞，甚至造成人員傷害。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time.
An inadequate anchor at the bottom elbow lets pumping pulses move it bit by bit until a coupling pulls apart and bursts.
quiz.explanation: 底部彎頭錨座不足，泵送脈動使彎頭逐漸移位，接頭被拉開而爆管；垂直段底部沒有截止閥，停泵時混凝土柱回流，S 閥與活塞受衝擊損壞，甚至造成人員傷害。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An inadequate anchor at the bottom elbow lets pumping pulses move it bit by bit until a coupling pulls apart and bursts; without a shut-off valve at the riser foot, the concrete column flows back when pumping stops, damaging the S-valve and pistons and possibly injuring people. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Priming, continuous supply and water flushing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「開泵與水洗清管」如何影響高強度混凝土高程泵送的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Start-up and water flushing” governs force, deformation or durability in “High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每次泵送開始前，管線內壁必須先以砂漿或商用潤管劑完整潤滑，否則第一批混凝土會失去漿體而堵管。泵送中最重要的是連續供料：一旦中斷，潤滑層開始脫水，管內混凝土逐漸變硬，重新啟動時壓力急升。超高層管線很長、容積很大，澆置結束後要把管內數立方公尺的混凝土推出並清潔管線；三一重工在超高層專案中以水洗方式把管內混凝土直接推送至澆置點，減少浪費與高空拆管作業。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「開泵與水洗清管」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before each pour the inside of the line must be fully lubricated with mortar or a commercial primer, or the first concrete loses its paste and blocks the line. During pumping the most important thing is continuous supply: once it stops the lubrication layer starts to dewater, concrete in the line stiffens, and pressure spikes on restart. Supertall lines are long and hold several cubic metres, so at the end of a pour that concrete must be pushed out and the line cleaned; on supertall projects Sany has used water flushing to push the concrete in the line through to the placement point, reducing waste and dismantling of pipes at height. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Start-up and water flushing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：管線容積 V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³，以 40 m³/h 充滿約需 12.9 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Line volume V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³, about 12.9 min to fill at 40 m³/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「開泵與水洗清管」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Start-up and water flushing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管
knowledge.titleEn: Priming, continuous supply and water flushing
knowledge.text: 每次泵送開始前，管線內壁必須先以砂漿或商用潤管劑完整潤滑，否則第一批混凝土會失去漿體而堵管。泵送中最重要的是連續供料：一旦中斷，潤滑層開始脫水，管內混凝土逐漸變硬，重新啟動時壓力急升。
knowledge.textEn: Before each pour the inside of the line must be fully lubricated with mortar or a commercial primer, or the first concrete loses its paste and blocks the line. During pumping the most important thing is continuous supply: once it stops the lubrication layer starts to dewater, concrete in the line stiffens, and pressure spikes on restart.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Priming, continuous supply and water flushing" is correct?
options: 每次泵送開始前，管線內壁必須先以砂漿或商用潤管劑完整潤滑，否則第一批混凝土會失去漿體而堵管。
泵送中途停一下沒關係，混凝土還沒凝結，隨時可以再開泵。
只要在地面試泵一次成功，整棟超高層都可以用同一配比泵送。
optionsEn: Before each pour the inside of the line must be fully lubricated with mortar or a commercial primer, or the first concrete loses its paste and blocks the line.
Pausing mid-pour is harmless because the concrete has not set and pumping can resume at any time.
One successful trial at ground level means the same mix can be pumped to the top of a supertall.
quiz.explanation: 每次泵送開始前，管線內壁必須先以砂漿或商用潤管劑完整潤滑，否則第一批混凝土會失去漿體而堵管。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before each pour the inside of the line must be fully lubricated with mortar or a commercial primer, or the first concrete loses its paste and blocks the line. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開泵潤管、連續供料與水洗清管：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Priming, continuous supply and water flushing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開泵與水洗清管」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Start-up and water flushing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：管線容積 V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³，以 40 m³/h 充滿約需 12.9 min。潤管砂漿以 2 mm 厚覆蓋內壁：π×0.125×700×0.002 ≈ 0.55 m³。供料 40 m³/h 時，9 m³ 預拌車需每 13.5 min 到達一車，車次間隔一旦超過約 30 min 即需啟動低速循環或暫停程序。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Line volume V = A·L = 0.0123×700 ≈ 8.6 m³, about 12.9 min to fill at 40 m³/h. Priming mortar 2 mm thick on the wall needs π×0.125×700×0.002 ≈ 0.55 m³. At 40 m³/h a 9 m³ truck must arrive every 13.5 min; if the gap exceeds about 30 min, the slow-recirculation or stop procedure starts. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次泵送記錄潤管材料與數量、首車到達時間、車次間隔、泵壓變化與清管方式；把車次間隔與泵壓尖峰對照，找出供料中斷造成的壓力異常，並與預拌廠檢討派車。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For each pour record priming material and quantity, first truck arrival, truck intervals, pressure changes and the cleaning method; compare truck gaps with pressure spikes to find supply-related anomalies and review dispatching with the ready-mix plant.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

At 40 m³/h a 9 m³ truck must arrive every 13.5 min; if the gap exceeds about 30 min, the slow-recirculation or stop procedure starts. Values are teaching assumptions.
