The test catches poor lubrication, mismatched lots, wrong tool settings, or bolts too short to fit the calibrator; the 2025 RCSC edition also adds procedures for nonconforming verification tests.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝前驗證試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pre-installation verification testing" is correct?
options: 出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。
任何預拉方法在現場使用前，都要以同批的螺栓、螺帽與墊圈組件，在液壓式螺栓張力校正器中照實際程序鎖緊，量測得到的張力，確認方法、工具與組件組合能達到規定的最低預拉力並留有餘裕（一般要求至少 1.05 倍）。
完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。
optionsEn: Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site.

Before any pretensioning method is used in the field, assemblies of bolts, nuts and washers from the same lots are tightened by the actual procedure in a hydraulic bolt tension calibrator and the tension measured, confirming that method, tools and assemblies reach the specified minimum pretension with margin, typically at least 1.05 times.
A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately.
quiz.explanation: 任何預拉方法在現場使用前，都要以同批的螺栓、螺帽與墊圈組件，在液壓式螺栓張力校正器中照實際程序鎖緊，量測得到的張力，確認方法、工具與組件組合能達到規定的最低預拉力並留有餘裕（一般要求至少 1.05 倍）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before any pretensioning method is used in the field, assemblies of bolts, nuts and washers from the same lots are tightened by the actual procedure in a hydraulic bolt tension calibrator and the tension measured, confirming that method, tools and assemblies reach the specified minimum pretension with margin, typically at least 1.05 times. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝前驗證試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pre-installation verification testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺栓張力校正器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolt tension calibrator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：7/8 in A325 最低預拉 173 kN，驗證要求 ≥ 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN。三組試驗得 186、190、179 kN：平均 185 kN，但 179 kN < 181.7 kN，此組合判不合格，須查明潤滑或程序後重做，不能以平均值放行。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 7/8 in A325 bolt the minimum pretension is 173 kN and verification requires at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN. Three assemblies give 186, 190 and 179 kN: the average is 185 kN, but 179 kN < 181.7 kN, so the combination fails and lubrication or procedure must be investigated and the test repeated; the average cannot release it. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：張力校正器須在有效期限內校正，試驗由檢驗員在場觀察並記錄批號、直徑、長度、方法、工具設定與每組張力；轉角法驗證同時記錄達到最低張力所需的轉角，扭剪型與指示墊圈則記錄扭斷或間隙判定時的實際張力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The calibrator must be within its calibration period, and the inspector witnesses and records lot numbers, diameter, length, method, tool settings and each tension; for turn-of-nut also record the rotation needed to reach minimum tension, and for twist-off bolts and indicators record the actual tension at shear-off or gap acceptance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 7/8 in A325 最低預拉 173 kN，驗證要求 ≥ 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN。三組試驗得 186、190、179 kN：平均 185 kN，但 179 kN < 181.7 kN，此組合判不合格，須查明潤滑或程序後重做，不能以平均值放行。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 7/8 in A325 bolt the minimum pretension is 173 kN and verification requires at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN. Three assemblies give 186, 190 and 179 kN: the average is 185 kN, but 179 kN < 181.7 kN, so the combination fails and lubrication or procedure must be investigated and the test repeated; the average cannot release it. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝前驗證試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pre-installation verification testing", which statement holds?
options: 螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。
外加拉力會全部直接加到預拉螺栓上，所以預拉沒有好處。
optionsEn: Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept.
Any applied tension adds directly to a pretensioned bolt, so pretension gives no benefit.
For a 7/8 in A325 bolt the minimum pretension is 173 kN and verification requires at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN.
quiz.explanation: 7/8 in A325 最低預拉 173 kN，驗證要求 ≥ 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 7/8 in A325 bolt the minimum pretension is 173 kN and verification requires at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝前驗證試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pre-installation verification testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「螺栓張力校正器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bolt tension calibrator” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 張力校正器須在有效期限內校正，試驗由檢驗員在場觀察並記錄批號、直徑、長度、方法、工具設定與每組張力；轉角法驗證同時記錄達到最低張力所需的轉角，扭剪型與指示墊圈則記錄扭斷或間隙判定時的實際張力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The calibrator must be within its calibration period, and the inspector witnesses and records lot numbers, diameter, length, method, tool settings and each tension; for turn-of-nut also record the rotation needed to reach minimum tension, and for twist-off bolts and indicators record the actual tension at shear-off or gap acceptance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把安裝前驗證列為每一批螺栓開工前的停留點，未完成驗證的批次不得發放到工作面；太短而無法放入校正器的螺栓，應依規範採用替代的直接張力量測方法，不能直接免驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make pre-installation verification a hold point before each lot is used, with unverified lots not issued to the work face; bolts too short for the calibrator must be verified by an alternative direct-tension method allowed by the specification, never simply exempted.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若省略安裝前驗證，某批扭剪型螺栓因螺帽潤滑不足，在尾端扭斷時張力只有規定值的七到八成，整座建築數千支螺栓都不足，直到事後抽查才發現，補救需要逐支更換。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping verification can let a lot of twist-off bolts with dry nuts shear at only seventy to eighty percent of required tension, leaving thousands of bolts across a building short until an after-the-fact audit finds them, with bolt-by-bolt replacement as the remedy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 張力校正器須在有效期限內校正，試驗由檢驗員在場觀察並記錄批號、直徑、長度、方法、工具設定與每組張力；轉角法驗證同時記錄達到最低張力所需的轉角，扭剪型與指示墊圈則記錄扭斷或間隙判定時的實際張力。
knowledge.textEn: The calibrator must be within its calibration period, and the inspector witnesses and records lot numbers, diameter, length, method, tool settings and each tension; for turn-of-nut also record the rotation needed to reach minimum tension, and for twist-off bolts and indicators record the actual tension at shear-off or gap acceptance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把安裝前驗證列為每一批螺栓開工前的停留點，未完成驗證的批次不得發放到工作面；太短而無法放入校正器的螺栓，應依規範採用替代的直接張力量測方法，不能直接免驗。
knowledge.textEn: Make pre-installation verification a hold point before each lot is used, with unverified lots not issued to the work face; bolts too short for the calibrator must be verified by an alternative direct-tension method allowed by the specification, never simply exempted.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝前驗證試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pre-installation verification testing"?
options: 張力校正器須在有效期限內校正，試驗由檢驗員在場觀察並記錄批號、直徑、長度、方法、工具設定與每組張力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。
optionsEn: The calibrator must be within its calibration period, and the inspector witnesses and records lot numbers, diameter, length, method, tool settings and each tension.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An extra coat of paint on faying surfaces protects the steel and has no effect on a slip-critical joint.
quiz.explanation: 張力校正器須在有效期限內校正，試驗由檢驗員在場觀察並記錄批號、直徑、長度、方法、工具設定與每組張力；轉角法驗證同時記錄達到最低張力所需的轉角，扭剪型與指示墊圈則記錄扭斷或間隙判定時的實際張力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安裝前驗證試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pre-installation verification testing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「螺栓張力校正器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bolt tension calibrator” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若省略安裝前驗證，某批扭剪型螺栓因螺帽潤滑不足，在尾端扭斷時張力只有規定值的七到八成，整座建築數千支螺栓都不足，直到事後抽查才發現，補救需要逐支更換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping verification can let a lot of twist-off bolts with dry nuts shear at only seventy to eighty percent of required tension, leaving thousands of bolts across a building short until an after-the-fact audit finds them, with bolt-by-bolt replacement as the remedy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗證要在每一批、每一種直徑與長度組合開工時進行。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Verification is done at the start of work for every lot and every diameter and length combination.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若省略安裝前驗證，某批扭剪型螺栓因螺帽潤滑不足，在尾端扭斷時張力只有規定值的七到八成，整座建築數千支螺栓都不足，直到事後抽查才發現，補救需要逐支更換。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝前驗證試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pre-installation verification testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若省略安裝前驗證，某批扭剪型螺栓因螺帽潤滑不足，在尾端扭斷時張力只有規定值的七到八成，整座建築數千支螺栓都不足，直到事後抽查才發現，補救需要逐支更換。
完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Skipping verification can let a lot of twist-off bolts with dry nuts shear at only seventy to eighty percent of required tension, leaving thousands of bolts across a building short until an after-the-fact audit finds them, with bolt-by-bolt replacement as the remedy.
A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately.
quiz.explanation: 若省略安裝前驗證，某批扭剪型螺栓因螺帽潤滑不足，在尾端扭斷時張力只有規定值的七到八成，整座建築數千支螺栓都不足，直到事後抽查才發現，補救需要逐支更換。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping verification can let a lot of twist-off bolts with dry nuts shear at only seventy to eighty percent of required tension, leaving thousands of bolts across a building short until an after-the-fact audit finds them, with bolt-by-bolt replacement as the remedy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工後檢驗與爭議稽核：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-installation inspection and arbitration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「稽查扭力與標記檢查」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arbitration torque and mark checks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預拉螺栓完成後無法直接看出張力，因此檢驗重點在於觀察過程：檢驗員觀察安裝前驗證，並定期觀察鐵工是否依程序密貼、標記與鎖緊，最後檢查轉角標記、扭斷尾端或指示墊圈間隙。若對已安裝螺栓有疑問，可用稽查扭力法：先以同批組件在校正器中求出達到規定張力所需的扭力，再以校正過的扭力扳手檢查現場螺栓是否在該扭力下不再轉動；RCSC 2025 年版新增稽查用扭力扳手的校正要求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「稽查扭力與標記檢查」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Because pretension cannot be seen once a bolt is installed, inspection focuses on observing the process: the inspector witnesses pre-installation verification, periodically watches crews snug, mark and tighten by procedure, and finally checks match marks, sheared splines or indicator gaps. Where installed bolts are in dispute, arbitration torque is used: the torque needed to reach specified tension is found for same-lot assemblies in the calibrator, then a calibrated torque wrench checks whether field bolts resist turning at that torque; the 2025 RCSC edition adds calibration requirements for the arbitration torque wrench. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Arbitration torque and mark checks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：扭力—張力近似 T = K·D·F。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Torque–tension is approximated by T = K·D·F.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「稽查扭力與標記檢查」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Arbitration torque and mark checks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Where installed bolts are in dispute, arbitration torque is used: the torque needed to reach specified tension is found for same-lot assemblies in the calibrator, then a calibrated torque wrench checks whether field bolts resist turning at that torque; the 2025 RCSC edition adds calibration requirements for the arbitration torque wrench.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「施工後檢驗與爭議稽核」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-installation inspection and arbitration" is correct?
options: 完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。
鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。
預拉螺栓完成後無法直接看出張力，因此檢驗重點在於觀察過程：檢驗員觀察安裝前驗證，並定期觀察鐵工是否依程序密貼、標記與鎖緊，最後檢查轉角標記、扭斷尾端或指示墊圈間隙。
optionsEn: A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately.
A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening.

Because pretension cannot be seen once a bolt is installed, inspection focuses on observing the process: the inspector witnesses pre-installation verification, periodically watches crews snug, mark and tighten by procedure, and finally checks match marks, sheared splines or indicator gaps.
quiz.explanation: 預拉螺栓完成後無法直接看出張力，因此檢驗重點在於觀察過程：檢驗員觀察安裝前驗證，並定期觀察鐵工是否依程序密貼、標記與鎖緊，最後檢查轉角標記、扭斷尾端或指示墊圈間隙。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Because pretension cannot be seen once a bolt is installed, inspection focuses on observing the process: the inspector witnesses pre-installation verification, periodically watches crews snug, mark and tighten by procedure, and finally checks match marks, sheared splines or indicator gaps. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工後檢驗與爭議稽核：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-installation inspection and arbitration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「稽查扭力與標記檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arbitration torque and mark checks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：扭力—張力近似 T = K·D·F。以同批組件校正得 K = 0.20、D = 22.2 mm、目標 F = 182 kN：稽查扭力 T = 0.20×0.0222×182,000 ≈ 808 N·m。若潤滑改變使 K 落在 0.12 至 0.30，同樣扭力對應的張力差約 2.5 倍，這說明扭力只適合作為同批比較，而不能用來安裝。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Torque–tension is approximated by T = K·D·F. Calibrating same-lot assemblies gives K = 0.20, with D = 22.2 mm and target F = 182 kN, so the arbitration torque is T = 0.20×0.0222×182,000 ≈ 808 N·m. If lubrication shifts K anywhere from 0.12 to 0.30, the same torque implies tensions differing by a factor of 2.5, which is why torque suits same-lot comparison only, not installation. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：稽核時依規範抽取每個接頭一定數量的螺栓，以稽查扭力檢查螺帽是否轉動，若有不合格則擴大抽查到整個接頭並重新鎖緊；所有檢查結果記錄接頭編號、日期、扳手編號與校正紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For arbitration, sample the specified number of bolts in each joint and check whether nuts turn at the arbitration torque; if any fail, extend to the whole joint and retighten, and record joint number, date, wrench number and calibration record for every check.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 扭力—張力近似 T = K·D·F。以同批組件校正得 K = 0.20、D = 22.2 mm、目標 F = 182 kN：稽查扭力 T = 0.20×0.0222×182,000 ≈ 808 N·m。若潤滑改變使 K 落在 0.12 至 0.30，同樣扭力對應的張力差約 2.5 倍，這說明扭力只適合作為同批比較，而不能用來安裝。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Torque–tension is approximated by T = K·D·F. Calibrating same-lot assemblies gives K = 0.20, with D = 22.2 mm and target F = 182 kN, so the arbitration torque is T = 0.20×0.0222×182,000 ≈ 808 N·m. If lubrication shifts K anywhere from 0.12 to 0.30, the same torque implies tensions differing by a factor of 2.5, which is why torque suits same-lot comparison only, not installation. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工後檢驗與爭議稽核」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-installation inspection and arbitration", which statement holds?
options: 扭力—張力近似 T = K·D·F。
摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。
螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。
optionsEn: Torque–tension is approximated by T = K·D·F.
A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength.
The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest.
quiz.explanation: 扭力—張力近似 T = K·D·F。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Torque–tension is approximated by T = K·D·F. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工後檢驗與爭議稽核：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-installation inspection and arbitration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「稽查扭力與標記檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arbitration torque and mark checks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 稽核時依規範抽取每個接頭一定數量的螺栓，以稽查扭力檢查螺帽是否轉動，若有不合格則擴大抽查到整個接頭並重新鎖緊；所有檢查結果記錄接頭編號、日期、扳手編號與校正紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For arbitration, sample the specified number of bolts in each joint and check whether nuts turn at the arbitration torque; if any fail, extend to the whole joint and retighten, and record joint number, date, wrench number and calibration record for every check. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢驗計畫要把觀察安裝前驗證與施工中鎖緊列為主要檢驗手段，完工後的稽查扭力只用於爭議處理；稽查扭力扳手須有校正紀錄，判定規則與擴大抽查方式須事先在合約中約定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection plan should make witnessing verification and in-process tightening the primary means, reserving post-installation arbitration torque for disputes; the arbitration wrench must have calibration records, and acceptance and escalation rules must be agreed in the contract beforehand.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若檢驗員只在完工後抽查扭力而沒有觀察安裝過程，且稽查扭力未以同批組件校正，量到的結果可能把合格的轉角法螺栓判為不合格，或把未預拉的螺栓判為合格，引發不必要的爭議或留下隱患。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If inspectors only spot-check torque after completion without observing installation, and the arbitration torque was not calibrated on same-lot assemblies, they may reject good turn-of-nut bolts or accept bolts never pretensioned, creating needless disputes or hidden risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 稽核時依規範抽取每個接頭一定數量的螺栓，以稽查扭力檢查螺帽是否轉動，若有不合格則擴大抽查到整個接頭並重新鎖緊；所有檢查結果記錄接頭編號、日期、扳手編號與校正紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: For arbitration, sample the specified number of bolts in each joint and check whether nuts turn at the arbitration torque; if any fail, extend to the whole joint and retighten, and record joint number, date, wrench number and calibration record for every check.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 檢驗計畫要把觀察安裝前驗證與施工中鎖緊列為主要檢驗手段，完工後的稽查扭力只用於爭議處理；稽查扭力扳手須有校正紀錄，判定規則與擴大抽查方式須事先在合約中約定。
knowledge.textEn: The inspection plan should make witnessing verification and in-process tightening the primary means, reserving post-installation arbitration torque for disputes; the arbitration wrench must have calibration records, and acceptance and escalation rules must be agreed in the contract beforehand.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工後檢驗與爭議稽核」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-installation inspection and arbitration"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
稽核時依規範抽取每個接頭一定數量的螺栓，以稽查扭力檢查螺帽是否轉動，若有不合格則擴大抽查到整個接頭並重新鎖緊。
每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
For arbitration, sample the specified number of bolts in each joint and check whether nuts turn at the arbitration torque.
Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned.
quiz.explanation: 稽核時依規範抽取每個接頭一定數量的螺栓，以稽查扭力檢查螺帽是否轉動，若有不合格則擴大抽查到整個接頭並重新鎖緊；所有檢查結果記錄接頭編號、日期、扳手編號與校正紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For arbitration, sample the specified number of bolts in each joint and check whether nuts turn at the arbitration torque; if any fail, extend to the whole joint and retighten, and record joint number, date, wrench number and calibration record for every check. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工後檢驗與爭議稽核：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-installation inspection and arbitration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「稽查扭力與標記檢查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arbitration torque and mark checks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若檢驗員只在完工後抽查扭力而沒有觀察安裝過程，且稽查扭力未以同批組件校正，量到的結果可能把合格的轉角法螺栓判為不合格，或把未預拉的螺栓判為合格，引發不必要的爭議或留下隱患。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If inspectors only spot-check torque after completion without observing installation, and the arbitration torque was not calibrated on same-lot assemblies, they may reject good turn-of-nut bolts or accept bolts never pretensioned, creating needless disputes or hidden risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若對已安裝螺栓有疑問，可用稽查扭力法：先以同批組件在校正器中求出達到規定張力所需的扭力，再以校正過的扭力扳手檢查現場螺栓是否在該扭力下不再轉動；RCSC 2025 年版新增稽查用扭力扳手的校正要求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Where installed bolts are in dispute, arbitration torque is used: the torque needed to reach specified tension is found for same-lot assemblies in the calibrator, then a calibrated torque wrench checks whether field bolts resist turning at that torque; the 2025 RCSC edition adds calibration requirements for the arbitration torque wrench.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完工後用扭力扳手抽查，就能準確知道每支螺栓的預拉力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A torque-wrench spot check after completion tells the pretension of each bolt accurately." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若檢驗員只在完工後抽查扭力而沒有觀察安裝過程，且稽查扭力未以同批組件校正，量到的結果可能把合格的轉角法螺栓判為不合格，或把未預拉的螺栓判為合格，引發不必要的爭議或留下隱患。
knowledge.textEn: If inspectors only spot-check torque after completion without observing installation, and the arbitration torque was not calibrated on same-lot assemblies, they may reject good turn-of-nut bolts or accept bolts never pretensioned, creating needless disputes or hidden risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工後檢驗與爭議稽核」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-installation inspection and arbitration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。
若檢驗員只在完工後抽查扭力而沒有觀察安裝過程，且稽查扭力未以同批組件校正，量到的結果可能把合格的轉角法螺栓判為不合格，或把未預拉的螺栓判為合格，引發不必要的爭議或留下隱患。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening.

If inspectors only spot-check torque after completion without observing installation, and the arbitration torque was not calibrated on same-lot assemblies, they may reject good turn-of-nut bolts or accept bolts never pretensioned, creating needless disputes or hidden risk.
quiz.explanation: 若檢驗員只在完工後抽查扭力而沒有觀察安裝過程，且稽查扭力未以同批組件校正，量到的結果可能把合格的轉角法螺栓判為不合格，或把未預拉的螺栓判為合格，引發不必要的爭議或留下隱患。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If inspectors only spot-check torque after completion without observing installation, and the arbitration torque was not calibrated on same-lot assemblies, they may reject good turn-of-nut bolts or accept bolts never pretensioned, creating needless disputes or hidden risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊」與「螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening" and "Bolting records, traceability and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pretension relaxation and corrosion” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預拉力在使用期間會因為幾個原因下降：螺紋與承壓面的局部嵌入、接觸面厚塗層的潛變、鍍鋅層的蠕變、腐蝕減少有效截面，以及反覆振動造成的鬆動。由於螺栓的軸向勁度很高，被夾區域只要縮短百分之幾毫米，夾緊力就明顯下降。高強度螺栓還可能因環境氫或腐蝕反應而延遲斷裂。維護時常見的問題是是否可以重新鎖緊：A490 與鍍鋅的 A325 螺栓不得重複使用，鬆動的螺栓通常應更換而非直接回鎖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pretension declines in service for several reasons: local embedment at threads and bearing faces, creep of thick coatings on faying surfaces, creep of galvanized layers, corrosion reducing the effective section, and loosening under repeated vibration. Because a bolt is axially very stiff, the clamped zone need only shorten by hundredths of a millimetre for clamp force to drop noticeably. High-strength bolts may also suffer delayed fracture from environmental hydrogen or corrosion reactions. A common maintenance question is whether bolts may be retightened: A490 and galvanized A325 bolts must not be reused, and loose bolts are usually replaced rather than simply retightened. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pretension relaxation and corrosion” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：螺栓軸向勁度 k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm（N/mm 換算）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Bolt axial stiffness k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pretension relaxation and corrosion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊
knowledge.text: 預拉力在使用期間會因為幾個原因下降：螺紋與承壓面的局部嵌入、接觸面厚塗層的潛變、鍍鋅層的蠕變、腐蝕減少有效截面，以及反覆振動造成的鬆動。由於螺栓的軸向勁度很高，被夾區域只要縮短百分之幾毫米，夾緊力就明顯下降。
knowledge.textEn: Pretension declines in service for several reasons: local embedment at threads and bearing faces, creep of thick coatings on faying surfaces, creep of galvanized layers, corrosion reducing the effective section, and loosening under repeated vibration. Because a bolt is axially very stiff, the clamped zone need only shorten by hundredths of a millimetre for clamp force to drop noticeably.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening" is correct?
options: 預拉力在使用期間會因為幾個原因下降：螺紋與承壓面的局部嵌入、接觸面厚塗層的潛變、鍍鋅層的蠕變、腐蝕減少有效截面，以及反覆振動造成的鬆動。
鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。
螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。
optionsEn: Pretension declines in service for several reasons: local embedment at threads and bearing faces, creep of thick coatings on faying surfaces, creep of galvanized layers, corrosion reducing the effective section, and loosening under repeated vibration.
A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening.
Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 預拉力在使用期間會因為幾個原因下降：螺紋與承壓面的局部嵌入、接觸面厚塗層的潛變、鍍鋅層的蠕變、腐蝕減少有效截面，以及反覆振動造成的鬆動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pretension declines in service for several reasons: local embedment at threads and bearing faces, creep of thick coatings on faying surfaces, creep of galvanized layers, corrosion reducing the effective section, and loosening under repeated vibration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pretension relaxation and corrosion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：螺栓軸向勁度 k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm（N/mm 換算）。若接觸面塗層潛變使夾緊長度縮短 0.02 mm，預拉力損失 ΔT = k_b·δ ≈ 851×0.02 ≈ 17 kN，約為 173 kN 的 10%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Bolt axial stiffness k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm. If faying-coating creep shortens the clamped length by 0.02 mm, pretension falls by ΔT = k_b·δ ≈ 851×0.02 ≈ 17 kN, about 10% of 173 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期檢查時以目視與敲擊找出鬆動、缺失或腐蝕的螺栓，關鍵接頭可抽樣以超音波螺栓伸長量測或稽查扭力確認夾緊力；接觸面塗層的潛變特性應在塗層滑動試驗中一併評估，選用通過潛變試驗的產品。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At periodic inspections, find loose, missing or corroded bolts visually and by tapping, and on critical joints sample clamp force by ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement or arbitration torque; assess creep of faying coatings as part of the coating slip test and select products that pass the creep test.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 螺栓軸向勁度 k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm（N/mm 換算）。若接觸面塗層潛變使夾緊長度縮短 0.02 mm，預拉力損失 ΔT = k_b·δ ≈ 851×0.02 ≈ 17 kN，約為 173 kN 的 10%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Bolt axial stiffness k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm. If faying-coating creep shortens the clamped length by 0.02 mm, pretension falls by ΔT = k_b·δ ≈ 851×0.02 ≈ 17 kN, about 10% of 173 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening", which statement holds?
options: 外加拉力會全部直接加到預拉螺栓上，所以預拉沒有好處。
螺栓軸向勁度 k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm（N/mm 換算）。
接觸面多塗一層油漆可以保護鋼材，對摩擦型接頭沒有影響。
optionsEn: Any applied tension adds directly to a pretensioned bolt, so pretension gives no benefit.
Bolt axial stiffness k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm.
An extra coat of paint on faying surfaces protects the steel and has no effect on a slip-critical joint.
quiz.explanation: 螺栓軸向勁度 k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm（N/mm 換算）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Bolt axial stiffness k_b = E·A/L = 200,000×298/70 ≈ 851 kN/mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pretension relaxation and corrosion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期檢查時以目視與敲擊找出鬆動、缺失或腐蝕的螺栓，關鍵接頭可抽樣以超音波螺栓伸長量測或稽查扭力確認夾緊力；接觸面塗層的潛變特性應在塗層滑動試驗中一併評估，選用通過潛變試驗的產品。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At periodic inspections, find loose, missing or corroded bolts visually and by tapping, and on critical joints sample clamp force by ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement or arbitration torque; assess creep of faying coatings as part of the coating slip test and select products that pass the creep test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊應規定鬆動、缺失或腐蝕螺栓的處理：同時更換螺栓、螺帽與墊圈，依原規格重新驗證與預拉，並確認接觸面狀態；一次更換一支，避免整個接頭同時失去夾緊，必要時由結構工程師指定更換順序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual should set rules for loose, missing or corroded bolts: replace bolt, nut and washer together, re-verify and pretension to the original specification and check the faying surface; replace one bolt at a time so the joint never loses all its clamp, with the structural engineer setting the sequence where needed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在接觸面使用未經滑動與潛變試驗的厚塗層，接頭完工時預拉力合格，數年後夾緊力流失，摩擦型接頭在強風或地震時滑動；海邊環境的螺栓頭與螺紋腐蝕，也可能在檢查前就失去大部分截面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a thick faying coating never tested for slip and creep leaves pretension correct at completion but lost within a few years, so the slip-critical joint slips in a storm or earthquake; in a marine setting, corrosion of bolt heads and threads can remove most of the section before anyone inspects it. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期檢查時以目視與敲擊找出鬆動、缺失或腐蝕的螺栓，關鍵接頭可抽樣以超音波螺栓伸長量測或稽查扭力確認夾緊力；接觸面塗層的潛變特性應在塗層滑動試驗中一併評估，選用通過潛變試驗的產品。
knowledge.textEn: At periodic inspections, find loose, missing or corroded bolts visually and by tapping, and on critical joints sample clamp force by ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement or arbitration torque; assess creep of faying coatings as part of the coating slip test and select products that pass the creep test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護手冊應規定鬆動、缺失或腐蝕螺栓的處理：同時更換螺栓、螺帽與墊圈，依原規格重新驗證與預拉，並確認接觸面狀態；一次更換一支，避免整個接頭同時失去夾緊，必要時由結構工程師指定更換順序。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance manual should set rules for loose, missing or corroded bolts: replace bolt, nut and washer together, re-verify and pretension to the original specification and check the faying surface; replace one bolt at a time so the joint never loses all its clamp, with the structural engineer setting the sequence where needed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要用扭力扳手鎖到規定扭力，就能精確得到設計預拉力。
定期檢查時以目視與敲擊找出鬆動、缺失或腐蝕的螺栓，關鍵接頭可抽樣以超音波螺栓伸長量測或稽查扭力確認夾緊力。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Tightening to a specified torque with a torque wrench gives the design pretension precisely.
At periodic inspections, find loose, missing or corroded bolts visually and by tapping, and on critical joints sample clamp force by ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement or arbitration torque.
quiz.explanation: 定期檢查時以目視與敲擊找出鬆動、缺失或腐蝕的螺栓，關鍵接頭可抽樣以超音波螺栓伸長量測或稽查扭力確認夾緊力；接觸面塗層的潛變特性應在塗層滑動試驗中一併評估，選用通過潛變試驗的產品。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At periodic inspections, find loose, missing or corroded bolts visually and by tapping, and on critical joints sample clamp force by ultrasonic bolt-elongation measurement or arbitration torque; assess creep of faying coatings as part of the coating slip test and select products that pass the creep test. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預拉力鬆弛與腐蝕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pretension relaxation and corrosion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在接觸面使用未經滑動與潛變試驗的厚塗層，接頭完工時預拉力合格，數年後夾緊力流失，摩擦型接頭在強風或地震時滑動；海邊環境的螺栓頭與螺紋腐蝕，也可能在檢查前就失去大部分截面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a thick faying coating never tested for slip and creep leaves pretension correct at completion but lost within a few years, so the slip-critical joint slips in a storm or earthquake; in a marine setting, corrosion of bolt heads and threads can remove most of the section before anyone inspects it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：維護時常見的問題是是否可以重新鎖緊：A490 與鍍鋅的 A325 螺栓不得重複使用，鬆動的螺栓通常應更換而非直接回鎖。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A common maintenance question is whether bolts may be retightened: A490 and galvanized A325 bolts must not be reused, and loose bolts are usually replaced rather than simply retightened.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鬆掉的高強度螺栓只要再鎖緊就能恢復原本性能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A loosened high-strength bolt regains full performance simply by retightening." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在接觸面使用未經滑動與潛變試驗的厚塗層，接頭完工時預拉力合格，數年後夾緊力流失，摩擦型接頭在強風或地震時滑動；海邊環境的螺栓頭與螺紋腐蝕，也可能在檢查前就失去大部分截面。
knowledge.textEn: Using a thick faying coating never tested for slip and creep leaves pretension correct at completion but lost within a few years, so the slip-critical joint slips in a storm or earthquake; in a marine setting, corrosion of bolt heads and threads can remove most of the section before anyone inspects it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期鬆弛、腐蝕與再鎖緊」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term relaxation, corrosion and retightening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在接觸面使用未經滑動與潛變試驗的厚塗層，接頭完工時預拉力合格，數年後夾緊力流失，摩擦型接頭在強風或地震時滑動。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。
optionsEn: Using a thick faying coating never tested for slip and creep leaves pretension correct at completion but lost within a few years, so the slip-critical joint slips in a storm or earthquake.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 在接觸面使用未經滑動與潛變試驗的厚塗層，接頭完工時預拉力合格，數年後夾緊力流失，摩擦型接頭在強風或地震時滑動；海邊環境的螺栓頭與螺紋腐蝕，也可能在檢查前就失去大部分截面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a thick faying coating never tested for slip and creep leaves pretension correct at completion but lost within a few years, so the slip-critical joint slips in a storm or earthquake; in a marine setting, corrosion of bolt heads and threads can remove most of the section before anyone inspects it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bolting records, traceability and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」如何影響高強度螺栓預拉力施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lots, verification records and bolt map” governs force, deformation or durability in “Pretensioning of high-strength structural bolts”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鉚接時代的接頭一旦完成就幾乎無法調整，雪梨港灣大橋以約六百萬支手工鉚釘接合，最大的一支重 3.5 kg、長 39.5 cm；高強度螺栓接頭則可以檢查、更換與重新預拉，但前提是紀錄完整。交接文件要讓維護人員知道：哪些接頭是摩擦型或預拉型、使用哪個等級與批號、採用何種預拉方法、安裝前驗證與稽核結果、曾經有哪些不符合項目與更換。沒有這些紀錄，任何一支斷裂螺栓都無法判斷是單一事件還是整批問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Riveted joints were practically unadjustable once made, and Sydney Harbour Bridge is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets, the largest weighing 3.5 kg and 39.5 cm long; high-strength bolted joints can be inspected, replaced and re-pretensioned, but only if the records are complete. Handover documents must tell maintainers which joints are slip-critical or pretensioned, which grade and lot was used, which pretensioning method, the verification and audit results, and any nonconformances and replacements. Without these records, nobody can tell whether a broken bolt is an isolated event or a lot-wide problem. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lots, verification records and bolt map” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若隨機有 0.5% 螺栓預拉不足，一個 8 支螺栓的接頭至少有一支不足的機率 = 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%；全結構 1,500 個接頭約有 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 個接頭含不足螺栓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If 0.5% of bolts are randomly under-tensioned, the chance that an 8-bolt joint has at least one is 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%; across 1,500 joints, about 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 joints contain a deficient bolt.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lots, verification records and bolt map”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接
knowledge.text: 鉚接時代的接頭一旦完成就幾乎無法調整，雪梨港灣大橋以約六百萬支手工鉚釘接合，最大的一支重 3.5 kg、長 39.5 cm；高強度螺栓接頭則可以檢查、更換與重新預拉，但前提是紀錄完整。交接文件要讓維護人員知道：哪些接頭是摩擦型或預拉型、使用哪個等級與批號、採用何種預拉方法、安裝前驗證與稽核結果、曾經有哪些不符合項目與更換。
knowledge.textEn: Riveted joints were practically unadjustable once made, and Sydney Harbour Bridge is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets, the largest weighing 3.5 kg and 39.5 cm long; high-strength bolted joints can be inspected, replaced and re-pretensioned, but only if the records are complete. Handover documents must tell maintainers which joints are slip-critical or pretensioned, which grade and lot was used, which pretensioning method, the verification and audit results, and any nonconformances and replacements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bolting records, traceability and handover" is correct?
options: 螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。
鉚接時代的接頭一旦完成就幾乎無法調整，雪梨港灣大橋以約六百萬支手工鉚釘接合，最大的一支重 3.5 kg、長 39.5 cm。
摩擦型接頭的強度主要來自螺栓的剪力強度。
optionsEn: Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept.
Riveted joints were practically unadjustable once made, and Sydney Harbour Bridge is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets, the largest weighing 3.5 kg and 39.5 cm long.
A slip-critical joint gets its strength mainly from the bolts' shear strength.
quiz.explanation: 鉚接時代的接頭一旦完成就幾乎無法調整，雪梨港灣大橋以約六百萬支手工鉚釘接合，最大的一支重 3.5 kg、長 39.5 cm；高強度螺栓接頭則可以檢查、更換與重新預拉，但前提是紀錄完整。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Riveted joints were practically unadjustable once made, and Sydney Harbour Bridge is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets, the largest weighing 3.5 kg and 39.5 cm long; high-strength bolted joints can be inspected, replaced and re-pretensioned, but only if the records are complete. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bolting records, traceability and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lots, verification records and bolt map” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若隨機有 0.5% 螺栓預拉不足，一個 8 支螺栓的接頭至少有一支不足的機率 = 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%；全結構 1,500 個接頭約有 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 個接頭含不足螺栓。這說明稽核抽樣應以接頭為單位，並以批號紀錄追查集中問題。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If 0.5% of bolts are randomly under-tensioned, the chance that an 8-bolt joint has at least one is 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%; across 1,500 joints, about 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 joints contain a deficient bolt. Audit samples should therefore be drawn by joint, with lot records used to trace clustered problems. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前抽查數個接頭，從現場螺栓的等級標記追溯到進料批號、出廠證明、安裝前驗證紀錄與檢驗報告，確認紀錄鏈完整；並確認螺栓配置圖標示所有摩擦型接頭、接觸面等級與曾經更換的位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, sample several joints and trace bolt grade markings back to delivery lots, mill certificates, verification records and inspection reports to confirm an unbroken chain; confirm that the bolt layout drawing marks every slip-critical joint, its faying-surface class and every replaced location.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若隨機有 0.5% 螺栓預拉不足，一個 8 支螺栓的接頭至少有一支不足的機率 = 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%；全結構 1,500 個接頭約有 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 個接頭含不足螺栓。這說明稽核抽樣應以接頭為單位，並以批號紀錄追查集中問題。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If 0.5% of bolts are randomly under-tensioned, the chance that an 8-bolt joint has at least one is 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%; across 1,500 joints, about 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 joints contain a deficient bolt. Audit samples should therefore be drawn by joint, with lot records used to trace clustered problems. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bolting records, traceability and handover", which statement holds?
options: 螺栓強度越高越好，選用最高等級一定最安全。
每支螺栓只要鎖一次到規定值，整個接頭就一定達到預拉力。
若隨機有 0.5% 螺栓預拉不足，一個 8 支螺栓的接頭至少有一支不足的機率 = 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%。
optionsEn: The stronger the bolt the better, so the highest grade is always safest.
Tightening each bolt once to the specified value guarantees the whole joint is pretensioned.
If 0.5% of bolts are randomly under-tensioned, the chance that an 8-bolt joint has at least one is 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%.
quiz.explanation: 若隨機有 0.5% 螺栓預拉不足，一個 8 支螺栓的接頭至少有一支不足的機率 = 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%；全結構 1,500 個接頭約有 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 個接頭含不足螺栓。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If 0.5% of bolts are randomly under-tensioned, the chance that an 8-bolt joint has at least one is 1 − 0.995⁸ ≈ 3.9%; across 1,500 joints, about 1,500×0.039 ≈ 59 joints contain a deficient bolt. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bolting records, traceability and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lots, verification records and bolt map” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前抽查數個接頭，從現場螺栓的等級標記追溯到進料批號、出廠證明、安裝前驗證紀錄與檢驗報告，確認紀錄鏈完整；並確認螺栓配置圖標示所有摩擦型接頭、接觸面等級與曾經更換的位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, sample several joints and trace bolt grade markings back to delivery lots, mill certificates, verification records and inspection reports to confirm an unbroken chain; confirm that the bolt layout drawing marks every slip-critical joint, its faying-surface class and every replaced location. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約應要求以數位格式交付螺栓批號與使用位置對照、安裝前驗證與稽核紀錄、不符合項目處理與螺栓配置圖；業主的維護手冊要列出關鍵受拉與摩擦型接頭的檢查週期，並指定由誰判定是否需要更換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The contract should require digital delivery of lot-to-location records, verification and audit records, nonconformance dispositions and the bolt layout drawing; the owner's maintenance manual should list inspection intervals for critical tension and slip-critical joints and name who decides on replacement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接時只留下「螺栓已依規範施工」的結論，多年後在某接頭發現延遲斷裂的螺栓，業主無法知道同批螺栓還用在哪裡，只能全面檢查或大量更換，成本與停用時間都大幅增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If handover leaves only a statement that bolting met the specification, an owner who finds a delayed-fracture bolt years later cannot know where else that lot was used and must inspect or replace across the structure, at much greater cost and downtime. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前抽查數個接頭，從現場螺栓的等級標記追溯到進料批號、出廠證明、安裝前驗證紀錄與檢驗報告，確認紀錄鏈完整；並確認螺栓配置圖標示所有摩擦型接頭、接觸面等級與曾經更換的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, sample several joints and trace bolt grade markings back to delivery lots, mill certificates, verification records and inspection reports to confirm an unbroken chain; confirm that the bolt layout drawing marks every slip-critical joint, its faying-surface class and every replaced location.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約應要求以數位格式交付螺栓批號與使用位置對照、安裝前驗證與稽核紀錄、不符合項目處理與螺栓配置圖；業主的維護手冊要列出關鍵受拉與摩擦型接頭的檢查週期，並指定由誰判定是否需要更換。
knowledge.textEn: The contract should require digital delivery of lot-to-location records, verification and audit records, nonconformance dispositions and the bolt layout drawing; the owner's maintenance manual should list inspection intervals for critical tension and slip-critical joints and name who decides on replacement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bolting records, traceability and handover"?
options: 交接前抽查數個接頭，從現場螺栓的等級標記追溯到進料批號、出廠證明、安裝前驗證紀錄與檢驗報告，確認紀錄鏈完整。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
出廠證明合格的螺栓，在現場就一定能鎖到規定預拉力。
optionsEn: Before handover, sample several joints and trace bolt grade markings back to delivery lots, mill certificates, verification records and inspection reports to confirm an unbroken chain.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Bolts with passing mill certificates will always reach specified pretension on site.
quiz.explanation: 交接前抽查數個接頭，從現場螺栓的等級標記追溯到進料批號、出廠證明、安裝前驗證紀錄與檢驗報告，確認紀錄鏈完整；並確認螺栓配置圖標示所有摩擦型接頭、接觸面等級與曾經更換的位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, sample several joints and trace bolt grade markings back to delivery lots, mill certificates, verification records and inspection reports to confirm an unbroken chain; confirm that the bolt layout drawing marks every slip-critical joint, its faying-surface class and every replaced location. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bolting records, traceability and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「批號、驗證紀錄與螺栓圖」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lots, verification records and bolt map” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交接時只留下「螺栓已依規範施工」的結論，多年後在某接頭發現延遲斷裂的螺栓，業主無法知道同批螺栓還用在哪裡，只能全面檢查或大量更換，成本與停用時間都大幅增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If handover leaves only a statement that bolting met the specification, an owner who finds a delayed-fracture bolt years later cannot know where else that lot was used and must inspect or replace across the structure, at much greater cost and downtime. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沒有這些紀錄，任何一支斷裂螺栓都無法判斷是單一事件還是整批問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without these records, nobody can tell whether a broken bolt is an isolated event or a lot-wide problem.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「螺栓接頭完工檢查合格後，就不需要保存批號與驗證紀錄。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once bolted joints pass inspection, lot and verification records need not be kept." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

courses.title: 組合樓板剪力釘焊接
courses.titleEn: Stud welding for composite floor systems
courses.summary: 從組合梁介面的水平剪力流與部分組合出發，說明頭釘強度與壓型鋼板肋的折減、穿板焊接的電流與環境條件、首件 30° 彎曲試驗與外觀檢查、推出試驗求取剪力釘強度，以及火災溫度效應與改修時的紀錄需求，並以 NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓組合樓板的調查、雙子塔以桁架「指節」取得組合作用的樓板，以及英國鋼結構協會對穿板焊接的說明為依據。
courses.summaryEn: Starting from horizontal shear flow and partial composite action at the beam–slab interface, explain headed-stud strength and its reduction in deck ribs, current and site conditions for through-deck welding, first-stud 30° bend tests and visual checks, push-out tests for stud resistance, and fire and thermal effects and record-keeping for alterations, drawing on NIST's investigation of the composite floors of 7 World Trade Center, the Twin Towers' floors made composite by truss knuckles, and steel-industry guidance on through-deck welding.
courses.focus: 以剪力流計算、穿板焊接條件控制、首件彎曲試驗與推出試驗，確保鋼梁與混凝土樓板真正組合受力
courses.focusEn: Making steel beams and concrete slabs truly act together through shear-flow design, control of through-deck welding, first-stud bend tests and push-out tests
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：12 m 簡支組合梁 W460×60（A_s = 7,590 mm²、F_y = 345 MPa），梁距 3 m，76 mm 高的壓型鋼板橫向鋪設、肋距 300 mm，樓板總厚 140 mm、f′c = 28 MPa，使用 19 mm 頭釘（F_u = 450 MPa）。(1) 完全組合所需剪力 C = min(7,590×345, 0.85×28×3,000×64) ≈ min(2,619, 4,570) = 2,619 kN。(2) 每肋 1 支、弱位置：Q_n = 0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN，半跨 20 個肋 ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN，組合比 58%；I_eff ≈ 255 + √0.58×(700 − 255) ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴，約為完全組合的 85%。(3) 焊後長度 125 mm，高出肋頂 49 mm，保護層 15 mm，皆滿足要求。(4) 若改變一個輸入：剪力釘全部焊在強位置（R_p = 0.75），每支約 95.7 kN，ΣQ_n ≈ 1,914 kN，組合比提高到約 73%，不必增加剪力釘數量就提高勁度與強度。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 12 m simply supported composite beam W460×60 (A_s = 7,590 mm², F_y = 345 MPa) at 3 m spacing carries a slab 140 mm thick on transverse 76 mm deck with ribs at 300 mm and f′c = 28 MPa, using 19 mm headed studs (F_u = 450 MPa). (1) Full composite shear C = min(7,590×345, 0.85×28×3,000×64) ≈ min(2,619, 4,570) = 2,619 kN. (2) One weak-position stud per rib: Q_n = 0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN, and 20 ribs per half span give ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN, a 58% ratio; I_eff ≈ 255 + √0.58×(700 − 255) ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴, about 85% of full composite. (3) The welded stud of 125 mm projects 49 mm above the rib with 15 mm of cover, both acceptable. (4) Changing one input: welding every stud in the strong position (R_p = 0.75) gives about 95.7 kN each, ΣQ_n ≈ 1,914 kN and a ratio of about 73%, raising stiffness and strength without adding studs. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「組合梁的水平剪力流」與「部分組合、勁度與使用性」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams" and "Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 組合梁的水平剪力流：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Horizontal shear flow in composite beams: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam–slab interface shear” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼梁上的混凝土樓板若只是放在梁上，兩者各自彎曲，接觸面會相對滑動；焊在上翼板的剪力釘阻止滑動，讓樓板成為受壓翼緣、鋼梁成為受拉部分，斷面像一根更深的梁，強度與勁度都大幅提高。剪力釘要傳遞的是從零彎矩點到最大彎矩點之間的水平剪力總和，等於混凝土受壓合力與鋼梁受拉合力中較小者。剪力釘數量不足時，梁只能部分組合，強度與勁度介於純鋼梁與完全組合之間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A concrete slab merely resting on a steel beam bends separately and slips along the interface; studs welded to the top flange prevent this slip so the slab becomes a compression flange and the steel a tension zone, behaving like a much deeper beam with far greater strength and stiffness. The studs must carry the total horizontal shear between the points of zero and maximum moment, equal to the smaller of the concrete compression force and the steel tension force. With too few studs, the beam is only partially composite, with strength and stiffness between those of the bare steel and full composite action. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Beam–slab interface shear” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Beam–slab interface shear”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A concrete slab merely resting on a steel beam bends separately and slips along the interface; studs welded to the top flange prevent this slip so the slab becomes a compression flange and the steel a tension zone, behaving like a much deeper beam with far greater strength and stiffness. The studs must carry the total horizontal shear between the points of zero and maximum moment, equal to the smaller of the concrete compression force and the steel tension force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「組合梁的水平剪力流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams" is correct?
options: 混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
鋼梁上的混凝土樓板若只是放在梁上，兩者各自彎曲，接觸面會相對滑動。
部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
optionsEn: A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
A concrete slab merely resting on a steel beam bends separately and slips along the interface.
Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
quiz.explanation: 鋼梁上的混凝土樓板若只是放在梁上，兩者各自彎曲，接觸面會相對滑動；焊在上翼板的剪力釘阻止滑動，讓樓板成為受壓翼緣、鋼梁成為受拉部分，斷面像一根更深的梁，強度與勁度都大幅提高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A concrete slab merely resting on a steel beam bends separately and slips along the interface; studs welded to the top flange prevent this slip so the slab becomes a compression flange and the steel a tension zone, behaving like a much deeper beam with far greater strength and stiffness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 組合梁的水平剪力流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Horizontal shear flow in composite beams: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam–slab interface shear” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c)。W460×60 鋼梁 A_s = 7,590 mm²、F_y = 345 MPa：A_s·F_y ≈ 2,619 kN；樓板有效寬 3,000 mm、肋上混凝土厚 64 mm、f′c = 28 MPa：0.85×28×3,000×64 ≈ 4,570 kN，取 C = 2,619 kN，即半跨內剪力釘須傳遞約 2,619 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c). For a W460×60 beam with A_s = 7,590 mm² and F_y = 345 MPa, A_s·F_y ≈ 2,619 kN; a slab of 3,000 mm effective width with 64 mm of concrete above the ribs and f′c = 28 MPa gives 0.85×28×3,000×64 ≈ 4,570 kN, so C = 2,619 kN, the force the studs in each half span must transfer. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計審查時核對每根組合梁的剪力釘數量、間距與分布是否滿足半跨剪力總和，並檢查集中載重或開口附近的剪力釘是否足夠；施工圖須以每根梁的剪力釘數量標示，現場以清點方式核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In design review, check that each composite beam's stud count, spacing and distribution satisfy the half-span shear total and that studs are sufficient near concentrated loads and openings; shop drawings must give the stud count for each beam, checked on site by counting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c)。W460×60 鋼梁 A_s = 7,590 mm²、F_y = 345 MPa：A_s·F_y ≈ 2,619 kN；樓板有效寬 3,000 mm、肋上混凝土厚 64 mm、f′c = 28 MPa：0.85×28×3,000×64 ≈ 4,570 kN，取 C = 2,619 kN，即半跨內剪力釘須傳遞約 2,619 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c). For a W460×60 beam with A_s = 7,590 mm² and F_y = 345 MPa, A_s·F_y ≈ 2,619 kN; a slab of 3,000 mm effective width with 64 mm of concrete above the ribs and f′c = 28 MPa gives 0.85×28×3,000×64 ≈ 4,570 kN, so C = 2,619 kN, the force the studs in each half span must transfer. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「組合梁的水平剪力流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams", which statement holds?
options: 只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。
C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c)。
optionsEn: If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.
A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded.
C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c).
quiz.explanation: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: C = min(A_s·F_y, 0.85·f′c·b·t_c). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 組合梁的水平剪力流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Horizontal shear flow in composite beams: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Beam–slab interface shear” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計審查時核對每根組合梁的剪力釘數量、間距與分布是否滿足半跨剪力總和，並檢查集中載重或開口附近的剪力釘是否足夠；施工圖須以每根梁的剪力釘數量標示，現場以清點方式核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In design review, check that each composite beam's stud count, spacing and distribution satisfy the half-span shear total and that studs are sufficient near concentrated loads and openings; shop drawings must give the stud count for each beam, checked on site by counting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構圖應在每根組合梁旁標示剪力釘數量與排列（單排、雙排、每肋支數），並註明是否為完全或部分組合；施工中若肋位與設計不符，須由結構工程師重新核算，而不是由現場自行減少。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural drawings should note stud number and arrangement (single or double row, studs per rib) beside each composite beam and say whether it is fully or partially composite; if rib positions differ from design, the structural engineer re-checks, rather than the site reducing studs on its own.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若施工時因壓型鋼板肋位不合或趕工而少焊剪力釘，梁在使用載重下仍看似正常，但撓度與振動比設計大，極限狀態下介面滑動使強度不足；事後補焊需要打除樓板，代價極高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If studs are omitted because rib positions do not match or work is rushed, the beam looks normal in service but deflects and vibrates more than designed, and at ultimate load interface slip leaves it short of strength; adding studs afterwards means breaking out the slab at great cost. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計審查時核對每根組合梁的剪力釘數量、間距與分布是否滿足半跨剪力總和，並檢查集中載重或開口附近的剪力釘是否足夠；施工圖須以每根梁的剪力釘數量標示，現場以清點方式核對。
knowledge.textEn: In design review, check that each composite beam's stud count, spacing and distribution satisfy the half-span shear total and that studs are sufficient near concentrated loads and openings; shop drawings must give the stud count for each beam, checked on site by counting.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構圖應在每根組合梁旁標示剪力釘數量與排列（單排、雙排、每肋支數），並註明是否為完全或部分組合；施工中若肋位與設計不符，須由結構工程師重新核算，而不是由現場自行減少。
knowledge.textEn: Structural drawings should note stud number and arrangement (single or double row, studs per rib) beside each composite beam and say whether it is fully or partially composite; if rib positions differ from design, the structural engineer re-checks, rather than the site reducing studs on its own.

quiz.question: 要驗證「組合梁的水平剪力流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams"?
options: 設計審查時核對每根組合梁的剪力釘數量、間距與分布是否滿足半跨剪力總和，並檢查集中載重或開口附近的剪力釘是否足夠。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
optionsEn: In design review, check that each composite beam's stud count, spacing and distribution satisfy the half-span shear total and that studs are sufficient near concentrated loads and openings.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
quiz.explanation: 設計審查時核對每根組合梁的剪力釘數量、間距與分布是否滿足半跨剪力總和，並檢查集中載重或開口附近的剪力釘是否足夠；施工圖須以每根梁的剪力釘數量標示，現場以清點方式核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In design review, check that each composite beam's stud count, spacing and distribution satisfy the half-span shear total and that studs are sufficient near concentrated loads and openings; shop drawings must give the stud count for each beam, checked on site by counting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 組合梁的水平剪力流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Horizontal shear flow in composite beams: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼梁與樓板介面剪力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Beam–slab interface shear” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若施工時因壓型鋼板肋位不合或趕工而少焊剪力釘，梁在使用載重下仍看似正常，但撓度與振動比設計大，極限狀態下介面滑動使強度不足；事後補焊需要打除樓板，代價極高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If studs are omitted because rib positions do not match or work is rushed, the beam looks normal in service but deflects and vibrates more than designed, and at ultimate load interface slip leaves it short of strength; adding studs afterwards means breaking out the slab at great cost. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：剪力釘數量不足時，梁只能部分組合，強度與勁度介於純鋼梁與完全組合之間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With too few studs, the beam is only partially composite, with strength and stiffness between those of the bare steel and full composite action.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若施工時因壓型鋼板肋位不合或趕工而少焊剪力釘，梁在使用載重下仍看似正常，但撓度與振動比設計大，極限狀態下介面滑動使強度不足；事後補焊需要打除樓板，代價極高。
