knowledge.textEn: If studs are omitted because rib positions do not match or work is rushed, the beam looks normal in service but deflects and vibrates more than designed, and at ultimate load interface slip leaves it short of strength; adding studs afterwards means breaking out the slab at great cost.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「組合梁的水平剪力流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Horizontal shear flow in composite beams" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若施工時因壓型鋼板肋位不合或趕工而少焊剪力釘，梁在使用載重下仍看似正常，但撓度與振動比設計大，極限狀態下介面滑動使強度不足；事後補焊需要打除樓板，代價極高。
部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

If studs are omitted because rib positions do not match or work is rushed, the beam looks normal in service but deflects and vibrates more than designed, and at ultimate load interface slip leaves it short of strength.
Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
quiz.explanation: 若施工時因壓型鋼板肋位不合或趕工而少焊剪力釘，梁在使用載重下仍看似正常，但撓度與振動比設計大，極限狀態下介面滑動使強度不足；事後補焊需要打除樓板，代價極高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If studs are omitted because rib positions do not match or work is rushed, the beam looks normal in service but deflects and vibrates more than designed, and at ultimate load interface slip leaves it short of strength; adding studs afterwards means breaking out the slab at great cost. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 部分組合、勁度與使用性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「組合比與有效慣性矩」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Composite ratio and effective inertia” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 實務上很多組合梁刻意設計成部分組合，因為壓型鋼板肋距限制了可焊剪力釘的位置，而強度往往不需要完全組合。部分組合時，介面有少量滑動，有效慣性矩低於完全組合的換算斷面，撓度與樓板振動因此變大。組合比（實際剪力釘總強度除以完全組合所需值）同時控制強度與勁度，太低時剪力釘會在變形能力用盡前斷裂，因此規範通常設定最低組合比。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「組合比與有效慣性矩」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In practice many composite beams are deliberately partially composite, because deck rib spacing limits where studs can go and strength often does not need full composite action. With partial composite action the interface slips slightly and the effective moment of inertia falls below that of the fully composite transformed section, so deflection and floor vibration increase. The composite ratio, total stud strength divided by that required for full action, governs both strength and stiffness; too low a ratio lets studs fracture before their deformation capacity is used, so codes usually set a minimum ratio. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Composite ratio and effective inertia” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：部分組合有效慣性矩 I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For partial composite action I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「組合比與有效慣性矩」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Composite ratio and effective inertia”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 部分組合、勁度與使用性
knowledge.titleEn: Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability
knowledge.text: 實務上很多組合梁刻意設計成部分組合，因為壓型鋼板肋距限制了可焊剪力釘的位置，而強度往往不需要完全組合。部分組合時，介面有少量滑動，有效慣性矩低於完全組合的換算斷面，撓度與樓板振動因此變大。
knowledge.textEn: In practice many composite beams are deliberately partially composite, because deck rib spacing limits where studs can go and strength often does not need full composite action. With partial composite action the interface slips slightly and the effective moment of inertia falls below that of the fully composite transformed section, so deflection and floor vibration increase.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「部分組合、勁度與使用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability" is correct?
options: 部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
實務上很多組合梁刻意設計成部分組合，因為壓型鋼板肋距限制了可焊剪力釘的位置，而強度往往不需要完全組合。
optionsEn: Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
In practice many composite beams are deliberately partially composite, because deck rib spacing limits where studs can go and strength often does not need full composite action.
quiz.explanation: 實務上很多組合梁刻意設計成部分組合，因為壓型鋼板肋距限制了可焊剪力釘的位置，而強度往往不需要完全組合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In practice many composite beams are deliberately partially composite, because deck rib spacing limits where studs can go and strength often does not need full composite action. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 部分組合、勁度與使用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「組合比與有效慣性矩」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Composite ratio and effective inertia” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：部分組合有效慣性矩 I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s)。I_s = 255×10⁶ mm⁴、I_tr = 700×10⁶ mm⁴，半跨 20 支剪力釘每支 76.5 kN：ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN，組合比 1,531/2,619 ≈ 0.58，√0.58 ≈ 0.76，I_eff ≈ 255 + 0.76×445 ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴，約為完全組合的 85%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For partial composite action I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s). With I_s = 255×10⁶ mm⁴, I_tr = 700×10⁶ mm⁴ and 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN, a composite ratio of 1,531/2,619 ≈ 0.58; √0.58 ≈ 0.76, so I_eff ≈ 255 + 0.76×445 ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴, about 85% of full composite. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有效慣性矩計算施工後的長期撓度與樓板自振頻率，與使用性標準比較；完工後可抽樣量測樓板頻率或以已知載重量測撓度，若明顯低於預期勁度，追查是否有剪力釘缺漏或焊接不良。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the effective inertia to compute long-term deflection and floor natural frequency against serviceability criteria; after completion, sample floor frequencies or measure deflection under a known load, and if stiffness is clearly below expectation, trace whether studs are missing or poorly welded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 部分組合有效慣性矩 I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s)。I_s = 255×10⁶ mm⁴、I_tr = 700×10⁶ mm⁴，半跨 20 支剪力釘每支 76.5 kN：ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN，組合比 1,531/2,619 ≈ 0.58，√0.58 ≈ 0.76，I_eff ≈ 255 + 0.76×445 ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴，約為完全組合的 85%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For partial composite action I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s). With I_s = 255×10⁶ mm⁴, I_tr = 700×10⁶ mm⁴ and 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN, a composite ratio of 1,531/2,619 ≈ 0.58; √0.58 ≈ 0.76, so I_eff ≈ 255 + 0.76×445 ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴, about 85% of full composite. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「部分組合、勁度與使用性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability", which statement holds?
options: 部分組合有效慣性矩 I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s)。
剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
optionsEn: For partial composite action I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s).
Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.
If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.
quiz.explanation: 部分組合有效慣性矩 I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For partial composite action I_eff ≈ I_s + √(ΣQ_n/C_f)·(I_tr − I_s). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 部分組合、勁度與使用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「組合比與有效慣性矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Composite ratio and effective inertia” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有效慣性矩計算施工後的長期撓度與樓板自振頻率，與使用性標準比較；完工後可抽樣量測樓板頻率或以已知載重量測撓度，若明顯低於預期勁度，追查是否有剪力釘缺漏或焊接不良。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use the effective inertia to compute long-term deflection and floor natural frequency against serviceability criteria; after completion, sample floor frequencies or measure deflection under a known load, and if stiffness is clearly below expectation, trace whether studs are missing or poorly welded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計說明應寫明每類組合梁採用的組合比及其使用性檢核結果；當樓板用途改變（例如由辦公改為實驗室或健身房）時，須以原組合比重新檢核振動與撓度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should state the composite ratio adopted for each beam type and its serviceability results; when floor use changes, for example from office to laboratory or gym, recheck vibration and deflection with the original composite ratio.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了節省剪力釘而把組合比壓得很低，梁強度檢核勉強通過，但樓板在人員走動下振動明顯，辦公室使用者抱怨；剪力釘在反覆滑動下也可能先達到變形極限而斷裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pushing the composite ratio very low to save studs lets the strength check pass narrowly, but the floor vibrates noticeably under footfall and office users complain; under repeated slip the studs may also reach their deformation limit and fracture first. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以有效慣性矩計算施工後的長期撓度與樓板自振頻率，與使用性標準比較；完工後可抽樣量測樓板頻率或以已知載重量測撓度，若明顯低於預期勁度，追查是否有剪力釘缺漏或焊接不良。
knowledge.textEn: Use the effective inertia to compute long-term deflection and floor natural frequency against serviceability criteria; after completion, sample floor frequencies or measure deflection under a known load, and if stiffness is clearly below expectation, trace whether studs are missing or poorly welded.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計說明應寫明每類組合梁採用的組合比及其使用性檢核結果；當樓板用途改變（例如由辦公改為實驗室或健身房）時，須以原組合比重新檢核振動與撓度。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should state the composite ratio adopted for each beam type and its serviceability results; when floor use changes, for example from office to laboratory or gym, recheck vibration and deflection with the original composite ratio.

quiz.question: 要驗證「部分組合、勁度與使用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以有效慣性矩計算施工後的長期撓度與樓板自振頻率，與使用性標準比較。
組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Use the effective inertia to compute long-term deflection and floor natural frequency against serviceability criteria.
The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.
quiz.explanation: 以有效慣性矩計算施工後的長期撓度與樓板自振頻率，與使用性標準比較；完工後可抽樣量測樓板頻率或以已知載重量測撓度，若明顯低於預期勁度，追查是否有剪力釘缺漏或焊接不良。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use the effective inertia to compute long-term deflection and floor natural frequency against serviceability criteria; after completion, sample floor frequencies or measure deflection under a known load, and if stiffness is clearly below expectation, trace whether studs are missing or poorly welded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 部分組合、勁度與使用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「組合比與有效慣性矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Composite ratio and effective inertia” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了節省剪力釘而把組合比壓得很低，梁強度檢核勉強通過，但樓板在人員走動下振動明顯，辦公室使用者抱怨；剪力釘在反覆滑動下也可能先達到變形極限而斷裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Pushing the composite ratio very low to save studs lets the strength check pass narrowly, but the floor vibrates noticeably under footfall and office users complain; under repeated slip the studs may also reach their deformation limit and fracture first. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：組合比（實際剪力釘總強度除以完全組合所需值）同時控制強度與勁度，太低時剪力釘會在變形能力用盡前斷裂，因此規範通常設定最低組合比。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The composite ratio, total stud strength divided by that required for full action, governs both strength and stiffness; too low a ratio lets studs fracture before their deformation capacity is used, so codes usually set a minimum ratio.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了節省剪力釘而把組合比壓得很低，梁強度檢核勉強通過，但樓板在人員走動下振動明顯，辦公室使用者抱怨；剪力釘在反覆滑動下也可能先達到變形極限而斷裂。
knowledge.textEn: Pushing the composite ratio very low to save studs lets the strength check pass narrowly, but the floor vibrates noticeably under footfall and office users complain; under repeated slip the studs may also reach their deformation limit and fracture first.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「部分組合、勁度與使用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Partial composite action, stiffness and serviceability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
為了節省剪力釘而把組合比壓得很低，梁強度檢核勉強通過，但樓板在人員走動下振動明顯，辦公室使用者抱怨；剪力釘在反覆滑動下也可能先達到變形極限而斷裂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
Pushing the composite ratio very low to save studs lets the strength check pass narrowly, but the floor vibrates noticeably under footfall and office users complain.
quiz.explanation: 為了節省剪力釘而把組合比壓得很低，梁強度檢核勉強通過，但樓板在人員走動下振動明顯，辦公室使用者抱怨；剪力釘在反覆滑動下也可能先達到變形極限而斷裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pushing the composite ratio very low to save studs lets the strength check pass narrowly, but the floor vibrates noticeably under footfall and office users complain; under repeated slip the studs may also reach their deformation limit and fracture first. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度」與「壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stud size, material and resistance" and "Profiled decking and through-deck welding details": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stud size, material and resistance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「19 mm 頭釘」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “19 mm headed stud” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 建築組合樓板最常用的是直徑 19 mm 的頭釘，釘頭讓混凝土能抵抗拔出，釘身則以剪力與彎曲把介面力傳入混凝土。單支剪力釘的強度由兩個機制中較小者決定：周圍混凝土被壓碎或劈裂，或釘身鋼材剪斷；放在壓型鋼板肋內時，肋的寬度、高度與剪力釘在肋中的位置還會進一步折減強度，例如剪力釘位於受力方向的不利側（弱位置）時強度明顯較低。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「19 mm 頭釘」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The most common connector in building composite floors is the 19 mm headed stud: the head anchors it against pull-out while the shank carries interface force into the concrete by shear and bending. A single stud's resistance is the lesser of two mechanisms, crushing or splitting of the surrounding concrete or shearing of the steel shank; inside a deck rib, the rib's width and height and the stud's position within it reduce strength further, notably when the stud sits on the unfavourable side of the rib relative to the load, the weak position. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “19 mm headed stud” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「19 mm 頭釘」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “19 mm headed stud”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度
knowledge.text: 建築組合樓板最常用的是直徑 19 mm 的頭釘，釘頭讓混凝土能抵抗拔出，釘身則以剪力與彎曲把介面力傳入混凝土。單支剪力釘的強度由兩個機制中較小者決定：周圍混凝土被壓碎或劈裂，或釘身鋼材剪斷；放在壓型鋼板肋內時，肋的寬度、高度與剪力釘在肋中的位置還會進一步折減強度，例如剪力釘位於受力方向的不利側（弱位置）時強度明顯較低。
knowledge.textEn: The most common connector in building composite floors is the 19 mm headed stud: the head anchors it against pull-out while the shank carries interface force into the concrete by shear and bending. A single stud's resistance is the lesser of two mechanisms, crushing or splitting of the surrounding concrete or shearing of the steel shank; inside a deck rib, the rib's width and height and the stud's position within it reduce strength further, notably when the stud sits on the unfavourable side of the rib relative to the load, the weak position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stud size, material and resistance" is correct?
options: 建築組合樓板最常用的是直徑 19 mm 的頭釘，釘頭讓混凝土能抵抗拔出，釘身則以剪力與彎曲把介面力傳入混凝土。
剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
optionsEn: The most common connector in building composite floors is the 19 mm headed stud: the head anchors it against pull-out while the shank carries interface force into the concrete by shear and bending.
Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.
quiz.explanation: 建築組合樓板最常用的是直徑 19 mm 的頭釘，釘頭讓混凝土能抵抗拔出，釘身則以剪力與彎曲把介面力傳入混凝土。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The most common connector in building composite floors is the 19 mm headed stud: the head anchors it against pull-out while the shank carries interface force into the concrete by shear and bending. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stud size, material and resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「19 mm 頭釘」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “19 mm headed stud” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u。19 mm 頭釘 A_sc ≈ 283.5 mm²，f′c = 28 MPa、E_c ≈ 24,870 MPa：混凝土控制值 ≈ 118 kN；F_u = 450 MPa，肋內單支弱位置 R_g = 1.0、R_p = 0.6：0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN 控制；強位置 R_p = 0.75 時約 95.7 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u. For a 19 mm stud, A_sc ≈ 283.5 mm²; with f′c = 28 MPa and E_c ≈ 24,870 MPa the concrete limit is about 118 kN; with F_u = 450 MPa, one stud per rib in the weak position (R_g = 1.0, R_p = 0.6) governs at 0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN, rising to about 95.7 kN in the strong position (R_p = 0.75). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：進場時核對剪力釘的材料證明（抗拉強度、伸長率）、尺寸與釘頭形狀，以及配套陶瓷護圈的型號；設計時確認所用的肋折減係數與實際壓型鋼板的肋寬、肋高與剪力釘位置一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At delivery, check stud material certificates (tensile strength, elongation), dimensions and head shape, and the matching ceramic ferrule type; in design, confirm that the rib reduction factors used match the actual deck rib width, height and stud position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u。19 mm 頭釘 A_sc ≈ 283.5 mm²，f′c = 28 MPa、E_c ≈ 24,870 MPa：混凝土控制值 ≈ 118 kN；F_u = 450 MPa，肋內單支弱位置 R_g = 1.0、R_p = 0.6：0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN 控制；強位置 R_p = 0.75 時約 95.7 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u. For a 19 mm stud, A_sc ≈ 283.5 mm²; with f′c = 28 MPa and E_c ≈ 24,870 MPa the concrete limit is about 118 kN; with F_u = 450 MPa, one stud per rib in the weak position (R_g = 1.0, R_p = 0.6) governs at 0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN, rising to about 95.7 kN in the strong position (R_p = 0.75). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stud size, material and resistance", which statement holds?
options: 被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。
Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u。
剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
optionsEn: A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded.
Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u.
Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
quiz.explanation: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Q_n = 0.5·A_sc·√(f′c·E_c) ≤ R_g·R_p·A_sc·F_u. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stud size, material and resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「19 mm 頭釘」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “19 mm headed stud” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 進場時核對剪力釘的材料證明（抗拉強度、伸長率）、尺寸與釘頭形狀，以及配套陶瓷護圈的型號；設計時確認所用的肋折減係數與實際壓型鋼板的肋寬、肋高與剪力釘位置一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At delivery, check stud material certificates (tensile strength, elongation), dimensions and head shape, and the matching ceramic ferrule type; in design, confirm that the rib reduction factors used match the actual deck rib width, height and stud position. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工圖應指定剪力釘在肋中的位置（例如一律焊在強位置），並在壓型鋼板配置圖上標示；若壓型鋼板中間有加勁肋使剪力釘無法置中，須由設計者指定偏移方向。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shop drawings should fix the stud position in the rib, for example always the strong position, and show it on the deck layout; where a stiffener in the rib prevents central placement, the designer must specify the direction of offset.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若設計以平板條件計算剪力釘強度，卻使用肋高較大的壓型鋼板並把剪力釘焊在弱位置，實際強度可能只有計算值的六成多，組合梁的極限強度與延性都不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing stud strength for a solid slab, then using a deep-rib deck with studs welded in the weak position, can leave actual strength at little more than sixty percent of the calculated value, short of both ultimate strength and ductility. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 進場時核對剪力釘的材料證明（抗拉強度、伸長率）、尺寸與釘頭形狀，以及配套陶瓷護圈的型號；設計時確認所用的肋折減係數與實際壓型鋼板的肋寬、肋高與剪力釘位置一致。
knowledge.textEn: At delivery, check stud material certificates (tensile strength, elongation), dimensions and head shape, and the matching ceramic ferrule type; in design, confirm that the rib reduction factors used match the actual deck rib width, height and stud position.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工圖應指定剪力釘在肋中的位置（例如一律焊在強位置），並在壓型鋼板配置圖上標示；若壓型鋼板中間有加勁肋使剪力釘無法置中，須由設計者指定偏移方向。
knowledge.textEn: Shop drawings should fix the stud position in the rib, for example always the strong position, and show it on the deck layout; where a stiffener in the rib prevents central placement, the designer must specify the direction of offset.

quiz.question: 要驗證「剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stud size, material and resistance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
進場時核對剪力釘的材料證明（抗拉強度、伸長率）、尺寸與釘頭形狀，以及配套陶瓷護圈的型號；設計時確認所用的肋折減係數與實際壓型鋼板的肋寬、肋高與剪力釘位置一致。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
At delivery, check stud material certificates (tensile strength, elongation), dimensions and head shape, and the matching ceramic ferrule type.
quiz.explanation: 進場時核對剪力釘的材料證明（抗拉強度、伸長率）、尺寸與釘頭形狀，以及配套陶瓷護圈的型號；設計時確認所用的肋折減係數與實際壓型鋼板的肋寬、肋高與剪力釘位置一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At delivery, check stud material certificates (tensile strength, elongation), dimensions and head shape, and the matching ceramic ferrule type; in design, confirm that the rib reduction factors used match the actual deck rib width, height and stud position. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stud size, material and resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「19 mm 頭釘」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “19 mm headed stud” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若設計以平板條件計算剪力釘強度，卻使用肋高較大的壓型鋼板並把剪力釘焊在弱位置，實際強度可能只有計算值的六成多，組合梁的極限強度與延性都不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing stud strength for a solid slab, then using a deep-rib deck with studs welded in the weak position, can leave actual strength at little more than sixty percent of the calculated value, short of both ultimate strength and ductility. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單支剪力釘的強度由兩個機制中較小者決定：周圍混凝土被壓碎或劈裂，或釘身鋼材剪斷；放在壓型鋼板肋內時，肋的寬度、高度與剪力釘在肋中的位置還會進一步折減強度，例如剪力釘位於受力方向的不利側（弱位置）時強度明顯較低。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A single stud's resistance is the lesser of two mechanisms, crushing or splitting of the surrounding concrete or shearing of the steel shank; inside a deck rib, the rib's width and height and the stud's position within it reduce strength further, notably when the stud sits on the unfavourable side of the rib relative to the load, the weak position.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若設計以平板條件計算剪力釘強度，卻使用肋高較大的壓型鋼板並把剪力釘焊在弱位置，實際強度可能只有計算值的六成多，組合梁的極限強度與延性都不足。
knowledge.textEn: Designing stud strength for a solid slab, then using a deep-rib deck with studs welded in the weak position, can leave actual strength at little more than sixty percent of the calculated value, short of both ultimate strength and ductility.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剪力釘尺寸、材料與強度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stud size, material and resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若設計以平板條件計算剪力釘強度，卻使用肋高較大的壓型鋼板並把剪力釘焊在弱位置，實際強度可能只有計算值的六成多，組合梁的極限強度與延性都不足。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
optionsEn: Designing stud strength for a solid slab, then using a deep-rib deck with studs welded in the weak position, can leave actual strength at little more than sixty percent of the calculated value, short of both ultimate strength and ductility.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.
quiz.explanation: 若設計以平板條件計算剪力釘強度，卻使用肋高較大的壓型鋼板並把剪力釘焊在弱位置，實際強度可能只有計算值的六成多，組合梁的極限強度與延性都不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing stud strength for a solid slab, then using a deep-rib deck with studs welded in the weak position, can leave actual strength at little more than sixty percent of the calculated value, short of both ultimate strength and ductility. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Profiled decking and through-deck welding details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck ribs and through-deck welding” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 英國鋼結構業界的說明指出，穿板焊接是把剪力釘固定在鋼梁上翼板的常規做法：壓型鋼板夾在剪力釘底部與翼板之間，一次焊接把三者熔合。約 1 mm 厚的鍍鋅鋼承板不影響焊接品質，但鋼承板必須緊貼翼板、保持乾燥，翼板頂面不得有影響焊接的厚塗層。橫向鋪設的鋼承板每個肋內通常最多兩支剪力釘，因此肋距直接決定可配置的剪力釘數量；兩支並排時每支強度又會再折減。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel-industry guidance in the UK describes through-deck welding as the normal way to fix studs to a beam's top flange: the decking is sandwiched between the stud base and the flange and one weld fuses all three. Galvanized decking about 1 mm thick does not affect weld quality, but the deck must sit tight on the flange and be dry, and the flange top must be free of thick coatings that impair welding. With transverse decking, usually no more than two studs go in one trough, so rib spacing directly sets how many studs can be placed, and two studs side by side are each reduced further. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck ribs and through-deck welding” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：12 m 梁、肋距 300 mm，半跨約 20 個肋。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 12 m beam with ribs at 300 mm has about 20 ribs per half span.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck ribs and through-deck welding”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部
knowledge.titleEn: Profiled decking and through-deck welding details
knowledge.text: 英國鋼結構業界的說明指出，穿板焊接是把剪力釘固定在鋼梁上翼板的常規做法：壓型鋼板夾在剪力釘底部與翼板之間，一次焊接把三者熔合。約 1 mm 厚的鍍鋅鋼承板不影響焊接品質，但鋼承板必須緊貼翼板、保持乾燥，翼板頂面不得有影響焊接的厚塗層。
knowledge.textEn: Steel-industry guidance in the UK describes through-deck welding as the normal way to fix studs to a beam's top flange: the decking is sandwiched between the stud base and the flange and one weld fuses all three. Galvanized decking about 1 mm thick does not affect weld quality, but the deck must sit tight on the flange and be dry, and the flange top must be free of thick coatings that impair welding.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Profiled decking and through-deck welding details" is correct?
options: 只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
英國鋼結構業界的說明指出，穿板焊接是把剪力釘固定在鋼梁上翼板的常規做法：壓型鋼板夾在剪力釘底部與翼板之間，一次焊接把三者熔合。
剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
optionsEn: If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.

Steel-industry guidance in the UK describes through-deck welding as the normal way to fix studs to a beam's top flange: the decking is sandwiched between the stud base and the flange and one weld fuses all three.
Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.
quiz.explanation: 英國鋼結構業界的說明指出，穿板焊接是把剪力釘固定在鋼梁上翼板的常規做法：壓型鋼板夾在剪力釘底部與翼板之間，一次焊接把三者熔合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Steel-industry guidance in the UK describes through-deck welding as the normal way to fix studs to a beam's top flange: the decking is sandwiched between the stud base and the flange and one weld fuses all three. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Profiled decking and through-deck welding details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck ribs and through-deck welding” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：12 m 梁、肋距 300 mm，半跨約 20 個肋。每肋 1 支弱位置 76.5 kN：ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN，組合比 58%；每肋 2 支時 R_g = 0.85，每支 0.85×0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 65.1 kN，40 支 ≈ 2,603 kN，組合比約 99%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 12 m beam with ribs at 300 mm has about 20 ribs per half span. One weak-position stud per rib at 76.5 kN gives ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN, a 58% ratio; two per rib with R_g = 0.85 gives 0.85×0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 65.1 kN each, 40 studs ≈ 2,603 kN, a ratio of about 99%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：焊接前檢查鋼承板是否已依圖固定、與翼板間無縫隙、接頭搭接位置是否避開剪力釘位置，並確認肋內無積水與雜物；翼板頂面若有底漆，須確認是否為允許穿板焊接的類型或已清除。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before welding, check that the deck is fixed as drawn, tight to the flange with no gap, with laps placed clear of stud positions, and that ribs are free of water and debris; if the flange top is primed, confirm the primer is permitted for through-deck welding or has been removed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 12 m 梁、肋距 300 mm，半跨約 20 個肋。每肋 1 支弱位置 76.5 kN：ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN，組合比 58%；每肋 2 支時 R_g = 0.85，每支 0.85×0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 65.1 kN，40 支 ≈ 2,603 kN，組合比約 99%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 12 m beam with ribs at 300 mm has about 20 ribs per half span. One weak-position stud per rib at 76.5 kN gives ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN, a 58% ratio; two per rib with R_g = 0.85 gives 0.85×0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 65.1 kN each, 40 studs ≈ 2,603 kN, a ratio of about 99%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Profiled decking and through-deck welding details", which statement holds?
options: 剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
12 m 梁、肋距 300 mm，半跨約 20 個肋。
optionsEn: If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.
The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.
A 12 m beam with ribs at 300 mm has about 20 ribs per half span.
quiz.explanation: 12 m 梁、肋距 300 mm，半跨約 20 個肋。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 12 m beam with ribs at 300 mm has about 20 ribs per half span. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Profiled decking and through-deck welding details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck ribs and through-deck welding” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 焊接前檢查鋼承板是否已依圖固定、與翼板間無縫隙、接頭搭接位置是否避開剪力釘位置，並確認肋內無積水與雜物；翼板頂面若有底漆，須確認是否為允許穿板焊接的類型或已清除。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before welding, check that the deck is fixed as drawn, tight to the flange with no gap, with laps placed clear of stud positions, and that ribs are free of water and debris; if the flange top is primed, confirm the primer is permitted for through-deck welding or has been removed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋼承板配置圖應與剪力釘配置圖一起審查，確認肋位、搭接與剪力釘位置相容；鋼承板鋪設完成並經檢查後才可開始焊接剪力釘，雨後須清除肋內積水並讓板面乾燥。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Review the deck layout together with the stud layout to confirm that rib positions, laps and stud locations are compatible; welding may start only after the deck is laid and inspected, and after rain, water must be cleared from the ribs and the surface allowed to dry.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋼承板與翼板之間有空隙或兩層鋼承板搭接處焊接，熔池無法同時熔合鋼承板與翼板，剪力釘看似牢固，實際只焊在鋼承板上；樓板澆置後這些剪力釘幾乎不傳力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A gap between deck and flange, or welding through a double-thickness lap, stops the weld pool fusing deck and flange together; the stud looks firm but is welded only to the deck and carries almost no force once the slab is cast. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 焊接前檢查鋼承板是否已依圖固定、與翼板間無縫隙、接頭搭接位置是否避開剪力釘位置，並確認肋內無積水與雜物；翼板頂面若有底漆，須確認是否為允許穿板焊接的類型或已清除。
knowledge.textEn: Before welding, check that the deck is fixed as drawn, tight to the flange with no gap, with laps placed clear of stud positions, and that ribs are free of water and debris; if the flange top is primed, confirm the primer is permitted for through-deck welding or has been removed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鋼承板配置圖應與剪力釘配置圖一起審查，確認肋位、搭接與剪力釘位置相容；鋼承板鋪設完成並經檢查後才可開始焊接剪力釘，雨後須清除肋內積水並讓板面乾燥。
knowledge.textEn: Review the deck layout together with the stud layout to confirm that rib positions, laps and stud locations are compatible; welding may start only after the deck is laid and inspected, and after rain, water must be cleared from the ribs and the surface allowed to dry.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Profiled decking and through-deck welding details"?
options: 焊接前檢查鋼承板是否已依圖固定、與翼板間無縫隙、接頭搭接位置是否避開剪力釘位置，並確認肋內無積水與雜物。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
optionsEn: Before welding, check that the deck is fixed as drawn, tight to the flange with no gap, with laps placed clear of stud positions, and that ribs are free of water and debris.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
quiz.explanation: 焊接前檢查鋼承板是否已依圖固定、與翼板間無縫隙、接頭搭接位置是否避開剪力釘位置，並確認肋內無積水與雜物；翼板頂面若有底漆，須確認是否為允許穿板焊接的類型或已清除。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before welding, check that the deck is fixed as drawn, tight to the flange with no gap, with laps placed clear of stud positions, and that ribs are free of water and debris; if the flange top is primed, confirm the primer is permitted for through-deck welding or has been removed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Profiled decking and through-deck welding details: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼承板肋與穿板焊接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck ribs and through-deck welding” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋼承板與翼板之間有空隙或兩層鋼承板搭接處焊接，熔池無法同時熔合鋼承板與翼板，剪力釘看似牢固，實際只焊在鋼承板上；樓板澆置後這些剪力釘幾乎不傳力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A gap between deck and flange, or welding through a double-thickness lap, stops the weld pool fusing deck and flange together; the stud looks firm but is welded only to the deck and carries almost no force once the slab is cast. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：橫向鋪設的鋼承板每個肋內通常最多兩支剪力釘，因此肋距直接決定可配置的剪力釘數量；兩支並排時每支強度又會再折減。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With transverse decking, usually no more than two studs go in one trough, so rib spacing directly sets how many studs can be placed, and two studs side by side are each reduced further.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鋼承板與翼板之間有空隙或兩層鋼承板搭接處焊接，熔池無法同時熔合鋼承板與翼板，剪力釘看似牢固，實際只焊在鋼承板上；樓板澆置後這些剪力釘幾乎不傳力。
knowledge.textEn: A gap between deck and flange, or welding through a double-thickness lap, stops the weld pool fusing deck and flange together; the stud looks firm but is welded only to the deck and carries almost no force once the slab is cast.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓型鋼板與穿板焊接細部」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Profiled decking and through-deck welding details" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
鋼承板與翼板之間有空隙或兩層鋼承板搭接處焊接，熔池無法同時熔合鋼承板與翼板，剪力釘看似牢固，實際只焊在鋼承板上；樓板澆置後這些剪力釘幾乎不傳力。
剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A gap between deck and flange, or welding through a double-thickness lap, stops the weld pool fusing deck and flange together.
Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.
quiz.explanation: 鋼承板與翼板之間有空隙或兩層鋼承板搭接處焊接，熔池無法同時熔合鋼承板與翼板，剪力釘看似牢固，實際只焊在鋼承板上；樓板澆置後這些剪力釘幾乎不傳力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A gap between deck and flange, or welding through a double-thickness lap, stops the weld pool fusing deck and flange together; the stud looks firm but is welded only to the deck and carries almost no force once the slab is cast. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件」與「首件試驗與尺寸檢核」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drawn-arc stud welding conditions" and "First-stud testing and dimensional checks": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Drawn-arc stud welding conditions: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接由焊槍提起剪力釘引弧，在設定時間內熔化釘端與母材，再把剪力釘壓入熔池；釘端的鋁球協助脫氧，陶瓷護圈集中熱量、保護熔池並使焊瘤成形，焊後敲除。焊接品質取決於電流、時間、提升與壓入量的組合，而這些設定又受剪力釘直徑、是否穿板、焊接電纜長度與接地位置影響。現場常見問題是電源容量不足、電纜過長或接地不良，使實際電流低於設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In drawn-arc stud welding the gun lifts the stud to strike an arc, melts the stud end and base metal for a set time, then plunges the stud into the pool; an aluminium flux ball on the stud end deoxidises the weld, and a ceramic ferrule concentrates heat, shields the pool and shapes the flash before being knocked off. Quality depends on the combination of current, time, lift and plunge, which in turn depend on stud diameter, whether welding through deck, cable length and ground position. Common site problems are undersized power supplies, overlong cables and poor grounds that leave actual current below the setting. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：焊接電纜壓降 ΔV = I·R。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cable voltage drop ΔV = I·R.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件
knowledge.text: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接由焊槍提起剪力釘引弧，在設定時間內熔化釘端與母材，再把剪力釘壓入熔池；釘端的鋁球協助脫氧，陶瓷護圈集中熱量、保護熔池並使焊瘤成形，焊後敲除。焊接品質取決於電流、時間、提升與壓入量的組合，而這些設定又受剪力釘直徑、是否穿板、焊接電纜長度與接地位置影響。
knowledge.textEn: In drawn-arc stud welding the gun lifts the stud to strike an arc, melts the stud end and base metal for a set time, then plunges the stud into the pool; an aluminium flux ball on the stud end deoxidises the weld, and a ceramic ferrule concentrates heat, shields the pool and shapes the flash before being knocked off. Quality depends on the combination of current, time, lift and plunge, which in turn depend on stud diameter, whether welding through deck, cable length and ground position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drawn-arc stud welding conditions" is correct?
options: 剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。
拉弧式剪力釘焊接由焊槍提起剪力釘引弧，在設定時間內熔化釘端與母材，再把剪力釘壓入熔池；釘端的鋁球協助脫氧，陶瓷護圈集中熱量、保護熔池並使焊瘤成形，焊後敲除。
optionsEn: Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.
A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded.
In drawn-arc stud welding the gun lifts the stud to strike an arc, melts the stud end and base metal for a set time, then plunges the stud into the pool.
quiz.explanation: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接由焊槍提起剪力釘引弧，在設定時間內熔化釘端與母材，再把剪力釘壓入熔池；釘端的鋁球協助脫氧，陶瓷護圈集中熱量、保護熔池並使焊瘤成形，焊後敲除。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In drawn-arc stud welding the gun lifts the stud to strike an arc, melts the stud end and base metal for a set time, then plunges the stud into the pool; an aluminium flux ball on the stud end deoxidises the weld, and a ceramic ferrule concentrates heat, shields the pool and shapes the flash before being knocked off. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drawn-arc stud welding conditions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：焊接電纜壓降 ΔV = I·R。銅纜截面 107 mm²，每米電阻 1.72×10⁻⁸/107×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.61×10⁻⁴ Ω；正負線合計 60 m，R ≈ 0.0096 Ω。若焊接電流 1,500 A，ΔV = 1,500×0.0096 ≈ 14.5 V，相對於數十伏的電弧電壓並不小，必須依電纜長度調整設定。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cable voltage drop ΔV = I·R. A 107 mm² copper cable has about 1.72×10⁻⁸/107×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.61×10⁻⁴ Ω per metre; with 60 m of lead and return, R ≈ 0.0096 Ω. At a welding current of 1,500 A, ΔV = 1,500×0.0096 ≈ 14.5 V, not small compared with an arc voltage of a few tens of volts, so settings must be adjusted for cable length. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個班次開工前以首件試焊確認設定，記錄電流、時間、電纜長度與接地位置；作業中若更換電纜、移動電源或改變剪力釘批次，須重新試焊；雨天或板面潮濕時停止焊接。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm settings with first-stud trial welds at the start of each shift and record current, time, cable length and ground position; re-test after changing cables, moving the power source or changing stud lots, and stop welding in rain or on wet deck.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 焊接電纜壓降 ΔV = I·R。銅纜截面 107 mm²，每米電阻 1.72×10⁻⁸/107×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.61×10⁻⁴ Ω；正負線合計 60 m，R ≈ 0.0096 Ω。若焊接電流 1,500 A，ΔV = 1,500×0.0096 ≈ 14.5 V，相對於數十伏的電弧電壓並不小，必須依電纜長度調整設定。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Cable voltage drop ΔV = I·R. A 107 mm² copper cable has about 1.72×10⁻⁸/107×10⁻⁶ ≈ 1.61×10⁻⁴ Ω per metre; with 60 m of lead and return, R ≈ 0.0096 Ω. At a welding current of 1,500 A, ΔV = 1,500×0.0096 ≈ 14.5 V, not small compared with an arc voltage of a few tens of volts, so settings must be adjusted for cable length. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drawn-arc stud welding conditions", which statement holds?
options: 焊接電纜壓降 ΔV = I·R。
剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
optionsEn: Cable voltage drop ΔV = I·R.
Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
quiz.explanation: 焊接電纜壓降 ΔV = I·R。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Cable voltage drop ΔV = I·R. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drawn-arc stud welding conditions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個班次開工前以首件試焊確認設定，記錄電流、時間、電纜長度與接地位置；作業中若更換電纜、移動電源或改變剪力釘批次，須重新試焊；雨天或板面潮濕時停止焊接。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm settings with first-stud trial welds at the start of each shift and record current, time, cable length and ground position; re-test after changing cables, moving the power source or changing stud lots, and stop welding in rain or on wet deck. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：剪力釘焊接人員須經訓練與資格認定，焊接程序寫明各直徑在穿板與直接焊接時的設定範圍、電源容量與最大電纜長度；接地夾須直接夾在鋼梁上並靠近焊接區。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Stud welders must be trained and qualified, and the procedure must state setting ranges for each diameter when welding through deck or direct, power-source capacity and maximum cable length; the ground clamp must be fixed directly to the steel beam close to the welding area.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：電源與多支焊槍共用造成電流不足，焊瘤不完整、釘端未完全熔合，剪力釘在敲擊或彎曲時從根部脫落；接地夾夾在遠端鋼承板上，電流經由鋼承板搭接處流通，產生電弧偏吹與不穩定焊接。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A power source shared among several guns leaves current too low, giving incomplete flash and unfused stud bases that break off when tapped or bent; a ground clamp on distant decking routes current through deck laps, causing arc blow and erratic welds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個班次開工前以首件試焊確認設定，記錄電流、時間、電纜長度與接地位置；作業中若更換電纜、移動電源或改變剪力釘批次，須重新試焊；雨天或板面潮濕時停止焊接。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm settings with first-stud trial welds at the start of each shift and record current, time, cable length and ground position; re-test after changing cables, moving the power source or changing stud lots, and stop welding in rain or on wet deck.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 剪力釘焊接人員須經訓練與資格認定，焊接程序寫明各直徑在穿板與直接焊接時的設定範圍、電源容量與最大電纜長度；接地夾須直接夾在鋼梁上並靠近焊接區。
knowledge.textEn: Stud welders must be trained and qualified, and the procedure must state setting ranges for each diameter when welding through deck or direct, power-source capacity and maximum cable length; the ground clamp must be fixed directly to the steel beam close to the welding area.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drawn-arc stud welding conditions"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
每個班次開工前以首件試焊確認設定，記錄電流、時間、電纜長度與接地位置；作業中若更換電纜、移動電源或改變剪力釘批次，須重新試焊；雨天或板面潮濕時停止焊接。
部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Confirm settings with first-stud trial welds at the start of each shift and record current, time, cable length and ground position.
Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
quiz.explanation: 每個班次開工前以首件試焊確認設定，記錄電流、時間、電纜長度與接地位置；作業中若更換電纜、移動電源或改變剪力釘批次，須重新試焊；雨天或板面潮濕時停止焊接。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm settings with first-stud trial welds at the start of each shift and record current, time, cable length and ground position; re-test after changing cables, moving the power source or changing stud lots, and stop welding in rain or on wet deck. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drawn-arc stud welding conditions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焊槍設定與陶瓷護圈」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gun settings and ceramic ferrules” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 電源與多支焊槍共用造成電流不足，焊瘤不完整、釘端未完全熔合，剪力釘在敲擊或彎曲時從根部脫落；接地夾夾在遠端鋼承板上，電流經由鋼承板搭接處流通，產生電弧偏吹與不穩定焊接。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A power source shared among several guns leaves current too low, giving incomplete flash and unfused stud bases that break off when tapped or bent; a ground clamp on distant decking routes current through deck laps, causing arc blow and erratic welds. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：現場常見問題是電源容量不足、電纜過長或接地不良，使實際電流低於設定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Common site problems are undersized power supplies, overlong cables and poor grounds that leave actual current below the setting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 電源與多支焊槍共用造成電流不足，焊瘤不完整、釘端未完全熔合，剪力釘在敲擊或彎曲時從根部脫落；接地夾夾在遠端鋼承板上，電流經由鋼承板搭接處流通，產生電弧偏吹與不穩定焊接。
knowledge.textEn: A power source shared among several guns leaves current too low, giving incomplete flash and unfused stud bases that break off when tapped or bent; a ground clamp on distant decking routes current through deck laps, causing arc blow and erratic welds.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拉弧式剪力釘焊接施工條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drawn-arc stud welding conditions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。
電源與多支焊槍共用造成電流不足，焊瘤不完整、釘端未完全熔合，剪力釘在敲擊或彎曲時從根部脫落。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded.
A power source shared among several guns leaves current too low, giving incomplete flash and unfused stud bases that break off when tapped or bent.
quiz.explanation: 電源與多支焊槍共用造成電流不足，焊瘤不完整、釘端未完全熔合，剪力釘在敲擊或彎曲時從根部脫落；接地夾夾在遠端鋼承板上，電流經由鋼承板搭接處流通，產生電弧偏吹與不穩定焊接。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A power source shared among several guns leaves current too low, giving incomplete flash and unfused stud bases that break off when tapped or bent; a ground clamp on distant decking routes current through deck laps, causing arc blow and erratic welds. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 首件試驗與尺寸檢核：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: First-stud testing and dimensional checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「30° 彎曲試驗」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “30° bend test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每個生產時段開始或設定改變時，先在代表性的構件上焊兩支剪力釘，目視確認 360° 完整焊瘤，再用鐵鎚把剪力釘敲彎約 30°，焊道與熱影響區不得斷裂；通過後才開始量產。焊後長度也要檢查：拉弧焊接會消耗數公釐長度，焊後剪力釘必須高出鋼承板頂足夠距離，頂端又要保留足夠的混凝土保護層，兩者都影響剪力釘的錨定與耐久。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「30° 彎曲試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At the start of each production period or after a settings change, two studs are welded on a representative member, checked visually for a full 360° flash, then hammered over to about 30°; neither weld nor heat-affected zone may fracture, and only then does production begin. After-weld length is checked too: the drawn-arc process consumes a few millimetres, and the welded stud must still project far enough above the deck while leaving enough concrete cover over its head, both affecting anchorage and durability. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “30° bend test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：焊前長 130 mm、焊接消耗約 5 mm，焊後 125 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A stud 130 mm long before welding loses about 5 mm, leaving 125 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「30° 彎曲試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “30° bend test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 首件試驗與尺寸檢核
knowledge.text: 每個生產時段開始或設定改變時，先在代表性的構件上焊兩支剪力釘，目視確認 360° 完整焊瘤，再用鐵鎚把剪力釘敲彎約 30°，焊道與熱影響區不得斷裂；通過後才開始量產。焊後長度也要檢查：拉弧焊接會消耗數公釐長度，焊後剪力釘必須高出鋼承板頂足夠距離，頂端又要保留足夠的混凝土保護層，兩者都影響剪力釘的錨定與耐久。
knowledge.textEn: At the start of each production period or after a settings change, two studs are welded on a representative member, checked visually for a full 360° flash, then hammered over to about 30°; neither weld nor heat-affected zone may fracture, and only then does production begin. After-weld length is checked too: the drawn-arc process consumes a few millimetres, and the welded stud must still project far enough above the deck while leaving enough concrete cover over its head, both affecting anchorage and durability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「首件試驗與尺寸檢核」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "First-stud testing and dimensional checks" is correct?
options: 每個生產時段開始或設定改變時，先在代表性的構件上焊兩支剪力釘，目視確認 360° 完整焊瘤，再用鐵鎚把剪力釘敲彎約 30°，焊道與熱影響區不得斷裂。
被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。
剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
optionsEn: At the start of each production period or after a settings change, two studs are welded on a representative member, checked visually for a full 360° flash, then hammered over to about 30°.
A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded.
If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.
quiz.explanation: 每個生產時段開始或設定改變時，先在代表性的構件上焊兩支剪力釘，目視確認 360° 完整焊瘤，再用鐵鎚把剪力釘敲彎約 30°，焊道與熱影響區不得斷裂；通過後才開始量產。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At the start of each production period or after a settings change, two studs are welded on a representative member, checked visually for a full 360° flash, then hammered over to about 30°; neither weld nor heat-affected zone may fracture, and only then does production begin. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 首件試驗與尺寸檢核：定量估算
steps.titleEn: First-stud testing and dimensional checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「30° 彎曲試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “30° bend test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：焊前長 130 mm、焊接消耗約 5 mm，焊後 125 mm。鋼承板肋高 76 mm：高出肋頂 125 − 76 = 49 mm（≥ 38 mm）；樓板總厚 140 mm：釘頂保護層 140 − 125 = 15 mm（≥ 13 mm）。30° 彎曲時 125 mm 剪力釘頂端位移約 125×sin30° ≈ 62.5 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A stud 130 mm long before welding loses about 5 mm, leaving 125 mm. With a 76 mm deck rib it projects 125 − 76 = 49 mm above the rib (≥ 38 mm), and in a 140 mm slab it leaves 140 − 125 = 15 mm of cover over the head (≥ 13 mm). Bending a 125 mm stud by 30° moves its tip about 125×sin30° ≈ 62.5 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：首件試驗由檢驗員見證並記錄日期、構件、設定、剪力釘批次與結果；失敗時調整設定並重做兩支，直到合格；量產中抽量焊後長度，若長度變化異常（過長代表熔化不足、過短代表過度熔化），立即停焊檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspectors witness first-stud tests and record date, member, settings, stud lot and result; on failure, adjust and repeat with two more studs until they pass; during production, spot-measure after-weld length and stop to investigate abnormal changes, since too long suggests insufficient melting and too short excessive melting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 焊前長 130 mm、焊接消耗約 5 mm，焊後 125 mm。鋼承板肋高 76 mm：高出肋頂 125 − 76 = 49 mm（≥ 38 mm）；樓板總厚 140 mm：釘頂保護層 140 − 125 = 15 mm（≥ 13 mm）。30° 彎曲時 125 mm 剪力釘頂端位移約 125×sin30° ≈ 62.5 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A stud 130 mm long before welding loses about 5 mm, leaving 125 mm. With a 76 mm deck rib it projects 125 − 76 = 49 mm above the rib (≥ 38 mm), and in a 140 mm slab it leaves 140 − 125 = 15 mm of cover over the head (≥ 13 mm). Bending a 125 mm stud by 30° moves its tip about 125×sin30° ≈ 62.5 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「首件試驗與尺寸檢核」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "First-stud testing and dimensional checks", which statement holds?
options: 組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
焊前長 130 mm、焊接消耗約 5 mm，焊後 125 mm。
混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
optionsEn: The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.
A stud 130 mm long before welding loses about 5 mm, leaving 125 mm.
A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
quiz.explanation: 焊前長 130 mm、焊接消耗約 5 mm，焊後 125 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A stud 130 mm long before welding loses about 5 mm, leaving 125 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 首件試驗與尺寸檢核：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: First-stud testing and dimensional checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「30° 彎曲試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “30° bend test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 首件試驗由檢驗員見證並記錄日期、構件、設定、剪力釘批次與結果；失敗時調整設定並重做兩支，直到合格；量產中抽量焊後長度，若長度變化異常（過長代表熔化不足、過短代表過度熔化），立即停焊檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspectors witness first-stud tests and record date, member, settings, stud lot and result; on failure, adjust and repeat with two more studs until they pass; during production, spot-measure after-weld length and stop to investigate abnormal changes, since too long suggests insufficient melting and too short excessive melting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把首件彎曲試驗列為每個班次與每次設定變更後的停留點，結果寫入剪力釘焊接日誌；通過試驗而彎曲的剪力釘若不妨礙鋼筋與保護層，一般可保留，具體做法依規範與工程師指示。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make the first-stud bend test a hold point for every shift and every settings change and log the results; studs bent in a passing test can usually remain if they do not obstruct reinforcement or cover, following the code and the engineer's instructions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略首件試驗直接量產，當天設定其實偏低，整區數百支剪力釘焊瘤不完整；若混凝土已澆置，只能以鑽心或打除樓板抽查，補救工程遠比一次試驗昂貴。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping first-stud tests and going straight to production with a low setting leaves hundreds of studs across an area with incomplete flash; once concrete is placed, checking requires coring or breaking out the slab, far costlier than one test. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 首件試驗由檢驗員見證並記錄日期、構件、設定、剪力釘批次與結果；失敗時調整設定並重做兩支，直到合格；量產中抽量焊後長度，若長度變化異常（過長代表熔化不足、過短代表過度熔化），立即停焊檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Inspectors witness first-stud tests and record date, member, settings, stud lot and result; on failure, adjust and repeat with two more studs until they pass; during production, spot-measure after-weld length and stop to investigate abnormal changes, since too long suggests insufficient melting and too short excessive melting.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把首件彎曲試驗列為每個班次與每次設定變更後的停留點，結果寫入剪力釘焊接日誌；通過試驗而彎曲的剪力釘若不妨礙鋼筋與保護層，一般可保留，具體做法依規範與工程師指示。
knowledge.textEn: Make the first-stud bend test a hold point for every shift and every settings change and log the results; studs bent in a passing test can usually remain if they do not obstruct reinforcement or cover, following the code and the engineer's instructions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「首件試驗與尺寸檢核」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "First-stud testing and dimensional checks"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
首件試驗由檢驗員見證並記錄日期、構件、設定、剪力釘批次與結果。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
Inspectors witness first-stud tests and record date, member, settings, stud lot and result.
quiz.explanation: 首件試驗由檢驗員見證並記錄日期、構件、設定、剪力釘批次與結果；失敗時調整設定並重做兩支，直到合格；量產中抽量焊後長度，若長度變化異常（過長代表熔化不足、過短代表過度熔化），立即停焊檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspectors witness first-stud tests and record date, member, settings, stud lot and result; on failure, adjust and repeat with two more studs until they pass; during production, spot-measure after-weld length and stop to investigate abnormal changes, since too long suggests insufficient melting and too short excessive melting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 首件試驗與尺寸檢核：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: First-stud testing and dimensional checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「30° 彎曲試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “30° bend test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略首件試驗直接量產，當天設定其實偏低，整區數百支剪力釘焊瘤不完整；若混凝土已澆置，只能以鑽心或打除樓板抽查，補救工程遠比一次試驗昂貴。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping first-stud tests and going straight to production with a low setting leaves hundreds of studs across an area with incomplete flash; once concrete is placed, checking requires coring or breaking out the slab, far costlier than one test. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：焊後長度也要檢查：拉弧焊接會消耗數公釐長度，焊後剪力釘必須高出鋼承板頂足夠距離，頂端又要保留足夠的混凝土保護層，兩者都影響剪力釘的錨定與耐久。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After-weld length is checked too: the drawn-arc process consumes a few millimetres, and the welded stud must still project far enough above the deck while leaving enough concrete cover over its head, both affecting anchorage and durability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
