knowledge.text: 省略首件試驗直接量產，當天設定其實偏低，整區數百支剪力釘焊瘤不完整；若混凝土已澆置，只能以鑽心或打除樓板抽查，補救工程遠比一次試驗昂貴。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping first-stud tests and going straight to production with a low setting leaves hundreds of studs across an area with incomplete flash; once concrete is placed, checking requires coring or breaking out the slab, far costlier than one test.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「首件試驗與尺寸檢核」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "First-stud testing and dimensional checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 省略首件試驗直接量產，當天設定其實偏低，整區數百支剪力釘焊瘤不完整；若混凝土已澆置，只能以鑽心或打除樓板抽查，補救工程遠比一次試驗昂貴。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
optionsEn: Skipping first-stud tests and going straight to production with a low setting leaves hundreds of studs across an area with incomplete flash.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.
quiz.explanation: 省略首件試驗直接量產，當天設定其實偏低，整區數百支剪力釘焊瘤不完整；若混凝土已澆置，只能以鑽心或打除樓板抽查，補救工程遠比一次試驗昂貴。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping first-stud tests and going straight to production with a low setting leaves hundreds of studs across an area with incomplete flash; once concrete is placed, checking requires coring or breaking out the slab, far costlier than one test. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」與「推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Visual, ring and replacement checks" and "Push-out tests and stud resistance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Visual, ring and replacement checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “360° flash and hammer ring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 量產中的剪力釘檢查以全數目視為主：焊瘤應完整環繞釘根，沒有缺口、裂紋或過度飛濺；剪力釘應垂直、長度一致。焊瘤不完整或可疑的剪力釘可以鐵鎚敲擊聽聲，或敲彎約 15° 檢查根部，不合格者須在旁邊補焊新剪力釘或依程序以填角焊修補。由於混凝土澆置後無法再檢查，檢驗必須在澆置前完成並放行，這是整個組合樓板最關鍵的停留點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Production studs are checked mainly by 100% visual inspection: the flash should fully encircle the base with no gaps, cracks or excessive spatter, and studs should be upright and of consistent length. Studs with incomplete or doubtful flash can be ring-tested with a hammer or bent about 15° to check the base, and rejects are replaced by a new stud alongside or repaired by fillet welding per the procedure. Because nothing can be checked once concrete is placed, inspection must be completed and released before casting, the single most critical hold point for a composite floor. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “360° flash and hammer ring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若某區不良率為 10%，隨機敲彎 5 支都沒抽到不良的機率 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%；一根梁 40 支剪力釘、不良率 2% 時，至少有一支不良的機率 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If an area has a 10% defect rate, the chance that 5 randomly bent studs include no defect is 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%; for a beam with 40 studs and a 2% defect rate, the chance that at least one is defective is 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “360° flash and hammer ring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查
knowledge.text: 量產中的剪力釘檢查以全數目視為主：焊瘤應完整環繞釘根，沒有缺口、裂紋或過度飛濺；剪力釘應垂直、長度一致。焊瘤不完整或可疑的剪力釘可以鐵鎚敲擊聽聲，或敲彎約 15° 檢查根部，不合格者須在旁邊補焊新剪力釘或依程序以填角焊修補。
knowledge.textEn: Production studs are checked mainly by 100% visual inspection: the flash should fully encircle the base with no gaps, cracks or excessive spatter, and studs should be upright and of consistent length. Studs with incomplete or doubtful flash can be ring-tested with a hammer or bent about 15° to check the base, and rejects are replaced by a new stud alongside or repaired by fillet welding per the procedure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Visual, ring and replacement checks" is correct?
options: 剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
量產中的剪力釘檢查以全數目視為主：焊瘤應完整環繞釘根，沒有缺口、裂紋或過度飛濺；剪力釘應垂直、長度一致。
剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
optionsEn: If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.

Production studs are checked mainly by 100% visual inspection: the flash should fully encircle the base with no gaps, cracks or excessive spatter, and studs should be upright and of consistent length.
Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
quiz.explanation: 量產中的剪力釘檢查以全數目視為主：焊瘤應完整環繞釘根，沒有缺口、裂紋或過度飛濺；剪力釘應垂直、長度一致。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Production studs are checked mainly by 100% visual inspection: the flash should fully encircle the base with no gaps, cracks or excessive spatter, and studs should be upright and of consistent length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Visual, ring and replacement checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “360° flash and hammer ring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若某區不良率為 10%，隨機敲彎 5 支都沒抽到不良的機率 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%；一根梁 40 支剪力釘、不良率 2% 時，至少有一支不良的機率 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%。抽樣無法代替全數目視，彎曲只用於可疑剪力釘。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If an area has a 10% defect rate, the chance that 5 randomly bent studs include no defect is 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%; for a beam with 40 studs and a 2% defect rate, the chance that at least one is defective is 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%. Sampling cannot replace 100% visual inspection, and bending is reserved for doubtful studs. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以樓層與梁編號分區檢查，每根梁清點剪力釘數量並與施工圖比對，檢查焊瘤、垂直度與長度，可疑者敲擊或彎曲；不合格與補焊位置以油漆標記並記錄，全部完成後由檢驗員簽發澆置放行單。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect by floor and beam number, count studs on every beam against the shop drawing, check flash, plumbness and length, and ring or bend doubtful studs; mark and record rejects and replacements in paint, and have the inspector issue a casting release once all are complete.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若某區不良率為 10%，隨機敲彎 5 支都沒抽到不良的機率 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%；一根梁 40 支剪力釘、不良率 2% 時，至少有一支不良的機率 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%。抽樣無法代替全數目視，彎曲只用於可疑剪力釘。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If an area has a 10% defect rate, the chance that 5 randomly bent studs include no defect is 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%; for a beam with 40 studs and a 2% defect rate, the chance that at least one is defective is 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%. Sampling cannot replace 100% visual inspection, and bending is reserved for doubtful studs. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Visual, ring and replacement checks", which statement holds?
options: 剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
若某區不良率為 10%，隨機敲彎 5 支都沒抽到不良的機率 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%。
optionsEn: Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
If an area has a 10% defect rate, the chance that 5 randomly bent studs include no defect is 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%.
quiz.explanation: 若某區不良率為 10%，隨機敲彎 5 支都沒抽到不良的機率 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%；一根梁 40 支剪力釘、不良率 2% 時，至少有一支不良的機率 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If an area has a 10% defect rate, the chance that 5 randomly bent studs include no defect is 0.9⁵ ≈ 59%; for a beam with 40 studs and a 2% defect rate, the chance that at least one is defective is 1 − 0.98⁴⁰ ≈ 55%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Visual, ring and replacement checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “360° flash and hammer ring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以樓層與梁編號分區檢查，每根梁清點剪力釘數量並與施工圖比對，檢查焊瘤、垂直度與長度，可疑者敲擊或彎曲；不合格與補焊位置以油漆標記並記錄，全部完成後由檢驗員簽發澆置放行單。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect by floor and beam number, count studs on every beam against the shop drawing, check flash, plumbness and length, and ring or bend doubtful studs; mark and record rejects and replacements in paint, and have the inspector issue a casting release once all are complete. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：澆置前的剪力釘檢查放行單應列為混凝土澆置許可的必要文件，由結構監造簽認；補焊剪力釘須使用相同程序並重新檢查，放行單上註明補焊數量與位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make the stud inspection release a required document for the concrete pour permit, signed by the structural inspector; replacement studs use the same procedure and are re-inspected, with their number and locations noted on the release.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若澆置時程壓縮而未完成剪力釘檢查，混凝土車到場就直接澆置，缺漏或不良的剪力釘從此無法發現；之後即使樓板裂縫或撓度異常，也很難判斷是否源自剪力釘。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the casting schedule is squeezed and stud inspection is incomplete when the trucks arrive, missing or defective studs are buried for good; later slab cracking or excess deflection can then hardly be traced to the studs. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以樓層與梁編號分區檢查，每根梁清點剪力釘數量並與施工圖比對，檢查焊瘤、垂直度與長度，可疑者敲擊或彎曲；不合格與補焊位置以油漆標記並記錄，全部完成後由檢驗員簽發澆置放行單。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect by floor and beam number, count studs on every beam against the shop drawing, check flash, plumbness and length, and ring or bend doubtful studs; mark and record rejects and replacements in paint, and have the inspector issue a casting release once all are complete.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 澆置前的剪力釘檢查放行單應列為混凝土澆置許可的必要文件，由結構監造簽認；補焊剪力釘須使用相同程序並重新檢查，放行單上註明補焊數量與位置。
knowledge.textEn: Make the stud inspection release a required document for the concrete pour permit, signed by the structural inspector; replacement studs use the same procedure and are re-inspected, with their number and locations noted on the release.

quiz.question: 要驗證「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Visual, ring and replacement checks"?
options: 以樓層與梁編號分區檢查，每根梁清點剪力釘數量並與施工圖比對，檢查焊瘤、垂直度與長度，可疑者敲擊或彎曲。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
optionsEn: Inspect by floor and beam number, count studs on every beam against the shop drawing, check flash, plumbness and length, and ring or bend doubtful studs.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.
quiz.explanation: 以樓層與梁編號分區檢查，每根梁清點剪力釘數量並與施工圖比對，檢查焊瘤、垂直度與長度，可疑者敲擊或彎曲；不合格與補焊位置以油漆標記並記錄，全部完成後由檢驗員簽發澆置放行單。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect by floor and beam number, count studs on every beam against the shop drawing, check flash, plumbness and length, and ring or bend doubtful studs; mark and record rejects and replacements in paint, and have the inspector issue a casting release once all are complete. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Visual, ring and replacement checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「360° 焊瘤與敲擊聲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “360° flash and hammer ring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若澆置時程壓縮而未完成剪力釘檢查，混凝土車到場就直接澆置，缺漏或不良的剪力釘從此無法發現；之後即使樓板裂縫或撓度異常，也很難判斷是否源自剪力釘。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the casting schedule is squeezed and stud inspection is incomplete when the trucks arrive, missing or defective studs are buried for good; later slab cracking or excess deflection can then hardly be traced to the studs. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於混凝土澆置後無法再檢查，檢驗必須在澆置前完成並放行，這是整個組合樓板最關鍵的停留點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because nothing can be checked once concrete is placed, inspection must be completed and released before casting, the single most critical hold point for a composite floor.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若澆置時程壓縮而未完成剪力釘檢查，混凝土車到場就直接澆置，缺漏或不良的剪力釘從此無法發現；之後即使樓板裂縫或撓度異常，也很難判斷是否源自剪力釘。
knowledge.textEn: If the casting schedule is squeezed and stud inspection is incomplete when the trucks arrive, missing or defective studs are buried for good; later slab cracking or excess deflection can then hardly be traced to the studs.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外觀、敲擊與補焊檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Visual, ring and replacement checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若澆置時程壓縮而未完成剪力釘檢查，混凝土車到場就直接澆置，缺漏或不良的剪力釘從此無法發現；之後即使樓板裂縫或撓度異常，也很難判斷是否源自剪力釘。
剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If the casting schedule is squeezed and stud inspection is incomplete when the trucks arrive, missing or defective studs are buried for good.
Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
quiz.explanation: 若澆置時程壓縮而未完成剪力釘檢查，混凝土車到場就直接澆置，缺漏或不良的剪力釘從此無法發現；之後即使樓板裂縫或撓度異常，也很難判斷是否源自剪力釘。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the casting schedule is squeezed and stud inspection is incomplete when the trucks arrive, missing or defective studs are buried for good; later slab cracking or excess deflection can then hardly be traced to the studs. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Push-out tests and stud resistance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「推出試驗試體」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Push-out test specimen” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力釘在特定壓型鋼板、混凝土與焊接條件下的強度與滑移能力，可用推出試驗直接量測：把焊有剪力釘的短鋼梁夾在兩塊混凝土板之間，從上方推壓鋼梁，記錄載重與滑移，直到剪力釘或混凝土破壞。歐洲規範 EN 1994-1-1 以特徵滑移能力至少 6 mm 作為延性剪力釘的條件，並提供由試驗結果求取設計強度的方法。新型壓型鋼板、特殊剪力釘或非標準焊接條件，都應以推出試驗確認。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「推出試驗試體」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The strength and slip capacity of studs with a particular deck, concrete and welding condition can be measured directly by push-out tests: a short steel section with studs is sandwiched between two concrete slabs and pushed down while load and slip are recorded until the studs or concrete fail. EN 1994-1-1 treats studs as ductile when their characteristic slip capacity is at least 6 mm and gives a procedure for deriving design resistance from tests. New deck profiles, special connectors or non-standard welding conditions should be confirmed by push-out testing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Push-out test specimen” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：三組推出試驗每支剪力釘破壞載重 92、88、95 kN，平均約 91.7 kN，各值偏差都在 10% 以內；特徵強度取最小值的 0.9 倍：P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN，設計強度 P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Three push-out tests give failure loads per stud of 92, 88 and 95 kN, a mean of about 91.7 kN with every result within 10%; the characteristic resistance is 0.9 times the minimum, P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN, and the design resistance P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「推出試驗試體」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Push-out test specimen”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證
knowledge.text: 剪力釘在特定壓型鋼板、混凝土與焊接條件下的強度與滑移能力，可用推出試驗直接量測：把焊有剪力釘的短鋼梁夾在兩塊混凝土板之間，從上方推壓鋼梁，記錄載重與滑移，直到剪力釘或混凝土破壞。歐洲規範 EN 1994-1-1 以特徵滑移能力至少 6 mm 作為延性剪力釘的條件，並提供由試驗結果求取設計強度的方法。
knowledge.textEn: The strength and slip capacity of studs with a particular deck, concrete and welding condition can be measured directly by push-out tests: a short steel section with studs is sandwiched between two concrete slabs and pushed down while load and slip are recorded until the studs or concrete fail. EN 1994-1-1 treats studs as ductile when their characteristic slip capacity is at least 6 mm and gives a procedure for deriving design resistance from tests.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Push-out tests and stud resistance" is correct?
options: 剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。
組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
剪力釘在特定壓型鋼板、混凝土與焊接條件下的強度與滑移能力，可用推出試驗直接量測：把焊有剪力釘的短鋼梁夾在兩塊混凝土板之間，從上方推壓鋼梁，記錄載重與滑移，直到剪力釘或混凝土破壞。
optionsEn: Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape.
The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.

The strength and slip capacity of studs with a particular deck, concrete and welding condition can be measured directly by push-out tests: a short steel section with studs is sandwiched between two concrete slabs and pushed down while load and slip are recorded until the studs or concrete fail.

quiz.explanationEn: The strength and slip capacity of studs with a particular deck, concrete and welding condition can be measured directly by push-out tests: a short steel section with studs is sandwiched between two concrete slabs and pushed down while load and slip are recorded until the studs or concrete fail. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Push-out tests and stud resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「推出試驗試體」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Push-out test specimen” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三組推出試驗每支剪力釘破壞載重 92、88、95 kN，平均約 91.7 kN，各值偏差都在 10% 以內；特徵強度取最小值的 0.9 倍：P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN，設計強度 P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Three push-out tests give failure loads per stud of 92, 88 and 95 kN, a mean of about 91.7 kN with every result within 10%; the characteristic resistance is 0.9 times the minimum, P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN, and the design resistance P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試體須使用與實際工程相同的壓型鋼板、剪力釘批次、焊接設定與混凝土配比，並在試驗當天量測混凝土強度；記錄完整的載重—滑移曲線，確認破壞模式（剪力釘剪斷、混凝土劈裂或拔出）與滑移能力是否滿足延性條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Specimens must use the same deck, stud lot, welding settings and concrete mix as the project, with concrete strength measured on test day; record the full load–slip curve and confirm the failure mode (stud shear, concrete splitting or pull-out) and whether slip capacity meets the ductility condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 三組推出試驗每支剪力釘破壞載重 92、88、95 kN，平均約 91.7 kN，各值偏差都在 10% 以內；特徵強度取最小值的 0.9 倍：P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN，設計強度 P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Three push-out tests give failure loads per stud of 92, 88 and 95 kN, a mean of about 91.7 kN with every result within 10%; the characteristic resistance is 0.9 times the minimum, P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN, and the design resistance P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Push-out tests and stud resistance", which statement holds?
options: 三組推出試驗每支剪力釘破壞載重 92、88、95 kN，平均約 91.7 kN，各值偏差都在 10% 以內。
混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
optionsEn: Three push-out tests give failure loads per stud of 92, 88 and 95 kN, a mean of about 91.7 kN with every result within 10%.
A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
quiz.explanation: 三組推出試驗每支剪力釘破壞載重 92、88、95 kN，平均約 91.7 kN，各值偏差都在 10% 以內；特徵強度取最小值的 0.9 倍：P_Rk = 0.9×88 = 79.2 kN，設計強度 P_Rd = P_Rk/γ_V = 79.2/1.25 ≈ 63.4 kN。 重算時請保留單位。

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Push-out tests and stud resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「推出試驗試體」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Push-out test specimen” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試體須使用與實際工程相同的壓型鋼板、剪力釘批次、焊接設定與混凝土配比，並在試驗當天量測混凝土強度；記錄完整的載重—滑移曲線，確認破壞模式（剪力釘剪斷、混凝土劈裂或拔出）與滑移能力是否滿足延性條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Specimens must use the same deck, stud lot, welding settings and concrete mix as the project, with concrete strength measured on test day; record the full load–slip curve and confirm the failure mode (stud shear, concrete splitting or pull-out) and whether slip capacity meets the ductility condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採用新型壓型鋼板或非標準剪力釘配置時，設計者應要求供應商提供依規範進行的推出試驗報告，並在設計說明中註明採用的強度與延性依據；報告須涵蓋實際使用的剪力釘位置與數量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When a new deck profile or non-standard stud layout is used, the designer should require the supplier's code-compliant push-out test reports and state the adopted resistance and ductility basis in the design notes; the reports must cover the actual stud positions and numbers used.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以標準平板的試驗結果套用到肋高較大、肋寬較窄的新型鋼承板，實際破壞可能由混凝土肋劈裂控制，強度與滑移能力都低於假設，部分組合梁的塑性設計前提隨之失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying solid-slab test results to a new deep, narrow-rib deck can miss that failure is governed by rib splitting, with strength and slip capacity both below assumption, invalidating the plastic design premise of partially composite beams. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試體須使用與實際工程相同的壓型鋼板、剪力釘批次、焊接設定與混凝土配比，並在試驗當天量測混凝土強度；記錄完整的載重—滑移曲線，確認破壞模式（剪力釘剪斷、混凝土劈裂或拔出）與滑移能力是否滿足延性條件。
knowledge.textEn: Specimens must use the same deck, stud lot, welding settings and concrete mix as the project, with concrete strength measured on test day; record the full load–slip curve and confirm the failure mode (stud shear, concrete splitting or pull-out) and whether slip capacity meets the ductility condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採用新型壓型鋼板或非標準剪力釘配置時，設計者應要求供應商提供依規範進行的推出試驗報告，並在設計說明中註明採用的強度與延性依據；報告須涵蓋實際使用的剪力釘位置與數量。
knowledge.textEn: When a new deck profile or non-standard stud layout is used, the designer should require the supplier's code-compliant push-out test reports and state the adopted resistance and ductility basis in the design notes; the reports must cover the actual stud positions and numbers used.

quiz.question: 要驗證「推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Push-out tests and stud resistance"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
試體須使用與實際工程相同的壓型鋼板、剪力釘批次、焊接設定與混凝土配比，並在試驗當天量測混凝土強度。
剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Specimens must use the same deck, stud lot, welding settings and concrete mix as the project, with concrete strength measured on test day.
Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.
quiz.explanation: 試體須使用與實際工程相同的壓型鋼板、剪力釘批次、焊接設定與混凝土配比，並在試驗當天量測混凝土強度；記錄完整的載重—滑移曲線，確認破壞模式（剪力釘剪斷、混凝土劈裂或拔出）與滑移能力是否滿足延性條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Specimens must use the same deck, stud lot, welding settings and concrete mix as the project, with concrete strength measured on test day; record the full load–slip curve and confirm the failure mode (stud shear, concrete splitting or pull-out) and whether slip capacity meets the ductility condition. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Push-out tests and stud resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「推出試驗試體」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Push-out test specimen” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以標準平板的試驗結果套用到肋高較大、肋寬較窄的新型鋼承板，實際破壞可能由混凝土肋劈裂控制，強度與滑移能力都低於假設，部分組合梁的塑性設計前提隨之失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying solid-slab test results to a new deep, narrow-rib deck can miss that failure is governed by rib splitting, with strength and slip capacity both below assumption, invalidating the plastic design premise of partially composite beams. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：新型壓型鋼板、特殊剪力釘或非標準焊接條件，都應以推出試驗確認。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: New deck profiles, special connectors or non-standard welding conditions should be confirmed by push-out testing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力釘強度只取決於鋼材強度，與混凝土和鋼承板形狀無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stud strength depends only on the steel, not on the concrete or deck shape." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以標準平板的試驗結果套用到肋高較大、肋寬較窄的新型鋼承板，實際破壞可能由混凝土肋劈裂控制，強度與滑移能力都低於假設，部分組合梁的塑性設計前提隨之失效。
knowledge.textEn: Applying solid-slab test results to a new deep, narrow-rib deck can miss that failure is governed by rib splitting, with strength and slip capacity both below assumption, invalidating the plastic design premise of partially composite beams.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「推出試驗與剪力釘強度驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Push-out tests and stud resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
若以標準平板的試驗結果套用到肋高較大、肋寬較窄的新型鋼承板，實際破壞可能由混凝土肋劈裂控制，強度與滑移能力都低於假設，部分組合梁的塑性設計前提隨之失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.

Applying solid-slab test results to a new deep, narrow-rib deck can miss that failure is governed by rib splitting, with strength and slip capacity both below assumption, invalidating the plastic design premise of partially composite beams.
quiz.explanation: 若以標準平板的試驗結果套用到肋高較大、肋寬較窄的新型鋼承板，實際破壞可能由混凝土肋劈裂控制，強度與滑移能力都低於假設，部分組合梁的塑性設計前提隨之失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying solid-slab test results to a new deep, narrow-rib deck can miss that failure is governed by rib splitting, with strength and slip capacity both below assumption, invalidating the plastic design premise of partially composite beams. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板」與「剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Composite floors under fire and thermal effects" and "Stud records, alterations and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite floors under fire and thermal effects: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 剪力釘讓鋼梁與樓板連成一體，這在常溫下是優點，在火災中卻會帶來另一種力：受熱的組合梁膨脹時被周圍結構束制，產生很大的軸向推力，推向梁端接頭與相鄰大梁。NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓的調查指出，樓板梁以剪力釘與混凝土組合，長跨樓板梁在遠低於一般設計考慮的溫度下熱膨脹，推動一根關鍵大梁離開其在 79 號柱的支承座，引發樓板連續破壞與柱挫屈；NIST 建議設計時檢討組合樓板與未考慮熱效應之接頭的熱膨脹影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Studs make the steel beam and slab act as one, an advantage at normal temperature that brings a different force in fire: a heated composite beam expands against surrounding restraint and develops large axial thrust on its end connections and adjacent girders. NIST's investigation of 7 World Trade Center found that floor beams, made composite with the slab by shear studs, expanded on long spans at temperatures far below those normally considered in design and pushed a key girder off its seat at Column 79, starting progressive floor failures and column buckling; NIST recommended evaluating thermal expansion in buildings with composite floor systems and connections not designed for thermal effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板
knowledge.titleEn: Composite floors under fire and thermal effects
knowledge.text: 剪力釘讓鋼梁與樓板連成一體，這在常溫下是優點，在火災中卻會帶來另一種力：受熱的組合梁膨脹時被周圍結構束制，產生很大的軸向推力，推向梁端接頭與相鄰大梁。NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓的調查指出，樓板梁以剪力釘與混凝土組合，長跨樓板梁在遠低於一般設計考慮的溫度下熱膨脹，推動一根關鍵大梁離開其在 79 號柱的支承座，引發樓板連續破壞與柱挫屈；NIST 建議設計時檢討組合樓板與未考慮熱效應之接頭的熱膨脹影響。
knowledge.textEn: Studs make the steel beam and slab act as one, an advantage at normal temperature that brings a different force in fire: a heated composite beam expands against surrounding restraint and develops large axial thrust on its end connections and adjacent girders. NIST's investigation of 7 World Trade Center found that floor beams, made composite with the slab by shear studs, expanded on long spans at temperatures far below those normally considered in design and pushed a key girder off its seat at Column 79, starting progressive floor failures and column buckling; NIST recommended evaluating thermal expansion in buildings with composite floor systems and connections not designed for thermal effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Composite floors under fire and thermal effects" is correct?
options: 剪力釘讓鋼梁與樓板連成一體，這在常溫下是優點，在火災中卻會帶來另一種力：受熱的組合梁膨脹時被周圍結構束制，產生很大的軸向推力，推向梁端接頭與相鄰大梁。
組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。
剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
optionsEn: Studs make the steel beam and slab act as one, an advantage at normal temperature that brings a different force in fire: a heated composite beam expands against surrounding restraint and develops large axial thrust on its end connections and adjacent girders.
The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire.
Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
quiz.explanation: 剪力釘讓鋼梁與樓板連成一體，這在常溫下是優點，在火災中卻會帶來另一種力：受熱的組合梁膨脹時被周圍結構束制，產生很大的軸向推力，推向梁端接頭與相鄰大梁。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Studs make the steel beam and slab act as one, an advantage at normal temperature that brings a different force in fire: a heated composite beam expands against surrounding restraint and develops large axial thrust on its end connections and adjacent girders. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Composite floors under fire and thermal effects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。15 m 長的樓板梁、α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、升溫 400°C：ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×15,000×400 = 72 mm。若梁端支承只有約 100 mm 的餘裕，在完全無束制下升溫約 100/(12×10⁻⁶×15,000) ≈ 556°C 即可推離。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. A 15 m floor beam with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C heated by 400°C grows ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×15,000×400 = 72 mm. If its end bearing has only about 100 mm of margin, an unrestrained rise of about 100/(12×10⁻⁶×15,000) ≈ 556°C pushes it off. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：性能式防火設計時，以考慮熱膨脹與束制的分析檢查長跨組合梁的端部接頭、支承座寬度與相鄰大梁的側向力；施工時核對防火被覆範圍是否涵蓋接頭與剪力釘附近的翼板，避免局部高溫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In performance-based fire design, analyse long-span composite beams with thermal expansion and restraint to check end connections, seat widths and lateral forces on adjacent girders; during construction, confirm that fireproofing covers connections and flanges near the studs to avoid local hot spots.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。15 m 長的樓板梁、α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、升溫 400°C：ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×15,000×400 = 72 mm。若梁端支承只有約 100 mm 的餘裕，在完全無束制下升溫約 100/(12×10⁻⁶×15,000) ≈ 556°C 即可推離。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. A 15 m floor beam with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C heated by 400°C grows ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×15,000×400 = 72 mm. If its end bearing has only about 100 mm of margin, an unrestrained rise of about 100/(12×10⁻⁶×15,000) ≈ 556°C pushes it off. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Composite floors under fire and thermal effects", which statement holds?
options: 部分組合梁只影響強度，不影響撓度與振動。
熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
只要剪力釘焊在鋼承板上站得住，就代表已與鋼梁焊牢。
optionsEn: Partial composite action affects only strength, not deflection or vibration.
Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
If a stud stands firm on the deck, it must be welded to the beam.
quiz.explanation: 熱膨脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Composite floors under fire and thermal effects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 性能式防火設計時，以考慮熱膨脹與束制的分析檢查長跨組合梁的端部接頭、支承座寬度與相鄰大梁的側向力；施工時核對防火被覆範圍是否涵蓋接頭與剪力釘附近的翼板，避免局部高溫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In performance-based fire design, analyse long-span composite beams with thermal expansion and restraint to check end connections, seat widths and lateral forces on adjacent girders; during construction, confirm that fireproofing covers connections and flanges near the studs to avoid local hot spots. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：長跨組合樓板的防火與接頭設計應由結構與防火工程師共同檢討熱膨脹路徑，並在圖說中標示需特別防護或容許位移的接頭；這類變更須經主管機關審查，本課只說明原理，不代替防火設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural and fire engineers should jointly review thermal-expansion paths in long-span composite floors and mark on the drawings the connections needing special protection or movement allowance; such changes require authority review, and this course explains principles only, not fire design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若接頭只依重力剪力設計，未考慮熱膨脹產生的軸向力與位移，火災時樓板梁推動大梁或剪斷接頭螺栓，樓板失去支承後層層掉落，最後連帶柱的側向支撐失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If connections are designed only for gravity shear, without thermal axial force and movement, fire-heated floor beams push girders or shear connection bolts, unsupported floors fall one onto another, and columns lose their lateral bracing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 性能式防火設計時，以考慮熱膨脹與束制的分析檢查長跨組合梁的端部接頭、支承座寬度與相鄰大梁的側向力；施工時核對防火被覆範圍是否涵蓋接頭與剪力釘附近的翼板，避免局部高溫。
knowledge.textEn: In performance-based fire design, analyse long-span composite beams with thermal expansion and restraint to check end connections, seat widths and lateral forces on adjacent girders; during construction, confirm that fireproofing covers connections and flanges near the studs to avoid local hot spots.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 長跨組合樓板的防火與接頭設計應由結構與防火工程師共同檢討熱膨脹路徑，並在圖說中標示需特別防護或容許位移的接頭；這類變更須經主管機關審查，本課只說明原理，不代替防火設計。
knowledge.textEn: Structural and fire engineers should jointly review thermal-expansion paths in long-span composite floors and mark on the drawings the connections needing special protection or movement allowance; such changes require authority review, and this course explains principles only, not fire design.

quiz.question: 要驗證「火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Composite floors under fire and thermal effects"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
被敲彎做試驗的剪力釘已經受損，必須割除重焊。
性能式防火設計時，以考慮熱膨脹與束制的分析檢查長跨組合梁的端部接頭、支承座寬度與相鄰大梁的側向力。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A stud bent in the test is damaged and must be cut off and rewelded.
In performance-based fire design, analyse long-span composite beams with thermal expansion and restraint to check end connections, seat widths and lateral forces on adjacent girders.
quiz.explanation: 性能式防火設計時，以考慮熱膨脹與束制的分析檢查長跨組合梁的端部接頭、支承座寬度與相鄰大梁的側向力；施工時核對防火被覆範圍是否涵蓋接頭與剪力釘附近的翼板，避免局部高溫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In performance-based fire design, analyse long-span composite beams with thermal expansion and restraint to check end connections, seat widths and lateral forces on adjacent girders; during construction, confirm that fireproofing covers connections and flanges near the studs to avoid local hot spots. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Composite floors under fire and thermal effects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板熱膨脹與梁端接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Floor thermal expansion and beam-end connections” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若接頭只依重力剪力設計，未考慮熱膨脹產生的軸向力與位移，火災時樓板梁推動大梁或剪斷接頭螺栓，樓板失去支承後層層掉落，最後連帶柱的側向支撐失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If connections are designed only for gravity shear, without thermal axial force and movement, fire-heated floor beams push girders or shear connection bolts, unsupported floors fall one onto another, and columns lose their lateral bracing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓的調查指出，樓板梁以剪力釘與混凝土組合，長跨樓板梁在遠低於一般設計考慮的溫度下熱膨脹，推動一根關鍵大梁離開其在 79 號柱的支承座，引發樓板連續破壞與柱挫屈；NIST 建議設計時檢討組合樓板與未考慮熱效應之接頭的熱膨脹影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: NIST's investigation of 7 World Trade Center found that floor beams, made composite with the slab by shear studs, expanded on long spans at temperatures far below those normally considered in design and pushed a key girder off its seat at Column 79, starting progressive floor failures and column buckling; NIST recommended evaluating thermal expansion in buildings with composite floor systems and connections not designed for thermal effects.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「組合樓板越剛越好，火災時也一定比較安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The stiffer the composite floor, the safer it must be in fire." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若接頭只依重力剪力設計，未考慮熱膨脹產生的軸向力與位移，火災時樓板梁推動大梁或剪斷接頭螺栓，樓板失去支承後層層掉落，最後連帶柱的側向支撐失效。
knowledge.textEn: If connections are designed only for gravity shear, without thermal axial force and movement, fire-heated floor beams push girders or shear connection bolts, unsupported floors fall one onto another, and columns lose their lateral bracing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「火災與溫度效應下的組合樓板」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Composite floors under fire and thermal effects" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若接頭只依重力剪力設計，未考慮熱膨脹產生的軸向力與位移，火災時樓板梁推動大梁或剪斷接頭螺栓，樓板失去支承後層層掉落，最後連帶柱的側向支撐失效。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
optionsEn: If connections are designed only for gravity shear, without thermal axial force and movement, fire-heated floor beams push girders or shear connection bolts, unsupported floors fall one onto another, and columns lose their lateral bracing.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
quiz.explanation: 若接頭只依重力剪力設計，未考慮熱膨脹產生的軸向力與位移，火災時樓板梁推動大梁或剪斷接頭螺栓，樓板失去支承後層層掉落，最後連帶柱的側向支撐失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If connections are designed only for gravity shear, without thermal axial force and movement, fire-heated floor beams push girders or shear connection bolts, unsupported floors fall one onto another, and columns lose their lateral bracing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stud records, alterations and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」如何影響組合樓板剪力釘焊接的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stud layout and inspection records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Stud welding for composite floor systems”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 樓板完成後剪力釘全部埋在混凝土中，日後改修時工程師只能依賴紀錄判斷樓板與梁的組合程度。不同年代的組合樓板做法也不同：NIST 描述世界貿易中心雙子塔的樓板以輕型鋼桁架支承 4 in 厚的輕質混凝土，桁架腹桿頂端彎折的「指節」伸出上弦約 3 in 埋入樓板而產生組合作用，而不是焊接剪力釘。改修時若在梁旁開大洞、切除樓板或增加重載設備，都可能減少有效的剪力連接，必須依原始紀錄重新檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once the slab is cast, every stud is buried, and engineers altering the floor later can judge composite action only from records. Composite floors also differ by era: NIST describes the Twin Towers' floors as 4 in of lightweight concrete on light steel trusses whose bent web tops, the knuckles, projected about 3 in above the top chord into the slab to create composite action, rather than welded studs. Cutting large openings beside beams, removing slab or adding heavy equipment during alterations can reduce effective shear connection, so the original records must be used to recheck it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stud layout and inspection records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原設計半跨 20 支剪力釘、每支 76.5 kN，組合比 58%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The original design has 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, a 58% ratio.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stud layout and inspection records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接
knowledge.text: 樓板完成後剪力釘全部埋在混凝土中，日後改修時工程師只能依賴紀錄判斷樓板與梁的組合程度。不同年代的組合樓板做法也不同：NIST 描述世界貿易中心雙子塔的樓板以輕型鋼桁架支承 4 in 厚的輕質混凝土，桁架腹桿頂端彎折的「指節」伸出上弦約 3 in 埋入樓板而產生組合作用，而不是焊接剪力釘。
knowledge.textEn: Once the slab is cast, every stud is buried, and engineers altering the floor later can judge composite action only from records. Composite floors also differ by era: NIST describes the Twin Towers' floors as 4 in of lightweight concrete on light steel trusses whose bent web tops, the knuckles, projected about 3 in above the top chord into the slab to create composite action, rather than welded studs.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stud records, alterations and handover" is correct?
options: 剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。
樓板完成後剪力釘全部埋在混凝土中，日後改修時工程師只能依賴紀錄判斷樓板與梁的組合程度。
混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
optionsEn: Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them.
Once the slab is cast, every stud is buried, and engineers altering the floor later can judge composite action only from records.
A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
quiz.explanation: 樓板完成後剪力釘全部埋在混凝土中，日後改修時工程師只能依賴紀錄判斷樓板與梁的組合程度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once the slab is cast, every stud is buried, and engineers altering the floor later can judge composite action only from records. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stud records, alterations and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stud layout and inspection records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原設計半跨 20 支剪力釘、每支 76.5 kN，組合比 58%。改修時沿梁開 1.2 m 寬的洞，切除 4 個肋內的剪力釘：剩 16 支，ΣQ_n = 16×76.5 ≈ 1,224 kN，組合比降為 1,224/2,619 ≈ 47%，須確認仍高於設計者設定的最低組合比並重新檢核強度與撓度。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The original design has 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, a 58% ratio. An alteration cutting a 1.2 m opening along the beam removes the studs in 4 ribs, leaving 16: ΣQ_n = 16×76.5 ≈ 1,224 kN and the ratio falls to 1,224/2,619 ≈ 47%, which must be confirmed above the designer's minimum ratio, with strength and deflection rechecked. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前核對竣工剪力釘配置圖與焊接日誌、首件試驗紀錄、澆置放行單是否一一對應；改修設計前，以紀錄確認原組合比，必要時以鑽心或局部打除樓板抽查剪力釘實際位置與狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, check that the as-built stud layout matches the welding logs, first-stud test records and casting releases one for one; before designing an alteration, confirm the original composite ratio from the records and, if needed, core or locally break out the slab to verify actual stud positions and condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原設計半跨 20 支剪力釘、每支 76.5 kN，組合比 58%。改修時沿梁開 1.2 m 寬的洞，切除 4 個肋內的剪力釘：剩 16 支，ΣQ_n = 16×76.5 ≈ 1,224 kN，組合比降為 1,224/2,619 ≈ 47%，須確認仍高於設計者設定的最低組合比並重新檢核強度與撓度。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The original design has 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, a 58% ratio. An alteration cutting a 1.2 m opening along the beam removes the studs in 4 ribs, leaving 16: ΣQ_n = 16×76.5 ≈ 1,224 kN and the ratio falls to 1,224/2,619 ≈ 47%, which must be confirmed above the designer's minimum ratio, with strength and deflection rechecked. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stud records, alterations and handover", which statement holds?
options: 剪力釘越長、越粗，強度就一定成比例提高。
剪力釘焊接是自動化的，設定一次就可以整天使用。
原設計半跨 20 支剪力釘、每支 76.5 kN，組合比 58%。
optionsEn: Longer and thicker studs always give proportionally higher strength.
Stud welding is automatic, so one setting serves all day.
The original design has 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, a 58% ratio.
quiz.explanation: 原設計半跨 20 支剪力釘、每支 76.5 kN，組合比 58%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The original design has 20 studs of 76.5 kN per half span, a 58% ratio. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stud records, alterations and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stud layout and inspection records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前核對竣工剪力釘配置圖與焊接日誌、首件試驗紀錄、澆置放行單是否一一對應；改修設計前，以紀錄確認原組合比，必要時以鑽心或局部打除樓板抽查剪力釘實際位置與狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, check that the as-built stud layout matches the welding logs, first-stud test records and casting releases one for one; before designing an alteration, confirm the original composite ratio from the records and, if needed, core or locally break out the slab to verify actual stud positions and condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含每根組合梁的剪力釘數量與位置、壓型鋼板型號、組合比、首件試驗與放行紀錄；建物管理規則要求樓板開孔或重型設備進駐前須經結構工程師核准，並更新紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include each composite beam's stud count and positions, deck type, composite ratio, first-stud test and release records; building management rules should require the structural engineer's approval, and a records update, before any slab opening or heavy equipment installation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若竣工圖沒有剪力釘資料，改修設計者只能假設梁為非組合，導致不必要的補強；反之若誤以為所有梁都完全組合，在梁旁開洞或加設備後，可能使樓板撓度與振動明顯增加，甚至超過強度餘裕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without stud data in the as-builts, an alteration designer must assume non-composite beams and strengthen needlessly; conversely, wrongly assuming full composite action everywhere can let openings or new equipment beside beams markedly increase deflection and vibration, or even exceed the strength margin. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前核對竣工剪力釘配置圖與焊接日誌、首件試驗紀錄、澆置放行單是否一一對應；改修設計前，以紀錄確認原組合比，必要時以鑽心或局部打除樓板抽查剪力釘實際位置與狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, check that the as-built stud layout matches the welding logs, first-stud test records and casting releases one for one; before designing an alteration, confirm the original composite ratio from the records and, if needed, core or locally break out the slab to verify actual stud positions and condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含每根組合梁的剪力釘數量與位置、壓型鋼板型號、組合比、首件試驗與放行紀錄；建物管理規則要求樓板開孔或重型設備進駐前須經結構工程師核准，並更新紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include each composite beam's stud count and positions, deck type, composite ratio, first-stud test and release records; building management rules should require the structural engineer's approval, and a records update, before any slab opening or heavy equipment installation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stud records, alterations and handover"?
options: 交接前核對竣工剪力釘配置圖與焊接日誌、首件試驗紀錄、澆置放行單是否一一對應；改修設計前，以紀錄確認原組合比，必要時以鑽心或局部打除樓板抽查剪力釘實際位置與狀態。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
剪力釘只要數量正確，焊接品質可以等澆置後再抽查。
optionsEn: Before handover, check that the as-built stud layout matches the welding logs, first-stud test records and casting releases one for one.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the stud count is right, weld quality can be spot-checked after casting.
quiz.explanation: 交接前核對竣工剪力釘配置圖與焊接日誌、首件試驗紀錄、澆置放行單是否一一對應；改修設計前，以紀錄確認原組合比，必要時以鑽心或局部打除樓板抽查剪力釘實際位置與狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, check that the as-built stud layout matches the welding logs, first-stud test records and casting releases one for one; before designing an alteration, confirm the original composite ratio from the records and, if needed, core or locally break out the slab to verify actual stud positions and condition. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stud records, alterations and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剪力釘配置圖與檢查紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stud layout and inspection records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若竣工圖沒有剪力釘資料，改修設計者只能假設梁為非組合，導致不必要的補強；反之若誤以為所有梁都完全組合，在梁旁開洞或加設備後，可能使樓板撓度與振動明顯增加，甚至超過強度餘裕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without stud data in the as-builts, an alteration designer must assume non-composite beams and strengthen needlessly; conversely, wrongly assuming full composite action everywhere can let openings or new equipment beside beams markedly increase deflection and vibration, or even exceed the strength margin. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：改修時若在梁旁開大洞、切除樓板或增加重載設備，都可能減少有效的剪力連接，必須依原始紀錄重新檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cutting large openings beside beams, removing slab or adding heavy equipment during alterations can reduce effective shear connection, so the original records must be used to recheck it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力釘埋在混凝土裡，日後改修不必考慮它們。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Studs are buried in concrete, so later alterations need not consider them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若竣工圖沒有剪力釘資料，改修設計者只能假設梁為非組合，導致不必要的補強；反之若誤以為所有梁都完全組合，在梁旁開洞或加設備後，可能使樓板撓度與振動明顯增加，甚至超過強度餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Without stud data in the as-builts, an alteration designer must assume non-composite beams and strengthen needlessly; conversely, wrongly assuming full composite action everywhere can let openings or new equipment beside beams markedly increase deflection and vibration, or even exceed the strength margin.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剪力釘紀錄、改修與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stud records, alterations and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若竣工圖沒有剪力釘資料，改修設計者只能假設梁為非組合，導致不必要的補強。
混凝土樓板放在鋼梁上，自然就會和鋼梁一起受力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without stud data in the as-builts, an alteration designer must assume non-composite beams and strengthen needlessly.
A concrete slab resting on a steel beam automatically works together with it.
quiz.explanation: 若竣工圖沒有剪力釘資料，改修設計者只能假設梁為非組合，導致不必要的補強；反之若誤以為所有梁都完全組合，在梁旁開洞或加設備後，可能使樓板撓度與振動明顯增加，甚至超過強度餘裕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without stud data in the as-builts, an alteration designer must assume non-composite beams and strengthen needlessly; conversely, wrongly assuming full composite action everywhere can let openings or new equipment beside beams markedly increase deflection and vibration, or even exceed the strength margin. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工
courses.summary: 剪力牆是高層與中高層建築最主要的側力抵抗構件，其耐震表現取決於牆端邊界構材的圍束、縱筋續接位置、施工縫處理與混凝土在密集鋼筋中的密實度。本課以哈里發塔的扶壁式核心牆、亞特蘭大電梯試驗塔的滑模核心牆，以及 2011 年基督城 CTV 大樓倒塌後皇家調查委員會的檢討為背景，說明側力分配、邊界構材需求、圍束配筋、續接、鋼筋間距與骨材、澆置振搗、強度驗收、澆置前查驗、震後損傷判讀與開孔變更管控。
courses.summaryEn: Shear walls are the main lateral-force-resisting members of mid- and high-rise buildings, and their seismic performance depends on confinement of boundary elements, the location of longitudinal splices, treatment of construction joints and the compaction of concrete within dense reinforcement. Against the background of Burj Khalifa's buttressed core walls, the slipformed core walls of the Atlanta elevator test tower and the Royal Commission's review after the 2011 collapse of the CTV Building in Christchurch, the course covers lateral force sharing, boundary-element demand, confinement detailing, splices, bar spacing and aggregate size, placing and vibration, strength acceptance, pre-pour inspection, post-earthquake damage interpretation and control of later openings.
courses.focus: 把設計圖上的韌性剪力牆真正做出來：邊界構材圍束、續接、鋼筋擁擠下的澆置與驗收
courses.focusEn: Building the ductile shear wall the drawings describe: boundary confinement, splices, placing concrete through congested steel, and acceptance
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計檢核練習：一道長 l_w = 8 m、厚 400 mm 的剪力牆，f′_c = 42 MPa、f_y = 420 MPa，設計位移比 δ_u/h_w = 0.01，分析得中性軸深度 c = 1,100 mm。邊界構材門檻 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm，c 超過門檻，需特殊邊界構材，延伸長度 max(1,100 − 800, 550) = 550 mm，取 600 mm。圍束：邊界 400×600 mm、核心 320×520 mm，A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442，0.3×0.442×42/420 ≈ 0.0133 控制，s = 100 mm 時 A_sh ≥ 425 mm²，用 4 肢 D13（507 mm²）。剪力強度 V_n = 3.2×10⁶×(0.17×6.48 + 0.0025×420) ≈ 6,886 kN，φV_n = 0.75×6,886 ≈ 5,164 kN。縱筋 D25 的 B 類搭接約 1,240 mm，若全部在同一斷面搭接，邊界淨間距由約 92 mm 降到約 27 mm，故改為錯開或使用續接器。若設計位移比提高到 0.015，門檻降為 8,000/(600×0.0225) ≈ 593 mm，邊界構材需求更明確，延伸長度仍為 550 mm 但塑性鉸區的應變更高。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design check exercise: a shear wall with l_w = 8 m and 400 mm thickness has f′_c = 42 MPa, f_y = 420 MPa, a design drift ratio δ_u/h_w = 0.01 and an analysed neutral-axis depth c = 1,100 mm. The boundary threshold is 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm, which c exceeds, so a special boundary element is needed, extending max(1,100 − 800, 550) = 550 mm, taken as 600 mm. Confinement: with a 400×600 mm boundary and 320×520 mm core, A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442 and 0.3×0.442×42/420 ≈ 0.0133 governs, so at s = 100 mm A_sh ≥ 425 mm², provided by four legs of D13 (507 mm²). Shear strength is V_n = 3.2×10⁶×(0.17×6.48 + 0.0025×420) ≈ 6,886 kN and φV_n = 0.75×6,886 ≈ 5,164 kN. A Class B lap for D25 is about 1,240 mm; lapping all bars at one section would cut boundary clear spacing from about 92 mm to about 27 mm, so laps are staggered or couplers used. If the design drift ratio rises to 0.015, the threshold falls to 8,000/(600×0.0225) ≈ 593 mm, the boundary-element demand becomes clearer, and although the extent remains 550 mm the hinge-zone strains are higher. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

factsEn: Burj Khalifa is 828 m tall with 163 floors above ground, its lower part built of reinforced-concrete core, columns and floors
Each of Burj Khalifa's 3 wings has its own high-performance concrete core, buttressed through a six-sided central core
Burj Khalifa's core and wing walls range from 200 mm to 1.3 m thick

ACI 318 sets a minimum web reinforcement ratio of 0.0025 for special structural walls
ACI 318 wall shear coefficient α_c falls from 0.25 (h_w/l_w ≤ 1.5) to 0.17 (h_w/l_w ≥ 2.0)
