steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The data also feed back into construction; for example, a darker lower zone prompts a review of vibration and paste flotation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「清水混凝土的外觀好壞只能靠主觀感覺判斷，無法量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The appearance of exposed concrete can only be judged subjectively and cannot be measured." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 拆模後第二天就在潮濕表面量色差，數據與日後乾燥後完全不同，據此要求的修補反而造成新的色斑；量測點只選在明顯缺陷處，無法代表整面牆，引發不必要的整面處理。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring colour on a damp surface the day after stripping gives data unlike the dry surface later, and repairs ordered on that basis create new blotches; choosing points only at obvious defects does not represent the wall and triggers unnecessary whole-face treatment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Quantifying colour, flatness and voids" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。
拆模後第二天就在潮濕表面量色差，數據與日後乾燥後完全不同，據此要求的修補反而造成新的色斑；量測點只選在明顯缺陷處，無法代表整面牆，引發不必要的整面處理。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan.
Measuring colour on a damp surface the day after stripping gives data unlike the dry surface later, and repairs ordered on that basis create new blotches.
quiz.explanation: 拆模後第二天就在潮濕表面量色差，數據與日後乾燥後完全不同，據此要求的修補反而造成新的色斑；量測點只選在明顯缺陷處，無法代表整面牆，引發不必要的整面處理。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring colour on a damp surface the day after stripping gives data unlike the dry surface later, and repairs ordered on that basis create new blotches; choosing points only at obvious defects does not represent the wall and triggers unnecessary whole-face treatment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「表面保護、污染與修補」與「清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Surface protection, soiling and repair" and "Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 表面保護、污染與修補：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Surface protection, soiling and repair: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「撥水保護與修補」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water-repellent protection and repair” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 清水混凝土沒有塗裝保護，表面毛細孔會吸水，雨水帶著灰塵與微生物進入表層，形成流痕與黑斑；吸水也會加速凍融、碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕。常見作法是在完工後施作滲透型撥水劑（如矽烷或矽氧烷），降低表面吸水但不改變外觀與透氣性。修補是清水混凝土最難的工作：修補砂漿必須與周圍顏色、質感一致，而且新舊材料的顏色會隨時間以不同速度變化，所以修補配方要在樣板牆上試驗並放置一段時間觀察。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「撥水保護與修補」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Exposed concrete has no paint, so surface capillaries absorb water and rain carries dust and micro-organisms into the surface layer, forming streaks and dark patches; absorption also accelerates freeze–thaw, carbonation and bar corrosion. A common measure is a penetrating water repellent such as silane or siloxane after completion, reducing absorption without changing appearance or breathability. Repair is the hardest job in exposed concrete: repair mortar must match the surrounding colour and texture, and new and old materials change colour at different rates over time, so repair recipes are trialled on the mock-up and left to weather before use. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Water-repellent protection and repair” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：毛細吸水量 W = w·√t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Capillary uptake W = w·√t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「撥水保護與修補」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Water-repellent protection and repair”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 表面保護、污染與修補
knowledge.text: 清水混凝土沒有塗裝保護，表面毛細孔會吸水，雨水帶著灰塵與微生物進入表層，形成流痕與黑斑；吸水也會加速凍融、碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕。常見作法是在完工後施作滲透型撥水劑（如矽烷或矽氧烷），降低表面吸水但不改變外觀與透氣性。
knowledge.textEn: Exposed concrete has no paint, so surface capillaries absorb water and rain carries dust and micro-organisms into the surface layer, forming streaks and dark patches; absorption also accelerates freeze–thaw, carbonation and bar corrosion. A common measure is a penetrating water repellent such as silane or siloxane after completion, reducing absorption without changing appearance or breathability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「表面保護、污染與修補」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Surface protection, soiling and repair" is correct?
options: 清水混凝土沒有塗裝保護，表面毛細孔會吸水，雨水帶著灰塵與微生物進入表層，形成流痕與黑斑；吸水也會加速凍融、碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕。
清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。
清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。
optionsEn: Exposed concrete has no paint, so surface capillaries absorb water and rain carries dust and micro-organisms into the surface layer, forming streaks and dark patches.
Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan.
Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing.
quiz.explanation: 清水混凝土沒有塗裝保護，表面毛細孔會吸水，雨水帶著灰塵與微生物進入表層，形成流痕與黑斑；吸水也會加速凍融、碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Exposed concrete has no paint, so surface capillaries absorb water and rain carries dust and micro-organisms into the surface layer, forming streaks and dark patches; absorption also accelerates freeze–thaw, carbonation and bar corrosion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 表面保護、污染與修補：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Surface protection, soiling and repair: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「撥水保護與修補」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water-repellent protection and repair” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：毛細吸水量 W = w·√t。未處理表面 w = 1.0 kg/m²·h^0.5，4 h 降雨吸水 W = 1.0×√4 = 2.0 kg/m²；以撥水劑降到 w = 0.1 時 W = 0.2 kg/m²，吸水減少 90%，表面污染與凍融風險隨之降低。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Capillary uptake W = w·√t. For an untreated surface with w = 1.0 kg/m²·h^0.5, four hours of rain absorb W = 1.0×√4 = 2.0 kg/m²; a water repellent that cuts w to 0.1 gives W = 0.2 kg/m², a 90% reduction with correspondingly less soiling and freeze–thaw risk. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：撥水劑施作前在樣板牆上試驗外觀是否改變，施作後以卡斯頓管（Karsten tube）或吸水試驗比較處理前後的吸水量；修補配方在樣板牆上試做並至少觀察數週至數月的顏色變化，再核定使用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before applying a repellent, trial it on the mock-up for any change in appearance, and afterwards compare water uptake before and after with Karsten tubes or absorption tests; trial repair recipes on the mock-up and watch colour change for at least several weeks to months before approval.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 毛細吸水量 W = w·√t。未處理表面 w = 1.0 kg/m²·h^0.5，4 h 降雨吸水 W = 1.0×√4 = 2.0 kg/m²；以撥水劑降到 w = 0.1 時 W = 0.2 kg/m²，吸水減少 90%，表面污染與凍融風險隨之降低。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Capillary uptake W = w·√t. For an untreated surface with w = 1.0 kg/m²·h^0.5, four hours of rain absorb W = 1.0×√4 = 2.0 kg/m²; a water repellent that cuts w to 0.1 gives W = 0.2 kg/m², a 90% reduction with correspondingly less soiling and freeze–thaw risk. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「表面保護、污染與修補」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Surface protection, soiling and repair", which statement holds?
options: 模板拼縫與繫桿孔只是施工痕跡，交給工地自行安排即可。
毛細吸水量 W = w·√t。
只要強度等級相同，不同預拌廠的混凝土在外觀上沒有差別。
optionsEn: Form joints and tie holes are just construction marks that the site can arrange as it likes.
Capillary uptake W = w·√t.
If the strength grade is the same, concrete from different plants looks the same.
quiz.explanation: 毛細吸水量 W = w·√t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Capillary uptake W = w·√t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 表面保護、污染與修補：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surface protection, soiling and repair: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「撥水保護與修補」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water-repellent protection and repair” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 撥水劑施作前在樣板牆上試驗外觀是否改變，施作後以卡斯頓管（Karsten tube）或吸水試驗比較處理前後的吸水量；修補配方在樣板牆上試做並至少觀察數週至數月的顏色變化，再核定使用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before applying a repellent, trial it on the mock-up for any change in appearance, and afterwards compare water uptake before and after with Karsten tubes or absorption tests; trial repair recipes on the mock-up and watch colour change for at least several weeks to months before approval. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：完工前應決定是否施作撥水劑、產品類型與重塗週期，並在樣板牆上核定；修補程序須規定誰可修補、修補範圍上限、配方與試做，並保存修補位置紀錄供日後維護比對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Decide before completion whether to apply a repellent, which type and how often to recoat, approved on the mock-up; the repair procedure should state who may repair, the maximum repair extent, recipes and trials, and keep a record of repair locations for later maintenance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture; repair mortar that matches on the day turns noticeably lighter or darker a year later, leaving the wall covered in patches. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 撥水劑施作前在樣板牆上試驗外觀是否改變，施作後以卡斯頓管（Karsten tube）或吸水試驗比較處理前後的吸水量；修補配方在樣板牆上試做並至少觀察數週至數月的顏色變化，再核定使用。
knowledge.textEn: Before applying a repellent, trial it on the mock-up for any change in appearance, and afterwards compare water uptake before and after with Karsten tubes or absorption tests; trial repair recipes on the mock-up and watch colour change for at least several weeks to months before approval.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 完工前應決定是否施作撥水劑、產品類型與重塗週期，並在樣板牆上核定；修補程序須規定誰可修補、修補範圍上限、配方與試做，並保存修補位置紀錄供日後維護比對。
knowledge.textEn: Decide before completion whether to apply a repellent, which type and how often to recoat, approved on the mock-up; the repair procedure should state who may repair, the maximum repair extent, recipes and trials, and keep a record of repair locations for later maintenance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「表面保護、污染與修補」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surface protection, soiling and repair"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
清水混凝土澆得越快越連續，表面就越均勻。
撥水劑施作前在樣板牆上試驗外觀是否改變，施作後以卡斯頓管（Karsten tube）或吸水試驗比較處理前後的吸水量。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The faster and more continuously exposed concrete is placed, the more uniform the surface.
Before applying a repellent, trial it on the mock-up for any change in appearance, and afterwards compare water uptake before and after with Karsten tubes or absorption tests.
quiz.explanation: 撥水劑施作前在樣板牆上試驗外觀是否改變，施作後以卡斯頓管（Karsten tube）或吸水試驗比較處理前後的吸水量；修補配方在樣板牆上試做並至少觀察數週至數月的顏色變化，再核定使用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before applying a repellent, trial it on the mock-up for any change in appearance, and afterwards compare water uptake before and after with Karsten tubes or absorption tests; trial repair recipes on the mock-up and watch colour change for at least several weeks to months before approval. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 表面保護、污染與修補：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surface protection, soiling and repair: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「撥水保護與修補」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water-repellent protection and repair” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture; repair mortar that matches on the day turns noticeably lighter or darker a year later, leaving the wall covered in patches. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：修補是清水混凝土最難的工作：修補砂漿必須與周圍顏色、質感一致，而且新舊材料的顏色會隨時間以不同速度變化，所以修補配方要在樣板牆上試驗並放置一段時間觀察。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Repair is the hardest job in exposed concrete: repair mortar must match the surrounding colour and texture, and new and old materials change colour at different rates over time, so repair recipes are trialled on the mock-up and left to weather before use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。
knowledge.textEn: Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture; repair mortar that matches on the day turns noticeably lighter or darker a year later, leaving the wall covered in patches.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「表面保護、污染與修補」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surface protection, soiling and repair" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。
optionsEn: Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing.
quiz.explanation: 使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture; repair mortar that matches on the day turns noticeably lighter or darker a year later, leaving the wall covered in patches. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「維護手冊與修補樣本」如何影響清水混凝土模板與澆置的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Maintenance manual and repair samples” governs force, deformation or durability in “Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 清水混凝土的外觀會隨時間演變：表面碳化使顏色略變，雨水流路形成污痕，綠藻在背陽面生長，繫桿孔塞頭可能鬆脫。沙克研究所於 1991 年被指定為歷史地標，其混凝土與柚木的保存工作顯示，清水建築的維護需要了解原始材料與工法。交接時應移交原配比、面材與脫模劑資料、撥水劑產品與施作紀錄、修補配方與樣本、樣板牆照片與量測基準，並規定可接受的清潔方法；高壓水柱或酸洗會改變表面質感，必須先試驗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「維護手冊與修補樣本」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Exposed concrete changes with time: surface carbonation shifts colour slightly, rain paths form streaks, algae grow on shaded faces and tie-hole plugs may loosen. The Salk Institute, designated a historic landmark in 1991, shows through its concrete and teak conservation work that maintaining exposed buildings requires knowing the original materials and methods. Handover should deliver the original mix, facing and release-agent data, water-repellent product and application records, repair recipes and samples, mock-up photographs and measurement baselines, and specify acceptable cleaning methods; high-pressure water or acid washing changes surface texture and must be trialled first. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Maintenance manual and repair samples” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：撥水劑用量 0.3 L/m²，清水面 2,400 m² 每次約 2,400×0.3 = 720 L；若每 12 年重塗一次，50 年內約 4 次，共約 2,880 L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 0.3 L/m², 2,400 m² of exposed surface needs about 2,400×0.3 = 720 L per application; recoating every 12 years means about 4 applications and 2,880 L over 50 years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「維護手冊與修補樣本」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Maintenance manual and repair samples”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理
knowledge.titleEn: Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance
knowledge.text: 清水混凝土的外觀會隨時間演變：表面碳化使顏色略變，雨水流路形成污痕，綠藻在背陽面生長，繫桿孔塞頭可能鬆脫。沙克研究所於 1991 年被指定為歷史地標，其混凝土與柚木的保存工作顯示，清水建築的維護需要了解原始材料與工法。
knowledge.textEn: Exposed concrete changes with time: surface carbonation shifts colour slightly, rain paths form streaks, algae grow on shaded faces and tie-hole plugs may loosen. The Salk Institute, designated a historic landmark in 1991, shows through its concrete and teak conservation work that maintaining exposed buildings requires knowing the original materials and methods.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance" is correct?
options: 清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。
清水混凝土的外觀會隨時間演變：表面碳化使顏色略變，雨水流路形成污痕，綠藻在背陽面生長，繫桿孔塞頭可能鬆脫。
清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。
optionsEn: Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing.
Exposed concrete changes with time: surface carbonation shifts colour slightly, rain paths form streaks, algae grow on shaded faces and tie-hole plugs may loosen.
Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification.
quiz.explanation: 清水混凝土的外觀會隨時間演變：表面碳化使顏色略變，雨水流路形成污痕，綠藻在背陽面生長，繫桿孔塞頭可能鬆脫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Exposed concrete changes with time: surface carbonation shifts colour slightly, rain paths form streaks, algae grow on shaded faces and tie-hole plugs may loosen. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「維護手冊與修補樣本」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Maintenance manual and repair samples” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：撥水劑用量 0.3 L/m²，清水面 2,400 m² 每次約 2,400×0.3 = 720 L；若每 12 年重塗一次，50 年內約 4 次，共約 2,880 L。把用量、施作日期與吸水試驗結果列入維護資料庫，可判斷實際重塗時機是否需要提前。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 0.3 L/m², 2,400 m² of exposed surface needs about 2,400×0.3 = 720 L per application; recoating every 12 years means about 4 applications and 2,880 L over 50 years. Recording quantities, dates and absorption-test results in a maintenance database shows whether recoating should come sooner. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：維護計畫規定定期目視檢查（污痕、藻類、裂縫、塞頭）、吸水試驗與色差量測，並與交接時的基準照片與數據比較；任何清潔或修補在不顯眼位置先試做，經建築師或維護顧問核可後才施作。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The maintenance plan sets periodic visual inspections for streaks, algae, cracks and plugs, absorption tests and colour measurements, compared with handover baseline photographs and data; trial any cleaning or repair in an inconspicuous spot and proceed only with approval from the architect or a conservation adviser.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 撥水劑用量 0.3 L/m²，清水面 2,400 m² 每次約 2,400×0.3 = 720 L；若每 12 年重塗一次，50 年內約 4 次，共約 2,880 L。把用量、施作日期與吸水試驗結果列入維護資料庫，可判斷實際重塗時機是否需要提前。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: At 0.3 L/m², 2,400 m² of exposed surface needs about 2,400×0.3 = 720 L per application; recoating every 12 years means about 4 applications and 2,880 L over 50 years. Recording quantities, dates and absorption-test results in a maintenance database shows whether recoating should come sooner. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance", which statement holds?
options: 脫模劑塗得越多越好，可以保證拆模後表面光滑。
清水模板只要表面光滑就好，背楞間距照一般結構模板即可。
撥水劑用量 0.3 L/m²，清水面 2,400 m² 每次約 2,400×0.3 = 720 L。
optionsEn: The more release agent the better; it guarantees a smooth surface after stripping.
Exposed-concrete forms only need a smooth facing; stud spacing can follow ordinary structural forms.
At 0.3 L/m², 2,400 m² of exposed surface needs about 2,400×0.3 = 720 L per application.
quiz.explanation: 撥水劑用量 0.3 L/m²，清水面 2,400 m² 每次約 2,400×0.3 = 720 L；若每 12 年重塗一次，50 年內約 4 次，共約 2,880 L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 0.3 L/m², 2,400 m² of exposed surface needs about 2,400×0.3 = 720 L per application; recoating every 12 years means about 4 applications and 2,880 L over 50 years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「維護手冊與修補樣本」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Maintenance manual and repair samples” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 維護計畫規定定期目視檢查（污痕、藻類、裂縫、塞頭）、吸水試驗與色差量測，並與交接時的基準照片與數據比較；任何清潔或修補在不顯眼位置先試做，經建築師或維護顧問核可後才施作。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The maintenance plan sets periodic visual inspections for streaks, algae, cracks and plugs, absorption tests and colour measurements, compared with handover baseline photographs and data; trial any cleaning or repair in an inconspicuous spot and proceed only with approval from the architect or a conservation adviser. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含清水面位置圖、材料與配比資料、撥水劑與修補紀錄、修補樣本與樣板牆照片、允許與禁止的清潔方法；重大清潔或修補應由熟悉清水混凝土的顧問評估並先試做。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include a map of exposed faces, material and mix data, repellent and repair records, repair samples and mock-up photographs, and permitted and prohibited cleaning methods; major cleaning or repair should be assessed by a consultant experienced in exposed concrete and trialled first.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：管理單位為去除污痕以高壓水柱或強酸清洗，表面漿體被沖蝕，骨材外露，與未清洗區形成永久差異；缺少原始配比與修補樣本，後來的修補只能憑感覺調色，越補越明顯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An owner who removes streaks with high-pressure water or strong acid erodes the surface paste and exposes aggregate, leaving a permanent difference from unwashed areas; without the original mix and repair samples, later repairs are colour-matched by guesswork and become ever more obvious. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 維護計畫規定定期目視檢查（污痕、藻類、裂縫、塞頭）、吸水試驗與色差量測，並與交接時的基準照片與數據比較；任何清潔或修補在不顯眼位置先試做，經建築師或維護顧問核可後才施作。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance plan sets periodic visual inspections for streaks, algae, cracks and plugs, absorption tests and colour measurements, compared with handover baseline photographs and data; trial any cleaning or repair in an inconspicuous spot and proceed only with approval from the architect or a conservation adviser.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含清水面位置圖、材料與配比資料、撥水劑與修補紀錄、修補樣本與樣板牆照片、允許與禁止的清潔方法；重大清潔或修補應由熟悉清水混凝土的顧問評估並先試做。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include a map of exposed faces, material and mix data, repellent and repair records, repair samples and mock-up photographs, and permitted and prohibited cleaning methods; major cleaning or repair should be assessed by a consultant experienced in exposed concrete and trialled first.

quiz.question: 要驗證「清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance"?
options: 維護計畫規定定期目視檢查（污痕、藻類、裂縫、塞頭）、吸水試驗與色差量測，並與交接時的基準照片與數據比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
樣板牆只是給業主看的展示品，正式施工時不需要再參照。
optionsEn: The maintenance plan sets periodic visual inspections for streaks, algae, cracks and plugs, absorption tests and colour measurements, compared with handover baseline photographs and data.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The mock-up is just a showpiece for the owner and need not be referred to during construction.
quiz.explanation: 維護計畫規定定期目視檢查（污痕、藻類、裂縫、塞頭）、吸水試驗與色差量測，並與交接時的基準照片與數據比較；任何清潔或修補在不顯眼位置先試做，經建築師或維護顧問核可後才施作。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The maintenance plan sets periodic visual inspections for streaks, algae, cracks and plugs, absorption tests and colour measurements, compared with handover baseline photographs and data; trial any cleaning or repair in an inconspicuous spot and proceed only with approval from the architect or a conservation adviser. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「維護手冊與修補樣本」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Maintenance manual and repair samples” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 管理單位為去除污痕以高壓水柱或強酸清洗，表面漿體被沖蝕，骨材外露，與未清洗區形成永久差異；缺少原始配比與修補樣本，後來的修補只能憑感覺調色，越補越明顯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An owner who removes streaks with high-pressure water or strong acid erodes the surface paste and exposes aggregate, leaving a permanent difference from unwashed areas; without the original mix and repair samples, later repairs are colour-matched by guesswork and become ever more obvious. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時應移交原配比、面材與脫模劑資料、撥水劑產品與施作紀錄、修補配方與樣本、樣板牆照片與量測基準，並規定可接受的清潔方法；高壓水柱或酸洗會改變表面質感，必須先試驗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover should deliver the original mix, facing and release-agent data, water-repellent product and application records, repair recipes and samples, mock-up photographs and measurement baselines, and specify acceptable cleaning methods; high-pressure water or acid washing changes surface texture and must be trialled first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 管理單位為去除污痕以高壓水柱或強酸清洗，表面漿體被沖蝕，骨材外露，與未清洗區形成永久差異；缺少原始配比與修補樣本，後來的修補只能憑感覺調色，越補越明顯。
knowledge.textEn: An owner who removes streaks with high-pressure water or strong acid erodes the surface paste and exposes aggregate, leaving a permanent difference from unwashed areas; without the original mix and repair samples, later repairs are colour-matched by guesswork and become ever more obvious.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
管理單位為去除污痕以高壓水柱或強酸清洗，表面漿體被沖蝕，骨材外露，與未清洗區形成永久差異；缺少原始配比與修補樣本，後來的修補只能憑感覺調色，越補越明顯。
清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An owner who removes streaks with high-pressure water or strong acid erodes the surface paste and exposes aggregate, leaving a permanent difference from unwashed areas.
Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification.
quiz.explanation: 管理單位為去除污痕以高壓水柱或強酸清洗，表面漿體被沖蝕，骨材外露，與未清洗區形成永久差異；缺少原始配比與修補樣本，後來的修補只能憑感覺調色，越補越明顯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An owner who removes streaks with high-pressure water or strong acid erodes the surface paste and exposes aggregate, leaving a permanent difference from unwashed areas; without the original mix and repair samples, later repairs are colour-matched by guesswork and become ever more obvious. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 大型鋼構防蝕塗裝
courses.titleEn: Protective coating of large steel structures
courses.summary: 從大氣腐蝕環境與 ISO 12944 腐蝕性分級出發，說明鋅底漆、中塗與面漆的防蝕機制、噴砂清潔度與錨紋、露點與施工環境、構件細部與邊緣膜厚、濕膜與乾膜厚度驗收、附著力檢測、劣化分級與維護策略，並以舊金山金門大橋的持續修補、蘇格蘭福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗與艾菲爾鐵塔每約七年一次的重塗為實例。
courses.summaryEn: Starting from atmospheric corrosivity and the ISO 12944 categories, explain how zinc primers, intermediate coats and topcoats protect steel, then cover blast-cleaning grade and surface profile, dew point and site conditions, detailing and edge film build, wet- and dry-film thickness acceptance, adhesion testing, degradation rating and maintenance strategy, using the continuous touch-up of San Francisco's Golden Gate Bridge, the first full repaint of Scotland's Forth Bridge and the roughly seven-yearly repainting of the Eiffel Tower.
courses.focus: 依腐蝕環境選擇塗裝系統，以表面處理、露點與膜厚控制施工品質，並以狀態評估決定局部修補或全面重塗
courses.focusEn: Selecting coating systems by corrosivity, controlling quality through surface preparation, dew point and film thickness, and using condition surveys to choose spot repair or full repainting
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 混凝土與鋼構施工技術

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某海邊鋼桁架橋塗裝面積 50,000 m²，評估為 C5 環境（教學假設第一年碳鋼損失 100 μm）。(1) 不塗裝時 25 年每面損失約 100×25^0.523 ≈ 538 μm。(2) 系統：無機鋅底漆 75 μm（固含量 60%）、環氧中塗 150 μm（80%）、聚氨酯面漆 60 μm（65%），總乾膜 285 μm。(3) 理論用量：50,000×75/(0.6×1,000) = 6,250 L、50,000×150/(0.8×1,000) = 9,375 L、50,000×60/(0.65×1,000) ≈ 4,615 L，合計約 20,240 L；損耗取 30%，採購約 20,240/0.7 ≈ 28,900 L，約 0.58 L/m²。(4) 施工時氣溫 20°C、濕度 85%，露點約 17.4°C，鋼面須 ≥ 20.4°C。(5) 驗收：最低個別讀數 0.8×285 = 228 μm。(6) 若改變一個輸入：飛濺區改列 CX 而加一道 150 μm 環氧中塗，該層理論用量再增加 9,375 L（含損耗約 13,400 L），總乾膜 435 μm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際工程。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a coastal steel truss bridge has 50,000 m² to coat in a C5 environment (teaching assumption: first-year steel loss 100 μm). (1) Uncoated, each face would lose about 100×25^0.523 ≈ 538 μm in 25 years. (2) System: inorganic zinc primer 75 μm (60% volume solids), epoxy intermediate 150 μm (80%) and polyurethane topcoat 60 μm (65%), 285 μm dry in total. (3) Theoretical volumes: 50,000×75/(0.6×1,000) = 6,250 L, 50,000×150/(0.8×1,000) = 9,375 L and 50,000×60/(0.65×1,000) ≈ 4,615 L, about 20,240 L in total; with 30% loss, about 20,240/0.7 ≈ 28,900 L is bought, about 0.58 L/m². (4) At 20°C and 85% humidity the dew point is about 17.4°C, so the steel must be at least 20.4°C. (5) Acceptance: the minimum single reading is 0.8×285 = 228 μm. (6) Changing one input: classifying splash zones as CX and adding a 150 μm epoxy coat there adds 9,375 L theoretical for that coat (about 13,400 L with losses) and raises total dry film to 435 μm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

The Golden Gate Bridge's original lead paint was about 68% red lead paste in a linseed oil carrier

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級」與「多層塗裝系統的防蝕機制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories" and "How multi-coat systems protect steel": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」如何影響大型鋼構防蝕塗裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ISO 12944 corrosivity category” governs force, deformation or durability in “Protective coating of large steel structures”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼材在大氣中腐蝕需要水膜與氧，速率主要取決於表面潮濕時間、氯鹽沉積與硫化物；海邊的霧與鹽風會讓腐蝕速率比內陸高出數倍。ISO 12944 依碳鋼第一年腐蝕損失把環境分成 C1 至 C5 與 CX 等類別，作為選擇塗裝系統與耐久等級的依據。同一座結構內也有微環境差異：遮蔽的下翼板、積水的接頭與縫隙、浪花飛濺區，往往比外露迎風面腐蝕更快。金門大橋的維護人員就描述他們要對抗風、海氣與霧造成的鋼材腐蝕。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel corrodes in air when a moisture film and oxygen are present, at a rate governed mainly by time of wetness, chloride deposition and sulfur compounds; coastal fog and salt-laden wind can multiply the rate several times over inland values. ISO 12944 groups environments into categories C1 to C5 and CX by the first-year corrosion loss of carbon steel, the basis for choosing coating systems and durability ranges. A single structure also has microclimates: sheltered bottom flanges, water-trapping joints and crevices, and splash zones often corrode faster than exposed windward faces. Golden Gate Bridge maintenance crews describe battling wind, sea air and fog that corrode the steel. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “ISO 12944 corrosivity category” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：大氣腐蝕長期損失 d(t) = r·t^b。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Long-term atmospheric loss d(t) = r·t^b.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “ISO 12944 corrosivity category”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級
knowledge.text: 鋼材在大氣中腐蝕需要水膜與氧，速率主要取決於表面潮濕時間、氯鹽沉積與硫化物；海邊的霧與鹽風會讓腐蝕速率比內陸高出數倍。ISO 12944 依碳鋼第一年腐蝕損失把環境分成 C1 至 C5 與 CX 等類別，作為選擇塗裝系統與耐久等級的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Steel corrodes in air when a moisture film and oxygen are present, at a rate governed mainly by time of wetness, chloride deposition and sulfur compounds; coastal fog and salt-laden wind can multiply the rate several times over inland values. ISO 12944 groups environments into categories C1 to C5 and CX by the first-year corrosion loss of carbon steel, the basis for choosing coating systems and durability ranges.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories" is correct?
options: 同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。
鋼材在大氣中腐蝕需要水膜與氧，速率主要取決於表面潮濕時間、氯鹽沉積與硫化物；海邊的霧與鹽風會讓腐蝕速率比內陸高出數倍。
塗裝主要是為了顏色與外觀，防蝕效果與塗層層次無關。
optionsEn: Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment.
Steel corrodes in air when a moisture film and oxygen are present, at a rate governed mainly by time of wetness, chloride deposition and sulfur compounds.
Coatings are mainly for colour and looks, and the number of layers does not matter for protection.
quiz.explanation: 鋼材在大氣中腐蝕需要水膜與氧，速率主要取決於表面潮濕時間、氯鹽沉積與硫化物；海邊的霧與鹽風會讓腐蝕速率比內陸高出數倍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Steel corrodes in air when a moisture film and oxygen are present, at a rate governed mainly by time of wetness, chloride deposition and sulfur compounds; coastal fog and salt-laden wind can multiply the rate several times over inland values. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ISO 12944 corrosivity category” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：大氣腐蝕長期損失 d(t) = r·t^b。取 C4 環境第一年損失 r = 60 μm、碳鋼指數 b = 0.523：25 年 d = 60×25^0.523 ≈ 60×5.38 ≈ 323 μm，每面約 0.32 mm；若誤用線性外推 60×25 = 1,500 μm，會高估約 4.6 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Long-term atmospheric loss d(t) = r·t^b. With a C4 first-year loss r = 60 μm and a carbon-steel exponent b = 0.523, 25 years gives d = 60×25^0.523 ≈ 60×5.38 ≈ 323 μm, about 0.32 mm per face; extrapolating linearly as 60×25 = 1,500 μm would overstate it about 4.6 times. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以現場暴露試片（碳鋼與鋅試片）量測一年腐蝕損失，或依鄰近海岸距離、氯鹽沉積與濕度資料評估腐蝕性類別；同時在結構上標出遮蔽、積水與飛濺等高風險區，分區指定塗裝系統。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure one-year corrosion loss on site with exposed steel and zinc coupons, or assess the corrosivity category from distance to the coast, chloride deposition and humidity data; mark sheltered, water-trapping and splash zones on the structure as high-risk areas and assign coating systems by zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 大氣腐蝕長期損失 d(t) = r·t^b。取 C4 環境第一年損失 r = 60 μm、碳鋼指數 b = 0.523：25 年 d = 60×25^0.523 ≈ 60×5.38 ≈ 323 μm，每面約 0.32 mm；若誤用線性外推 60×25 = 1,500 μm，會高估約 4.6 倍。數值為教學假設。

With a C4 first-year loss r = 60 μm and a carbon-steel exponent b = 0.523, 25 years gives d = 60×25^0.523 ≈ 60×5.38 ≈ 323 μm, about 0.32 mm per face; extrapolating linearly as 60×25 = 1,500 μm would overstate it about 4.6 times. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories", which statement holds?
options: 塗裝問題只能靠塗料品質解決，與結構細部無關。
塗膜越厚越好，超過規定厚度只會更耐久。
大氣腐蝕長期損失 d(t) = r·t^b。
optionsEn: Coating problems are solved only by better paint, not by structural detailing.
The thicker the film the better; exceeding the specified thickness only adds durability.
Long-term atmospheric loss d(t) = r·t^b.
quiz.explanation: 大氣腐蝕長期損失 d(t) = r·t^b。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term atmospheric loss d(t) = r·t^b. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “ISO 12944 corrosivity category” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以現場暴露試片（碳鋼與鋅試片）量測一年腐蝕損失，或依鄰近海岸距離、氯鹽沉積與濕度資料評估腐蝕性類別；同時在結構上標出遮蔽、積水與飛濺等高風險區，分區指定塗裝系統。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure one-year corrosion loss on site with exposed steel and zinc coupons, or assess the corrosivity category from distance to the coast, chloride deposition and humidity data; mark sheltered, water-trapping and splash zones on the structure as high-risk areas and assign coating systems by zone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：塗裝規格書應以腐蝕性分區圖指定每一區的系統、總膜厚與耐久等級，並把高風險區列為加強塗裝（例如加一道中塗或條塗）；分區圖由結構與塗裝工程師共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The coating specification should use a corrosivity zoning drawing to assign system, total film thickness and durability range to each zone, with high-risk zones upgraded, for example by an extra intermediate or stripe coat; structural and coating engineers sign the zoning drawing together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若整座海邊橋梁以單一較低的腐蝕性類別設計塗裝，迎風外露面表現尚可，但下翼板、支承附近與排水不良的節點在數年內就出現大面積生鏽與層狀剝落，修補需要搭設困難的懸吊架。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing a whole coastal bridge's coating for one lower corrosivity category leaves exposed windward faces fine, but bottom flanges, areas near bearings and poorly drained nodes rust widely and delaminate within a few years, and repair needs difficult suspended access. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories"?
options: 以現場暴露試片（碳鋼與鋅試片）量測一年腐蝕損失，或依鄰近海岸距離、氯鹽沉積與濕度資料評估腐蝕性類別。

quiz.explanationEn: Measure one-year corrosion loss on site with exposed steel and zinc coupons, or assess the corrosivity category from distance to the coast, chloride deposition and humidity data; mark sheltered, water-trapping and splash zones on the structure as high-risk areas and assign coating systems by zone. steps.title: 腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “ISO 12944 corrosivity category” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若整座海邊橋梁以單一較低的腐蝕性類別設計塗裝，迎風外露面表現尚可，但下翼板、支承附近與排水不良的節點在數年內就出現大面積生鏽與層狀剝落，修補需要搭設困難的懸吊架。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing a whole coastal bridge's coating for one lower corrosivity category leaves exposed windward faces fine, but bottom flanges, areas near bearings and poorly drained nodes rust widely and delaminate within a few years, and repair needs difficult suspended access. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：金門大橋的維護人員就描述他們要對抗風、海氣與霧造成的鋼材腐蝕。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Golden Gate Bridge maintenance crews describe battling wind, sea air and fog that corrode the steel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若整座海邊橋梁以單一較低的腐蝕性類別設計塗裝，迎風外露面表現尚可，但下翼板、支承附近與排水不良的節點在數年內就出現大面積生鏽與層狀剝落，修補需要搭設困難的懸吊架。
knowledge.textEn: Designing a whole coastal bridge's coating for one lower corrosivity category leaves exposed windward faces fine, but bottom flanges, areas near bearings and poorly drained nodes rust widely and delaminate within a few years, and repair needs difficult suspended access.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若整座海邊橋梁以單一較低的腐蝕性類別設計塗裝，迎風外露面表現尚可，但下翼板、支承附近與排水不良的節點在數年內就出現大面積生鏽與層狀剝落，修補需要搭設困難的懸吊架。
塗裝主要是為了顏色與外觀，防蝕效果與塗層層次無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
