steps.title: 長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長玻璃翻轉與吊裝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-glass tilting and lifting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 吊裝計畫須附每一搬運狀態（平放、翻轉、吊升、就位）的應力計算、吊具與吸盤額定荷重與安全係數、風速上限與停止條件，由帷幕牆工程師與起重負責人共同簽認；每支玻璃進場時目視檢查邊緣與膠合品質並拍照建檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The lifting plan must include stress calculations for each handling state (flat, tilting, hoisting, placing), lifting-gear and vacuum-pad ratings and safety factors, wind-speed limits and stop conditions, signed jointly by the façade engineer and the lifting supervisor; inspect and photograph every pane's edges and laminate on arrival. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝屬高風險作業，每一次大型玻璃吊裝都要有經核准的吊裝計畫、試吊與停止點，由起重負責人與帷幕牆工程師在現場確認後才能進行；玻璃以立式運輸架運送並全程保護邊緣。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lifting is high-risk work: every major glass lift needs an approved lifting plan, a trial lift and hold points, and proceeds only after the lifting supervisor and façade engineer confirm on site; glass travels in upright transport frames with its edges protected throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把長玻璃肋平放在中央單點或兩端支點上搬運，弱軸彎曲加上車輛振動足以讓玻璃開裂；翻轉時邊緣碰到地面或鋼構造成貝殼狀崩邊，安裝時看不出，數月後在風壓或溫差下自邊緣破裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Carrying a long fin flat on a single central support or on supports at its ends lets weak-axis bending plus vehicle vibration crack it; during tilting an edge that strikes the ground or steelwork suffers a shell chip invisible at installation that later starts a crack under wind or thermal stress months afterwards. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 吊裝計畫須附每一搬運狀態（平放、翻轉、吊升、就位）的應力計算、吊具與吸盤額定荷重與安全係數、風速上限與停止條件，由帷幕牆工程師與起重負責人共同簽認；每支玻璃進場時目視檢查邊緣與膠合品質並拍照建檔。
knowledge.textEn: The lifting plan must include stress calculations for each handling state (flat, tilting, hoisting, placing), lifting-gear and vacuum-pad ratings and safety factors, wind-speed limits and stop conditions, signed jointly by the façade engineer and the lifting supervisor; inspect and photograph every pane's edges and laminate on arrival.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊裝屬高風險作業，每一次大型玻璃吊裝都要有經核准的吊裝計畫、試吊與停止點，由起重負責人與帷幕牆工程師在現場確認後才能進行；玻璃以立式運輸架運送並全程保護邊緣。
knowledge.textEn: Lifting is high-risk work: every major glass lift needs an approved lifting plan, a trial lift and hold points, and proceeds only after the lifting supervisor and façade engineer confirm on site; glass travels in upright transport frames with its edges protected throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
吊裝計畫須附每一搬運狀態（平放、翻轉、吊升、就位）的應力計算、吊具與吸盤額定荷重與安全係數、風速上限與停止條件，由帷幕牆工程師與起重負責人共同簽認。
玻璃肋只要彎曲應力低於玻璃強度，就不會失效。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

The lifting plan must include stress calculations for each handling state (flat, tilting, hoisting, placing), lifting-gear and vacuum-pad ratings and safety factors, wind-speed limits and stop conditions, signed jointly by the façade engineer and the lifting supervisor.
A glass fin cannot fail as long as its bending stress is below the strength of glass.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝計畫須附每一搬運狀態（平放、翻轉、吊升、就位）的應力計算、吊具與吸盤額定荷重與安全係數、風速上限與停止條件，由帷幕牆工程師與起重負責人共同簽認；每支玻璃進場時目視檢查邊緣與膠合品質並拍照建檔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The lifting plan must include stress calculations for each handling state (flat, tilting, hoisting, placing), lifting-gear and vacuum-pad ratings and safety factors, wind-speed limits and stop conditions, signed jointly by the façade engineer and the lifting supervisor; inspect and photograph every pane's edges and laminate on arrival. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長玻璃翻轉與吊裝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-glass tilting and lifting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把長玻璃肋平放在中央單點或兩端支點上搬運，弱軸彎曲加上車輛振動足以讓玻璃開裂；翻轉時邊緣碰到地面或鋼構造成貝殼狀崩邊，安裝時看不出，數月後在風壓或溫差下自邊緣破裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Carrying a long fin flat on a single central support or on supports at its ends lets weak-axis bending plus vehicle vibration crack it; during tilting an edge that strikes the ground or steelwork suffers a shell chip invisible at installation that later starts a crack under wind or thermal stress months afterwards. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此吊裝計畫要指定支點位置、翻轉方式（立式運輸架或翻轉架）、吸盤或夾具配置、風速限制與每一步的停止條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The lifting plan must therefore specify support positions, the tilting method (upright transport frame or tilting frame), vacuum-pad or clamp layout, wind-speed limits and stop conditions for every step.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃肋在使用期的受力最大，吊裝過程的應力可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A glass fin sees its highest stresses in service, so handling stresses can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把長玻璃肋平放在中央單點或兩端支點上搬運，弱軸彎曲加上車輛振動足以讓玻璃開裂；翻轉時邊緣碰到地面或鋼構造成貝殼狀崩邊，安裝時看不出，數月後在風壓或溫差下自邊緣破裂。
knowledge.textEn: Carrying a long fin flat on a single central support or on supports at its ends lets weak-axis bending plus vehicle vibration crack it; during tilting an edge that strikes the ground or steelwork suffers a shell chip invisible at installation that later starts a crack under wind or thermal stress months afterwards.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長尺寸玻璃的運輸、翻轉與吊裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transport, tilting and lifting of long glass" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。
把長玻璃肋平放在中央單點或兩端支點上搬運，弱軸彎曲加上車輛振動足以讓玻璃開裂。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade.
Carrying a long fin flat on a single central support or on supports at its ends lets weak-axis bending plus vehicle vibration crack it.
quiz.explanation: 把長玻璃肋平放在中央單點或兩端支點上搬運，弱軸彎曲加上車輛振動足以讓玻璃開裂；翻轉時邊緣碰到地面或鋼構造成貝殼狀崩邊，安裝時看不出，數月後在風壓或溫差下自邊緣破裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Carrying a long fin flat on a single central support or on supports at its ends lets weak-axis bending plus vehicle vibration crack it; during tilting an edge that strikes the ground or steelwork suffers a shell chip invisible at installation that later starts a crack under wind or thermal stress months afterwards. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 安裝順序、公差與主結構變位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「頂部滑動接頭」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sliding head joint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 玻璃肋安裝的關鍵是讓它只承擔設計中的荷重，而不被主結構的變形「擠壓」。屋頂梁在活載重、雪或溫度下會上下變位，若玻璃肋頂部固定死，就會被當成柱子受壓；因此常見做法是底部固定、頂部只傳遞水平力並允許垂直滑動，或改為頂部吊掛、底部滑動，讓玻璃處於受拉。安裝順序通常是先定位支座、立起並調整玻璃肋垂直度，再裝面玻璃、最後施打矽利康，每一步都要量測累積公差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「頂部滑動接頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The key to fin installation is that the fin carries only its design loads and is never squeezed by deformation of the main structure. A roof beam moves vertically under live load, snow or temperature; a fin fixed rigidly at its head would be loaded as a column, so the usual approach fixes the base and lets the head transfer horizontal force while sliding vertically, or hangs the fin from the head with a sliding base so the glass is in tension. The normal sequence is to set the shoes, stand and plumb the fins, install face glass and finally apply silicone, measuring the accumulated tolerance at every step. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sliding head joint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：屋頂梁跨度 18 m、活載重撓度限制 L/360：δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm；加上安裝公差 ±10 mm，頂部滑動接頭的垂直行程至少 50 + 10 = 60 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an 18 m roof beam with a live-load deflection limit of L/360, δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm; adding ±10 mm installation tolerance, the sliding head joint needs at least 50 + 10 = 60 mm of vertical travel.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「頂部滑動接頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sliding head joint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝順序、公差與主結構變位
knowledge.titleEn: Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement
knowledge.text: 玻璃肋安裝的關鍵是讓它只承擔設計中的荷重，而不被主結構的變形「擠壓」。屋頂梁在活載重、雪或溫度下會上下變位，若玻璃肋頂部固定死，就會被當成柱子受壓；因此常見做法是底部固定、頂部只傳遞水平力並允許垂直滑動，或改為頂部吊掛、底部滑動，讓玻璃處於受拉。
knowledge.textEn: The key to fin installation is that the fin carries only its design loads and is never squeezed by deformation of the main structure. A roof beam moves vertically under live load, snow or temperature; a fin fixed rigidly at its head would be loaded as a column, so the usual approach fixes the base and lets the head transfer horizontal force while sliding vertically, or hangs the fin from the head with a sliding base so the glass is in tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝順序、公差與主結構變位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement" is correct?
options: 玻璃肋安裝的關鍵是讓它只承擔設計中的荷重，而不被主結構的變形「擠壓」。
玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。
玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。
optionsEn: The key to fin installation is that the fin carries only its design loads and is never squeezed by deformation of the main structure.
The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade.
Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing.
quiz.explanation: 玻璃肋安裝的關鍵是讓它只承擔設計中的荷重，而不被主結構的變形「擠壓」。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The key to fin installation is that the fin carries only its design loads and is never squeezed by deformation of the main structure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝順序、公差與主結構變位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂部滑動接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sliding head joint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：屋頂梁跨度 18 m、活載重撓度限制 L/360：δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm；加上安裝公差 ±10 mm，頂部滑動接頭的垂直行程至少 50 + 10 = 60 mm。若接頭被卡死，10 m 玻璃肋需承受迫使梁減少撓度的軸壓，遠超過設計。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an 18 m roof beam with a live-load deflection limit of L/360, δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm; adding ±10 mm installation tolerance, the sliding head joint needs at least 50 + 10 = 60 mm of vertical travel. If the joint jams, the 10 m fin must take the axial compression needed to stop the beam deflecting, far beyond its design. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝時以全站儀或雷射量測每支玻璃肋的垂直度、間距與面外偏差，記錄於逐支檢查表；頂部滑動接頭在打矽利康前檢查行程、潤滑與止動，並確認臨時固定件已全部拆除，由監造簽認後才進行下一階段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During installation survey each fin's plumb, spacing and out-of-plane deviation with a total station or laser and record them on a fin-by-fin checklist; before siliconing, check the sliding head joint's travel, lubrication and stops, and confirm all temporary fixings are removed, signed off by the supervising engineer before the next stage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 屋頂梁跨度 18 m、活載重撓度限制 L/360：δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm；加上安裝公差 ±10 mm，頂部滑動接頭的垂直行程至少 50 + 10 = 60 mm。若接頭被卡死，10 m 玻璃肋需承受迫使梁減少撓度的軸壓，遠超過設計。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For an 18 m roof beam with a live-load deflection limit of L/360, δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm; adding ±10 mm installation tolerance, the sliding head joint needs at least 50 + 10 = 60 mm of vertical travel. If the joint jams, the 10 m fin must take the axial compression needed to stop the beam deflecting, far beyond its design. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝順序、公差與主結構變位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement", which statement holds?
options: 熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。
屋頂梁跨度 18 m、活載重撓度限制 L/360：δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm。
全玻璃立面的玻璃肋只是裝飾，風壓主要由面玻璃自己承受。
optionsEn: Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously.
For an 18 m roof beam with a live-load deflection limit of L/360, δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm.
Glass fins in an all-glass façade are decorative; the face glass carries the wind by itself.
quiz.explanation: 屋頂梁跨度 18 m、活載重撓度限制 L/360：δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm；加上安裝公差 ±10 mm，頂部滑動接頭的垂直行程至少 50 + 10 = 60 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For an 18 m roof beam with a live-load deflection limit of L/360, δ = 18,000/360 = 50 mm; adding ±10 mm installation tolerance, the sliding head joint needs at least 50 + 10 = 60 mm of vertical travel. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝順序、公差與主結構變位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂部滑動接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sliding head joint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝時以全站儀或雷射量測每支玻璃肋的垂直度、間距與面外偏差，記錄於逐支檢查表；頂部滑動接頭在打矽利康前檢查行程、潤滑與止動，並確認臨時固定件已全部拆除，由監造簽認後才進行下一階段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During installation survey each fin's plumb, spacing and out-of-plane deviation with a total station or laser and record them on a fin-by-fin checklist; before siliconing, check the sliding head joint's travel, lubrication and stops, and confirm all temporary fixings are removed, signed off by the supervising engineer before the next stage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：介面圖應標示主結構在各荷重下的預估變位與滑動接頭的設計行程，並在安裝程序中設「臨時固定件拆除確認」停止點；屋頂後續增設設備或改變用途，須由結構設計者確認不超過玻璃肋的容許變位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Interface drawings must show predicted main-structure movements under each load and the design travel of sliding joints, with a hold point in the installation procedure confirming removal of temporary fixings; any later rooftop equipment or change of use needs the structural designer to confirm that fin movement limits are not exceeded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工時為了方便而以點焊或螺栓暫時固定頂部滑動接頭，完工後忘記拆除；第一次大雪或屋頂設備加載時，屋頂梁下垂把玻璃肋壓裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A sliding head joint temporarily tack-welded or bolted for convenience and never released lets the roof beam, sagging under the first heavy snow or rooftop equipment, crush the fin; setting blocks in the wrong position put the face glass's weight off-centre and concentrate stress at the corners. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝時以全站儀或雷射量測每支玻璃肋的垂直度、間距與面外偏差，記錄於逐支檢查表；頂部滑動接頭在打矽利康前檢查行程、潤滑與止動，並確認臨時固定件已全部拆除，由監造簽認後才進行下一階段。
knowledge.textEn: During installation survey each fin's plumb, spacing and out-of-plane deviation with a total station or laser and record them on a fin-by-fin checklist; before siliconing, check the sliding head joint's travel, lubrication and stops, and confirm all temporary fixings are removed, signed off by the supervising engineer before the next stage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 介面圖應標示主結構在各荷重下的預估變位與滑動接頭的設計行程，並在安裝程序中設「臨時固定件拆除確認」停止點；屋頂後續增設設備或改變用途，須由結構設計者確認不超過玻璃肋的容許變位。
knowledge.textEn: Interface drawings must show predicted main-structure movements under each load and the design travel of sliding joints, with a hold point in the installation procedure confirming removal of temporary fixings; any later rooftop equipment or change of use needs the structural designer to confirm that fin movement limits are not exceeded.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝順序、公差與主結構變位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
膠合玻璃的強度永遠等於同總厚度的單片玻璃。
安裝時以全站儀或雷射量測每支玻璃肋的垂直度、間距與面外偏差，記錄於逐支檢查表。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A laminated pane is always as strong and stiff as a monolithic pane of the same total thickness.
During installation survey each fin's plumb, spacing and out-of-plane deviation with a total station or laser and record them on a fin-by-fin checklist.
quiz.explanation: 安裝時以全站儀或雷射量測每支玻璃肋的垂直度、間距與面外偏差，記錄於逐支檢查表；頂部滑動接頭在打矽利康前檢查行程、潤滑與止動，並確認臨時固定件已全部拆除，由監造簽認後才進行下一階段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During installation survey each fin's plumb, spacing and out-of-plane deviation with a total station or laser and record them on a fin-by-fin checklist; before siliconing, check the sliding head joint's travel, lubrication and stops, and confirm all temporary fixings are removed, signed off by the supervising engineer before the next stage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安裝順序、公差與主結構變位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂部滑動接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sliding head joint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工時為了方便而以點焊或螺栓暫時固定頂部滑動接頭，完工後忘記拆除；第一次大雪或屋頂設備加載時，屋頂梁下垂把玻璃肋壓裂。底部墊塊位置錯誤也會讓面玻璃自重偏心，造成角隅應力集中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A sliding head joint temporarily tack-welded or bolted for convenience and never released lets the roof beam, sagging under the first heavy snow or rooftop equipment, crush the fin; setting blocks in the wrong position put the face glass's weight off-centre and concentrate stress at the corners. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：安裝順序通常是先定位支座、立起並調整玻璃肋垂直度，再裝面玻璃、最後施打矽利康，每一步都要量測累積公差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The normal sequence is to set the shoes, stand and plumb the fins, install face glass and finally apply silicone, measuring the accumulated tolerance at every step.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃肋上下兩端都固定得越牢，立面就越穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工時為了方便而以點焊或螺栓暫時固定頂部滑動接頭，完工後忘記拆除；第一次大雪或屋頂設備加載時，屋頂梁下垂把玻璃肋壓裂。底部墊塊位置錯誤也會讓面玻璃自重偏心，造成角隅應力集中。
knowledge.textEn: A sliding head joint temporarily tack-welded or bolted for convenience and never released lets the roof beam, sagging under the first heavy snow or rooftop equipment, crush the fin; setting blocks in the wrong position put the face glass's weight off-centre and concentrate stress at the corners.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝順序、公差與主結構變位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Installation sequence, tolerances and structural movement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 施工時為了方便而以點焊或螺栓暫時固定頂部滑動接頭，完工後忘記拆除；第一次大雪或屋頂設備加載時，屋頂梁下垂把玻璃肋壓裂。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。
optionsEn: A sliding head joint temporarily tack-welded or bolted for convenience and never released lets the roof beam, sagging under the first heavy snow or rooftop equipment, crush the fin.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing.
quiz.explanation: 施工時為了方便而以點焊或螺栓暫時固定頂部滑動接頭，完工後忘記拆除；第一次大雪或屋頂設備加載時，屋頂梁下垂把玻璃肋壓裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A sliding head joint temporarily tack-welded or bolted for convenience and never released lets the roof beam, sagging under the first heavy snow or rooftop equipment, crush the fin; setting blocks in the wrong position put the face glass's weight off-centre and concentrate stress at the corners. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」與「現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison" and "Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 實尺寸試驗與撓度比對：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Full-scale testing and deflection comparison: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-scale fin load test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 玻璃結構的計算對邊界條件、中間膜耦合與接合剛度非常敏感，因此大型玻璃肋常以實尺寸樣品做載重試驗：在試驗架上以分級靜載重或氣壓箱施加設計風壓與超載，量測撓度、側向位移與殘餘變形，並在破壞試驗中觀察裂紋起點與破裂後行為。實測撓度若明顯大於計算，表示支承鬆動、耦合不足或接合滑移，必須在量產前找出原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Glass calculations are very sensitive to boundary conditions, interlayer coupling and joint stiffness, so large fins are often load-tested at full scale: on a test rig, staged static loads or a pressure chamber apply design wind and overload while deflection, lateral displacement and residual set are measured, and destructive tests reveal where cracks start and how the fin behaves after breakage. A measured deflection clearly above the calculation points to loose supports, insufficient coupling or joint slip, which must be explained before production. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Full-scale fin load test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Strong-axis deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) with I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴, w = 3.0 N/mm and L = 10,000 mm: δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120); at a 150% test load the prediction is 13.4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Full-scale fin load test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 實尺寸試驗與撓度比對
knowledge.text: 玻璃結構的計算對邊界條件、中間膜耦合與接合剛度非常敏感，因此大型玻璃肋常以實尺寸樣品做載重試驗：在試驗架上以分級靜載重或氣壓箱施加設計風壓與超載，量測撓度、側向位移與殘餘變形，並在破壞試驗中觀察裂紋起點與破裂後行為。實測撓度若明顯大於計算，表示支承鬆動、耦合不足或接合滑移，必須在量產前找出原因。
knowledge.textEn: Glass calculations are very sensitive to boundary conditions, interlayer coupling and joint stiffness, so large fins are often load-tested at full scale: on a test rig, staged static loads or a pressure chamber apply design wind and overload while deflection, lateral displacement and residual set are measured, and destructive tests reveal where cracks start and how the fin behaves after breakage. A measured deflection clearly above the calculation points to loose supports, insufficient coupling or joint slip, which must be explained before production.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison" is correct?
options: 玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。
玻璃結構的計算對邊界條件、中間膜耦合與接合剛度非常敏感，因此大型玻璃肋常以實尺寸樣品做載重試驗：在試驗架上以分級靜載重或氣壓箱施加設計風壓與超載，量測撓度、側向位移與殘餘變形，並在破壞試驗中觀察裂紋起點與破裂後行為。
玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。
optionsEn: Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing.

Glass calculations are very sensitive to boundary conditions, interlayer coupling and joint stiffness, so large fins are often load-tested at full scale: on a test rig, staged static loads or a pressure chamber apply design wind and overload while deflection, lateral displacement and residual set are measured, and destructive tests reveal where cracks start and how the fin behaves after breakage.
Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact.
quiz.explanation: 玻璃結構的計算對邊界條件、中間膜耦合與接合剛度非常敏感，因此大型玻璃肋常以實尺寸樣品做載重試驗：在試驗架上以分級靜載重或氣壓箱施加設計風壓與超載，量測撓度、側向位移與殘餘變形，並在破壞試驗中觀察裂紋起點與破裂後行為。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Glass calculations are very sensitive to boundary conditions, interlayer coupling and joint stiffness, so large fins are often load-tested at full scale: on a test rig, staged static loads or a pressure chamber apply design wind and overload while deflection, lateral displacement and residual set are measured, and destructive tests reveal where cracks start and how the fin behaves after breakage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 實尺寸試驗與撓度比對：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Full-scale testing and deflection comparison: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full-scale fin load test” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：強軸撓度 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI)，I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴，w = 3.0 N/mm、L = 10,000 mm：δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm（約 L/1,120）；150% 試驗載重時預估 13.4 mm。若實測 16.0 mm，表觀勁度只有 13.4/16.0 ≈ 84%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Strong-axis deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) with I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴, w = 3.0 N/mm and L = 10,000 mm: δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120); at a 150% test load the prediction is 13.4 mm. A measured 16.0 mm means the apparent stiffness is only 13.4/16.0 ≈ 84%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗計畫事先定義載重分級、保持時間、量測點（中央撓度、受壓邊側向位移、支承滑移）與允收準則，例如設計載重下撓度不超過計算值一定比例、卸載後殘餘變形小於規定值、無裂紋；破壞試驗後檢查破裂片是否仍由中間膜保持在原位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define in advance the load steps, hold times, measurement points (mid-span deflection, lateral movement of the compressed edge, support slip) and acceptance criteria, such as deflection at design load within a set margin of the calculation, residual set below a stated limit after unloading and no cracks; after a destructive test check that broken fragments are still held in place by the interlayer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Strong-axis deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) with I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴, w = 3.0 N/mm and L = 10,000 mm: δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120); at a 150% test load the prediction is 13.4 mm. A measured 16.0 mm means the apparent stiffness is only 13.4/16.0 ≈ 84%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison", which statement holds?
options: 玻璃結構完工後不會再更換，因此不必保留吊點與運輸路徑。
玻璃肋只要彎曲應力低於玻璃強度，就不會失效。
optionsEn: A glass structure will never be replaced, so pick points and access routes need not be kept.
A glass fin cannot fail as long as its bending stress is below the strength of glass.
Strong-axis deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) with I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴, w = 3.0 N/mm and L = 10,000 mm: δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120).
quiz.explanationEn: Strong-axis deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) with I = 45×550³/12 ≈ 6.24×10⁸ mm⁴, w = 3.0 N/mm and L = 10,000 mm: δ = 5×3.0×10¹⁶/(384×70,000×6.24×10⁸) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120); at a 150% test load the prediction is 13.4 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 實尺寸試驗與撓度比對：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Full-scale testing and deflection comparison: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full-scale fin load test” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗計畫事先定義載重分級、保持時間、量測點（中央撓度、受壓邊側向位移、支承滑移）與允收準則，例如設計載重下撓度不超過計算值一定比例、卸載後殘餘變形小於規定值、無裂紋；破壞試驗後檢查破裂片是否仍由中間膜保持在原位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define in advance the load steps, hold times, measurement points (mid-span deflection, lateral movement of the compressed edge, support slip) and acceptance criteria, such as deflection at design load within a set margin of the calculation, residual set below a stated limit after unloading and no cracks; after a destructive test check that broken fragments are still held in place by the interlayer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗樣品的玻璃、中間膜、金屬件與支承要與量產相同，並由獨立試驗室執行、設計者到場見證；試驗結果與計算差異超過預定範圍時，須修正模型或細部後重新試驗，不能以「安全係數夠大」帶過。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Test samples must use the production glass, interlayer, fittings and supports, tested by an independent laboratory with the designer witnessing; if results differ from calculation beyond the agreed range, correct the model or details and retest rather than relying on a large safety factor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試驗只量中央撓度而沒有量受壓邊的側向位移，挫屈前兆被忽略；或試驗樣品的支承比現場更剛硬，試驗合格但現場勁度不足，實際立面在強風時明顯晃動並有破裂風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Measuring only mid-span deflection and not the lateral movement of the compressed edge misses the warning signs of buckling; a test rig with stiffer supports than the site lets the sample pass while the real façade lacks stiffness, swaying visibly in strong wind with a risk of breakage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫事先定義載重分級、保持時間、量測點（中央撓度、受壓邊側向位移、支承滑移）與允收準則，例如設計載重下撓度不超過計算值一定比例、卸載後殘餘變形小於規定值、無裂紋；破壞試驗後檢查破裂片是否仍由中間膜保持在原位。
knowledge.textEn: Define in advance the load steps, hold times, measurement points (mid-span deflection, lateral movement of the compressed edge, support slip) and acceptance criteria, such as deflection at design load within a set margin of the calculation, residual set below a stated limit after unloading and no cracks; after a destructive test check that broken fragments are still held in place by the interlayer.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗樣品的玻璃、中間膜、金屬件與支承要與量產相同，並由獨立試驗室執行、設計者到場見證；試驗結果與計算差異超過預定範圍時，須修正模型或細部後重新試驗，不能以「安全係數夠大」帶過。
knowledge.textEn: Test samples must use the production glass, interlayer, fittings and supports, tested by an independent laboratory with the designer witnessing; if results differ from calculation beyond the agreed range, correct the model or details and retest rather than relying on a large safety factor.

quiz.question: 要驗證「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison"?
options: 試驗計畫事先定義載重分級、保持時間、量測點（中央撓度、受壓邊側向位移、支承滑移）與允收準則，例如設計載重下撓度不超過計算值一定比例、卸載後殘餘變形小於規定值、無裂紋。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
結構矽利康越厚、塗得越多，接合就越安全。
optionsEn: Define in advance the load steps, hold times, measurement points (mid-span deflection, lateral movement of the compressed edge, support slip) and acceptance criteria, such as deflection at design load within a set margin of the calculation, residual set below a stated limit after unloading and no cracks.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The thicker and more generous the structural silicone, the safer the joint.
quiz.explanation: 試驗計畫事先定義載重分級、保持時間、量測點（中央撓度、受壓邊側向位移、支承滑移）與允收準則，例如設計載重下撓度不超過計算值一定比例、卸載後殘餘變形小於規定值、無裂紋；破壞試驗後檢查破裂片是否仍由中間膜保持在原位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define in advance the load steps, hold times, measurement points (mid-span deflection, lateral movement of the compressed edge, support slip) and acceptance criteria, such as deflection at design load within a set margin of the calculation, residual set below a stated limit after unloading and no cracks; after a destructive test check that broken fragments are still held in place by the interlayer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 實尺寸試驗與撓度比對：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Full-scale testing and deflection comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「實尺寸玻璃肋載重試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full-scale fin load test” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試驗只量中央撓度而沒有量受壓邊的側向位移，挫屈前兆被忽略；或試驗樣品的支承比現場更剛硬，試驗合格但現場勁度不足，實際立面在強風時明顯晃動並有破裂風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring only mid-span deflection and not the lateral movement of the compressed edge misses the warning signs of buckling; a test rig with stiffer supports than the site lets the sample pass while the real façade lacks stiffness, swaying visibly in strong wind with a risk of breakage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實測撓度若明顯大於計算，表示支承鬆動、耦合不足或接合滑移，必須在量產前找出原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A measured deflection clearly above the calculation points to loose supports, insufficient coupling or joint slip, which must be explained before production.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃強度在試驗室已有大量數據，大型玻璃肋不需要再做實尺寸試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Glass strength is well documented, so large fins need no full-scale testing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試驗只量中央撓度而沒有量受壓邊的側向位移，挫屈前兆被忽略；或試驗樣品的支承比現場更剛硬，試驗合格但現場勁度不足，實際立面在強風時明顯晃動並有破裂風險。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring only mid-span deflection and not the lateral movement of the compressed edge misses the warning signs of buckling; a test rig with stiffer supports than the site lets the sample pass while the real façade lacks stiffness, swaying visibly in strong wind with a risk of breakage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
試驗只量中央撓度而沒有量受壓邊的側向位移，挫屈前兆被忽略；或試驗樣品的支承比現場更剛硬，試驗合格但現場勁度不足，實際立面在強風時明顯晃動並有破裂風險。
玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Measuring only mid-span deflection and not the lateral movement of the compressed edge misses the warning signs of buckling.
Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact.
quiz.explanation: 試驗只量中央撓度而沒有量受壓邊的側向位移，挫屈前兆被忽略；或試驗樣品的支承比現場更剛硬，試驗合格但現場勁度不足，實際立面在強風時明顯晃動並有破裂風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring only mid-span deflection and not the lateral movement of the compressed edge misses the warning signs of buckling; a test rig with stiffer supports than the site lets the sample pass while the real façade lacks stiffness, swaying visibly in strong wind with a risk of breakage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Glass edge quality and thermal stress” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 玻璃破裂幾乎都從邊緣或孔緣開始，因此現場檢查的重點是邊緣：研磨等級、崩邊、刮傷與接觸金屬。局部遮陽、室內暖氣出風口或深色貼紙會讓同一片玻璃中央與邊緣溫差擴大，在邊緣產生拉應力；未強化或邊緣受損的玻璃最容易因熱應力破裂。強化玻璃還要檢查應力分布是否均勻（以偏光觀察）與輥筒波紋等光學缺陷，後者雖不影響安全，卻常是業主驗收爭議的來源。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Glass breakage almost always starts at an edge or hole, so site inspection concentrates on edges: grinding grade, chips, scratches and metal contact. Partial shading, heating outlets or dark films widen the temperature difference between the centre and edge of a pane and create edge tension; untoughened glass or damaged edges are most prone to thermal breakage. Toughened glass is also checked for uniform stress distribution by polarised viewing and for optical defects such as roller wave, which do not affect safety but often cause acceptance disputes with the owner. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Glass edge quality and thermal stress” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱應力 σ ≈ E·α·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal stress σ ≈ E·α·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Glass edge quality and thermal stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質
knowledge.titleEn: Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality
knowledge.text: 玻璃破裂幾乎都從邊緣或孔緣開始，因此現場檢查的重點是邊緣：研磨等級、崩邊、刮傷與接觸金屬。局部遮陽、室內暖氣出風口或深色貼紙會讓同一片玻璃中央與邊緣溫差擴大，在邊緣產生拉應力；未強化或邊緣受損的玻璃最容易因熱應力破裂。
knowledge.textEn: Glass breakage almost always starts at an edge or hole, so site inspection concentrates on edges: grinding grade, chips, scratches and metal contact. Partial shading, heating outlets or dark films widen the temperature difference between the centre and edge of a pane and create edge tension; untoughened glass or damaged edges are most prone to thermal breakage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality" is correct?
options: 玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。
熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。
玻璃破裂幾乎都從邊緣或孔緣開始，因此現場檢查的重點是邊緣：研磨等級、崩邊、刮傷與接觸金屬。
optionsEn: Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact.
Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously.
Glass breakage almost always starts at an edge or hole, so site inspection concentrates on edges: grinding grade, chips, scratches and metal contact.
quiz.explanation: 玻璃破裂幾乎都從邊緣或孔緣開始，因此現場檢查的重點是邊緣：研磨等級、崩邊、刮傷與接觸金屬。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Glass breakage almost always starts at an edge or hole, so site inspection concentrates on edges: grinding grade, chips, scratches and metal contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Glass edge quality and thermal stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱應力 σ ≈ E·α·ΔT。E = 70,000 MPa、α = 9×10⁻⁶ /K、中央與遮陰邊緣溫差 ΔT = 30 K：σ ≈ 70,000×9×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 18.9 MPa，已接近未強化玻璃受損邊緣的允許應力；若 ΔT 增為 40 K，σ ≈ 25.2 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal stress σ ≈ E·α·ΔT. With E = 70,000 MPa, α = 9×10⁻⁶ /K and a 30 K difference between the sunlit centre and shaded edge: σ ≈ 70,000×9×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 18.9 MPa, close to the allowable stress of a damaged annealed edge; with ΔT = 40 K, σ ≈ 25.2 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每片玻璃進場與安裝後以目視與放大鏡檢查邊緣，記錄崩邊大小與位置並對照允收標準；以熱應力分析檢查遮陽、暖氣與貼膜配置；強化玻璃以偏光片抽查應力分布，光學品質依合約約定的觀看距離與角度判定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect every pane's edges visually and with a magnifier on arrival and after installation, recording chip size and position against the acceptance standard; check shading, heating and film layouts with a thermal-stress analysis; spot-check toughened glass with polarising filters, and judge optical quality at the viewing distance and angle stated in the contract.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱應力 σ ≈ E·α·ΔT。E = 70,000 MPa、α = 9×10⁻⁶ /K、中央與遮陰邊緣溫差 ΔT = 30 K：σ ≈ 70,000×9×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 18.9 MPa，已接近未強化玻璃受損邊緣的允許應力；若 ΔT 增為 40 K，σ ≈ 25.2 MPa。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal stress σ ≈ E·α·ΔT. With E = 70,000 MPa, α = 9×10⁻⁶ /K and a 30 K difference between the sunlit centre and shaded edge: σ ≈ 70,000×9×10⁻⁶×30 ≈ 18.9 MPa, close to the allowable stress of a damaged annealed edge; with ΔT = 40 K, σ ≈ 25.2 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality", which statement holds?
options: 熱應力 σ ≈ E·α·ΔT。
全玻璃立面的玻璃肋只是裝飾，風壓主要由面玻璃自己承受。
膠合玻璃的強度永遠等於同總厚度的單片玻璃。
optionsEn: Thermal stress σ ≈ E·α·ΔT.
Glass fins in an all-glass façade are decorative; the face glass carries the wind by itself.
A laminated pane is always as strong and stiff as a monolithic pane of the same total thickness.
quiz.explanation: 熱應力 σ ≈ E·α·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal stress σ ≈ E·α·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Glass edge quality and thermal stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每片玻璃進場與安裝後以目視與放大鏡檢查邊緣，記錄崩邊大小與位置並對照允收標準；以熱應力分析檢查遮陽、暖氣與貼膜配置；強化玻璃以偏光片抽查應力分布，光學品質依合約約定的觀看距離與角度判定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect every pane's edges visually and with a magnifier on arrival and after installation, recording chip size and position against the acceptance standard; check shading, heating and film layouts with a thermal-stress analysis; spot-check toughened glass with polarising filters, and judge optical quality at the viewing distance and angle stated in the contract. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工文件要列出禁止事項（例如未經評估不得貼膜、不得在玻璃附近加裝出風口），並規定玻璃清潔與維修時使用不傷邊緣的工具；所有崩邊紀錄與更換紀錄都要納入維護資料庫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Completion documents must list prohibitions, such as no films and no new air outlets near the glass without assessment, and require cleaning and maintenance tools that cannot damage edges; all chip and replacement records go into the maintenance database.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：安裝時被金屬工具碰出的小崩邊未被記錄，冬季清晨室內暖氣直吹玻璃下緣、上半部仍冰冷，溫差使邊緣拉應力超過受損邊緣強度而破裂；業主事後貼深色隔熱膜也可能讓原本安全的玻璃熱裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small chip from a metal tool during installation goes unrecorded, then on a winter morning heating blows on the lower edge while the upper part is still cold and the edge tension exceeds the damaged edge's strength; a dark solar film added later by the owner can also crack glass that was originally safe. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每片玻璃進場與安裝後以目視與放大鏡檢查邊緣，記錄崩邊大小與位置並對照允收標準；以熱應力分析檢查遮陽、暖氣與貼膜配置；強化玻璃以偏光片抽查應力分布，光學品質依合約約定的觀看距離與角度判定。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect every pane's edges visually and with a magnifier on arrival and after installation, recording chip size and position against the acceptance standard; check shading, heating and film layouts with a thermal-stress analysis; spot-check toughened glass with polarising filters, and judge optical quality at the viewing distance and angle stated in the contract.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 竣工文件要列出禁止事項（例如未經評估不得貼膜、不得在玻璃附近加裝出風口），並規定玻璃清潔與維修時使用不傷邊緣的工具；所有崩邊紀錄與更換紀錄都要納入維護資料庫。
knowledge.textEn: Completion documents must list prohibitions, such as no films and no new air outlets near the glass without assessment, and require cleaning and maintenance tools that cannot damage edges; all chip and replacement records go into the maintenance database.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
每片玻璃進場與安裝後以目視與放大鏡檢查邊緣，記錄崩邊大小與位置並對照允收標準。
玻璃肋在使用期的受力最大，吊裝過程的應力可以忽略。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Inspect every pane's edges visually and with a magnifier on arrival and after installation, recording chip size and position against the acceptance standard.
A glass fin sees its highest stresses in service, so handling stresses can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 每片玻璃進場與安裝後以目視與放大鏡檢查邊緣，記錄崩邊大小與位置並對照允收標準；以熱應力分析檢查遮陽、暖氣與貼膜配置；強化玻璃以偏光片抽查應力分布，光學品質依合約約定的觀看距離與角度判定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect every pane's edges visually and with a magnifier on arrival and after installation, recording chip size and position against the acceptance standard; check shading, heating and film layouts with a thermal-stress analysis; spot-check toughened glass with polarising filters, and judge optical quality at the viewing distance and angle stated in the contract. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「玻璃邊緣品質與熱應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Glass edge quality and thermal stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 安裝時被金屬工具碰出的小崩邊未被記錄，冬季清晨室內暖氣直吹玻璃下緣、上半部仍冰冷，溫差使邊緣拉應力超過受損邊緣強度而破裂；業主事後貼深色隔熱膜也可能讓原本安全的玻璃熱裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A small chip from a metal tool during installation goes unrecorded, then on a winter morning heating blows on the lower edge while the upper part is still cold and the edge tension exceeds the damaged edge's strength; a dark solar film added later by the owner can also crack glass that was originally safe. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：強化玻璃還要檢查應力分布是否均勻（以偏光觀察）與輥筒波紋等光學缺陷，後者雖不影響安全，卻常是業主驗收爭議的來源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Toughened glass is also checked for uniform stress distribution by polarised viewing and for optical defects such as roller wave, which do not affect safety but often cause acceptance disputes with the owner.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻璃破裂一定是因為風壓或撞擊過大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Glass always breaks because of excessive wind or impact." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 安裝時被金屬工具碰出的小崩邊未被記錄，冬季清晨室內暖氣直吹玻璃下緣、上半部仍冰冷，溫差使邊緣拉應力超過受損邊緣強度而破裂；業主事後貼深色隔熱膜也可能讓原本安全的玻璃熱裂。
knowledge.textEn: A small chip from a metal tool during installation goes unrecorded, then on a winter morning heating blows on the lower edge while the upper part is still cold and the edge tension exceeds the damaged edge's strength; a dark solar film added later by the owner can also crack glass that was originally safe.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場檢查：邊緣、熱應力與光學品質」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site inspection: edges, thermal stress and optical quality" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。
安裝時被金屬工具碰出的小崩邊未被記錄，冬季清晨室內暖氣直吹玻璃下緣、上半部仍冰冷，溫差使邊緣拉應力超過受損邊緣強度而破裂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously.

A small chip from a metal tool during installation goes unrecorded, then on a winter morning heating blows on the lower edge while the upper part is still cold and the edge tension exceeds the damaged edge's strength.
quiz.explanation: 安裝時被金屬工具碰出的小崩邊未被記錄，冬季清晨室內暖氣直吹玻璃下緣、上半部仍冰冷，溫差使邊緣拉應力超過受損邊緣強度而破裂；業主事後貼深色隔熱膜也可能讓原本安全的玻璃熱裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A small chip from a metal tool during installation goes unrecorded, then on a winter morning heating blows on the lower edge while the upper part is still cold and the edge tension exceeds the damaged edge's strength; a dark solar film added later by the owner can also crack glass that was originally safe. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久」與「更換計畫、簡化接合與竣工交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability" and "Replacement planning, simplified joints and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「硫化鎳自爆風險」如何影響大型玻璃肋結構安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nickel-sulphide breakage risk” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural glass-fin installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 強化玻璃內若含硫化鎳雜質，雜質在常溫下會緩慢相變並體積膨脹，數年後可能讓玻璃在沒有外力的情況下突然破裂，這就是自爆。熱浸處理（如 EN 14179）把強化後的玻璃加熱並保持一段時間，讓含雜質的玻璃在工廠先破，以降低現場自爆機率，但無法完全消除。玻璃肋若為強化玻璃，自爆一片就要靠其餘玻璃與中間膜承擔；長期而言，中間膜邊緣受潮脫層、矽利康老化與金屬件腐蝕也會削弱接合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「硫化鎳自爆風險」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: If toughened glass contains a nickel-sulphide inclusion, the inclusion slowly changes phase and expands at ambient temperature, and years later the glass may shatter with no external load, which is spontaneous breakage. Heat soaking, for example to EN 14179, reheats toughened glass and holds it at temperature so that affected panes break in the factory, reducing but not eliminating the site risk. In a toughened-glass fin one broken ply must be carried by the remaining plies and interlayer; in the long term, moisture delamination at interlayer edges, silicone ageing and corrosion of fittings also weaken the joints. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Nickel-sulphide breakage risk” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若每片未熱浸強化玻璃的使用期自爆機率取 p = 0.1%，120 片中至少一片自爆的機率 = 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%；熱浸處理使 p 降為 0.01% 時，機率約 1.2%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If each non-heat-soaked toughened pane has a lifetime spontaneous-breakage probability p = 0.1%, the chance that at least one of 120 panes breaks is 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%; if heat soaking lowers p to 0.01%, the chance is about 1.2%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「硫化鎳自爆風險」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久
knowledge.titleEn: Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability
knowledge.text: 強化玻璃內若含硫化鎳雜質，雜質在常溫下會緩慢相變並體積膨脹，數年後可能讓玻璃在沒有外力的情況下突然破裂，這就是自爆。熱浸處理（如 EN 14179）把強化後的玻璃加熱並保持一段時間，讓含雜質的玻璃在工廠先破，以降低現場自爆機率，但無法完全消除。
knowledge.textEn: If toughened glass contains a nickel-sulphide inclusion, the inclusion slowly changes phase and expands at ambient temperature, and years later the glass may shatter with no external load, which is spontaneous breakage. Heat soaking, for example to EN 14179, reheats toughened glass and holds it at temperature so that affected panes break in the factory, reducing but not eliminating the site risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability" is correct?
options: 強化玻璃內若含硫化鎳雜質，雜質在常溫下會緩慢相變並體積膨脹，數年後可能讓玻璃在沒有外力的情況下突然破裂，這就是自爆。
熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。
玻璃結構完工後不會再更換，因此不必保留吊點與運輸路徑。
optionsEn: If toughened glass contains a nickel-sulphide inclusion, the inclusion slowly changes phase and expands at ambient temperature, and years later the glass may shatter with no external load, which is spontaneous breakage.
Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously.
A glass structure will never be replaced, so pick points and access routes need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 強化玻璃內若含硫化鎳雜質，雜質在常溫下會緩慢相變並體積膨脹，數年後可能讓玻璃在沒有外力的情況下突然破裂，這就是自爆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: If toughened glass contains a nickel-sulphide inclusion, the inclusion slowly changes phase and expands at ambient temperature, and years later the glass may shatter with no external load, which is spontaneous breakage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「硫化鎳自爆風險」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nickel-sulphide breakage risk” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若每片未熱浸強化玻璃的使用期自爆機率取 p = 0.1%，120 片中至少一片自爆的機率 = 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%；熱浸處理使 p 降為 0.01% 時，機率約 1.2%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何產品或標準的統計值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If each non-heat-soaked toughened pane has a lifetime spontaneous-breakage probability p = 0.1%, the chance that at least one of 120 panes breaks is 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%; if heat soaking lowers p to 0.01%, the chance is about 1.2%. Values are teaching assumptions, not statistics for any product or standard. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：要求玻璃廠提交每批熱浸處理的爐溫紀錄與保溫時間，並在玻璃上留可追溯的標記；使用期定期檢查玻璃肋的破裂、中間膜邊緣脫層與白化、矽利康硬化或龜裂、金屬件鏽蝕與螺栓鬆動，以照片與量測結果和竣工基準比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Require furnace temperature records and dwell times for every heat-soak batch and traceable marks on each pane; in service inspect fins periodically for breakage, interlayer edge delamination and clouding, silicone hardening or cracking, corrosion of fittings and loose bolts, comparing photographs and measurements with the completion baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若每片未熱浸強化玻璃的使用期自爆機率取 p = 0.1%，120 片中至少一片自爆的機率 = 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%；熱浸處理使 p 降為 0.01% 時，機率約 1.2%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何產品或標準的統計值。
knowledge.textEn: If each non-heat-soaked toughened pane has a lifetime spontaneous-breakage probability p = 0.1%, the chance that at least one of 120 panes breaks is 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%; if heat soaking lowers p to 0.01%, the chance is about 1.2%. Values are teaching assumptions, not statistics for any product or standard.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability", which statement holds?
options: 玻璃肋只要彎曲應力低於玻璃強度，就不會失效。
若每片未熱浸強化玻璃的使用期自爆機率取 p = 0.1%，120 片中至少一片自爆的機率 = 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%。
結構矽利康越厚、塗得越多，接合就越安全。
optionsEn: A glass fin cannot fail as long as its bending stress is below the strength of glass.
If each non-heat-soaked toughened pane has a lifetime spontaneous-breakage probability p = 0.1%, the chance that at least one of 120 panes breaks is 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%.
The thicker and more generous the structural silicone, the safer the joint.
quiz.explanation: 若每片未熱浸強化玻璃的使用期自爆機率取 p = 0.1%，120 片中至少一片自爆的機率 = 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%；熱浸處理使 p 降為 0.01% 時，機率約 1.2%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If each non-heat-soaked toughened pane has a lifetime spontaneous-breakage probability p = 0.1%, the chance that at least one of 120 panes breaks is 1 − (1 − 0.001)¹²⁰ ≈ 11.3%; if heat soaking lowers p to 0.01%, the chance is about 1.2%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「硫化鎳自爆風險」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nickel-sulphide breakage risk” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 要求玻璃廠提交每批熱浸處理的爐溫紀錄與保溫時間，並在玻璃上留可追溯的標記；使用期定期檢查玻璃肋的破裂、中間膜邊緣脫層與白化、矽利康硬化或龜裂、金屬件鏽蝕與螺栓鬆動，以照片與量測結果和竣工基準比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Require furnace temperature records and dwell times for every heat-soak batch and traceable marks on each pane; in service inspect fins periodically for breakage, interlayer edge delamination and clouding, silicone hardening or cracking, corrosion of fittings and loose bolts, comparing photographs and measurements with the completion baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構玻璃肋至少應採多片膠合並以一片破裂作為設計情境，外層用半強化或熱浸強化玻璃；維護手冊要寫明破裂後的緊急隔離範圍、臨時支撐方式與更換程序，並由帷幕牆工程師判定是否可繼續開放使用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Structural fins should be multi-ply laminates designed for the one-ply-broken case, with heat-strengthened or heat-soaked toughened outer plies; the maintenance manual must state the emergency exclusion zone, temporary support and replacement procedure after breakage, with the façade engineer deciding whether the area can stay open.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：結構玻璃肋全部採用未熱浸的強化玻璃且未考慮一片破裂的殘餘承載，一次自爆就可能讓整支肋失去承載，面玻璃隨之鬆脫；中間膜邊緣長期浸水造成脫層，耦合降低而增加挫屈風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using non-heat-soaked toughened glass throughout the fins without checking residual capacity after one ply breaks means a single spontaneous breakage can disable a whole fin and release the face glass; long-term water at interlayer edges causes delamination, reducing coupling and increasing buckling risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 要求玻璃廠提交每批熱浸處理的爐溫紀錄與保溫時間，並在玻璃上留可追溯的標記；使用期定期檢查玻璃肋的破裂、中間膜邊緣脫層與白化、矽利康硬化或龜裂、金屬件鏽蝕與螺栓鬆動，以照片與量測結果和竣工基準比較。
knowledge.textEn: Require furnace temperature records and dwell times for every heat-soak batch and traceable marks on each pane; in service inspect fins periodically for breakage, interlayer edge delamination and clouding, silicone hardening or cracking, corrosion of fittings and loose bolts, comparing photographs and measurements with the completion baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構玻璃肋至少應採多片膠合並以一片破裂作為設計情境，外層用半強化或熱浸強化玻璃；維護手冊要寫明破裂後的緊急隔離範圍、臨時支撐方式與更換程序，並由帷幕牆工程師判定是否可繼續開放使用。

quiz.question: 要驗證「自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

The more rigidly a fin is fixed at both ends, the more stable the façade.

quiz.explanationEn: Require furnace temperature records and dwell times for every heat-soak batch and traceable marks on each pane; in service inspect fins periodically for breakage, interlayer edge delamination and clouding, silicone hardening or cracking, corrosion of fittings and loose bolts, comparing photographs and measurements with the completion baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spontaneous breakage, heat soaking and long-term durability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「硫化鎳自爆風險」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nickel-sulphide breakage risk” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 結構玻璃肋全部採用未熱浸的強化玻璃且未考慮一片破裂的殘餘承載，一次自爆就可能讓整支肋失去承載，面玻璃隨之鬆脫；中間膜邊緣長期浸水造成脫層，耦合降低而增加挫屈風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using non-heat-soaked toughened glass throughout the fins without checking residual capacity after one ply breaks means a single spontaneous breakage can disable a whole fin and release the face glass; long-term water at interlayer edges causes delamination, reducing coupling and increasing buckling risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：玻璃肋若為強化玻璃，自爆一片就要靠其餘玻璃與中間膜承擔；長期而言，中間膜邊緣受潮脫層、矽利康老化與金屬件腐蝕也會削弱接合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In a toughened-glass fin one broken ply must be carried by the remaining plies and interlayer; in the long term, moisture delamination at interlayer edges, silicone ageing and corrosion of fittings also weaken the joints.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「熱浸處理後的強化玻璃就完全不會自爆。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Heat-soaked toughened glass can never break spontaneously." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 結構玻璃肋全部採用未熱浸的強化玻璃且未考慮一片破裂的殘餘承載，一次自爆就可能讓整支肋失去承載，面玻璃隨之鬆脫；中間膜邊緣長期浸水造成脫層，耦合降低而增加挫屈風險。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「自爆、熱浸處理與長期耐久」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

quiz.explanationEn: Using non-heat-soaked toughened glass throughout the fins without checking residual capacity after one ply breaks means a single spontaneous breakage can disable a whole fin and release the face glass; long-term water at interlayer edges causes delamination, reducing coupling and increasing buckling risk.
