quiz.explanationEn: A module is a large, thin box whose forces in lifting differ completely from those in service: four slings pulled straight to the hook push inward on the top frame with their horizontal components, which can distort the frame and crack wall panels and finishes, so a lifting frame or spreader beam keeps the slings vertical. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊點設計、吊具與模組變形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊點與吊裝框」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lift points and lifting frame” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：模組 25 t、動力係數 1.2，吊重 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN。四肢吊索與水平成 60° 時，每肢張力 T = 294/(4 sin 60°) ≈ 85.0 kN，水平分力 T cos 60° ≈ 42.5 kN 向內壓擠頂框；改用吊裝框使吊索垂直後，每肢 294/4 ≈ 73.6 kN，水平分力趨近 0。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 25 t module with a dynamic factor of 1.2 gives a hook load of 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN. With four sling legs at 60° to the horizontal, each leg carries T = 294/(4 sin 60°) ≈ 85.0 kN and its horizontal component T cos 60° ≈ 42.5 kN squeezes the top frame inward; a lifting frame that keeps slings vertical gives 294/4 ≈ 73.6 kN per leg with nearly zero horizontal component. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊點以計算與荷重試驗確認，吊裝框依 EN 13155 一類標準設計並標示額定荷重與自重；每種模組型式在工廠先試吊，量測離地後的傾斜角與框架變形並與重心計算比較，調整後才放行運送。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm lift points by calculation and load test, design the lifting frame to standards such as EN 13155 and mark it with rated load and self-weight; trial-lift each module type at the factory, measuring tilt and frame distortion once clear of the ground against the centre-of-gravity calculation, and release it for shipping only after adjustment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 模組 25 t、動力係數 1.2，吊重 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN。四肢吊索與水平成 60° 時，每肢張力 T = 294/(4 sin 60°) ≈ 85.0 kN，水平分力 T cos 60° ≈ 42.5 kN 向內壓擠頂框；改用吊裝框使吊索垂直後，每肢 294/4 ≈ 73.6 kN，水平分力趨近 0。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 25 t module with a dynamic factor of 1.2 gives a hook load of 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN. With four sling legs at 60° to the horizontal, each leg carries T = 294/(4 sin 60°) ≈ 85.0 kN and its horizontal component T cos 60° ≈ 42.5 kN squeezes the top frame inward; a lifting frame that keeps slings vertical gives 294/4 ≈ 73.6 kN per leg with nearly zero horizontal component. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊點設計、吊具與模組變形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion", which statement holds?
options: 模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。
模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。
optionsEn: Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.
Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation.
A 25 t module with a dynamic factor of 1.2 gives a hook load of 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN.
quiz.explanation: 模組 25 t、動力係數 1.2，吊重 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 25 t module with a dynamic factor of 1.2 gives a hook load of 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊點設計、吊具與模組變形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊點與吊裝框」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lift points and lifting frame” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 吊點以計算與荷重試驗確認，吊裝框依 EN 13155 一類標準設計並標示額定荷重與自重；每種模組型式在工廠先試吊，量測離地後的傾斜角與框架變形並與重心計算比較，調整後才放行運送。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm lift points by calculation and load test, design the lifting frame to standards such as EN 13155 and mark it with rated load and self-weight; trial-lift each module type at the factory, measuring tilt and frame distortion once clear of the ground against the centre-of-gravity calculation, and release it for shipping only after adjustment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每種模組都要有吊裝計算書與吊點圖，標示重量、重心與吊具配置；吊具須有荷重試驗證明與定期檢查紀錄，吊裝計畫由合格的吊掛負責人簽核，現場依核准的計畫作業。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Every module type needs a lifting calculation and lift-point drawing showing weight, centre of gravity and rigging arrangement; lifting gear needs load-test certificates and periodic inspection records, and the lifting plan is signed by a competent lifting supervisor and followed as approved on site.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未用吊裝框而直接斜拉吊索，模組頂框被壓彎，落位後門框變形、石膏板接縫開裂；重心估算錯誤使模組在高空傾斜，接近定位時撞擊已安裝的模組，造成損壞並威脅下方人員。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Slinging directly at an angle without a lifting frame bends the module's top frame, so after setting the door frames are distorted and plasterboard joints crack; a wrong centre-of-gravity estimate tilts the module at height so it strikes already-installed modules on approach, causing damage and endangering people below. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 吊點以計算與荷重試驗確認，吊裝框依 EN 13155 一類標準設計並標示額定荷重與自重；每種模組型式在工廠先試吊，量測離地後的傾斜角與框架變形並與重心計算比較，調整後才放行運送。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm lift points by calculation and load test, design the lifting frame to standards such as EN 13155 and mark it with rated load and self-weight; trial-lift each module type at the factory, measuring tilt and frame distortion once clear of the ground against the centre-of-gravity calculation, and release it for shipping only after adjustment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每種模組都要有吊裝計算書與吊點圖，標示重量、重心與吊具配置；吊具須有荷重試驗證明與定期檢查紀錄，吊裝計畫由合格的吊掛負責人簽核，現場依核准的計畫作業。
knowledge.textEn: Every module type needs a lifting calculation and lift-point drawing showing weight, centre of gravity and rigging arrangement; lifting gear needs load-test certificates and periodic inspection records, and the lifting plan is signed by a competent lifting supervisor and followed as approved on site.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊點設計、吊具與模組變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion"?
options: 吊點以計算與荷重試驗確認，吊裝框依 EN 13155 一類標準設計並標示額定荷重與自重。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。
optionsEn: Confirm lift points by calculation and load test, design the lifting frame to standards such as EN 13155 and mark it with rated load and self-weight.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis.
quiz.explanation: 吊點以計算與荷重試驗確認，吊裝框依 EN 13155 一類標準設計並標示額定荷重與自重；每種模組型式在工廠先試吊，量測離地後的傾斜角與框架變形並與重心計算比較，調整後才放行運送。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm lift points by calculation and load test, design the lifting frame to standards such as EN 13155 and mark it with rated load and self-weight; trial-lift each module type at the factory, measuring tilt and frame distortion once clear of the ground against the centre-of-gravity calculation, and release it for shipping only after adjustment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊點設計、吊具與模組變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊點與吊裝框」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift points and lifting frame” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未用吊裝框而直接斜拉吊索，模組頂框被壓彎，落位後門框變形、石膏板接縫開裂；重心估算錯誤使模組在高空傾斜，接近定位時撞擊已安裝的模組，造成損壞並威脅下方人員。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slinging directly at an angle without a lifting frame bends the module's top frame, so after setting the door frames are distorted and plasterboard joints crack; a wrong centre-of-gravity estimate tilts the module at height so it strikes already-installed modules on approach, causing damage and endangering people below. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：吊點與吊具屬於臨時工程，必須依起重相關標準設計、標示額定荷重並做荷重試驗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lift points and lifting gear are temporary works that must be designed to lifting-equipment standards, marked with their rated load and load-tested.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未用吊裝框而直接斜拉吊索，模組頂框被壓彎，落位後門框變形、石膏板接縫開裂；重心估算錯誤使模組在高空傾斜，接近定位時撞擊已安裝的模組，造成損壞並威脅下方人員。
knowledge.textEn: Slinging directly at an angle without a lifting frame bends the module's top frame, so after setting the door frames are distorted and plasterboard joints crack; a wrong centre-of-gravity estimate tilts the module at height so it strikes already-installed modules on approach, causing damage and endangering people below.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊點設計、吊具與模組變形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
未用吊裝框而直接斜拉吊索，模組頂框被壓彎，落位後門框變形、石膏板接縫開裂；重心估算錯誤使模組在高空傾斜，接近定位時撞擊已安裝的模組，造成損壞並威脅下方人員。
只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Slinging directly at an angle without a lifting frame bends the module's top frame, so after setting the door frames are distorted and plasterboard joints crack.
If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed.
quiz.explanation: 未用吊裝框而直接斜拉吊索，模組頂框被壓彎，落位後門框變形、石膏板接縫開裂；重心估算錯誤使模組在高空傾斜，接近定位時撞擊已安裝的模組，造成損壞並威脅下方人員。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Slinging directly at an angle without a lifting frame bends the module's top frame, so after setting the door frames are distorted and plasterboard joints crack; a wrong centre-of-gravity estimate tilts the module at height so it strikes already-installed modules on approach, causing damage and endangering people below. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制」與「堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits" and "Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「起重半徑與受風面積」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crane radius and wind area” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模組重量集中、外形大，起重機選型要同時考慮吊重、半徑與吊高，最遠、最重的模組通常決定起重機規格。模組像一面帆，受風面積遠大於鋼梁，風會讓吊在空中的模組旋轉與擺動，使定位困難並可能撞擊結構，所以模組吊裝的允許風速通常低於一般吊裝。吊裝順序要讓結構在每個階段都穩定，並配合即時進場的運輸排程，減少工地堆置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「起重半徑與受風面積」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Modules are heavy and bulky, so crane selection must consider load, radius and hook height together, and the farthest, heaviest module usually sets the crane size. A module acts like a sail with far more wind area than a steel beam, so wind turns and swings it in the air, making placement difficult and risking impact with the structure; module lifting therefore usually has a lower permissible wind speed than ordinary lifting. The lifting sequence must keep the structure stable at every stage and match just-in-time delivery to minimise storage on site. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Crane radius and wind area” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A module face of 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m² with C_d = 1.2 and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ takes F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N at 10 m/s and 6,480 N at 15 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「起重半徑與受風面積」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Crane radius and wind area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制
knowledge.titleEn: Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits
knowledge.text: 模組重量集中、外形大，起重機選型要同時考慮吊重、半徑與吊高，最遠、最重的模組通常決定起重機規格。模組像一面帆，受風面積遠大於鋼梁，風會讓吊在空中的模組旋轉與擺動，使定位困難並可能撞擊結構，所以模組吊裝的允許風速通常低於一般吊裝。
knowledge.textEn: Modules are heavy and bulky, so crane selection must consider load, radius and hook height together, and the farthest, heaviest module usually sets the crane size. A module acts like a sail with far more wind area than a steel beam, so wind turns and swings it in the air, making placement difficult and risking impact with the structure; module lifting therefore usually has a lower permissible wind speed than ordinary lifting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits" is correct?
options: 只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。
只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。
模組重量集中、外形大，起重機選型要同時考慮吊重、半徑與吊高，最遠、最重的模組通常決定起重機規格。
optionsEn: If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed.
If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too.
Modules are heavy and bulky, so crane selection must consider load, radius and hook height together, and the farthest, heaviest module usually sets the crane size.
quiz.explanation: 模組重量集中、外形大，起重機選型要同時考慮吊重、半徑與吊高，最遠、最重的模組通常決定起重機規格。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Modules are heavy and bulky, so crane selection must consider load, radius and hook height together, and the farthest, heaviest module usually sets the crane size. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「起重半徑與受風面積」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crane radius and wind area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：模組受風面積 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m²，C_d = 1.2、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³：風速 10 m/s 時 F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N，15 m/s 時 6,480 N。相對於 25 t（約 245 kN）的重量，偏擺角約 atan(6.48/245) ≈ 1.5°，吊索長 40 m 時水平偏移約 40×6.48/245 ≈ 1.06 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A module face of 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m² with C_d = 1.2 and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ takes F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N at 10 m/s and 6,480 N at 15 m/s. Against a 25 t weight of about 245 kN the swing angle is about atan(6.48/245) ≈ 1.5°, so with 40 m of hoist rope the horizontal offset is about 40×6.48/245 ≈ 1.06 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊裝前核對每一模組的出廠秤重、吊具重量與半徑，對照起重機荷重表；現場以風速計在吊高處量測陣風，超過計畫門檻即暫停；每次吊裝記錄模組編號、重量、風速與定位時間，作為後續吊次規劃依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before lifting, check each module's weighed factory mass, rigging weight and radius against the crane load chart; measure gusts at hook height with an anemometer and stop when the planned limit is exceeded; record module number, weight, wind speed and placement time for every lift to inform later lift planning.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: A module face of 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m² with C_d = 1.2 and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ takes F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N at 10 m/s and 6,480 N at 15 m/s. Against a 25 t weight of about 245 kN the swing angle is about atan(6.48/245) ≈ 1.5°, so with 40 m of hoist rope the horizontal offset is about 40×6.48/245 ≈ 1.06 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits", which statement holds?
options: 扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。
模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。
optionsEn: A module face of 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m² with C_d = 1.2 and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ takes F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N at 10 m/s and 6,480 N at 15 m/s.
Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload.
Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records.
quiz.explanationEn: A module face of 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m² with C_d = 1.2 and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ takes F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N at 10 m/s and 6,480 N at 15 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「起重半徑與受風面積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crane radius and wind area” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 吊裝前核對每一模組的出廠秤重、吊具重量與半徑，對照起重機荷重表；現場以風速計在吊高處量測陣風，超過計畫門檻即暫停；每次吊裝記錄模組編號、重量、風速與定位時間，作為後續吊次規劃依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before lifting, check each module's weighed factory mass, rigging weight and radius against the crane load chart; measure gusts at hook height with an anemometer and stop when the planned limit is exceeded; record module number, weight, wind speed and placement time for every lift to inform later lift planning. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝計畫須列出每一吊次的重量、半徑、使用率、允許風速、牽引繩配置與禁區，經吊掛負責人與工地主任核准；風速、能見度或通訊不符條件時，吊掛負責人有權也有義務停止作業。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lifting plan must list weight, radius, utilisation, permissible wind speed, tag-line arrangement and exclusion zone for every lift, approved by the lifting supervisor and site manager; when wind, visibility or communications fall outside the conditions, the lifting supervisor has both the authority and the duty to stop work.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以設計重量而非出廠秤重規劃吊次，裝修與設備增加的重量使部分吊次超過起重機在該半徑的能力；在陣風中勉強吊裝，模組旋轉撞擊鷹架，拉牽引繩的工人被拖行受傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Planning lifts from design weights instead of weighed factory masses lets added finishes and equipment push some lifts beyond the crane's capacity at that radius; forcing a lift in gusts spins the module into scaffolding and drags tag-line workers, injuring them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 吊裝前核對每一模組的出廠秤重、吊具重量與半徑，對照起重機荷重表；現場以風速計在吊高處量測陣風，超過計畫門檻即暫停；每次吊裝記錄模組編號、重量、風速與定位時間，作為後續吊次規劃依據。
knowledge.textEn: Before lifting, check each module's weighed factory mass, rigging weight and radius against the crane load chart; measure gusts at hook height with an anemometer and stop when the planned limit is exceeded; record module number, weight, wind speed and placement time for every lift to inform later lift planning.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊裝計畫須列出每一吊次的重量、半徑、使用率、允許風速、牽引繩配置與禁區，經吊掛負責人與工地主任核准；風速、能見度或通訊不符條件時，吊掛負責人有權也有義務停止作業。
knowledge.textEn: The lifting plan must list weight, radius, utilisation, permissible wind speed, tag-line arrangement and exclusion zone for every lift, approved by the lifting supervisor and site manager; when wind, visibility or communications fall outside the conditions, the lifting supervisor has both the authority and the duty to stop work.

quiz.question: 要驗證「起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
吊裝前核對每一模組的出廠秤重、吊具重量與半徑，對照起重機荷重表。
模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before lifting, check each module's weighed factory mass, rigging weight and radius against the crane load chart.
As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝前核對每一模組的出廠秤重、吊具重量與半徑，對照起重機荷重表；現場以風速計在吊高處量測陣風，超過計畫門檻即暫停；每次吊裝記錄模組編號、重量、風速與定位時間，作為後續吊次規劃依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before lifting, check each module's weighed factory mass, rigging weight and radius against the crane load chart; measure gusts at hook height with an anemometer and stop when the planned limit is exceeded; record module number, weight, wind speed and placement time for every lift to inform later lift planning. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「起重半徑與受風面積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crane radius and wind area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以設計重量而非出廠秤重規劃吊次，裝修與設備增加的重量使部分吊次超過起重機在該半徑的能力；在陣風中勉強吊裝，模組旋轉撞擊鷹架，拉牽引繩的工人被拖行受傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Planning lifts from design weights instead of weighed factory masses lets added finishes and equipment push some lifts beyond the crane's capacity at that radius; forcing a lift in gusts spins the module into scaffolding and drags tag-line workers, injuring them. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：吊裝順序要讓結構在每個階段都穩定，並配合即時進場的運輸排程，減少工地堆置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The lifting sequence must keep the structure stable at every stage and match just-in-time delivery to minimise storage on site.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以設計重量而非出廠秤重規劃吊次，裝修與設備增加的重量使部分吊次超過起重機在該半徑的能力；在陣風中勉強吊裝，模組旋轉撞擊鷹架，拉牽引繩的工人被拖行受傷。
knowledge.textEn: Planning lifts from design weights instead of weighed factory masses lets added finishes and equipment push some lifts beyond the crane's capacity at that radius; forcing a lift in gusts spins the module into scaffolding and drags tag-line workers, injuring them.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。
以設計重量而非出廠秤重規劃吊次，裝修與設備增加的重量使部分吊次超過起重機在該半徑的能力；在陣風中勉強吊裝，模組旋轉撞擊鷹架，拉牽引繩的工人被拖行受傷。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too.
Planning lifts from design weights instead of weighed factory masses lets added finishes and equipment push some lifts beyond the crane's capacity at that radius.
quiz.explanation: 以設計重量而非出廠秤重規劃吊次，裝修與設備增加的重量使部分吊次超過起重機在該半徑的能力；在陣風中勉強吊裝，模組旋轉撞擊鷹架，拉牽引繩的工人被拖行受傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Planning lifts from design weights instead of weighed factory masses lets added finishes and equipment push some lifts beyond the crane's capacity at that radius; forcing a lift in gusts spins the module into scaffolding and drags tag-line workers, injuring them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「墊片與堆疊標高」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shims and stack levels” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每個模組出廠時都有高度、長度與方正度的製造公差，堆疊時這些偏差會逐層累積，墊塊壓縮、接頭間隙與裙樓轉換層的平整度也會加入。若不控制，高樓層模組的樓板會越來越不水平、外牆線條歪斜，帷幕或外牆板接縫寬度失控。因此安裝時每隔幾層就要量測標高與垂直度並以墊片修正，裙樓或轉換層頂面的精度要求也必須比一般樓板嚴格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墊片與堆疊標高」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every module leaves the factory with height, length and squareness tolerances, and in stacking these deviations accumulate floor by floor, joined by packer compression, joint gaps and the flatness of the podium or transfer level. Uncontrolled, upper module floors drift out of level, façade lines lean and cladding joint widths run out of control. Installation therefore measures level and verticality every few storeys and corrects with shims, and the top of the podium or transfer level needs tighter accuracy than an ordinary slab. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shims and stack levels” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每個模組高度公差 ±3 mm、堆疊 30 層：最壞情況累積 30×3 = 90 mm，隨機合成約 √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With ±3 mm height tolerance per module over 30 storeys, worst-case accumulation is 30×3 = 90 mm and random combination about √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「墊片與堆疊標高」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shims and stack levels”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制
knowledge.titleEn: Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control
knowledge.text: 每個模組出廠時都有高度、長度與方正度的製造公差，堆疊時這些偏差會逐層累積，墊塊壓縮、接頭間隙與裙樓轉換層的平整度也會加入。若不控制，高樓層模組的樓板會越來越不水平、外牆線條歪斜，帷幕或外牆板接縫寬度失控。
knowledge.textEn: Every module leaves the factory with height, length and squareness tolerances, and in stacking these deviations accumulate floor by floor, joined by packer compression, joint gaps and the flatness of the podium or transfer level. Uncontrolled, upper module floors drift out of level, façade lines lean and cladding joint widths run out of control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control" is correct?
options: 每個模組出廠時都有高度、長度與方正度的製造公差，堆疊時這些偏差會逐層累積，墊塊壓縮、接頭間隙與裙樓轉換層的平整度也會加入。
只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。
模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。
optionsEn: Every module leaves the factory with height, length and squareness tolerances, and in stacking these deviations accumulate floor by floor, joined by packer compression, joint gaps and the flatness of the podium or transfer level.
If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too.
Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.
quiz.explanation: 每個模組出廠時都有高度、長度與方正度的製造公差，堆疊時這些偏差會逐層累積，墊塊壓縮、接頭間隙與裙樓轉換層的平整度也會加入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every module leaves the factory with height, length and squareness tolerances, and in stacking these deviations accumulate floor by floor, joined by packer compression, joint gaps and the flatness of the podium or transfer level. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墊片與堆疊標高」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shims and stack levels” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每個模組高度公差 ±3 mm、堆疊 30 層：最壞情況累積 30×3 = 90 mm，隨機合成約 √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm。若墊塊壓縮比預期少而每層系統偏高 +1 mm，30 層再加 30 mm，隨機與系統合計可能超出外牆接縫 ±20 mm 的調整範圍，所以每 5 層以墊片歸零一次。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With ±3 mm height tolerance per module over 30 storeys, worst-case accumulation is 30×3 = 90 mm and random combination about √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm. If packers compress less than expected so each storey sits 1 mm high, 30 storeys add 30 mm systematically, and random plus systematic error may exceed a ±20 mm façade joint adjustment range, so levels are reset with shims every five storeys. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每安裝一層，以全測站量測模組角點的標高與平面位置，計算與設計的偏差並繪成趨勢；每 5 層做一次整體垂直度與標高檢核，結果連動下一批模組的墊片厚度計畫，並在開始堆疊前先驗收裙樓頂面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each level, measure corner levels and plan positions with a total station, compute deviations from design and plot the trend; every five storeys check overall verticality and level, link the results to the shim plan for the next batch, and accept the podium top surface before stacking starts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每個模組高度公差 ±3 mm、堆疊 30 層：最壞情況累積 30×3 = 90 mm，隨機合成約 √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm。若墊塊壓縮比預期少而每層系統偏高 +1 mm，30 層再加 30 mm，隨機與系統合計可能超出外牆接縫 ±20 mm 的調整範圍，所以每 5 層以墊片歸零一次。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With ±3 mm height tolerance per module over 30 storeys, worst-case accumulation is 30×3 = 90 mm and random combination about √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm. If packers compress less than expected so each storey sits 1 mm high, 30 storeys add 30 mm systematically, and random plus systematic error may exceed a ±20 mm façade joint adjustment range, so levels are reset with shims every five storeys. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control", which statement holds?
options: 模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。
每個模組高度公差 ±3 mm、堆疊 30 層：最壞情況累積 30×3 = 90 mm，隨機合成約 √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm。
模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。
optionsEn: Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation.
With ±3 mm height tolerance per module over 30 storeys, worst-case accumulation is 30×3 = 90 mm and random combination about √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm.
Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis.
quiz.explanation: 每個模組高度公差 ±3 mm、堆疊 30 層：最壞情況累積 30×3 = 90 mm，隨機合成約 √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With ±3 mm height tolerance per module over 30 storeys, worst-case accumulation is 30×3 = 90 mm and random combination about √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墊片與堆疊標高」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shims and stack levels” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每安裝一層，以全測站量測模組角點的標高與平面位置，計算與設計的偏差並繪成趨勢；每 5 層做一次整體垂直度與標高檢核，結果連動下一批模組的墊片厚度計畫，並在開始堆疊前先驗收裙樓頂面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each level, measure corner levels and plan positions with a total station, compute deviations from design and plot the trend; every five storeys check overall verticality and level, link the results to the shim plan for the next batch, and accept the podium top surface before stacking starts. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：安裝程序書應規定量測頻率、墊片材料與最大厚度、歸零樓層與允許偏差；裙樓頂面驗收列為開始堆疊前的保留點，由測量主管與結構設計者共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The installation method statement must set measurement frequency, shim material and maximum thickness, reset levels and permitted deviations, with podium acceptance as a hold point before stacking begins, signed jointly by the survey lead and the structural designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：裙樓轉換層頂面不平而未先修正，第一層模組就帶著傾斜，後續每層依前一層對位使傾斜延續到頂部，帷幕外牆接縫上寬下窄，只能在高樓層以異形板件收邊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An uneven podium transfer slab left uncorrected tilts the first module level, each later level aligns to the one below so the tilt continues to the roof, and façade joints widen toward the top, ending in special-shaped closure panels at high level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每安裝一層，以全測站量測模組角點的標高與平面位置，計算與設計的偏差並繪成趨勢；每 5 層做一次整體垂直度與標高檢核，結果連動下一批模組的墊片厚度計畫，並在開始堆疊前先驗收裙樓頂面。
knowledge.textEn: After each level, measure corner levels and plan positions with a total station, compute deviations from design and plot the trend; every five storeys check overall verticality and level, link the results to the shim plan for the next batch, and accept the podium top surface before stacking starts.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 安裝程序書應規定量測頻率、墊片材料與最大厚度、歸零樓層與允許偏差；裙樓頂面驗收列為開始堆疊前的保留點，由測量主管與結構設計者共同簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The installation method statement must set measurement frequency, shim material and maximum thickness, reset levels and permitted deviations, with podium acceptance as a hold point before stacking begins, signed jointly by the survey lead and the structural designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。
每安裝一層，以全測站量測模組角點的標高與平面位置，計算與設計的偏差並繪成趨勢。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site.
After each level, measure corner levels and plan positions with a total station, compute deviations from design and plot the trend.
quiz.explanation: 每安裝一層，以全測站量測模組角點的標高與平面位置，計算與設計的偏差並繪成趨勢；每 5 層做一次整體垂直度與標高檢核，結果連動下一批模組的墊片厚度計畫，並在開始堆疊前先驗收裙樓頂面。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each level, measure corner levels and plan positions with a total station, compute deviations from design and plot the trend; every five storeys check overall verticality and level, link the results to the shim plan for the next batch, and accept the podium top surface before stacking starts. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墊片與堆疊標高」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shims and stack levels” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 裙樓轉換層頂面不平而未先修正，第一層模組就帶著傾斜，後續每層依前一層對位使傾斜延續到頂部，帷幕外牆接縫上寬下窄，只能在高樓層以異形板件收邊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An uneven podium transfer slab left uncorrected tilts the first module level, each later level aligns to the one below so the tilt continues to the roof, and façade joints widen toward the top, ending in special-shaped closure panels at high level. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此安裝時每隔幾層就要量測標高與垂直度並以墊片修正，裙樓或轉換層頂面的精度要求也必須比一般樓板嚴格。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Installation therefore measures level and verticality every few storeys and corrects with shims, and the top of the podium or transfer level needs tighter accuracy than an ordinary slab.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 裙樓轉換層頂面不平而未先修正，第一層模組就帶著傾斜，後續每層依前一層對位使傾斜延續到頂部，帷幕外牆接縫上寬下窄，只能在高樓層以異形板件收邊。
knowledge.textEn: An uneven podium transfer slab left uncorrected tilts the first module level, each later level aligns to the one below so the tilt continues to the roof, and façade joints widen toward the top, ending in special-shaped closure panels at high level.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 裙樓轉換層頂面不平而未先修正，第一層模組就帶著傾斜，後續每層依前一層對位使傾斜延續到頂部，帷幕外牆接縫上寬下窄，只能在高樓層以異形板件收邊。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。
optionsEn: An uneven podium transfer slab left uncorrected tilts the first module level, each later level aligns to the one below so the tilt continues to the roof, and façade joints widen toward the top, ending in special-shaped closure panels at high level.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.
quiz.explanation: 裙樓轉換層頂面不平而未先修正，第一層模組就帶著傾斜，後續每層依前一層對位使傾斜延續到頂部，帷幕外牆接縫上寬下窄，只能在高樓層以異形板件收邊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An uneven podium transfer slab left uncorrected tilts the first module level, each later level aligns to the one below so the tilt continues to the roof, and façade joints widen toward the top, ending in special-shaped closure panels at high level. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」與「現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance" and "Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「出廠檢查表」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Factory release checklist” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模組化的品質大部分在工廠決定：結構焊接、尺寸方正、防水層、防火封堵與機電管線都在出廠前完成，到工地後很難再打開檢查。因此工廠要建立與工地同等嚴格的檢驗制度，包含原物料證明、焊接檢查、尺寸量測、給排水試壓與電氣測試，並由第三方或主管機關在廠內查驗。ICC/MBI 1205 規範廠內與現場檢查及法規符合程序，新加坡則對 PPVC 製造廠實施認證制度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「出廠檢查表」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Most of a module's quality is decided in the factory: structural welds, dimensional squareness, waterproofing, fire stopping and services are all complete before shipping and hard to open up again on site. The factory therefore needs an inspection regime as strict as on site, covering material certificates, weld inspection, dimensional measurement, plumbing pressure tests and electrical tests, with in-plant inspection by third parties or the authority. ICC/MBI 1205 sets in-plant and on-site inspection and regulatory-compliance procedures, and Singapore runs an accreditation scheme for PPVC manufacturers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Factory release checklist” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The theoretical diagonal of a 3.6 m × 12.0 m module is √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「出廠檢查表」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Factory release checklist”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收
knowledge.text: 模組化的品質大部分在工廠決定：結構焊接、尺寸方正、防水層、防火封堵與機電管線都在出廠前完成，到工地後很難再打開檢查。因此工廠要建立與工地同等嚴格的檢驗制度，包含原物料證明、焊接檢查、尺寸量測、給排水試壓與電氣測試，並由第三方或主管機關在廠內查驗。
knowledge.textEn: Most of a module's quality is decided in the factory: structural welds, dimensional squareness, waterproofing, fire stopping and services are all complete before shipping and hard to open up again on site. The factory therefore needs an inspection regime as strict as on site, covering material certificates, weld inspection, dimensional measurement, plumbing pressure tests and electrical tests, with in-plant inspection by third parties or the authority.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance" is correct?
options: 模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。
模組化的品質大部分在工廠決定：結構焊接、尺寸方正、防水層、防火封堵與機電管線都在出廠前完成，到工地後很難再打開檢查。
扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。
optionsEn: Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.

Most of a module's quality is decided in the factory: structural welds, dimensional squareness, waterproofing, fire stopping and services are all complete before shipping and hard to open up again on site.
Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload.
quiz.explanation: 模組化的品質大部分在工廠決定：結構焊接、尺寸方正、防水層、防火封堵與機電管線都在出廠前完成，到工地後很難再打開檢查。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Most of a module's quality is decided in the factory: structural welds, dimensional squareness, waterproofing, fire stopping and services are all complete before shipping and hard to open up again on site. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出廠檢查表」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Factory release checklist” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：3.6 m × 12.0 m 模組的理論對角線 √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m。實測兩對角線 12.531 m 與 12.522 m，差 9 mm，大於教學假設的允許差 6 mm，表示框架歪斜，須在出廠前調整，否則角部接頭到現場將無法對位。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The theoretical diagonal of a 3.6 m × 12.0 m module is √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m. Measured diagonals of 12.531 m and 12.522 m differ by 9 mm, more than an assumed allowable 6 mm, showing a racked frame that must be corrected before shipping or the corner joints will not align on site. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個模組出廠前完成檢查表：對角線與高度量測、焊接目視與抽樣非破壞檢測、試水與試壓、電氣絕緣測試、防火封堵照片，由廠內品管與第三方簽名；檢查表與模組編號綁定，隨模組送到工地供驗收比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before shipping, complete a checklist for each module: diagonal and height measurements, visual and sampled non-destructive weld testing, water and pressure tests, electrical insulation tests and photographs of fire stopping, signed by factory QA and a third party; the checklist is tied to the module number and travels with it for comparison at site acceptance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 3.6 m × 12.0 m 模組的理論對角線 √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m。實測兩對角線 12.531 m 與 12.522 m，差 9 mm，大於教學假設的允許差 6 mm，表示框架歪斜，須在出廠前調整，否則角部接頭到現場將無法對位。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The theoretical diagonal of a 3.6 m × 12.0 m module is √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m. Measured diagonals of 12.531 m and 12.522 m differ by 9 mm, more than an assumed allowable 6 mm, showing a racked frame that must be corrected before shipping or the corner joints will not align on site. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。
模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。
optionsEn: Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records.
As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact.
The theoretical diagonal of a 3.6 m × 12.0 m module is √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m.
quiz.explanationEn: The theoretical diagonal of a 3.6 m × 12.0 m module is √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出廠檢查表」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Factory release checklist” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個模組出廠前完成檢查表：對角線與高度量測、焊接目視與抽樣非破壞檢測、試水與試壓、電氣絕緣測試、防火封堵照片，由廠內品管與第三方簽名；檢查表與模組編號綁定，隨模組送到工地供驗收比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before shipping, complete a checklist for each module: diagonal and height measurements, visual and sampled non-destructive weld testing, water and pressure tests, electrical insulation tests and photographs of fire stopping, signed by factory QA and a third party; the checklist is tied to the module number and travels with it for comparison at site acceptance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約要求工廠品質計畫、檢查表樣式與第三方查驗頻率，並設出廠放行保留點：未完成檢查表與簽認的模組不得裝車；工地收貨時再以抽樣量測確認運輸未造成損傷。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The contract should require a factory quality plan, checklist format and third-party inspection frequency, with a release hold point so no module without a completed, signed checklist is loaded; at site receipt, sample measurements confirm that transport caused no damage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：工廠為了趕交期而跳過試水與試壓，模組堆疊後才發現衛浴管線接頭滲漏，只能拆除已完成的裝修甚至吊出模組；尺寸歪斜的模組被勉強安裝，接頭只能在現場切割修改。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A factory that skips water and pressure tests to meet deadlines finds bathroom pipe joints leaking only after the modules are stacked, forcing removal of finished linings or even lifting modules back out; racked modules forced into place can only be connected by cutting joints on site. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個模組出廠前完成檢查表：對角線與高度量測、焊接目視與抽樣非破壞檢測、試水與試壓、電氣絕緣測試、防火封堵照片，由廠內品管與第三方簽名；檢查表與模組編號綁定，隨模組送到工地供驗收比對。
knowledge.textEn: Before shipping, complete a checklist for each module: diagonal and height measurements, visual and sampled non-destructive weld testing, water and pressure tests, electrical insulation tests and photographs of fire stopping, signed by factory QA and a third party; the checklist is tied to the module number and travels with it for comparison at site acceptance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約要求工廠品質計畫、檢查表樣式與第三方查驗頻率，並設出廠放行保留點：未完成檢查表與簽認的模組不得裝車；工地收貨時再以抽樣量測確認運輸未造成損傷。
knowledge.textEn: The contract should require a factory quality plan, checklist format and third-party inspection frequency, with a release hold point so no module without a completed, signed checklist is loaded; at site receipt, sample measurements confirm that transport caused no damage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance"?
options: 每個模組出廠前完成檢查表：對角線與高度量測、焊接目視與抽樣非破壞檢測、試水與試壓、電氣絕緣測試、防火封堵照片，由廠內品管與第三方簽名。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。
optionsEn: Before shipping, complete a checklist for each module: diagonal and height measurements, visual and sampled non-destructive weld testing, water and pressure tests, electrical insulation tests and photographs of fire stopping, signed by factory QA and a third party.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm.
quiz.explanation: 每個模組出廠前完成檢查表：對角線與高度量測、焊接目視與抽樣非破壞檢測、試水與試壓、電氣絕緣測試、防火封堵照片，由廠內品管與第三方簽名；檢查表與模組編號綁定，隨模組送到工地供驗收比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before shipping, complete a checklist for each module: diagonal and height measurements, visual and sampled non-destructive weld testing, water and pressure tests, electrical insulation tests and photographs of fire stopping, signed by factory QA and a third party; the checklist is tied to the module number and travels with it for comparison at site acceptance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出廠檢查表」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Factory release checklist” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 工廠為了趕交期而跳過試水與試壓，模組堆疊後才發現衛浴管線接頭滲漏，只能拆除已完成的裝修甚至吊出模組；尺寸歪斜的模組被勉強安裝，接頭只能在現場切割修改。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A factory that skips water and pressure tests to meet deadlines finds bathroom pipe joints leaking only after the modules are stacked, forcing removal of finished linings or even lifting modules back out; racked modules forced into place can only be connected by cutting joints on site. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：ICC/MBI 1205 規範廠內與現場檢查及法規符合程序，新加坡則對 PPVC 製造廠實施認證制度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: ICC/MBI 1205 sets in-plant and on-site inspection and regulatory-compliance procedures, and Singapore runs an accreditation scheme for PPVC manufacturers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 工廠為了趕交期而跳過試水與試壓，模組堆疊後才發現衛浴管線接頭滲漏，只能拆除已完成的裝修甚至吊出模組；尺寸歪斜的模組被勉強安裝，接頭只能在現場切割修改。
knowledge.textEn: A factory that skips water and pressure tests to meet deadlines finds bathroom pipe joints leaking only after the modules are stacked, forcing removal of finished linings or even lifting modules back out; racked modules forced into place can only be connected by cutting joints on site.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
工廠為了趕交期而跳過試水與試壓，模組堆疊後才發現衛浴管線接頭滲漏，只能拆除已完成的裝修甚至吊出模組；尺寸歪斜的模組被勉強安裝，接頭只能在現場切割修改。
扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

A factory that skips water and pressure tests to meet deadlines finds bathroom pipe joints leaking only after the modules are stacked, forcing removal of finished linings or even lifting modules back out.
Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload.
quiz.explanation: 工廠為了趕交期而跳過試水與試壓，模組堆疊後才發現衛浴管線接頭滲漏，只能拆除已完成的裝修甚至吊出模組；尺寸歪斜的模組被勉強安裝，接頭只能在現場切割修改。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A factory that skips water and pressure tests to meet deadlines finds bathroom pipe joints leaking only after the modules are stacked, forcing removal of finished linings or even lifting modules back out; racked modules forced into place can only be connected by cutting joints on site. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolt preload and sealing checks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模組落位後還有一連串現場工作決定成敗：螺栓鎖固與檢查、灌漿或現場焊接、模組間防水接縫、屋頂與外牆的臨時防護，以及模組之間的防火封堵與隔音。這些位置多半在吊裝後很快被下一個模組遮住，所以必須跟著吊裝節奏逐層檢查。螺栓預拉力透過扭矩係數與鎖固扭矩相關，而扭矩係數會隨表面狀況改變，重要接頭宜以校正過的工具配合轉角法等方式確認。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After a module is set, a chain of site work decides success: bolt tightening and checks, grouting or site welding, waterproof joints between modules, temporary protection of roof and façade, and fire stopping and acoustic sealing between modules. Most of these locations are soon hidden by the next module, so they must be inspected level by level at the pace of lifting. Bolt preload depends on tightening torque through a torque coefficient that varies with surface condition, so critical joints should be confirmed with calibrated tools and methods such as turn-of-nut. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bolt preload and sealing checks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Preload F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN for an M20 grade 8.8 bolt.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bolt preload and sealing checks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查
knowledge.titleEn: Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks
knowledge.text: 模組落位後還有一連串現場工作決定成敗：螺栓鎖固與檢查、灌漿或現場焊接、模組間防水接縫、屋頂與外牆的臨時防護，以及模組之間的防火封堵與隔音。這些位置多半在吊裝後很快被下一個模組遮住，所以必須跟著吊裝節奏逐層檢查。
knowledge.textEn: After a module is set, a chain of site work decides success: bolt tightening and checks, grouting or site welding, waterproof joints between modules, temporary protection of roof and façade, and fire stopping and acoustic sealing between modules. Most of these locations are soon hidden by the next module, so they must be inspected level by level at the pace of lifting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks" is correct?

optionsEn: Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload.
