After a module is set, a chain of site work decides success: bolt tightening and checks, grouting or site welding, waterproof joints between modules, temporary protection of roof and façade, and fire stopping and acoustic sealing between modules.
quiz.explanation: 模組落位後還有一連串現場工作決定成敗：螺栓鎖固與檢查、灌漿或現場焊接、模組間防水接縫、屋頂與外牆的臨時防護，以及模組之間的防火封堵與隔音。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After a module is set, a chain of site work decides success: bolt tightening and checks, grouting or site welding, waterproof joints between modules, temporary protection of roof and façade, and fire stopping and acoustic sealing between modules. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolt preload and sealing checks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預拉力 F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN（8.8 級 M20）。以 T = K·F·d 估算扭矩，K = 0.20、d = 0.020 m：T = 0.20×137,200×0.020 ≈ 549 N·m；若潤滑使 K 降為 0.14，同樣扭矩會產生約 137.2×0.20/0.14 ≈ 196 kN，可能超出螺栓降伏。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Preload F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN for an M20 grade 8.8 bolt. Estimating torque by T = K·F·d with K = 0.20 and d = 0.020 m gives T = 0.20×137,200×0.020 ≈ 549 N·m; if lubrication lowers K to 0.14, the same torque produces about 137.2×0.20/0.14 ≈ 196 kN, possibly beyond bolt yield. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每層吊裝後由檢查員確認螺栓數量、鎖固標記與抽樣扭矩，灌漿接頭檢查灌漿紀錄；在下一個模組覆蓋前拍照記錄防火封堵與防水接縫，並對外牆接縫做試水，紀錄與模組編號連結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each level is lifted, an inspector confirms bolt count, tightening marks and sampled torque, and checks grout records for grouted joints; before the next module covers them, fire stopping and waterproof joints are photographed, façade joints are water-tested, and records are linked to module numbers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Preload F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN for an M20 grade 8.8 bolt. Estimating torque by T = K·F·d with K = 0.20 and d = 0.020 m gives T = 0.20×137,200×0.020 ≈ 549 N·m; if lubrication lowers K to 0.14, the same torque produces about 137.2×0.20/0.14 ≈ 196 kN, possibly beyond bolt yield. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks", which statement holds?
options: 模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。
模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。
optionsEn: Preload F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN for an M20 grade 8.8 bolt.
Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis.
Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site.
quiz.explanationEn: Preload F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN for an M20 grade 8.8 bolt. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bolt preload and sealing checks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每層吊裝後由檢查員確認螺栓數量、鎖固標記與抽樣扭矩，灌漿接頭檢查灌漿紀錄；在下一個模組覆蓋前拍照記錄防火封堵與防水接縫，並對外牆接縫做試水，紀錄與模組編號連結。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each level is lifted, an inspector confirms bolt count, tightening marks and sampled torque, and checks grout records for grouted joints; before the next module covers them, fire stopping and waterproof joints are photographed, façade joints are water-tested, and records are linked to module numbers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把接頭檢查、防火封堵與防水接縫列為每一層的保留點，未經檢查員簽認不得吊放覆蓋該處的模組；扭矩工具定期校正，並先在工地以預拉力試驗確認扭矩係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make joint checks, fire stopping and waterproof joints a hold point at every level, with no covering module lifted until the inspector signs off; calibrate torque tools regularly and confirm the torque coefficient on site with preload tests first.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為趕吊裝進度讓下一個模組先覆蓋，未檢查的接頭從此無法進入；防火封堵遺漏使模組間空腔連通多個樓層，日後火災時煙與火沿空腔蔓延。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rushing the lifting sequence so the next module covers joints before inspection leaves them permanently inaccessible; missing fire stopping links inter-module cavities through several floors so that in a later fire smoke and flame travel along the cavities. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每層吊裝後由檢查員確認螺栓數量、鎖固標記與抽樣扭矩，灌漿接頭檢查灌漿紀錄；在下一個模組覆蓋前拍照記錄防火封堵與防水接縫，並對外牆接縫做試水，紀錄與模組編號連結。
knowledge.textEn: After each level is lifted, an inspector confirms bolt count, tightening marks and sampled torque, and checks grout records for grouted joints; before the next module covers them, fire stopping and waterproof joints are photographed, façade joints are water-tested, and records are linked to module numbers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把接頭檢查、防火封堵與防水接縫列為每一層的保留點，未經檢查員簽認不得吊放覆蓋該處的模組；扭矩工具定期校正，並先在工地以預拉力試驗確認扭矩係數。
knowledge.textEn: Make joint checks, fire stopping and waterproof joints a hold point at every level, with no covering module lifted until the inspector signs off; calibrate torque tools regularly and confirm the torque coefficient on site with preload tests first.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
每層吊裝後由檢查員確認螺栓數量、鎖固標記與抽樣扭矩，灌漿接頭檢查灌漿紀錄；在下一個模組覆蓋前拍照記錄防火封堵與防水接縫，並對外牆接縫做試水，紀錄與模組編號連結。
只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
After each level is lifted, an inspector confirms bolt count, tightening marks and sampled torque, and checks grout records for grouted joints.
If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed.
quiz.explanation: 每層吊裝後由檢查員確認螺栓數量、鎖固標記與抽樣扭矩，灌漿接頭檢查灌漿紀錄；在下一個模組覆蓋前拍照記錄防火封堵與防水接縫，並對外牆接縫做試水，紀錄與模組編號連結。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After each level is lifted, an inspector confirms bolt count, tightening marks and sampled torque, and checks grout records for grouted joints; before the next module covers them, fire stopping and waterproof joints are photographed, façade joints are water-tested, and records are linked to module numbers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bolt preload and sealing checks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為趕吊裝進度讓下一個模組先覆蓋，未檢查的接頭從此無法進入；防火封堵遺漏使模組間空腔連通多個樓層，日後火災時煙與火沿空腔蔓延。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rushing the lifting sequence so the next module covers joints before inspection leaves them permanently inaccessible; missing fire stopping links inter-module cavities through several floors so that in a later fire smoke and flame travel along the cavities. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：螺栓預拉力透過扭矩係數與鎖固扭矩相關，而扭矩係數會隨表面狀況改變，重要接頭宜以校正過的工具配合轉角法等方式確認。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bolt preload depends on tightening torque through a torque coefficient that varies with surface condition, so critical joints should be confirmed with calibrated tools and methods such as turn-of-nut.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為趕吊裝進度讓下一個模組先覆蓋，未檢查的接頭從此無法進入；防火封堵遺漏使模組間空腔連通多個樓層，日後火災時煙與火沿空腔蔓延。
knowledge.textEn: Rushing the lifting sequence so the next module covers joints before inspection leaves them permanently inaccessible; missing fire stopping links inter-module cavities through several floors so that in a later fire smoke and flame travel along the cavities.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。
為趕吊裝進度讓下一個模組先覆蓋，未檢查的接頭從此無法進入；防火封堵遺漏使模組間空腔連通多個樓層，日後火災時煙與火沿空腔蔓延。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation.
Rushing the lifting sequence so the next module covers joints before inspection leaves them permanently inaccessible.
quiz.explanation: 為趕吊裝進度讓下一個模組先覆蓋，未檢查的接頭從此無法進入；防火封堵遺漏使模組間空腔連通多個樓層，日後火災時煙與火沿空腔蔓延。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rushing the lifting sequence so the next module covers joints before inspection leaves them permanently inaccessible; missing fire stopping links inter-module cavities through several floors so that in a later fire smoke and flame travel along the cavities. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久」與「模組履歷、維修更換與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities" and "Module records, repair and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「模組間空腔」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inter-module cavities” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模組建築的雙層牆與雙層樓板之間形成許多隱藏空腔，它們讓模組能獨立製造，卻也帶來耐久與防火風險：施工期間未覆蓋的模組頂部遇雨，水會流入空腔與隔熱材中久久不乾；空腔若沒有分隔，火煙可沿著它跨越樓層；鋼接頭藏在空腔內，長期潮濕會鏽蝕卻難以檢查。因此設計要提供空腔分隔、排水與通風路徑，並規劃日後的檢查開口。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「模組間空腔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The double walls and floors of modular buildings create many concealed cavities that allow modules to be made independently but bring durability and fire risks: rain on uncovered module tops during construction runs into cavities and insulation and stays wet for a long time, unsubdivided cavities let fire and smoke cross floors, and steel joints hidden inside can corrode in long-term damp while being hard to inspect. The design must therefore provide cavity barriers, drainage and ventilation paths and plan inspection openings for later. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Inter-module cavities” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一個 3.6 m × 12 m 模組頂面 43.2 m²，若未覆蓋時遇到 50 mm 降雨，落在頂面的雨水約 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³，即約 2,160 L；只要其中一成滲入空腔，就有約 216 L 的水進入隔熱材與石膏板。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The 43.2 m² top of a 3.6 m × 12 m module left uncovered in a 50 mm rainfall receives about 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³, roughly 2,160 L; if only a tenth enters the cavities, about 216 L of water reaches the insulation and plasterboard.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「模組間空腔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Inter-module cavities”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The design must therefore provide cavity barriers, drainage and ventilation paths and plan inspection openings for later.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模組間空腔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inter-module cavities” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一個 3.6 m × 12 m 模組頂面 43.2 m²，若未覆蓋時遇到 50 mm 降雨，落在頂面的雨水約 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³，即約 2,160 L；只要其中一成滲入空腔，就有約 216 L 的水進入隔熱材與石膏板。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The 43.2 m² top of a 3.6 m × 12 m module left uncovered in a 50 mm rainfall receives about 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³, roughly 2,160 L; if only a tenth enters the cavities, about 216 L of water reaches the insulation and plasterboard. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝期間每天收工前檢查模組頂部的臨時防水覆蓋，雨後以含水率計抽查空腔內木料、石膏板與隔熱材；完工前確認空腔分隔完整，並以內視鏡或預留開口抽查鋼接頭的防蝕狀況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During installation inspect temporary waterproof covers on module tops before the end of each shift, spot-check moisture content of timber, plasterboard and insulation in cavities with a moisture meter after rain, and before completion confirm cavity barriers are complete and check corrosion protection of steel joints through borescopes or planned openings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一個 3.6 m × 12 m 模組頂面 43.2 m²，若未覆蓋時遇到 50 mm 降雨，落在頂面的雨水約 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³，即約 2,160 L；只要其中一成滲入空腔，就有約 216 L 的水進入隔熱材與石膏板。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The 43.2 m² top of a 3.6 m × 12 m module left uncovered in a 50 mm rainfall receives about 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³, roughly 2,160 L; if only a tenth enters the cavities, about 216 L of water reaches the insulation and plasterboard. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities", which statement holds?
options: 模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。
一個 3.6 m × 12 m 模組頂面 43.2 m²，若未覆蓋時遇到 50 mm 降雨，落在頂面的雨水約 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³，即約 2,160 L。
模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。
optionsEn: As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact.
The 43.2 m² top of a 3.6 m × 12 m module left uncovered in a 50 mm rainfall receives about 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³, roughly 2,160 L.
Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm.
quiz.explanation: 一個 3.6 m × 12 m 模組頂面 43.2 m²，若未覆蓋時遇到 50 mm 降雨，落在頂面的雨水約 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³，即約 2,160 L；只要其中一成滲入空腔，就有約 216 L 的水進入隔熱材與石膏板。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The 43.2 m² top of a 3.6 m × 12 m module left uncovered in a 50 mm rainfall receives about 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³, roughly 2,160 L; if only a tenth enters the cavities, about 216 L of water reaches the insulation and plasterboard. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模組間空腔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inter-module cavities” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝期間每天收工前檢查模組頂部的臨時防水覆蓋，雨後以含水率計抽查空腔內木料、石膏板與隔熱材；完工前確認空腔分隔完整，並以內視鏡或預留開口抽查鋼接頭的防蝕狀況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During installation inspect temporary waterproof covers on module tops before the end of each shift, spot-check moisture content of timber, plasterboard and insulation in cavities with a moisture meter after rain, and before completion confirm cavity barriers are complete and check corrosion protection of steel joints through borescopes or planned openings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫要規定每一層吊裝完成後的臨時防水程序與責任人，雨後含水率超過門檻的模組須乾燥並經檢查員確認才能封閉；空腔分隔位置要在圖面與現場標示，並列入消防查驗項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan must set the temporary waterproofing procedure and responsible person after each level is lifted; modules whose moisture content exceeds the threshold after rain must be dried and cleared by the inspector before closing, and cavity-barrier locations must be marked on drawings and on site and included in fire inspections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工中臨時防水覆蓋不足，雨水滲入多層模組的空腔，完工後出現發霉、地板變形與異味，只能拆開大量內裝乾燥與更換；空腔分隔遺漏時，火災中的煙可在住戶察覺前擴散到其他樓層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inadequate temporary weather protection lets rain into cavities across several module levels, and after completion mould, buckled floors and odours appear, requiring extensive linings to be opened, dried and replaced; missing cavity barriers let smoke from a fire spread to other floors before occupants notice. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝期間每天收工前檢查模組頂部的臨時防水覆蓋，雨後以含水率計抽查空腔內木料、石膏板與隔熱材；完工前確認空腔分隔完整，並以內視鏡或預留開口抽查鋼接頭的防蝕狀況。
knowledge.textEn: During installation inspect temporary waterproof covers on module tops before the end of each shift, spot-check moisture content of timber, plasterboard and insulation in cavities with a moisture meter after rain, and before completion confirm cavity barriers are complete and check corrosion protection of steel joints through borescopes or planned openings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫要規定每一層吊裝完成後的臨時防水程序與責任人，雨後含水率超過門檻的模組須乾燥並經檢查員確認才能封閉；空腔分隔位置要在圖面與現場標示，並列入消防查驗項目。
knowledge.textEn: The construction plan must set the temporary waterproofing procedure and responsible person after each level is lifted; modules whose moisture content exceeds the threshold after rain must be dried and cleared by the inspector before closing, and cavity-barrier locations must be marked on drawings and on site and included in fire inspections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。
安裝期間每天收工前檢查模組頂部的臨時防水覆蓋，雨後以含水率計抽查空腔內木料、石膏板與隔熱材；完工前確認空腔分隔完整，並以內視鏡或預留開口抽查鋼接頭的防蝕狀況。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too.

During installation inspect temporary waterproof covers on module tops before the end of each shift, spot-check moisture content of timber, plasterboard and insulation in cavities with a moisture meter after rain, and before completion confirm cavity barriers are complete and check corrosion protection of steel joints through borescopes or planned openings.
quiz.explanation: 安裝期間每天收工前檢查模組頂部的臨時防水覆蓋，雨後以含水率計抽查空腔內木料、石膏板與隔熱材；完工前確認空腔分隔完整，並以內視鏡或預留開口抽查鋼接頭的防蝕狀況。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During installation inspect temporary waterproof covers on module tops before the end of each shift, spot-check moisture content of timber, plasterboard and insulation in cavities with a moisture meter after rain, and before completion confirm cavity barriers are complete and check corrosion protection of steel joints through borescopes or planned openings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模組間空腔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inter-module cavities” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工中臨時防水覆蓋不足，雨水滲入多層模組的空腔，完工後出現發霉、地板變形與異味，只能拆開大量內裝乾燥與更換；空腔分隔遺漏時，火災中的煙可在住戶察覺前擴散到其他樓層。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inadequate temporary weather protection lets rain into cavities across several module levels, and after completion mould, buckled floors and odours appear, requiring extensive linings to be opened, dried and replaced; missing cavity barriers let smoke from a fire spread to other floors before occupants notice. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此設計要提供空腔分隔、排水與通風路徑，並規劃日後的檢查開口。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The design must therefore provide cavity barriers, drainage and ventilation paths and plan inspection openings for later.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工中臨時防水覆蓋不足，雨水滲入多層模組的空腔，完工後出現發霉、地板變形與異味，只能拆開大量內裝乾燥與更換；空腔分隔遺漏時，火災中的煙可在住戶察覺前擴散到其他樓層。
knowledge.textEn: Inadequate temporary weather protection lets rain into cavities across several module levels, and after completion mould, buckled floors and odours appear, requiring extensive linings to be opened, dried and replaced; missing cavity barriers let smoke from a fire spread to other floors before occupants notice.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 施工中臨時防水覆蓋不足，雨水滲入多層模組的空腔，完工後出現發霉、地板變形與異味，只能拆開大量內裝乾燥與更換。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。
optionsEn: Inadequate temporary weather protection lets rain into cavities across several module levels, and after completion mould, buckled floors and odours appear, requiring extensive linings to be opened, dried and replaced.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records.
quiz.explanation: 施工中臨時防水覆蓋不足，雨水滲入多層模組的空腔，完工後出現發霉、地板變形與異味，只能拆開大量內裝乾燥與更換；空腔分隔遺漏時，火災中的煙可在住戶察覺前擴散到其他樓層。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inadequate temporary weather protection lets rain into cavities across several module levels, and after completion mould, buckled floors and odours appear, requiring extensive linings to be opened, dried and replaced; missing cavity barriers let smoke from a fire spread to other floors before occupants notice. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 模組履歷、維修更換與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Module records, repair and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「模組履歷」如何影響建築模組化吊裝與接合的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Module records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 模組建築的每個箱體都是可追溯的產品：材料批號、焊接與試驗紀錄、安裝位置、墊片厚度與接頭檢查都應與模組編號連結。日後改裝時，住戶或設計者必須知道哪些牆是承重框架、哪些是可拆隔間、接頭位在哪裡；若需要修理或更換某個模組，也要知道它的連接方式與吊出路徑。把這些紀錄連到資產資訊模型交給業主，才能讓工廠品質延續到營運期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「模組履歷」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each box in a modular building is a traceable product: material batches, welding and test records, installed location, shim thickness and joint inspections should all be linked to the module number. In later alterations occupants and designers must know which walls are structural frame, which are removable partitions and where the joints are; if a module must be repaired or replaced, its connections and lift-out route must also be known. Linking these records to the asset information model at handover is what carries the factory's quality into operation. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Module records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 1,866 個模組、每個模組約 30 個品質檢查點估算，共 1,866×30 = 55,980 筆紀錄；若不符合率 0.5%，約有 280 筆需追蹤處置與結案。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 1,866 modules and about 30 quality checkpoints per module there are 1,866×30 = 55,980 records; at a 0.5% nonconformance rate about 280 items need tracking and close-out.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「模組履歷」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Module records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模組履歷、維修更換與交接
knowledge.text: 模組建築的每個箱體都是可追溯的產品：材料批號、焊接與試驗紀錄、安裝位置、墊片厚度與接頭檢查都應與模組編號連結。日後改裝時，住戶或設計者必須知道哪些牆是承重框架、哪些是可拆隔間、接頭位在哪裡；若需要修理或更換某個模組，也要知道它的連接方式與吊出路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Each box in a modular building is a traceable product: material batches, welding and test records, installed location, shim thickness and joint inspections should all be linked to the module number. In later alterations occupants and designers must know which walls are structural frame, which are removable partitions and where the joints are; if a module must be repaired or replaced, its connections and lift-out route must also be known.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模組履歷、維修更換與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Module records, repair and handover" is correct?
options: 模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。
模組建築的每個箱體都是可追溯的產品：材料批號、焊接與試驗紀錄、安裝位置、墊片厚度與接頭檢查都應與模組編號連結。
模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。
optionsEn: Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records.
Each box in a modular building is a traceable product: material batches, welding and test records, installed location, shim thickness and joint inspections should all be linked to the module number.
Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis.
quiz.explanation: 模組建築的每個箱體都是可追溯的產品：材料批號、焊接與試驗紀錄、安裝位置、墊片厚度與接頭檢查都應與模組編號連結。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each box in a modular building is a traceable product: material batches, welding and test records, installed location, shim thickness and joint inspections should all be linked to the module number. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模組履歷、維修更換與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Module records, repair and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模組履歷」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Module records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 1,866 個模組、每個模組約 30 個品質檢查點估算，共 1,866×30 = 55,980 筆紀錄；若不符合率 0.5%，約有 280 筆需追蹤處置與結案。模組數取自公開案例，檢查點數與不符合率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 1,866 modules and about 30 quality checkpoints per module there are 1,866×30 = 55,980 records; at a 0.5% nonconformance rate about 280 items need tracking and close-out. The module count comes from a public case; checkpoints and nonconformance rate are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前抽查模組編號、位置與紀錄是否一致，確認所有不符合事項已結案；交接文件應包含模組配置圖、承重構件標示、接頭詳圖與檢查紀錄、維護與改裝限制，並由業主的設施管理單位確認可查詢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, spot-check that module numbers, positions and records agree and that every nonconformance is closed; the handover set should include the module layout, identification of structural elements, joint details and inspection records, and maintenance and alteration limits, confirmed as searchable by the owner's facilities team.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 1,866 個模組、每個模組約 30 個品質檢查點估算，共 1,866×30 = 55,980 筆紀錄；若不符合率 0.5%，約有 280 筆需追蹤處置與結案。模組數取自公開案例，檢查點數與不符合率為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 1,866 modules and about 30 quality checkpoints per module there are 1,866×30 = 55,980 records; at a 0.5% nonconformance rate about 280 items need tracking and close-out. The module count comes from a public case; checkpoints and nonconformance rate are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模組履歷、維修更換與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Module records, repair and handover", which statement holds?
options: 模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。
只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。
以 1,866 個模組、每個模組約 30 個品質檢查點估算，共 1,866×30 = 55,980 筆紀錄。
optionsEn: Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site.
If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed.
With 1,866 modules and about 30 quality checkpoints per module there are 1,866×30 = 55,980 records.
quiz.explanation: 以 1,866 個模組、每個模組約 30 個品質檢查點估算，共 1,866×30 = 55,980 筆紀錄；若不符合率 0.5%，約有 280 筆需追蹤處置與結案。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 1,866 modules and about 30 quality checkpoints per module there are 1,866×30 = 55,980 records; at a 0.5% nonconformance rate about 280 items need tracking and close-out. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模組履歷、維修更換與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Module records, repair and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模組履歷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Module records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前抽查模組編號、位置與紀錄是否一致，確認所有不符合事項已結案；交接文件應包含模組配置圖、承重構件標示、接頭詳圖與檢查紀錄、維護與改裝限制，並由業主的設施管理單位確認可查詢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, spot-check that module numbers, positions and records agree and that every nonconformance is closed; the handover set should include the module layout, identification of structural elements, joint details and inspection records, and maintenance and alteration limits, confirmed as searchable by the owner's facilities team. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主管理規約與使用手冊應寫明模組承重構件不得任意切割，任何改裝須經結構技師評估；模組履歷由業主長期保存，並在產權移轉時一併移交。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owners' rules and user manual must state that structural module members may not be cut freely and that any alteration requires assessment by a structural engineer; module records are kept long-term by the owner and passed on with any change of ownership.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：交接資料只有一般竣工圖，沒有標示模組框架與接頭位置，多年後住戶裝修時切開模組角柱旁的牆，削弱承重框架；需要更換受損模組時，也找不到原始接頭設計與吊裝資料。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Handover with only general as-built drawings, without module frames and joint locations, lets a later tenant fit-out cut a wall beside a corner post and weaken the structural frame; when a damaged module needs replacing, nobody can find the original joint design or lifting data. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前抽查模組編號、位置與紀錄是否一致，確認所有不符合事項已結案；交接文件應包含模組配置圖、承重構件標示、接頭詳圖與檢查紀錄、維護與改裝限制，並由業主的設施管理單位確認可查詢。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, spot-check that module numbers, positions and records agree and that every nonconformance is closed; the handover set should include the module layout, identification of structural elements, joint details and inspection records, and maintenance and alteration limits, confirmed as searchable by the owner's facilities team.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 業主管理規約與使用手冊應寫明模組承重構件不得任意切割，任何改裝須經結構技師評估；模組履歷由業主長期保存，並在產權移轉時一併移交。
knowledge.textEn: The owners' rules and user manual must state that structural module members may not be cut freely and that any alteration requires assessment by a structural engineer; module records are kept long-term by the owner and passed on with any change of ownership.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模組履歷、維修更換與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Module records, repair and handover"?
options: 交接前抽查模組編號、位置與紀錄是否一致，確認所有不符合事項已結案。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。
optionsEn: Before handover, spot-check that module numbers, positions and records agree and that every nonconformance is closed.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.
quiz.explanation: 交接前抽查模組編號、位置與紀錄是否一致，確認所有不符合事項已結案；交接文件應包含模組配置圖、承重構件標示、接頭詳圖與檢查紀錄、維護與改裝限制，並由業主的設施管理單位確認可查詢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, spot-check that module numbers, positions and records agree and that every nonconformance is closed; the handover set should include the module layout, identification of structural elements, joint details and inspection records, and maintenance and alteration limits, confirmed as searchable by the owner's facilities team. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模組履歷、維修更換與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Module records, repair and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模組履歷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Module records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 交接資料只有一般竣工圖，沒有標示模組框架與接頭位置，多年後住戶裝修時切開模組角柱旁的牆，削弱承重框架；需要更換受損模組時，也找不到原始接頭設計與吊裝資料。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Handover with only general as-built drawings, without module frames and joint locations, lets a later tenant fit-out cut a wall beside a corner post and weaken the structural frame; when a damaged module needs replacing, nobody can find the original joint design or lifting data. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把這些紀錄連到資產資訊模型交給業主，才能讓工廠品質延續到營運期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Linking these records to the asset information model at handover is what carries the factory's quality into operation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交接資料只有一般竣工圖，沒有標示模組框架與接頭位置，多年後住戶裝修時切開模組角柱旁的牆，削弱承重框架；需要更換受損模組時，也找不到原始接頭設計與吊裝資料。
knowledge.textEn: Handover with only general as-built drawings, without module frames and joint locations, lets a later tenant fit-out cut a wall beside a corner post and weaken the structural frame; when a damaged module needs replacing, nobody can find the original joint design or lifting data.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模組履歷、維修更換與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Module records, repair and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
交接資料只有一般竣工圖，沒有標示模組框架與接頭位置，多年後住戶裝修時切開模組角柱旁的牆，削弱承重框架；需要更換受損模組時，也找不到原始接頭設計與吊裝資料。
模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Handover with only general as-built drawings, without module frames and joint locations, lets a later tenant fit-out cut a wall beside a corner post and weaken the structural frame.
Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis.
quiz.explanation: 交接資料只有一般竣工圖，沒有標示模組框架與接頭位置，多年後住戶裝修時切開模組角柱旁的牆，削弱承重框架；需要更換受損模組時，也找不到原始接頭設計與吊裝資料。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Handover with only general as-built drawings, without module frames and joint locations, lets a later tenant fit-out cut a wall beside a corner post and weaken the structural frame; when a damaged module needs replacing, nobody can find the original joint design or lifting data. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 明石海峽大橋
history.text: 本州四國連絡橋公團於 1970 年成立，明石海峽大橋 1986 年動土、1988 年 5 月現場開工，1998 年 4 月 5 日通車，以 1,991 m 主跨保持世界紀錄直到 2022 年。工程首度在長大橋使用 180 kgf/mm² 級高強度鋼絲、設置沉箱與抗水洗水中混凝土，並以直升機牽引導索避免干擾繁忙航道；1995 年兵庫縣南部地震在主纜擠壓期間發生，設計團隊以修正桁段長度吸收跨徑變化。營運後的主纜乾燥空氣、吊索纏絲與減振裝置維護研究，成為長大橋預防保全的公開參考。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Authority was set up in 1970; Akashi Kaikyo broke ground in 1986, began site work in May 1988 and opened on 5 April 1998, its 1,991 m main span holding the world record until 2022. It was the first long-span bridge to use 180 kgf/mm² class high-strength wire, used laid-down caissons with antiwashout underwater concrete, and flew its pilot rope by helicopter to keep a busy shipping lane open; the 1995 Hyogo-ken Nanbu earthquake struck during cable squeezing, and the designers absorbed the span change by revising truss member lengths. In service, its dry-air cable system, hanger wire winding and damper maintenance studies became public references for preventive maintenance of long-span bridges. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 1915 恰納卡萊大橋
history.text: 土耳其公路總局把達達尼爾海峽跨越列為馬爾馬拉高速公路環線的關鍵段，2017 年 3 月 18 日動土，由 DL E&C、Limak、SK ecoplant 與 Yapı Merkezi 組成的聯合體承建，COWI 負責細部設計，Arup 與 Aas-Jakobsen 等擔任獨立驗證。工程以 1,960 MPa 級鋼絲、318 m 鋼塔與乾塢預製沉箱完成，2022 年 3 月 18 日通車，以 2,023 m 超越明石海峽大橋成為世界最長跨徑懸索橋，也是第一座主跨超過 2 km 的懸索橋。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Türkiye's General Directorate of Highways made the Dardanelles crossing the key link of the Marmara motorway ring; ground was broken on 18 March 2017, with a consortium of DL E&C, Limak, SK ecoplant and Yapı Merkezi as contractor, COWI as detailed designer, and Arup and Aas-Jakobsen among the independent checkers. Built with 1,960 MPa class wire, 318 m steel towers and caissons cast in dry dock, it opened on 18 March 2022, overtaking Akashi Kaikyo with a 2,023 m span to become the world's longest suspension span and the first beyond 2 km. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大貝爾特東橋
history.text: 大貝爾特固定連結由公路橋、鐵路橋與海底隧道組成，1988 年至 1998 年興建；東橋懸索橋段由 COWI 與 Ramboll 等設計、Dissing+Weitling 擔任建築設計。1991 年芬蘭以 65 m 淨空會阻礙鑽探平台通行為由向國際法院起訴，1992 年和解撤案。1998 年 6 月 14 日公路通車時，1,624 m 主跨僅次於同年稍早通車的明石海峽大橋；其後加裝導流板處理渦振，並於 2015 年完成主纜除濕改造。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Great Belt fixed link, made up of a road bridge, a railway bridge and an undersea tunnel, was built from 1988 to 1998; the East Bridge suspension section was designed by COWI and Ramboll among others, with Dissing+Weitling as architects. In 1991 Finland took Denmark to the International Court of Justice, arguing that the 65 m clearance would block drilling rigs, and the case was settled and withdrawn in 1992. When the motorway opened on 14 June 1998, its 1,624 m span was second only to Akashi Kaikyo, opened earlier the same year; guide vanes were later fitted against vortex shedding and cable dehumidification was completed in 2015. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 青馬大橋
history.text: 青馬大橋是連接香港赤鱲角新機場與市區的大嶼山幹線核心，由 Mott MacDonald 設計，Costain、三井與 Trafalgar House 組成的英日聯營承建，1992 年 5 月動工，1997 年 4 月 27 日主持揭幕、5 月 22 日通車。它以 1,377 m 主跨在完工時為世界第二長的懸索橋，至今仍是承載鐵路的最長跨徑橋梁；雙層桁架讓公路、機場鐵路與颱風時的遮蔽車道共用一個斷面。香港路政署以 WASHMS 長期監測此橋與相鄰的汲水門、汀九兩橋。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Tsing Ma Bridge is the core of the Lantau Link connecting Hong Kong's new airport at Chek Lap Kok with the urban area; designed by Mott MacDonald and built by the Anglo Japanese Construction joint venture of Costain, Mitsui and Trafalgar House, it began in May 1992, was inaugurated on 27 April 1997 and opened on 22 May 1997. Its 1,377 m main span was the world's second longest suspension span on completion, and it is still the longest-span bridge carrying rail; the double-deck truss lets road, the airport railway and typhoon-sheltered lanes share one section. The Highways Department monitors it, together with the neighbouring Kap Shui Mun and Ting Kau bridges, through WASHMS. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 舊金山金門大橋
history.text: 金門大橋 1937 年通車，主跨 4,200 ft（1,280 m），由金門大橋公路及運輸管理區（1928 年成立）營運。此後它經歷了一連串可量化的改造：1953 至 1954 年增設下層橫向斜撐並再張拉索夾螺栓，1972 至 1976 年更換全部 250 對吊索，1980 年代以正交異性鋼橋面取代混凝土橋面並減重約 12,300 噸；1989 年洛馬普列塔地震後展開分期耐震改造，2008 年完成第 2 期，第 3B 期主橋工程於 2025 年 10 月發包。2020 年代的抗風改造與 2024 年完成的防墜網則再次改變了斷面。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Golden Gate Bridge opened in 1937 with a 4,200 ft (1,280 m) main span and is operated by the Golden Gate Bridge, Highway and Transportation District, formed in 1928. It has since gone through a series of quantifiable modifications: lower lateral bracing and re-tensioned cable-band bolts in 1953–1954, replacement of all 250 suspender pairs in 1972–1976, and an orthotropic steel deck replacing the concrete deck in the 1980s, saving about 12,300 tons; phased seismic retrofit began after the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake, Phase 2 finished in 2008 and the Phase 3B main-bridge contract was awarded in October 2025. The wind retrofit of the 2020s and the deterrent net completed in 2024 changed the section again. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 瀨戶大橋橋群
history.text: 本州四國連絡橋公團規劃三條連絡路線，瀨戶大橋是其中唯一兼有鐵路的兒島—坂出路線，1978 年 10 月 10 日舉行動土典禮，北、南備讚瀨戶大橋於 1979 年 1 月現場開工，下津井瀨戶大橋於 1981 年、櫃石島橋於 1982 年開工，六座橋於 1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車。工程以 11 座設置沉箱、預壘骨材水中混凝土、起重船牽引導索與共用錨碇等技術完成，經驗直接延續到明石海峽大橋。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Authority planned three routes, and Seto Ohashi on the Kojima–Sakaide route is the only one that also carries rail; the ground-breaking ceremony was held on 10 October 1978, site work on Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto began in January 1979, Shimotsui-Seto in 1981 and Hitsuishijima in 1982, and all six bridges opened together on 10 April 1988. The project was completed with eleven placed caissons, prepacked underwater concrete, crane-ship pilot ropes and a shared anchorage, experience that carried directly into the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 懸索橋主纜架設
history.text: 以平行鋼絲在現場紡成主纜的方法由 Roebling 父子在 19 世紀發展，1883 年通車的布魯克林大橋首度以鍍鋅鋼絲紡線；1937 年金門大橋以空中紡線在 6 個月又 9 天內完成每纜 27,572 根鋼絲。20 世紀後半，工廠預製平行鋼絲索股讓現場作業大幅縮短，本州四國連絡橋的多數懸索橋都採用此法，瀨戶大橋並以起重船牽引導索；1998 年明石海峽大橋首度使用 1,770 MPa 級鋼絲，同年大貝爾特東橋仍以空中紡線完成。2012 年美國聯邦公路總署整理了主纜檢查與強度評估的入門手冊。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Spinning parallel wires into a cable on site was developed by the Roeblings in the 19th century, and the Brooklyn Bridge, opened in 1883, was the first to spin galvanised steel wire; in 1937 the Golden Gate Bridge spun 27,572 wires per cable in six months and nine days. In the second half of the 20th century factory-prefabricated parallel-wire strands greatly shortened site work, and most Honshu-Shikoku suspension bridges used them, Seto Ohashi carrying its pilot rope across by crane ship; in 1998 Akashi Kaikyo first used 1,770 MPa class wire, while the Great Belt East Bridge of the same year was still air-spun. In 2012 the US Federal Highway Administration published a primer on cable inspection and strength evaluation. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 懸索橋主纜除濕系統
history.text: 本州四國連絡橋公團檢查較早完成的懸索橋時，拆開鍍鋅纏絲後發現鋼絲已有鏽蝕，因而開發了把乾燥空氣送入主纜內部的系統，業主稱其為世界首創，管理目標為相對濕度 40%，並安裝在所有本四懸索橋，之後再針對夏季高濕加裝預冷設備。歐洲的懸索橋在發現主纜腐蝕後陸續採用彈性體包覆與除濕，大貝爾特東橋於 2014 至 2015 年完成改造；美國聯邦公路總署 2012 年的入門手冊也指出這類系統在亞洲廣泛使用、歐洲已有應用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: When the Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Authority inspected its earlier suspension bridges and found rust on wires beneath the galvanised wrapping, it developed a system to inject dry air into the main cables, which the owner calls a world first, managed to 40% relative humidity and installed on all its suspension bridges, later adding pre-coolers for humid summers. European suspension bridges adopted elastomeric wrapping and dehumidification after cable corrosion was found, the Great Belt East Bridge completing its retrofit in 2014–2015, and the US Federal Highway Administration's 2012 primer noted that such systems are widely used in Asia and have been used in Europe. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 淡江大橋工程
history.text: 淡江大橋計畫於 2014 年由行政院核定，2015 年國際競圖由札哈・哈蒂建築師事務所與中興工程顧問、德國 Leonhardt, Andrä und Partner 團隊勝出，以單柱混凝土塔減少視覺與河床干擾，並避開淡水夕照景觀。主橋工程歷經 2017 至 2018 年多次流標，2019 年 2 月由工信工程開工；2025 年 3 月淡水側鋼梁合龍、9 月 16 日八里側合龍，2026 年 5 月 12 日通車，成為主跨最長的單塔不對稱斜張橋，並預留淡海輕軌空間。本課只依公開資料重建工程原理，不代表任何設計或施工文件。
history.textEn: The Danjiang Bridge plan was approved by the Executive Yuan in 2014, and in 2015 an international competition was won by Zaha Hadid Architects with Sinotech Engineering Consultants and Germany’s Leonhardt, Andrä und Partner, whose single concrete mast limits visual and riverbed impact and keeps the Tamsui sunset view open. After repeated failed tenders in 2017 and 2018, main-bridge construction by Kung Sing Engineering began in February 2019; the Tamsui-side girder closed in March 2025 and the Bali-side closure followed on 16 September 2025, and the bridge opened on 12 May 2026 as the longest-span single-pylon asymmetric cable-stayed bridge, with space reserved for the Danhai light rail. This course reconstructs engineering principles from public information only and represents no design or construction document.

history.title: 昂船洲大橋
history.text: 香港政府為 8 號幹線跨越藍巴勒海峽，於 2000 年舉辦國際設計比賽，之後由 Arup 主導、COWI 為分包顧問的團隊承擔細部設計，2002 年展開細部設計。主體工程由前田建設、日立造船、橫河橋梁與新昌營造組成的聯營承造，2004 年 4 月開工，約 68 個月後於 2009 年 12 月通車，當時是全球僅有的兩座主跨超過 1,000 m 的斜張橋之一。其分離式雙箱梁、不鏽鋼複合單柱塔與塔梁液壓緩衝器，是颱風區超大跨斜張橋的代表性解法。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: To carry Route 8 over the Rambler Channel, the Hong Kong Government held an international design competition in 2000; an Arup-led team with COWI as subconsultant then took on the detailed design, which began in 2002. A joint venture of Maeda, Hitachi Zosen, Yokogawa Bridge and Hsin Chong built the bridge from April 2004, and it opened in December 2009 after about 68 months, one of only two cable-stayed bridges in the world with a span over 1,000 m at the time. Its split twin-box deck, composite stainless monopole towers and tower–deck hydraulic buffers are a reference solution for very long cable-stayed spans in typhoon regions. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.

history.title: 蘇通長江公路大橋
history.text: 蘇通大橋連接江蘇蘇州與南通，初步設計由中交公路規劃設計院、江蘇省交通規劃設計院與同濟大學聯合體承擔，2003 年 6 月開工，主橋由中國交通建設集團第二航務工程局總承包，英國 Dorman Long Technology 負責重型提升，AECOM 為承包商提供架設分析、線形控制與風工程服務。主梁於 2007 年 6 月合龍，2008 年 5 月試通車、6 月 30 日正式通車，以 1,088 m 主跨刷新斜張橋紀錄，並以 300.4 m 的塔與約 577 m 的斜索創下當時紀錄；2010 年獲美國土木工程師學會傑出土木工程成就獎。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: Sutong Bridge links Suzhou and Nantong in Jiangsu. Preliminary design was by a consortium of the CCCC Highway Planning and Design Institute, Jiangsu Provincial Communications Planning and Design Institute and Tongji University; construction began in June 2003 with CCCC Second Navigational Engineering Bureau as general contractor, Dorman Long Technology of the UK handling heavy lifts and AECOM providing erection analysis, geometry control and wind engineering to the contractor. The deck closed in June 2007, trial traffic began in May 2008 and the bridge officially opened on 30 June 2008, setting a cable-stayed span record of 1,088 m with record 300.4 m towers and stays of about 577 m; in 2010 it received ASCE’s Outstanding Civil Engineering Achievement award. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 里翁—安提里翁大橋
history.text: 連接伯羅奔尼撒半島與希臘大陸的里翁—安提里翁大橋由 Vinci 主導的法希聯營以特許經營方式設計、興建與營運，1998 年展開海床整備與浚挖，2000 年起建塔，2004 年 5 月完工、8 月通車。面對 65 m 水深、超過 500 m 厚的軟弱沉積層、強震與海峽持續擴張，設計團隊採用加勁土壤上可滑移的大直徑基礎與連續全懸吊橋面，成為當時連續懸吊長度最長的多跨斜張橋。2005 年 1 月一根斜索遭雷擊起火斷落，修復時加裝了防雷系統。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: The Rion–Antirion Bridge, linking the Peloponnese with mainland Greece, was designed, built and operated under a concession by a French–Greek consortium led by Vinci; seabed preparation and dredging began in 1998, pylon construction started in 2000, and the bridge was completed in May 2004 and opened in August. Facing 65 m of water, soft sediments over 500 m thick, strong earthquakes and a widening strait, the team chose large sliding footings on reinforced soil and a continuous fully suspended deck, creating the longest continuous suspended multi-span cable-stayed deck of its time. In January 2005 a stay failed after a lightning strike started a fire, and lightning protection was added during the repair. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.

history.title: 諾曼第大橋
history.text: 為連接勒阿弗爾與翁弗勒爾、跨越塞納河口，勒阿弗爾工商會推動興建諾曼第大橋，由 Michel Virlogeux 主導設計，Bouygues 的 Bernard Raspaud 負責總體研究，1988 年起施工、1994 年完成主體，1995 年 1 月 20 日通車。當時 856 m 的主跨比前一紀錄長逾 250 m，靠的是混合主梁、倒 Y 形塔與流線形箱梁，CSTB 則提供現地風量測與氣動研究；1999 年跨徑紀錄被日本多多羅大橋打破。通車後長索振動促成阻尼器加裝，成為斜索防振的重要案例。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: To cross the Seine estuary between Le Havre and Honfleur, the Le Havre Chamber of Commerce and Industry promoted the Pont de Normandie, designed under Michel Virlogeux with general studies led by Bernard Raspaud of Bouygues; construction began in 1988, the main works were finished in 1994 and the bridge opened on 20 January 1995. Its 856 m span beat the previous record by more than 250 m thanks to the hybrid deck, inverted-Y pylons and a streamlined box, with CSTB providing site wind measurements and aerodynamic studies; Japan’s Tatara Bridge took the span record in 1999. Long-stay vibration after opening led to retrofitted dampers, making the bridge a key case in stay vibration control. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 皇后渡口大橋
history.text: 為減輕 1964 年啟用的福斯公路大橋的交通與耐久壓力，蘇格蘭政府推動福斯替代跨越計畫：2008 年 1 月委任 Jacobs 與 Arup 聯合體擔任設計顧問，完成標準設計與合約文件；2011 年 4 月以約 7.9 億英鎊把主合約授予由 Dragados、Hochtief、American Bridge 與 Morrison 組成的 FCBC，細部設計由 Ramboll 主導的聯合體負責。大橋於 2017 年 8 月 30 日通車，9 月 4 日由英國女王正式啟用，成為全球最長的三塔斜張橋與規模最大的跨中交叉索斜張橋，2018 年 2 月升格為高速公路。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: To relieve traffic and durability pressure on the Forth Road Bridge of 1964, the Scottish Government launched the Forth Replacement Crossing: in January 2008 the Jacobs Arup joint venture was appointed to prepare the specimen design and contract documents, and in April 2011 the principal contract of about £790 million went to FCBC, comprising Dragados, Hochtief, American Bridge and Morrison, with detailed design by a Ramboll-led joint venture. The bridge opened to traffic on 30 August 2017 and was formally opened by the Queen on 4 September, becoming the world’s longest three-tower cable-stayed bridge and the largest with stays crossing at mid-span; it became a motorway in February 2018. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 伊拉斯謨大橋
history.text: 伊拉斯謨大橋為連接鹿特丹市中心與南岸新開發的 Kop van Zuid 而建，主要目標是成為城市地標。建築師 Ben van Berkel 在 1990 年提出受阿拉米略橋啟發的構想，經工程可行性修改為 139 m 鋼塔加背索，市議會於 1991 年 11 月確定塔形；大部分經費來自荷蘭經濟結構強化基金。工程於 1993 年 9 月 1 日開工，1996 年 9 月由女王碧雅翠絲正式啟用，工期約 3 年又 3 天、實際成本略低於預算。通車後的雨風振動與後來加裝的調諧液壓阻尼器，使它成為斜索防振的重要案例。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: The Erasmus Bridge was built to link central Rotterdam with the newly developed Kop van Zuid on the south bank, primarily as a city landmark. Architect Ben van Berkel proposed an Alamillo-inspired concept in 1990, which engineering feasibility reworked into a 139 m steel pylon with back stays, and the city council fixed the pylon form in November 1991; most funding came from the Dutch economic structure fund. Construction began on 1 September 1993 and Queen Beatrix opened the bridge in September 1996, about 3 years and 3 days later, with realised cost slightly below budget. Rain–wind vibration after opening and the tuned hydraulic dampers fitted later made it a key case in stay vibration control. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 斜張橋斜索張力調整
history.text: 現代斜張橋始於 1955 年瑞典的 Strömsund 橋，早期以封閉式鋼索搭配墊片調整索力，張拉需要整根大型千斤頂。1980 至 1990 年代平行鋼絞線斜索普及，諾曼第大橋在 1995 年以 184 根、每根 31 至 53 股的鋼絞線斜索創下跨徑紀錄，逐股安裝與等張張拉讓長索不必整根吊裝；影響矩陣與施工階段分析則讓多索協同調整成為常規。法國 CIP 斜索建議（2002）、fib Bulletin 30（2005）與 PTI DC45.1 逐步把試驗、安裝與允收寫成規範，fib Bulletin 89（2019）再更新驗收要求。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不提供任何張拉作業授權。
history.textEn: Modern cable-stayed bridges began with Sweden’s Strömsund Bridge in 1955, when locked-coil ropes were adjusted with shims and stressing needed large whole-cable jacks. Parallel-strand stays spread in the 1980s and 1990s; the Pont de Normandie set a span record in 1995 with 184 stays of 31 to 53 strands each, and strand-by-strand installation with equal-tension stressing meant long stays no longer had to be lifted whole, while influence matrices and staged analysis made coordinated multi-stay tuning routine. The French CIP stay recommendations (2002), fib Bulletin 30 (2005) and PTI DC45.1 progressively codified testing, installation and acceptance, and fib Bulletin 89 (2019) updated the acceptance requirements. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only and gives no authorisation for stressing operations.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 斜張索雨風振動抑制
history.titleEn: Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables
history.text: 1980 年代，日本名港西大橋的斜索在下雨且有風時出現大幅振動，Hikami 與 Shiraishi 於 1988 年發表研究，指出索面水線與風共同作用的機制，雨風振動從此成為斜張橋的重要課題。1995 年通車的諾曼第大橋與 1996 年通車的伊拉斯謨大橋都在通車後不久出現斜索大幅振動，分別加裝阻尼系統與調諧液壓阻尼器。此後業界發展出螺旋凸肋或凹窩套管、內外置阻尼器與交叉索等對策，fib Bulletin 30（2005）與 PTI 斜索建議把阻尼裝置與試驗要求納入規範，超長索則以數公尺高的阻尼器桅桿處理。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不提供任何高空作業授權。
history.textEn: In the 1980s the stays of Japan’s Meiko-Nishi Bridge vibrated heavily in wind with rain, and Hikami and Shiraishi’s 1988 paper identified the mechanism of rivulets on the cable surface acting with wind, making rain–wind vibration a major topic for cable-stayed bridges. The Pont de Normandie, opened in 1995, and the Erasmus Bridge, opened in 1996, both showed large stay vibration soon after opening and were fitted with damping systems and tuned hydraulic dampers respectively. Industry then developed helically ribbed or dimpled ducts, internal and external dampers and cross-ties, fib Bulletin 30 (2005) and the PTI stay recommendations codified damping devices and testing, and very long stays came to use damper masts several metres tall. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only and gives no authorisation for work at height.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 金門大橋（金門）
history.text: 連接大、小金門的固定橋梁自 1993 年開始規劃，2010 年由行政院核定計畫，由交通部國道新建工程局（後併入高速公路局）主辦、台灣世曦設計，2011 年起陸續施工。工程歷經兩次終止契約與重新發包，2016 年底由東丕營造接續主體工程，2022 年 7 月 22 日全橋合龍、10 月 30 日通車，主橋為國內最長跨徑的五塔六跨脊背橋。其工程意義在於深槽區鋼箱圍堰、花崗岩海床中的大口徑全套管基樁，以及在本島預鑄、跨海運輸後懸臂吊裝的節塊工法。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計或施工文件。
history.textEn: A fixed link between Greater and Lesser Kinmen was planned from 1993 and approved by the Executive Yuan in 2010, with the national expressway engineering bureau of the Ministry of Transportation (later merged into the Freeway Bureau) as owner and CECI Engineering Consultants as designer; works began in stages from 2011. After two contract terminations and re-tenders, a third contractor took over the main works at the end of 2016, the bridge closed on 22 July 2022 and opened on 30 October 2022, with Taiwan's longest-span five-tower extradosed main bridge. Its engineering significance lies in steel box cofferdams in the deep trough, large cased bored piles in granite and segments precast on Taiwan's main island, shipped across the strait and erected by cantilevering. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design or construction documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 米約高架橋
history.text: 法國 A75 高速公路需要跨越米約附近的塔恩河谷，經過十多年的研究與方案比選，最後採用工程師 Michel Virlogeux 與建築師 Norman Foster 的多跨斜張方案，由 Eiffage 以特許經營方式融資、興建與營運。2001 年底開工，2003 年 3 月首段鋼梁頂推出平台，2004 年 5 月 28 日南北鋼梁接合，同年 12 月 14 日落成、16 日通車，2006 年獲國際橋梁及結構工程協會傑出結構獎。其工程新意在於六個連續 342 公尺主跨的多跨斜張體系、上部分叉的高墩，以及以臨時鋼墩與同步頂推器在高空頂推 36,000 公噸鋼梁。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: France's A75 motorway had to cross the Tarn valley near Millau, and after more than a decade of studies and option comparisons, the multi-span cable-stayed scheme of engineer Michel Virlogeux and architect Norman Foster was chosen, financed, built and operated by Eiffage under a concession. Work began in late 2001, the first deck section was launched off its platform in March 2003, the north and south decks met on 28 May 2004, and the bridge was inaugurated on 14 December and opened on 16 December 2004, later receiving the IABSE Outstanding Structure Award in 2006. Its novelty lies in a multi-span cable-stayed system with six continuous 342 m spans, tall piers that split near the top, and launching a 36,000 t steel deck at height over temporary steel towers with synchronised launching units. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.

history.title: 厄勒海峽大橋
history.text: 丹麥與瑞典在 1991 年簽署興建厄勒海峽固定通道的協定，採用人工島、沉管隧道與橋梁的組合，以避免阻擋哥本哈根機場附近的空域與航道，並滿足對波羅的海水流的零阻水要求。橋梁由 Arup 領導的 ASO 設計團隊在設計競圖中勝出，以設計—施工合約由 Sundlink 聯合承攬，大量採用陸上預製與浮吊整跨吊裝；1995 年海上工程展開，1999 年 8 月最後一段橋跨就位，2000 年 7 月 1 日通車，提前且未超出預算。其工程新意在於主跨 490 公尺的公路鐵路雙層斜張橋、以設計修整與補償浚挖達成零阻水，以及接近設備極限的整跨吊裝。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: Denmark and Sweden agreed in 1991 to build a fixed link across the Øresund, combining an artificial island, an immersed tunnel and a bridge so as to keep airspace near Copenhagen Airport and the shipping lanes clear and to meet a zero-blocking requirement for Baltic water exchange. The bridge design by the Arup-led ASO group won the design competition and was built under a design-and-construct contract by the Sundlink consortium, relying heavily on onshore prefabrication and full-span floating-crane lifts; marine works started in 1995, the last bridge span was placed in August 1999 and the link opened on 1 July 2000, ahead of schedule and within budget. Its novelties were a double-deck road–rail cable-stayed bridge with a 490 m span, zero blocking achieved by design trimming plus compensation dredging, and full-span lifts near equipment limits. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 港珠澳大橋橋梁段
history.text: 連接香港、珠海與澳門的跨伶仃洋通道經多年研究後，主體工程於 2009 年 12 月 15 日開工，以橋、島、隧結合的方案同時滿足航運、香港機場空域與 120 年設計壽命的要求。橋梁段大量採用大型化、工廠化與整體吊裝，三座通航孔斜張橋與非通航孔連續梁在 2016 年 9 月全面貫通；2018 年 2 月全線完工，10 月 23 日舉行開通儀式，24 日通車。其工程意義在於以工業化製造與嚴格的颱風季風險管理，在繁忙航道上完成約 22.9 公里的跨海橋梁，並建立三地共同管理的營運模式。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計或施工文件。
history.textEn: After years of study, main works on the crossing of the Lingdingyang between Hong Kong, Zhuhai and Macao began on 15 December 2009, with a bridge–island–tunnel scheme meeting shipping needs, Hong Kong airport airspace limits and a 120-year design life. The bridge works relied heavily on large-scale, factory-made components and single-piece lifts, and the three channel cable-stayed bridges and viaduct spans were all connected in September 2016; the whole project was completed in February 2018, opened ceremonially on 23 October and to traffic on 24 October 2018. Its engineering significance lies in building about 22.9 km of sea-crossing bridge across busy shipping lanes through industrialised fabrication and strict typhoon-season risk management, and in a jointly managed operating model for three jurisdictions. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design or construction documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 聯邦大橋（加拿大）
history.text: 愛德華王子島 1873 年加入加拿大時，聯邦政府承諾提供全年渡輪服務；1988 年島上公投以約 60% 支持興建固定通道。1993 年加拿大政府與 Strait Crossing 簽署設計、興建、融資、營運與維護協議，由多跨預製混凝土橋梁專家 Jean Muller 參與設計，同年 10 月開工；大型構件在陸上預製後由浮吊 Svanen 安裝，主體結構於 1996 年 11 月完成，1997 年 5 月 31 日通車。其工程新意在於以錐形冰盾降低浮冰荷載、以超大型預製構件縮短冰季限制下的海上作業，以及合約明訂 100 年設計壽命。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: When Prince Edward Island joined Canada in 1873, the federal government promised year-round ferry service; in 1988 islanders voted about 60% in favour of a fixed link. In 1993 the Government of Canada signed design, build, finance, operate and maintain agreements with Strait Crossing, with Jean Muller, a specialist in multi-span precast concrete bridges, as designer, and work began that October; large components were precast on land and placed by the floating crane Svanen, the structure was completed in November 1996 and the bridge opened on 31 May 1997. Its novelties were conical ice shields that reduce pack-ice loads, very large precast components that shortened marine work constrained by the ice season, and a contractual 100-year design life. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雪梨港灣大橋
history.text: 跨越雪梨港的構想可追溯到 19 世紀，新南威爾斯公共工程部總工程師 J. J. C. Bradfield 長期推動，1922 年通過大橋法案。1924 年國際招標由英國 Dorman Long 公司以拱橋方案得標，其顧問工程師 Ralph Freeman 負責細部設計與架設；1923 年開始引道工程，1928 年開始架設鋼拱，1930 年 8 月兩半拱合龍，1932 年初以 96 輛機車做載重試驗，3 月 19 日通車。其工程意義在於以 U 形岩盤隧道錨碇鋼索懸臂架設當時世界級跨度的鋼拱、同時承載公路與鐵路，以及延續至今的大規模維護管理。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: A harbour crossing was proposed from the nineteenth century, and J. J. C. Bradfield, chief engineer of the New South Wales Public Works Department, championed it for years until the Sydney Harbour Bridge Act passed in 1922. An international tender in 1924 was won by the British firm Dorman Long with an arch design, its consulting engineer Ralph Freeman leading detailed design and erection; approach works began in 1923, arch erection in 1928, the half-arches met in August 1930, a load test with 96 locomotives followed in early 1932, and the bridge opened on 19 March 1932. Its significance lies in cantilevering a steel arch of world-class span with cables anchored in U-shaped rock tunnels, carrying road and rail together, and a large-scale maintenance regime that continues today. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 新河峽大橋
history.text: 為了讓阿帕拉契山區的公路不必繞行深谷，西維吉尼亞州公路部門委託 Michael Baker 公司設計跨越新河峽谷的大橋，由總工程師 Clarence V. Knudsen 主持；美國鋼鐵公司旗下的 American Bridge 部門承攬施工，1974 年 6 月開工。承包商以跨越峽谷的纜索吊運系統運送鋼構件，以油井套管背拉索懸臂架設兩側半拱，1976 年 5 月以液壓千斤頂下放合龍，1977 年 10 月 22 日通車，造價逾 3,700 萬美元。完工時它是世界最長的單跨鋼拱，並長期保持西半球最長鋼拱跨度的紀錄，2013 年列入國家史蹟名錄。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: To spare Appalachian highway traffic a long detour around the gorge, West Virginia's highway department commissioned Michael Baker to design a crossing of the New River Gorge, led by chief engineer Clarence V. Knudsen; the American Bridge Division of U.S. Steel built it, starting in June 1974. The contractor carried steel by a cableway across the gorge, cantilevered both half-arches on oil-well-casing tiebacks, lowered them together with hydraulic jacks in May 1976 and opened the bridge on 22 October 1977 at a cost of more than US$37 million. On completion it was the world's longest single-span steel arch, and it long remained the longest steel arch span in the Western Hemisphere; it joined the National Register of Historic Places in 2013. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼拱橋拱肋合龍
history.text: 以懸臂方式架設大跨度鋼拱、再於拱頂合龍的做法在二十世紀初逐漸成熟。1930 年雪梨港灣大橋以兩岸岩盤隧道錨碇 128 條鋼索支撐半拱，逐步放鬆錨索讓兩半拱在 8 月 19 日接合；1976 年新河峽大橋以纜索吊運、油井套管背拉索與 16 具 1,250 噸液壓千斤頂下放合龍；2002 年上海盧浦大橋以臨時斜拉索懸臂架設 550 公尺拱跨並於 10 月合龍，之後重慶朝天門大橋把鋼桁拱跨度推到 552 公尺。這些案例的共同課題都是扣索控制、溫度窗口與體系轉換的量測驗證。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計或施工文件。
history.textEn: Cantilevering long-span steel arches and closing them at the crown matured in the early twentieth century. In 1930 Sydney Harbour Bridge held its half-arches back with 128 cables anchored in rock tunnels and gradually released them until the halves met on 19 August; in 1976 New River Gorge Bridge used a cableway, oil-well-casing tiebacks and sixteen 1,250-ton hydraulic jacks to lower its arms to closure; in 2002 Shanghai's Lupu Bridge cantilevered a 550 m arch on temporary cable stays and closed it in October, and Chongqing's Chaotianmen Bridge later pushed the steel truss arch span to 552 m. Common to all are tieback control, temperature windows and measured verification of the system change. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design or construction documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工
history.text: 德國 Dyckerhoff & Widmann 公司的 Ulrich Finsterwalder 結合預力鋼棒與懸臂施工，1951 年完成跨度 62 m 的 Balduinstein 蘭河橋，被視為第一座以懸臂工法建造的預力混凝土橋；1965 年完工的 Bendorf 萊茵河橋主跨 208 m，把場鑄平衡懸臂推向大跨度。法國 Campenon Bernard 公司 1962 年在 Choisy-le-Roi 橋首度大規模商業應用預鑄節塊，Jean Muller 隨後發展匹配澆注與節塊架設設備。1998 年挪威 Stolma 橋以約 301 m 主跨創下紀錄，而 1996 年 Koror–Babeldaob 橋的倒塌則提醒工程界長期撓度與補強評估的重要。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Ulrich Finsterwalder of Dyckerhoff & Widmann combined prestressing bars with cantilever construction; the 62 m Balduinstein bridge over the Lahn, finished in 1951, is regarded as the first prestressed concrete bridge built by the free-cantilever method, and the Bendorf Rhine bridge, completed in 1965 with a 208 m main span, pushed cast-in-place balanced cantilevering to long spans. Campenon Bernard made the first major commercial use of precast segments at Choisy-le-Roi in 1962, and Jean Muller went on to develop match casting and segment-erection equipment. Norway's Stolma Bridge set a record main span of about 301 m in 1998, while the 1996 collapse of the Koror–Babeldaob Bridge reminded the profession of the importance of long-term deflection and retrofit assessment. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
history.text: 法國在 1960 年代發展出匹配澆注預鑄節塊與架橋機，Oléron 高架橋（1964–1966）首度使用架橋機。Jean Muller 與 FIGG 在佛州 Keys 群島把逐跨工法推向成熟：Long Key 橋以約 36 m 的跨度在架設桁架上逐跨組裝，節塊長約 5.5 m，平均每週約 2.5 跨，並採乾接縫與箱內體外鋼腱；1982 年完工的新 Seven Mile 橋以類似設計建造，完工時是世界最長的預鑄節塊橋。2000 年通車的曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路長約 55 km，以匹配澆注、乾接縫與體外鋼腱逐跨架設，展示了工廠化預製的規模。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: France developed match-cast precast segments and launching gantries in the 1960s, and the Oléron Viaduct (1964–1966) was the first to use a gantry. Jean Muller and FIGG brought span-by-span erection to maturity in the Florida Keys: the Long Key Bridge was assembled span by span on an erection truss with spans of about 36 m and segments about 5.5 m long, averaging about 2.5 spans a week, with dry joints and external tendons inside the box; the new Seven Mile Bridge, completed in 1982 on a similar design, was then the world's longest precast segmental bridge. Bangkok's Bang Na Expressway, opened in 2000 and about 55 km long, was erected span by span with match-cast dry joints and external tendons, demonstrating factory-scale precasting. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁頂推施工
history.text: 德國 Leonhardt 與 Baur 的團隊在 1960 年代初建造委內瑞拉 Caroní 河橋，梁體在橋台後組成後頂推越過橋墩，並在每跨設臨時墩、以鋼桁架延伸前端，被 VSL 報告稱為首次具備此工法主要特徵的工程；1965 年奧地利 Kufstein 茵河橋首度採用在橋台後逐段澆製、匹配後整體頂推的真正頂推工法。1970 年代起滑板、導梁與液壓頂推設備標準化，VSL 1977 年的技術報告整理了 30 至 60 m 的經濟跨度與每週一段的循環，20 世紀全球頂推的預力混凝土橋超過 2,500 座。2001 至 2004 年 Millau 高架橋的鋼橋面由谷地兩側以分散式液壓裝置頂推，配合最高約 175 m 的臨時支撐，把工法推向高墩大跨。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In the early 1960s Leonhardt and Baur's team built the Caroní River bridge in Venezuela, assembling the deck behind the abutment and launching it over the piers with a temporary pier in each span and a steel truss extension at the front, described in a VSL report as the first use of the method's essential features; in 1965 the Inn bridge at Kufstein, Austria, introduced true incremental launching, casting segments behind the abutment, match-casting each against the last and pushing the whole deck forward. From the 1970s sliding pads, noses and hydraulic launching equipment became standard, a 1977 VSL technical report summarised economic spans of 30 to 60 m and a one-segment-per-week cycle, and more than 2,500 prestressed concrete bridges were launched worldwide in the 20th century. Between 2001 and 2004 Millau's steel deck was launched from both sides of the valley by distributed hydraulic devices with temporary supports up to about 175 m tall, extending the method to tall piers and long spans. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁轉體施工
history.text: 轉體施工的構想很早就用於活動橋，但作為「先在旁邊建、再轉到位」的施工法，是在 1980 年代隨著大型球面支承與同步液壓設備成熟而普及。比利時默茲河上的 Ben-Ahin 斜張橋主跨 168 m，1985 至 1987 年施工時以繞豎軸旋轉的方式就位；1989 年 5 月塞維亞 Barqueta 鋼拱橋則在岸邊組裝後，以浮力支撐一端旋轉到 Alfonso XII 運河上方。此後中國大量以水平轉體跨越營運中的鐵路，單次轉體重量達數萬噸；美國 FHWA 2011 年的加速橋梁施工手冊也把豎軸旋轉列為重型移動工法之一。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The idea of rotation has long been used in movable bridges, but as a construction method of building alongside and then swinging into place it spread in the 1980s as large spherical bearings and synchronised hydraulics matured. The Ben-Ahin cable-stayed bridge over the Meuse in Belgium, with a 168 m main span, was rotated about a vertical axis into position during its 1985–1987 construction; in May 1989 Seville's Barqueta steel arch, assembled on the bank, was swung over the Alfonso XII channel with one end supported by flotation. China has since used horizontal rotation extensively to cross live railways, with single rotations reaching tens of thousands of tonnes, and FHWA's 2011 Accelerated Bridge Construction manual lists the vertical-axis pivot among heavy-movement methods. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
