history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 正交異性鋼橋面板製作
history.text: 德國工程師 Wilhelm Cornelius 於 1948 年提出以正交異性鋼橋面建造懸索橋並建立分析方法，戰後德國重建的大量鋼橋使這種輕量橋面迅速成熟。1975 年溫哥華 Lions Gate 橋北側高架段以正交異性鋼橋面取代混凝土橋面，是北美首例；1982 至 1986 年金門大橋在不封閉道路的情況下，利用 401 個夜間把原混凝土橋面分 747 段換成正交異性鋼橋面，橋面重量減輕約 12,300 噸（美噸）。早期部分橋面的肋—面板焊縫出現疲勞裂縫，促使業界提高面板厚度並控制焊縫熔深，FHWA 於 2012 年出版正交異性鋼橋面設計、施工與維護手冊整合這些經驗；2004 年通車的 Millau 高架橋則擁有面積極大的正交異性鋼橋面。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: German engineer Wilhelm Cornelius proposed a suspension bridge with an orthotropic steel deck in 1948 and developed methods to analyse it, and Germany's post-war rebuilding of many steel bridges quickly matured this light deck. In 1975 the north viaduct of Vancouver's Lions Gate Bridge replaced its concrete deck with an orthotropic steel deck, the first in North America; from 1982 to 1986 the Golden Gate Bridge replaced its concrete deck in 747 sections over 401 nights without closing the roadway, cutting deck weight by about 12,300 US tons. Fatigue cracks at the rib-to-deck welds of some early decks led the industry to thicker deck plates and controlled weld penetration, experience that FHWA consolidated in its 2012 manual on the design, construction and maintenance of orthotropic steel deck bridges, while the Millau Viaduct, opened in 2004, carries a very large orthotropic deck. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 自行式模組運輸車換橋
history.text: 自行式模組運輸車原用於造船、石化與重型設備搬運，歐洲較早普遍以它把整座預製橋梁在數分鐘至數小時內開到橋位。美國 FHWA 的國際考察團隊在 2004 年前後參訪歐洲案例，2007 年出版 SPMT 移除與更換橋梁手冊，收錄荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 兩跨橋（逾 3,600 噸、134 軸線、移動 2 小時）、法國 PRA 13 09 鐵路橋（48 小時封閉）、芝加哥 Wells Street 2002 年週末換橋，以及 2006 年佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue 換橋的詳細案例。2011 年 FHWA 加速橋梁施工手冊把 SPMT 與橫移、豎軸旋轉並列為重型移動工法，使其成為加速橋梁施工的標準選項之一。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Self-propelled modular transporters were first used in shipbuilding, petrochemicals and heavy-equipment haulage, and Europe was early to use them routinely to drive whole prefabricated bridges to site in minutes to hours. An FHWA international scan team visited European cases around 2004, and in 2007 FHWA published its manual on using SPMTs to remove and replace bridges, documenting the Netherlands' two-span Badhoevedorp A4/A5 bridge (more than 3,600 tons, 134 axle lines, a 2-hour move), France's PRA 13 09 railway bridge (a 48-hour closure), Chicago's Wells Street weekend replacement in 2002 and Florida's 2006 I-4/Graves Avenue replacement in detail. FHWA's 2011 Accelerated Bridge Construction manual placed SPMTs alongside lateral slides and vertical-axis pivots as heavy-movement methods, making them a standard ABC option. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 浮吊大型橋段吊裝
history.titleEn: Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments
history.text: 大型浮吊讓跨海橋梁可以把整段構件在岸上預製再一次吊放。荷蘭建造的雙體重吊船 Svanen 原為丹麥大貝爾特橋建造，之後在 1994 至 1996 年為加拿大聯邦大橋吊放墩座、主梁與落入跨等大型預製構件，這座長 12.9 km、主跨 250 m 的橋於 1997 年 5 月 31 日通車，之後 Svanen 又參與厄勒海峽大橋。2009 年建成的剪腿式浮吊 Left Coast Lifter 額定約 1,700 t，在 2010 至 2011 年為舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段吊放 28 段箱梁橋面，2014 年改名 I Lift NY，在 2015 至 2018 年參與紐約新 Tappan Zee 橋（州長 Mario M. Cuomo 橋）的建造，之後並協助拆除舊橋。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Large floating cranes let sea crossings prefabricate whole members on shore and set them in one lift. The Dutch-built catamaran heavy-lift vessel Svanen, originally built for Denmark's Great Belt crossing, placed pier bases, main girders and drop-in spans for Canada's Confederation Bridge between 1994 and 1996; the 12.9 km bridge with 250 m main spans opened on 31 May 1997, and Svanen went on to the Øresund Bridge. The shear-leg crane barge Left Coast Lifter, built in 2009 and rated about 1,700 t, placed 28 box-girder deck sections for the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge east span in 2010–2011, then as I Lift NY helped build New York's new Tappan Zee crossing, the Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge, between 2015 and 2018 and afterwards helped dismantle the old bridge. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換
history.text: 早期橋梁多以鋼板滑動縫或簡單的開口縫處理梁端位移，隨著長跨鋼橋與預力混凝土橋的發展，位移量增加到數百公釐以上，多間隙的模組式伸縮縫與旋轉橫梁伸縮縫在歐洲發展成熟，並以疲勞與水密試驗建立型式認證制度。漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋原於 1974 年完工，2014 至 2016 年翻修時換裝位移達 760 至 1,140 mm 的模組式伸縮縫；紐約新 Tappan Zee 橋在 2015 至 2018 年安裝 23 座模組式伸縮縫，最大的 LR18 位移可達約 1.4 m；2000 年通車的 Øresund 橋則於 2025 年春季完成第一座 DS15 旋轉橫梁伸縮縫的更換，其餘預定在 2026 至 2030 年陸續進行。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Early bridges handled girder-end movement with sliding steel plates or simple open gaps; as long steel spans and prestressed concrete bridges raised movements to hundreds of millimetres and more, multi-gap modular joints and swivel-joist joints matured in Europe, with type approval based on fatigue and watertightness testing. Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge, completed in 1974, received modular joints with movements of 760 to 1,140 mm in its 2014–2016 rehabilitation; New York's new Tappan Zee crossing installed 23 modular joints between 2015 and 2018, the largest LR18 units taking about 1.4 m; and the Øresund Bridge, opened in 2000, completed the replacement of its first DS15 swivel-joist joint in spring 2025, with the rest planned for 2026 to 2030. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 球面支承安裝
history.text: 二十世紀後半葉，橋梁支承逐漸由鋼製搖軸、滾軸改為以滑動材料搭配轉動元件的高荷重多向轉動支承，球面支承以凹凸曲面同時處理任意方向轉角，適合大反力與大轉角的長跨橋。歐洲以 EN 1337-11（1997）規範運輸、儲存與安裝，EN 1337-7（2004）專門規範球面與圓柱面 PTFE 支承；美國則有 AASHTO LRFD 第 14 章與 AASHTO/NSBA G9.1 鋼橋支承指引。2023 年德國萊茵河上的萊夫艾森橋把磨損的盆式支承換成最大約 120 MN 的球面支承，2024 年啟用的勒沃庫森萊茵河大橋首段則在塔墩下以球面支承承受約 100,000 kN 荷重。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或施工文件。
history.textEn: In the second half of the twentieth century, bridge bearings moved from steel rockers and rollers to high-load multi-rotational bearings that combine sliding materials with rotation elements; the spherical bearing handles rotation in any direction on matched concave and convex surfaces and suits long spans with large reactions and rotations. In Europe EN 1337-11 (1997) covers transport, storage and installation and EN 1337-7 (2004) covers spherical and cylindrical PTFE bearings; in the United States AASHTO LRFD Section 14 and the AASHTO/NSBA G9.1 steel bridge bearing guidelines apply. In 2023 the Raiffeisen Bridge over the Rhine in Germany replaced worn pot bearings with spherical bearings of up to about 120 MN, and the first section of the Leverkusen Rhine bridge, opened in 2024, carries about 100,000 kN on spherical bearings under its pylon. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or construction documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鉛心橡膠支承隔震
history.text: 紐西蘭科學與工業研究部（DSIR）的 Bill Robinson 在 1970 年代中期發展出鉛心橡膠支承，把可反覆屈服的鉛心壓入疊層橡膠，同時提供隔震柔性與遲滯阻尼；1981 年他與 Tucker 發表 William Clayton 大樓及 Toe Toe、Waiotukupuna 兩座橋的支承試驗結果。此後該技術在紐西蘭、日本、美國、中國與義大利等地大量使用，美國金門大橋第一期耐震改造（1997 至 2001 年）也在馬林郡引道高架橋採用鉛心橡膠隔震支承。1999 年 921 集集地震重創南投的集鹿大橋，其後的研究以鉛心橡膠支承評估斜張橋隔震改造，台灣的國家地震工程研究中心也以大型試驗設施驗證隔震元件與系統。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Bill Robinson of New Zealand's Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR) developed the lead-rubber bearing in the mid-1970s, pressing a repeatedly yielding lead core into laminated rubber to provide both isolation flexibility and hysteretic damping; in 1981 he and Tucker published test results for bearings of the William Clayton Building and the Toe Toe and Waiotukupuna bridges. The technique then spread widely in New Zealand, Japan, the United States, China and Italy, and Phase 1 of the Golden Gate Bridge seismic retrofit (1997 to 2001) used lead-core rubber isolators on the Marin approach viaduct. The 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake badly damaged the Chi-Lu cable-stayed bridge in Nantou, and later studies assessed lead-rubber isolation as a retrofit for it, while Taiwan's NCREE uses large test facilities to verify isolation devices and systems. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋墩塑鉸韌性設計
history.titleEn: Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers
history.text: 1971 年聖費爾南多地震後，加州開始檢討橋柱圍束不足的問題；1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中奧克蘭雙層的賽普勒斯街高架橋崩塌、造成 42 人死亡，其柱缺乏圍束且上下柱未以鋼筋連接，促使加州運輸局全面推動以容量設計與位移韌性為核心的耐震設計準則。1995 年阪神地震中阪神高速神戶線多處高架段側倒，日本隨後大幅修訂道路橋耐震設計並引入殘留位移檢核；1999 年台灣 921 集集地震約 102 座主要橋梁嚴重受損，也推動了公路橋梁耐震設計規範與既有橋梁補強。Priestley、Seible 與 Calvi 等研究者以大量柱試驗建立塑鉸長度與圍束模型，成為今日韌性設計的基礎。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: After the 1971 San Fernando earthquake California began addressing inadequate column confinement; in the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake Oakland's double-deck Cypress Street Viaduct collapsed, killing 42 people, its columns lacking confinement and its upper columns not tied to the lower ones, prompting Caltrans to adopt seismic criteria built on capacity design and displacement ductility. In the 1995 Kobe earthquake several elevated sections of the Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route toppled, and Japan then substantially revised highway bridge seismic design and introduced residual-displacement checks; in Taiwan's 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake about 102 major bridges were badly damaged, driving revisions to the highway bridge seismic code and retrofit of existing bridges. Researchers such as Priestley, Seible and Calvi built hinge-length and confinement models from extensive column tests, the basis of today's ductile design. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋墩纖維複材耐震補強
history.titleEn: FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers
history.text: 1989 年洛馬普列塔與 1994 年北嶺地震後，加州大規模以鋼板套管補強舊橋柱，同期以航太材料補強橋柱的纖維複材產業興起，Fyfe 公司即於 1988 年為此成立。1990 年代加州大學聖地牙哥分校等實驗室以大尺寸柱試驗驗證複材套管的圍束、剪力與搭接夾持效果，賓州 I-84 跨越橋在 1995 年於柱頂與柱底塑鉸區完成包覆，約 17 年後仍未見脫層；之後舊金山碼頭約 250 支沉箱也以預製套管加灌漿補強。fib 在 2001 年、美國混凝土學會 ACI 440 委員會在 2002 年起陸續發布外貼纖維複材設計指引，2017 年版納入耐震補強專章；台灣在 921 地震後推動既有橋梁耐震補強，纖維包覆成為與鋼板、混凝土套管並列的選項。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案或產品的設計文件。
history.textEn: After the 1989 Loma Prieta and 1994 Northridge earthquakes California retrofitted old bridge columns on a large scale with steel jackets, while an FRP strengthening industry using aerospace materials grew alongside; Fyfe was founded in 1988 for this purpose. In the 1990s laboratories such as the University of California, San Diego validated the confinement, shear and splice-clamping effect of composite jackets with large column tests; an I-84 overpass in Pennsylvania had its top and bottom hinge zones wrapped in 1995 and showed no delamination about 17 years later, and about 250 caissons of a San Francisco pier were later strengthened with prefabricated jackets and grout. fib in 2001 and ACI Committee 440 from 2002 published guidance for externally bonded FRP, the 2017 edition including a seismic strengthening chapter; in Taiwan the retrofit of existing bridges after the Chi-Chi earthquake made FRP wrapping an option alongside steel and concrete jackets. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's or product's design documents.

history.title: 橋梁基礎沖刷監測
history.text: 1987 年 4 月 5 日紐約州高速公路 Schoharie 溪橋因三號墩擴展基礎被淘空而崩塌，造成 10 人死亡，促使美國全面檢討橋梁沖刷的設計、檢查與維護；聯邦公路總署陸續發布 HEC-18 沖刷評估與 HEC-23 保護工指引，NCHRP 第 396 號報告（1997 年）則在多州實地測試聲納、磁性滑環與浮出式等監測儀器。台灣方面，2000 年碧利斯颱風後高屏大橋 P22、P23 橋墩被沖毀，2008 年辛樂克颱風造成大甲溪后豐大橋斷落，使沖刷監測、預警封橋與河川採砂管理成為公路養護的重點。現行 HEC-18 為 2012 年第 5 版，HEC-23 為 2009 年第 3 版。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或監測文件。
history.textEn: On 5 April 1987 the Schoharie Creek Bridge on the New York State Thruway collapsed when the spread footing of pier 3 was undermined, killing 10 people and prompting a nationwide review of scour design, inspection and maintenance in the United States; the Federal Highway Administration went on to publish HEC-18 for scour evaluation and HEC-23 for countermeasures, and NCHRP Report 396 (1997) field-tested sonar, magnetic sliding collar and float-out monitors in several states. In Taiwan, piers P22 and P23 of the Kaoping Bridge were washed out after Typhoon Bilis in 2000, and Typhoon Sinlaku brought down the Houfeng Bridge over the Dajia River in 2008, making scour monitoring, pre-emptive closure and control of river mining priorities for highway maintenance. The current HEC-18 is the 5th edition of 2012 and HEC-23 the 3rd edition of 2009. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or monitoring documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗
history.text: 1940 年 7 月 1 日通車的塔科馬海峽橋，以 8 呎深板梁加勁約 853 m 的主跨，同年 11 月 7 日在約 40 mph 的風中扭轉振動崩塌；華盛頓大學 Farquharson 當時已以 1/20 節段模型與 1/200 全橋模型研究其振動，並建議導流措施，但未及實施。由 Ammann、von Kármán 與 Woodruff 組成的委員會調查後，氣動力在橋梁設計中的地位大幅提升，風洞試驗逐漸成為長跨橋梁的必要程序，1950 年 10 月 14 日新橋通車；1970 年代 Scanlan 等人提出以顫振導數描述橋面自激氣動力。1998 年完工的明石海峽大橋以全橋模型風洞試驗驗證抗風設計，2010 年伏爾加格勒大橋的振動事件則提醒完工後仍需監測與改善。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的試驗或設計文件。
history.textEn: The Tacoma Narrows Bridge, opened on 1 July 1940 with a main span of about 853 m stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders, twisted itself apart in a wind of about 40 mph on 7 November that year; Farquharson at the University of Washington was already studying its motion with a 1:20 section model and a 1:200 full model and had recommended aerodynamic fixes that were never installed. After the board of Ammann, von Kármán and Woodruff investigated, aerodynamics gained a central place in bridge design and wind-tunnel testing became a standard step for long spans; the replacement bridge opened on 14 October 1950, and in the 1970s Scanlan and others introduced flutter derivatives to describe self-excited deck forces. The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge, completed in 1998, verified its wind design with full-model wind-tunnel testing, while the 2010 vibration event on the Volgograd Bridge showed that monitoring and remedies are still needed after completion. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's test or design documents.

history.title: 橋面超高性能混凝土接縫
history.text: 美國聯邦公路總署的 Turner-Fairbank 研究中心在 2000 年代研究 UHPC 用於預鑄橋梁構件的現澆接縫，2009 年紐約州交通部完成首批應用：Lyons 的 SR 31 跨 Canandaigua Outlet 橋（預鑄 T 梁翼板接縫）與 Oneonta 的 SR 23 跨 Otego Creek 橋（預鑄橋面板接縫）。2013 年紐約州在雪城 I-81 以全深度預鑄橋面板與 6 吋 UHPC 接縫更換四座州際公路橋，每個方向以 10 天封路完成；FHWA 於 2014 年發布現澆 UHPC 接縫設計與施工技術說明，2017 至 2018 年的 Every Day Counts 第四輪（EDC-4）則全國推廣預鑄構件的 UHPC 接縫。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件或產品配比。
history.textEn: FHWA's Turner-Fairbank Highway Research Center studied UHPC for field-cast connections between prefabricated bridge elements during the 2000s, and in 2009 the New York State DOT completed the first applications: SR 31 over the Canandaigua Outlet in Lyons (deck-bulb-tee flange connections) and SR 23 over Otego Creek in Oneonta (precast deck-panel connections). In 2013 New York replaced four interstate bridges on I-81 in Syracuse with full-depth precast panels and 6 inch UHPC joints, completing each direction under a 10-day closure; FHWA published its TechNote on designing and building field-cast UHPC connections in 2014, and the fourth round of Every Day Counts (EDC-4) in 2017 to 2018 promoted UHPC connections for prefabricated elements nationwide. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents or product mix designs.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 預力混凝土孔道灌漿
history.text: Eugène Freyssinet 發展的後拉預力技術在二十世紀中葉廣泛用於橋梁，孔道灌漿被視為鋼腱的主要防蝕層。1985 年威爾斯 1953 年建成的 Ynys-y-Gwas 預鑄節塊橋因接縫處鋼腱腐蝕突然崩塌，其後英國多座橋發現鋼腱腐蝕，英國公路局在 1992 年暫停新建內部灌漿後拉橋並展開五年檢查，1996 年解除。美國自 1999 年起陸續發現灌漿空洞、泌水與錨頭腐蝕問題，2000 年夏洛特賽車場人行橋因灌漿添加未核准化學品而斷落；業界轉向預拌觸變性灌漿、PTI M55.1 灌漿規範與專業認證，FHWA 於 2013 年發布鋼腱安裝與灌漿手冊及缺陷灌漿取樣與修復指引。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或施工文件，也不構成現場作業許可。
history.textEn: Post-tensioning, developed by Eugène Freyssinet, spread widely in bridges in the mid-twentieth century, with duct grout regarded as the tendons' main corrosion barrier. In 1985 the Ynys-y-Gwas precast segmental bridge in Wales, built in 1953, collapsed suddenly from tendon corrosion at its joints; tendon corrosion was then found in several British bridges, and the Highways Agency halted new internally grouted post-tensioned bridges in 1992 for a five-year inspection programme, lifting the moratorium in 1996. In the United States, grout voids, bleed water and anchorage corrosion came to light from 1999, and in 2000 the Charlotte Motor Speedway footbridge fell because an unapproved chemical had been added to its grout; industry moved to pre-bagged thixotropic grouts, the PTI M55.1 grouting specification and specialist certification, and in 2013 FHWA published its tendon installation and grouting manual and guidelines for sampling and restoring defective grout. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or construction documents, and is not an authorisation for field work.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁預力鋼腱更換
history.text: 外置鋼腱的預鑄節塊箱梁在 1980 至 1990 年代廣泛用於美國的跨水與高架橋，1993 年通車、長約 5.8 km 的佛州 Mid-Bay 大橋即屬此類。1999 年佛州 Niles Channel 橋出現美國第一起確認由腐蝕造成的鋼腱失效，2000 年 Mid-Bay 大橋接著發現斷裂鋼腱，FDOT 研擬逐股切斷的去張程序並更換 11 條鋼腱；之後 Ringling 堤道橋在 2011 年更換 17 條鋼腱，Wando River 橋在 2016 與 2018 年兩度出現鋼腱失效。這些事件推動了灌漿材料與規範改進、2019 年 FHWA 可更換灌漿外置鋼腱指引，以及 2024 年 FHWA 腐蝕導致鋼腱失效的彙整報告。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Precast segmental box girders with external tendons were widely used for American water crossings and viaducts in the 1980s and 1990s, including Florida's Mid-Bay Bridge, about 5.8 km long and opened in 1993. In 1999 Florida's Niles Channel Bridge had the first confirmed corrosion-caused tendon failure in the United States; in 2000 broken tendons were found at Mid-Bay, where FDOT devised a strand-by-strand detensioning procedure and replaced 11 tendons. Ringling Causeway Bridge later had 17 tendons replaced in 2011, and Wando River Bridge suffered tendon failures in 2016 and 2018. These events drove improved grout materials and specifications, FHWA's 2019 guide to replaceable grouted external tendons and FHWA's 2024 compilation on corrosion-induced tendon failures. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復
history.text: 鋼橋疲勞在 1960 至 1970 年代成為美國公路橋的重要課題：1967 年 Silver Bridge 因無冗餘眼桿脆斷倒塌，促成斷裂關鍵構件的檢查與韌性要求；同一時期以 Lehigh 大學為代表的研究以足尺試驗建立焊接細節的 S–N 曲線與分類，成為 AASHTO 疲勞規定的基礎，Yellow Mill Pond 與 Lafayette Street 等橋的裂縫則提供了現場教訓。2000 年 Hoan 橋在沒有疲勞裂縫下發生脆性斷裂，2005 年完成、2013 年由 FHWA 發布的疲勞裂縫修復手冊整理了止裂孔、錘擊與螺栓拼接等方法；2021 年 I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋繫梁斷裂則凸顯近距離檢查的重要。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Fatigue of steel highway bridges became a major issue in the United States in the 1960s and 1970s: the 1967 collapse of the Silver Bridge through brittle fracture of a non-redundant eyebar led to inspection and toughness requirements for fracture-critical members, while full-scale testing led by researchers such as those at Lehigh University established S–N curves and categories for welded details that underpin the AASHTO fatigue provisions, and cracks at bridges such as Yellow Mill Pond and Lafayette Street supplied field lessons. In 2000 the Hoan Bridge fractured in a brittle way without prior fatigue cracking; FHWA's fatigue-crack repair manual, completed in 2005 and issued in 2013, collected methods such as arrest holes, peening and bolted splices; and the 2021 tie-girder fracture on the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge underlined the importance of hands-on inspection. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 橋梁健康監測感測網
history.text: 大跨橋梁的長期監測在 1990 年代後期快速發展：1997 年通車的香港青馬大橋與汀九、汲水門橋由公路署的風與結構健康監測系統監測，之後再納入昂船洲大橋，系統共約 900 個感測器，量測風、溫度、應變、位移、動態地磅與 GPS。2007 年明尼阿波利斯 I-35W 舊橋倒塌後，2008 年 9 月通車的新橋把約 323 個感測器直接建在橋內，由明尼蘇達大學協助分析。加州運輸局則在收費橋梁設置強震儀，並自 2020 年起推動 BRACE2 計畫，嘗試在震後即時評估橋梁狀態。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Long-term monitoring of long-span bridges grew rapidly from the late 1990s: Hong Kong's Tsing Ma Bridge, opened in 1997, together with the Ting Kau and Kap Shui Mun bridges, is monitored by the Highways Department's wind and structural health monitoring system, later extended to Stonecutters Bridge, with about 900 sensors measuring wind, temperature, strain, displacement, weigh-in-motion loads and GPS positions. After the 2007 collapse of the old I-35W bridge in Minneapolis, the new bridge opened in September 2008 with about 323 sensors built in, analysed with the University of Minnesota. Caltrans instruments its toll bridges with strong-motion sensors and since 2020 has pursued the BRACE2 project to assess bridge condition in near real time after earthquakes. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 橋梁動態荷重試驗
history.text: 橋梁載重試驗早期多為靜態驗證，1932 年雪梨港灣大橋開放前以最多 96 部蒸汽機車進行約三週的試驗即為代表。1940 年塔科馬海峽橋通車約四個月後在風中倒塌，使橋梁的動力行為成為設計與試驗的核心課題。2000 年倫敦千禧橋開放兩天即因人群同步側向振動封閉，工程團隊以人群試驗找出臨界行為，加裝黏滯與調諧質量阻尼器後，再以 2,000 人過橋驗證，2002 年重新開放。2019 年 TRB 發布橋梁載重試驗入門，整理診斷試驗、驗證試驗與動態試驗的方法與限制。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Early bridge load tests were mostly static proofs, exemplified by the roughly three-week test with up to 96 steam locomotives before Sydney Harbour Bridge opened in 1932. The Tacoma Narrows Bridge fell in the wind about four months after opening in 1940, putting dynamic behaviour at the centre of bridge design and testing. In 2000 London's Millennium Bridge closed two days after opening because of synchronous lateral crowd vibration; engineers used crowd tests to find the critical behaviour, added viscous and tuned mass dampers, verified them with 2,000 people walking across and reopened the bridge in 2002. In 2019 TRB published a primer on bridge load testing that summarises diagnostic, proof and dynamic testing methods and their limits. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 台北 101
history.text: 台北 101 由李祖原建築師事務所設計，永峻工程顧問擔任結構設計，Thornton Tomasetti 提供結構概念與初步設計並審查最終設計；1999 年開工、2004 年完工，以 508 m 成為 2004 至 2010 年的世界最高建築。它在颱風與強震並存的台北盆地軟弱地層上，以八支鋼箱填充混凝土巨柱、斜撐核心與多道外伸桁架組成抗側系統，並以岩盤嵌入基樁支承；2002 年地震造成施工中塔吊墜落，凸顯施工階段臨時結構的耐震責任。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Taipei 101 was designed by C.Y. Lee & Partners, with Evergreen Consulting Engineering as structural engineer and Thornton Tomasetti providing the structural concept and preliminary design and reviewing the final design; construction began in 1999 and finished in 2004, and at 508 m it was the world's tallest building from 2004 to 2010. Facing both typhoons and strong earthquakes on the soft Taipei basin, it combines eight concrete-filled steel-box mega-columns, a braced core and multiple outriggers into its lateral system on rock-socketed piles; the 2002 earthquake that toppled two cranes during construction highlighted the seismic responsibility of temporary works. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 哈里發塔
history.text: 哈里發塔（原名杜拜塔）由 Emaar Properties 開發，SOM 負責建築與結構設計（William F. Baker 主導結構），Hyder Consulting 為當地紀錄建築師與工程師，三星物產領銜承攬；2004 年開挖、2009 年封頂、2010 年 1 月啟用，以 828 m 成為世界最高建築。它的扶壁核心延續以混凝土牆為主的高層系統，搭配 Y 形平面與螺旋退縮降低風力，並把高性能混凝土泵送、GPS 測量與長期監測推到新的高度。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Burj Khalifa, originally Burj Dubai, was developed by Emaar Properties and designed architecturally and structurally by SOM, with William F. Baker leading the structure, Hyder Consulting as local architect and engineer of record and Samsung C&T leading construction; excavation began in 2004, it topped out in 2009 and opened in January 2010 as the world's tallest building at 828 m. Its buttressed core extends concrete wall-based tall-building systems, combined with a Y-shaped plan and spiralling setbacks to reduce wind loads, and it pushed high-performance concrete pumping, GPS surveying and long-term monitoring to new heights. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 上海中心大廈
history.text: 上海中心大廈由 Gensler 建築設計、Thornton Tomasetti 結構設計，同濟大學建築設計研究院為紀錄建築師與工程師，上海建工集團總承包；2009 年開工、2015 年完工，以 632 m、地上 128 層成為中國最高建築。它在陸家嘴深厚軟土上，以巨型框架、核心筒與外伸臂組成三重抗側體系，並以扭轉外形降低風載、以懸掛雙層帷幕形成垂直分區的中庭。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Shanghai Tower was designed architecturally by Gensler and structurally by Thornton Tomasetti, with Tongji Architectural Design (Group) as architect and engineer of record and Shanghai Construction Group as main contractor; construction began in 2009 and finished in 2015, making it China's tallest building at 632 m with 128 floors above ground. On the deep soft ground of Lujiazui it combines a mega-frame, core and outriggers into a triple lateral system, reduces wind load with a twisting form and uses a hung double-skin façade to create vertically zoned atria. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 東京晴空塔
history.text: 東京晴空塔由東武鐵道（經其子公司東武塔晴空塔）開發，日建設計負責設計、大林組承攬施工，目的在取代東京鐵塔作為關東地區的主要電視與廣播發射塔，因為都心高樓增加後需要更高的發射點。2008 年 7 月動工，2011 年 3 月在東日本大地震一週後達到 634 m，同年 11 月獲金氏世界紀錄認證為世界最高的塔，2012 年 2 月完工、5 月開放。其心柱制振概念取自日本五重塔的中心柱，並結合現代油壓阻尼器、鋼管桁架與節狀壁樁基礎。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Tokyo Skytree was developed by Tobu Railway through its subsidiary Tobu Tower Skytree, designed by Nikken Sekkei and built by Obayashi, to replace Tokyo Tower as the main television and radio transmitter for the Kantō region once taller buildings in central Tokyo required a higher broadcasting point. Work began in July 2008, the tower reached 634 m in March 2011 a week after the Great East Japan Earthquake, Guinness World Records certified it as the world's tallest tower that November, and it was completed in February 2012 and opened in May. Its central-column vibration control draws on the central pillar of Japanese five-storey pagodas, combined with modern oil dampers, a tubular steel truss and knuckle-wall foundations. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 吉隆坡雙子星塔
history.text: 吉隆坡雙子星塔由國家石油公司 Petronas 委託、César Pelli 建築師事務所設計，Thornton Tomasetti 與 Ranhill Bersekutu 擔任結構工程師，塔一與塔二分別由間組與三星物產領銜的團隊施工；1992 年動工、1998 年完工、1999 年正式開幕，以 451.9 m 在 1998 至 2004 年間並列世界最高建築。1996 年高層建築與都市人居委員會依「尖塔計入、天線不計」的原則，認定其高度超越芝加哥西爾斯大樓，引發高度量測標準的討論。它以高強度混凝土管中管、雙鉸拱空橋與喀斯特地質上的深樁筏基著稱。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Petronas Twin Towers were commissioned by the national oil company Petronas and designed by Cesar Pelli & Associates, with Thornton Tomasetti and Ranhill Bersekutu as structural engineers; Tower 1 and Tower 2 were built by teams led by Hazama and Samsung C&T respectively. Construction began in 1992, the towers were completed in 1998 and officially opened in 1999, and at 451.9 m they shared the title of world's tallest building from 1998 to 2004. In 1996 the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat, counting spires but not antennas, ruled that they exceeded Chicago's Sears Tower, prompting debate on height criteria. They are known for a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube, a two-hinged arch skybridge and deep piles and rafts on karstic ground. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 世界貿易中心一號大樓
history.text: 2001 年 9 月 11 日原世界貿易中心雙塔倒塌後，下曼哈頓重建由總體規劃開始，現行塔樓方案於 2005 年提出、2006 年動工，由 SOM 擔任建築與設計、WSP 擔任結構設計，並由 Leslie E. Robertson Associates 做同儕審查。設計把生命安全與強健性放在核心：高強混凝土核心筒包覆逃生梯與消防員專用梯，周邊延性鋼框架提供替代傳力路徑，14,000 psi 混凝土也首次在紐約市使用。2013 年 5 月尖塔最後兩段就位，2014 年 11 月大樓啟用。本課只重建公開資料中的結構原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件或安全防護細節。
history.textEn: After the original World Trade Center towers collapsed on 11 September 2001, the rebuilding of Lower Manhattan began with a master plan; the current tower scheme was put forward in 2005 and construction started in 2006, with SOM as architect and designer, WSP as structural engineer and Leslie E. Robertson Associates as peer reviewer. Life safety and robustness were central: the high-strength concrete core encloses the exit stairs and a stair for first responders, the ductile perimeter steel frame provides alternate load paths, and 14,000 psi concrete was used in New York City for the first time. The final spire sections were set in May 2013 and the building opened in November 2014. This course reconstructs structural principles and engineering logic from public sources only, not design documents or security details.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 樂天世界塔
history.text: 樂天集團自 1980 年代末就研究在首爾蠶室興建地標塔，先後考慮約十種其他方案後選定 Kohn Pedersen Fox 的錐形設計；Leslie E. Robertson Associates 擔任結構設計，Chang Minwoo Structural Consultants 為在地結構技師、Thornton Tomasetti 做同儕審查，樂天建設負責施工。2009 年開始方案設計，2011 年動工，2015 年 12 月結構封頂，2016 年 3 月頂部燈籠完成，2017 年 4 月開幕，成為韓國最高建築。工程上的特色在於以核心筒、巨柱、外伸臂與帶狀桁架組成系統，並用延遲接頭、巨柱預拱與長期力量設計處理差異變形。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Lotte Group studied a landmark tower at Jamsil in Seoul from the late 1980s and, after considering about ten other designs, chose the tapered design by Kohn Pedersen Fox; Leslie E. Robertson Associates was the design structural engineer, Chang Minwoo Structural Consultants the local engineer of record, Thornton Tomasetti the peer reviewer and Lotte Engineering & Construction the builder. Schematic design began in 2009, construction in 2011, the structure topped out in December 2015, the lantern was completed in March 2016 and the tower opened in April 2017 as Korea's tallest building. Its engineering signature is a system of core, mega-columns, outriggers and belt trusses, with delayed joints, mega-column camber and long-term force design to manage differential movement. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 威利斯大樓
history.text: 1969 年希爾斯公司委託 SOM 設計總部大樓，建築師 Bruce Graham 與結構工程師 Fazlur Khan 提出束筒概念：把九個可各自獨立成立的鋼框管綁在一起，並讓管筒在不同高度終止。1970 年 8 月動工，1973 年 5 月結構封頂，1974 年完工並開放觀景台，此後二十多年保持世界最高建築紀錄；公開資料指出其單位面積用鋼量低於早期的帝國大廈。2009 年更名為威利斯大樓，2017 至 2020 年在大樓持續營運下由 Thornton Tomasetti 與 Gensler 完成底座改造。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In 1969 Sears commissioned SOM to design its headquarters; architect Bruce Graham and structural engineer Fazlur Khan proposed the bundled tube, tying together nine steel framed tubes that could each stand alone and letting them stop at different heights. Ground was broken in August 1970, the structure topped out in May 1973 and the tower was completed with its observation deck in 1974, remaining the world's tallest building for more than two decades; public sources note that it used less steel per unit floor area than the earlier Empire State Building. It was renamed Willis Tower in 2009, and from 2017 to 2020 Thornton Tomasetti and Gensler carried out a base repositioning while the tower stayed in operation. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 香港環球貿易廣場
history.text: 環球貿易廣場是西九龍九龍站上蓋發展「Union Square」的核心，2000 年 Kohn Pedersen Fox 贏得有限邀請競圖，Wong & Ouyang 為合作建築師，業主為新鴻基地產。結構概念由 Leslie E. Robertson 提出八根巨柱、核心筒與外伸臂的方案，Arup 在施工階段擔任結構工程並發展摩擦型壁樁基礎，該基礎形式在當時對香港相對較新。塔樓 2002 年動工、2010 年完工，頂部的麗思卡爾頓酒店於 2011 年 3 月開業，成為香港最高建築。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The International Commerce Centre is the centrepiece of the Union Square development above Kowloon Station in West Kowloon. Kohn Pedersen Fox won a limited international competition in 2000, with Wong & Ouyang as associate architect and Sun Hung Kai Properties as developer. Leslie E. Robertson proposed the structural concept of eight mega-columns, a core and outriggers, and Arup served as execution structural engineer and developed the friction barrette foundations, a system then relatively new to Hong Kong. Construction began in 2002 and was completed in 2010, and the Ritz-Carlton hotel at the top opened in March 2011, making it Hong Kong's tallest building. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 碎片大廈
history.text: 碎片大廈由開發商 Irvine Sellar 推動，Renzo Piano Building Workshop 設計建築，WSP 擔任結構設計，Robert Bird Group 參與結構工程，Mace 承建。2009 年全面動工，英國首次以由上而下的方式施作核心筒，讓核心筒在地下室開挖的同時向上升；2012 年 3 月 66 m 的尖塔吊裝就位，7 月舉行落成儀式，觀景台於 2013 年 2 月開放。結構上的新意在於依用途垂直分區：下部鋼構辦公、上部後拉預力混凝土飯店與住宅、塔頂鋼構散熱器，並以轉換構件調和不同柱距，以上部混凝土樓板的質量取代補充阻尼裝置。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Shard was promoted by developer Irvine Sellar, designed by Renzo Piano Building Workshop with WSP as structural designer, Robert Bird Group contributing structural engineering and Mace as contractor. Full construction began in 2009 with the UK's first top-down core, rising while the basement was excavated; the 66 m spire was lifted into place in March 2012, the building was inaugurated in July and the viewing gallery opened in February 2013. Its structural novelty is vertical zoning by use: steel offices below, post-tensioned concrete hotel and homes above and a steel radiator at the crown, with transfer structures reconciling different column grids and the mass of the upper concrete floors standing in for supplementary dampers. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
history.text: 外伸臂系統的想法是讓核心筒不再單獨抵抗傾覆，而是以深桁架把周邊柱拉進來形成力偶；隨著建築高度與細長比增加，這個做法在超高層中成為主流，並常與機電層、避難層結合。台北 101（2004）以多道單層至三層高的外伸桁架連結八支巨柱與斜撐核心，哈里發塔（2010）在機械層設五組外伸臂，上海中心（2015）則以六道兩層高外伸桁架、帶狀桁架與巨柱組成巨型框架；CTBUH 在 2012 年出版外伸臂設計技術指南，整理差異縮短、接合與阻尼外伸臂等議題。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The idea of an outrigger system is that the core no longer resists overturning alone: deep trusses draw the perimeter columns in to form a couple. As building height and slenderness grew, the approach became mainstream in supertall towers, usually combined with mechanical and refuge floors. Taipei 101 (2004) links eight mega-columns to a braced core through multiple outriggers one to three storeys deep, Burj Khalifa (2010) has five sets of outriggers at mechanical floors, and Shanghai Tower (2015) forms a mega-frame from six two-storey outrigger trusses, belt trusses and super columns; in 2012 CTBUH published a technical guide on outrigger design covering differential shortening, connections and damped outriggers. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高層建築斜交網格結構
history.text: 以斜向構件組成網格的結構可追溯到 19 世紀末俄國工程師舒霍夫的雙曲面與網殼結構，而現代高層建築的斜交網格在 2000 年代成為重要的抗側系統：倫敦聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號（2003 年完工、2004 年啟用）以 Arup 設計的全三角化周邊結構形成曲面外形，紐約赫斯特大樓（2006）以四層一組的斜交網格建在 1928 年歷史建築的立面之上，廣州國際金融中心（2010）則以鋼管混凝土斜柱把斜交網格推上 438.6 m 的超高層。斜交網格以軸力取代彎矩，節省鋼材並形成開放的室內空間，但也把複雜度集中在節點與施工幾何。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Structures built from grids of diagonal members trace back to the hyperboloid and lattice-shell works of the Russian engineer Vladimir Shukhov in the late nineteenth century, while modern high-rise diagrids became an important lateral system in the 2000s: 30 St Mary Axe in London (completed 2003, opened 2004) uses Arup's fully triangulated perimeter structure to form its curved shape, the Hearst Tower in New York (2006) raises a four-storey-module diagrid above the façade of a 1928 landmark, and the Guangzhou International Finance Center (2010) carries a diagrid of concrete-filled tubes to 438.6 m. Diagrids replace bending with axial force, saving steel and opening up interiors, but they concentrate complexity in the nodes and in erection geometry. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 束筒高層結構系統
history.text: SOM 芝加哥事務所的結構工程師 Fazlur Rahman Khan 在 1960 年代提出依高度選擇結構系統的觀念，把框架筒推廣為高層建築的經濟解法，芝加哥 DeWitt-Chestnut 公寓被視為第一棟框架筒建築。為了讓筒體不必是單一方盒並減少剪力滯後，Khan 與建築師 Bruce Graham 在西爾斯大樓（今威利斯大樓）把九個方筒束在一起，1970 年開工、1973 年封頂、1974 年完工，以 442 m 成為 1974 至 1998 年的世界最高建築；1983 年的 One Magnificent Mile 則以四個六角形混凝土筒延伸這個系統。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In the 1960s Fazlur Rahman Khan, structural engineer in SOM's Chicago office, introduced the idea of choosing a structural system by height and promoted the framed tube as an economical solution for tall buildings, with Chicago's DeWitt-Chestnut Apartments regarded as the first framed-tube building. To free the tube from being a single box and to reduce shear lag, Khan and architect Bruce Graham bundled nine square tubes in the Sears Tower, now Willis Tower, which began in 1970, topped out in 1973 and was completed in 1974, standing at 442 m as the world's tallest building from 1974 to 1998; One Magnificent Mile in 1983 extended the system with four hexagonal concrete tubes. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.titleEn: Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings
history.text: Hermann Frahm 於 1909 年提出以附加質量抑制振動的構想並取得專利，Ormondroyd 與 Den Hartog 在 1928 年建立阻尼吸振器理論，Den Hartog 的教科書使最佳調頻與阻尼公式成為工程常識。1970 年代末紐約花旗集團中心與波士頓約翰漢考克大樓率先在高樓裝設調諧質量阻尼器；2004 年完工的台北 101 把巨大鋼球擺錘公開展示，2010 年代的上海中心大廈則採用以磁鐵與銅板產生阻尼的渦電流擺錘。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Hermann Frahm proposed damping vibration with an added mass and patented the idea from 1909, Ormondroyd and Den Hartog developed damped vibration-absorber theory in 1928, and Den Hartog's textbook made the optimum tuning and damping formulas engineering common knowledge. In the late 1970s Citicorp Center in New York and the John Hancock Tower in Boston were early tall buildings with tuned mass dampers; Taipei 101, completed in 2004, put its giant steel-sphere pendulum on public display, and Shanghai Tower in the 2010s used a pendulum damped by magnets moving over copper plates. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 液態調諧阻尼器
history.text: 液體晃動減振與船舶抗橫搖水艙的原理相近，而調諧液體阻尼器用於土木結構最早在日本實現，長崎機場塔台、橫濱海洋塔、新橫濱王子飯店與東京國際機場塔台都是常被引用的早期案例；1989 年 Fujino 等人在 Damping '89 研討會發表淺水槽阻尼器研究，同年 Sakai 與 Takaeda 提出液柱阻尼器構想。北美方面，2001 年完工的溫哥華 One Wall Centre 在頂部設置兩座各約 50,000 加侖的液柱阻尼器，2008 年完工的費城 Comcast Center 則採用超過 1,300 公噸水量的液柱阻尼器。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Liquid sloshing damping shares its principle with ships' anti-roll tanks, and tuned liquid dampers were first applied to civil structures in Japan, with Nagasaki Airport Tower, Yokohama Marine Tower, Shin-Yokohama Prince Hotel and Tokyo International Airport Tower often cited as early cases; in 1989 Fujino and co-workers presented shallow-tank damper research at the Damping '89 conference, and in the same year Sakai and Takaeda proposed the liquid-column damper. In North America, One Wall Centre in Vancouver, completed in 2001, placed two liquid-column dampers of about 50,000 gallons each at its top, and Comcast Center in Philadelphia, completed in 2008, adopted a liquid-column damper holding over 1,300 tons of water. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 黏滯阻尼器性能驗證
history.text: 流體黏滯阻尼器源自國防與航太的衝擊與振動控制，Taylor Devices 自 1955 年起製造流體阻尼器，約 1990 年前後這項技術轉入土木結構，並在大學與國家實驗室的試驗機與振動台上驗證。2000 年倫敦千禧橋開通即因行人引起的側向擺動關閉，後續加裝阻尼裝置並以約 2,000 人行走試驗確認；2003 年墨西哥市 Torre Mayor 以 98 具流體黏滯阻尼器完工，同年台灣高鐵雲林段高架橋在伸縮縫設置 34 具約 4,000 kN 的阻尼器。美國 2000 年版起的 NEHRP 條文與其後的 ASCE 7 第 18 章，把阻尼系統的分析方法與原型、出廠試驗要求制度化。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Fluid viscous dampers grew out of shock and vibration control for defence and aerospace; Taylor Devices has made fluid dampers since 1955, and around 1990 the technology moved into civil structures, proven on test machines and shaking tables at universities and national laboratories. London's Millennium Bridge closed right after opening in 2000 because of pedestrian-induced lateral sway, was later fitted with damping devices and was confirmed with a walking test of about 2,000 people; Torre Mayor in Mexico City was completed in 2003 with 98 fluid viscous dampers, and in the same year the Taiwan High Speed Rail viaduct in Yunlin received 34 dampers of about 4,000 kN at its expansion joints. The US NEHRP Provisions from the 2000 edition onward and then ASCE 7 Chapter 18 codified analysis methods and prototype and production testing for damping systems. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高層建築差異縮短補償
history.text: 高層建築柱縮短的系統性研究始於 1960 年代芝加哥混凝土高樓興起時，Mark Fintel 與 Fazlur Khan 在 1969 年發表預測柱非彈性縮短的論文，之後 Fintel、Ghosh 與 Iyengar 在 1987 年整理出柱縮短的預測與補償方法；ACI 209 委員會的報告提供潛變收縮預測公式，fib Model Code 與 Eurocode 2 也有對應模型。2010 年完工的哈里發塔以退縮對齊柱網讓傳力平順，並進行潛變收縮試驗支援分析；2017 年開幕的樂天世界塔使用延遲接頭、長槽孔與巨柱預拱，並在施工中重新計算差異縮短。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Systematic study of column shortening in tall buildings began as concrete high-rises rose in Chicago in the 1960s: Mark Fintel and Fazlur Khan published a method for predicting inelastic column shortening in 1969, and Fintel, Ghosh and Iyengar compiled prediction and compensation methods in 1987; ACI Committee 209 reports provide creep and shrinkage formulas, with corresponding models in the fib Model Code and Eurocode 2. Burj Khalifa, completed in 2010, aligned setbacks with the column grid for a smooth load path and used creep and shrinkage testing to support its analysis; Lotte World Tower, opened in 2017, used delay joints, long-slotted connections and mega-column camber and recalculated differential shortening during construction. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 建築施工階段結構分析
history.text: 施工階段的結構問題很早就受到注意：1963 年 Grundy 與 Kabaila 分析了多層支撐樓板在施工中承受的荷重，柱縮短研究則在 1960 年代末隨高樓興起。ASCE 37 在 2002 年首次把施工期荷載系統化，EN 1991-1-6 於 2005 年發布施工期作用的歐洲規範。電腦分析進步後，逐層啟動構件與時間相依材料的施工階段分析成為超高層的常規工作：中央電視台總部以五天監測決定兩塔接合時機，碎片大廈以由上而下方式讓核心與地下室同時推進，樂天世界塔延後外伸臂接合，威利斯大樓則在營運中完成底座改造。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Structural problems during construction were recognised early: in 1963 Grundy and Kabaila analysed the loads on slabs in multi-level shoring, and column-shortening studies followed as high-rises grew in the late 1960s. ASCE 37 first systematised construction loads in 2002, and EN 1991-1-6 on actions during execution was published in 2005. As computing advanced, staged analysis activating members floor by floor with time-dependent materials became routine for supertall towers: CCTV Headquarters used five days of monitoring to time the joining of its two towers, The Shard advanced its core and basement simultaneously by top-down construction, Lotte World Tower delayed its outrigger connections, and Willis Tower completed a base repositioning while occupied. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 跨層轉換桁架施工
history.text: 以深梁或桁架轉換柱位是高層建築的老問題，隨著混合用途塔樓興起而更常見：上部住宅或飯店的密柱要落在下部開闊的辦公、大廳或車站之上。2006 年完工的紐約赫斯特大樓以八根長約 27 m 的超級斜撐由第 3 層延伸到第 10 層，把斜交網格塔身的荷重送到保留的歷史立面內；2012 年封頂的碎片大廈以費氏桁架與 A 形構架轉換不同用途的柱網；2015 年封頂的樂天世界塔以帶狀桁架把燈籠與飯店柱轉到巨柱，並吊掛低層樓板；威利斯大樓在 2017 至 2020 年改造中以轉換柱與轉換梁把新裙樓的柱網對齊既有塔樓。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Transferring columns with deep beams or trusses is an old tall-building problem that has become more frequent with mixed-use towers, where dense residential or hotel columns must land over open offices, lobbies or stations below. The Hearst Tower in New York, completed in 2006, used eight super-diagonals about 27 m long running from the third to the tenth floor to carry its diagrid shaft down inside the retained historic façade; The Shard, topped out in 2012, used Vierendeel trusses and A-frames to transfer between column grids for different uses; Lotte World Tower, topped out in 2015, used belt trusses to carry the lantern and hotel columns onto mega-columns and to hang lower floors; and the 2017 to 2020 Willis Tower renovation used transfer columns and girders to align a new podium's grid with the existing tower. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雪梨歌劇院
history.text: 丹麥建築師烏戎在 1957 年贏得雪梨歌劇院國際競圖，Ove Arup & Partners 隨即擔任結構顧問，但帆形屋殼缺乏可計算的幾何，經過多年試算才在 1961 年前後採用以單一球面為母體的預鑄肋拱方案。承包商 Hornibrook 在現場預鑄肋段與瓷磚蓋板，以可伸縮的鋼構架設拱、塔吊與環氧膠結加後拉預力完成屋殼，並以電腦檢核架設程序；風洞試驗與壓克力結構模型也在此案中被大規模使用。建築於 1973 年開幕，2007 年列入世界遺產。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Danish architect Jørn Utzon won the Sydney Opera House international competition in 1957 and Ove Arup & Partners became structural engineers, but the sail-like shells lacked a computable geometry and only around 1961, after years of trial schemes, was the precast rib-arch solution based on a single sphere adopted. The contractor Hornibrook precast rib segments and tile lids on site and built the shells with telescopic steel erection arches, tower cranes and epoxy joints with post-tensioning, checking the erection procedure by computer; wind-tunnel tests and acrylic structural models were also used extensively. The building opened in 1973 and was inscribed as World Heritage in 2007. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 北京國家體育場
history.text: 北京國家體育場由 Herzog & de Meuron 與中國建築設計研究院合作設計，Arup 擔任結構與機電顧問，2002 至 2003 年競圖勝出後於 2003 年 12 月 24 日奠基。原方案含可開合屋頂，2004 年 6 月因鋼材成本與預算壓力取消，屋蓋開口隨之加大、用鋼量下降；主結構為交織的 12 m 深平面桁架，以 24 組桁架柱支承，設計採三級性能化耐震與性能化防火。體育場於 2008 年完工，作為北京奧運主場館，2022 年再次用於冬奧開閉幕式。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Beijing National Stadium was designed by Herzog & de Meuron with China Architecture Design & Research Group, with Arup as structural and building-services engineer; after winning the 2002–2003 competition the foundation stone was laid on 24 December 2003. The original scheme included a retractable roof, dropped in June 2004 because of steel costs and budget pressure, which enlarged the roof opening and reduced steel; the primary structure is a set of interlaced 12 m deep plane trusses on 24 column trusses, designed with three-level performance-based seismic design and performance-based fire engineering. Completed in 2008 as the main venue of the Beijing Olympics, it hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics ceremonies. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園
history.text: 濱海灣金沙綜合度假村由 Moshe Safdie 設計，Arup 擔任結構顧問，雙龍建設（Ssangyong E&C）承建，2006 年設計競圖後約四年即接近完工。三座 55 層旅館塔樓以斜靠的雙腿與第 23 層鋼桁架連結，塔頂的空中花園長約 340 m，以巨型桁架與鋼箱梁跨越三塔並懸挑約 66.5 m；平台分成 14 個主要預製段，由 VSL 以鋼絞線千斤頂提升到約 200 m 高空，懸臂端內藏調諧質量阻尼器處理人群振動。空中花園於 2010 年 6 月開放。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Marina Bay Sands integrated resort was designed by Moshe Safdie with Arup as structural engineer and built by Ssangyong E&C, reaching substantial completion about four years after the 2006 design competition. Its three 55-storey hotel towers have leaning twin legs connected by steel trusses at Level 23, and the SkyPark on top, about 340 m long, bridges the towers with mega-trusses and steel box girders and cantilevers about 66.5 m; the platform was prefabricated in 14 main segments and strand-jacked to about 200 m by VSL, with a tuned mass damper hidden in the cantilever tip against crowd vibration. The SkyPark opened in June 2010. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋
history.text: 千禧巨蛋由 Richard Rogers Partnership 設計，Buro Happold 擔任結構與機電工程顧問，McAlpine 與 Laing 聯合承攬，1997 年 6 月開工，屋頂結構在約 15 個月內完成，造價約 4,300 萬英鎊。它以 12 支約 100 m 高的桅桿、約 70 km 鋼索與 PTFE 玻纖膜構成，屋面原規劃為 PVC 聚酯膜後改為 PTFE 玻纖膜，膜材由 Chemfab 供應、Birdair 安裝，並獲英國皇家工程院 MacRobert 獎。展覽於 2000 年結束，2007 年改建為 The O2 重新開放，2022 年風暴 Eunice 撕裂數個膜面區段。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Millennium Dome was designed by Richard Rogers Partnership with Buro Happold as structural and services engineer and built by a McAlpine–Laing joint venture; work began in June 1997 and the roof structure was delivered in about 15 months for about £43 million. It combines 12 masts about 100 m high, about 70 km of steel cable and PTFE-coated glass fabric; the roof, first planned in PVC-polyester, was changed to PTFE-glass supplied by Chemfab and installed by Birdair, and the project won the Royal Academy of Engineering MacRobert Award. The exhibition closed in 2000, the building reopened as The O2 in 2007, and Storm Eunice tore several fabric segments in 2022. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋
history.text: 1967 年慕尼黑奧運公園建築競圖共收到 104 件作品，Behnisch & Partner 以覆蓋體育場、體育館與游泳館的帳篷屋蓋得獎，Frei Otto 擔任帳篷結構顧問，Leonhardt + Andrä 負責結構，Jörg Schlaich 主導屋蓋完成。原本以模型為主的形狀研究無法提供製造所需精度，團隊因此發展出這類問題首次使用的迭代電腦計算，並以等網目索網、鑄鋼節點與壓克力覆板實現約 74,800 m² 的屋蓋。體育場屋蓋於 1972 年 4 月完成，5 月開幕，同年舉辦奧運；屋蓋現為列管古蹟並持續檢測整修。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The 1967 architectural competition for Munich's Olympic Park drew 104 entries, and Behnisch & Partner won with a tent roof over the stadium, arena and swimming hall, with Frei Otto as tent-structure consultant, Leonhardt + Andrä as structural engineers and Jörg Schlaich leading the roof's completion. Model-based form studies could not deliver fabrication accuracy, so the team developed what became the first iterative computer application for this class of problem and built about 74,800 m² of roof from uniform-mesh cable nets, cast-steel nodes and acrylic panels. The stadium roof was completed in April 1972 and the stadium opened in May, hosting the Olympics that year; the roof is now a listed monument under ongoing inspection and renovation. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大跨度空間桁架提升
history.text: 以千斤頂整體提升大型結構的做法，隨著預力技術發展出的鋼絞線千斤頂與電腦同步控制而成熟，讓數千噸的屋蓋可以在地面組裝後提升數十公尺。日本結構工程師川口衞發展的 Pantadome 構法在 1984 年首次用於神戶世界紀念館，其後用於大阪 Namihaya Dome 等場館；倫敦希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋因雷達限制在地面組裝後分段頂升，最後一段於 2005 年就位；2010 年前後的新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園則把約 1,270 t 的箱梁提升到約 200 m 高空。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件或操作許可。
history.textEn: Lifting large structures whole with jacks matured with strand jacks derived from post-tensioning and with computer synchronisation, allowing roofs of thousands of tonnes to be assembled at ground level and raised tens of metres. Japanese structural engineer Mamoru Kawaguchi's Pantadome method was first used at Kobe's World Memorial Hall in 1984 and later at venues such as Osaka's Namihaya Dome; the 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5 was assembled on the ground and jacked up in sections because of radar restrictions, the last section placed in 2005; and around 2010 the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark in Singapore raised a box-girder pair of about 1,270 t to about 200 m. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents or operating authorisation.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 張拉膜屋蓋成形
history.titleEn: Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs
history.text: 現代張拉膜結構的形狀尋找由 Frei Otto 推動：他在 1964 年於斯圖加特大學創立輕量結構研究所，以肥皂膜與實體模型研究極小曲面，並與 Rolf Gutbrod 設計 1967 年蒙特婁世博會德國館。1970 年代的慕尼黑奧運屋蓋促成迭代電腦計算，1974 年發表的力密度法與後來的動態鬆弛法讓形狀尋找與裁片計算成為標準流程。1981 年啟用的吉達哈吉航廈以 210 個 PTFE 玻纖錐形單元覆蓋大面積候機空間，1994 年完成的丹佛國際機場 Jeppesen 航廈則以雙層 PTFE 膜與鋼索構成約 34,800 m² 的主屋頂。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件或施工許可。
history.textEn: Form finding for modern tensile membranes was driven by Frei Otto, who founded the Institute for Lightweight Structures at the University of Stuttgart in 1964, studied minimal surfaces with soap films and physical models, and designed the German Pavilion at Expo 67 in Montreal with Rolf Gutbrod. The Munich Olympic roof of the early 1970s prompted iterative computer methods, and the force density method published in 1974, followed by dynamic relaxation, made form finding and patterning standard procedure. The Hajj Terminal in Jeddah, opened in 1981, covered a vast waiting area with 210 PTFE-glass conical units, and Denver International Airport's Jeppesen Terminal, completed in 1994, used double-layer PTFE and steel cables for a main roof of about 34,800 m². This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents or construction authorisation.

history.title: 索網屋蓋張拉
history.text: Matthew Nowicki 設計、Fred Severud 擔任結構顧問的羅利 Dorton 體育館於 1952 年完成，以兩道交叉拋物線拱撐起鞍形索網，被 ASCE 認定為世界第一座永久性索支承屋頂，並於 2002 年列為國家歷史土木工程地標。1972 年慕尼黑奧運屋蓋以等網目鞍形索網與迭代電腦計算把索網推向大規模應用；1983 年啟用的卡加利 Saddledome 以索網承托混凝土板構成雙曲面屋頂；其後輪輻式屋蓋以受壓環、受拉環與徑向索自我平衡，巴西利亞國家體育場為 2014 年世界盃改建時即採用平衡懸吊輪原理的雙層懸吊屋頂。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件或張拉作業許可。
history.textEn: Raleigh's Dorton Arena, designed by Matthew Nowicki with Fred Severud as structural consultant and completed in 1952, carried a saddle-shaped cable net on two intersecting parabolic arches; ASCE recognises it as the world's first permanent cable-supported roof and designated it a National Historic Civil Engineering Landmark in 2002. Munich's 1972 Olympic roof took cable nets to large scale with uniform-mesh saddle nets and iterative computation; Calgary's Saddledome, opened in 1983, used a cable net carrying concrete slabs to form a saddle roof; and later spoked-wheel roofs balanced themselves with compression rings, tension rings and radial cables, as in the double-layer suspended roof built on the balanced suspension-wheel principle when Brasília's National Stadium was rebuilt for the 2014 World Cup. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents or tensioning authorisation.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 可開合體育場屋頂
history.text: 1976 年蒙特婁奧運體育場的可收放織物屋頂未能可靠運作，成為後來設計者的反面教材。1985 年 Michael Allen 與建築師 Rod Robbie 提出 SkyDome 的屋頂構想：兩片中段拱形屋面直線滑動、一片四分之一圓頂旋轉，1989 年啟用。日本福岡巨蛋於 1993 年完成三片繞中心旋轉的屋頂，2009 年溫布頓中央球場加裝可摺疊移動屋頂，2017 年啟用的亞特蘭大賓士體育場則以 8 片花瓣狀屋面板直線移動形成光圈造型。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The retractable fabric roof of Montreal's 1976 Olympic stadium never worked reliably and became a cautionary example for later designers. In 1985 Michael Allen and architect Rod Robbie devised the SkyDome roof, with two middle arched panels sliding in straight lines and a quarter-dome panel rotating, and the stadium opened in 1989. Fukuoka Dome in Japan completed a roof of three sections rotating about its centre in 1993, Wimbledon's Centre Court added a folding moving roof in 2009, and Atlanta's Mercedes-Benz Stadium, opened in 2017, moves eight petal panels in straight lines to form an aperture. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 薄殼混凝土屋頂施工
history.text: Félix Candela 1949 年在墨西哥成立營造公司，1950 至 1976 年間設計約 1,500 個案，其中過半建成；1951 年宇宙射線館的殼面最厚處只有約 5/8 英寸，1958 年的 Los Manantiales 以四個雙曲拋物面組成跨距逾 42 m 的八瓣拱頂。瑞士工程師 Heinz Isler 1955 年在工地看見濕麻布自然懸垂而受啟發，發展倒懸模型找形，建造近 1,400 座殼。2017 年蘇黎世聯邦理工學院與 Empa 以索網織物模板完成 HiLo 屋頂原型，2021 年 NEST HiLo 單元啟用，把柔性模板與噴附混凝土帶入薄殼施工。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Félix Candela founded his building firm in Mexico in 1949 and between 1950 and 1976 designed about 1,500 projects, more than half of them built; the 1951 Cosmic Ray Pavilion shell is only about 5/8 inch at its thickest, and the 1958 Los Manantiales combines four hyperbolic paraboloids into an eight-lobed vault spanning over 42 m. Swiss engineer Heinz Isler, inspired in 1955 by wet burlap hanging on a building site, developed form-finding with inverted hanging models and built nearly 1,400 shells. In 2017 ETH Zurich and Empa completed a HiLo roof prototype on cable-net fabric formwork, and the NEST HiLo unit opened in 2021, bringing flexible formwork and sprayed concrete into shell construction. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高層建築核心筒滑模施工
history.text: 滑模源自筒倉與煙囪這類斷面固定的高聳結構，因可連續成形而被引入高塔與高層核心筒。1973 年 2 月動工的多倫多 CN Tower 以液壓爬升千斤頂推動的模具連續澆築約 335 m 的六角形混凝土塔身，並邊升邊收窄形成錐形，1975 年 4 月完工。2014 至 2016 年 Züblin 以滑模建造羅特魏爾高 246 m 的電梯試驗塔；2020 年亞特蘭大的電梯試驗塔由奧地利滑模專業廠商 Gleitbau 負責滑模設計與督導，核心筒約 54 天完成。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Slipforming grew out of silos and chimneys, tall structures of constant section, and was brought into towers and high-rise cores because it forms walls continuously. Toronto's CN Tower, started in February 1973, cast its hexagonal concrete shaft of about 335 m in a mould pushed up by hydraulic climbing jacks that narrowed as it rose to form the taper, and was completed in April 1975. Between 2014 and 2016 Züblin slipformed the 246 m elevator test tower in Rottweil, and in 2020 the Atlanta elevator test tower used the Austrian slipform specialist Gleitbau for slipform design and supervision, completing its core in about 54 days. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高層建築液壓爬模施工
history.text: 自爬模板由傳統的吊升跳模發展而來，把模板、平台與油壓頂升機構整合成不依賴塔吊的系統。PERI 的 ACS 自爬系統型錄把 1994 年的吉隆坡雙子星塔列為早期參考案例；2004 年起興建、2010 年完工的哈里發塔，由 Doka 以 SKE100 自爬系統配合 Top 50 大面積牆模，以 3 天樓層循環完成核心筒與翼牆，並首次使用 Xclimb 60 自爬防護屏。2012 年樂天世界塔核心筒以 132 組 SKE100 爬升，另以自爬單元同步提升混凝土布料機。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Self-climbing formwork evolved from crane-lifted jump forms by integrating forms, platforms and hydraulic lifting into a system that does not depend on the tower crane. PERI's ACS self-climbing literature lists the Petronas Towers of 1994 among its early references; at Burj Khalifa, completed in 2010, Doka used the SKE100 self-climbing system with Top 50 large-area wall forms to build the core and wing walls on a three-day floor cycle and used the Xclimb 60 self-climbing protection screen for the first time. In 2012 Lotte World Tower's core climbed on 132 SKE100 units, with further self-climbing units lifting the concrete placing booms in step. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高強度混凝土高程泵送
history.text: ACI 304.2R 記載機械式活塞泵於 1933 年在美國密爾瓦基出現，早期多用 150 mm 以上的管徑。超高層建築把泵送高度推向數百公尺：哈里發塔的預拌商 Unimix 在 2007 年達到 452 m，2008 年以 Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D 創下 606 m 的垂直泵送紀錄；三一重工公布上海中心大廈於 2013 年封頂核心筒時泵送至約 580 m，平安金融中心 2014 年以 C100 泵送至 555.5 m，2015 年天津高銀金融 117 以 621 m 創下金氏世界紀錄。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: ACI 304.2R records that mechanical piston pumps appeared in Milwaukee in 1933, usually with lines of 150 mm or more. Supertall buildings pushed pumping heights to hundreds of metres: at Burj Khalifa the ready-mix supplier Unimix reached 452 m in 2007 and set a vertical record of 606 m in 2008 with a Putzmeister BSA 14000 SHP-D; Sany reports pumping to about 580 m at Shanghai Tower's core top-out in 2013, C100 concrete to 555.5 m at Ping An Finance Center in 2014, and a Guinness record of 621 m at Goldin Finance 117 in Tianjin in 2015. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 巨厚筏基水化熱控制
history.titleEn: Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations
history.text: 1930 年代美國胡佛水壩以分塊澆置與預埋冷卻水管控制巨積混凝土的水化熱，奠定大體積溫控的工程方法。超高層筏基把這些原則帶入建築：1999 年拉斯維加斯 Venetian 以約 21,000 立方碼創下連續澆置紀錄，2014 年 2 月洛杉磯 Wilshire Grand Center 以約 21,200 立方碼（約 16,200 m³）、約 20 小時的連續澆置刷新紀錄；三一重工公布上海中心大廈筏基約 60 小時澆置約 61,000 m³，天津高銀金融 117 以 80 小時澆置 65,000 m³。ACI 301 第 8 節則把巨積混凝土的溫度限值與溫控計畫要求納入規範。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In the 1930s Hoover Dam controlled the hydration heat of mass concrete with block placement and embedded cooling pipes, establishing the engineering methods of thermal control for large volumes. Supertall rafts brought these principles into buildings: in 1999 the Venetian in Las Vegas set a continuous-pour record of about 21,000 cubic yards, and in February 2014 Wilshire Grand Center in Los Angeles broke it with about 21,200 cubic yards (about 16,200 m³) in about 20 hours; Sany reports that Shanghai Tower's raft placed about 61,000 m³ in about 60 hours and that Goldin Finance 117 placed 65,000 m³ in 80 hours. ACI 301 Section 8 brought temperature limits and thermal-control plan requirements for mass concrete into a specification. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗
history.titleEn: Welding inspection of major steel joints
history.text: 焊接在二十世紀中期取代鉚接成為鋼結構主要接合方式，也帶來新的破壞模式。1980 年北海 Alexander L. Kielland 平台因斜撐上一道附屬填角焊引發的疲勞裂縫傾覆，123 人罹難；1994 年 Northridge 地震後，多棟鋼造抗彎矩構架的梁柱焊接接頭被發現脆性斷裂，SEAOC、ATC 與 CUREE 組成的 SAC 聯合團隊研究至 2000 年，推動了需求關鍵焊縫的韌性、細部與檢驗要求。2005 年海灣大橋東段工程焊接遭指控後的獨立檢驗，以及 2021 年 I-40 橋追溯到製造時焊接修補的斷裂，都凸顯品保與紀錄的重要。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Welding replaced riveting as the main way to join structural steel in the mid-twentieth century and brought new failure modes. In 1980 the Alexander L. Kielland platform in the North Sea capsized after a fatigue crack grew from an attachment fillet weld on a brace, killing 123 people; after the 1994 Northridge earthquake, brittle fractures were found in welded beam–column joints of many steel moment frames, and the SAC Joint Venture of SEAOC, ATC and CUREE studied them until 2000, driving toughness, detailing and inspection requirements for demand-critical welds. The independent inspection after allegations about welds on the Bay Bridge East Span project in 2005, and the 2021 I-40 bridge fracture traced to fabrication weld repairs, both underline the importance of quality assurance and records. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高強度螺栓預拉力施工
history.text: 二十世紀上半葉的大型鋼構以熱鉚接為主，1932 年通車的雪梨港灣大橋即由約六百萬支手工鉚釘組成。RCSC 於 1951 年 1 月發布第一版高強度螺栓接頭規範，使預拉螺栓逐步取代鉚釘，此後已出版 18 個版本；2025 年版撤除校正扳手法，並新增螺栓施工人員資格與承包商責任等條文。1979 年 Kemper Arena 屋頂吊架螺栓失效，以及 2013 年海灣大橋東段高強度錨桿在受拉後兩週內大量斷裂，都提醒工程師預拉、材料與氫脆控制必須一併管理。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Large steel structures of the early twentieth century were mostly hot-riveted; Sydney Harbour Bridge, opened in 1932, is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets. RCSC published its first specification for high-strength bolted joints in January 1951, letting pretensioned bolts gradually replace rivets, and has issued 18 successive editions since; the 2025 edition withdrew the calibrated wrench method and added provisions on bolting personnel qualifications and contractor responsibilities. The 1979 failure of Kemper Arena's roof hanger bolts and the 2013 fracture of many high-strength anchor rods on the Bay Bridge East Span within two weeks of tensioning both remind engineers that pretension, material and hydrogen-embrittlement control must be managed together. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 組合樓板剪力釘焊接
history.titleEn: Stud welding for composite floor systems
history.text: 鋼梁與混凝土樓板的組合構造在二十世紀中後期成為鋼構建築樓板的主流，焊接頭釘與壓型鋼板的穿板焊接讓剪力連接可以在現場快速完成。1960 至 1970 年代興建的世界貿易中心雙子塔，樓板以輕型桁架腹桿頂端的「指節」埋入混凝土取得組合作用；1980 年代完成的世界貿易中心七號樓，則以剪力釘把樓板梁與混凝土組合。2001 年七號樓在長時間火災後倒塌，NIST 於 2008 年的最終報告指出樓板梁熱膨脹推動大梁離座是關鍵，並建議檢討組合樓板與接頭的熱膨脹效應。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Composite construction of steel beams and concrete slabs became the dominant floor system for steel buildings in the mid to late twentieth century, with welded headed studs and through-deck welding letting shear connection be made quickly on site. The World Trade Center Twin Towers, built in the 1960s and 1970s, achieved composite floors with truss-web knuckles embedded in the concrete, while 7 World Trade Center, completed in the 1980s, made its floor beams composite with shear studs. After 7 World Trade Center collapsed following prolonged fires in 2001, NIST's final report in 2008 identified thermal expansion of floor beams pushing a girder off its seat as the key event and recommended evaluating thermal expansion in composite floors and their connections. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工
history.text: 鋼筋混凝土剪力牆自二十世紀中期成為中高層建築的主要抗側力系統，歷次大地震的經驗逐步把規範的重點從強度轉向牆端圍束與韌性。2010 年完工的哈里發塔以三翼高性能混凝土核心牆互相扶壁，形成抗扭勁度很高的扶壁式核心；2011 年 2 月 22 日基督城 CTV 大樓倒塌，紐西蘭皇家調查委員會在 2012 年的第六卷報告中檢討其結構系統與樓板拉桿補強。ACI 318-19 把邊界構材的判斷改為以 1.5 倍設計位移計算，反映對牆端應變需求的新認識。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Reinforced-concrete shear walls became the main lateral system of mid- and high-rise buildings from the mid-twentieth century, and experience from successive major earthquakes gradually shifted code emphasis from strength to wall-end confinement and ductility. Burj Khalifa, completed in 2010, uses high-performance concrete core walls in three wings that buttress one another, forming a buttressed core with very high torsional stiffness; after the CTV Building in Christchurch collapsed on 22 February 2011, Volume 6 of the New Zealand Royal Commission's 2012 report reviewed its structural system and drag-bar retrofit. ACI 318-19 changed the boundary-element check to use 1.5 times the design displacement, reflecting new understanding of wall-end strain demands. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 清水混凝土模板與澆置
history.text: 路易斯．康設計的沙克研究所於 1962 年 6 月動工、同年 12 月開始澆置混凝土，1967 年完工，以含火山灰的暖色混凝土與規則的模板痕跡成為清水混凝土的經典，1991 年被指定為歷史地標。安藤忠雄的光之教會於 1989 年在大阪茨木完成，以規則的模板分割與繫桿孔和牆上的十字光縫聞名，1999 年增建主日學校。ACI 347.3R 在 2014 年初版印行，把成形混凝土表面分為 CSC1 至 CSC4 四級；ACI 301-20 第 6 節則規定契約指定時適用的建築混凝土要求。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Louis Kahn's Salk Institute broke ground in June 1962, began placing concrete that December and was completed in 1967; its warm-toned concrete containing volcanic ash and orderly form marks made it a classic of exposed concrete, and it was designated a historic landmark in 1991. Tadao Ando's Church of the Light was completed in Ibaraki, Osaka in 1989, known for its regular panel layout, tie holes and the cross-shaped slit of light in its wall, and a Sunday school was added in 1999. ACI 347.3R was first printed in 2014, dividing formed concrete surfaces into four categories, CSC1 to CSC4, while ACI 301-20 Section 6 sets architectural-concrete requirements that apply when the contract designates them. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大型鋼構防蝕塗裝
history.titleEn: Protective coating of large steel structures
history.text: 大型鋼構的防蝕塗裝長期以含鉛塗料為主：1889 年完工的艾菲爾鐵塔自 1899 年後大致每七年重塗一次，至今已 20 次；1937 年通車的金門大橋最初則使用以紅丹與亞麻仁油調製的含鉛塗料。1960 年代起，金門大橋因腐蝕開始移除含鉛塗料並改用無機鋅矽酸鹽底漆系統，1995 年完成，並因空氣品質法規改用水性面漆；福斯鐵橋則在 2002 年起進行首次全面重塗，採用源自北海石油工業的三層系統。這些案例顯示塗裝系統、表面處理、環境法規與持續維護團隊必須一起規劃。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Protective coating of large steel structures long relied on lead-based paints: the Eiffel Tower, completed in 1889, has been repainted roughly every seven years since 1899, 20 times so far, while the Golden Gate Bridge, opened in 1937, began with a lead-based paint of red lead in linseed oil. From the 1960s, corrosion led the Golden Gate Bridge to remove its lead paint for an inorganic zinc silicate primer system, completed in 1995, with water-borne topcoats adopted under air-quality rules; the Forth Bridge began its first full repaint in 2002 with a three-coat system derived from the North Sea oil industry. These cases show that coating systems, surface preparation, environmental regulation and a standing maintenance team must be planned together. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 結構抗連鎖倒塌設計
history.text: 1968 年倫敦 Ronan Point 角落倒塌後，英國在 1970 年修訂建築法規加入「不成比例倒塌」要求，並在過渡期以 34 kPa 的爆炸壓力作為新建高層住宅的設計值。1995 年奧克拉荷馬市 Murrah 聯邦大樓爆炸與 2001 年世界貿易中心事件之後，美國聯邦總務署與國防部發展替代路徑設計準則，國防部 UFC 4-023-03 於 2009 年發布並持續修訂；NIST 在 2007 年出版 NISTIR 7396 整理抗連鎖倒塌的最佳實務，2008 年完成世界貿易中心 7 號大樓調查，2026 年發布 Champlain Towers South 的技術結論。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: After the 1968 corner collapse at Ronan Point in London, the UK amended its building regulations in 1970 to require resistance to disproportionate collapse, using an interim explosion pressure of 34 kPa for new tall housing blocks. Following the 1995 bombing of the Murrah Federal Building in Oklahoma City and the 2001 World Trade Center attacks, the US General Services Administration and the Department of Defense developed alternate-path design guidelines, with the Department of Defense issuing UFC 4-023-03 in 2009 and revising it since; NIST published best practices on progressive collapse as NISTIR 7396 in 2007, completed its World Trade Center 7 investigation in 2008 and released technical findings on Champlain Towers South in 2026. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 既有建築基礎隔震改造
history.text: Forell/Elsesser 在 1980 年代初期開始把基礎隔震用於建築，鹽湖城市郡大樓在多年整修後於 1989 年重新開放，被該公司稱為全球第一個以基礎隔震改造的既有建築。同年 Loma Prieta 地震損壞舊金山市政府，其後的改造切斷約 530 根柱與約 1,500 ft 磚牆以安裝隔震器，成為當時最大的隔震結構；奧克蘭市政府的隔震改造則是當時最高的隔震建築。猶他州議會大廈後來以 256 個隔震器與後拉預力托換梁完成改造，2020 年規模 5.7 地震也驗證了鹽湖城市郡大樓的隔震效益。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Forell/Elsesser began applying base isolation to buildings in the early 1980s, and the Salt Lake City and County Building, reopened in 1989 after a multi-year renovation, is described by the firm as the world's first base-isolation retrofit of an existing building. In the same year the Loma Prieta earthquake damaged San Francisco City Hall, whose subsequent retrofit cut about 530 columns and about 1,500 ft of brick walls to install isolators and became the largest isolated structure of its time, while the Oakland City Hall isolation retrofit was then the tallest. The Utah State Capitol was later retrofitted with 256 isolators and post-tensioned transfer girders, and a magnitude 5.7 earthquake in 2020 confirmed the benefit of isolation at the Salt Lake City and County Building. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 挫屈束制支撐安裝
history.text: 挫屈束制支撐的構想在 1970 至 1980 年代於日本發展成熟，日本製鐵工程的無黏結支撐上市至今已 30 餘年、交付超過 10 萬支。1994 年 Northridge 與 1995 年阪神地震後，美國開始在建築中採用挫屈束制支撐構架，並透過柏克萊加州大學等機構的實尺度試驗與 AISC 341 的資格試驗條文制度化。舊金山 One Rincon Hill 在塔樓中以挫屈束制支撐處理地震力，近年的鹽湖城國際機場與紐約 Louis Armstrong 網球場也採用美國製造商 CoreBrace 的支撐。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The buckling-restrained brace matured in Japan during the 1970s and 1980s, and Nippon Steel Engineering's unbonded brace has been on the market for more than 30 years with over 100,000 braces delivered. After the 1994 Northridge and 1995 Kobe earthquakes, buckling-restrained braced frames were adopted in US buildings and codified through full-scale tests at institutions such as the University of California, Berkeley, and the qualification testing provisions of AISC 341. One Rincon Hill in San Francisco uses buckling-restrained braces in its tower for seismic resistance, and more recently Salt Lake City International Airport and Louis Armstrong Stadium in New York used braces from the US manufacturer CoreBrace. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 預鑄混凝土耐震接頭
history.text: 1994 年 Northridge 地震中多座預鑄停車結構倒塌，凸顯預鑄接頭與隔板傳力的弱點。美日合作的 PRESSS 研究計畫在 1990 年代發展接合式預鑄系統，1999 年於加州大學聖地牙哥分校完成約 60% 縮尺的五層預鑄試驗建築，驗證混合構架與接合式剪力牆的自復位行為；舊金山 The Paramount 公寓以預鑄預力構架在約 2001 至 2002 年完工，完工時被稱為該地震分區最高的混凝土構架建築。2011 年基督城地震中預鑄樓梯崩落，促使各國重新檢討預鑄構件的變位相容。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Several precast parking structures collapsed in the 1994 Northridge earthquake, exposing weaknesses in precast connections and diaphragm load paths. The US–Japan PRESSS research programme developed jointed precast systems in the 1990s and in 1999 completed a five-storey precast test building at about 60% scale at the University of California, San Diego, demonstrating self-centring of hybrid frames and jointed shear walls; The Paramount apartment tower in San Francisco, built with precast prestressed frames, was completed around 2001 to 2002 and was then described as the tallest concrete-framed structure in its seismic zone. Precast stair collapses in the 2011 Christchurch earthquake prompted renewed review of deformation compatibility for precast elements. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋
history.text: 預力混凝土在 1950 年代的美國迅速發展，預鑄預力混凝土協會（PCI）於 1954 年成立，雙 T 梁因寬幅、輕量與大跨度成為停車場樓板與工業、商業建築屋頂的標準構件。隨著應用擴大，施工期間的事故也提供了重要教訓：美國職業安全衛生署調查 1990 年匹茲堡國際機場航廈預鑄屋頂構件吊裝時的倒塌、2012 年邁阿密戴德學院停車場倒塌、2013 年 Montgomery Mall 以千斤頂移除雙 T 梁時的倒塌，以及 2016 年邁阿密戴德學院重建停車場的雙 T 梁倒塌，共同指出支承灌漿、連接完成與臨時支撐的重要性。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Prestressed concrete expanded rapidly in the United States in the 1950s, the Precast/Prestressed Concrete Institute (PCI) was founded in 1954, and the double tee, wide, light and long-spanning, became a standard element for parking-structure floors and industrial and commercial roofs. As use grew, construction incidents provided key lessons: OSHA investigated the 1990 collapse of precast roof members during erection at the Greater Pittsburgh International Airport airside building, the 2012 Miami Dade College garage collapse, the 2013 Montgomery Mall collapse while a double tee was being removed by jacking, and the 2016 double-tee collapse at the rebuilt Miami Dade College garage, which together highlight support grouting, completed connections and temporary supports. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高層建築消防分區設計
history.text: 高層建築的防火區劃觀念隨著電梯與鋼構高樓的普及而發展，大型火災不斷推動法規修訂。1991 年費城 One Meridian Plaza 火災燒毀 8 層、3 名消防員殉職，火勢直到有灑水的 30 樓才停止，成為推動既有高樓加裝灑水的重要案例；2017 年倫敦 Grenfell Tower 火災造成 72 人死亡，外牆改裝材料使火勢繞過內部區劃，公開調查第一階段報告於 2019 年 10 月發布；2021 年 10 月高雄城中城大樓火災造成 46 人死亡，促使台灣各地加強老舊建築的消防與公共安全檢查。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Compartmentation in tall buildings developed alongside lifts and steel-framed high-rises, and major fires repeatedly drove regulatory change. The 1991 One Meridian Plaza fire in Philadelphia destroyed eight floors and killed three firefighters before stopping at the sprinklered 30th floor, an important case for retrofitting sprinklers in existing towers; the 2017 Grenfell Tower fire in London killed 72 people as façade refurbishment materials let fire bypass internal compartments, with the inquiry's Phase 1 report published in October 2019; and the October 2021 Cheng Chung Cheng Building fire in Kaohsiung killed 46 people, prompting stronger fire and public-safety inspections of ageing buildings across Taiwan. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼構耐火被覆施工
history.text: 1918 年美國 ASTM 委員會通過建築構造耐火試驗標準並建立標準升溫曲線，其後的 ASTM E119 與 UL 263 成為北美鋼構耐火被覆的試驗基礎。1995 至 1997 年英國 Cardington 實尺寸鋼構火災試驗中，未保護的組合樓板梁最高約 1,100°C 仍未倒塌，推動了性能化防火設計；2001 年世界貿易中心倒塌後，NIST 調查指出被覆被撞落與厚度不均的影響，促成 2009 年版 IBC 提高高層建築 SFRM 黏結強度並要求現場特別檢驗。2005 年馬德里溫莎大樓火災則揭示改修過渡期的風險。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In 1918 an ASTM committee adopted a fire-test standard for building construction that established the standard time–temperature curve, and its successors ASTM E119 and UL 263 became the test basis for steel fireproofing in North America. In the full-scale Cardington steel-frame fire tests in the UK from 1995 to 1997, unprotected composite floor beams reached about 1,100°C without collapse, encouraging performance-based fire design; after the 2001 World Trade Center collapses, the NIST investigation highlighted dislodged and uneven fireproofing and led the 2009 IBC to raise SFRM bond strength for high-rise buildings and require field special inspection. The 2005 Windsor Building fire in Madrid exposed the risk of a building caught mid-retrofit. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大型玻璃肋結構安裝
history.text: 以玻璃肋穩定大片玻璃立面的做法，在 1975 年完工的英國伊普斯威奇 Willis Faber & Dumas 總部等作品中受到廣泛注意，懸吊玻璃以角隅夾具與玻璃肋連接，讓立面幾乎沒有金屬框。此後強化與膠合技術、離子型中間膜與膠合入玻璃的金屬件逐步成熟，2000 年代起蘋果直營店把結構玻璃推向十公尺以上的單片尺寸：上海陸家嘴店以約 13 m 高的單片曲面玻璃與通高玻璃肋組成圓筒，第五大道店的玻璃立方體在 2011 年以更少的玻璃單元與接合件重建。歐洲則在 2021 年發布 CEN/TS 19100，將玻璃結構設計納入規範體系。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Stabilising large glass façades with glass fins drew wide attention through works such as the Willis Faber & Dumas headquarters in Ipswich, completed in 1975, where suspended glass was connected by corner patch fittings and glass fins so that the façade had almost no metal frame. Toughening and laminating, ionoplast interlayers and laminated-in metal fittings then matured, and from the 2000s Apple stores pushed structural glass to single pieces over ten metres long: the Pudong store in Shanghai formed a cylinder from single curved panels about 13 m tall with full-height glass fins, and the Fifth Avenue glass cube was rebuilt in 2011 with far fewer glass units and fixings. In 2021 Europe published CEN/TS 19100, bringing glass structural design into the code framework. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
