history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝
history.text: 單元式帷幕牆把立面的玻璃、框料與密封移到工廠組裝，隨著超高層建築的興起成為主流做法，因為它減少高空作業、縮短工期並讓品質在可控環境下完成。2010 年完工的哈里發塔高 828 m，官方資料記錄其鋁與玻璃立面在 512 m 高度安裝的紀錄；2014 年完工的紐約世界貿易中心一號大樓由 Benson Industries 承作帷幕牆；倫敦碎片大廈則以約 11,000 片玻璃覆蓋 95 層的錐形塔身。歐洲以 EN 13830 規範帷幕牆產品性能，英國 CWCT 與美國 AAMA 則建立了樣品牆試驗與層間位移試驗的方法。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Unitized curtain walls move glazing, framing and sealing into the factory, and they became the dominant approach as supertall buildings multiplied because they reduce work at height, shorten programmes and let quality be achieved in controlled conditions. Burj Khalifa, completed in 2010 at 828 m, records in its official information the installation of its aluminium and glass façade at a height of 512 m; One World Trade Center in New York, completed in 2014, had its curtain wall delivered by Benson Industries; and The Shard in London covers its 95-storey tapering form with about 11,000 glass panels. In Europe EN 13830 governs curtain-wall product performance, while CWCT in the UK and AAMA in the US established methods for mock-up and racking tests. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 雙層通風幕牆整合
history.text: 在建築外再加一層玻璃以形成緩衝空間的構想很早就出現，二十世紀初德國吉恩根的 Steiff 工廠常被引為早期例子；1990 年代起，歐洲在節能與高層自然通風的需求下大量採用雙層幕牆。由 Sauerbruch Hutton 設計、1995 至 1999 年施工的柏林 GSW 總部，以西向腔體作為對流井並在腔體內設可動穿孔金屬遮陽板；2003 年完工的倫敦聖瑪莉斧街 30 號以六道螺旋採光井協助自然通風，並每六層設防火隔斷；2009 年完工的溫尼伯曼尼托巴水電大樓則在嚴寒氣候中結合東西向雙層立面、中庭與太陽能煙囪，取得 LEED 白金級。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The idea of adding a second glass layer outside a building to form a buffer space appeared early, and the Steiff factory in Giengen, Germany, from the early twentieth century is often cited as an early example; from the 1990s Europe adopted double-skin façades widely in pursuit of energy savings and natural ventilation in tall buildings. The GSW headquarters in Berlin, designed by Sauerbruch Hutton and built from 1995 to 1999, uses its west cavity as a convection shaft with movable perforated-metal shading panels inside; 30 St Mary Axe in London, completed in 2003, uses six spiralling light wells to support natural ventilation, with fire breaks every sixth floor; and Manitoba Hydro Place in Winnipeg, completed in 2009, combines east and west double façades with atria and a solar chimney in a severe climate and achieved LEED Platinum. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 建築外牆氣密水密試驗
history.text: 外牆水密的現代理解來自「雨幕原理」：讓外層通氣、使腔體壓力接近外部，壓差由內側乾燥的空氣屏障承擔。北美在 ASTM E283、E331 與 AAMA 501 系列中建立了實驗室與現場試驗方法，歐洲則以 EN 12153、EN 12155 等標準與 EN 13830 分級。1980 至 2000 年代初英屬哥倫比亞沿海大量公寓漏水，1998 年 Barrett 委員會指出過度依賴表面密封的牆體，促成當地規範要求雨幕構造；2004 年啟用的麻省理工學院 Stata 中心在 2007 年因漏水等問題提起訴訟，2010 年和解；同年代完工的台北 101 則公開其外牆可承受約 95 mm 側向位移。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The modern understanding of façade watertightness comes from the rainscreen principle: vent the outer layer so cavity pressure approaches exterior pressure, leaving the pressure difference to a dry inner air barrier. North America established laboratory and field test methods in ASTM E283, E331 and the AAMA 501 series, while Europe uses standards such as EN 12153 and EN 12155 with classification under EN 13830. From the 1980s to the early 2000s large numbers of condominiums in coastal British Columbia leaked; in 1998 the Barrett Commission identified reliance on face-sealed walls, leading local codes to require rainscreen construction. MIT's Stata Center, opened in 2004, became the subject of a 2007 lawsuit over leaks and other problems, settled in 2010, while Taipei 101, completed in the same era, states publicly that its façade can take about 95 mm of lateral displacement. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超高層電梯分區與調度
history.titleEn: Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings
history.text: 1854 年 Elisha Otis 在紐約水晶宮展示安全煞車，使載人電梯得以普及，高樓從此能往上發展。1960 至 1970 年代興建的原世界貿易中心雙塔把每棟分成三段，以 44 與 78 樓空中大廳轉乘，確立超高層「直達穿梭加區間電梯」的分區模式；1990 年 Schindler 推出 Miconic 10 目的樓層派梯系統，把派梯決策移到乘客進入車廂之前。2000 年代之後，台北 101、上海中心大廈與廣州周大福金融中心相繼刷新電梯速度紀錄，碳纖維曳引索則挑戰單段行程限制。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In 1854 Elisha Otis demonstrated his safety brake at the New York Crystal Palace, making passenger lifts acceptable and letting buildings grow taller. The original World Trade Center towers, built in the 1960s and 1970s, split each tower into three tiers with sky lobbies on floors 44 and 78, establishing the supertall pattern of express shuttles plus local elevators; in 1990 Schindler launched Miconic 10, a destination-control system that moved the dispatch decision to before passengers board. Since the 2000s Taipei 101, Shanghai Tower and Guangzhou CTF Finance Centre have each set elevator speed records, and carbon-fibre hoisting ropes have challenged the single-run travel limit. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 工程數位模型碰撞檢查
history.text: 1970 年代 Charles Eastman 的建築描述系統提出以物件資料庫取代圖紙，1987 年 ArchiCAD 讓個人電腦能同時產生 2D 與 3D，1992 年「建築資訊模型」一詞出現在學術論文中。2007 年 Autodesk 收購英國 NavisWorks，其 Clash Detective 使多專業聯合模型的碰撞檢查成為營建常規；2009 年 Solibri、Tekla 與慕尼黑應用科技大學開始發展 BCF，以開放格式交換議題。英國於 2011 年要求公共工程在 2016 年達到 BIM Level 2，Crossrail 於 2008 至 2012 年建立整合資訊環境，ISO 19650 第 1、2 部則在 2018 年發布。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In the 1970s Charles Eastman's Building Description System proposed replacing drawings with an object database; in 1987 ArchiCAD let a personal computer produce both 2D and 3D, and in 1992 the term building information model appeared in an academic paper. In 2007 Autodesk acquired the UK firm NavisWorks, whose Clash Detective made multi-discipline federated clash checking routine in construction; in 2009 Solibri, Tekla and the Munich University of Applied Sciences began developing BCF to exchange issues in an open format. In 2011 the UK required public projects to reach BIM Level 2 by 2016, Crossrail built its integrated information environment from 2008 to 2012, and ISO 19650 Parts 1 and 2 were published in 2018. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 施工測量控制網
history.text: 最小二乘法由 Legendre 於 1805 年發表、Gauss 發展為測量平差的基礎，十九世紀的三角測量以此建立國家控制網。1950 年代電子測距儀問世，1970 年代全測站把測角、測距與記錄整合在一台儀器上；GPS 首顆衛星於 1978 年發射，1990 年代成為大範圍控制網的主力。1990 年英法海底隧道服務隧道在海底貫通，2010 年戈達基線隧道東管以公分級偏差貫通，顯示地面網、洞內導線與陀螺定向結合的成效；Crossrail 則把自動化全測站網路推到數百站的規模。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Legendre published the method of least squares in 1805 and Gauss developed it into the basis of survey adjustment, on which nineteenth-century triangulation built national control networks. Electronic distance measurement appeared in the 1950s, and in the 1970s total stations combined angles, distances and recording in one instrument; the first GPS satellite was launched in 1978 and by the 1990s GNSS had become the backbone of large control networks. The Channel Tunnel service tunnel broke through under the sea in 1990, and in 2010 the east tube of the Gotthard Base Tunnel broke through with centimetre-level deviation, showing the power of combining surface networks, underground traverses and gyro orientation; Crossrail then scaled automated total-station networks to hundreds of stations. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 建築雷射掃描竣工比對
history.text: 1990 年代 Ben Kacyra 等人開發可攜式雷射掃描儀 Cyrax，2001 年由徠卡測量系統收購，使地面雷射掃描逐漸進入測量與營建。非營利組織 CyArk 把掃描用於文化資產紀錄，2009 年掃描烏干達卡蘇比王陵，次年主陵毀於火災；Andrew Tallon 自 2010 年掃描巴黎聖母院，2019 年大火後成為修復參考。2011 年 ASTM 發布 E57 中立交換格式，2018 年 ISO 17123-9 訂定掃描儀現場檢定程序，USIBD 的 LOA 規範則提供指定與驗證精度的共同語言。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In the 1990s Ben Kacyra and colleagues developed the Cyrax portable laser scanner, acquired by Leica Geosystems in 2001, which helped bring terrestrial laser scanning into surveying and construction. The non-profit CyArk applied scanning to heritage records, scanning the Kasubi Tombs in Uganda in 2009 a year before their main tomb burned; Andrew Tallon scanned Notre-Dame de Paris from 2010, and his data became a reference for restoration after the 2019 fire. In 2011 ASTM published the neutral E57 exchange format, in 2018 ISO 17123-9 set field test procedures for scanners, and the USIBD LOA specification provides a common language for specifying and verifying accuracy. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 建築模組化吊裝與接合
history.text: 以工廠預製構件組成建築的想法由來已久，英國 1957 年成立的 CLASP 以預製系統大量興建學校；1967 年蒙特婁世界博覽會的 Habitat 67 由 Moshe Safdie 設計，以 354 個預製混凝土箱體堆疊成住宅群，成為體積模組的代表作。2010 年代模組建築往高層發展：紐約 461 Dean Street 於 2012 年動工、2016 年以 32 層開幕，當時被稱為世界最高的模組公寓；新加坡自 2014 年起要求部分政府售地住宅採用 PPVC，The Clement Canopy 以兩棟 40 層塔樓、1,866 個混凝土模組完成。2021 年 ICC 與模組建築協會發布 1200 與 1205 兩項異地建造標準。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The idea of assembling buildings from factory-made parts is old: CLASP, formed in England in 1957, built many schools from a prefabricated system, and Habitat 67, designed by Moshe Safdie for the 1967 Montreal Expo, stacked 354 precast concrete boxes into housing and became the emblem of volumetric construction. In the 2010s modular building went high-rise: 461 Dean Street in New York broke ground in 2012 and opened in 2016 at 32 storeys, billed at the time as the world's tallest modular apartment building, and Singapore required PPVC on selected Government Land Sales housing sites from 2014, with The Clement Canopy completed as two 40-storey towers from 1,866 concrete modules. In 2021 the ICC and the Modular Building Institute issued the off-site construction standards 1200 and 1205. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 瀨戶大橋橋群
related.transfer: 可遷移「桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速」與「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；瀨戶大橋橋群的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder" and "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seto Ohashi bridge network must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以數字深入明石海峽大橋：顫振裕度、高強度鋼絲、設置沉箱、地震後幾何修正與主纜乾燥空氣；瀨戶大橋橋群則以9.4 km 海峽上的六座公路鐵路兩用橋：橋型配置、連續懸索橋、共用錨碇、設置沉箱與預壘骨材混凝土為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on numbers behind Akashi Kaikyo: flutter margin, high-strength wire, laid-down caissons, post-quake geometry correction and dry-air cables; Seto Ohashi bridge network centres on six road–rail bridges across 9.4 km of strait: type selection, continuous suspension spans, a shared anchorage, placed caissons and prepacked concrete, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」與「海峽段 9.4 km 橋型配置」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到瀨戶大橋橋群，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「預組量測與誤差累積控制」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Truss flutter margin” and “Type layout over 9.4 km”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seto Ohashi bridge network, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Trial-assembly survey and error accumulation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 大貝爾特東橋

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」與「東航道船舶撞擊」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大貝爾特東橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Truss flutter margin” and “East Channel ship impact”.

related.title: 橋梁頂推施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全」與「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁頂推施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Valley wind and traffic safety" and "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Incremental bridge launching must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以高墩、多跨斜張與鋼箱梁頂推，在 270 公尺高的河谷上完成 2,460 公尺連續橋面；橋梁頂推施工則以以導梁、中心預力、滑移支承與高程控制，讓整條連續梁從橋台後方一段段推過每一座橋墩為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tall piers, multi-span cable stays and a launched steel box deck delivering a 2,460 m continuous deck about 270 m above a valley; Incremental bridge launching centres on launching nose, centric prestress, sliding bearings and level control that let a continuous girder be pushed segment by segment over every pier from behind the abutment, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「橋面風屏」與「導梁前端懸臂彎矩」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁頂推施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「支承高程偏差與反力量測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck wind screens” and “Front cantilever moment with nose”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Incremental bridge launching, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Support level deviations and reaction measurement", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tall piers, multi-span cable stays and a launched steel box deck delivering a 2,460 m continuous deck about 270 m above a valley; Queensferry Crossing centres on A three-tower cable-stayed bridge whose mid-span crossing stays stabilise the central tower, with wind shielding, monitoring and access for all-weather service, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「橋面風屏」與「中塔塔頂」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck wind screens” and “Central tower head”.

related.title: 大貝爾特東橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「零阻水要求與海峽環境」與「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大貝爾特東橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on building a double-deck road–rail cable-stayed crossing by full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection under a zero-blocking constraint; Great Belt East Bridge centres on A strait suspension bridge whose span was set by ship-collision risk, whose box girder needed guide vanes against vortex shedding, and whose cables were dehumidified for long life, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「橋墩阻水斷面」與「東航道船舶撞擊」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Pier blockage cross-section” and “East Channel ship impact”.

related.title: 港珠澳大橋橋梁段
related.transfer: 可遷移「零阻水要求與海峽環境」與「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；港珠澳大橋橋梁段的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.transfer: 可遷移「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」與「1932 年機車載重試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；新河峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch" and "The 1932 locomotive load test" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of New River Gorge Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 503 公尺雙鉸鋼拱、錨碇鋼索懸臂架設與六百萬顆鉚釘，承載公路與鐵路跨越雪梨港；新河峽大橋則以以耐候鋼兩鉸桁架拱、峽谷纜索吊運與背拉懸臂架設，跨越 267 公尺深的峽谷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on carrying road and rail across Sydney Harbour on a 503 m two-hinged steel arch erected by cable-anchored cantilevering and joined by six million rivets; New River Gorge Bridge centres on spanning a gorge 267 m deep with a weathering-steel two-hinged truss arch erected by gorge cableway and tieback cantilevering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

以「線形量測與溫度修正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。

related.difference: 本課聚焦以 503 公尺雙鉸鋼拱、錨碇鋼索懸臂架設與六百萬顆鉚釘，承載公路與鐵路跨越雪梨港；鋼拱橋拱肋合龍則以從懸臂半拱到完整拱的體系轉換：扣索控制、溫度窗口、合龍段接合與卸載監測為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Two-hinged arch bearings” and “System change at closure”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Steel arch rib closure, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "System transfer and tieback release monitoring", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 雪梨港灣大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「合龍的力學意義」與「體系轉換與扣索卸載監測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；雪梨港灣大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "What closure means structurally" and "System transfer and tieback release monitoring" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sydney Harbour Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從懸臂半拱到完整拱的體系轉換：扣索控制、溫度窗口、合龍段接合與卸載監測；雪梨港灣大橋則以以 503 公尺雙鉸鋼拱、錨碇鋼索懸臂架設與六百萬顆鉚釘，承載公路與鐵路跨越雪梨港為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the system change from cantilevered half-arches to a complete arch: tieback control, temperature windows, closure joints and release monitoring; Sydney Harbour Bridge centres on carrying road and rail across Sydney Harbour on a 503 m two-hinged steel arch erected by cable-anchored cantilevering and joined by six million rivets, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「合龍前後的體系轉換」與「雙鉸拱支承」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雪梨港灣大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「1932 年機車載重試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “System change at closure” and “Two-hinged arch bearings”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sydney Harbour Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The 1932 locomotive load test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 新河峽大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「合龍的力學意義」與「體系轉換與扣索卸載監測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；新河峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "What closure means structurally" and "System transfer and tieback release monitoring" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of New River Gorge Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從懸臂半拱到完整拱的體系轉換：扣索控制、溫度窗口、合龍段接合與卸載監測；新河峽大橋則以以耐候鋼兩鉸桁架拱、峽谷纜索吊運與背拉懸臂架設，跨越 267 公尺深的峽谷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the system change from cantilevered half-arches to a complete arch: tieback control, temperature windows, closure joints and release monitoring; New River Gorge Bridge centres on spanning a gorge 267 m deep with a weathering-steel two-hinged truss arch erected by gorge cableway and tieback cantilevering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「合龍前後的體系轉換」與「兩鉸桁架拱推力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到新河峽大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「線形量測與溫度修正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “System change at closure” and “Two-hinged truss-arch thrust”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to New River Gorge Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Geometry surveys and temperature correction", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
related.transfer: 可遷移「懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁」與「線形測量與預拱回饋控制」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder" and "Geometry survey and camber feedback" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Span-by-span precast bridge erection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以墩頂不平衡彎矩、懸臂預力與預拱線形控制，安全地由橋墩兩側對稱長出長跨箱梁；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設則以以架橋機整跨懸吊預鑄節塊、一次張拉體外鋼腱，讓長距離高架橋以每跨數天的節奏重複推進為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on unbalanced pier moment, cantilever prestress and camber control that let a long-span box girder grow symmetrically from each pier; Span-by-span precast bridge erection centres on hanging a whole span of precast segments from a gantry and stressing external tendons at once, so long viaducts advance at a few days per span, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「墩頂變高度箱梁」與「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Haunched box girder at the pier” and “Whole-span box and external tendons”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Span-by-span precast bridge erection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Short-line match casting and curve control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁頂推施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁」與「線形測量與預拱回饋控制」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁頂推施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder" and "Geometry survey and camber feedback" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Incremental bridge launching must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以墩頂不平衡彎矩、懸臂預力與預拱線形控制，安全地由橋墩兩側對稱長出長跨箱梁；橋梁頂推施工則以以導梁、中心預力、滑移支承與高程控制，讓整條連續梁從橋台後方一段段推過每一座橋墩為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on unbalanced pier moment, cantilever prestress and camber control that let a long-span box girder grow symmetrically from each pier; Incremental bridge launching centres on launching nose, centric prestress, sliding bearings and level control that let a continuous girder be pushed segment by segment over every pier from behind the abutment, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「墩頂變高度箱梁」與「導梁前端懸臂彎矩」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁頂推施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「支承高程偏差與反力量測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Haunched box girder at the pier” and “Front cantilever moment with nose”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Incremental bridge launching, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Support level deviations and reaction measurement", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」與「短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection" and "Short-line match casting and curve control" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以架橋機整跨懸吊預鑄節塊、一次張拉體外鋼腱，讓長距離高架橋以每跨數天的節奏重複推進；橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工則以以墩頂不平衡彎矩、懸臂預力與預拱線形控制，安全地由橋墩兩側對稱長出長跨箱梁為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hanging a whole span of precast segments from a gantry and stressing external tendons at once, so long viaducts advance at a few days per span; Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction centres on unbalanced pier moment, cantilever prestress and camber control that let a long-span box girder grow symmetrically from each pier, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」與「墩頂變高度箱梁」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「線形測量與預拱回饋控制」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Whole-span box and external tendons” and “Haunched box girder at the pier”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Geometry survey and camber feedback", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 預力混凝土孔道灌漿
related.transfer: 可遷移「逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求」與「短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；預力混凝土孔道灌漿的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection" and "Short-line match casting and curve control" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Prestressing-duct grouting must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以架橋機整跨懸吊預鑄節塊、一次張拉體外鋼腱，讓長距離高架橋以每跨數天的節奏重複推進；預力混凝土孔道灌漿則以以灌漿材料、孔道與排氣配置、灌漿程序與空洞檢測，確保後拉預力鋼腱數十年不腐蝕為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hanging a whole span of precast segments from a gantry and stressing external tendons at once, so long viaducts advance at a few days per span; Prestressing-duct grouting centres on grout materials, duct and vent layout, grouting procedure and void detection that keep post-tensioning tendons free of corrosion for decades, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」與「鋼腱有效預力 P_e」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到預力混凝土孔道灌漿，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Whole-span box and external tendons” and “Tendon effective force P_e”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Prestressing-duct grouting, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Grout testing and field mock-ups", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 米約高架橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「交變彎矩與導梁的作用」與「支承高程偏差與反力量測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；米約高架橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Alternating moments and the role of the nose" and "Support level deviations and reaction measurement" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Millau Viaduct must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以導梁、中心預力、滑移支承與高程控制，讓整條連續梁從橋台後方一段段推過每一座橋墩；米約高架橋則以以高墩、多跨斜張與鋼箱梁頂推，在 270 公尺高的河谷上完成 2,460 公尺連續橋面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on launching nose, centric prestress, sliding bearings and level control that let a continuous girder be pushed segment by segment over every pier from behind the abutment; Millau Viaduct centres on tall piers, multi-span cable stays and a launched steel box deck delivering a 2,460 m continuous deck about 270 m above a valley, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「導梁前端懸臂彎矩」與「橋面風屏」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到米約高架橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Front cantilever moment with nose” and “Deck wind screens”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Millau Viaduct, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transfer: 可遷移「轉體工法的系統與適用情境」與「轉動前稱重試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "System logic and where rotation fits" and "Pre-rotation weighing test" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以球鉸承壓、重心平衡、摩擦力矩與牽引控制，把在障礙物旁建好的萬噸級橋體安全轉到設計軸線；橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工則以以墩頂不平衡彎矩、懸臂預力與預拱線形控制，安全地由橋墩兩側對稱長出長跨箱梁為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on spherical-hinge bearing, centre-of-gravity balance, friction torque and traction control that swing a structure of thousands of tonnes from beside an obstacle onto its design axis; Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction centres on unbalanced pier moment, cantilever prestress and camber control that let a long-span box girder grow symmetrically from each pier, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「轉動 T 構與跨越線」與「墩頂變高度箱梁」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Rotating T-frame and the crossing line” and “Haunched box girder at the pier”.

Using "Geometry survey and camber feedback", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on spherical-hinge bearing, centre-of-gravity balance, friction torque and traction control that swing a structure of thousands of tonnes from beside an obstacle onto its design axis; SPMT bridge replacement centres on support-point changes, axle-line capacity, ground bearing and closure-window control that let SPMTs remove an old span and set a whole new one within hours, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

related.title: 鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復
related.transfer: 可遷移「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」與「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" and "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以面板厚度、肋—面板部分滲透焊、焊接變形與組裝精度控制，製作能承受數億次輪載的輕量鋼橋面；鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復則以由細節類別、應力範圍與斷裂力學判斷鋼橋裂縫的風險，選擇止裂孔、錘擊或拼接補強並訂定追蹤週期為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deck-plate thickness, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, distortion and fit-up control that produce a light steel deck able to survive hundreds of millions of wheel passes; Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair centres on judging steel-bridge crack risk from detail category, stress range and fracture mechanics, then choosing arrest holes, peening or splices and setting follow-up intervals, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」與「蓋板端部焊趾」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” and “Cover-plate end weld toe”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋面超高性能混凝土接縫
related.transfer: 可遷移「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」與「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋面超高性能混凝土接縫的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" and "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of UHPC bridge-deck closure joints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以面板厚度、肋—面板部分滲透焊、焊接變形與組裝精度控制，製作能承受數億次輪載的輕量鋼橋面；橋面超高性能混凝土接縫則以以超高性能混凝土的短搭接、介面處理與品質驗收，讓預鑄橋面板接縫窄、快且不漏水為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deck-plate thickness, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, distortion and fit-up control that produce a light steel deck able to survive hundreds of millions of wheel passes; UHPC bridge-deck closure joints centres on short lap splices, interface preparation and acceptance testing that make UHPC joints between precast deck elements narrow, fast and watertight, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」與「接縫介面彎曲應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋面超高性能混凝土接縫，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” and “Joint-interface flexural stress”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to UHPC bridge-deck closure joints, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Material acceptance testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦以支承點改變、軸線容量、地盤承載與封閉時段控制，用自行式模組運輸車在數小時內移除舊橋並放上整跨新橋；橋梁轉體施工則以以球鉸承壓、重心平衡、摩擦力矩與牽引控制，把在障礙物旁建好的萬噸級橋體安全轉到設計軸線為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Period shift and load path" and "Prototype and production testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Spherical bridge-bearing installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以鉛心屈服強度、橡膠側向勁度與等效阻尼，拉長橋梁週期並把位移集中在可檢查的支承；球面支承安裝則以以約束配置、轉角與摩擦力矩、預設偏移與灌漿墊層，讓球面支承如設計般轉動與滑動為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on lead-core yield strength, rubber lateral stiffness and equivalent damping that lengthen the bridge period and concentrate displacement in inspectable bearings; Spherical bridge-bearing installation centres on restraint layout, rotation and friction moment, presetting and bedding grout so a spherical bearing rotates and slides as designed, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「隔震週期 T_eff」與「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到球面支承安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「型式試驗與出廠檢驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Isolated period T_eff” and “Fixed, guided and free layout”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Spherical bridge-bearing installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Type testing and factory inspection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 既有建築基礎隔震改造
related.transfer: 可遷移「週期移轉與荷載路徑」與「原型試驗與量產試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；既有建築基礎隔震改造的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Period shift and load path" and "Prototype and production testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以鉛心屈服強度、橡膠側向勁度與等效阻尼，拉長橋梁週期並把位移集中在可檢查的支承；既有建築基礎隔震改造則以以隔震層延長週期、托換構件轉移荷載、分段頂升施工與性質上下限檢核，保護歷史建築免於地震損傷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on lead-core yield strength, rubber lateral stiffness and equivalent damping that lengthen the bridge period and concentrate displacement in inspectable bearings; Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings centres on period lengthening, load-transfer members, staged jacking and property bounds that protect historic buildings from earthquake damage, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「隔震週期 T_eff」與「隔震層週期」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到既有建築基礎隔震改造，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Isolated period T_eff” and “Isolated period”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.title: FHWA 鋼橋設計手冊：支承設計（FHWA-HIF-16-002 第 15 冊）

references.scopeEn: U.S. Federal Highway Administration handbook on bearing design and detailing practice, written to AASHTO LRFD, used here as a design-process reference.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 橋墩纖維複材耐震補強
related.titleEn: FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers
related.transfer: 可遷移「容量設計與破壞層級」與「擬靜態反覆載重試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋墩纖維複材耐震補強的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Capacity design and failure hierarchy" and "Quasi-static cyclic column testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以容量設計、圍束箍筋與塑鉸轉角，讓橋墩在大地震中延展變形而不剪斷或倒塌；橋墩纖維複材耐震補強則以以環向纖維複材套管提供圍束、剪力與搭接夾持，補足舊橋墩的韌性缺陷而不增加彎矩強度為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on capacity design, confinement and plastic-hinge rotation that let piers deform in a major earthquake without shear failure or collapse; FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers centres on hoop-direction FRP jackets that add confinement, shear strength and splice clamping to old piers without raising flexural strength, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「超強度彎矩 M_o」與「舊橋墩三種缺陷」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋墩纖維複材耐震補強，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Overstrength moment M_o” and “Three deficiencies of old piers”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Capacity design and failure hierarchy" and "Quasi-static cyclic column testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以容量設計、圍束箍筋與塑鉸轉角，讓橋墩在大地震中延展變形而不剪斷或倒塌；鉛心橡膠支承隔震則以以鉛心屈服強度、橡膠側向勁度與等效阻尼，拉長橋梁週期並把位移集中在可檢查的支承為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on capacity design, confinement and plastic-hinge rotation that let piers deform in a major earthquake without shear failure or collapse; Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation centres on lead-core yield strength, rubber lateral stiffness and equivalent damping that lengthen the bridge period and concentrate displacement in inspectable bearings, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「超強度彎矩 M_o」與「隔震週期 T_eff」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鉛心橡膠支承隔震，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗與量產試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Overstrength moment M_o” and “Isolated period T_eff”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Prototype and production testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.scopeEn: Owner's public exhibit page on isolator construction, size and force-reduction effect.

references.title: 第 13 屆世界地震工程會議：以隔震系統改造斜張橋（集鹿大橋）
references.titleEn: 13th World Conference on Earthquake Engineering: Cable-stayed bridge retrofit using isolation system (Chi-Lu Bridge)
references.scope: 以數值分析評估集鹿大橋採鉛心橡膠支承隔震改造的研究論文，含 921 地震損傷與測站紀錄；屬研究，非施工文件。
references.scopeEn: Research paper numerically assessing lead-rubber isolation retrofit of the Chi-Lu Bridge, with 921 earthquake damage and station records; research, not construction documents.

references.scopeEn: Popular account of the lead-rubber bearing's invention and applications, for further reading.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 橋墩塑鉸韌性設計
related.titleEn: Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers
related.transfer: 可遷移「舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略」與「黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy" and "Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以環向纖維複材套管提供圍束、剪力與搭接夾持，補足舊橋墩的韌性缺陷而不增加彎矩強度；橋墩塑鉸韌性設計則以以容量設計、圍束箍筋與塑鉸轉角，讓橋墩在大地震中延展變形而不剪斷或倒塌為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hoop-direction FRP jackets that add confinement, shear strength and splice clamping to old piers without raising flexural strength; Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers centres on capacity design, confinement and plastic-hinge rotation that let piers deform in a major earthquake without shear failure or collapse, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「舊橋墩三種缺陷」與「超強度彎矩 M_o」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋墩塑鉸韌性設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「擬靜態反覆載重試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Three deficiencies of old piers” and “Overstrength moment M_o”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Quasi-static cyclic column testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 既有建築基礎隔震改造
related.transfer: 可遷移「舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略」與「黏結拉拔、脫層與試片驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；既有建築基礎隔震改造的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy" and "Bond pull-off, delamination and witness-panel acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以環向纖維複材套管提供圍束、剪力與搭接夾持，補足舊橋墩的韌性缺陷而不增加彎矩強度；既有建築基礎隔震改造則以以隔震層延長週期、托換構件轉移荷載、分段頂升施工與性質上下限檢核，保護歷史建築免於地震損傷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on hoop-direction FRP jackets that add confinement, shear strength and splice clamping to old piers without raising flexural strength; Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings centres on period lengthening, load-transfer members, staged jacking and property bounds that protect historic buildings from earthquake damage, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「舊橋墩三種缺陷」與「隔震層週期」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到既有建築基礎隔震改造，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Three deficiencies of old piers” and “Isolated period”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Base-isolation retrofit of existing buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.title: 美國混凝土學會 ACI PRC-440.2-17 外貼纖維複材補強設計與施工指引
references.titleEn: ACI PRC-440.2-17 Guide for the Design and Construction of Externally Bonded FRP Systems
references.scope: 標準制定機構的產品頁，說明指引範圍含撓曲、剪力、軸向與耐震圍束補強；已標示有更新版本。
references.scopeEn: Standards-body product page describing the guide's scope covering flexure, shear, axial and seismic confinement strengthening; marked as superseded by a newer version.

references.title: Fyfe FRP 案例：I-84 跨越橋柱塑鉸區包覆
references.titleEn: Fyfe FRP case study: I-84 Bridge Overpass column hinge-zone wrapping
references.scope: 材料供應商的案例頁，說明補強原因、塑鉸區範圍、柱數與尺寸及長期表現；屬廠商資料，非設計文件。
references.scopeEn: Supplier case study giving the retrofit reason, hinge-zone extent, column count and size and long-term performance; vendor material, not design documents.

references.title: Fyfe FRP 案例：Fort Mason 市立碼頭沉箱補強
references.titleEn: Fyfe FRP case study: Fort Mason Municipal Pier strengthening
references.scope: 說明約 250 支沉箱以預製套管、濕式積層與灌漿補強圍束與剪力的施工方式。
references.scopeEn: Describes about 250 caissons strengthened for confinement and shear with prefabricated jackets, wet lay-up and grout.

references.title: Fyfe FRP 案例：加州橋柱剪力補強（Caltrans 跨越橋）
references.titleEn: Fyfe FRP case study: California bridge column shear enhancement (Caltrans overpasses)
references.scope: 說明三座 Caltrans 跨越橋剪力不足矩形柱以碳纖維全高包覆取代鋼板套管。
references.scopeEn: Describes shear-deficient rectangular columns of three Caltrans overpasses wrapped full height with carbon FRP instead of steel jackets.

references.title: 維基百科：耐震補強（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Seismic retrofit
references.scope: 耐震補強方法概覽，含高架橋柱套管與阪神、賽普勒斯案例背景，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of retrofit methods including viaduct column jacketing and the Kobe and Cypress background, for further reading.

references.title: 加州運輸局耐震設計準則 2.1 版
references.titleEn: Caltrans Seismic Design Criteria Version 2.1
references.scope: 現行耐震設計準則，定義超強度彎矩與剪力、塑鉸長度、圍束與能力保護；課程僅引用公開原則。
references.scopeEn: Current seismic design criteria defining overstrength moment and shear, plastic-hinge length, confinement and capacity protection; the course cites public principles only.

references.title: 加州運輸局耐震設計準則 1.7 版
references.titleEn: Caltrans Seismic Design Criteria Version 1.7
references.scope: 前版準則，列出位移韌性需求與容量限值、最小側向強度、P-Δ 檢核與主筋比限制。
references.scopeEn: Previous edition listing displacement-ductility demand and capacity limits, minimum lateral strength, P-Δ check and longitudinal-steel limits.

references.title: PEER 結構性能資料庫（鋼筋混凝土柱反覆載重試驗）

references.scopeEn: University research-centre database of column tests with geometry, materials, reinforcement, axial load and force–displacement histories for model calibration.

references.title: 維基百科：賽普勒斯街高架橋（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Cypress Street Viaduct
references.scope: 高架橋歷史、1989 年崩塌原因與改線重建概要，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of the viaduct's history, the causes of its 1989 collapse and its realignment, for further reading.

references.title: 維基百科：1999 年集集地震（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: 1999 Jiji earthquake
references.scope: 921 地震規模、傷亡與橋梁受損數量概要，作為延伸閱讀；工程細節以官方與研究資料為準。
references.scopeEn: Overview of the Chi-Chi earthquake's magnitude, casualties and bridge damage count, for further reading; rely on official and research sources for engineering detail.

references.title: Forell/Elsesser：基礎隔震專業與代表專案
references.titleEn: Forell/Elsesser: Base isolation expertise and key projects
references.scope: 設計者說明其隔震經驗與鹽湖城市郡大樓、奧克蘭市政府、舊金山市政府等改造案的定位；不含設計參數。
references.scopeEn: Designer's page on its isolation experience and the significance of the Salt Lake City and County Building, Oakland City Hall and San Francisco City Hall retrofits; no design parameters.

references.title: Forell/Elsesser：舊金山市政府耐震改造
references.titleEn: Forell/Elsesser: San Francisco City Hall seismic retrofit
references.scope: 專案頁說明建築規模、Loma Prieta 地震損傷、切柱頂升數量與施工排序考量。
references.scopeEn: Project page on building size, Loma Prieta damage, the number of columns cut and jacked, and construction sequencing.

references.title: Forell/Elsesser：猶他州議會大廈耐震改造
references.titleEn: Forell/Elsesser: Utah State Capitol seismic retrofit
references.scope: 專案頁說明隔震器數量、側移能力、後拉預力托換梁與荷載轉移量。
references.scopeEn: Project page on isolator count, displacement capacity, post-tensioned transfer girders and the load transferred.

references.title: 維基百科：鹽湖城市郡大樓（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Salt Lake City and County Building
references.scope: 建築歷史、隔震改造與 2020 年地震後表現的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of the building's history, isolation retrofit and performance in the 2020 earthquake, for further reading.

references.title: 國家地震工程研究中心：雙軸向動態測試系統直接剪力量測
references.titleEn: NCREE: Direct shear measurement for the Bi-Axial Testing System
references.publisher: National Center for Research on Earthquake Engineering
references.scope: 說明 BATS 可同時施加高軸壓與快速水平運動並用於隔震元件試驗，以及力量測的修正方法。
references.scopeEn: Explains that BATS applies high axial load with fast horizontal motion for isolator testing, and how its force measurement is corrected.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 橋梁健康監測感測網
related.transfer: 可遷移「沖刷分量與洪水荷載路徑」與「即時監測資料與警戒判斷」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁健康監測感測網的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Scour components and the flood load path" and "Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以沖刷深度估算、基礎暴露評估、固定式感測器與行動計畫，在洪峰期間判斷何時封橋；橋梁健康監測感測網則以從監測問題反推感測器種類、位置、取樣與同步，並把資料變成可行動的警戒與維護決策為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on scour-depth estimation, foundation-exposure assessment, fixed sensors and plans of action that decide when to close a bridge during a flood peak; Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges centres on working back from monitoring questions to sensor types, locations, sampling and synchronisation, and turning data into actionable alerts and maintenance decisions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「總沖刷深度三分量」與「監測目標清單」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁健康監測感測網，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「模態識別與環境效應分離」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Three components of total scour” and “Monitoring objectives list”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Modal identification and environmental effects", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁動態荷重試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「沖刷分量與洪水荷載路徑」與「即時監測資料與警戒判斷」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁動態荷重試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Scour components and the flood load path" and "Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Dynamic bridge load testing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以沖刷深度估算、基礎暴露評估、固定式感測器與行動計畫，在洪峰期間判斷何時封橋；橋梁動態荷重試驗則以以受控的車輛、人群與激振試驗量出實際動力放大、頻率與阻尼，並把結果轉成評等與舒適度決策為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on scour-depth estimation, foundation-exposure assessment, fixed sensors and plans of action that decide when to close a bridge during a flood peak; Dynamic bridge load testing centres on measuring actual dynamic amplification, frequency and damping with controlled vehicle, crowd and shaker tests, and turning the results into rating and comfort decisions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「總沖刷深度三分量」與「動力放大係數」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁動態荷重試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Three components of total scour” and “Dynamic amplification factor”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Dynamic bridge load testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.title: FHWA HEC-18：橋梁沖刷評估（第 5 版，FHWA-HIF-12-003）
references.titleEn: FHWA HEC-18: Evaluating Scour at Bridges, 5th edition (FHWA-HIF-12-003)
references.scope: 美國聯邦公路總署的沖刷評估手冊，含長期、束縮與局部沖刷計算方法及行動計畫章節。
references.scopeEn: U.S. Federal Highway Administration scour evaluation manual covering long-term, contraction and local scour methods and plans of action.

references.title: FHWA HEC-23：橋梁沖刷與河道不穩定保護工（第 3 版第 1 冊）
references.titleEn: FHWA HEC-23: Bridge Scour and Stream Instability Countermeasures, 3rd edition, Volume 1
references.scope: 保護工選擇與設計指引，含攜帶式與固定式沖刷監測儀器、行動計畫範本與案例。
references.scopeEn: Countermeasure selection and design guidance including portable and fixed scour monitors, the plan-of-action template and case histories.

references.title: NCHRP 第 396 號報告：橋墩與橋台沖刷量測儀器
references.titleEn: NCHRP Report 396: Instrumentation for Measuring Scour at Bridge Piers and Abutments
references.scope: 以實驗室與多州現地測試評估聲納、磁性滑環、浮出式等儀器的精度與耐用性。
references.scopeEn: Laboratory and multi-state field evaluation of the accuracy and durability of sonar, magnetic sliding collar, float-out and other instruments.

references.title: 維基百科：后豐大橋
references.titleEn: Wikipedia (Chinese): Houfeng Bridge
references.scope: 2008 年斷橋經過、調查推論原因與重建時程，作為延伸閱讀；工程細節以主管機關資料為準。
references.scopeEn: The 2008 collapse, investigators' likely cause and the rebuilding schedule, for further reading; rely on agency sources for engineering detail.

references.title: 維基百科：高屏大橋
references.titleEn: Wikipedia (Chinese): Kaoping Bridge
references.scope: 舊橋完工年份、2000 年斷橋的橋墩編號、傷亡與新橋長度概要，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Old-bridge completion year, the piers lost in 2000, casualties and the new bridge's length, for further reading.

references.title: 明尼蘇達州交通部：I-35W St. Anthony Falls 橋概述
references.titleEn: MnDOT: I-35W St. Anthony Falls Bridge overview
references.scope: 業主說明新橋內建感測與監測系統、高性能混凝土、339 天統包工期與 100 年設計壽命；未列感測器細目。
references.scopeEn: Owner's description of the built-in sensor and monitoring system, high-performance concrete, 339-day design–build and 100-year design life; no sensor details.

references.title: 加州運輸局研究摘要：極端事件橋梁快速評估中心（BRACE2）
references.titleEn: Caltrans research note: Bridge Rapid Assessment Center for Extreme Events (BRACE2)
references.scope: 說明收費橋梁強震儀資料流、Hayward 試辦橋的即時傳輸、OpenSees 模型與易損性評估平台的進度。
references.scopeEn: Describes toll-bridge strong-motion data flow, real-time transfer from the Hayward trial bridge, the OpenSees model and the fragility-based assessment platform.

references.title: 工程強震資料中心（CESMD）
references.titleEn: Center for Engineering Strong Motion Data (CESMD)
references.publisher: Center for Engineering Strong Motion Data
references.scope: 提供地震事件與特定結構測站的強震紀錄查詢，可了解結構監測資料如何公開與交換。
references.scopeEn: Portal for strong-motion records by earthquake and by instrumented structure, showing how structural monitoring data are published and exchanged.

references.title: 維基百科：風與結構健康監測系統（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System
references.scope: 香港四座橋的監測項目與各橋感測器數量概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of measurands and sensor counts on the four Hong Kong bridges, for further reading.

references.title: 維基百科：I-35W St. Anthony Falls 橋（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: I-35W Saint Anthony Falls Bridge
references.scope: 新橋跨徑、通車日期與約 323 個感測器的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of spans, opening date and the roughly 323 sensors of the new bridge, for further reading.

references.title: TRB：橋梁載重試驗入門（E-C257）
references.titleEn: TRB: Primer on Bridge Load Testing (Transportation Research Circular E-C257)
references.scope: 說明診斷、驗證與動態試驗的目的、動力載重容許值、慢速試驗與資料擷取規劃；課程計算另為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Explains the aims of diagnostic, proof and dynamic tests, the dynamic load allowance, crawl-speed testing and data-acquisition planning; course calculations are separate teaching assumptions.

references.title: Arup：倫敦千禧橋專案
references.titleEn: Arup: Millennium Bridge project
references.scope: 設計者說明側向振動的正回饋機制、受控人群試驗、加裝阻尼裝置與 2,000 人驗證試驗。
references.scopeEn: Designer's account of the positive-feedback lateral vibration, controlled crowd tests, added damping devices and the 2,000-person verification test.

references.title: 華盛頓州交通部：塔科馬海峽橋歷史
references.titleEn: WSDOT: Tacoma Narrows Bridge history
references.scope: 業主的歷史頁，記載 1940 年橋梁通車與倒塌日期及其對懸索橋設計的影響。
references.scopeEn: Owner's history pages recording the 1940 opening and collapse dates and their influence on suspension-bridge design.

references.title: 維基百科：倫敦千禧橋（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Millennium Bridge, London
references.scope: 跨徑、開放與封閉日期、人群數量、阻尼器數量與重新開放日期的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of spans, opening and closure dates, crowd numbers, damper counts and reopening date, for further reading.

references.title: 維基百科：雪梨港灣大橋（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Sydney Harbour Bridge
references.scope: 1932 年機車載重試驗與開放日期的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of the 1932 locomotive load test and opening date, for further reading.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 明石海峽大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「設計風速與風場特性」與「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；明石海峽大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics" and "Spring-mounted section-model testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Akashi Kaikyo Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以設計風速、相似律、節段與全橋模型試驗，確認長跨橋梁在渦振、馳振與顫振前保有足夠風速餘裕；明石海峽大橋則以以數字深入明石海峽大橋：顫振裕度、高強度鋼絲、設置沉箱、地震後幾何修正與主纜乾燥空氣為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on design wind speed, similitude and section and full-bridge model tests that confirm long-span bridges keep enough margin against vortex shedding, galloping and flutter; Akashi Kaikyo Bridge centres on numbers behind Akashi Kaikyo: flutter margin, high-strength wire, laid-down caissons, post-quake geometry correction and dry-air cables, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「橋面高度設計風速」與「桁架加勁梁顫振裕度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到明石海峽大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck-level design wind speed” and “Truss flutter margin”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 斜張索雨風振動抑制
related.titleEn: Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables
related.transfer: 可遷移「設計風速與風場特性」與「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；斜張索雨風振動抑制的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics" and "Spring-mounted section-model testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以設計風速、相似律、節段與全橋模型試驗，確認長跨橋梁在渦振、馳振與顫振前保有足夠風速餘裕；斜張索雨風振動抑制則以以水線氣動機制、史庫頓數、表面處理、阻尼器與交叉索，診斷並抑制斜索的雨風振動為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on design wind speed, similitude and section and full-bridge model tests that confirm long-span bridges keep enough margin against vortex shedding, galloping and flutter; Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables centres on diagnosing and suppressing rain–wind stay vibration through rivulet aerodynamics, Scruton number, surface treatment, dampers and cross-ties, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「橋面高度設計風速」與「上緣水線」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到斜張索雨風振動抑制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「現場監測：同步記錄振動、風與雨」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deck-level design wind speed” and “Upper water rivulet”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Field monitoring: synchronised vibration, wind and rain", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.title: 本州四國連絡高速道路：明石海峽大橋技術資料
references.titleEn: Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Expressway: Akashi-Kaikyo Bridge
references.scope: 業主頁面，列出跨徑、基本與設計風速、全橋模型風洞試驗與施工期程；不含試驗數據。
references.scopeEn: Owner page listing spans, basic and design wind speeds, full-model wind-tunnel testing and the construction period; no test data.

references.title: 華盛頓州交通部：塔科馬海峽橋歷史
references.titleEn: Washington State DOT: Tacoma Narrows Bridge history
references.scope: 業主的歷史頁，記錄 1940 年橋的通車與崩塌日期及 1950 年替代橋；工程細節以延伸資料補充。
references.scopeEn: Owner's history page recording the 1940 bridge's opening and collapse dates and the 1950 replacement; engineering detail comes from further reading.

references.title: 維基百科：塔科馬海峽橋（1940 年，英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Tacoma Narrows Bridge (1940)
references.scope: 斷面尺寸、崩塌風速、Farquharson 模型試驗與調查委員會的概要，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of section dimensions, collapse wind speed, Farquharson's model tests and the investigating board, for further reading.

references.title: 維基百科：伏爾加格勒大橋（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Volgograd Bridge
references.scope: 2010 年封橋與 2011 年加裝半主動調諧質量阻尼器的概要，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of the 2010 closure and the 2011 installation of semi-active tuned mass dampers, for further reading.

references.title: 本州四國連絡高速道路：長大橋上部結構維護技術
references.titleEn: Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Expressway: Maintenance technology for long-span bridge superstructures
references.scope: 營運單位說明主纜乾燥空氣系統的 40% 濕度目標、吊索尾流振動與纏絲對策、磁通檢測與塗裝策略。
references.scopeEn: Operator page on the 40% humidity target of dry-air cable injection, hanger wake vibration and helical-wire countermeasure, magnetic-flux inspection and coating strategy.

references.title: 本州四國連絡高速道路：材料開發（高強度鋼絲與水中混凝土）
references.titleEn: Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Expressway: Development of materials (high-strength wire and underwater concrete)
references.scope: 說明 180 kgf/mm² 鋼絲讓每側只需一條主纜，以及水中不分離混凝土與低熱水泥的開發背景。
references.scopeEn: Explains how 180 kgf/mm² wire allowed one cable per side, and the background of non-segregating underwater concrete and low-heat cement.

references.title: 明石海峽大橋耐震設計與兵庫縣南部地震時的行為（WCEE 論文）
references.titleEn: Seismic design and behaviour during the Hyogo-ken Nanbu earthquake of the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge (WCEE paper)
references.publisher: World Conference on Earthquake Engineering (authors from the Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Authority)
references.scope: 業主技術人員撰寫的地震行為報告：基礎位移、跨徑變化、桁段加長量、垂度與張力變化；本課計算另為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Owner engineers' report on foundation movement, span change, truss lengthening, sag and tension changes; course calculations are separate teaching assumptions.

references.title: 明石海峽大橋主塔基礎大型鋼沉箱水中混凝土的自動化施工（ISARC 論文）
references.titleEn: Automation and robotics of underwater concreting in the huge steel caissons of the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge tower foundations (ISARC paper)
references.publisher: International Association for Automation and Robotics in Construction
references.scope: 沉箱尺寸、水中混凝土數量、層厚、澆置管與泵送設備等施工數據；不含設計計算。
references.scopeEn: Construction data on caisson size, underwater concrete volume, layer thickness, tremie pipes and pumping plant; no design calculations.

references.title: 明石海峽大橋減振裝置維護減量研究（PIARC 2011 簡報）
references.titleEn: Study on reduction of vibration control devices for the Akashi-Kaikyo Bridge (PIARC 2011 presentation)
references.publisher: PIARC World Road Congress 2011 (Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Expressway)
references.scope: 營運單位簡報：主塔 TMD 數量、風洞與實測位移、容許值與維護週期延長研究。
references.scopeEn: Operator presentation on tower TMD numbers, wind-tunnel and measured displacements, the allowable value and the maintenance-interval study.

references.title: Freyssinet：斜索阻尼器
references.titleEn: Freyssinet: Stay cable dampers
references.scope: 供應商的阻尼器選型表（依索長、行程、耐久累積行程與阻尼效能）、交叉索說明與雙螺旋凸紋套管的阻力係數。
references.scopeEn: Supplier selection table for dampers by cable length, stroke, cumulative-stroke endurance and damping, notes on cross-ties and the drag coefficient of double-spiral ducts.

references.title: Freyssinet：斜拉索系統
references.titleEn: Freyssinet: Cable systems
references.scope: 斜索系統概述，依索長分類的阻尼器類型與試驗依據的規範。
references.scopeEn: Overview of the stay system, damper types by cable length and the standards used for testing.

references.title: Freyssinet：亞武茲蘇丹塞利姆大橋斜索技術案例
references.titleEn: Freyssinet: Yavuz Sultan Selim Bridge stay cable technology case study
references.scope: 超長斜索的阻尼需求、控制桅桿高度與油壓活塞行程，以及錨口導向器試驗。
references.scopeEn: Damping needs of very long stays, control-mast height and hydraulic piston stroke, and anchorage deviator testing.

references.title: fib Bulletin 30：預力鋼斜拉索系統驗收
references.titleEn: fib Bulletin 30: Acceptance of stay cable systems using prestressing steels
references.scope: 國際學會建議涵蓋阻尼裝置在內的設計細部、試驗、安裝與檢查維護範圍。
references.scopeEn: Scope of the international recommendation, including damping devices within detailing, testing, installation and inspection.

references.title: 維基百科：伊拉斯謨大橋（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Erasmusbrug
references.scope: 通車後斜索雨風振動、臨時措施與約一年後加裝永久調諧液壓阻尼器的概覽。
references.scopeEn: Overview of post-opening rain–wind stay vibration, temporary measures and permanent tuned hydraulic dampers about a year later.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 自行式模組運輸車換橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」與「材料驗收試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；自行式模組運輸車換橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path through precast deck joints" and "Material acceptance testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of SPMT bridge replacement must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以超高性能混凝土的短搭接、介面處理與品質驗收，讓預鑄橋面板接縫窄、快且不漏水；自行式模組運輸車換橋則以以支承點改變、軸線容量、地盤承載與封閉時段控制，用自行式模組運輸車在數小時內移除舊橋並放上整跨新橋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on short lap splices, interface preparation and acceptance testing that make UHPC joints between precast deck elements narrow, fast and watertight; SPMT bridge replacement centres on support-point changes, axle-line capacity, ground bearing and closure-window control that let SPMTs remove an old span and set a whole new one within hours, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「接縫介面彎曲應力」與「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到自行式模組運輸車換橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「運輸過程的即時監測與停止條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Joint-interface flexural stress” and “SPMT support points and overhangs”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to SPMT bridge replacement, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Real-time monitoring and stop criteria during the move", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
related.transfer: 可遷移「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」與「材料驗收試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path through precast deck joints" and "Material acceptance testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Span-by-span precast bridge erection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以超高性能混凝土的短搭接、介面處理與品質驗收，讓預鑄橋面板接縫窄、快且不漏水；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設則以以架橋機整跨懸吊預鑄節塊、一次張拉體外鋼腱，讓長距離高架橋以每跨數天的節奏重複推進為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on short lap splices, interface preparation and acceptance testing that make UHPC joints between precast deck elements narrow, fast and watertight; Span-by-span precast bridge erection centres on hanging a whole span of precast segments from a gantry and stressing external tendons at once, so long viaducts advance at a few days per span, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「接縫介面彎曲應力」與「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Joint-interface flexural stress” and “Whole-span box and external tendons”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Span-by-span precast bridge erection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Short-line match casting and curve control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.title: FHWA 技術說明：現澆 UHPC 接縫設計與施工（FHWA-HRT-14-084）
references.titleEn: FHWA TechNote: Design and Construction of Field-Cast UHPC Connections (FHWA-HRT-14-084)
references.publisher: U.S. Federal Highway Administration, Turner-Fairbank Highway Research Center
references.scope: 聯邦公路總署的接縫設計與施工指引，含材料性質、搭接規則、介面處理、模板與驗收試驗及部署紀錄。
references.scopeEn: Federal guidance on joint design and construction with material properties, lap rules, interface preparation, formwork, acceptance tests and deployment records.

references.title: FHWA Every Day Counts 第四輪：預鑄橋梁構件 UHPC 接縫
references.titleEn: FHWA Every Day Counts round 4: UHPC connections for prefabricated bridge elements
references.scope: 說明 UHPC 接縫在快速施工、耐久與免後拉預力方面的推廣理由與期程；不含設計數值。
references.scopeEn: Explains the case for UHPC connections in accelerated construction, durability and elimination of post-tensioning, and the programme period; no design values.

references.title: 維基百科：超高性能混凝土（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Ultra-high performance concrete
references.scope: UHPC 組成與強度範圍的概覽，作為延伸閱讀；工程數據以 FHWA 資料為準。
references.scopeEn: Overview of UHPC constituents and strength range, for further reading; rely on FHWA sources for engineering data.

references.title: FHWA：自行式模組運輸車移除與更換橋梁手冊（FHWA-HIF-07-022）
references.titleEn: FHWA: Manual on Use of Self-Propelled Modular Transporters to Remove and Replace Bridges (FHWA-HIF-07-022)
references.scope: 美國聯邦公路總署手冊，列出軸線承載、接地壓力、行程、速度、動態放大與設計檢核項目。
references.scopeEn: US federal manual giving axle-line capacity, ground pressure, stroke, speed, dynamic allowance and design check items.

references.title: FHWA：SPMT 手冊第 7 章案例研究
references.titleEn: FHWA: SPMT manual Chapter 7, Case Studies
references.scope: Graves Avenue、Badhoevedorp、Wells Street、Lewis and Clark 與 PRA 13 09 等案例的跨度、重量、時間與經驗教訓。
references.scopeEn: Spans, weights, durations and lessons for cases including Graves Avenue, Badhoevedorp, Wells Street, Lewis and Clark and PRA 13 09.

references.title: FHWA：加速橋梁施工手冊（FHWA-HIF-12-013）
references.titleEn: FHWA: Accelerated Bridge Construction Manual (FHWA-HIF-12-013)
references.scope: 把 SPMT、橫移與其他重型移動工法放在加速橋梁施工整體架構中說明。
references.scopeEn: Places SPMTs, lateral slides and other heavy-movement methods within the overall accelerated bridge construction framework.

references.title: 維基百科：自行式模組運輸車（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Self-propelled modular transporter
references.scope: SPMT 的構造與用途概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of SPMT construction and uses, for further reading.

references.title: 美國分段橋協會：分段施工方法（含逐跨工法）
references.titleEn: American Segmental Bridge Institute: Segmental construction methods including span-by-span
references.scope: 產業協會說明逐跨工法的施工順序與適用跨度約至 150 ft；不含個案資料。
references.scopeEn: Industry institute description of span-by-span sequencing and its span range up to about 150 ft; no project data.

references.title: PCI Journal：曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路—世界最長橋梁與最大預製作業
references.titleEn: PCI Journal: Bang Na Expressway, Bangkok, Thailand — World's Longest Bridge and Largest Precasting Operation

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 橋梁預力鋼腱更換
related.transfer: 可遷移「灌漿的功能與鋼腱腐蝕後果」與「灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁預力鋼腱更換的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "What grout does and the consequences of tendon corrosion" and "Grout testing and field mock-ups" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以灌漿材料、孔道與排氣配置、灌漿程序與空洞檢測，確保後拉預力鋼腱數十年不腐蝕；橋梁預力鋼腱更換則以在維持交通下安全移除腐蝕外置鋼腱、重建預力並留下可追溯的鋼腱履歷為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on grout materials, duct and vent layout, grouting procedure and void detection that keep post-tensioning tendons free of corrosion for decades; Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement centres on removing corroded external tendons safely under traffic, restoring prestress and leaving a traceable tendon record, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鋼腱有效預力 P_e」與「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁預力鋼腱更換，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「全橋鋼腱普查與抽樣」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Tendon effective force P_e” and “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Network-wide tendon survey and sampling", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「灌漿的功能與鋼腱腐蝕後果」與「灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "What grout does and the consequences of tendon corrosion" and "Grout testing and field mock-ups" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以灌漿材料、孔道與排氣配置、灌漿程序與空洞檢測，確保後拉預力鋼腱數十年不腐蝕；橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工則以以墩頂不平衡彎矩、懸臂預力與預拱線形控制，安全地由橋墩兩側對稱長出長跨箱梁為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on grout materials, duct and vent layout, grouting procedure and void detection that keep post-tensioning tendons free of corrosion for decades; Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction centres on unbalanced pier moment, cantilever prestress and camber control that let a long-span box girder grow symmetrically from each pier, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鋼腱有效預力 P_e」與「墩頂變高度箱梁」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「線形測量與預拱回饋控制」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Tendon effective force P_e” and “Haunched box girder at the pier”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Geometry survey and camber feedback", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
related.transfer: 可遷移「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」與「全橋鋼腱普查與抽樣」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path of external tendons" and "Network-wide tendon survey and sampling" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Span-by-span precast bridge erection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在維持交通下安全移除腐蝕外置鋼腱、重建預力並留下可追溯的鋼腱履歷；橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設則以以架橋機整跨懸吊預鑄節塊、一次張拉體外鋼腱，讓長距離高架橋以每跨數天的節奏重複推進為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on removing corroded external tendons safely under traffic, restoring prestress and leaving a traceable tendon record; Span-by-span precast bridge erection centres on hanging a whole span of precast segments from a gantry and stressing external tendons at once, so long viaducts advance at a few days per span, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」與「整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” and “Whole-span box and external tendons”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Span-by-span precast bridge erection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Short-line match casting and curve control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
