related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 正交異性鋼橋面板製作
related.transfer: 可遷移「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」與「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；正交異性鋼橋面板製作的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Stress range and fatigue detail categories" and "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Orthotropic steel deck fabrication must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由細節類別、應力範圍與斷裂力學判斷鋼橋裂縫的風險，選擇止裂孔、錘擊或拼接補強並訂定追蹤週期；正交異性鋼橋面板製作則以以面板厚度、肋—面板部分滲透焊、焊接變形與組裝精度控制，製作能承受數億次輪載的輕量鋼橋面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on judging steel-bridge crack risk from detail category, stress range and fracture mechanics, then choosing arrest holes, peening or splices and setting follow-up intervals; Orthotropic steel deck fabrication centres on deck-plate thickness, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, distortion and fit-up control that produce a light steel deck able to survive hundreds of millions of wheel passes, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「蓋板端部焊趾」與「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到正交異性鋼橋面板製作，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cover-plate end weld toe” and “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Orthotropic steel deck fabrication, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗
related.titleEn: Welding inspection of major steel joints
related.transfer: 可遷移「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」與「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Stress range and fatigue detail categories" and "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Welding inspection of major steel joints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由細節類別、應力範圍與斷裂力學判斷鋼橋裂縫的風險，選擇止裂孔、錘擊或拼接補強並訂定追蹤週期；鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗則以以焊接程序、預熱與熱輸入控制、施工停留點與非破壞檢測，確保厚板全滲透焊接頭能承受設計力與地震、疲勞需求為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on judging steel-bridge crack risk from detail category, stress range and fracture mechanics, then choosing arrest holes, peening or splices and setting follow-up intervals; Welding inspection of major steel joints centres on securing thick-plate complete-joint-penetration joints for design, seismic and fatigue demands through procedures, preheat and heat-input control, hold points and nondestructive testing, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「蓋板端部焊趾」與「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「超音波與相位陣列檢測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cover-plate end weld toe” and “Beam-flange CJP groove weld”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Welding inspection of major steel joints, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ultrasonic and phased-array testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 橋梁基礎沖刷監測
related.transfer: 可遷移「監測目的決定量測項目」與「模態識別與環境效應分離」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁基礎沖刷監測的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Objectives define what to measure" and "Modal identification and environmental effects" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bridge-foundation scour monitoring must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從監測問題反推感測器種類、位置、取樣與同步，並把資料變成可行動的警戒與維護決策；橋梁基礎沖刷監測則以以沖刷深度估算、基礎暴露評估、固定式感測器與行動計畫，在洪峰期間判斷何時封橋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on working back from monitoring questions to sensor types, locations, sampling and synchronisation, and turning data into actionable alerts and maintenance decisions; Bridge-foundation scour monitoring centres on scour-depth estimation, foundation-exposure assessment, fixed sensors and plans of action that decide when to close a bridge during a flood peak, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「監測目標清單」與「總沖刷深度三分量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁基礎沖刷監測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「即時監測資料與警戒判斷」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Monitoring objectives list” and “Three components of total scour”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bridge-foundation scour monitoring, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁動態荷重試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「監測目的決定量測項目」與「模態識別與環境效應分離」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁動態荷重試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Objectives define what to measure" and "Modal identification and environmental effects" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Dynamic bridge load testing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從監測問題反推感測器種類、位置、取樣與同步，並把資料變成可行動的警戒與維護決策；橋梁動態荷重試驗則以以受控的車輛、人群與激振試驗量出實際動力放大、頻率與阻尼，並把結果轉成評等與舒適度決策為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on working back from monitoring questions to sensor types, locations, sampling and synchronisation, and turning data into actionable alerts and maintenance decisions; Dynamic bridge load testing centres on measuring actual dynamic amplification, frequency and damping with controlled vehicle, crowd and shaker tests, and turning the results into rating and comfort decisions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「監測目標清單」與「動力放大係數」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁動態荷重試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Monitoring objectives list” and “Dynamic amplification factor”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Dynamic bridge load testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁健康監測感測網
related.transfer: 可遷移「車輛動力效應與衝擊係數」與「動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁健康監測感測網的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance" and "Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以受控的車輛、人群與激振試驗量出實際動力放大、頻率與阻尼，並把結果轉成評等與舒適度決策；橋梁健康監測感測網則以從監測問題反推感測器種類、位置、取樣與同步，並把資料變成可行動的警戒與維護決策為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on measuring actual dynamic amplification, frequency and damping with controlled vehicle, crowd and shaker tests, and turning the results into rating and comfort decisions; Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges centres on working back from monitoring questions to sensor types, locations, sampling and synchronisation, and turning data into actionable alerts and maintenance decisions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「動力放大係數」與「監測目標清單」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁健康監測感測網，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「模態識別與環境效應分離」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Dynamic amplification factor” and “Monitoring objectives list”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Modal identification and environmental effects", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「車輛動力效應與衝擊係數」與「動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Vehicle dynamic effects and impact allowance" and "Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以受控的車輛、人群與激振試驗量出實際動力放大、頻率與阻尼，並把結果轉成評等與舒適度決策；橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗則以以設計風速、相似律、節段與全橋模型試驗，確認長跨橋梁在渦振、馳振與顫振前保有足夠風速餘裕為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on measuring actual dynamic amplification, frequency and damping with controlled vehicle, crowd and shaker tests, and turning the results into rating and comfort decisions; Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing centres on design wind speed, similitude and section and full-bridge model tests that confirm long-span bridges keep enough margin against vortex shedding, galloping and flutter, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「動力放大係數」與「橋面高度設計風速」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Dynamic amplification factor” and “Deck-level design wind speed”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

related.transfer: 可遷移「三級風力準則與角隅修形」與「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping" and "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Mega-column and outrigger structural systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以巨柱合成斷面、外伸桁架力偶、台北盆地基樁與施工期臨時結構的實際數字，深化台北 101 的結構檢核；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deepening Taipei 101 checks with real numbers on composite mega-columns, outrigger couples, basin piles and construction-stage temporary works; Mega-column and outrigger structural systems centres on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Sawtooth corner notches” and “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”.

related.transfer: 可遷移「三級風力準則與角隅修形」與「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Three-tier wind criteria and corner shaping" and "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以巨柱合成斷面、外伸桁架力偶、台北盆地基樁與施工期臨時結構的實際數字，深化台北 101 的結構檢核；高層建築調諧質量阻尼器則以以質量比、調頻與阻尼最佳化，把超高層風振加速度降到舒適度門檻內為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deepening Taipei 101 checks with real numbers on composite mega-columns, outrigger couples, basin piles and construction-stage temporary works; Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings centres on mass ratio, tuning and damping optimisation that bring supertall wind-induced acceleration below comfort limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「角隅鋸齒缺角」與「頂層樓板加速度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Sawtooth corner notches” and “Top-floor acceleration”.

related.title: 高強度混凝土高程泵送
related.transfer: 可遷移「扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度」與「測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高強度混凝土高程泵送的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness" and "Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦扶壁核心、Y 形平面與螺旋退縮，加上高性能混凝土、超高泵送與長期監測，如何撐起 828 m 的高塔；高強度混凝土高程泵送則以把黏稠的高強度混凝土推上數百公尺：靜壓、管壁摩擦、輸送管強度、可泵性與連續供料為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how a buttressed core, Y-shaped plan and spiralling setbacks, with high-performance concrete, extreme pumping and monitoring, carry an 828 m tower; High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete centres on pushing viscous high-strength concrete hundreds of metres up: static head, wall friction, pipeline strength, pumpability and continuous supply, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「Y 形扶壁核心」與「泵送壓力需求」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高強度混凝土高程泵送，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「可泵性試驗、試驗迴路與逐步加高」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Y-shaped buttressed core” and “Pump pressure demand”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to High-elevation pumping of high-strength concrete, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Pumpability tests, test loops and stepwise height increase", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 上海中心大廈

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness" and "Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Shanghai Tower must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦扶壁核心、Y 形平面與螺旋退縮，加上高性能混凝土、超高泵送與長期監測，如何撐起 828 m 的高塔；上海中心大廈則以巨型框架、核心筒與外伸臂三重體系，配合扭轉外形、軟土深基礎與柔性懸掛帷幕的整合設計為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how a buttressed core, Y-shaped plan and spiralling setbacks, with high-performance concrete, extreme pumping and monitoring, carry an 828 m tower; Shanghai Tower centres on A mega-frame, core and outrigger triple system integrated with a twisting form, deep soft-ground foundations and a flexibly hung façade, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「Y 形扶壁核心」與「120° 扭轉外形」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到上海中心大廈，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Y-shaped buttressed core” and “120-degree twist”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Shanghai Tower, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「扭轉漸縮外形與 24% 風載折減」與「軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Twisting tapered form and a 24% wind-load cut" and "Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Mega-column and outrigger structural systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦巨型框架、核心筒與外伸臂三重體系，配合扭轉外形、軟土深基礎與柔性懸掛帷幕的整合設計；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A mega-frame, core and outrigger triple system integrated with a twisting form, deep soft-ground foundations and a flexibly hung façade; Mega-column and outrigger structural systems centres on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「120° 扭轉外形」與「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “120-degree twist” and “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Mega-column and outrigger structural systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Twisting tapered form and a 24% wind-load cut" and "Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Taipei 101 must be respecified.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A mega-frame, core and outrigger triple system integrated with a twisting form, deep soft-ground foundations and a flexibly hung façade; Taipei 101 centres on deepening Taipei 101 checks with real numbers on composite mega-columns, outrigger couples, basin piles and construction-stage temporary works, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「120° 扭轉外形」與「角隅鋸齒缺角」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到台北 101，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “120-degree twist” and “Sawtooth corner notches”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Taipei 101, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 黏滯阻尼器性能驗證
related.transfer: 可遷移「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力」與「心柱油壓阻尼器的性能驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice" and "Verifying the central-column oil dampers" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Viscous-damper performance verification must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦三角形鋼管桁架塔身、獨立鋼筋混凝土心柱與油壓阻尼的「心柱制振」，以及節狀壁樁基礎如何支撐 634 m 電波塔；黏滯阻尼器性能驗證則以以力—速度本構、原型與逐件試驗、安裝置中與系統識別，證明每具黏滯阻尼器提供設計阻尼為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how a triangular tubular steel truss, an independent concrete central column with oil dampers and knuckle-wall foundations carry a 634 m broadcasting tower; Viscous-damper performance verification centres on force–velocity laws, prototype and production tests, installation centring and system identification that prove every viscous damper delivers its design damping, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「三角形到圓形的斷面」與「附加阻尼比」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到黏滯阻尼器性能驗證，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Triangle-to-circle section” and “Supplemental damping ratio”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Viscous-damper performance verification, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how a triangular tubular steel truss, an independent concrete central column with oil dampers and knuckle-wall foundations carry a 634 m broadcasting tower; Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings centres on mass ratio, tuning and damping optimisation that bring supertall wind-induced acceleration below comfort limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「三角形到圓形的斷面」與「頂層樓板加速度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築調諧質量阻尼器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「環境振動量測與系統識別」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Triangle-to-circle section” and “Top-floor acceleration”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

related.transfer: 可遷移「高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工」與「高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；威利斯大樓的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「核心筒與周邊柱環」與「九管束筒與內部腹板」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Willis Tower, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

references.scope: 設計者撰寫：巨柱尺寸與填充範圍、外伸桁架間距與層數、斜撐核心、60 ksi 鋼材、兩級地震與減弱斷面梁。
references.scopeEn: Written by the designers: mega-column size and fill extent, outrigger spacing and depth, braced core, 60 ksi steel, two-level seismic design and reduced beam sections.

references.title: 東南亞大地工程學會期刊：台北 101 群樁基礎之設計與施工（余慶涵，2011）

references.scope: 基樁數量、直徑、入岩長度、筏基厚度、地層、載重試驗與沉陷資料；課程中的計算另為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Pile number, diameter, socket length, raft thickness, ground profile, load tests and settlement data; course calculations are separate teaching assumptions.

references.title: 張國鎮：台北 101 結構工程的新挑戰（講義，永峻工程顧問提供資料）

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 威利斯大樓
related.transfer: 可遷移「削角收分形體與風荷載」與「高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；威利斯大樓的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" and "Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Willis Tower must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以高強混凝土核心筒、周邊延性鋼框架與岩盤基礎，建立兼顧風荷載與結構強健性的混合系統；威利斯大樓則以九個 22.9 m 鋼框管綁成束筒，以內部腹板框架降低剪力遲滯並以分段收進調整質量與風荷載為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A hybrid of high-strength concrete core, ductile perimeter steel frame and rock foundations balancing wind load and structural robustness; Willis Tower centres on nine 22.9 m steel framed tubes bundled together, using interior web frames to cut shear lag and staged terminations to shape mass and wind load, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「削角錐形體量」與「九管束筒與內部腹板」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到威利斯大樓，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「經驗週期公式與實測比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Chamfered tapering massing” and “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Willis Tower, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Empirical period formulas versus measurement", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 結構抗連鎖倒塌設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「削角收分形體與風荷載」與「高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Chamfered tapering form and wind load" and "Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以高強混凝土核心筒、周邊延性鋼框架與岩盤基礎，建立兼顧風荷載與結構強健性的混合系統；結構抗連鎖倒塌設計則以以拉結力、替代路徑、穿孔剪力與懸鏈作用檢核，讓局部破壞不擴散成不成比例的倒塌為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A hybrid of high-strength concrete core, ductile perimeter steel frame and rock foundations balancing wind load and structural robustness; Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design centres on tie forces, alternate paths, punching shear and catenary checks that keep local damage from becoming disproportionate collapse, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「削角錐形體量」與「局部破壞範圍」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到結構抗連鎖倒塌設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「子結構試驗與能量法動力容量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Chamfered tapering massing” and “Extent of local damage”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.scopeEn: Investigating agency's account of WTC 7 storeys, collapse time, the fire and thermal-expansion sequence that failed Column 79, and recommendations; no connection design details.

references.title: NIST：Champlain Towers South 部分倒塌技術結論新聞稿

references.scopeEn: Describes the initiating punching shear failure, design and construction deviations, added loads and corrosion, and the collapse sequence; the final report and recommendations are still to come.

references.title: WBDG：UFC 4-023-03 建築物抗連鎖倒塌設計（2016 年第 3 次修訂）
references.titleEn: WBDG: UFC 4-023-03 Design of Buildings to Resist Progressive Collapse, Change 3 (2016)

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔」與「施工中頻率量測與模型校準」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns" and "Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Mega-column and outrigger structural systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以核心筒、八根混凝土巨柱、外伸臂與 6.5 m 筏基組成的錐形超高層，並以延遲接合處理差異變形；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A tapered supertall of core, eight concrete mega-columns, outriggers and a 6.5 m mat, using delayed connections to manage differential movement; Mega-column and outrigger structural systems centres on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「核心筒與八根巨柱」與「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Core and eight mega-columns” and “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Mega-column and outrigger structural systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 高層建築差異縮短補償
related.transfer: 可遷移「核心筒與巨柱的重力分擔」與「施工中頻率量測與模型校準」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築差異縮短補償的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Gravity sharing between core and mega-columns" and "Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以核心筒、八根混凝土巨柱、外伸臂與 6.5 m 筏基組成的錐形超高層，並以延遲接合處理差異變形；高層建築差異縮短補償則以預測柱與核心筒的彈性、潛變與收縮縮短差，並以標高預抬、延遲接合與監測回饋加以補償為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A tapered supertall of core, eight concrete mega-columns, outriggers and a 6.5 m mat, using delayed connections to manage differential movement; Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings centres on predicting elastic, creep and shrinkage shortening differences between columns and cores and compensating with level corrections, delayed connections and monitoring feedback, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「核心筒與八根巨柱」與「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築差異縮短補償，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Core and eight mega-columns” and “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 束筒高層結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「束筒與剪力遲滯」與「經驗週期公式與實測比對」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；束筒高層結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Bundled tubes and shear lag" and "Empirical period formulas versus measurement" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bundled-tube tall-building systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦九個 22.9 m 鋼框管綁成束筒，以內部腹板框架降低剪力遲滯並以分段收進調整質量與風荷載；束筒高層結構系統則以把數個框架筒束在一起以減少剪力滯後、並讓筒體逐段截止的束筒系統，從鋼構威利斯大樓到混凝土六角束筒為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on nine 22.9 m steel framed tubes bundled together, using interior web frames to cut shear lag and staged terminations to shape mass and wind load; Bundled-tube tall-building systems centres on bundling framed tubes to cut shear lag and let tubes stop at different heights, from the steel Willis Tower to hexagonal concrete bundles, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「九管束筒與內部腹板」與「框架筒剪力滯後」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到束筒高層結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「邊界層風洞試驗與束筒外形」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” and “Shear lag in a framed tube”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bundled-tube tall-building systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Boundary-layer wind-tunnel testing of the bundled form", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 世界貿易中心一號大樓
related.transfer: 可遷移「束筒與剪力遲滯」與「經驗週期公式與實測比對」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；世界貿易中心一號大樓的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Bundled tubes and shear lag" and "Empirical period formulas versus measurement" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of One World Trade Center must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦九個 22.9 m 鋼框管綁成束筒，以內部腹板框架降低剪力遲滯並以分段收進調整質量與風荷載；世界貿易中心一號大樓則以以高強混凝土核心筒、周邊延性鋼框架與岩盤基礎，建立兼顧風荷載與結構強健性的混合系統為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on nine 22.9 m steel framed tubes bundled together, using interior web frames to cut shear lag and staged terminations to shape mass and wind load; One World Trade Center centres on A hybrid of high-strength concrete core, ductile perimeter steel frame and rock foundations balancing wind load and structural robustness, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「九管束筒與內部腹板」與「削角錐形體量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到世界貿易中心一號大樓，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「高強混凝土的溫度監測與強度驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs” and “Chamfered tapering massing”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to One World Trade Center, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Temperature monitoring and strength acceptance of high-strength concrete", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「颱風風荷載與凹角平面」與「風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Typhoon wind and the notched plan" and "Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Mega-column and outrigger structural systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在填海地盤與颱風環境中，以核心筒、八根巨柱、四道外伸臂與摩擦型壁樁支撐 484 m 塔樓；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on supporting a 484 m tower on reclaimed land in a typhoon climate with a core, eight mega-columns, four outrigger levels and friction barrettes; Mega-column and outrigger structural systems centres on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「凹角方形平面」與「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Notched square plan” and “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Mega-column and outrigger structural systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 台北 101
related.transfer: 可遷移「颱風風荷載與凹角平面」與「風洞試驗的相似律與資料換算」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；台北 101的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Typhoon wind and the notched plan" and "Similitude and data conversion in wind-tunnel tests" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Taipei 101 must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在填海地盤與颱風環境中，以核心筒、八根巨柱、四道外伸臂與摩擦型壁樁支撐 484 m 塔樓；台北 101則以以巨柱合成斷面、外伸桁架力偶、台北盆地基樁與施工期臨時結構的實際數字，深化台北 101 的結構檢核為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on supporting a 484 m tower on reclaimed land in a typhoon climate with a core, eight mega-columns, four outrigger levels and friction barrettes; Taipei 101 centres on deepening Taipei 101 checks with real numbers on composite mega-columns, outrigger couples, basin piles and construction-stage temporary works, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「凹角方形平面」與「角隅鋸齒缺角」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到台北 101，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Notched square plan” and “Sawtooth corner notches”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Taipei 101, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。

related.title: 建築施工階段結構分析
related.transfer: 可遷移「混合用途分區與樓板系統」與「風洞試驗與居住舒適度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；建築施工階段結構分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" and "Wind-tunnel testing and occupant comfort" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Construction-stage structural analysis must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦鋼構辦公、預力混凝土飯店住宅與鋼構塔頂的混合分區，以及由上而下的核心筒施工；建築施工階段結構分析則以依真實施工順序逐步啟動構件、荷重與材料齡期，找出臨時狀態的控制內力、變形與接合時機為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on mixed zoning of steel offices, post-tensioned concrete hotel and homes and a steel crown, built with a top-down core; Construction-stage structural analysis centres on activating members, loads and material age in the real construction order to find governing forces, deformations and connection timing in temporary states, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「用途分區與樓板質量」與「一次加載與逐層加載」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到建築施工階段結構分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「施工測量的溫度效應修正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Use zoning and floor mass” and “One-step versus staged loading”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Construction-stage structural analysis, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Temperature correction of construction surveys", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 跨層轉換桁架施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「混合用途分區與樓板系統」與「風洞試驗與居住舒適度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；跨層轉換桁架施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Mixed-use zoning and floor systems" and "Wind-tunnel testing and occupant comfort" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Multi-storey transfer-truss construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦鋼構辦公、預力混凝土飯店住宅與鋼構塔頂的混合分區，以及由上而下的核心筒施工；跨層轉換桁架施工則以把上部柱力經一到三層樓高的桁架轉到下部柱或巨柱時的構件、接頭、安裝、預拱、卸撐與檢驗為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on mixed zoning of steel offices, post-tensioned concrete hotel and homes and a steel crown, built with a top-down core; Multi-storey transfer-truss construction centres on members, joints, erection, camber, de-propping and inspection when one- to three-storey trusses carry upper column loads onto columns or mega-columns below, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「用途分區與樓板質量」與「轉換桁架弦桿與斜桿力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到跨層轉換桁架施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「全滲透焊的超音波檢驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Use zoning and floor mass” and “Transfer-truss chord and diagonal forces”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Multi-storey transfer-truss construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 台北 101
related.transfer: 可遷移「外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角」與「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；台北 101的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "How outriggers restrain core rotation" and "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Taipei 101 must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂；台北 101則以以巨柱合成斷面、外伸桁架力偶、台北盆地基樁與施工期臨時結構的實際數字，深化台北 101 的結構檢核為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers; Taipei 101 centres on deepening Taipei 101 checks with real numbers on composite mega-columns, outrigger couples, basin piles and construction-stage temporary works, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」與「角隅鋸齒缺角」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到台北 101，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「巨柱填充混凝土的配比與充填驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Core rotation and column axial stiffness” and “Sawtooth corner notches”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Taipei 101, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Infill concrete mix and fill acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 上海中心大廈
related.transfer: 可遷移「外伸臂如何約束核心筒轉角」與「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；上海中心大廈的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "How outriggers restrain core rotation" and "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Shanghai Tower must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂；上海中心大廈則以巨型框架、核心筒與外伸臂三重體系，配合扭轉外形、軟土深基礎與柔性懸掛帷幕的整合設計為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers; Shanghai Tower centres on A mega-frame, core and outrigger triple system integrated with a twisting form, deep soft-ground foundations and a flexibly hung façade, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」與「120° 扭轉外形」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到上海中心大廈，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Core rotation and column axial stiffness” and “120-degree twist”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Shanghai Tower, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 束筒高層結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨」與「節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；束筒高層結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Axial load paths and the angle trade-off" and "Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bundled-tube tall-building systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以斜柱軸力同時抵抗重力與側力的斜交網格：斜角取捨、樓板環向繫材、節點、施工幾何與耐火維護；束筒高層結構系統則以把數個框架筒束在一起以減少剪力滯後、並讓筒體逐段截止的束筒系統，從鋼構威利斯大樓到混凝土六角束筒為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on diagrids that carry gravity and lateral load through diagonal axial force: angle trade-offs, floor hoop ties, nodes, erection geometry and fire upkeep; Bundled-tube tall-building systems centres on bundling framed tubes to cut shear lag and let tubes stop at different heights, from the steel Willis Tower to hexagonal concrete bundles, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「斜柱角度」與「框架筒剪力滯後」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到束筒高層結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「邊界層風洞試驗與束筒外形」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Diagonal angle” and “Shear lag in a framed tube”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bundled-tube tall-building systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Boundary-layer wind-tunnel testing of the bundled form", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨」與「節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Axial load paths and the angle trade-off" and "Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Mega-column and outrigger structural systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以斜柱軸力同時抵抗重力與側力的斜交網格：斜角取捨、樓板環向繫材、節點、施工幾何與耐火維護；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on diagrids that carry gravity and lateral load through diagonal axial force: angle trade-offs, floor hoop ties, nodes, erection geometry and fire upkeep; Mega-column and outrigger structural systems centres on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「斜柱角度」與「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Diagonal angle” and “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Mega-column and outrigger structural systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 威利斯大樓

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Shear lag in a framed tube and how bundling helps" and "Boundary-layer wind-tunnel testing of the bundled form" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Willis Tower must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把數個框架筒束在一起以減少剪力滯後、並讓筒體逐段截止的束筒系統，從鋼構威利斯大樓到混凝土六角束筒；威利斯大樓則以九個 22.9 m 鋼框管綁成束筒，以內部腹板框架降低剪力遲滯並以分段收進調整質量與風荷載為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on bundling framed tubes to cut shear lag and let tubes stop at different heights, from the steel Willis Tower to hexagonal concrete bundles; Willis Tower centres on nine 22.9 m steel framed tubes bundled together, using interior web frames to cut shear lag and staged terminations to shape mass and wind load, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「框架筒剪力滯後」與「九管束筒與內部腹板」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到威利斯大樓，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「經驗週期公式與實測比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Shear lag in a framed tube” and “Nine bundled tubes and interior webs”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Willis Tower, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Empirical period formulas versus measurement", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「框架筒剪力滯後」與「斜柱角度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築斜交網格結構，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Shear lag in a framed tube” and “Diagonal angle”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to High-rise diagrid structures, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 液態調諧阻尼器
related.transfer: 可遷移「風致振動與居住舒適度」與「環境振動量測與系統識別」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；液態調諧阻尼器的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort" and "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tuned liquid dampers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以質量比、調頻與阻尼最佳化，把超高層風振加速度降到舒適度門檻內；液態調諧阻尼器則以以水槽晃動頻率、有效水量與水頭損失阻尼，把高樓風致加速度降到舒適度門檻內為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on mass ratio, tuning and damping optimisation that bring supertall wind-induced acceleration below comfort limits; Tuned liquid dampers centres on sloshing frequency, effective water mass and head-loss damping that bring tall-building wind acceleration within comfort limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「頂層樓板加速度」與「屋頂水槽群」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到液態調諧阻尼器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「福祿數相似律與模型試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Top-floor acceleration” and “Rooftop tank array”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tuned liquid dampers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Froude similitude and model testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 黏滯阻尼器性能驗證
related.transfer: 可遷移「風致振動與居住舒適度」與「環境振動量測與系統識別」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort" and "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Viscous-damper performance verification must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以質量比、調頻與阻尼最佳化，把超高層風振加速度降到舒適度門檻內；黏滯阻尼器性能驗證則以以力—速度本構、原型與逐件試驗、安裝置中與系統識別，證明每具黏滯阻尼器提供設計阻尼為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on mass ratio, tuning and damping optimisation that bring supertall wind-induced acceleration below comfort limits; Viscous-damper performance verification centres on force–velocity laws, prototype and production tests, installation centring and system identification that prove every viscous damper delivers its design damping, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「頂層樓板加速度」與「附加阻尼比」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到黏滯阻尼器性能驗證，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Top-floor acceleration” and “Supplemental damping ratio”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Viscous-damper performance verification, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 高層建築調諧質量阻尼器
related.titleEn: Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings
related.transfer: 可遷移「附加阻尼的性能目標」與「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築調諧質量阻尼器的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Performance targets for supplemental damping" and "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以力—速度本構、原型與逐件試驗、安裝置中與系統識別，證明每具黏滯阻尼器提供設計阻尼；高層建築調諧質量阻尼器則以以質量比、調頻與阻尼最佳化，把超高層風振加速度降到舒適度門檻內為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on force–velocity laws, prototype and production tests, installation centring and system identification that prove every viscous damper delivers its design damping; Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings centres on mass ratio, tuning and damping optimisation that bring supertall wind-induced acceleration below comfort limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「附加阻尼比」與「頂層樓板加速度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築調諧質量阻尼器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「環境振動量測與系統識別」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Supplemental damping ratio” and “Top-floor acceleration”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 液態調諧阻尼器
related.transfer: 可遷移「附加阻尼的性能目標」與「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；液態調諧阻尼器的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Performance targets for supplemental damping" and "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tuned liquid dampers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以力—速度本構、原型與逐件試驗、安裝置中與系統識別，證明每具黏滯阻尼器提供設計阻尼；液態調諧阻尼器則以以水槽晃動頻率、有效水量與水頭損失阻尼，把高樓風致加速度降到舒適度門檻內為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on force–velocity laws, prototype and production tests, installation centring and system identification that prove every viscous damper delivers its design damping; Tuned liquid dampers centres on sloshing frequency, effective water mass and head-loss damping that bring tall-building wind acceleration within comfort limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「附加阻尼比」與「屋頂水槽群」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到液態調諧阻尼器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「福祿數相似律與模型試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Supplemental damping ratio” and “Rooftop tank array”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tuned liquid dampers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Froude similitude and model testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 建築施工階段結構分析
related.transfer: 可遷移「縮短的三個來源」與「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；建築施工階段結構分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Three sources of shortening" and "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Construction-stage structural analysis must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦預測柱與核心筒的彈性、潛變與收縮縮短差，並以標高預抬、延遲接合與監測回饋加以補償；建築施工階段結構分析則以依真實施工順序逐步啟動構件、荷重與材料齡期，找出臨時狀態的控制內力、變形與接合時機為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on predicting elastic, creep and shrinkage shortening differences between columns and cores and compensating with level corrections, delayed connections and monitoring feedback; Construction-stage structural analysis centres on activating members, loads and material age in the real construction order to find governing forces, deformations and connection timing in temporary states, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」與「一次加載與逐層加載」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到建築施工階段結構分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「施工測量的溫度效應修正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” and “One-step versus staged loading”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Construction-stage structural analysis, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Temperature correction of construction surveys", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 樂天世界塔
related.transfer: 可遷移「縮短的三個來源」與「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；樂天世界塔的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Three sources of shortening" and "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Lotte World Tower must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦預測柱與核心筒的彈性、潛變與收縮縮短差，並以標高預抬、延遲接合與監測回饋加以補償；樂天世界塔則以以核心筒、八根混凝土巨柱、外伸臂與 6.5 m 筏基組成的錐形超高層，並以延遲接合處理差異變形為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on predicting elastic, creep and shrinkage shortening differences between columns and cores and compensating with level corrections, delayed connections and monitoring feedback; Lotte World Tower centres on A tapered supertall of core, eight concrete mega-columns, outriggers and a 6.5 m mat, using delayed connections to manage differential movement, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」與「核心筒與八根巨柱」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到樂天世界塔，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「施工中頻率量測與模型校準」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” and “Core and eight mega-columns”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Lotte World Tower, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Frequency measurement and model calibration during construction", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦把上部柱力經一到三層樓高的桁架轉到下部柱或巨柱時的構件、接頭、安裝、預拱、卸撐與檢驗；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "From free-form sails to the spherical solution" and "Wind-tunnel testing and blockage" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Thin-shell concrete roof construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以單一球面為母體的預鑄肋拱、環氧接縫與後拉預力，把自由造型的帆形屋殼變成可製造、可架設的結構；薄殼混凝土屋頂施工則以以形狀而非厚度承載：薄膜作用、挫屈敏感度、模板成形與脫模控制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on precast rib arches cut from one sphere, epoxy joints and post-tensioning that turned free-form sails into a buildable structure; Thin-shell concrete roof construction centres on carrying load by form rather than thickness: membrane action, buckling sensitivity, formwork shaping and decentering control, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

related.transfer: 可遷移「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」與「風洞試驗與雷諾數效應」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；張拉膜屋蓋成形的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system" and "Wind-tunnel testing and Reynolds-number effects" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 12 支約 100 m 桅桿、約 70 km 鋼索與 PTFE 玻纖膜構成的輕量索網屋蓋，及其風吸力、索夾與膜片維護；張拉膜屋蓋成形則以由預應力平衡求膜面形狀，經雙軸試驗、裁片補償、展開吊升與分階段張拉，把膜屋蓋做成不積水、不鬆弛的曲面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A lightweight cable-net roof of 12 masts about 100 m high, about 70 km of steel cable and PTFE-glass fabric: wind uplift, clamps and panel upkeep; Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs centres on finding membrane shapes from prestress equilibrium, then biaxial testing, compensated patterns, hoisting and staged tensioning to build roofs that neither pond nor go slack, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」與「邊索垂度與膜預應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Radial net and 12 masts” and “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress”.

related.difference: 本課聚焦以 12 支約 100 m 桅桿、約 70 km 鋼索與 PTFE 玻纖膜構成的輕量索網屋蓋，及其風吸力、索夾與膜片維護；索網屋蓋張拉則以以預拉力賦予索網勁度：鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的張拉策略、力與幾何雙重控制、頻率法驗證與長期索力管理為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」與「預拉力與幾何勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Radial net and 12 masts” and “Prestress and geometric stiffness”.

related.difference: 本課聚焦以 75 cm 等網目鞍形索網、邊索、桅桿與 3 × 3 m 壓克力板構成的 1972 年奧運帳篷屋蓋，及其形狀計算、張拉與保存；索網屋蓋張拉則以以預拉力賦予索網勁度：鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的張拉策略、力與幾何雙重控制、頻率法驗證與長期索力管理為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鞍形索網曲面」與「預拉力與幾何勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Saddle-shaped net surfaces” and “Prestress and geometric stiffness”.

related.difference: 本課聚焦由預應力平衡求膜面形狀，經雙軸試驗、裁片補償、展開吊升與分階段張拉，把膜屋蓋做成不積水、不鬆弛的曲面；倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋則以以 12 支約 100 m 桅桿、約 70 km 鋼索與 PTFE 玻纖膜構成的輕量索網屋蓋，及其風吸力、索夾與膜片維護為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on finding membrane shapes from prestress equilibrium, then biaxial testing, compensated patterns, hoisting and staged tensioning to build roofs that neither pond nor go slack; Millennium Dome roof centres on A lightweight cable-net roof of 12 masts about 100 m high, about 70 km of steel cable and PTFE-glass fabric: wind uplift, clamps and panel upkeep, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「邊索垂度與膜預應力」與「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「風洞試驗與雷諾數效應」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress” and “Radial net and 12 masts”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Millennium Dome roof, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wind-tunnel testing and Reynolds-number effects", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦把會移動的千噸級屋面板當成結構與機械的組合，控制輪壓、驅動、偏斜與運轉風速；大跨度空間桁架提升則以在地面組裝大跨度鋼屋蓋後，以鋼絞線千斤頂或頂升機構整體提升，並控制吊點反力、同步誤差、塔架穩定與就位轉換為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on treating thousand-tonne moving roof panels as combined structure and machinery: wheel loads, drives, skew and operating wind limits; Lifting of long-span space trusses centres on ground-assembling long-span steel roofs and lifting them whole by strand jacks or push-up, controlling lift-point reactions, synchronisation, tower stability and final transfer, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

related.title: 雪梨歌劇院
related.transfer: 可遷移「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」與「成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；雪梨歌劇院的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Shell form and membrane action" and "Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sydney Opera House must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以形狀而非厚度承載：薄膜作用、挫屈敏感度、模板成形與脫模控制；雪梨歌劇院則以以單一球面為母體的預鑄肋拱、環氧接縫與後拉預力，把自由造型的帆形屋殼變成可製造、可架設的結構為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on carrying load by form rather than thickness: membrane action, buckling sensitivity, formwork shaping and decentering control; Sydney Opera House centres on precast rib arches cut from one sphere, epoxy joints and post-tensioning that turned free-form sails into a buildable structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「薄膜內力」與「75 m 共同球面」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雪梨歌劇院，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「風洞試驗與阻塞效應」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Membrane forces” and “Common 75 m sphere”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sydney Opera House, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wind-tunnel testing and blockage", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.titleEn: Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs
related.transfer: 可遷移「殼體形狀與薄膜作用」與「成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；張拉膜屋蓋成形的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Shell form and membrane action" and "Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以形狀而非厚度承載：薄膜作用、挫屈敏感度、模板成形與脫模控制；張拉膜屋蓋成形則以由預應力平衡求膜面形狀，經雙軸試驗、裁片補償、展開吊升與分階段張拉，把膜屋蓋做成不積水、不鬆弛的曲面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on carrying load by form rather than thickness: membrane action, buckling sensitivity, formwork shaping and decentering control; Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs centres on finding membrane shapes from prestress equilibrium, then biaxial testing, compensated patterns, hoisting and staged tensioning to build roofs that neither pond nor go slack, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「薄膜內力」與「邊索垂度與膜預應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到張拉膜屋蓋成形，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Membrane forces” and “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Post-installation membrane tension measurement and acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦以拉結力、替代路徑、穿孔剪力與懸鏈作用檢核，讓局部破壞不擴散成不成比例的倒塌；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭則以以等同現澆與接合式兩種策略、混合預力接頭、套筒續接與支承長度，讓預鑄構架在地震中可靠傳力並能自行復位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

related.transfer: 可遷移「週期延長與隔震改造的動機」與「原型試驗、出廠試驗與試驗設施」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鉛心橡膠支承隔震的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Period lengthening and why to isolate an existing building" and "Prototype tests, production tests and test facilities" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以隔震層延長週期、托換構件轉移荷載、分段頂升施工與性質上下限檢核，保護歷史建築免於地震損傷；鉛心橡膠支承隔震則以以鉛心屈服強度、橡膠側向勁度與等效阻尼，拉長橋梁週期並把位移集中在可檢查的支承為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on period lengthening, load-transfer members, staged jacking and property bounds that protect historic buildings from earthquake damage; Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation centres on lead-core yield strength, rubber lateral stiffness and equivalent damping that lengthen the bridge period and concentrate displacement in inspectable bearings, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

related.difference: 本課聚焦以隔震層延長週期、托換構件轉移荷載、分段頂升施工與性質上下限檢核，保護歷史建築免於地震損傷；黏滯阻尼器性能驗證則以以力—速度本構、原型與逐件試驗、安裝置中與系統識別，證明每具黏滯阻尼器提供設計阻尼為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「隔震層週期」與「附加阻尼比」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Isolated period” and “Supplemental damping ratio”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Viscous-damper performance verification, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

related.transfer: 可遷移「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」與「AISC 341 資格試驗與 ω、β 係數」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦以斷面性質、預力反拱、缺口梁端、翼板連接器與吊裝連接完成度，確保雙 T 梁屋蓋從工廠到使用期間都可靠；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭則以以等同現澆與接合式兩種策略、混合預力接頭、套筒續接與支承長度，讓預鑄構架在地震中可靠傳力並能自行復位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on section properties, prestress camber, dapped ends, flange connectors and completed erection connections that keep double-tee roofs reliable from plant to service; Seismic connections for precast concrete centres on emulative and jointed strategies, hybrid post-tensioned joints, grouted sleeves and seating length that let precast frames transfer seismic force reliably and recentre, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「雙 T 梁斷面」與「樓板隔板接合器」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到預鑄混凝土耐震接頭，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Double-tee section” and “Diaphragm connectors”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic connections for precast concrete, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 薄殼混凝土屋頂施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「雙 T 梁屋蓋的構成與荷載路徑」與「預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；薄殼混凝土屋頂施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Make-up and load path of a double-tee roof" and "Transfer checks and plant quality control" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Thin-shell concrete roof construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以斷面性質、預力反拱、缺口梁端、翼板連接器與吊裝連接完成度，確保雙 T 梁屋蓋從工廠到使用期間都可靠；薄殼混凝土屋頂施工則以以形狀而非厚度承載：薄膜作用、挫屈敏感度、模板成形與脫模控制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on section properties, prestress camber, dapped ends, flange connectors and completed erection connections that keep double-tee roofs reliable from plant to service; Thin-shell concrete roof construction centres on carrying load by form rather than thickness: membrane action, buckling sensitivity, formwork shaping and decentering control, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「雙 T 梁斷面」與「薄膜內力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到薄殼混凝土屋頂施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「成形精度、曲率偏差與挫屈折減」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Double-tee section” and “Membrane forces”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Thin-shell concrete roof construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Form accuracy, curvature deviation and buckling reduction", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.scopeEn: Government index of incident investigation reports with summaries and links, including several precast double-tee incidents.

references.title: 美國職業安全衛生署：2012 年邁阿密戴德學院停車場施工倒塌調查

references.scopeEn: Explains the ungrouted column base, overloaded shim bearing, cascading collapse of double tees and inverted tees, and construction-management failures; the course quotes only public figures.

references.scope: 說明以千斤頂移除雙 T 梁時臨時支撐塔頂部鋼梁挫屈的原因，並列出雙 T 梁尺寸與重量。
references.scopeEn: Explains the buckling of a temporary tower's top beam while a double tee was removed by jacking, with the tee's dimensions and weight.

references.title: 預鑄預力混凝土協會（PCI）
references.titleEn: Precast/Prestressed Concrete Institute (PCI)
references.scope: 預鑄產業技術學會，出版 PCI 設計手冊與 PCI Journal，提供設計資源；課程未引用其專有數據。
references.scopeEn: Precast industry technical institute publishing the PCI Design Handbook and PCI Journal with design resources; the course quotes no proprietary data.

references.title: 紐西蘭坎特伯里地震皇家調查委員會：最終報告第 2 冊目錄

references.scopeEn: Official inquiry Volume 2 on the performance of Christchurch CBD buildings and concrete-standard recommendations, background for precast stair and connection lessons.

references.title: 紐西蘭坎特伯里地震皇家調查委員會首頁
references.titleEn: Canterbury Earthquakes Royal Commission home page
references.scope: 列出最終報告各部分的發布日期與內容範圍。

references.title: 維基百科：The Paramount（舊金山，英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: The Paramount, San Francisco
references.scope: 大樓高度、樓層、完工年份、結構顧問與營造廠的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of the tower's height, floors, completion, structural engineer and contractor, for further reading.

references.title: Empa：創新施工技術通過實地測試（HiLo 屋頂原型）
references.titleEn: Empa: Innovative construction technique passes field test (HiLo roof prototype)
references.scope: HiLo 原型的殼厚、面積、索網與織物模板重量、承載濕混凝土量與噴附施工；不含設計計算。
references.scopeEn: HiLo prototype shell thickness, area, cable-net and textile formwork weights, wet-concrete load and spraying; no design calculations.

references.title: 普林斯頓大學美術館：瑞士結構傳統—Heinz Isler
references.titleEn: Princeton University Art Museum: The Swiss Legacy — Heinz Isler
references.scope: Isler 倒懸膜找形的起源、實驗年份、留置纖維板保溫以避免溫差裂縫。
references.scopeEn: Origin and dates of Isler's inverted hanging-membrane method and left-in-place fibreboard insulation against thermal cracking.

references.title: ACI 334.1R-92《混凝土殼結構實務與解說》摘要

references.scope: 混凝土薄殼分析、配置、配筋與施工的實務指引範圍說明；課程計算另為教學假設。
references.scopeEn: Scope of practical guidance on analysis, proportioning, reinforcing and construction of concrete shells; course calculations are separate teaching assumptions.

references.title: Springer 期刊論文：Isler 混凝土殼的逆向工程分析

references.scope: 八座 Isler 殼的數值分析、厚度範圍、找形方法比較與 Grötzingen 殼的尺寸。
