related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鋼構耐火被覆施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」與「耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鋼構耐火被覆施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments" and "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Structural-steel fireproofing application must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以區劃面積、防火時效、防火門與貫穿填塞、帷幕牆層間防火與樓梯加壓，把高層火災限制在起火區劃並保護結構；鋼構耐火被覆施工則以以臨界溫度、斷面係數與現場厚度、密度、黏結抽驗，確保鋼構件在火害中維持設計耐火時效為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on compartment area, fire resistance, fire doors and penetration firestops, curtain-wall perimeter barriers and stair pressurisation that confine high-rise fires to the compartment of origin and protect the structure; Structural-steel fireproofing application centres on critical temperature, section factor and field thickness, density and bond checks that keep steel members within their rated fire resistance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「防火區劃面積」與「鋼構件臨界溫度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鋼構耐火被覆施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「現場厚度、密度與黏結強度抽驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Compartment floor area” and “Critical steel temperature”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Structural-steel fireproofing application, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Field sampling of thickness, density and bond strength", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 結構抗連鎖倒塌設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「防火區劃的目的、面積與火載量」與「耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；結構抗連鎖倒塌設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Purpose, area and fire load of compartments" and "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以區劃面積、防火時效、防火門與貫穿填塞、帷幕牆層間防火與樓梯加壓，把高層火災限制在起火區劃並保護結構；結構抗連鎖倒塌設計則以以拉結力、替代路徑、穿孔剪力與懸鏈作用檢核，讓局部破壞不擴散成不成比例的倒塌為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on compartment area, fire resistance, fire doors and penetration firestops, curtain-wall perimeter barriers and stair pressurisation that confine high-rise fires to the compartment of origin and protect the structure; Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design centres on tie forces, alternate paths, punching shear and catenary checks that keep local damage from becoming disproportionate collapse, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「防火區劃面積」與「局部破壞範圍」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到結構抗連鎖倒塌設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「子結構試驗與能量法動力容量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Compartment floor area” and “Extent of local damage”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Progressive-collapse-resistant structural design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Subassembly testing and energy-based dynamic capacity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.title: Grenfell Tower 公開調查：第一階段報告

references.scopeEn: Investigating agency's account of WTC 7 storeys, collapse time, the fire and thermal-expansion sequence that failed Column 79, and recommendations; no connection design details.

references.title: 維基百科：One Meridian Plaza（英文）

references.scopeEn: Overview of the 1991 fire's floors, extent of spread, sprinkler stop and standpipe pressure problems, for further reading.

references.title: 維基百科：Grenfell Tower 火災（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Grenfell Tower fire
references.scope: 建築規模、改裝外牆材料、火勢蔓延、避難策略與防火門問題的概覽，作為延伸閱讀。
references.scopeEn: Overview of building size, refurbishment façade materials, fire spread, evacuation strategy and fire-door issues, for further reading.

references.title: NIST：依世界貿易中心調查建議通過的 ICC 建築與消防規範修訂
references.titleEn: NIST: Changes to ICC building and fire codes from the WTC investigation (FY 2008)

references.scope: 說明高層建築 SFRM 黏結強度提高的倍數、現場安裝要求與特別檢驗項目；不含個別產品資料。
references.scopeEn: Describes the multiples by which high-rise SFRM bond strength was raised, field-installation requirements and special-inspection items; no product data.

references.title: NIST：世界貿易中心樓板系統 UL 耐火試驗公開簡報

references.title: NIST：Champlain Towers South 部分倒塌技術結論新聞稿

references.title: WBDG：UFC 4-023-03 建築物抗連鎖倒塌設計（2016 年第 3 次修訂）

references.title: NIST：降低建築物連鎖倒塌潛勢的最佳實務（NISTIR 7396）

references.scopeEn: Describes the risk framework, the tie-force, specific local resistance and alternate-path methods, a review of national standards and case studies.

references.title: 維基百科：Ronan Point（英文）
references.titleEn: Wikipedia: Ronan Point

related.difference: 本課聚焦以臨界溫度、斷面係數與現場厚度、密度、黏結抽驗，確保鋼構件在火害中維持設計耐火時效；高層建築消防分區設計則以以區劃面積、防火時效、防火門與貫穿填塞、帷幕牆層間防火與樓梯加壓，把高層火災限制在起火區劃並保護結構為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on critical temperature, section factor and field thickness, density and bond checks that keep steel members within their rated fire resistance; Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings centres on compartment area, fire resistance, fire doors and penetration firestops, curtain-wall perimeter barriers and stair pressurisation that confine high-rise fires to the compartment of origin and protect the structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鋼構件臨界溫度」與「防火區劃面積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築消防分區設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Critical steel temperature” and “Compartment floor area”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Critical steel temperature” and “ISO 12944 corrosivity category”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Protective coating of large steel structures, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Adhesion and film-defect testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑」與「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；單元式帷幕牆安裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wind load path through an all-glass façade" and "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Unitized curtain-wall installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以玻璃肋的面內彎曲、側向扭轉挫屈、膠合中間膜耦合與破損後承載，控制全玻璃立面的設計、吊裝與驗收；單元式帷幕牆安裝則以以錨定反力、上下單元接縫變位、豎框勁度與安裝公差控制，讓工廠組裝的單元板塊在高層主結構上可靠就位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on in-plane bending, lateral–torsional buckling, interlayer coupling and post-breakage capacity that govern the design, lifting and acceptance of all-glass façades; Unitized curtain-wall installation centres on anchor reactions, stack-joint movement, mullion stiffness and installation tolerance control that seat factory-built units reliably on a tall structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「玻璃肋風壓分擔寬度」與「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Fin tributary wind load” and “Slab-edge anchor reaction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Unitized curtain-wall installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Performance mock-up and racking test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 建築外牆氣密水密試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「全玻璃立面的風壓傳遞路徑」與「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；建築外牆氣密水密試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wind load path through an all-glass façade" and "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Facade air- and water-tightness testing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以玻璃肋的面內彎曲、側向扭轉挫屈、膠合中間膜耦合與破損後承載，控制全玻璃立面的設計、吊裝與驗收；建築外牆氣密水密試驗則以以驅動壓差、壓力等化、洩漏特性與實驗室及現場試驗程序，驗證外牆在風雨中不漏氣、不漏水為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on in-plane bending, lateral–torsional buckling, interlayer coupling and post-breakage capacity that govern the design, lifting and acceptance of all-glass façades; Facade air- and water-tightness testing centres on driving pressure, pressure equalisation, leakage characteristics and laboratory and field procedures that prove a façade keeps out air and rain, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「玻璃肋風壓分擔寬度」與「風壓驅動水頭」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到建築外牆氣密水密試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Fin tributary wind load” and “Wind-driven water head”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Facade air- and water-tightness testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 大型玻璃肋結構安裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力」與「性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大型玻璃肋結構安裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Unit load path and anchor reactions" and "Performance mock-up and racking test" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Structural glass-fin installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以錨定反力、上下單元接縫變位、豎框勁度與安裝公差控制，讓工廠組裝的單元板塊在高層主結構上可靠就位；大型玻璃肋結構安裝則以以玻璃肋的面內彎曲、側向扭轉挫屈、膠合中間膜耦合與破損後承載，控制全玻璃立面的設計、吊裝與驗收為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on anchor reactions, stack-joint movement, mullion stiffness and installation tolerance control that seat factory-built units reliably on a tall structure; Structural glass-fin installation centres on in-plane bending, lateral–torsional buckling, interlayer coupling and post-breakage capacity that govern the design, lifting and acceptance of all-glass façades, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「樓板邊緣錨件反力」與「玻璃肋風壓分擔寬度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大型玻璃肋結構安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「實尺寸試驗與撓度比對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Slab-edge anchor reaction” and “Fin tributary wind load”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Structural glass-fin installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Full-scale testing and deflection comparison", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 建築外牆氣密水密試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「單元板塊荷重路徑與錨定反力」與「性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；建築外牆氣密水密試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Unit load path and anchor reactions" and "Performance mock-up and racking test" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Facade air- and water-tightness testing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以錨定反力、上下單元接縫變位、豎框勁度與安裝公差控制，讓工廠組裝的單元板塊在高層主結構上可靠就位；建築外牆氣密水密試驗則以以驅動壓差、壓力等化、洩漏特性與實驗室及現場試驗程序，驗證外牆在風雨中不漏氣、不漏水為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on anchor reactions, stack-joint movement, mullion stiffness and installation tolerance control that seat factory-built units reliably on a tall structure; Facade air- and water-tightness testing centres on driving pressure, pressure equalisation, leakage characteristics and laboratory and field procedures that prove a façade keeps out air and rain, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「樓板邊緣錨件反力」與「風壓驅動水頭」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到建築外牆氣密水密試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Slab-edge anchor reaction” and “Wind-driven water head”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Facade air- and water-tightness testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cavity types and the solar heat balance" and "Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Unitized curtain-wall installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以腔體熱平衡、浮力通風、外層支撐結構與防火排煙整合，讓雙層幕牆在節能、舒適與安全間取得平衡；單元式帷幕牆安裝則以以錨定反力、上下單元接縫變位、豎框勁度與安裝公差控制，讓工廠組裝的單元板塊在高層主結構上可靠就位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cavity heat balance, buoyancy ventilation, outer-skin support and fire and smoke integration that balance energy, comfort and safety in double-skin façades; Unitized curtain-wall installation centres on anchor reactions, stack-joint movement, mullion stiffness and installation tolerance control that seat factory-built units reliably on a tall structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「通風腔體熱平衡」與「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到單元式帷幕牆安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cavity heat balance” and “Slab-edge anchor reaction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Unitized curtain-wall installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

related.title: 高層建築消防分區設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「腔體類型與日射熱平衡」與「樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築消防分區設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Cavity types and the solar heat balance" and "Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以腔體熱平衡、浮力通風、外層支撐結構與防火排煙整合，讓雙層幕牆在節能、舒適與安全間取得平衡；高層建築消防分區設計則以以區劃面積、防火時效、防火門與貫穿填塞、帷幕牆層間防火與樓梯加壓，把高層火災限制在起火區劃並保護結構為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cavity heat balance, buoyancy ventilation, outer-skin support and fire and smoke integration that balance energy, comfort and safety in double-skin façades; Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings centres on compartment area, fire resistance, fire doors and penetration firestops, curtain-wall perimeter barriers and stair pressurisation that confine high-rise fires to the compartment of origin and protect the structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「通風腔體熱平衡」與「防火區劃面積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築消防分區設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「耐火試驗、判定準則與認可範圍」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Cavity heat balance” and “Compartment floor area”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fire compartmentation in high-rise buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fire-resistance tests, criteria and scope of approval", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」與「氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；單元式帷幕牆安裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure" and "Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Unitized curtain-wall installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以驅動壓差、壓力等化、洩漏特性與實驗室及現場試驗程序，驗證外牆在風雨中不漏氣、不漏水；單元式帷幕牆安裝則以以錨定反力、上下單元接縫變位、豎框勁度與安裝公差控制，讓工廠組裝的單元板塊在高層主結構上可靠就位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on driving pressure, pressure equalisation, leakage characteristics and laboratory and field procedures that prove a façade keeps out air and rain; Unitized curtain-wall installation centres on anchor reactions, stack-joint movement, mullion stiffness and installation tolerance control that seat factory-built units reliably on a tall structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「風壓驅動水頭」與「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到單元式帷幕牆安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Wind-driven water head” and “Slab-edge anchor reaction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Unitized curtain-wall installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Performance mock-up and racking test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 雙層通風幕牆整合
related.transfer: 可遷移「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」與「氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；雙層通風幕牆整合的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure" and "Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Double-skin ventilated facade integration must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以驅動壓差、壓力等化、洩漏特性與實驗室及現場試驗程序，驗證外牆在風雨中不漏氣、不漏水；雙層通風幕牆整合則以以腔體熱平衡、浮力通風、外層支撐結構與防火排煙整合，讓雙層幕牆在節能、舒適與安全間取得平衡為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on driving pressure, pressure equalisation, leakage characteristics and laboratory and field procedures that prove a façade keeps out air and rain; Double-skin ventilated facade integration centres on cavity heat balance, buoyancy ventilation, outer-skin support and fire and smoke integration that balance energy, comfort and safety in double-skin façades, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「風壓驅動水頭」與「通風腔體熱平衡」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雙層通風幕牆整合，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「樣品牆與實建築的熱流量測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Wind-driven water head” and “Cavity heat balance”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Double-skin ventilated facade integration, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Heat-flow measurement on mock-ups and the real building", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 上海中心大廈
related.transfer: 可遷移「尖峰交通需求與服務指標」與「往返時間計算與交通模擬」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；上海中心大廈的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Peak traffic demand and service metrics" and "Round-trip-time calculation and traffic simulation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Shanghai Tower must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以尖峰人流、分區轉乘、曳引極限與派梯演算法，讓超高層垂直運輸在有限核心筒內達到服務目標；上海中心大廈則以巨型框架、核心筒與外伸臂三重體系，配合扭轉外形、軟土深基礎與柔性懸掛帷幕的整合設計為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on peak demand, tiered zoning, traction limits and dispatch algorithms that let supertall vertical transport meet service targets within a limited core; Shanghai Tower centres on A mega-frame, core and outrigger triple system integrated with a twisting form, deep soft-ground foundations and a flexibly hung façade, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上行尖峰人口」與「120° 扭轉外形」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到上海中心大廈，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Up-peak population” and “120-degree twist”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Shanghai Tower, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 哈里發塔
related.transfer: 可遷移「尖峰交通需求與服務指標」與「往返時間計算與交通模擬」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；哈里發塔的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Peak traffic demand and service metrics" and "Round-trip-time calculation and traffic simulation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Burj Khalifa must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以尖峰人流、分區轉乘、曳引極限與派梯演算法，讓超高層垂直運輸在有限核心筒內達到服務目標；哈里發塔則以扶壁核心、Y 形平面與螺旋退縮，加上高性能混凝土、超高泵送與長期監測，如何撐起 828 m 的高塔為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on peak demand, tiered zoning, traction limits and dispatch algorithms that let supertall vertical transport meet service targets within a limited core; Burj Khalifa centres on how a buttressed core, Y-shaped plan and spiralling setbacks, with high-performance concrete, extreme pumping and monitoring, carry an 828 m tower, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上行尖峰人口」與「Y 形扶壁核心」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到哈里發塔，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Up-peak population” and “Y-shaped buttressed core”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Burj Khalifa, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 建築雷射掃描竣工比對
related.transfer: 可遷移「樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突」與「碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；建築雷射掃描竣工比對的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts" and "Clash grouping, false positives and model quality" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Laser-scan verification of as-built construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以空間預算、共用座標、碰撞規則與協調循環，在施工前消除結構與機電之間的空間衝突；建築雷射掃描竣工比對則以以量測不確定度、精度等級、控制配準與偏差分析，判定竣工幾何能否交給下一工序為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on space budgets, shared coordinates, clash rules and coordination cycles that remove structure–services conflicts before construction; Laser-scan verification of as-built construction centres on measurement uncertainty, accuracy levels, controlled registration and deviation analysis that decide whether as-built geometry can pass to the next trade, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「天花板內管線空間」與「竣工偏差與量測不確定度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到建築雷射掃描竣工比對，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「點雲與設計模型的偏差分析」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ceiling service void” and “As-built deviation and measurement uncertainty”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Laser-scan verification of as-built construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Deviation analysis between cloud and design model", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 施工測量控制網
related.transfer: 可遷移「樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突」與「碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；施工測量控制網的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts" and "Clash grouping, false positives and model quality" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Construction surveying control networks must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以空間預算、共用座標、碰撞規則與協調循環，在施工前消除結構與機電之間的空間衝突；施工測量控制網則以以誤差預算、坐標系統、穩定控制點與統計平差，讓放樣、貫通與監測都建立在可信的基準上為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on space budgets, shared coordinates, clash rules and coordination cycles that remove structure–services conflicts before construction; Construction surveying control networks centres on error budgets, coordinate systems, stable control points and statistical adjustment that give set-out, breakthrough and monitoring a trustworthy reference, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「天花板內管線空間」與「主控制網」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到施工測量控制網，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ceiling service void” and “Primary control network”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Construction surveying control networks, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Static GNSS surveys and height conversion", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 工程數位模型碰撞檢查
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何以掃描驗證竣工幾何」與「點雲與設計模型的偏差分析」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；工程數位模型碰撞檢查的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Why verify as-built geometry by scanning" and "Deviation analysis between cloud and design model" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of BIM-based construction clash detection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以量測不確定度、精度等級、控制配準與偏差分析，判定竣工幾何能否交給下一工序；工程數位模型碰撞檢查則以以空間預算、共用座標、碰撞規則與協調循環，在施工前消除結構與機電之間的空間衝突為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on measurement uncertainty, accuracy levels, controlled registration and deviation analysis that decide whether as-built geometry can pass to the next trade; BIM-based construction clash detection centres on space budgets, shared coordinates, clash rules and coordination cycles that remove structure–services conflicts before construction, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「竣工偏差與量測不確定度」與「天花板內管線空間」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到工程數位模型碰撞檢查，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「碰撞分組、誤報與模型品質」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “As-built deviation and measurement uncertainty” and “Ceiling service void”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to BIM-based construction clash detection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Clash grouping, false positives and model quality", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 施工測量控制網
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何以掃描驗證竣工幾何」與「點雲與設計模型的偏差分析」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；施工測量控制網的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Why verify as-built geometry by scanning" and "Deviation analysis between cloud and design model" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Construction surveying control networks must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以量測不確定度、精度等級、控制配準與偏差分析，判定竣工幾何能否交給下一工序；施工測量控制網則以以誤差預算、坐標系統、穩定控制點與統計平差，讓放樣、貫通與監測都建立在可信的基準上為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on measurement uncertainty, accuracy levels, controlled registration and deviation analysis that decide whether as-built geometry can pass to the next trade; Construction surveying control networks centres on error budgets, coordinate systems, stable control points and statistical adjustment that give set-out, breakthrough and monitoring a trustworthy reference, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「竣工偏差與量測不確定度」與「主控制網」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到施工測量控制網，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “As-built deviation and measurement uncertainty” and “Primary control network”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Construction surveying control networks, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Static GNSS surveys and height conversion", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 自行式模組運輸車換橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統」與「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；自行式模組運輸車換橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules" and "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of SPMT bridge replacement must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以角柱荷載路徑、模組間繫結、吊具設計與堆疊公差控制，讓工廠製造的體積模組安全成為整體建築；自行式模組運輸車換橋則以以支承點改變、軸線容量、地盤承載與封閉時段控制，用自行式模組運輸車在數小時內移除舊橋並放上整跨新橋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on corner-post load paths, inter-module ties, lifting-gear design and stacking-tolerance control that turn factory-made volumetric modules safely into one building; SPMT bridge replacement centres on support-point changes, axle-line capacity, ground bearing and closure-window control that let SPMTs remove an old span and set a whole new one within hours, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「角柱與雙層樓板」與「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到自行式模組運輸車換橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「運輸過程的即時監測與停止條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Corner posts and double floors” and “SPMT support points and overhangs”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to SPMT bridge replacement, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Real-time monitoring and stop criteria during the move", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 預鑄混凝土耐震接頭
related.transfer: 可遷移「體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統」與「工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules" and "Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seismic connections for precast concrete must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以角柱荷載路徑、模組間繫結、吊具設計與堆疊公差控制，讓工廠製造的體積模組安全成為整體建築；預鑄混凝土耐震接頭則以以等同現澆與接合式兩種策略、混合預力接頭、套筒續接與支承長度，讓預鑄構架在地震中可靠傳力並能自行復位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on corner-post load paths, inter-module ties, lifting-gear design and stacking-tolerance control that turn factory-made volumetric modules safely into one building; Seismic connections for precast concrete centres on emulative and jointed strategies, hybrid post-tensioned joints, grouted sleeves and seating length that let precast frames transfer seismic force reliably and recentre, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「角柱與雙層樓板」與「樓板隔板接合器」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到預鑄混凝土耐震接頭，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Corner posts and double floors” and “Diaphragm connectors”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic connections for precast concrete, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
